4.8.35 |  tataḥ pravṛtte navame māse puṇye 'hani praśastanakṣatrayogamupagate praśaste bhagavati śaśini kalyāṇe kalyāṇe ca karaṇe maitre muhūrte śāntiṃ hutvā gobrāhmaṇamagnimudakaṃ cādau praveśya gobhyastṛṇodakaṃ madhulājāṃśca pradāya brāhmaṇebhayo 'kṣatān sumanaso nāndīmukhāni ca phalānīṣṭāni dattvodakapūrvamāsanasthebhyo 'bhivādya punarācamya svasti vācayet|
tataḥ puṇyāhaśabdena gobrāhmaṇaṃ *samanuvartamānā[*'anvāvartamānā praviśet'iti pā+] pradakṣiṇaṃ praviśet sūtikāgāram|
tatrasthā ca prasavakālaṃ pratīkṣet||
4.8.36 |  tasyāstu khalvimāni liṅgāni prajananakālamabhito bhavanti; tadyathā---klamo gātrāṇāṃ, glānirānanasya, akṣṇoḥ śaithilyaṃ, *vimuktabandhanatvamiva[*'akṣṇorvimuktabandhanatvamiva'iti pā+] vakṣasaḥ, kukṣeravasraṃsanam, adhogurutvaṃ, vaṃkṣaṇabastikaṭīkukṣipārśvapṛṣṭhanistodaḥ, yoneḥ prasravaṇam, anannābhilāṣaśceti; tato 'nantaramāvīnāṃ prādurbhāvaḥ, prasekaśca garbhodakasya||
4.8.37 |  āvīprādurbhāve tu bhūmau śayanaṃ vidadhyānmṛdvāstaraṇopapannam|
*tadadhyāsīta[*'tadadhyāsīnāṃ tāṃ tataḥ'iti pā+] sā|
tāṃ tataḥ samantataḥ parivārya yathoktaguṇāḥ striyaḥ paryupāsīrannāśvāsayantyo vāgbhir-*grāhiṇīyābhiḥ[*'grāhaṇīyābhirupadiṣṭavadarthābhidhāyinībhiḥ' iti pā+] sāntvanīyābhiśca||
4.8.38 |  sā cedāvībhiḥ saṃkliśyamānā na prajāyetāthaināṃ brūyāt---uttiṣṭha, musalamanyataraṃ gṛhṇīṣva, anenaitadulūkhalaṃ dhānyapūrṇaṃ muhurmuhurabhijahi muhurmuhuravajṛmbhasva caṅkramasva cāntarā 'ntareti; evamupadiśantyeke|
tannetyāha bhagavānātreyaḥ|
dāruṇavyāyāmavarjanaṃ hi garbhiṇyāḥ satatamupadiśyate, viśeṣataśca prajananakāle pracalitasarvadhātudoṣāyāḥ sukumāryā nāryā musalavyāyāmasamīrito vāyurantaraṃ labdhvā prāṇān hiṃsyāt, duṣpratīkāratamā hi tasmin kāle viśeṣeṇa bhavati garbhiṇī; tasmānmusalagrahaṇaṃ parihāryamṛṣayo manyante, jṛmbhaṇaṃ caṅkramaṇaṃ ca punaranuṣṭheyamiti |
athāsyai dadyāt kuṣṭhailālāṅgalikīvacācikatracirabilvacavyacūrṇamupaghrātuṃ, sā tanmuhurmuhurupajighret, tathā bhūrjapatradhūmaṃ śiṃśapāsāradhūmaṃ vā|
tasyāścāntarā 'ntarā kaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭhasakthideśānīṣaduṣṇena *tailenābhyajyānusukhamavamṛd(n?)gīyāt[*'anumukhaṃ'iti pā+]|
anena karmaṇā garbho+*avāk[*'avāggarbhaḥ'iti pā+] pratipadyate||
4.8.39 |  sa yadā jānīyādvimucya hṛdayamudaramasyāstvāviśati, bastiśiro 'vagṛhṇāti, tvarayantyenāmāvyaḥ, parivartate+*adho garbha[*'avāggarbhaḥ'iti pā+] iti; asyāmavasthāyāṃ paryaṅkamenāmāropya pravāhayitumupakrameta|
karṇe cāsyā mantramimamanukūlā strī japet---
'kṣitirjalaṃ viyattejo *vāyurviṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ|
sagarbhāṃ tvāṃ sadā pāntu vaiśalyaṃ ca diśantu te||
[*'indraḥ' iti pā+]
prasūṣva tvamavikliṣṭamavikliṣṭā śubhānane !|
kārtikeyadyutiṃ putraṃ kārtikeyābhirakṣitam' iti||
4.8.40 |  tāścaināṃ yathoktaguṇāḥ striyo 'nuśiṣyuḥ---anāgatāvīrmā pravāhiṣṭhāḥ; *yā[*'yadyanāgatāvīḥ'iti pā+] hyanāgatāvīḥ pravāhate vyarthamevāsyāstat karma bhavati, prajā cāsyā vikṛtā vikṛtimāpannā ca, śvāsakāsaśoṣaplīhaprasaktā vā bhavati|
yathā hi kṣavathūdgāravātamūtrapurīṣavegān prayatamāno 'pyaprāptakālānna labhate kṛcchreṇa *vā[*'vā labhate'iti pā+]  'pyavāpnoti, tathā 'nāgatakālaṃ garbhamapi pravāhamāṇā; yathā caiṣāmeva kṣavathvādīnāṃ sandhāraṇamupaghātāyopapadyate, tathā prāptakālasya garbhasyāpravāhaṇamiti|sā yathānirdeśaṃ kuruṣveti vaktavyā syāt|
tathā ca kurvatī śanaiḥ pūrvaṃ pravāheta, tato 'nantaraṃ balavattaram|tasyāṃ ca pravāhamāṇāyāṃ striyaḥ śabdaṃ kuryuḥ---'prajātā prajātā dhanyaṃ dhanyaṃ putram' iti |
tathā 'syā harṣeṇāpyāyyante prāṇāḥ||
4.8.41 |  yadā ca prajātā syāttadaivaināmavekṣeta---kācidasyā aparā prapannā na veti |
tasyāścedaparā na prapannā syādathaināmanyatamā strī dakṣiṇena pāṇinā nābherupariṣṭādbalavannipīḍya savyena pāṇinā pṛṣṭhata upasaṃgṛhya tāṃ sunirdhūtaṃ nirdhunuyāt|
athāsyāḥ pārṣṇyā śroṇīmākoṭayet |
asyāḥ sphicāvupasaṃgṛhya supīḍitaṃ pīḍayet|
athāsyā bālaveṇyā kaṇṭhatālu parimṛśet|
bhūrjapatrakācamaṇisarpanirmokaiścāsyā yoniṃ dhūpayet|
kuṣṭhatālīsakalkaṃ *balvajayūṣe[*'balvajakvāthe'iti pā+] maireyasurāmaṇḍe tīkṣṇe kaulatthe vā yūṣe maṇḍūkaparṇīpippalīsaṃpāke vā saṃplāvya pāyayedenām|
tathā sūkṣmailākilimakuṣṭhanāgaraviḍaṅgapippalīkālāgurucavyacitrakopakuñcikākalkaṃ kharavṛṣabhasya vā *jīvato[*'kharasyavṛṣasya vā jarato dakṣiṇaṃ parṇamutkṛtya'iti pā+] dakṣiṇaṃ karṇamutkṛtya dṛṣadi jarjarīkṛtya *balvajakvāthādīnāmāplāvanānāmanyatame[*'balvajayūṣādīnāmanyatame'iti pā+] prakṣipyāplāvya muhūrtasthitamuddhṛtya tadāplāvanaṃ pāyayedenām|
śatapuṣpākuṣṭhamadanahiṅgusiddhasya cainām tailasya picuṃ grāhayet|ataścaivānuvāsayet |
etaireva cāplāvanaiḥ phalajīmūtekṣvākudhāmārgavakuṭajakṛtavedhanahastipippalyupahitairāsthāpayet|
tadāsthāpanamasyāḥ saha vātamūtrapurīṣairnirharatyaparāmāsaktāṃ *vāyorevāpratilomagatvāt[*'vāyoranulomagamanāt'iti pā+]|
aparāṃ hi vātamūtrapurīṣāṇyanyāni *cāntarbahirmārgāṇi[*'cāntarbahirmukhāni'iti pā+] sajjanti||
4.8.42 |  tasyāstu khalvaparāyāḥ prapatanārthe karmaṇi kriyamāṇe jātamātrasyaiva kumārasya kāryāṇyetāni karmāṇi bhavanti; tadyathā---aśmanoḥ saṃghaṭṭanaṃ karṇayormūle, śītodakenoṣṇodakena vā *mukhapariṣekaḥ[*'sukhena pariṣekaḥ'iti pā+], tathā sa kleśavihatān prāṇān punarlabheta|
kṛṣṇakapālikāśūrpeṇa cainamabhiniṣpuṇīyuryadyaceṣṭaḥ syād yāvat prāṇānāṃ pratyāgamanam (*tattat sarvameva kāryam[*ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate])|
tataḥ pratyāgataprāṇaṃ prakṛtibhūtamabhisamīkṣya snānodakagrahaṇābhyāmupapādayet||
4.8.43 |  athāsya tālvoṣṭhakaṇṭhajihvāpramārjanamārabhetāṅgulyā suparilikhitanakhayā suprakṣālitopadhānakārpāsa?sapicumatyā|
prathamaṃ pramārjitāsyasya cāsya śirastālu kārpāsapicunā snehagarbheṇa pratisaṃchādayet|
tato 'syānantaraṃ saindhavopahitena sarpiṣā kāryaṃ pracchardanam||
4.8.44 |  tataḥ kalpanaṃ nāḍyāḥ |
atastasyāḥ kalpanavidhimupadekṣyāmaḥ---nābhibandhanāt prabhṛtyaṣṭāṅgulamabhijñānaṃ kṛtvā chedanāvakāśasya dvayorantarayoḥ śanairgṛhītvā tīkṣṇena raukmarājatāyasānāṃ chedanānāmanyatamena-*ārdhadhāreṇa[*'ūrdhvadhāreṇa'iti pā+] chedayet|
tāmagre sūtreṇopanibadhya kaṇṭhe 'sya śithilamavasṛjet|
tasya cennābhiḥ pacyeta, tāṃ lodhramadhukapriyaṅgusuradāruharidrākalkasiddhena tailenābhyajyāt, eṣāmeva tailauṣadhānāṃ cūrṇenāvacūrṇayet|
iti nāḍīkalpanavidhiruktaḥ samyak||
4.8.45 |  asamyakkalpane hi nāḍyā āyāmavyāyāmottuṇḍitā-piṇḍalikā-vināmikā-vijṛmbhikābādhebhyo bhayam|
tatrāvidāhibhirvātapittapraśamanairabhyaṅgotsādanapariṣekaiḥ sarpirbhiścopakrameta gurulāghavamabhisamīkṣya||
4.8.46 |  ato 'nantaraṃ jātakarma kumārasya kāryam|
tadyathā---madhusarpiṣī mantropamantrite yathāmnāyaṃ prathamaṃ prāśituṃ dadyāt|
stanamata ūrdhvametenaiva vidhinā dakṣiṇaṃ pātuṃ purastāt prayacchet|
*athātaḥ[*'athāsya'iti pā+] śīrṣataḥ sthāpayedudakumbhaṃ mantropamantritam||
4.8.47 |  athāsya rakṣāṃ vidadhyāt---ādānīkhadirakarkandhupīluparūṣakaśākhābhirasyā gṛhaṃ samantataḥ parivārayet|
sarvataśca sūtikāgārasya sarṣapātasītaṇḍulakaṇakaṇikāḥ prakireyuḥ |
tathā taṇdulabalihomaḥ satatam-*ubhayakālaṃ[*'ubhayataḥkālaṃ'iti pā+] *kriyetānāmakarmaṇaḥ[*'prāṅnāmakarmaṇaḥ'iti pā+] |
dvāre ca musalaṃ dehalīmanu tiraścīnaṃ nyaset|
vacākuṣṭhakṣaumakahiṅgusarṣpātasīlaśunakaṇakaṇikānāṃ rakṣoghnasamākhyātānāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ poṭṭalikāṃ baddhvā sūtikāgārasyottaradehalyāmavasṛjet, tathā sūtikāyāḥ kaṇṭhe saputrāyāḥ, sthālyudakakumbhaparyaṅkeṣvapi, tathaiva ca dvayordvārapakṣayoḥ|
kaṇakakaṇṭakendhanavānagnistindukakāṣṭhendhanaścāgniḥ sūtikāgārasyābhyantarato nityaṃ syāt|
striyaścaināṃ yathoktaguṇāḥ suhṛdaścānuścānujāgṛyur(anujāgṛyur?)-daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā|
anuparatapradānamaṅgalāśīḥstutigītavāditramannapānaviśadamanuraktaprahṛṣṭajanasaṃpūrṇaṃ ca tadveśma kāryam|
brāhmaṇaścātharvavedavit satatamubhayakālaṃ śāntiṃ juhuyāt svastyayanārthaṃ kumārasya tathā sūtikāyāḥ |
ityetadrakṣāvidhānamuktam||
4.8.48 |  sūtikāṃ tu khalu bubhukṣitāṃ viditvā snehaṃ pāyayeta paramayā śaktyā sarpistailaṃ vasāṃ majjānaṃ vā sātmyībhāvamabhisamīkṣya pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakaśṛṅgaveracūrṇasahitam|
snehaṃ pītavatyāśca sarpistailābhyāmabhyajya veṣṭayedudaraṃ mahatā 'cchena vāsasā; tathā tasyā na vāyurudare vikṛtimutpādayatyanavakāśatvāt|jīrṇe tu snehe pippalyādibhireva siddhāṃ yavāgūṃ susnigdhāṃ dravāṃ *mātraśaḥ [*'mātrāṃ'iti pā+] pāyayet|
ubhayataḥkālaṃ coṣṇodakena ca pariṣecayet prāk snehayavāgūpānābhyām|
evaṃ pañcarātraṃ saptarātraṃ vā 'nupālya krameṇāpyāyayet|
svasthavṛttametāvat sūtikāyāḥ||
4.8.49 |  tasyāstu khalu yo vyādhirutpadyate sa kṛcchrasādhyo bhavatyasādhyo vā, garbhavṛddhikṣayitaśithilasarvadhātutvāt, pravāhaṇavedanākledanaraktaniḥsrutiviśeṣaśūnyaśarīratvācca; tasmāttāṃ yathoktena vidhinopacaret; bhautikajīvanīyabṛṃhaṇīyamadhuravātaharasiddhairabhyaṅgotsādanapariṣekāvagāhanānnapānavidhibhirviśeṣataścopacaret; viśeṣato hi śūnyaśarīrāḥ striyaḥ prajātā bhavanti||
4.8.50 |  daśame *tvahani[*'daśamyāṃ niśyatītāyām'iti pā+] saputrā strī sarvagandhauṣadhairgaurasarṣapalodhraiśca snātā laghvahataśucivastraṃ *paridhāya[*'laghvahatavastraparihitā'iti pā+] pavitreṣṭalaghuvicitrabhūṣaṇavatī ca saṃspṛśya maṅgalānyucitāmarcayitvā ca devatāṃ śikhinaḥ śuklavāsaso 'vyaṅgāṃśca brāhmaṇān svasti vācayitvā *kumāramahatānāṃ ca vāsasāṃ saṃcaye prākśirasamudakśirasaṃ vā saṃveśya [*'kumāramahatena vāsasā++ācchādayet prākśirasamudakśirasaṃ vā saṃveśya'iti pā+] devatāpūrvaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ praṇamatītyuktvā kumārasya pitā dve nāmanī kārayennākṣatrikaṃ nāmābhiprāyikaṃ ca |
tatrābhiprāyikaṃ ghoṣavadādyantasthāntamūṣmāntaṃ vā+*avṛddhaṃ tripuruṣānūkamanavapratiṣṭhitaṃ [*'vṛddhatripuruṣāntaraṃ'iti pā+], nākṣātrikaṃ tu *nakṣatradevatāsamānākhyaṃ[*'nakṣatradevatāsaṃyuktaṃ kṛtaṃ'iti pā+] dvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā||4.8.51 |  *vṛtte [*'kṛte'iti pā+] ca nāmakarmaṇi kumāraṃ parīkṣitumupakrametāyuṣaḥ pramāṇajñānahetoḥ|
tatremānyāyuṣmatāṃ kumārāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni bhavanti|
tadyathā---ekaikajā mṛdavo 'lpāḥ snigdhāḥ subaddhamūlāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ keśāḥ praśasyante, sthirā bahalā tvak, prakṛtyā 'tisaṃpannamīṣat-*pramāṇātivṛttamanurūpamātapatropamaṃ [*'pramāṇātiriktaṃ'iti pā+] śiraḥ, vyūḍhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ samaṃ suśliṣṭaśaṅkhasandhyūrdhvavyañjanasaṃpannamupacitaṃ valibhamardhacandrākṛti lalāṭaṃ, bahalau vipulasamapīṭhau samau nīcairvṛddhau pṛṣṭhato 'vanatau suśliṣṭakarṇaputrakau mahācchidrau karṇau, īṣatpralambinyāvasaṃgate same saṃhate mahatyau bhuvau, same samāhitadarśane vyaktabhāgavibhāge balavatī tejasopapanne svaṅgāpāṅge cakṣuṣī, ṛjvī mahocchvāsā vaṃśasaṃpanneṣadavanatāgrā nāsikā, mahadṛjusuniviṣṭadantamāsyam, āyāmavistāropapannā ślakṣṇā tanvī  *prakṛtivarṇayuktā [*'prakṛtiyuktā pāṭalavarṇā'iti pā+] jihvā, ślakṣṇaṃ yuktopacayamūṣmopapannaṃ raktaṃ tālu, mahānadīnaḥ snigdho 'nunādī gambhīrasamuttho dhīraḥ svaraḥ, nātisthūlau nātikṛśau vistāropapannāvāsyapracchādanau raktāvoṣṭhau, mahatyau hanū, vṛttā nātimahatī grīvā,vyūḍhamupacitamuraḥ, gūḍhaṃ jatru pṛṣṭhavaṃśaśca, viprakṛṣṭāntarau stanau, asaṃpātinī sthire pārśve, vṛttaparipūrṇāyatau bāhū sakthinī aṅgulayaśca, mahadupacitaṃ pāṇipādaṃ, sthirā vṛttāḥ snigdhāstāmrāstuṅgāḥ kūrmākārāḥ karajāḥ, pradakṣiṇāvartā sotsaṅgā ca nābhiḥ, urastribhāgahīnā samā samupacitamāṃsā kaṭī, vṛttau sthiropacitamāṃsau nātyunnatau nātyavanatau sphicau, anupūrvaṃ vṛttāvupacayayuktāvūrū, nātyupacite nātyapacite eṇīpade pragūḍhasirāsthisandhī jaṅghe, nātyupacitau nātyapacitau gulphau, pūrvopadiṣṭaguṇau pādau kūrmākārau, prakṛtiyuktāni vātamūtrapurīṣaguhyāni tathā svapr(n?)ajāgaraṇāyāsasmitaruditastanagrahaṇāni, yacca kiñcidanyadapyanuktamasti tadapi sarvaṃ prakṛtisaṃpannamiṣṭaṃ, viparītaṃ punaraniṣṭam|
iti dīrghāyurlakṣaṇāni||
4.8.52 |  ato dhātrīparīkṣāmupadekṣyāmaḥ |
atha brūyāt---dhātrīmānaya samānavarṇāṃ yauvanasthāṃ nibhṛtāmanāturāmavyaṅgāmavyasanāmavirūpām-*ajugupsitāṃ [*'avijugupsāmajugupsitāṃ'iti pā+] deśajātīyāmakṣudrāmakṣudrakarmiṇīṃ kule jātāṃ vatsalāmarogāṃ jīvadvatsāṃ puṃvatsāṃ dogdhrīmapramattāmanuccāraśāyinīmanantyāvasāyinīṃ kuśalopacārāṃśucimaśucidveṣiṇīṃ stanastanyasaṃpadupetāmiti||
4.8.53 |  tatreyaṃ stanasaṃpat---nātyūrdhvau nātilambāvanatikṛśāvanatipīnau yuktapippalakau sukhaprapānau ceti (stanasaṃpat)||
4.8.54 |  stanyasaṃpattu prakṛtivarṇagandharasasparśam, udapātre ca duhyamānamudakaṃ vyeti prakṛtibhūtatvāt; tat puṣṭikaramārogyakaraṃ ceti(stanyasaṃpat)||
4.8.55 |  ato 'nyathā vyāpannaṃ jñeyam|
tasya viśeṣāḥ---śyāvāruṇavarṇaṃ kaṣāyānurasaṃ viśadamanālakṣyagandhaṃ rūkṣaṃ dravaṃ phenilaṃ laghvatṛptikaraṃ karśanaṃ vātavikārāṇāṃ kartṛ vātopasṛṣṭaṃ *kṣīramabhijñeyaṃ [*'kṣīramiti jñeyam'iti pā+]; kṛṣṇanīlapītatāmrāvabhāsaṃ tiktāmlakaṭukānurasaṃ kuṇaparudhiragandhi bhṛśoṣṇaṃ pittavikārāṇāṃ kartṛ ca pittopasṛṣṭaṃ kṣīramabhijñeyam, atyarthaśuklamatimādhuryopapannaṃ lavaṇānurasaṃ ghṛtatailavasāmajjagandhi picchilaṃ tantumadudakapātre 'vasīdach(cch?)leṣmavikārāṇāṃ kartṛ śleṣmopasṛṣṭaṃ kṣīramabhijñeyam||
4.8.56 |  teṣāṃ tu trayāṇāmapi kṣīradoṣāṇāṃ prativiśeṣamabhisamīkṣya yathāsvaṃ yathādoṣaṃ ca vamanavirecanāsthāpanānuvāsanāni vibhajya kṛtāni praśamanāya bhavanti|
pānāśanavidhistu duṣṭakṣīrāyā yavagodhūmaśāliṣaṣṭikamudgahareṇukakulatthasurāsauvīrakamaireyamedakalaśunakarañjaprāyaḥ syāt|
kṣīradoṣaviśeṣāṃścāvekṣyāvekṣya tattadvidhānaṃ kāryaṃ syāt|
pāṭhāmahauṣadhasuradārumustamūrvāguḍūcīvatsakaphalakirātatiktakakaṭukarohiṇīsārivākaṣāyāṇāṃ ca pānaṃ praśasyate, tathā 'nyeṣāṃ *tiktakaṣāyakaṭukamadhurāṇāṃ [*'tiktakaṣāyakaṭukaprāyāṇāṃ'iti pā+] dravyāṇāṃ prayogaḥ kṣīravikāraviśeṣānabhisamīkṣya mātrāṃ kālaṃ ca |
iti kṣīraviśodhanāni||
4.8.57 |  kṣīrajananāni tu madyāni sīdhuvarjyāni, grāmyānūpaudakāni ca śākadhānyamāṃsāni, dravamadhurāmlalavaṇabhūyiṣṭhāścāhārāḥ, kṣīriṇyaścauṣadhayaḥ, kṣīrapānamanāyāsaśca, vīraṇaṣaṣṭikaśālīkṣuvālikādarbhakuśakāśagundretkaṭamūlakaṣāyāṇāṃ ca pānamiti(kṣīrajananāni)||
4.8.58 |  dhātrī tu yadā svādubahulaśuddhadugdhā syāttadā snātānuliptā śuklavastraṃ paridhāyaindrīṃ brāhmīṃ śatavīryāṃ sahasravīryāmamoghāmavyathāṃ śivāmariṣṭāṃ vāṭyapuṣpīṃ *viṣvaksenakāntāṃ vā bibhratyoṣadhiṃ [*'viṣvaksenakāntāmiti bibhratyoṣadhīḥ'iti pā+] kumāraṃ prāṅmukhaṃ prathamaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ stanaṃ pāyayet|
iti dhātrīkarma||
4.8.59 |  ato 'nantaraṃ kumārāgāravidhimanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ---vāstuvidyākuśalaḥ praśastaṃ ramyamatamaskaṃ nivātaṃ pravātaikadeśaṃ dṛḍhamapagataśvāpadapaśudaṃṣṭrimūṣikapataṅgaṃ suvibhaktasalilolūkhalamūtravarcaḥsthānasnānabhūmimahānasamṛtusukhaṃ yathartuśayanāsanāstaraṇasaṃpannaṃ kuryāt; tathā suvihitarakṣāvidhānabalimaṅgalahomaprāyaścittaṃ śucivṛddhavaidyānuraktajanasaṃpūrṇam|
iti kumārāgāravidhiḥ||
4.8.60 |  śayanāsanāstaraṇaprāvaraṇāni kumārasya mṛdulaghuśucisuganghīni syuḥ; svedamalajantumanti mūtrapurīṣopasṛṣṭāni ca varjyāni syuḥ; asati saṃbhave 'nyeṣāṃ tānyeva ca suprakṣālitopadhānāni sudhūpitāni śuddhaśuṣkāṇyupayogaṃ gaccheyuḥ||
4.8.61 |  dhūpanāni punarvāsasāṃ śayanāstaraṇaprāvaraṇānāṃ ca yavasarṣapātasīhiṅgugugguluvacācorakavayaḥsthāgolomījaṭilāpalaṅkaṣāśokarohiṇīsarpanirmokāṇi ghṛtayuktāni syuḥ||
4.8.62 |  maṇayaśca dhāraṇīyāḥ kumārasya khaḍgarurugavayavṛṣabhāṇāṃ jīvatāmeva dakṣiṇebhyo viṣāṇebhyo 'grāṇi gṛhītāni syuḥ; aindryādyāścauṣadhayo jīvakarṣabhakau ca, yāni cānyānyapi brāhmaṇāḥ praśaṃseyuratharvavedavidaḥ||
4.8.63 |  krīḍanakāni khalu kumārasya vicitrāṇi ghoṣavantyabhirāmāṇi cāgurūṇi cātīkṣṇāgrāṇi cānāsyapraveśīni cāprāṇaharāṇi cāvitrā sanāni syuḥ||
4.8.64 |  na hyasya vitrāsanaṃ sādhu|
tasmāttasmin rudatyabhuñjāne vā 'nyatra vidheyatāmagacchati rākṣasapiśācapūtanādyānāṃ nāmānyāhvayatā kumārasya vitrāsanārthaṃ nāmagrahaṇaṃ na kāryaṃ syāt||
4.8.65 |  yadi tvāturyaṃ kiñcit kumāramāgacchet tat prakṛtinimittapūrvarūpaliṅgopaśayaviśeṣaistattvato 'nubudhya sarvaviśeṣānāturauṣadhadeśakālāśrayānavekṣamāṇaścikitsitumārabhetainaṃ madhuramṛdulaghusurabhiśītaśaṅkaraṃ karma pravartayan|
evaṃsātmyā hi kumārā bhavanti |
tathā te śarma labhante cirāya|
aroge tvarogavṛttamātiṣṭheddeśakālātmaguṇaviparyayeṇa vartamānaḥ, krameṇāsātmyāni parivartyopayuñjānaḥ sarvāṇyahitāni varjayet|
tathā balavarṇaśarīrāyuṣāṃ saṃpadamavāpnotīti||
4.8.66 |  evamenaṃ kumāramāyauvanaprāpterdharmārthakauśalāgamanāccānupālayet||
4.8.67 |  iti putrāśiṣāṃ samṛddhikaraṃ karma vyākhyātam|
tadācaran yathoktairvidhibhiḥ pūjāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ labhate 'nasūyaka iti||
4.8.68 |  tatra ślokau---
putrāśiṣāṃ karma samṛddhikārakaṃ
yaduktametanmahadarthasaṃhitam|
tadācaran jño vidhibhiryathātathaṃ
pūjāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ labhate 'nasūyakaḥ||
4.8.69 |  śarīraṃ cintyate sarvaṃ daivamānuṣasaṃpadā|
sarvabhāvairyatastasmācchārīraṃ sthānamucyate||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte śārīrasthāne jātisūtrīyaṃ śārīraṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8 | |

śārīrasthānaṃ saṃpūrṇam|


indriyasthānam|

prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.1.1 |  athāto varṇasvarīyamindiyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.1.2 |  iti hasmāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.1.3 |  iha khalu varṇaśca svaraśca gandhaśca rasaśca sparśaśca cakṣuśca śrotraṃ ca ghrāṇaṃ ca rasanaṃ ca sparśanaṃ ca sattvaṃ ca bhaktiśca śaucaṃ ca śīlaṃ cācāraśca smṛtiścākṛtiśca prakṛtiśca vikṛtiśca balaṃ ca glāniśca medhā ca harṣaśca raukṣyaṃ ca snehaśca tandrā cārambhaśca gauravaṃ ca lāghavaṃ ca guṇāścāhāraśca vihāraścāhārapariṇāmaścopāyaścāpāyaśca vyādhiśca vyādhipūrvarūpaṃ ca vedanāścopadravāśca cchāyā ca praticchāyā ca svapnadarśanaṃ ca dūtādhikāraśca pathi cautpātikaṃ cāturakule bhāvāvasthāntāaṇi ca 1bheṣajasaṃvṛttiśca bheṣajavikārayuktiśceti parīkṣyāṇi pratyakṣānumānopadeśairāyuṣaḥ pramāṇāvaśeṣaṃ jijñāsamānena bhiṣajā||
5.1.4 |  tatra tu khalveṣāṃ parīkṣyāṇāṃ kānicit puruṣamanāśritāni, kānicicca puruṣasaṃśrayāṇi|
tatra yāni puruṣamanāśritāni tānyupadeśato yuktitaśca parīkṣeta, puruṣasaṃśrayāṇi punaḥ prakṛtito vikṛtitaśca||
5.1.5 |  tatra prakṛtir jātiprasaktā ca, kulaprasaktā ca, 1deśānupātinī ca, kālānupātinī ca, vayo 'nupātinī ca, pratyātmaniyatā ceti|
jātikuladeśakālavayaḥpratyātmaniyatā hi teṣāṃ teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ te te bhāvaviśeṣā bhavanti||
5.1.6 |  vikṛtiḥ punarlakṣaṇanimittā ca, lakṣyannimittā ca, nimittānurūpā ca||
5.1.7(1)| tatra lakṣaṇanimittā nāma sā yasyāḥ śarīre lakṣaṇānyeva hetubhūtāni bhavanti daivāt; lakṣaṇāni hi kāniciccharīropanibaddhāni bhavanti, yāni hi tasmiṃstasmin kāle tatrādhiṣṭhānamāsādya tāṃ tāṃ vikṛtimutpādayanti||
5.1.7(2)| lakṣyanimittā tu sā yasyā upalabhyate nimittaṃ 1yathoktaṃ nidāneṣu||
5.1.7 |  nimittānurūpā tu nimittārthānukāriṇī yā, tāmanimittāṃ nimittamāyuṣaḥ pramāṇajñānasyecchanti bhiṣajo bhūyaścāyuṣaḥ kṣayanimittāṃ pretaliṅgānurūpāṃ, yāmāyuṣo+1antargatasya jñānārthamupadiśanti dhīrāḥ|
yāṃ cādhikṛtya puruṣasaṃśrayāṇi mumūrṣatāṃ lakṣaṇānyupadekṣyāmaḥ|
ityuddeśaḥ|
taṃ vistareṇānuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.1.8 |  tatrādita eva varṇādhikāraḥ|
tadyathā---kṛṣṇaḥ, 1śyāmaḥ, śyāmāvadātaḥ, avadātaśceti prakṛtivarṇāḥ śarīrasya bhavanti; 1yāṃścāparānupekṣamāṇo vidyādanūkato 'nyathā vā 'pi nirdiśyamānāṃstajjñaiḥ||
5.1.9 |  nīlaśyāvatāmraharitaśuklāśca varṇāḥ śarīrasya vaikārikā bhavanti; yāṃścāpara-1anupekṣamāṇo vidyāt 1prāgvikṛtānabhūtvotpannān|
iti prakṛtivikṛtivarṇā bhavantyuktāḥ śarīrasya||
5.1.9 |  tatra prakṛtivarṇamardhaśarīre vikṛtivarṇamardhaśarīre, dvāvapi varṇau maryādānibhaktau dṛṣṭvā; yadyevaṃ savyadakṣiṇavibhāgena, yadyevaṃ pūrvapaścimavibhāgena, yadyuttarādharavibhāgena, yadyantarbahirvibhāgena, āturasyāriṣṭamiti vidyāt; evameva varṇabhedo mukhe+1apyanyatra vartamāno maraṇāya bhavati||
5.1.10 |  varṇabhedena glāviharṣaraukṣyasnehā vyākhyātāḥ||
5.1.11 |  tathā pipluvyaṅgatilakālakapiḍakānāmanyatamasyānane janmāturasyaivamevāpraśastaṃ vidyāt||
5.1.12 |  nakhanayanavadanamūtrapurīṣahastapādauṣṭhādiṣvapi ca vaikārikoktānāṃ varṇānāmanyatamasya prādurbhāvo hīnabalavarṇendriyeṣu lakṣaṇamāyuṣaḥ kṣayasya bhavati||
5.1.13 |  yaccānyadapi kiṃcidvarṇavaikṛtamabhūtapūrvaṃ sahasotpadyetānimittameva hīyamānasyāturasya śaśvat, tadariṣṭamiti vidyāt|
iti varṇādhikāraḥ||
5.1.14 |  svarādhikārastu---haṃsakrauñcanemidundubhikalaviṅkakākakapotajarjarānukārāḥ prakṛtisvarā bhavanti; yāṃścāpara-1anupekṣamāṇo 'pi vidyādanūkarto 'nyathā vā 'pi virdiśyamānāṃstajñaiḥ|
1eḍakakalagrastānyaktagadgadakṣāmadīnānukīrṇāstvāturāṇāṃ svarā vaikārikā bhavanti; yāṃścāpara-1anupekṣamāṇo 'pi vidyāt 1prāgvikṛtānabhūtvotpannān|
iti prakṛtivikṛtisvarā vyākhyātā bhavanti||
5.1.15 |  tatra prakṛtivaikārikāṇāṃ svarāṇāmāśvabhinirvṛttiḥ 1svarānekatvamekasya cānekatvamapraśastam|
iti svarādhikāraḥ||
5.1.16 |  iti varṇasvarādhikārau yathāvaduktau mumūrṣatāṃ lakṣaṇajñānārthamiti||
5.1.17 |  bhavanti cātra---
yasya vaikāriko varṇaḥ śarīra upapadyate|
ardhe vā yadi vā kṛtsne nimittaṃ na ca nāsti saḥ||
5.1.18 |  nīlaṃ vā yadi vā śyāvaṃ tāmraṃ vā yadi vā 'ruṇam|
mukhārdhamanyathā varaṇo mukhārdhe 'riṣṭamucyate||
5.1.19 |  sneho mukhārdhe suvyakto 1raukṣyamardhamukhe bhṛśam|
glānirardhe tathā harṣo mukhārdhe pretalakṣaṇam||
5.1.20 |  tilakāḥ pipalavo vyaṅgā rājayaśca pṛthagvidhāḥ|
āturasyāśu jāyante mukhe prāṇān mumukṣataḥ||
5.1.21 |  puṣpāṇi nakhadanteṣu paṅko vā dantasaṃśritaḥ|
cūrṇako vā 'pi danteṣu lakṣaṇaṃ 1maraṇasya tat||
5.1.22 |  auṣṭhayoḥ pādayoḥ pāṇyorakṣṇormūtrapurīṣayoḥ|
nakheṣvapi ca vaivarṇyametat kṣīṇabale 'ntakṛt||
5.1.23 |  yasya nīlāvubhāvoṣṭhau pakvajāmbavasannibhau|
mumūrṣuriti taṃ vidyānnaro dhīro gatāyuṣam||
5.1.24 |  eko vā yadi vā 'neko yasya vaikārikaḥ svaraḥ|
sahasotpadyate jantorhīyamānasya nāsti saḥ||
5.1.25 |  yaccānyadapi kiñcit syādvaikṛtaṃ svaravarṇayoḥ|
balamāṃsavihīnasya tat sarvaṃ 1maraṇodayam||
5.1.26 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
iti varṇasvarāvuktau lakṣaṇārthaṃ mumūrṣatām|
1yastau samyagvijānāti nāyurjñāne sa muhyati||

ityagviceśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne varṇasvarīyamindriyaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1 | |


dvitīye 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.2.1 |  athātaḥ puṣpitakamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.2.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.2.3 |  puṣpaṃ yathā pūrvarūpaṃ phalasyeha bhaviṣyataḥ|
tathā liṅgamariṣṭākhyaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ mariṣyataḥ||
5.2.4 |  apyevaṃ tu bhavet puṣpaṃ phalenānanubandhi yat|
phalaṃ cāpi bhavet kiñcidyasya puṣpaṃ na 1pūrvajam||
5.2.5 |  na tvariṣṭasya jātasya nāśo 'sti maraṇādṛte|
maraṇaṃ cāpi tannāsti yannāriṣṭapuraḥsaram||
5.2.6 |  mithyādṛṣṭamariṣṭābhamanariṣṭamajānatā|
ariṣṭaṃ vā 'pyasaṃbuddhametat prajñāparādhajam||
5.2.7 |  jñānasaṃbodhanārthaṃ tu liṅgairmaraṇapūrvajaiḥ|
puṣpitānupadekṣyāmo narān 1bahuvidhairbahūn|
5.2.8 |  nānāpuṣpopamo gandho yasya 1bhāti divāniśam|
puṣpitasya vanasyeva nānādrumalatāvataḥ||
5.2.9 |  tamāhuḥ puṣpitaṃ dhīrā naraṃ maraṇalakṣaṇaiḥ|
sa 1nā saṃvatsarāddehaṃ jahātīti viniścayaḥ||
5.2.10 |  evamekaikaśaḥ puṣpairyasya gandhaḥ samo bhavet|
iṣṭairvā yadi vā 'niṣṭaiḥ sa ca puṣpita ucyate||
5.2.11 |  samāsenāśubhān gandhānekatvenāthavā punaḥ|
ājighredyasya gātreṣu taṃ vidyāt puṣpitaṃ bhiṣak||
5.2.12 |  āpulutānāplute kāye yasya gandhāḥ śubhāśubhāḥ|
vyatyāsenānimittāḥ syuḥ sa ca puṣpita ucyate||
5.2.13 |  tadyathā-candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tagarāguruṇī madhu|
mālyaṃ mūtrapurīṣe ca *mṛtāni kuṇapāni ca||
5.2.14 |  ye cānye vividhātmāno gandhā vividhayonayaḥ|
te 'pyanenānumānena vijñeyā vikṛtiṃ gatāḥ||
5.2.15 |  idaṃ cāpyatideśārthaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ gandhasaṃśrayam|
vakṣyāmo yadabhijñāya bhiṣaṅnaraṇamādiśet||
5.2.16 |  1viyonirviduro gandho yasya gātreṣu jāyate|
iṣṭo vā yadi vā 'niṣṭo na sa jīvati tāṃ samām||
5.2.17 |  etāvadgandhavijñānaṃ,rasajñānamataḥ param|
āturāṇaṃ śarīreṣu vakṣyate vidhipūrvakam||
5.2.18 |  yo rasaḥ prakṛtisthānāṃ narāṇāṃ dehasaṃbhavaḥ|
sa eṣāṃ carame kāle vikāraṃ bhajate dvayam||
5.2.19 |  kaścidevāsyavairasyamatyarthamupapadyate|
svādutvamaparaścāpi vipulaṃ bhajate rasaḥ||
5.2.20 |  tamanenānumānena vidyādvikṛtimāgatam|
manuṣyo hi manuṣyasya kathaṃ rasamavāpnuyāt||
5.2.21 |  makṣikāścaiva yūkāśca maśakaiḥ saha|
virasādapasarpanti jantoḥ kāyānmumūrṣataḥ||
5.2.22 |  atyartharasikaṃ kāyaṃ kālapakvasya makṣikāḥ|
api snātānuliptasya bhṛśamāyānti sarvaśaḥ||
5.2.23 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
sāmānyena mayoktāni liṅgāni rasagandhayīḥ|
puṣpitasya narasyaitatphalaṃ maraṇamādiśet||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
indriyasthāne puṣpitakamindriyaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||2 | |

tritīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.3.1 |  athātaḥ parimarśanīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.3.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.3.3 |  varṇe svare ca gandhe ca rase coktaṃ pṛthak pṛthak|
liṅgaṃ mumūrṣatāṃ samyak sparśoṣvapi nibodhata||
5.3.4 |  1sparśaprādhānyenaivāturasyāyuṣaḥ 1pramāṇāvaśeṣaṃ jijñāsuḥ prakṛtisthena pāṇinā śarīramasya kevalaṃ spṛśet, parimarśayedvā 'nyena|
parimṛśatā tu khalvāturaśarīramime bhāvāstatra tatrāvaboddhavyā bhavanti|tadyathā---satataṃ spandamānānāṃ śarīradeśānāmaspandanaṃ, nityoṣmaṇāṃ śītībhāvaḥ, mṛdūnāṃ dāruṇatvaṃ, ślakṣṇānāṃ kharatvaṃ, 1satāmasadbhāvaḥ, sandhīnāṃ sraṃsabharaṃśacyavanāni; māṃsaśoṇitayorvītībhāvaḥ, dāruṇatvaṃ, svedānubandhaḥ, stambho vā; yaccānyadapi kiñcidīdṛśaṃ sparśānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhṛśavikṛtamanimittaṃ syāt|
iti lakṣaṇaṃ spṛśyānāṃ bhāvānāmuktaṃ samāsena||
5.3.5 |  tadvyāsato 'nuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ---tasya cet parimṛśyamānaṃ pṛthaktvena pādajaṅghorusphigudarapārśvapṛṣṭheṣikāpāṇigrīvātālvoṣṭhalalāṭaṃ svinnaṃ śītaṃ 1stabdhaṃ dāruṇaṃ vītamāṃsaśoṇitaṃ vā syāt, parāsurayaṃ puruṣo na cirāt 1kālaṃ mariṣyatīti vidyāt|
tasya cet parimṛśyamānāni pṛthaktvena gulphajānuvaṅkṣaṇagudavṛṣaṇameḍhranābhyaṃsastanamaṇikaparśukāhanunāsikākarṇākṣibhrūśaṅkhādīni srastāni vyastāni cyutāni sthānebhyaḥ 1skannāni vā syuḥ, parāsurayaṃ puruṣo 'cirāt kālaṃ 1mariṣyatīti vidyāt||
5.3.6 |  tathā 'syocchvāsamanyādantapakṣmacakṣuḥkeśalomodaranakhāṅgulīrālakṣayet|
tasya ceducchvāso 'tidīrgho 'tihrasvo vā syāt, parāsuriti vidyāt|
tasya cenmanye parimṛśyamāne na spandeyātāṃ, parāsuriti vidyāt|
tasya ceddantāḥ parikīrṇāḥ śvetā jātaśarkarāḥ syuḥ, parāsuriti vidyāt|
tasya cet pakṣmāṇi jaṭābaddhāni syuḥ, parāsuriti vidyāt|
tasya ceccakṣuṣī prakṛtihīne, vikṛtiyukte---atyutpiṇḍite,atipraviṣṭe,atijihme,ativiṣame, atimuktabandhane,atiprasrute,satatonmiṣite,satatanimiṣite,nimiṣonmeṣātipravṛtte,vibhrāntadṛṣṭike,viparītadṛṣṭike,hīnadṛṣṭike,vyastadṛṣṭike,1nakulāndhe,kapotāndhe,alātavarṇe,kṛṣṇapītanīlaśyāvatāmraharitahāridraśuklavaikārikāṇāṃ varṇānāmanyatamenātiplute vā syātāṃ,tadā parāsuriti vidyāt|
athāsya keśalomānyāyacchet,tasya cet keśalomānyāyamyamānāni pralucyeran na cedvedayeyustaṃ parāsuriti vidyāt|
tasya cedudare sirāḥ prakāśerañ śyāvatāmranīlahāridraśuklā vā syuḥ, parāsuriti vidyāt|
tasya cennakhā vītamāṃsaśoṇitāḥ pakvajāmbavavarṇāḥ syuḥ, parāsuriti vidyāt|
athāsyāṅgulīrāyacchet; tasya cedaṅgulaya āyamyamānā na sphuṭeyuḥ, parāsuriti vidyāt||
5.3.7 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
etān spṛśyān bahūn bhāvān yaḥ spṛśannavabudhyate|
āture na sa saṃmohamāyurjñānasya gacchati||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne parimarśanīyamindriyaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||3 | |

caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.4.1 |  athāta indriyānīkamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.4.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.4.3 |  indriyāṇi yathā jantoḥ parīkṣeta viśeṣavit|
jñātumicchan bhiṣaṅnānam-1āyuṣastannibodhata||
5.4.4 |  anumānāt parīkṣeta darśanādīni tattvataḥ|
addhā hi 1viditaṃ jñānamindriyāṇāmatīndriyam||
5.4.5 |  svasthebhyo vikṛtaṃ yasya 1jñānamindriyasaṃśrayam|
ālakṣyetānimittena lakṣaṇaṃ maraṇasya tat||
5.4.6 |  ityuktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samyagindriyeṣvaśubhodayam|
tadeva tu punarbhūyo vistareṇa vibodhata||
5.4.7 |  ghanībhūtamivākāśamākāśamiva medinīm|
vigītamubhayaṃ hyetat paśyan maraṇamṛcchati||
5.4.8 |  yasya darśanamāyāti māruto 'mbaragocaraḥ|
agnirnāyāti cādīptastasyāyuḥkṣayamādiśet||
5.4.9 |  jale suvimale jālamajālāvatate naraḥ|
sthite gacchati vā dṛṣṭvā jīvitāt parimucyate||
5.4.10 |  jāgrat paśyati yaḥ pretān rakṣāṃsi vividhāni ca|
anyadvā 'pyadbhutaṃ 1kiñcinna sa jīvatumarhati||
5.4.11 |  yo 'gniṃ prakṛtivarṇasthaṃ nīlaṃ paśyati niṣprabham|
kṛṣṇaṃ vā yadi vā śuklaṃ niśāṃ vrajati saptamīm||
5.4.12 |  marīvcīnasato meghānmeghān vā 'pyasato 'mbare|
vidyuto vā vinā meghaiḥ *paśyan maraṇamṛcchati||
5.4.13 |  mṛnmayīmiva yaḥ pātrīṃ kṛṣṇāmbarasamāvṛtām|
ādityamīkṣate śuddhaṃ candraṃ vā na sa jīvati||
5.4.14 |  aparvaṇi yadā paśyet sūryācandramasorgraham|
avyādhito vyādhito vā tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.4.15 |  naktaṃ sūryamahaścandramanagnau dhūmamutthitam|
agniṃ vā niṣprabhaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭvā maraṇamṛcchati||
5.4.16 |  prabhāvataḥ prabhāhīnānniṣprabhāṃśca prabhāvataḥ|
narā viliṅgān paśyanti bhāvān 1bhāvāñjihāsavaḥ||
5.4.17 |  vyākṛtīni vivarṇāni visaṃkhyopagatāni ca|
vinimittāni paśyanti rūpāṇyāyuḥkṣaye narāḥ||
5.4.18 |  yaśca paśyatyadṛśyān vai dṛśyān yaśca na paśyati|
1tāvubhau paśyataḥ kṣipraṃ yamakṣayamasaṃśayam||
5.4.19 |  aśabdasya ca yaḥ śrotā śabdān yaśca na budhyate|
dvāvapyetau yathā pretau tathā jñeyau 1vijānatā||
5.4.20 |  saṃvṛtyāṅgulibhiḥ karṇau jvālāśabdaṃ ya āturaḥ|
na śṛṇoti gatāsuṃ taṃ buddhimān parivārjayet||
5.4.21 |  viparyayeṇa yo vidyādgandhānāṃ sādhvasādhutām|
na vā 1tān sarvaśo vidyāttaṃ vidyādvigatāyuṣam||
5.4.22 |  yo rasānna vijānāti na vā jānāti tattvataḥ|
mukhapākādṛte pakvaṃ tamāhuḥ kuśalā naram||
5.4.23 |  uṣṇāñchītān kharāñchlakṣṇānmṛdūnapi ca dāruṇān|
spṛśyān spṛṣṭvā tato 'nyatvaṃ mumūrṣusteṣu manyate||
5.4.24 |  antareṇa tapastīvraṃ yogaṃ vā vidhipūrvakam|
indiyairadhikaṃ paśyan pañcatvamadhigacchati||
5.4.25 |  1indriyāṇāmṛte dṛṣṭerindriyārthānadoṣajān|
naraḥ paśyati yaḥ kaścidindriyairna sa jīvati||
5.4.26 |  svasthāḥ prajñāviparyāsairindiyārtheṣu vaikṛtam|
paśyanti ye+1asadvbahuśasteṣāṃ maraṇamādiśet||
5.4.27 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
etadindriyavijñānaṃ yaḥ paśyati yathātatham|
maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ caiva sa bhiṣak jñātumarhati||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne indriyānīkamindriyaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4 | |

pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.5.1 |  athātaḥ pūrvarūpīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.5.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.5.3 |  pūrvarūpāṇyasādhyānāṃ vikārāṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthak|
bhinnābhinnāni vakṣyāmo bhiṣajāṃ jñānavṛddhaye||
5.5.4 |  pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvaroktānyatimātrayā|
yaṃ viśanti viśatyenaṃ mṛtyurjvarapuraḥsaraḥ||
5.5.5 |  anyasyāpi ca rogasya pūrvarūpāṇi yaṃ naram|
viśantyanena kalpena tasyāpi maraṇaṃ dhruvam||
5.5.6 |  pūrvarūpaikadeśāṃstu vakṣyāmo 'nyān sudāruṇān|
ye rohānanubadhvanti 1mṛtyuryairanubadhyate||
5.5.7 |  balaṃ ca hīyate yasya pratiśyāyaśca vardhate|
tasya nārīprasaktasya śoṣo 'ntāyopajāyate||
5.5.8 |  śvabhiruṣṭraiḥ kharairvā 'pi yāti yo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam|
svapne yakṣmāṇamāsādya jīvitaṃ sa vimuñcati||
5.5.9 |  pretaiḥ saha pibenmadyaṃ svapne yaḥ kṛṣyate śunā|
sughoraṃ jvaramāsādya jīvitaṃ sa vimuñcati||
5.5.10 |  lākṣāraktāmbarābhaṃ yaḥ paśyatyambaramantikāt|
sa raktapittamāsādya tenaivāntāya nīyate||
5.5.11 |  raktasragraktasarvāṅgo raktavāsā muhurhasan|
yaḥ svapne *hriyate nāryā sa raktaṃ prāpya sīdati||
5.5.12 |  śūlāṭopāntrakūjāśca daurbalyaṃ cātimātrayā|
nakhādiṣu ca vaivarṇyaṃ gulmenāntakaro grahaḥ||
5.5.13 |  latā kaṇṭakinī yasya dāruṇā hṛdi jāyate|
svapne gulmastamantāya krūro viśati mānavam||
5.5.14 |  kāye 'lpamapi saṃspṛṣṭaṃ subhṛśaṃ yasya dīryate|
kṣatāni ca na rohanti kuṣṭhairmṛtyurhinasti tam||
5.5.15 |  nagnasyājyāvasiktasya juhvato 'gnimanarciṣam|
padmānyurasi jāyante svapne kuṣṭhairmariṣyataḥ||
5.5.16 |  snātānuliptagātre 'pi yasmin gṛdhnanti makṣikāḥ|
sa prameheṇa saṃsparṇaṃ prāpya tenaiva hanyate||
5.5.17 |  snehaṃ bahuvidhaṃ svapne caṇḍālaiḥ saha yaḥ pibet|
badhyate sa prameheṇa spṛśyate 'ntāya mānavaḥ||
5.5.18 |  dhyānāyāsau tathodvegau mohaścāsthānasaṃbhavaḥ|
aratirbalahāniśca mṛtyurunmādapūrvakaḥ||
5.5.19 |  āhāradveṣiṇaṃ paśyan luptacittamudarditam|
vidyāddhīro mumūrṣuṃ tamunmādenātipātinā||
5.5.20 |  krodhanaṃ trāsabahulaṃ sakṛtprahasitānanam|
mūrcchāpipāsābahulaṃ hantyunmādaḥ śarīriṇam||
5.5.21 |  nṛtyan rakṣogaṇaiḥ sākaṃ yaḥ svapne 'mbhasi *sīdati|
sa prāpya bhṛśamunmādaṃ yāti lokamataḥ param||
5.5.22 |  asattamaḥ paśyati yaḥ śṛṇotyapyasataḥ svanān|
bahūn bahuvidhān jāgrat so 'pasmāreṇa badhyate||
5.5.23 |  mattaṃ nṛtyantamāvidhya preto harati yaṃ naram|
svapne harati taṃ mṛtyurapasmārapuraḥsaraḥ||
5.5.24 |  stabhyete pratibuddhasya hanū manye tathā 'kṣiṇī|
yasya taṃ bahirāyāmo gṛhītvā hantyasaṃśayam||
5.5.25 |  śaṣkulīrvā 'pyapūpān vā svapne khādati yo naraḥ|
sa 1cettādṛk chardayati pratibuddho na jīvati||
5.5.26 |  etāni pūrvarūpāṇi yaḥ samyagavabudhyate|
sa eṣāmanubandhaṃ ca phalaṃ ca jñātumarhati||
5.5.27 |  imāṃścāpyaparān svapnān dāruṇānupalakṣayet|
vyādhitānāṃ vināśāya kleśāya mahate 'pi vā||
5.5.28 |  yasyottamāṅge jāyante vaṃśagulmalatādayaḥ|
vayāṃsi ca vilīyante svapne maiṇḍyamiyācca yaḥ||
5.5.29 |  gṛdhrolūkaśvakākādyaiḥ svapne yaḥ parivāryate|
rakṣaḥpretapiśācastrīcaṇḍāla-1draviḍāndhrakaiḥ||
5.5.30 |  vaṃśavetralatāpāśatṛṇakaṇṭakasaṅkaṭe|
1saṃsajjati hi yaḥ svapne yo 1gacchan prapatatyapi||
5.5.31 |  bhūmau pāṃśūpadhānāyāṃ valmīke vā 'tha bhasmani|
śmaśānāyatane śvabhre svapne yaḥ 1prapatatyapi||
5.5.32 |  kaluṣe 'mbhasi paṅke vā kūpe vā tamasā++āvṛte|
svapne majjati śīghreṇa srotasā 1hriyate ca yaḥ||
5.5.33 |  snehapānaṃ tathā 'bhyaṅgaḥ pracchardanavirecane|
hiraṇyalābhaḥ kalahaḥ svapne bandhaparājayau||
5.5.34 |  upānadyuganāśaśca prapātaḥ pādacarmaṇoḥ|
harṣaḥ svapne prakupitaiḥ pitṛbhiścāvabhartsanam||
5.5.35 |  danta-1candrārkanakṣatradevatādīpacakṣuṣām|
patanaṃ vā vināśo vā svapne bhedo nagasya vā||
5.5.36 |  raktapuṣpaṃ vanaṃ bhūmiṃ pāpakarmālayaṃ citām|
guhāndhakārasaṃbādhaṃ svapne yaḥ praviśatyapi||
5.5.37 |  raktamālī hasannuccairdigvāsā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam|
dāruṇāmaṭavīṃ svapne kapiyuktena yāti vā||
5.5.38 |  kāṣāyiṇāmasaumyānāṃ nagnānāṃ daṇḍadhāriṇām|
kṛṣṇānāṃ raktanetrāṇāṃ svapne necchanti daraśanam||
5.5.39 |  kṛṣṇā 1pāpā nirācārā dīrghakeśanakhastanī|
virāgamālyavasanā svapne kālaniśā matā||
5.5.40 |  ityete dāruṇāḥ svapnā rohī yairyāti pañcatām|
arogaḥ saṃśayaṃ gatvā kaścideva pramucyate||
5.5.41 |  manovahānāṃ pūrṇatvāddoṣauratibalaistribhiḥ|
srotasāṃ dāruṇān svapnān kāle paśyati dāruṇe||
5.5.42 |  nātiprasuptaḥ puruṣaḥ saphalānaphalāṃstathā|
indriyeśena manasā svapnān paśyatyanekadhā||
5.5.43 |  dṛṣṭaṃ śrutānubhūtaṃ ca prārthitaṃ kalpitaṃ tathā|
bhāvikaṃ doṣajaṃ caiva svapnaṃ saptavidhaṃ viduḥ||
5.5.44 |  tatra pañcavidhaṃ pūrvamaphalaṃ bhiṣagādiśet|
divāsvapnamatihrasvamatidīrghaṃ *ca buddhimān||
5.5.45 |  dṛṣṭaḥ prathamarātre yaḥ svapnaḥ so+1alpaphalo bhavet|
na svapedyaṃ punardṛṣṭvā sa sadyaḥ syānmahāphalaḥ||
5.5.46 |  akalyāṇamapi svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatraiva yaḥ punaḥ|
paśyet saumyaṃ śubhākāraṃ tasya vidyācchubhaṃ phalam||
5.5.47 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
pūrvarūpāṇyatha svapnān ya imān vetti dāruṇān|
na sa mohādasādhyeṣu karmāṇyārabhate bhiṣak||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne pūrvarūpīyamindriyaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5 | |

ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.6.1 |  athātaḥ katamāniśarīrīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.6.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.6.3 |  katamāni śarīrāṇi vyādhimanti mahāmune!|
yāni vaidyaḥ pariharedyeṣu karma na siddhyati||
5.6.4 |  1ityātreyo 'gniveśena praśnaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sudurvacam|
ācacakṣe yathā tasmai bhagavāṃstannibodhata||
5.6.5 |  yasya vaibhāṣamāṇasya rujatyūrdhvamuro bhṛśam|
annaṃ ca cyavate bhuktaṃ sthitaṃ cāpi na jīryati||
5.6.6 |  balaṃ ca hīyate 1śīghraṃ tṛṣṇā cātipravardhate|
jāyate hṛdi śūlaṃ ca taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet||
5.6.7 |  hikkā gambhīrajā yasya śoṇitaṃ cātisāryate|
na tasmai bheṣajaṃ dadyāt smarannātreyaśāsnama||
5.6.8 |  ānāhaścātisāraśca yametau durbalaṃ naram|
vyādhitaṃ viśato rogau durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.6.9 |  ānāhaścātitṛṣṇā ca yametau durbalaṃ naram|
viśato vijahatyenaṃ prāṇā nāticirānnaram||
5.6.10 |  jvaraḥ paurvāhṇiko yasya śuṣkakāsaśca dāruṇaḥ|
balamāṃsavihīnasya yathā pretastathaiva saḥ||
5.6.11 |  yasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca grathitaṃ saṃpravartate|
nirūṣmaṇo jaṭhariṇaḥ śvasano na sa jīvati||
5.6.12 |  śvayathuryasya kukṣistho hastapādaṃ visarpati|
jñātisaṅghaṃ sa saṃkleśya tena rogeṇa hanyate||
5.6.13 |  śvayathuryasya pādasthastathā sraste ca piṇḍike|
sīdataścāpyubhe 1jaṅghe taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet||
5.6.14 |  śūnahastaṃ śūnapādaṃ śūnaguhyodaraṃ naram|
hīnavarṇabalāhāramauṣadhairnopapādayet||
5.6.15 |  1uroyukto bahuśleṣmā nīlaḥ pītaḥ salohitaḥ|
satataṃ cyavate yasya dūrātaṃ parivarjayet||
5.6.16 |  hṛṣṭaromā sāndramūtraḥ śūnaḥ 1kāsajvarārditaḥ|
kṣīṇamāṃso naro dūrādvarjyo vaidyena jānatā||
5.6.17 |  trayaḥ prakupitā yasya doṣāḥ 1kaṣṭābhilakṣitāḥ|
kṛśasya balahīnasya nāsti tasya cikitsitam||
5.6.18 |  jvarātisārau śophānte śvayathurvā tayoḥ kṣaye|
durbalasya viśeṣeṇa narasyāntāya jāyate||
5.6.19 |  pāṇḍuraśca kṛśo 'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇayā 'bhipariplutaḥ|
ḍambarī kupitocchvāsaḥ pratyākhyeyo vijānatā||
5.6.20 |  hanumanyāgrahastṛṣṇā balahrāso 'timātrayā|
prāṇāścorasi vartante yasya taṃ parivarjayet||
5.6.21 |  1tāmyatyāyacchate śarma na kiñcidapi vindati|
kṣīṇamāṃsabalāhāro mumūrṣuracirānnaraḥ||
5.6.22 |  viruddhayonayo yasya viruddhopakramā bhṛśam|
*vardhante dāruṇā rogāḥ śīghraṃ śīghraṃ sa hanyate||
5.6.23 |  balaṃ vijñānamārogyaṃ grahaṇī 1māṃsaśoṇitam|
etāni yasya 1kṣīyante kṣipraṃ kṣipraṃ sa hanyate||
5.6.24 |  ārogyaṃ hīyate 1yasya prakṛtiḥ parihīyate|
sahasā sahasā tasya mṛtyurharati jīvitam||
5.6.25 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
ityetāni śarīrāṇi vyādhimanti vivarjayet|
na hyeṣu dhīrāḥ paśyanti siddhiṃ kāñcidupakramāt||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne katamāniśarīrīyamindriyaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6 | |

saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.7.1 |  athātaḥ pannarūpīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.7.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.7.3 |  dṛṣṭyāṃ yasya vijānīyāt pannarūpāṃ kumārikām|
praticchāyāmayīmakṣṇornainamiccheccikitsitum||
5.7.4 |  jyotsnāyāmātape dīpe salilādarśayorapi|
aṅgeṣu vikṛtā yasya cchāyā 1pretastathaiva saḥ||
5.7.5 |  chinnā bhinnā++ākulā cchāyā hīnā vā 'pyadhikā 'pi vā|
naṣṭā tanvī dvidhā cchinnā vikṛtā viśitā ca yā||
5.7.6 |  etāścānyāśca yāḥ kāścit praticchāyā vigarhitāḥ|
sarvā mumūrṣatāṃ jñeyā na cellakṣyanimittajāḥ||
5.7.7 |  saṃsthānena pramāṇena varṇena prabhayā tathā|
chāyā vivartate yasya svastho 'pi preta eva saḥ||
5.7.8 |  saṃsthānamākṛtirjñeyā suṣamā viṣamā ca sā|
madhyamalpaṃ mahaccoktaṃ pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ nṛṇām||
5.7.9 |  pratipramāṇasaṃsthānā jalādarśātapādiṣu|
chāyā yā sā praticchāyā cchāyā varṇaprabhāśrayā||
5.7.10 |  svādīnāṃ pañca pañcānāṃ chāyā vividhalakṣaṇāḥ|
nābhasī nirmalā nilā sasnehā saprabheva ca ||
5.7.11 |  rūkṣā śyāvāruṇā yā tu vāyavī sā hataprabhā|
viśuddharaktā tvāgneyī dīptābhā darśanapriyā||
5.7.12 |  śuddhavaidūryavimalā susnigdhā cāmbhasī matā|
sthirā 1snigdhā ghanā ślakṣṇā śyāmā śvetā ca pārthivī||
5.7.13 |  vāyavī garhitā tvāsāṃ catasraḥ syuḥ 1sukhodayāḥ|
vāyavī tu vimāśāyā kleśāya mahate 'pi vā||
5.7.14 |  syāttaijasī prabhā sarvā sā tu saptavidhā smṛtā|
raktā pītā sitā śyāvā haritā pāṇḍurā 'sitā||
5.7.15 |  tāsāṃ yāḥ syurvikāsinyaḥ snigdhāśca vipulāśca yāḥ|
tāḥ śubhā rūkṣamalināḥ 1saṃkṣiptāścāśubhodayāḥ||
5.7.16 |  varṇamākrāmati cchāyā 1bhāstu varṇaprakāśinī|
āsannā lakṣyate cchāyā bhāḥ 1prakṛṣṭā prakāśate||
5.7.17 |  nācchāyo nāprabhaḥ kaścidviśeṣāścihnayanti tu|
nṛṇāṃ śubhāśubhotpattiṃ kāle chāyāprabhāśrayāḥ||
5.7.18 |  kāmalā 'kṣṇormukhaṃ pūrṇaṃ śaṅkhayormuktamāṃsatā|
1saṃtrāsaścoṣṇagātratvaṃ yasya taṃ parivarjayet||
5.7.19 |  utthāpyamānaḥ śayanāt pramohaṃ yāti yo naraḥ|
muhurmuhurna saptāhaṃ sa jīvati 1vikatthanaḥ||
5.7.20 |  saṃsṛṣṭā vyādhayo yasya pratilomānulomagāḥ|
vyāpannā grahaṇī prāyaḥ so 'rdhamāsaṃ na jīvati||
5.7.21 |  uparuddhasya rogeṇa karśitasyālpamaśnataḥ|
bahu mūtrapurīṣaṃ syādyasya taṃ parivarjayet||
5.7.22 |  durbalo bahu bhuṅkte yaḥ 1prāgbhuktādannamāturaḥ|
alpamūtrapurīṣaśca yathā pretastathaiva saḥ||
5.7.23 |  iṣṭaṃ ca 1guṇasaṃpannamannamaśnāti yo naraḥ|
śaśvacca balavarṇābhyāṃ hīyate na sa jīvati||
5.7.24 |  prakūjati praśvasiti śithilaṃ cātisāryate|
balahīnaḥ pipāsārtaḥ śuṣkāsyo na sa jīvati||
5.7.25 |  hrasvaṃ ca yaḥ praśvasiti vyāviddhaṃ spandate ca yaḥ|
mṛtameva tamātreyo vyācacakṣe punarvasuḥ||
5.7.26 |  ūrdhvaṃ ca yaḥ praśvasiti śleṣmaṇā cābhibhūyate|
hīnavarṇabalāhāro yo naro na sa jīvati||
5.7.27 |  ūrdhvāgne nayane yasya 1manye cāratakampane|
balahīnaḥ pipāsārtaḥ śuṣkāsyo na sa jīvati||
5.7.28 |  yasya gaṇḍāvupacitau jvarakāsau ca dāruṇau|
śūlī pradveṣṭi cāpyannaṃ tasmin karma na sidhyati||
5.7.29 |  1vyāvṛttamūrdhajihvāsyo bhruvau yasya ca vicyute|
kaṇṭakaiścācitā jihvā yathā pretastathaiva saḥ||
5.7.30 |  śophaścātyarthamutsiktaṃ niḥsṛtau vṛṣaṇau bhṛśam|
ataścaiva viparyāso vikṛtyā pretalakṣaṇam||
5.7.31 |  nicitaṃ yasya māṃsaṃ 1syāttvagasthiṣveva dṛśyate|
kṣīṇasyānaśnatastasya māsamāyuḥ paraṃ bhavet||
5.7.32 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
idaṃ liṅgamariṣṭāakhyamanekamabhijajñivān|
āyurvedavidityākhyāṃ labhate kuśalo janaḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne pannarūpīyamindriyaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7 | |

aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.8.1 |  athāto 'vākśirasīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.8.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.8.3 |  avākśirā vā jihmā vā yasya vā viśirā bhavet|
janto rūpapraticchāyā nainamiccheccikitsitum||
5.8.4 |  jaṭībhūtāni pakṣmāṇi dṛṣṭiścāpi 1nigṛhyate|
yasya jantorna taṃ dhīro bheṣajenopapādayet||
5.8.5 |  yasya śūnāni vartmāni na samāyānti śuṣyataḥ|
cakṣuṣī 1copadihyete yathā pretastathaiva saḥ||
5.8.6 |  bhruvorvā yadi vā mūrdhni sīmantāvartakān bahūn|
apūrvānakṛtān vyaktān dṛṣṭvā maraṇamādiśet||
5.8.7 |  tryahametena jīvanti lakṣaṇenāturā narāḥ|
arogāṇāṃ punastvetat ṣaḍrātraṃ 1paramucyate||
5.8.8 |  āyamyotpāṭitān keśān yo naro nāvabudhyate|
anāturo vā rogī vā ṣaḍrātraṃ nātivartate||
5.8.9 |  yasya keśā nirabhyaṅgā dṛśyante 'bhyaktasannibhāḥ|
uparuddhāyuṣaṃ jñātvā taṃ dhīraḥ parivarjayet||
5.8.10 |  1glāyate nāsikāvaṃśaḥ pṛthutvaṃ yasya gacchati|
aśūnaḥ śūnasaṃkāśaḥ pratyākhyeyaḥ sa jānatā||
5.8.11 |  atyarthavivṛtā yasya yasya cātyarthasaṃvṛtā|
jihmā vā pariśuṣkā vā nāsikā na sa jīvati||
5.8.12 |  mukhaṃ 1śabdaśravāvoṣṭhau śuklaśyāvātilohitau|
vikṛtyā yasya vā nīlau na sa rogādvimucyate||
5.8.13 |  asthiśvetā dvijā yasya puṣpitāḥ paṅkasaṃvṛtāḥ|
vikṛtyā na sa rogaṃ taṃ vihāyārogyamaśnute||
5.8.14 |  stabdhā niścetanā gurvī kaṇṭakopacitā bhṛśam|
śyāvā śuṣkā 'thavā śūnā pretajihvā nisarpiṇī||
5.8.15 |  dīrghamucchvasya yo hrasvaṃ naro niḥśvasya tāmyati|
uparuddhāyuṣaṃ jñātvā taṃ dhīraḥ parivarjayet||
5.8.16 |  hastau pādau ca manye ca tālu caivātidītalam|
bhavatyāyuḥkṣaye krūramathavā 'pi bhavenmṛdu||
5.8.17 |  ghaṭṭayañjānunā jānu pādāvudyamya pātayan|
yo 'pāsyati muhurvaktramāturo na sa jīvati||
5.8.18 |  dantaiśchindannakhāgrāṇi nakhaicchindañchiroruhān|
kāṣṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhanna rogāt parimucyate||
5.8.19 |  dantān khādati yo jāgradasāmnā virudan hasan|
vijānāti na cedduḥkhaṃ na sa rogādvimucyate||
5.8.20 |  muhurhasan muhuḥ kṣveḍan śayyāṃ pādena hanti yaḥ|
1uccaiśchidrāṇi vimṛśannāturo na sa jīvati||
5.8.21 |  yairvindati purā bhāvaiḥ sametaiḥ paramāṃ ratim|
tairevāramamāṇasya glāsnormaraṇamādiśet||
5.8.22 |  na bibharti śiro grīvā na pṛṣṭhaṃ bhāramātmanaḥ|
na hanū piṇḍamāsyasthamāturasya mumūrṣataḥ||
5.8.23 |  sahasā jvarasaṃtāpastṛṣṇā mūrcchā balakṣayaḥ|
viśleṣaṇaṃ ca sandhīnāṃ mumūrṣorupajāyate||
5.8.24 |  gosargo vadanādyasya svedaḥ pracyavate bhṛśam|
lepajvaropataptasya durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.8.25 |  nopaiti kaṇṭhamāhāro jihvā kaṇṭhamupaiti ca|
āyuṣyantaṃ gate jantorbalaṃ ca parihīyate||
5.8.26 |  śiro vikṣipate kṛcchrānmuñcayitvā prapāṇikau|
lalāṭasrupratasvedo 1mumūrṣuścyutabandhanaḥ||
5.8.27 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
imāni liṅgāni nareṣu buddhimān vibhāvayetāvahito mumūrṣuṣu|
kṣaṇena bhūtvā hyupayānti kānicinnacāphalaṃ liṅgamihāsti kiñcana||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne 'vākṇirasīyamindriyaṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8 | |

navamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.9.1 |  athāto 1yasyaśyāvanimittīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.9.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.9.3 |  yasya śyāve paridhvaste harite cāpi darśane|
āpanno vyādhirantāya jñeyastasya vijānatā||
5.9.4 |  niḥsaṃjñaḥ pariśuṣkāsyaḥ 1samṛddho vyādhibhiśca yaḥ|
uparuddhāyuṣaṃ jñātvā taṃ dhīraḥ parivarjayet||
5.9.5 |  1haritāśca sirā yasya lomakūpāśca saṃvṛtāḥ|
so 'mlābhilāṣī puruṣaḥ pittānmaraṇamaśnute||
5.9.6 |  śarīrāntāśca śobhante śarīraṃ copaśuṣyati|
balaṃ ca hīyate yasya rājayakṣmā hinasti tam||
5.9.7 |  aṃsābhitāpo hikkā ca chardanaṃ śoṇitasya ca|
ānāhaḥ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca bhavatyantāya śoṣiṇaḥ||
5.9.8 |  vātavyādhirapasmārī kuṣṭhī 1śophī tathodarī|
gulmī ca madhumehī ca rājayakṣmī ca yo naraḥ||
5.9.9 |  acikitsyā bhavantyete balamāṃsakṣaye sati|
anyeṣvapi vikāreṣu tān bhiṣak parivarjayet||
5.9.10 |  virecanahṛtānāho yastṛṣṇānugato naraḥ|
viriktaḥ punarādhmāti yathā pretastathaiva saḥ||
5.9.11 |  peyaṃ pātuṃ na śaknoti kaṇṭhasya ca mukhasya ca|
urasaśca niśuṣkatvādyo naro na sa 1jīvati||
5.9.12 |  svarasya durbalībhāvaṃ hāniṃ ca balavarṇayoḥ|
rogavṛddhimayuktyā ca dṛṣṭvā maraṇamādiśet||
5.9.13 |  ūrdhvaśvāsaṃ gatoṣmāṇaṃ śūlopahatavaṅkṣaṇam|
śarma cānadhigacchantaṃ buddhimān parivarjayet||
5.9.14 |  apasvaraṃ bhāpamāṇaṃ prāptaṃ maraṇamātmanaḥ|
śrotāraṃ cāpyaśabdasya dūrataḥ parivarjayet||
5.9.15 |  yaṃ naraṃ sahasā rogo durbalaṃ parimuñcati|
saṃśayaprāptamātreyo jīvitaṃ tasya manyate||
5.9.16 |  atha cejjñātayastasya yāceran praṇipātataḥ|
rasenādyāditi brūyānnāsmai dadyādviśodhanam||
5.9.17 |  māsena cenna dṛśyeta viśeṣastasya śobhanaḥ|
rasaiścānyaibahuvidhairdurlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.9.18 |  niṣṭhyūtaṃ ca purīṣaṃ ca retaścāmbhasi majjati|
yasya tasyāyuṣaḥ prāptamantamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ||
5.9.19 |  niṣṭyūte yasya dṛśyante varṇā bahuvidhāḥ pṛthak|
tacca sīdatyapaḥ prāpya na sa 1jīvitumarhati||
5.9.20 |  pittamūṣmānugaṃ yasya śaṅgau prāpya 1vimūrcchati|
sa rogaḥ śaṅkhako nāmnā trirātrāddhanti jīvitam||
5.9.21 |  saphenaṃ rudhiraṃ yasya muhurāsyāt prasicyate|
śūlaiśca tudyate kukṣiḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ||
5.9.22 |  balamāṃsakṣayastīvro rogavṛddhirarocakaḥ|
yasyāturasya lakṣyante trīn pakṣānna sa jīvati||
5.9.23 |  tatra ślokau---
vijñānāni manuṣyāṇāṃ maraṇe pratyupasthite|
bhavantyetāni saṃpaśyedanyānyevaṃvidhāni ca||
5.9.24 |  tāni sarvāṇi lakṣyante na tu sarvāṇi mānavam|
viśanti vinaśiṣyantaṃ tasmādbodhyāni sarvataḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne yasyaśyāvanimittīyamindriyaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ||9 | |

daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.10.1 |  athātaḥ sadyomaraṇīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.10.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.10.3 |  sadyastitikṣataḥ prāṇāṃ(anunāsika)llakṣaṇāni pṛthak pṛthak|
agniveśa! pravakṣyāmi saṃspṛṣṭo yairna jīvati||
5.10.4 |  vātāṣṭhīlā susaṃvṛddhā tiṣṭhantī dāruṇā hṛdi|
tṛṣṇayā 'bhiparītasya sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.5 |  piṇḍike śithilīkṛtya jihmīkṛtya ca nāsikām|
vāyuḥ śarīre vicaran sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.6 |  bhruvau yasya cyute sthānādantardāhaśca dāruṇaḥ|
tasya hikkākaro rogaḥ sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.7 |  kṣīṇaśoṇitamāṃsasya vāyurūrdhvagatiścaran|
ubhe manye same yasya sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.8 |  1antareṇa gudaṃ gacchan nābhiṃ ca sahasā 'nilaḥ|
kṛśasya vaṃkṣaṇau gṛhṇan sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.9 |  vitatya parśukāgrāṇi gṛhītvoraśca mārutaḥ|
stimitasyāyatākṣasya sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.10 |  hṛdayaṃ ca gudaṃ cobhe 1gṛhītvā māruto balī|
durbalasya viśeṣeṇa sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.11 |  vaṃkṣaṇaṃ ca gudaṃ cobhe gṛhītvā māruto balī|
śvāsaṃ saṃjanayañjantoḥ sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.12 |  nābhiṃ mūtraṃ 1bastiśīrṣaṃ purīṣaṃ cāpi mārutaḥ|
1pracchinnaṃ janayañchūlaṃ sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam||
5.10.13 |  bhidyete vaṃkṣaṇau yasya vātaśūlaiḥ samantataḥ|
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca sadyaḥ prāṇāñjahāti saḥ||
5.10.14 |  āplutaṃ māruteneha śarīraṃ yasya kevalam|
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam||
5.10.15 |  śarīraṃ śophitaṃ yasya vātāśophena dehinaḥ|
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam||
5.10.16 |  āmāśayasamutthānā yasya syāt parikartikā|
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca sadyaḥ prāṇāñjahāti saḥ||
5.10.17 |  pakvāśayasamutthānā yasya syāt parikartikā|
tṛṣṇā gudagrahaścograḥ sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam||
5.10.18 |  1pakvāśayamadhiṣṭhāyaṃ hatvā saṃjñāṃ ca mārutaḥ|
kaṇṭhe ghurghurakaṃ kṛtvā sadyo harati jīvitam||
5.10.19 |  dantāḥ kardamadigdhābhā mukhaṃ cūrṇakasannibham|
siprāyante ca gātrāṇi liṅgaṃ sadyo mariṣyataḥ||
5.10.20 |  tṛṣṇāśvāsaśirorogamohadairbalyakūjanaiḥ|
spṛṣṭaḥ prāṇāñjahātyāśu śakṛdbhedena cāturaḥ||
5.10.21 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
etāni khalu liṅgāni yaḥ samyagavabudhyate|
sa jīvitaṃ ca martyānāṃ maraṇaṃ cāvabudhyate||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne sadyomaraṇīyamindriyaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||10 | |

ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.11.1 |  athāto 'ṇujyotīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.11.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.11.3 |  aṇujyotiranekāgro duśchāyo durmanāḥ sadā|
ratiṃ na labhate 1yāti paralokaṃ samāntaram||
5.11.4 |  baliṃ balibhṛto yasya praṇītaṃ nopabhuñjate|
lokāntaragataḥ piṇḍaṃ bhuṅkte saṃvatsareṇa saḥ||
5.11.5 |  saptarṣīṇāṃ samīpasthāṃ yo na paśyatyarundhatīm|
saṃvatsarānte jantuḥ sa saṃpaśyati mahattamaḥ||
5.11.6 |  vikṛtyā vinimittaṃ yaḥ śobhāmupacayaṃ dhanam|
prāpnotyato vā vibhraṃśaṃ samāntaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.11.7 |  bhaktiḥ śīlaṃ smṛtistyāgo buddhirbalamahetukam|
ṣaḍetāni nivartante ṣaḍbhirmāsairmariṣyataḥ||
5.11.8 |  dhamanīnāmapūrvāṇāṃ jālamatyarthaśobhanam|
lalāṭe dṛśyate yasya ṣaṇmāsānna sa jīvati||
5.11.9 |  lekhābhiścandravakrābhirlalāṭamupacīyate|
yasya tasyāyuṣaḥ ṣaḍbhirmāsairantaṃ samādiśet||
5.11.10 |  śarīrakampaḥ saṃmoho gatirvacanameva ca|
mattasyevopalabhyante yasya māsaṃ na jīvati||
5.11.11 |  retomūtrapurīṣāṇi yasya majjanti cāmbhasi|
sa māsāt svajanadveṣṭā mṛtyuvāriṇi majjati||
5.11.12 |  hastapādaṃ mukhaṃ cobhe viśeṣādyasya śuṣyataḥ|
śūyete vā vinā dehāt sa ca 1māsaṃ na jīvati||
5.11.13 |  lalāṭe mūrdhni bastau vā nīlā yasya prakāśate|
rājī bālendukuṭilā na sa jīvitumarhati||
5.11.14 |  pravālaguṭikābhāsā yasya gātre masūrikāḥ|
utpadyāśu 1vinaśyanti na cirāt sa vinaśyati||
5.11.15 |  grīvāvamardo balavāñjihvāśvayathureva ca|
bradhnāsyagalapākaśca yasya pakvaṃ tamādiśet||
5.11.16 |  saṃbhramo 'tipralāpo 'tibhedo+1asthnāmatidāruṇaḥ|
kālapāśaparītasya trayametat pravartate||
5.11.17 |  pramuhya luñcayet keśān 1parigṛhṇātyatīva ca|
naraḥ 1svasthavadāhāramabalaḥ kālacoditaḥ||
5.11.18 |  samīpe cakṣuṣoḥ kṛtvā mṛgayetāṅgulīkaram|
smayate 'pi ca kālāndha 1ūrdhvagānimiṣekṣaṇaḥ||
5.11.19 |  śayanādāsanādaṅgāt kāṣṭhāt kuḍyādathāpi vā|
asanmṛgayate kiñcit sa muhyan kālacoditaḥ||
5.11.20 |  ahāsyahāsī saṃmuhyan 1praleḍhi daśanacchadau|
śītapādakarocchvāso yo naro na sa jīvati||
5.11.21 |  āhvayaṃstaṃ samīpasthaṃ svajanaṃ janameva vā|
mahāmohāvṛtamanāḥ paśyannapi na paśyati||
5.11.22 |  ayogamatiyogaṃ vā śarīre matimān bhiṣak|
khādīnāṃ yugapaddṛṣṭvā bheṣajaṃ nāvacārayet||
5.11.23 |  atipravṛddhyā rogāṇāṃ manasaśca balakṣayāt|
vāsamutsṛjati kṣipraṃ śarīrī dehasaṃjñakam||
5.11.24 |  varṇasvarāvannibalaṃ vāgindriyamanobalam|
hīyate 'sukṣaye nidrā nityā bhavati vā na vā||
5.11.25 |  bhiṣagbheṣajapānānnagurumitradviṣaśca ye|
vaśagāḥ sarva evaite boddhavyāḥ samavartinaḥ||
5.11.26 |  eteṣu rogaḥ kramate bheṣajaṃ pratihanyate|
naiṣāmannāni bhuñjīta na codakamapi spṛśet||
5.11.27 |  pādāḥ sametāścatvāraḥ saṃpannāḥ sādhakairguṇaiḥ|
vyarthā gatāyuṣo dravyaṃ vinā nāsti guṇodayaḥ||
5.11.28 |  parīkṣyamāyurbhiṣajā nīrujasyāturasya ca|
āyurjñānaphalaṃ kṛtsnamāyurjñe hyanuvartate||
5.11.29 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
kriyāpathamatikrāntāḥ kevalaṃ dehamāplutāḥ|
cihnaṃ kurvanti yaddoṣāstadariṣṭaṃ nirucyate||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne 'ṇujyotīyamindriyaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||11 | |

dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
5.12.1 |  athāto gomayacūrṇīyamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
5.12.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
5.12.3 |  yasya gomayacūrṇābhaṃ cūrṇaṃ mūrdhani jāyate|
sasnehaṃ bhraśyate caiva māsāntaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.12.4 |  1nikaṣanniva yaḥ pādau cyutāṃsaḥ paridhāvati|
vikṛtyā na sa loke 'smiṃściraṃ vasati mānavaḥ||
5.12.5 |  yasya snātānuliptasya pūrvaṃ śuṣyatyuro bhṛśam|
ārdreṣu sarvagātreṣu so 'rdhamāsaṃ na jīvati||
5.12.6 |  yamuddiśyāturaṃ vaidyaḥ 1saṃvartayitumauṣadham|
yatamāno na śaknoti durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.12.7 |  vijñātaṃ bahuśaḥ siddhaṃ vidhivaccāvacāritam|
na sidhyatyauṣadhaṃ yasya nāsti tasya cikitsitam||
5.12.8 |  1āhāramupayuñjāno bhiṣajā sūpakalpitam|
yaḥ phalaṃ tasya nāpnoti durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.12.9 |  dūtādhikāre vakṣyāmo lakṣaṇāni mumūrṣatām|
yāni dṛṣṭvā bhiṣak prājñaḥ pratyākhyāyādasaṃyamam||
5.12.10 |  muktakeśo 'thavā nagne rudatyaprayate 'thavā|
bhiṣagabhyāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dūtaṃ maraṇamādiśet||
5.12.11 |  supte bhiṣaji ye dūtāśchindatyapi ca bhindati|
āgacchanti bhiṣak teṣāṃ na bhartāramanuvrajet||
5.12.12 |  juhvatyagniṃ tathā piṇḍān pitṛbhyo nirvapatyapi|
vaidye dūtā ya āyānti te ghnanti prajighāṃsavaḥ||
5.12.13 |  kathayatyapraśastāni cintayatyathavā punaḥ|
vaidye dūtā manuṣyāṇāmāgacchanti mumūrṣatām||
5.12.14 |  mṛtadagdhavinaṣṭāni bhajati vyāharatyapi|
apraśastāni cānyāni vaidye dūtā mumūrṣatām||
5.12.15 |  vikārasāmānyaguṇe deśe kāle 'thavā bhiṣak|
dūtamabhyāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nāturaṃ tamupācaret||
5.12.16 |  dīnabhītadrutatrastamalināmasatīṃ striyam|
trīn vyākṛtīṃśca ṣaṇḍāṃśca dūtān vidyānmumūrṣatām||
5.12.17 |  aṅgavyasaninaṃ dūtaṃ liṅginaṃ vyādhitaṃ tathā|
saṃprekṣya cograkarmāṇaṃ na vaidyo gantumarhati||
5.12.18 |  āturārthamanuprāptaṃ kharoṣṭrarathavāhanam|
dūtaṃ dṛdṣṭvā bhiṣagvidyādāturasya parābhavam||
5.12.19 |  palālabusamāṃsāsthikeśalomanakhadvijān|
mārjanīṃ musalaṃ śūrpamupānaccarma 1vicyutam||
5.12.20 |  tṛṇakāṣṭhatuṣāṅgāraṃ spṛśanto loṣṭamaśma ca|
tatpūrvadarśane dūtā vyāharanti mumūrṣatām||
5.12.21 |  yasmiṃśca dūte bruvati vākyamāturasaṃśrayam|
paśyennimittamaśubhaṃ taṃ ca nānuvrajedbhiṣak||
5.12.22 |  tathā vyasaninaṃ pretaṃ pretālaṅkārameva vā|
bhinnaṃ dagdhaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā tadvādīni vacāṃsi vā||
5.12.23 |  raso vā kaṭukastīvro gandho vā kauṇapo mahān|
sparśo vā vipulaḥ krūro yadvā 'nyadaśubhaṃ bhavet||
5.12.24 |  tatpūrvamabhito vākyaṃ vākyakāle 'thavā punaḥ|
dūtānāṃ vyāhṛtaṃ śrutvā dhīro maraṇamādiśet||
5.12.25 |  iti dūtādhikāro 'yamuktaḥ kṛtsno mumūrṣatām|
pathyāturakulānāṃ ca vakṣyāmyautpātikaṃ punaḥ||
5.12.26 |  avakṣutamathotkruṣṭaṃ skhalanaṃ patanaṃ tathā|
ākrośaḥ saṃprahāro vā pratiṣedho vigarhaṇam||
5.12.27 |  vastroṣṇīṣottarāsaṅgaśchatropānadyugāśrayam|
vyasanaṃ darśanaṃ cāpi mṛtavyasanināṃ tathā||
5.12.28 |  caityadhvajapatākānāṃ pūrṇānāṃ patanāni ca|
hatāniṣṭapravādāśca dūṣaṇaṃ bhasmapāṃśubhiḥ||
5.12.29 |  pathacchedo biḍālena śunā sarpeṇa vā punaḥ|
mṛgādvijānāṃ krūrāṇāṃ giro dīptāṃ diśaṃ prati||
5.12.30 |  śayanāsanayānānāmuttānānāṃ ca darśanam|
ityetānyapraśastāni sarvāṇyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ||
5.12.31 |  etāni pathi vaidyena paśyatā++āturaveśmani|
śṛṇvatā ca na gantavyaṃ tadāgāraṃ vipaścitā||
5.12.32 |  ityautpātikamākhyātaṃ pathi vaidyavigarhitam|
imāmapi ca budhyeta gṛhāvasthāṃ mumūrṣatām||
5.12.33 |  praveśe pūrṇakumbhāgnimṛdvījaphalasarpiṣām|
vṛṣabrāhmaṇaratnānnadevatānāṃ ca nirgatim||
5.12.34 |  agnipūrṇāni pātrāṇi bhinnāni viśikhāni ca|
bhiṣaṅ mumūrṣatāṃ veśma praviśanneva paśyati||
5.12.35 |  chinnabhinnāni dagdhāni bhagnāni mṛditāni ca|
durbalāni ca sevante mumūrṣorvaiśmikā janāḥ||
5.12.36 |  śayanaṃ vasanaṃ yānaṃ gamanaṃ bhojanaṃ rutam|
śrūyate 'maṅgalaṃ yasya nāsti tasya cikitsitam||
5.12.37 |  śayanaṃ vasanaṃ yānamanyaṃ vā 'pi paricchadam|
pretavadyasya kurvanti suhṛdaḥ preta eva saḥ||
5.12.38 |  annaṃ vyāpadyate 'tyarthaṃ jyotiścaivopaśāmyati|
nivāte sendhanaṃ yasya tasya nāsti cikitsitam||
5.12.39 |  āturasya gṛhe yasya bhidyante vā patanti vā|
atimātramamatrāṇi durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam||
5.12.40 |  bhavanti cātra---
yaddvādaśabhiradhyāyairvyāsataḥ parikīrtitam|
mumūrṣatāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jīvitāntakṛt||
5.12.41 |  tat samāsena vakṣyāmaḥ paryāyāntaramāśritam|
paryāyavacanaṃ hyarthavijñānāyopapadyate||
5.12.42 |  atyarthaṃ punareṛveyaṃ vivakṣā no vidhīyate|
tasminnevādhikaraṇe yat pūrvamabhiśabditam||
5.12.43 |  vasatāṃ caramaṃ kālaṃ śarīreṣu śarīriṇām|
abhyugrāṇāṃ vināśāya dehebhyaḥ pravivatsatām||
5.12.44 |  iṣṭāṃstitikṣatāṃ prāṇān kāntaṃ vāsaṃ jihāsatām|
tantrayantreṣu bhinneṣu tamo 'ntyaṃ pravivikṣatām||
5.12.45 |  vināśāyeha rūpāṇi yānyavasthāntarāṇi ca|
bhavanti tāni vakṣyāmi yathoddeśaṃ yathāgamam||
5.12.46 |  prāṇāḥ 1samupatapyante nijñānamuparudhyate|
vamanti balamaṅgāni ceṣṭā vyuparamanti ca||
5.12.47 |  indriyāṇi vinaśyanti khilībhavati 1cetanā|
autsukyaṃ bhajate sattvaṃ ceto bhīrāviśatyapi||
5.12.48 |  smṛtistyajati medhā ca hrīśriyau cāpasarpataḥ|
upaplavante pāpmāna 1ojastejaśca naśyati||
5.12.49 |  śīlaṃ vyāvartate 'tyarthaṃ bhaktiśca parivartate|
vikriyante praticchāyāśchāyāśca vikṛtiṃ prati||
5.12.50 |  śukraṃ pracyavate sthānādunmārgaṃ bhajate 'nilaḥ|
kṣayaṃ māṃsāni gacchanti gacchatyasṛgapi kṣayam||
5.12.51 |  ūṣmāṇaḥ pralayaṃ yānti viśleṣaṃ yānti sandhayaḥ|
gandhā vikṛtimāyānti bhedaṃ varṇasvarau tathā||
5.12.52 |  vaivarṇyaṃ bhajate kāyaḥ kāyacchidraṃ viśuṣyati|
dhūmaḥ saṃjāyate mūrdhnī dāruṇākhyaśca cūrṇakaḥ||
5.12.53 |  satataspandanā deśāḥ śarīre ye 'bhilakṣitāḥ|
te stambhānugatāḥ sarve na calanti kathaṃcana||
5.12.54 |  guṇāḥ śarīradeśānāṃ śītoṣṇamṛdudāruṇāḥ|
niparyāsena vartante sthāneṣvanyeṣu tadvidhāḥ||
5.12.55 |  nakheṣu jāyate puṣpaṃ paṅko danteṣu jāyate|
jaṭāḥ pakṣmasu jāyante sīmantāścāpi mūrdhani||
5.12.56 |  bheṣajāni na saṃvṛttiṃ prāpnuvanti yathāruci|
yāni cāpyupapadyante teṣāṃ 1vīryaṃ na sidhyati||
5.12.57 |  nānāprakṛtayaḥ krūrā vikārā vividhauṣadhāḥ|
kṣipraṃ samabhivartante pratihatya balaujasī||
5.12.58 |  śabdaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandhaśceṣṭā 1vicintitam|
utpadyante 'śubhānyeva pratikarmapravṛttiṣu||
5.12.59 |  dṛśyante dāruṇāḥ svapnā daurātmyamupajāyate|
preṣyāḥ pratīpatāṃ yānti pretākṛtirudīryate||
5.12.60 |  prakṛtirhīyate 'tyarthaṃ vikṛtiścābhivardhate|
kṛtsnamautpātikaṃ ghoramari(ni)ṣṭamupalakṣyate||
5.12.61 |  ityetāni manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavanti vinaśiṣyatām|
lakṣaṇāni yathoddeśaṃ yānyuktāni yathāgamam||
5.12.62 |  maraṇāyeha rūpāṇi paśyatā 'pi bhiṣagvidā|
apṛṣṭena na vaktavyaṃ maraṇaṃ pratyupasthitam||
5.12.63 |  pṛṣṭenāpi na vaktavyaṃ tatra yatropaghātakam|
āturasya bhavedduḥkhamathavā 'nyasya kasyacit||
5.12.64 |  abruvanmaraṇaṃ tasya nainamiccheccikitsitum|
yasya paśyedvināśāya liṅgāni kuśalo bhiṣak||
5.12.65 |  liṅgebhyo maraṇākhyebhyo viparītāni paśyatā|
liṅgānyārogyamāgantu vaktavyaṃ bhiṣajā dhruvam||
5.12.66 |  dūtairautpātikairbhāvaiḥ pathyāturakulāśrayaiḥ|
āturācāraśīleṣṭadravyasaṃpattilakṣaṇaiḥ||
5.12.67 |  svācāraṃ hṛṣṭamavyaṅgaṃ yaśasyaṃ śuklavāsasam|
amuṇḍamajaṭaṃ dūtaṃ jātiveśakriyāsamam||
5.12.68 |  anuṣṭrakharayānasthamasandhyāsvagraheṣu ca|
adāruṇeṣu nakṣatreṣvanugreṣu 1dhruveṣu ca||
5.12.69 |  vinā caturthīṃ navamīṃ vinā riktāṃ caturdaśīm|
madhyāhnamardharātraṃ ca bhūkampaṃ rāhudarśanam||
5.12.70 |  vinā deśamaśastaṃ cāśastautpātikalakṣaṇam|
dūtaṃ praśastamavyagraṃ nirdiśedāgataṃ bhiṣak||
5.12.71 |  dadhyakṣatadvijātīnāṃ vṛṣabhāṇāṃ nṛpasya ca||
5.12.72 |  ratnānāṃ pūrṇakumbhānāṃ sitasya turagasya ca|
suradhvajapatākānāṃ phalānāṃ 1yāvakasya ca||
5.12.73 |  kanyāpuṃvardhamānānāṃ baddhasyaikapaśostasthā|
pṛthivyā uddhṛtāyāśca vahneḥ prajvalitasya ca||
5.12.74 |  modakānāṃ sumanasāṃ śuklānāṃ candanasya ca|
manojñasyānnapānasya pūrṇasya śakaṭasya ca||
5.12.75 |  nṛbhirdhenvāḥ savatsāyā vaḍavāyāḥ striyāstathā|
jīvañjīvakasiddhārthasārasapriyavādinām||
5.12.76 |  haṃsānāṃ śatapatrāṇāṃ cāṣāṇāṃ śikhināṃ tathā|
matsyājadvijaśaṅkhānāṃ 1priyaṅgūnāṃ ghṛtasya ca||
5.12.77 |  rucakādarśasiddhārtharocanānāṃ ca darśanam|
gandhaḥ surabhirvarṇaśca suśuklo madhuro rasaḥ||
5.12.78 |  mṛgapakṣimanuṣyāṇāṃ praśastāśca giraḥ śubhāḥ|
chatradhvajapatākānāmutkṣepaṇamabhiṣṭutiḥ||
5.12.79 |  bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāṃ śabdāḥ puṇyāhanisvanāḥ|
vedādhyayanaśabdāśca sukho vāyuḥ pradakṣiṇaḥ||
5.12.80 |  pathi veśmapraveśe tu vidyādārogyalakṣaṇam|
maṅgalācārasaṃpannaḥ sāruto vaiśmiko janaḥ||
5.12.81 |  śraddadhāno 'nukūlaśca prabhūtadravyasaṃgrahaḥ|
dhanaiśvaryasukhāvāptiriṣṭalābhaḥ sukhena ca||
5.12.82 |  dravyāṇāṃ tatra yogyānāṃ yojanā siddhireva ca|
gṛhaprāsādaśailānāṃ nāgānāmṛṣabhasya ca||
5.12.83 |  hayānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca svapne samadhirohaṇam|
somārkāgnidvijātīnāṃ gavāṃ nṛṛṇāṃ payāsvinām||
5.12.84 |  arṇavānāṃ prataraṇaṃ vṛddhiḥ saṃbādhaniḥsṛtiḥ|
svapne devaiḥ sapitṛbhiḥ prasannaiścābhibhāṣaṇam||
5.12.85 |  darśanaṃ śuklavastrāṇāṃ hradasya vimalasya ca|
māṃsamatsyaviṣāmedhyacchatrādarśaparigrahaḥ||
5.12.86 |  svapne sumanasāṃ caiva śuklānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham|
aśvagorathayānaṃ ca yānaṃ pūrvottareṇa ca|
rodanaṃ patitotthānaṃ dviṣatāṃ cāvamardanam||
5.12.87 |  sattvalakṣaṇasaṃyogo bhaktirvaidyadvijātiṣu|
sādhyatvaṃ na ca nirvedastadārogyasya lakṣaṇaṃ||
5.12.88 |  ārogyādbalamāyuśca sukhaṃ ca labhate mahat|
iṣṭāṃścāpyaparān bhāvān puruṣaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ||
5.12.89 |  uktaṃ gomayacūrṇīye maraṇārogyalakṣaṇam|
dūtasvapnāturotpātayuktisiddhivyapāśrayam||
5.12.90 |  itīdamuktaṃ prakṛtaṃ yathātathaṃ
tadanvavekṣyaṃ satataṃ bhiṣagvidā|
tathā hi siddhiṃ ca yaśaśca śāśvataṃ
sa siddhakarmā labhate dhanāni ca||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte indriyasthāne gomayacūrṇīyamindriyaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||12 | |

indriyasthānaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ|carakasaṃhitā


cikitsāsthānam|

prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.1.1.1 |  rasāyanādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ|
athāto 'bhayāmalakīyaṃ rasāyanapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.1.1.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.1.1.3 |  cikitsitaṃ vyādhiharaṃ pathyaṃ sādhanamauṣadham|
prāyaścittaṃ praśamanaṃ prakṛtisthāpanaṃ hitam||
6.1.1.4 |  vidyādbheṣajanāmāni,bheṣajaṃ dvividhaṃ ca tat|
svasthasyorjaskaraṃ kiñcit kiñcidārtasya roganut||
6.1.1.5 |  abheṣajaṃ ca dvividhaṃ bādhanaṃ sānubādhanam|
svasthasyorjaskaraṃ yattu tadtṛṣyaṃ tadrasāyanam||
6.1.1.6 |  prāyaḥ,prāyeṇa rogāṇāṃ dvitīyaṃ praśame matam|
prāyaḥśabdo viśeṣārtho hyubhayaṃ hyubhayārthakṛt||
6.1.1.7 |  dīrghamāyuḥ smṛtiṃ medhāmārogyaṃ taruṇaṃ vayaḥ|
prabhāvarṇasvaraudāryaṃ dehendriyabalaṃ param||
6.1.1.8 |  vāksiddhiṃ *praṇatiṃ kāntiṃ labhate nā rasāyanāt|
lābhopāyo hi śastānāṃ rasādīnāṃ rasāyanam||
6.1.1.9 |  apatyasaṃtānakaraṃ yat sadyaḥ saṃpraharṣaṇam|
vājīvātibalo yena yātyapratihataḥ striyaḥ||
6.1.1.10 |  bhavatyatipriyaḥ strīṇāṃ yena yenopacīyate|
jīryato 'pyakṣayaṃ śukraṃ phalavadyena dṛśyate||
6.1.1.11 |  prabhūtaśākhaḥ śākhīva yena caityo yathā mahān|
*bhavatyarcyo bahumataḥ prajānāṃ subahuprajaḥ||
6.1.1.12 |  saṃtānamūlaṃ yeneha pretya cānantyamaśnute|
yaśaḥ śriyaṃ balaṃ puṣṭiṃ vājīkaraṇameva tat||
6.1.1.13 |  svasthasyorjaskaraṃ tvetaddvividhaṃ proktamauṣadham|
yadvyādhinirghātakaraṃ vakṣyate taccikitsite||
6.1.1.14 |  cikitsitārtha etāvān vikārāṇāṃ yadauṣadham|
rasāyanavidhiścāgre vājīkaraṇameva ca||
6.1.1.15 |  abheṣajamiti jñeyaṃ viparītaṃ yadauṣadhāt|
tadasevyaṃ viṣevyaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yadauṣadham||
6.1.1.16 |  rasāyanānāṃ dvividhaṃ prayogamṛṣayo viduḥ|
kuṭīprāveśikaṃ caiva vātātapikameva ca||
6.1.1.17 |  kuṭīprāveśikasyādau vidhiḥ samupadekṣyate|
nṛpavaidyadvijātīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām||
6.1.1.18 |  nivāse nirbhaye śaste prāpyopakaraṇe pure|
diśi pūrvottarasyāṃ ca subhūmau kārayet kuṭīm||
6.1.1.19 |  vistārotsedhasaṃpannāṃ trigarbhāṃ sūkṣmalocanām|
ghanabhittimṛtusukhāṃ suspaṣṭāṃ manasaḥ priyām||
6.1.1.20 |  śabdādīnāmaśastānāmagamyāṃ strīvivarjitām|
iṣṭopakaraṇopetāṃ *sajjavaudyauṣadhadvijām||
6.1.1.21 |  athodagayane śukle tithinakṣatrapūjite|
muhūrtakaraṇopete praśaste kṛtavāpanaḥ||
6.1.1.22 |  dhṛtismṛtibalaṃ kṛtvā śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ|
vidhūya mānasān doṣān maitrīṃ bhūteṣu cintayan||
6.1.1.23 |  devatāḥ pūjayitvā 'gre dvijātīṃśca pradakṣiṇam|
devagobrāhmaṇān kṛtvā tatastāṃ praviśet kuṭīm||
6.1.1.24 |  tasyāṃ saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ sukhī jātabalaḥ punaḥ|
rasāyanaṃ prayuñjīta *tatpravakṣyāmi śodhanam||
6.1.1.25 |  harītakīnāṃ cūrṇāni saindhavāmalake guḍam|
vacāṃ viḍaṅgaṃ rajanīṃ pippalīṃ viśvabheṣajam||
6.1.1.26 |  pibeduṣṇāmbunā jantuḥ snehasvedopapāditaḥ|
tena śuddhaśarīrāya kṛtasaṃsarjanāya ca||
6.1.1.27 |  trirātraṃ yāvakaṃ dadyāt pañcāhaṃ vā 'pi sarpiṣā|
saptāhaṃ vā purāṇasya yāvacchuddhestu varcasaḥ||
6.1.1.28 |  śuddhakoṣṭhaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā rasāyanamupācaret|
vayaḥprakṛtisātmyajño yaugikaṃ yasya yadbhavet||
6.1.1.29 |  harītakīṃ pañcarasāmuṣṇāmalavaṇaṃ śivām|
doṣānulomanīṃ laghvīṃ vidyāddīpanapācanīm||
6.1.1.30 |  āyuṣyāṃ pauṣṭikīṃ dhanyāṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanīṃ parām|
sarvarogapraśamanīṃ buddhīndriyabalapradām||
6.1.1.31 |  kuṣṭhaṃ gulmamudāvartaṃ śoṣaṃ pāṇḍvāmayaṃ madam|
arśāṃsi grahaṇīdoṣaṃ purāṇaṃ viṣamajvaram||
6.1.1.32 |  hṛdrogaṃ saśirorogamatīsāramarocakam|
kāsaṃ pramehamānāhaṃ plīhānamudaraṃ navam||
6.1.1.33 |  kaphaprasekaṃ vaisvaryaṃ vaivarṇyaṃ kāmalāṃ krimīn|
śvayathuṃ tamakaṃ chardiṃ klaiṣyamaṅgāvasādanam||
6.1.1.34 |  srotovibandhān vividhān pralepaṃ hṛdayorasoḥ|
smṛtibuddhipramohaṃ ca jyecchīghraṃ harītakī||
6.1.1.35 |  (*ajīrṇino rūkṣabhujaḥ strīmadyaviṣakarśitāḥ|
severannābhayāmete kṣuttṛṣṇoṣṇārditāśca ye||)
6.1.1.36 |  tān guṇāṃstāni karmāṇi vidyādāmalakīṣvapi|
yānyuktāni harītakyā vīryasya tu viparyayaḥ||
6.1.1.37 |  ataścāmṛtakalpāni vidyāt karmabhirīdṛśaiḥ|
harītakīnāṃ śasyāni bhiṣagāmalakasya ca||
6.1.1.38 |  auṣadhīnāṃ parā bhūmirhimavāñ śailasattamaḥ|
tasmātphalāni tajjāni grāhayetkālajāni tu||
6.1.1.39 |  āpūrṇarasavīryāṇi kāle kāle yathāvidhi|
ādityapavanacchāyāsalilaprīṇitāni ca||
6.1.1.40 |  *yānyajagdhānyapūtīni nirvraṇānyagadāni ca|
teṣāṃ prayogaṃ vakṣyāmi phalānāṃ karma cottamam||
6.1.1.41 |  pañcānāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ bhāgān daśapalonmitān|
harītakīsahasraṃ ca triguṇāmalakaṃ navam||
6.1.1.42 |  vidārigandhāṃ bṛhatīṃ pṛśnipaṇīṃ nidigdhikām|
vidyādvidārigandhādyaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāpañcamaṃ gaṇam||
6.1.1.43 |  bilvāgnimanthaśyonākaṃ kāśmaryamatha pāṭalām|
punarnavāṃ śūrpaparṇyau balāmeraṇḍameva ca||
6.1.1.44 |  jīvakarṣabhakau medāṃ jīvantīṃ saśatāvarīm|
śarekṣudarbhakāśānāṃ śālīnāṃ mūlameva ca||
6.1.1.45 |  ityeṣāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ pañcānāmupakalpayet|
bhagān yathoktāṃstatsarvaṃ sādhyaṃ daśaguṇe 'mbhasi||
6.1.1.46 |  daśabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu pūtaṃ taṃ grāhayedrasam|
harītakīśca tāḥ sarvāḥ sarvāṇyāmalakāni ca||
6.1.1.47 |  tāni sarvāṇyanasthīni phalānyāpothya kūrcanaiḥ|
vinīya tasminniryūhe cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet||
6.1.1.48 |  maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ pippalyāḥ śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ plavasya ca|
mustānāṃ saviḍaṅgānāṃ candanāguruṇostathā||
6.1.1.49 |  madhukasya haridrāyā vacāyāḥ kanakasya ca|
bhāgāṃścatuṣpalān kṛtvā sūkṣmailāyāstvacastathā||
6.1.1.50 |  sitopalāsahasraṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ tulayā 'dhikam|
tailasya dvyāḍhakaṃ tatra dadyāttrīṇi ca sarpiṣaḥ||
6.1.1.51 |  sādhyamaudumbare pātre tat sarvaṃ mṛdunā 'gninā|
jñātvā *lehyamadagdhaṃ ca śītaṃ kṣaudreṇa saṃsṛjet||
6.1.1.52 |  kṣaudrapramāṇaṃ snehārdhaṃ tat sarvaṃ ghṛtabhājane|
tiṣṭhetsaṃmūrcchitaṃ tasya mātrāṃ kāle prayojayet||
6.1.1.53 |  yā *noparundhyādāhāramekaṃ mātrā jarāṃ prati|
ṣaṣṭikaḥ payasā cātra jīrṇe bhojanamiṣyate||
6.1.1.54 |  vaikhānasā vālakhilyāstathā cānye tapodhanāḥ|
rasāyanamidaṃ *prāśya babhūvuramitāyuṣaḥ||
6.1.1.55 |  muktvā jīrṇaṃ vapuścāgryamavāpustaruṇaṃ vayaḥ|
vītatandrāklamaśvāsā nirātaṅkāḥ samāhitāḥ||
6.1.1.56 |  medhāsmṛtibalopetāścirarātraṃ tapodhanāḥ|
brāhmaṃ tapo brahmacaryaṃ ceruścātyantaniṣṭhayā||
6.1.1.57 |  rasāyanamidaṃ brāhmāyuṣkāmaḥ prayojayet|
dīrghamāyurvayaścāgryāṃ kāmāṃśceṣṭān samaśnute||
(iti brāhmarasāyanam)
6.1.1.58 |  yathoktaguṇānāmāmalakānāṃ sahasraṃ piṣṭasvedanavidhinā payasa ūṣmaṇā susvinnamanātapaśuṣkamanasthi cūrṇayet|
tadāmalakasahasrasvarasaparīpītaṃ sthirāpunarnavājīvantīnāgabalābrahmanuvarcalāmaṇḍūkaparṇīśatāvarīśaṅkhapuṣpīpippalīvacāviḍaṅgasvayaṅguptāmṛtācandanāgurumadhukamadhūkapuṣpotpalapadmamālatīyuvatīyūthikācūrṇāṣṭabhāgasaṃyuktaṃ punarnāgabalāsahasrapalasvarasaparipītamanātapaśuṣkaṃ dviguṇitasarpiṣā kṣaudrasarpiṣā vā kṣudraguḍākṛtiṃ kṛtvā śucau dṛḍhe ghṛtabhāvite kumbhe bhasmarāśeradhaḥ sthāpayedantarbhūmeḥ pakṣaṃ kṛtarakṣāvidhānamatharvavedavidā, pakṣātyaye coddhṛtya kanakarajatatāmrapravālakālāyasacūrṇāṣṭabhāgasaṃyuktamardhakarṣavṛddhyā yathoktena vidhinā prātaḥ prātaḥ prayuñjāno 'gnibalamabhisamīkṣya, jīrṇe ca ṣaṣṭikaṃ payasā sasarpiṣkamupasevamāno yathoktān guṇān samaśnuta iti||
6.1.1.59 |  bhavanti cātra---
idaṃ rasāyanaṃ brāhmaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam|
bhavatyarogo dīrghāyuḥ prayuñjāno mahābalaḥ||
6.1.1.60 |  kāntaḥ prajānāṃ siddhārthaścandrādityasamadyutiḥ|
śrutaṃ dhārayate sattvamārṣaṃ cāsya pravartate||
6.1.1.61 |  dharaṇīdharasāraśca vāyunā samavikramaḥ|
sa bhavatyaviṣaṃ cāsya gātre saṃpadyate viṣam||
(iti dvitīyaṃ brāhmarasāyanam)
6.1.1.62 |  bilvo 'gnimanthaḥ śyonākaḥ kāśmaryaḥ pāṭalirbalā|
parṇyaścatasraḥ pippalyaḥ śvadaṃṣṭrā bṛhatīdvayam||
6.1.1.63 |  śṛṅgī tāmalakī drākṣā jīvantī puṣkarāguru|
abhayā cāmṛtā ṛddhirjīvakarṣabhakau śaṭī||
6.1.1.64 |  mustaṃ punarnavā medā sailā candanamutpalam|
vidārī vṛṣamūlāni kākolī kākanāsikā||
6.1.1.65 |  eṣāṃ palonmitān bhāgāṅchatānyāmalakasya ca|
pañca dadyāttadaikadhyaṃ jaladroṇe vipācayet||
6.1.1.66 |  jñātvā gatarasānyetānyauṣadhānyatha taṃ rasam|
taccāmalakamuddhṛtya niṣkulaṃ tailasarpiṣoḥ||
6.1.1.67 |  paladvādaśake bhṛṣṭvā dattvā cārdhatulāṃ bhiṣak|
matsyaṇḍikāyāḥ pūtāyā lehavatsādhu sādhayet||
6.1.1.68 |  ṣaṭpalaṃ madhunaścātra siddhaśīte pradāpayet|
catuṣpalaṃ tugākṣīryāḥ pippalīdvipalaṃ tathā||
6.1.1.69 |  palamekaṃ nidadhyācca tvagelāpatrakeśarāt|
ityayaṃ cyavanapraśaḥ paramukto rasāyanaḥ||
6.1.1.70 |  kāsaśvāsaharaścaiva viśeṣeṇopadiśyate|
kṣīṇakṣatānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ bālānāṃ cāṅgavardhanaḥ||
6.1.1.71 |  svarakṣayamurorogaṃ hṛdrogaṃ vātaśoṇitam|
pipāsāṃ mūtraśukrasthān doṣāṃścāpyapakarṣati||
6.1.1.72 |  asya mātrāṃ prayuñjīta yoparundhyānna bhojanam|
asya praygāccyavanaḥ suvṛddho 'bhūt punaryuvā||
6.1.1.73 |  medhāṃ smṛtīṃ kāntimanāmayatvamāyuḥprakarṣaṃ balamindriyāṇām|
strīṣu praharṣaṃ paramagnivṛddhiṃ varṇaprasādaṃ pavanānulomyam||
6.1.1.74 |  rasāyanasyāsya naraḥ prayogāllabheta jīrṇo 'pi kuṭīpraveśāt|
jarākṛtaṃ rūpamapāsya sarvaṃ bibharti rūpaṃ navayauvanasya||
(iti cyavanaprāśaḥ|)
6.1.1.75 |  athāmalakaharītakīnāmāmalakabibhītakānāṃ harītakībibhītakānāmāmalakaharītakībibhītakānāṃ vā palāśatvagavanaddhānāṃ mṛdā 'valiptānāṃ kukūlasvinnānāmakulakānāṃ palasahasramulūkhale saṃpothya dadhighṛtamadhupalalatailaśarkarāsaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinā; tasyānte yavāgvādibhiḥ *pratyavasthāpanam, abhyaṅgotsādanaṃ sarpiṣā yavacūrṇaiśca, ayaṃ ca rasāyanaprayogaprakarṣo *dvistāvadagnibalamabhisamīkṣya, pratibhojanaṃ yūṣeṇa payasā vā ṣaṣṭikaḥ sasarpiṣkaḥ, ataḥ paraṃ yathāsukhavihāraḥ kāmabhakṣyaḥ syāt|
anena prayogeṇarṣayaḥ punaryuvatvamavāpurbabhūvuścānekavarṣaśatajīvino nirvikārāḥ paraṃ śarīrabuddhīndriyabalasamuditāśceruścātyantaniṣṭhayā tapaḥ||
(iti caturthāmalakarasāyanam|)
6.1.1.76 |  harītakyāmalakabibhītakapañcapañcamūlaniryūhe pippalīmadhukamadhūkakākolīkṣīrakākolyātmaguptājīvakarṣabhakakṣīraśuklākalkasaṃprayuktena vidārīsvarasena kṣīrāṣṭaguṇasaṃprayuktena ca sarpiṣaḥ kumbhaṃ sādhayitvā *prayuñjāno 'gnibalasamāṃ mātrāṃ jīrṇe ca kṣīrasarpirbhyāṃ śāliṣaṣṭikamuṣṇodakānupānamaśnañjarāvyādhipāpābhicāravyapagatabhayaḥ śarīrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyāpratihatasarvārambhaḥ paramāyuranavāpnuyāt||
(iti pañcamo harītakīyogaḥ|)
6.1.1.77 |  harītakyāmalakabibhītakaharidrāsthirā-*balāviḍaṅgāmṛtavallīviśvabheṣajamadhukapippalīsomavalkasiddhena kṣīrasapiṣā madhuśarkarābhyāmapi ca sannīyāmalakasvarasaśataparipītamāmalakacūrṇamayaścūrṇacaturbhāgasaṃprayuktaṃ pāṇitalamātraṃ pāṇitalamātraṃ prātaḥ prātaḥ prāśya yathoktena vidhinā sāyaṃ mudgayūṣeṇa payasā vā sasarpiṣkaṃ śāliṣaṣṭikānnamaśnīyāt, trivarṣaprayogādasya varṣaśatamajaraṃ vayastiṣṭhiti, śrutamavatiṣṭhate, sarvāmayāḥ praśāmyanti, viṣamaviṣaṃ bhavati gātre, gātramaśmavat sthirībhavati, adhṛṣyo bhūtānāṃ bhavati||
6.1.1.78 |  bhavanti cātra---
yathā 'marāṇāmamṛtaṃ yathā bhogavatāṃ sudhā|
tathā 'bhavanmaharṣīṇāṃ rasāyanavidhiḥ purā||
6.1.1.79 |  na jarāṃ na ca daurbalyaṃ nāturyaṃ nidhanaṃ na ca|
jagmurvarṣasahasrāṇi rasāyanaparāḥ purā||
6.1.1.80 |  na kevalaṃ dīrghamihāyuraśnute rasāyanaṃ yo vidhivanniṣevate|
gatiṃ sa devarṣiniṣevitāṃ śubhāṃ prapadyate brahma tatheti *cākṣayam||
6.1.1.81 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
abhayāmalakīye 'smin ṣaḍyogāḥ parikīrtitāḥ|
rasāyanānāṃ siddhānāmāyuryairanuvartate||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne rasāyanādhyāye 'bhayāmalakīyo nāma rasāyanapādaḥ prathamaḥ||1 | |

rasāyanādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ|
6.1.2.1 |  athātaḥ prāṇakāmīyaṃ rasāyanapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.1.2.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.1.2.3 |  prāṇakāmaḥ śuśrūṣadhvamidamucyamānamamṛtamivāparamaditisutahitakaramacintyādbhutaprabhāvamāyuṣyamārogyakaraṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ nidrātandrāśramaklamālasyadaurbalyāpaharamanilakaphapittasāmyakaraṃ sthairyakaramabaddhamāṃsaharamantaragnisandhukṣaṇaṃ pramāvarṇasvarottamakaraṃ rasāyanavidhānam|
anena cyavanādayo maharṣayaḥ punaryuvatvamāpuranārīṇāṃ ceṣṭatamā babhūvuḥ, sthirasamasuvibhaktamāṃsāḥ, susaṃhatasthiraśarīrāḥ, suprasannabalavarṇendriyāḥ, sarvatrāpratihataparākramāḥ, kleśasahāśca|
sarve śarīradoṣā bhavanti grāmyāhārādamlalavaṇakaṭukakṣāraśuṣkaśāka-*māṃsatilapalalapiṣṭānnabhojināṃ virūḍhanavaśūkaśamīdhānyaviruddhāsātmyarūkṣakṣārābhiṣyandibhojināṃ klinnagurupūtiparyuṣitabhojināṃ viṣamādhyaśanaprāyāṇāṃ divāsvapnastrīmadya nityānāṃ viṣamātimātravyāyāmasaṃkṣobhitaśarīrāṇāṃ bhayakrodhaśokalobhamohāyāsabahulānām; *atonimittaṃ hi śithilībhavanti māṃsāni, vimucyante sandhayaḥ, vidadhyate raktaṃ, viṣyandate cānalpaṃ medaḥ, na sandhīyate 'sthiṣu majjā, śukraṃ na pravartate, kṣayamupaityojaḥ; sa evaṃbhūto glāyati, sīdati, nidrātandrālasyasamanvito nirutsāhaḥ śvasiti, asamarthaśceṣṭānāṃ śārīramānasīnāṃ, naṣṭasmṛtibuddhicchāyo rogāṇāmadhiṣṭhānabhūto na sarvamāyuravāpnoti|
tasmādetān doṣānavekṣamāṇaḥ sarvān yathoktānahitānapāsyāhāravihārān rasāyanāni prayoktumarhatītyuktvā bhagavān punarvasurātreya uvāca---||
6.1.2.4 |  āmalakānāṃ subhūmijānāṃ kālajānāmanupahatagandhavarṇarasānāmāpūrṇarasapramāṇanīryāṇāṃ svarasena punarnavākalkapādasaṃprayuktena sarpiṣaḥ sādhayedāḍhakam, ataḥ paraṃ vidārīsvarasena jīvantīkalkasaṃprayuktena, ataḥ paraṃ caturguṇena payasā balātibalākaṣāyeṇa śatāvarīkalkasaṃyuktena; anena krameṇaikaikaṃ śatapākaṃ sahasrapākaṃ vā śarkarākṣaudracaturbhāgasaṃprayuktaṃ sauvarṇe rājate mārtike vā śucau dṛḍhe ghṛtabhāvite kumbhe sthāpayet; tadyathoktena vidhinā yathāgni prātaḥ prātaḥ prayojayet, jīrṇe ca kṣīrasarpirbhyāṃ śāliṣaṣṭikamaśnīyāt|
asya prayogādvarṣaśataṃ vayo 'jarṃ tiṣṭhati, śrutamavatiṣṭhate, sarvāmayāḥ praśāmyanti, apratihatagatiḥ strīṣu, apatyavān bhavatīti||
6.1.2.5 |  bhavataścātra---
bṛhaccharīraṃ girisārasāraṃ sthirendriyaṃ cātibalendriyaṃ ca|
aghṛṣyamanyairatikāntarūpaṃ praśastipūjāsukhacittabhāk ca||
6.1.2.6 |  balaṃ mahadvarṇaviśuddhiragryā svaro ghanaughastanitānukārī|
bhavatyapatyaṃ vipulaṃ sthiraṃ ca samaśnato yogamimaṃ narasya||
(ityāmalakaghṛtam|)
6.1.2.7 |  āmalakasahasraṃ pippalīsahasrasaṃprayuktaṃ palāśataruṇakṣārodakottaraṃ tiṣṭhet, tadanugatakṣārodakamanātapaśuṣkamanasthi cūrṇīkṛtaṃ caturguṇābhyāṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ saṃnīya śarkarācūrṇacaturbhāgasaṃprayuktaṃ ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ ṣaṇmāsān sthāpayedantarbhūmeḥ|
tasyottarakālamagnibalasamāṃ mātrāṃ khādet, paurvāhṇikaḥ prayogo nāparāhṇikaḥ, sātmyāpekṣaścāhāravidhiḥ|
asya prayogādvarṣaśatamajaraṃ vayastiṣṭhatīti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
(ityāmalakāvalehaḥ|)
6.1.2.8 |  āmalakacūrṇāḍhakamekaviṇśatirātramāmalakasvarasaparipītaṃ madhughṛtāḍhakābhyāṃ dvābhyāmekīkṛtamaṣṭabhāgapippalīkaṃ śarkarācūrṇacaturbhāgasaṃprayuktaṃ ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ prāvṛṣi bhasmarāśau nidadhyāt; tadvarṣānte sātmyapathyāśī prayojayet; asya prayogādvarṣaśatamajaramāyustiṣṭhatīti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
(ityāmalakacūrṇam|)
6.1.2.9 |  viḍaṅgataṇḍulacūrṇānāmāḍhakamāḍhakaṃ pippalītaṇḍulānāmadhyardhāḍhakaṃ sitopalāyāḥ sarpistailamadhvāḍhakaiḥ ṣaḍbhirekīkṛtaṃ ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ prāvṛṣi bhasmarāśāviti sarvaṃ samānaṃ pūrveṇa yāvadāśīḥ||
(iti viḍaṅgāvalehaḥ|)

6.1.2.10 |  yathoktaguṇānāmāmalakānāṃ sahasramārdrapalāśadroṇyāṃ sapidhānāyāṃ bābpamanudvamantyāmāraṇyagomayāgnibhirupasvedayet, tāni susvinnaśītānyuddhṛtakulakānyāpothyāḍhakena pippalīcūrṇānāmāḍhakena ca viḍaṅgataṇḍulacūrṇānāmadhyardhena cāḍhakena śarkarāyā dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmāḍhakābhyāṃ tailasya madhunaḥ sarpiṣaśca saṃyojya śucau dṛḍhe ghṛtabhānite kumbhe sthāpayedekaviṃśatirātram, ata ūrdhvaṃ prayogaḥ; asya prayogādvarṣaśatamajaramāyustiṣṭhatīti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
(ityāmalakāvaleho 'paraḥ|)
6.1.2.11 |  dhanvani kuśāstīrṇe snigdhakuṣṇamadhuramṛttike suvarṇavarṇamṛttike vā vyapagataviṣaśvāpadapavanasalilāgnidoṣe karṣaṇavalmīkaśmaśānacaityoṣarāvasathavarjite deśe yathartusukhapavanasalilādityasevite jātānyanupahatānyanadhyārūḍhānyabālānyajīrṇānyadhigatavīryāṇi śīrṇapurāṇaparṇāny-*asaṃjātānyaparṇāni tapasi tapasye vā māse śuciḥ prayataḥ kṛtadevārcanaḥ svasti vācayitvā dvijātīn *cale sumuhūrte nāgabalāmūlānyuddharet, teṣāṃ suprakṣālitānāṃ tvakpiṇḍamāmramātramakṣamātraṃ vā ślakṣṇapiṣṭamāloḍya payasā prātaḥ prayojayet, cūrṇīkṛtāni vā pibet payasā, madhusarpirbhyāṃ vā saṃyojya bhakṣayet, jīrṇe ca *kṣīrasarpirbhyāṃ śāliṣaṣṭikamaśnīyāt|
saṃvatsaraprayogādasya varṣaśatamajaraṃ vayastiṣṭhitīti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
(iti nāgabalārasāyanam|)
6.1.2.12 |  balātibalāvandanāgurudhavatiniśakhadiraśiṃśapāsanasvarasāḥ punarnavāntāścauṣadhayo *daśa nāgabalayā vyākhyātāḥ|
svarasānāmalābhe tvayaṃ svarasavidhiḥ---cūrṇānāmāḍhakamāḍhakamudakasyāhorātrasthitaṃ mṛditapūtaṃ svarasavat prayojyam||
6.1.2.13 |  bhallātakānyanupahatānyanāmayānyāpūrṇarasapramāṇavīryāṇi pakvajāmbavaprakāśāni śucau śukre vā māse saṃgṛhya yavapalle māṣapalle vā nidhāpayet, tāni caturmāsasthitāni sahasi sahasye vā māse prayoktumārabheta śītasnigdhamadhuropaskṛtaśarīraḥ|
pūrvaṃ daśabhallātakānyāpothyāṣṭaguṇenāmbhasā sādhu sādhayet, teṣāṃ rasamaṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ pūtaṃ sapayaskaṃ pibet sarpiṣā 'ntarmukhamabhyajya|
tānyekaikabhallātakotkarṣāpakarṣeṇa daśabhallātakānyātriṇśataḥ prayojyāni, nātaḥ paramutkarṣaḥ|
prayogavidhānena sahasrapara eva bhallātakaprayogaḥ|
jīrṇe ca sasarpiṣā payasā śāliṣaṣṭikāśanamupacāraḥ, prayogānte ca dvistāvat payasaivopacāraḥ|
tatprayogādvarṣaśatamajaraṃ vayastiṣṭhatīti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
(iti bhallātakakṣīram|)
6.1.2.14 |  bhallātakānāṃ jarjarīkṛtānāṃ piṣṭasvedanaṃ pūrayitvā bhūmāvākaṇṭhaṃ nikhātasya snehabhāvitasya dṛḍhasyopari kumbhasyāropyoḍupenāpidhāya kṛṣṇamṛttikāvaliptaṃ homayāgnibhirupasvedayet; teṣāṃ yaḥ svarasaḥ kumbhaṃ prapadyeta, tamaṣṭabhāgamadhusaṃprayuktaṃ dviguṇaghṛtamadyāt; tatprayogādvarṣaśatamajaraṃ vayastiṣṭhatīti samanaṃ pūrveṇa||
(iti bhallātakakṣaudram|)
6.1.2.15 |  bhallātakatailapātraṃ sapayaskaṃ madhukena kalkenākṣamātreṇa śatapākaṃ kuryāditi samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
(iti bhallātakatailam|)
6.1.2.16 |  *bhallātakasarpiḥ, bhallātakakṣīraṃ, bhallātakakṣaudraṃ, guḍabhallātakaṃ, bhallātakayūṣaḥ, bhallātakatailaṃ, bhallātakapalalaṃ, bhallātakasaktavaḥ, bhallātakalavaṇaṃ, bhallātakatarpaṇam, iti bhallātakavidhānamuktaṃ bhavati||
6.1.2.17 |  bhavanti cātra---
bhallātakāni kīkṣṇāni pākīnyagnisamāni ca|
bhavantyamṛtakalpāni prayuktāni yathāvidhi||
6.1.2.18 |  ete daśavidhāstveṣāṃ prayogāḥ parikīrtitāḥ|
rogaprakṛtisātmyajñastān prayogān prakalpayet||
6.1.2.19 |  kaphajo na sa rogo 'sti na vibandho 'sti kaścana|
yaṃ na bhallātakaṃ hanyācchīghraṃ medhāgnivardhanam||
6.1.2.20 |  prāṇakāmāḥ purā jīrṇāścyavanādyā maharṣayaḥ|
rasāyanaiḥ śivairetairbabhūvuramitāyuṣaḥ||
6.1.2.21 |  *brāhmaṃ tapo brāhmacaryamadhyātmadhyānameva ca|
dīrghāyuṣo yathākāmaṃ saṃbhṛtya tridivaṃ gatāḥ||
6.1.2.22 |  tasmādāyuḥprakarṣārthaṃ prāṇakāmaiḥ sukhārthibhiḥ|
rasāyanavidhiḥ sevyo vidhivatsusamāhitaiḥ||
6.1.2.23 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
rasāyanānāṃ saṃyogāḥ siddhā bhūtahitaiṣiṇā|
nirdiṣṭāḥ prāṇakāmīye *saptatriṃśanmaharṣiṇā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne rasāyanādhyāye prāṇakāmīyo nāma rasāyanapādo dvitīyaḥ||2 | |

rasāyanādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ|
6.1.3.1 |  athātaḥ karapracitīyaṃ rasāyanapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.1.3.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.1.3.3 |  karapracitānāṃ yathoktaguṇānāmāmalakānāmuddhṛtāsthnāṃ śuṣkacūrṇitānāṃ punarmāghe phālgune vā māse triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ svarasaparipītānāṃ punaḥ śuṣkacūrṇīkṛtānāmāḍhakamekaṃ grāhayet, atha jīvanīyānāṃ bṛṃhaṇīyānāṃ stanyajananānāṃ śukajananānāṃ vayaḥsthāpanānāṃ *ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyoktānāmauṣadhagaṇānāṃ candanāgurudhavatiniśakhadiraśiṃśapāsanasārāṇāṃ *cāṇuśaḥ kṛttānāmabhayābibhītakapippalīvacācavyacitrakaviḍaṅgānāṃ ca samastānāmāḍhakamekaṃ daśaguṇenāmbhasā sādhayet, tasminnāḍhakāvaśeṣe rase supūte tānyāmalakacūrṇāni dattvā gomayāgnibhirvaṃśavidalaśaratejanāgnibhirvā sādhayedyāvadapanayādrasasya, tamanupadagdhamupahṛtyāyasīṣu pātrīṣvāstīrya śoṣayet, suśuṣkaṃ tat kṛṣṇājinasyopari dṛṣadi ślakṣṇapiṣṭamayaḥsthālyāṃ nidhāpayet samyak, taccūrṇamayaścūrṇāṣṭabhāgasaṃprayuktaṃ madhusarpirbhyāmagnibalamabhisamīkṣya prayojayediti||
6.1.3.4 |  bhavanti cātra---
etadrasāyanaṃ pūrvaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo 'ṅgirāḥ|
jamadagnirbharadvājo bhṛguranye ca tadvidhāḥ||
6.1.3.5 |  prayujya prayatā muktāḥ śramavyādhijarābhayāt|
yāvadaicchaṃstapastepustatprabhāvānmahābalāḥ||
6.1.3.6 |  idaṃ rasāyanaṃ cakre brahmā vārṣasahasrikam|
jarāvyādhipraśamanaṃ buddhīndriyabalapradam||
(ityāmalakāyasaṃ brāhmarasāyanam|)
6.1.3.7 |  tapasā brahmacaryeṇa dhyānena praśamena ca|
rasāyanavidhānena kālayuktena cāyuṣā||
6.1.3.8 |  sthitā maharṣayaḥ pūrvaṃ, nahi kiñcidrasāyanam|
grāmyānāmanyakāryāṇāṃ sidhyatyaprayatātmanām||
6.1.3.9 |  saṃvatsaraṃ payovṛttirgavāṃ madhye vaset sadā|
sāvitrīṃ manasā dhyāyan brahmacārī yatendriyaḥ||
6.1.3.10 |  saṃvatsarānte paupīṃ vā māghīṃ vā phālgunīṃ tithim|
tryahopavāsī śuklasya praviśyāmalakīvanam||
6.1.3.11 |  bṛhatphalāḍhyamāruhya drumaṃ śākhāgataṃ phalam|
gṛhītvā pāṇinā tiṣṭhejjapan brahmāmṛtāgamāt||
6.1.3.12 |  tadā hyavaśyamamṛtaṃ vasatyāmalake kṣaṇam|
śarkarāmadhukalpāni snehavanti mṛdūni ca||
6.1.3.13 |  bhavantyamṛtasaṃyogāttāni yāvanti bhakṣayet|
jīvedvarṣasahasrāṇi tāvantyāgatayauvanaḥ||
6.1.3.14 |  sauhityameṣāṃ gatvā tu bhavatyamarasannibhaḥ|
svayaṃ cāsyopatiṣṭhante śrīrvedā vāk ca rūpiṇī||
(iti kevalāmalakarasāyanam|)
6.1.3.15 |  triphalāyā rase mūtre gavāṃ kṣāre ca lāvaṇe|
krameṇa ceṅgudīkṣāre kiṃśukakṣāra eva ca||
6.1.3.16 |  tīkṣṇāyasasya patrāṇi vahnivarṇāni *sādhayet|
