caturaṅguladīrghāṇi *tilotsedhatanūni ca||
6.1.3.17 |  jñātvā tānyañjanābhāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet|
tāni cūrṇāni madhunā rasenāmalakasya ca||
6.1.3.18 |  yuktāni lehavat kumbhe sthitāni ghṛtabhāvite|
saṃvatsaraṃ nidheyāni yavapalle tathaiva ca||
6.1.3.19 |  dadyādāloḍanaṃ māse sarvatrāloḍayan budhaḥ|
saṃvatsarātyaye tasya prayogo madhusarpiṣā||
6.1.3.20 |  prātaḥ prātarvalāpekṣī sātmyaṃ jīrṇe ca bhojanam|
eṣa eva ca lauhānāṃ prayogaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ||
6.1.3.21 |  nābhighātairna cātaṅkairjarayā na ca mṛtyunā|
sa dhṛṣyaḥ syādgajaprāṇaḥ sadā cātibalendriyaḥ||
6.1.3.22 |  dhīmān yaśasvī *vāksiddhaḥ śrutadhārī *mahādhanaḥ|
bhavet samāṃ prayuñjāno naro lauharasāyanam||
6.1.3.23 |  anenaiva vidhānena hemnaśca rajatasya ca|
āyuḥprakarṣakṛtsiddhaḥ prayogaḥ sarvaroganut||
(iti lauhādirasāyanam|)
6.1.3.24 |  aindrī mattyākhyako brāhmī vacā brahmasuvarcalā|
pippalyo lavaṇaṃ hema śaṅkhapuṣpī viṣaṃ ghṛtam||
6.1.3.25 |  eṣāṃ triyavakān bhāgān hemasarpirviṣairvinā|
dvau yavau tatra hemnastu tilaṃ dadyādviṣasya ca||
6.1.3.26 |  sarpiṣaśca palaṃ dadyāttadaikadhyaṃ prayojayet|
ghṛtaprabhūtaṃ sakṣaudraṃ jīrṇe cānnaṃ praśasyate||
6.1.3.27 |  jarāvyādhipraśamanaṃ smṛtimedhākaraṃ param|
āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ dhanyaṃ svaravarṇaprasādanam||
6.1.3.28 |  paramojaskaraṃ caitat siddhamaindraṃ rasāyanam|
nainat prasahate kṛtyā nālakṣmīrna viṣaṃ na ruk||
6.1.3.29 |  śvitraṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ jaṭharāṇi gulmāḥ plīhā purāṇo viṣamajvaraśca|
medhāsmṛtijñānaharāśca rogāḥ śāmyantyanenātibalāśca vātāḥ||
(ityaindraṃ rasāyanam|)
6.1.3.30 |  maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ svarasaḥ prayojyaḥ kṣīreṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya cūṇam|
raso guḍūcyāstu samūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaḥ prayojyaḥ khalu śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ||
6.1.3.31 |  āyuḥpradānyāmayanāśanāni balāgnivarṇasvaravardhanāni|
medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa ca śaṅkhapuṣpī||
(iti medhyarasāyanāni|)
6.1.3.32 |  pañcāṣṭau sapta daśa vā pippalīrmadhusarpiṣā|
rasāyanaguṇānveṣī samāmekāṃ prayojyet||
6.1.3.33 |  tisrastisrastu pūrvāhṇe bhuktvā 're bhojanasya ca|
pippalyaḥ kiṃśukakṣārabhāvitā ghṛtabharjitāḥ||
6.1.3.34 |  prayojyā madhusaṃmiśrā rasāyanaguṇaiṣiṇā|
jetuṃ kāsaṃ kṣayaṃ śoṣaṃ śvāsaṃ hikkāṃ galāmayān||
6.1.3.35 |  arśāṃsi grahaṇīdoṣaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ viṣamajvaram|
vaisvaryaṃ pīnasaṃ śophaṃ gulmaṃ vātabalāsakam||
(iti pippalīrasāyanam|)
6.1.3.36 |  kramavṛddhyā daśāhāni *daśapaippalikaṃ dinam|
vardhayet payasā sārdhaṃ tathaivāpanayet punaḥ||
6.1.3.37 |  jīrṇe jīrṇa ca bhuñjīta ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīrasarpiṣā|
pippalīnāṃ sahasrasya grayogo 'yaṃ rasāyanam||
6.1.3.38 |  piṣṭāstā balibhiḥ sevyāḥ, śṛtā madhyabalairnaraiḥ|
*cūrṇīkṛtā hṛasvabalairyojyā doṣāmayān prati||
6.1.3.39 |  daśapaippalikaḥ śreṣṭho madhyamaḥ *ṣaṭ prakīrtitaḥ|
prayogo yastriparyantaḥ sa kanīyān sa cābalaiḥ||
6.1.3.40 |  bṛṃhaṇaṃ svaryamāyuṣyaṃ plīhodaravināśanam|
vayasraḥ sthāpanaṃ medhyaṃ pippalīnāṃ rasāyanam||
(iti *pippalīvardhamānaṃ rasāyanam|)
6.1.3.41 |  jaraṇānte 'bhayāmekāṃ prāgbhuktād dve bibhītake|
bhuktvā tu madhusarpirbhyāṃ catvāryāmalakāni ca||
6.1.3.42 |  prayojayan samāmekāṃ triphalāyā rasāyanam|
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ pūrṇamajaro 'vyādhireva ca||
(iti triphalārasāyanam|)
6.1.3.43 |  traiphalenāyasīṃ pātrīṃ kalkenālepayennavām|
tamahorātrikaṃ lepaṃ pibet kṣaudrodakāplutam||
6.1.3.44 |  prabhūtasnehamaśanaṃ jīrṇe tatra praśasyate|
ajaro 'ruk samābhyāsājjīveccaiva samāḥ śatam||
(iti triphalārasāyanamaparam|)
6.1.3.45 |  mdhukena tugākṣīryā pippalyā kṣaudrasarpiṣā|
triphalā sitayā cāpi yuktā siddhaṃ rasāyanam||
(iti triphalārasāyanamaparam|)
6.1.3.46 |  *sarvalauhaiḥ suvarṇena vacayā madhusarpiṣā|
viḍaṅgapippalībhyāṃ ca triphalā lavaṇena ca||
6.1.3.47 |  saṃvatsaraprayogeṇa medhāsmṛtibalapradā|
bhavatyāyuḥpradā dhanyā jarāroganibarhaṇī||
(iti triphalārasāyanamaparam|)
6.1.3.48 |  anamlaṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca kaṭu pāke śilājatu|
nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ dhātubhyaścaturbhyastasya saṃbhavaḥ||
6.1.3.49 |  hemnaśca rajatāttāmrād-*varāt kṛṣṇāyasādapi|
rasāyanaṃ tadvidhibhistadvṛṣyaṃ tacca roganut||
6.1.3.50 |  vātapittakaphaghnaiśca niryūhaistat subhāvitam|
vīryotkarṣaṃ paraṃ yāti sarvairekaikaśo 'pi vā||
6.1.3.51 |  *prakṣiptoddhṛtamapyenat punastat prakṣipedrase|
koṣṇe saptāhametena vidhinā tasya bhāvanā||
6.1.3.52 |  pūrvoktena vidhānena lohaiścūrṇīkṛtaiḥ saha|
tat pītaṃ payasā dadyāddīrghamāyuḥ sukhānvitam||
6.1.3.53 |  jarāvyādhipraśamanaṃ dehadārḍhya karaṃ param|
medhāsmṛtikarṃ dhanyaṃ kṣīrāśī tat prayojayet||
6.1.3.54 |  prayogaḥ saptasaptāhāstrayaścaikaśca saptakaḥ|
nirdiṣṭastrividhastasya paro madhyo 'varastathā||
6.1.3.55 |  palamardhapalaṃ karṣo mātrā tasya tridhā matā|
jāterviśeṣaṃ savidhiṃ tasya vakṣyāmyataḥ param||
6.1.3.56 |  hemādyāḥ sūryasaṃtaptāḥ sravanti giridhātavaḥ|
jatvābhaṃ mṛdu mṛtsnācchaṃ yanmālaṃ tacchilājatu||
6.1.3.57 |  madhuraśca satiktaśca japāpuṣpanibhaśca yaḥ|
kaṭurvipāke śītaśca sa suvarṇasya nisravaḥ||
6.1.3.58 |  rūpyasya kaṭukaḥ śvetaḥ śītaḥ svādu vipacyate|
tāmrasya barhikaṇṭhābhastiktoṣṇaḥ pacyate kaṭu||
6.1.3.59 |  yastu guggulukābhāsastiktako lavaṇānvitaḥ|
kaṭurvipāke śītaśca sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ sa cāyasaḥ||
6.1.3.60 |  gomūtragandhayaḥ sarve sarvakarmasu yaugikāḥ|
rasāyanaprayogeṣu paścimastu viśiṣyate||
6.1.3.61 |  yathākramaṃ vātapitte śleṣmapitte kaphe triṣu|
śiśeṣataḥ praśasyante malā hemādidhātujāḥ||
6.1.3.62 |  śilājatuprayogeṣu vidāhīni gurūṇi ca|
varjayet sarvakālaṃ tu *kulatthān parivarjayet||
6.1.3.63 |  te hyatyantaviruddhatvādaśmano bhedanāḥ param|
loke dṛṣṭāstatasteṣāṃ prayogaḥ pratiṣidhyate||
6.1.3.64 |  payāṃsi *takrāṇi rasāḥ sayūṣāstoyaṃ samūtrā vividhāḥ kaṣāyāḥ|
āloḍanārthaṃ girijasya śastāste te prayojyāḥ prasamīkṣya kāryam||
6.1.3.65 |  na so 'sti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpaḥ śilāhvayaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya|
tat kālayogairvidhibhiḥ prayuktaṃ svasthasya corjāṃ vipulāṃ dadāti||
(iti śilājaturasāyanam|)
6.1.3.66 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
karapracitike pāde daśa ṣaṭ ca maharṣiṇā|
rasāyanānāṃ siddhānāṃ saṃyogāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ||

ityagvineśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne rasāyanādhyāye karapracitīyo nāma rasāyanapādastṛtīyaḥ||3 | |

rasāyanādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ|
6.1.4.1 |  athāta āyurvedasamutthānīyaṃ rasāyanapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.1.4.2 |  iti ha smāha bhāgavānātreyaḥ||
6.1.4.3 |  ṛṣayaḥ khalu kadācicchālīnā *yāyāvarāśca grāmyauṣadhyāhārāḥ santaḥ sāṃpannikā mandaceṣṭā nātikalyāśca prāyeṇa babhūvuḥ|
te sarvāsāmitikartavyatānāmasamarthāḥ santo grāmyavāsakṛtamātmadoṣaṃ matvā pūrvanicāsamapagatagrāmyadoṣaṃ śivaṃ puṇyamudāraṃ medhyamagamyamasukṛtibhirgaṅgāprabhavamamaragandharvakinnarānucaritamanekaratnanicayamacintyādbhutaprabhāvaṃ brāhmarṣiśiddhacāraṇānucaritaṃ divyatīrthauṣadhiprabhavamatiśaraṇyaṃ himavantamamarādhipatiguptaṃ jagmurbhṛgvaṅgiro 'trivasiṣṭhakaśyapāgastyapulastyavāmadevāsitagautamaprabhṛtayo maharṣayaḥ||
6.1.4.4 |  tānnidraḥ sahasradṛgamaragururabravīt---svāgataṃ brahmavidāṃ jñānatapodhanānāṃ brahmarṣīṇām|
asti nanu vo glāniraprabhāvatvaṃa vaisvaryaṃ vaivarṇyaṃ ca grāmyavāsakṛtamasukhamasukhānubandhaṃ ca; grāmyo hi vāso mūlamaśastānāṃ, tat kṛtaḥ puṇyakṛdbhiranugrahaḥ prajānāṃ, svaśarīramavekṣituṃ *kālaḥ kālaścāyamāyurvedopadeśasya brahmarṣīṇām; ātmanaḥ prajānāṃ cānugrahārthamāyurvedamaśvinau mahyaṃ prāyacchatāṃ, prajāpatiraśvibhyāṃ, prajāpatye brahmā, prajānāmalpamāyurjarāvyādhibahulamasukhamasukhānubandhamalpatvādalpatapodamaniyamadānādhyayanasaṃcayaṃ matvā puṇyatamamāyuḥprakarṣakaraṃ jarāvyādhipraśamanamūrjaskaramamṛtaṃ śivaṃ śaraṇyamudāraṃ bhavanto mattaḥ śrotumarhatāthopadhārayituṃ prakāśayituṃ ca prajānugrahārthamārṣaṃ brahma ca prati maitrīṃ kāruṇyamātmanaścānuttamaṃ puṇyamudāraṃ brāhmamakṣayaṃ karmeti||
6.1.4.5 |  tacchutvā vibudhapativacanamṛṣayaḥ sarva evamaravaramṛgbhistuṣṭuvuḥ, prahṛṣṭāśca tadvacanamabhinananduśceti||
6.1.4.6 |  athendrastadāyurvedāmṛtamṛṣibhyaḥ saṃkramyovāca---etat sarvamanuṣṭheyam, ayaṃ ca śivaḥ kālo rasāyanānāṃ, divyāścauṣadhayo *himavatprabhavāḥ prāptavīryāḥ; tadyathā---aindrī, brāhmī, payasyā, kṣīrapuṣpī, śrāvaṇī, mahāśrāvaṇī, śatāvarī, vidārī, jīvantī, punarnavā, nāgabalā, sthirā, vacā, chatrā, atichatrā, medā, mehāmedā, jīvanīyāścānyāḥ payasā prayuktāḥ ṣaṇmāsāt paramāyurvayaśca taruṇamanāmayatvaṃ svaravarṇasaṃpadamupacayaṃ medhāṃ smṛtimuttamabalamiṣṭāṃścāparān bhāvānāvahanti siddhāḥ||
(itīndroktaṃ rasāyanam|)
6.1.4.7 |  brahmasuvarcalā nāmauṣadhiryā hiraṇyakṣīrā puṣkarasadṛśapatrā, ādityaparṇī nāmauṣadhiryā 'sūryakāntā' iti vijñāyate suvarṇakṣīrā sūryamaṇḍalākārapuṣpā ca, nārīnāmauṣadhiḥ 'aśvabalā' iti vijñāyate yā *balvajasadṛśapatrā, kāṣṭhagodhā nāmauṣa dhirgodhākārā, sarpānāmauṣadhiḥ sarpākārā, somo nāmauṣadhirājaḥ *pañcadaśaparvā sa somo iva hīyate vardhate ca, padmā nāmauṣadhiḥ padmākārā padmaraktā padmagandhā ca, ajā nāmauṣadhiḥ 'ajaśṛṅgī' iti vijñāyate, nīlā nāmauṣadhistu nīlakṣīrā nīlapuṣpā latāpratānabahuleti; āsāmoṣadhīnāṃ yāṃ yāmevopalabheta tasyāstasyāḥ svarasasya sauhityaṃ gatvā snehabhāvitāyāmārdrapalāśadroṇyāṃ sapidhānāyāṃ digvāsāḥ śayīta, tatra pralīyate, ṣaṇmāsena punaḥ saṃbhavati, tasyājaṃ payaḥ pratyavasthāpanaṃ; ṣaṇmāsena devatānukārī bhavati vayovarṇasvarākṛtibalaprabhābhiḥ, svayaṃ cāsya sarvavācogatāni prādurbhavanti, divyaṃ cāsya cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca bhavati, gatiryojanasahasraṃ, daśavarṣasahasrāṇyāyuranupadravaṃ ceti||
6.1.4.8 |  bhavanti cātra---
divyānāmoṣadhīnāṃ yaḥ prabhāvaḥ sa bhavadvidhaiḥ|
śakyaḥ sodumaśakyastu syāt sodumakṛtātmabhiḥ||
6.1.4.9 |  auṣadhīnāṃ prabhāveṇa tiṣṭhatāṃ sve ca karmaṇi|
bhavatāṃ vikhilaṃ śreyaḥ sarvamevopapatsyate||
6.1.4.10 |  vānaprasthairgṛhasthaiśca prayatairniyatātmabhiḥ|
śakyā auṣadhayo hyetāḥ sevituṃ viṣayābhijāḥ||
6.1.4.11 |  *yāstu kṣetraguṇaisteṣāṃ madhyamena ca karmaṇā|
mṛduvīryatarāstāsāṃ vidhirjñeyaḥ sa eva tu||
6.1.4.12 |  paryeṣṭuṃ tāḥ prayoktuṃ vā ye 'samarthāḥ sukhārthinaḥ|
rasāyanavidhisteṣāmayamanyaḥ praśasyate||
6.1.4.13 |  balyānāṃ jīvanīyānāṃ bṛṃhaṇīyāśca yā daśa|
vayasaḥ sthāpanānāṃ ca khadirasyāsanasya ca||
6.1.4.14 |  kharjūrāṇāṃ madhūkānāṃ mustānāmutpalasya ca|
mṛdvīkānāṃ viḍaṅgānāṃ vacāyāścitrakasya ca||
6.1.4.15 |  śatāvaryāḥ payasyāyāḥ pippalyā joṅgakasya ca|
ṛddhyā nāgabalāyāśca dvāradāyā dhavasya ca||
6.1.4.16 |  triphalākaṇṭakāryośca vidāryāścandanasya ca|
ikṣūṇāṃ śaramūlānāṃ śrīparṇyāstiniśasya ca||
6.1.4.17 |  rasāḥ prthak pṛthaggrāhyāḥ palāśakṣāra eva ca|
eṣāṃ palonmitān bhāgān payo gavyaṃ caturguṇam||
6.1.4.18 |  dve pātre tilatailasya dve ca gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ|
tat sādhyaṃ sarvamekatra susidhaṃ snehamuddharet||
6.1.4.19 |  tatrāmalakacūrṇānāmāḍhakaṃ śatabhāvitam|
svarasenaiva dātavyaṃ kṣaudrasyābhinavasya||
6.1.4.20 |  śarkarācūrṇapātraṃ ca prasthamekaṃ pradāpayet|
tugākṣīryāḥ sapippalyāḥ sthāpyaṃ saṃmūrcchitaṃ ca tat||
6.1.4.21 |  sucaukṣe mārtike kumbhe māsārdhaṃ ghṛtabhāvite|
mātrāmagnisamāṃ tasya tata ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet||
6.1.4.22 |  hematāmrapravālānāmayasaḥ sphaṭikasya ca|
muktāvaidūryaśaṅkhānāṃ cūrṇānāṃ rajatasya ca||
6.1.4.23 |  prakṣipya ṣoḍaśīṃ mātrāṃ vihāyāyāsamaithunam|
jīrṇe jīrṇe ca bhuñjīta ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīrasarpiṣā||
6.1.4.24 |  sarvarogapraśamanaṃ vṛṣyamāyuṣyamuttamam|
sattvasmṛtiśarīrāgnibuddhīndriyabalapradam||
6.1.4.25 |  paramūrjaskaraṃ caiva varṇasvarakaraṃ tathā|
viṣālakṣmīpraśamanaṃ sarvavācogatapradam||
6.1.4.26 |  siddhārthatāṃ cābhinavaṃ vayaśca prajāpriyatvaṃ ca yaśaśca loke|
prayojyamicchadbhiridaṃ yathāvadrasāyanaṃ brāhmamudāravīryam||
(itīndroktarasāyanamaparam|)
6.1.4.27 |  samarthānāmarogāṇāṃ dhīmatāṃ niyatātmanām|
kṛṭīpraveśaḥ *kṣaṇināṃ paricchadavatāṃ hitaḥ||
6.1.4.28 |  ato 'nyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ|
tayoḥ śreṣṭhataraḥ pūrvo vidhiḥ sa tu suduṣkaraḥ||
6.1.4.29 |  rasāyanavidhibhraṃśājjāyeran vyādhayo yadi|
yathāsvamauṣadhaṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktvā rasāyanam||
6.1.4.30 |  satyavādinamakrodhaṃ nivṛttaṃ madyamaithunāt|
ahiṃsakamanāyāsaṃ praśāntaṃ priyavādinam||
6.1.4.31 |  japaśaucaparaṃ dhīraṃ dānanityaṃ tapasvinam|
devagobrāhmaṇācāryaguruvṛddhārcane ratam||
6.1.4.32 |  ānṛśaṃsyaparaṃ nityaṃ nityaṃ *karuṇavedinam|
samajāgaraṇasvapnaṃ nityaṃ kṣīraghṛtāśinam||
6.1.4.33 |  deśakālapramāṇajñaṃ yuktijñamanahaṅkṛtam|
śastācāramasaṃkīrṇamadhyātmapravaṇendriyam||
6.1.4.34 |  upāsitāraṃ vṛddhānāmāstikānāṃ jitātmanām|
dharmaśāstraparaṃ vidyānnaraṃ nityarasāyanam||
6.1.4.35 |  guṇairetaiḥ samuditaiḥ prayuṅkte yo rasāyanam|
rasāyanaguṇān sarvān yathoktān sa samaśrute||
(ityācārarasāyanam|)
6.1.4.36 |  yathāsthūlamanirvāhya doṣāñchārīramānasām|
rasāyanaguṇairjanturyujyate na kadācana||
6.1.4.37 |  yogā hyāyuḥprakarṣārthā jarāroganibarhaṇāḥ|
manaḥśarīraśuddhānāṃ sidhyanti prayatātmanām||
6.1.4.38 |  tadetanna bhavedvācyaṃ sarvameva hatātmasu|
*arujebhyo 'dvijātibhyaḥ śuśrūṣā yeṣu nāsti ca||
6.1.4.39 |  ye rasāyanasaṃyogā vṛṣyayogāśca ye matāḥ|
yaccoṣadhaṃ vikārāṇāṃ sarvaṃ tadvaidyasaṃśrayam||
6.1.4.40 |  prāṇācāryaṃ budhastasmāddhīmantaṃ vedapāragam|
aśvināviva devendraḥ pūjayedatiśaktitaḥ||
6.1.4.41 |  aśvinau devabhiṣajau yajñavāhāviti smṛtau|
yajñasya hi śiraśchinnaṃ punastābhyāṃ samāhitam||
6.1.4.42 |  praśīrṇā daśanāḥ pūṣṇo netre naṣṭe bhagasya ca|
vajriṇaśca bhujastambhastābhyāmeva cikitsitaḥ||
6.1.4.43 |  cikitsitaśca śītāṃśurgṛhīto rājayakṣmaṇā|
somābhipatitaścandraḥ kṛtastābhyāṃ punaḥ sukhī||
6.1.4.44 |  bhārgavaścyavanaḥ kāmī vṛddhaḥ san vikṛtiṃ gataḥ|
vītavarṇasvaropetaḥ kṛtastābhyāṃ punaryuvā||
6.1.4.45 |  etaiścānyaiśca bahubhiḥ karmabhirbhiṣaguttamau|
babhūvaturbhṛśaṃ pūjyāvindrādīnāṃ mahātmanām||
6.1.4.46 |  grahāḥ stotrāṇi mantrāṇi *tathā nānāhavīṃṣi ca|
*dhūmrāśca paśavastābhyāṃ prakalpyante dvijātibhiḥ||
6.1.4.47 |  prātaśca savane somaṃ śakro 'śvibhyāṃ sahāśnute|
sautrāmaṇyāṃ ca bhagavānaśvibhyāṃ saha modate||
6.1.4.48 |  indrāgnī cāśvinau caiva stūyante prāyaśo dvijaiḥ|
stūyante vedavākyeṣu na tathā 'nyā hi devatāḥ||
6.1.4.49 |  ajarairamaraistāvadvibudhaiḥ sādhipairdhruvaiḥ|
pūjyete prayatairevamaśvinau bhiṣajāviti||
6.1.4.50 |  mṛtyuvyādhijarāvaśyairduḥkhaprāyaiḥ sukhārthibhiḥ|
kiṃ punarbhiṣajo martyaiḥ syurnātiśaktitaḥ||
6.1.4.51 |  śīlavānmatimān yukto *dvijātiḥ śāstrapāragaḥ|
prāṇibhirguruvat pūjyaḥ prāṇācāryaḥ sa hi smṛtaḥ||
6.1.4.52 |  vidyāsamāptau *bhiṣajo dvitīyā jātirucyate|
aśnute vaidyaśabdaṃ hi na vaidyaḥ pūrvajanmanā||
6.1.4.53 |  vidyāsamāptau brahmaṃ vā sattvamārṣamathāpi vā|
dhruvamāviśati *jñānāttasmadvaidyo dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ||
6.1.4.54 |  nābhidhyāyenna cākrośedahitaṃ na samācaret|
prāṇācāryaṃ budhaḥ kaścidicchannāyuranitvaram||
6.1.4.55 |  cikitsitastu *saṃśrutya yo vā 'saṃśrutya mānavaḥ|
nopākaroti vaidyāya nāsti tasyeha niṣkṛtiḥ||
6.1.4.56 |  bhiṣagapyāturān sarvān svasutāniva yatnavān|
āṣādhebhyo hi saṃrakṣedicchan dharmamanuttamam||
6.1.4.57 |  dharmārthaṃ *cārthakāmārthamāyurvedo maharṣibhiḥ|
prakāśito dharmaparairicchadbhiḥ sthānamakṣaram||
6.1.4.58 |  nārthārthaṃ nāpi kāmārthamatha bhūtadayāṃ prati|
vartate yaścikitsāyāṃ sa sarvamativartate||
6.1.4.59 |  kurvate ye tu vṛttyarthaṃ cikitsāpaṇyavikrayam|
te hitvā kāñcanaṃ rāśiṃ pāṃśurāśimupāsate||
6.1.4.60 |  dāruṇaiḥ kṛṣyamāṇānāṃ gadairvaivasvatakṣayam|
chittvā vaivasvatān pāśān jīvitaṃ yaḥ prayacchati||
6.1.4.61 |  dharmārthadātā sadṛśastasya nehopalabhyate|
na hi jīvitadānāddhi dānamanyadviśiṣyate||
6.1.4.62 |  paro bhūtadayā dharma iti matvā cikitsayā|
vartate yaḥ sa siddhārthaḥ sukhamatyantamaśnute||
6.1.4.63 |  tatra ślokau---
āyurvedasamutthānaṃ divyauṣadhividhiṃ śubham|
amṛtālpāntaraguṇaṃ siddhaṃ ratnarasāyanam||
6.1.4.64 |  siddhebhyo brahmacāribhyo yaduvācāmareśvaraḥ|
āyurvedasamutthāne tat sarvaṃ saṃprakāśitam||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsitasthāne rasāyanādhyāye āyurvedasamutthānīyo nāma rasāyanapādaścaturthaḥ||4 | |

samāptaścāyaṃ rasāyanādhyāyaḥ||1 | |

dvitīyodhyāyaḥ|
vājīkaraṇādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ|

6.2.1.1 |  athātaḥ saṃyogaśaramūlīyaṃ vājīkaraṇapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.2.1.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.2.1.3 |  vājīkaraṇamanvicchet puruṣo nityamātmavān|
tadāyattau hi dharmārthau prītiśca yaśa eva ca||
6.2.1.4 |  putrasyāyatanaṃ hyetadguṇāścaite sutāśrayāḥ|
vājīkaraṇamagryaṃ ca kṣetraṃ strī yā praharṣiṇī||
6.2.1.5 |  iṣṭā hyekaikaśo 'pyarthā paraṃ prītikarā smṛtāḥ|
kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṅdhātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ||
(saṅghāto hīndriyārtho yaḥ sa prītijanano 'dhikam|)
6.2.1.6 |  stryāśrayo hīndriyārtho yaḥ sa prītijanano 'dhikam|
strīṣu prītirviśeṣeṇa strīṣvapatyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam||
6.2.1.7 |  dharmārthau strīṣu lakṣmīśca strīṣu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ|
surūpā yauvanasthā yā lakṣaṇairyā vibhūṣitā||
6.2.1.8 |  yā vaśyā śikṣitā yā ca sā strī vṛṣyatamā matā|
nānābhaktyā tu lokasya daivayogācca yoṣitām||
6.2.1.9 |  taṃ taṃ prāpya vivardhante naraṃ rūpādayo guṇāḥ|
vayorūpavacohāvairyā yasya paramāṅganā||
6.2.1.10 |  praviśatyāśu hṛdayaṃ daivādvā karmaṇo 'pi vā|
hṛdayotsavarūpā yā yā samānamanaḥśayā||
6.2.1.11 |  samānasattvā yā vaśyā yā yasya prīyate priyaiḥ|
yā pāśabhūtā sarveṣāmindriyāṇāṃ parairguṇaiḥ||
6.2.1.12 |  yayā viyukto nistrīkamaratirmanyate jagat|
yasyā rte śarīraṃ nā dhatte śūnyamivendriyaiḥ||
6.2.1.13 |  śokodvegāratibhayairyāṃ dṛṣṭvā nābhibhūyate|
yāti yāṃ prāpya visrambhaṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyatyatīva yām||
6.2.1.14 |  apūrvāmiva yāṃ yāti nityaṃ harṣātivegatāḥ|
gatvā garvā 'pi bahuśo yāṃ tṛptiṃ naiva gacchati||
6.2.1.15 |  sā strī vṛṣyatamā tasya nānābhāvā hi mānavāḥ|
atulyagotrāṃ vṛṣyāṃ ca prahṛṣṭāṃ nirupadravām||
6.2.1.16 |  śuddhasnātāṃ vrajennārīmapatyārthī nirāmayaḥ|
acchāyaścaikaśākhaśca niṣphalaśca yathā drumaḥ||
6.2.1.17 |  aniṣṭagandhaścaikaśca nirapatyastathā naraḥ|
citradīpaḥ saraḥ śuṣkamadhāturdhātusannibhaḥ||
6.2.1.18 |  niṣprajastṛṇapūlīti mantavyaḥ puruṣākṛtiḥ|
apratiṣṭhaśca nagnaśca śūnyaścaikendriyaśca nā||
6.2.1.19 |  mantavyo niṣkriyaścaiva yasyāpatyaṃ na vidyate|
bahumūrtirbahumukho bahuvyūho bahukriyaḥ||
6.2.1.20 |  bahucakṣurbahujñāno bahvātmā ca bahuprajaḥ|
maṅgalyo 'yaṃ praśasyo 'yaṃ dhanyo 'yaṃ vīryavānayam||
6.2.1.21 |  bahuśākho 'yamiti ca stūyate nā bahuprajaḥ|
prītirbalaṃ sukhaṃ vṛttirvistāro *vipulaṃ kulam||
6.2.1.22 |  yaśo lokāḥ sukhodarkāstuṣṭiścāpatyasaṃśritāḥ|
tasmādapatyamanvicchan guṇāṃścāpatyasaṃśritān||
6.2.1.23 |  vājīkaraṇanityaḥ syādicchan kāmasukhāni ca|
upabhogasukhān siddhān vīryāpatyavivardhanān||
6.2.1.24 |  vājīkaraṇasaṃyogān pravakṣyāmyata uttaram|
śaramūlekṣumūlāni kāṇḍekṣuḥ sekṣuvālikā||
6.2.1.25 |  śatāvarī payasyā ca vidārī kaṇṭakārikā|
jīvantī jīvako medā vīrā carṣabhako balā||
6.2.1.26 |  ṛddhirgokṣurakaṃ rāsnā sātmaguptā punarnavā|
eṣāṃ tripalikān *bhāgān māṣāṇāmāḍhakaṃ navam||
6.2.1.27 |  vipācayejjaladroṇe caturbhāgaṃ ca śeṣayet|
tatra peṣyāṇi madhukaṃ drākṣā phalgūni pippalī||
6.2.1.28 |  ātmaguptā madhūkāni kharjūrāṇi śatāvarī|
vidāryāmalakekṣūṇāṃ rasasya ca pṛthak pṛthak||
6.2.1.29 |  sarpiṣaścāḍhakaṃ dadyāt kṣīradroṇaṃ ca tadbhiṣak|
sādhayedghṛtaśeṣaṃ ca supūtaṃ yojayet punaḥ||
6.2.1.30 |  śarkarāyāstugākṣīryāścūrṇaiḥ prasthonmataiḥ pṛthak|
palaiścaturbhirmāgadhyāḥ palena maricasya ca||
6.2.1.31 |  tvagelākeśarāṇāṃ ca cūrṇairardhapalonmitaiḥ|
madhunaḥ kuḍavābhyāṃ ca dvābhyāṃ tatkārayedbhiṣak||
6.2.1.32 |  palikā *gulikāstyānāstā yathāgni prayojayet|
eṣa vṛṣyaḥ paraṃ yogo bṛṃhaṇo balavardhanaḥ||
6.2.1.33 |  anenāśva ivodīrṇo balī liṅgaṃ samarpayet|
(iti vṛṃhaṇīguṭikā|)
māṣāṇāmātmaguptāyā bījānāmāḍhakaṃ navam||
6.2.1.34 |  jīvakarṣabhakau vīrāṃ medāmṛddhiṃ śatāvarīm|
madhukaṃ cāśvagandhāṃ ca sādhayet kuḍavonmitām||
6.2.1.35 |  rase tasmin ghṛtaprasthaṃ gavyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ payaḥ|
vidārīṇāṃ rasaprasthaṃ prasthamikṣurasasya ca||
6.2.1.36 |  dattvā mṛdvagninā sādhyaṃ siddhaṃ sarpirnidhāpayet|
śarkarāyāstugākṣīryāḥ kṣaudrasya ca pṛthak pṛthak||
6.2.1.37 |  bhāgāṃścatuṣpalāṃstatra pippalyāścāvapet palam|
palaṃ pūrvamato līḍhvā tato 'nnamupayojayet||
6.2.1.38 |  ya icchedakṣayaṃ śukraṃ śephasaścottamaṃ balam|
(iti vājīkaraṇaṃ ghṛtam|)
śarkarā māṣavidalāstugākṣīrī payo ghṛtam||
6.2.1.39 |  godhūmacūrṇaṣaṣṭhāni sarpiṣyutkārikāṃ pacet|
tāṃ nātipakvāṃ mṛditāṃ kaukkuṭe madhure rase||
6.2.1.40 |  sugandhe prakṣipeduṣṇe yathā sāndrībhavedrasaḥ|
eṣa piṇḍdaraso vṛṣyaḥ pauṣṭiko balavardhanaḥ||
6.2.1.41 |  anenāśva ivodīrṇo *balī liṅgaṃ samarpayet|
śikhitittirihaṃsānāmevaṃ piṇḍaraso mataḥ|
balavarṇasvarakaraḥ pumāṃstena vṛṣāyate||
(iti *vājīkaraṇapiṇḍarasāḥ|)
6.2.1.42 |  ghṛtaṃ māṣān sabastāṇḍān sādhayenmāhiṣe rese|
bharjayettaṃ rasaṃ pūtaṃ phalāmlaṃ navasarpiṣi||
6.2.1.43 |  īṣatsalavaṇaṃ yuktaṃ dhānyajīrakanāgaraiḥ|
eṣa vṛṣyaśca balyaśca bṛṃhaṇaśca rasottamaḥ||
(iti *vṛṣyamāhiṣarasaḥ|)
6.2.1.44 |  caṭakāṃstittirirase tittirīn kaukkuṭe rase|
kukkuṭān bārhiṇarase hāṃse bārhiṇameva ca||
6.2.1.45 |  navasarpiṣi saṃtaptān phalāmlān kārayedrasān|
madhurān vā yathāsātmyaṃ gandhāḍhyān balavardhanām||
(ityanye vṛṣyasarāḥ|)
6.2.1.46 |  tṛptiṃ caṭakamāṃsānāṃ gatvā yo 'nupibet payaḥ|
na tasya liṅgaśaithilyaṃ syānna śukrakṣayo niśi||
(iti vṛṣyamāṃsam|)
6.2.1.47 |  māṣayūṣeṇa yo bhuktvā ghṛtāṭhyaṃ ṣaṣṭikaudanam|
payaḥ pibati rātriṃ sa kṛtsnāṃ jāgarti vegavān||
(iti vṛṣyamāṣayogaḥ|)
6.2.1.48 |  na nā svapiti rātriṣu *nityastabdhena śephasā|
tṛptaḥ kukkuṭamāṃsānāṃ bhṛṣṭānāṃ nakraretasi||
(iti *vṛṣyaḥ kukkuṭamāṃsaprayogaḥ|)
6.2.1.49 |  niśsrāvya matsyāṇḍarasaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ sarpiṣi bhakṣayet|
haṃsabarhiṇadakṣāṇāmevamaṇḍāni bhakṣayet||
(iti vṛṣyo 'ṇḍarasaḥ|)
6.2.1.50 |  bhavataścātra---
srotaśsu śuddheṣvamale śarīre vṛṣyaṃ yadā *nā mitamatti kāle|
vṛṣāyate tena paraṃ manuṣyastadbṛṃhaṇaṃ caiva balapradaṃ ca||
6.2.1.51 |  tasmāt purā śodhanameva kāryaṃ balānurūpaṃ na hi vṛṣyayogāḥ|
sidhyanti dehe maline prayuktāḥ *kliṣṭe yathā vāsasi rāgayogāḥ||
6.2.1.52 |  tatra ślokau---
vājīkaraṇasāmarthyaṃ kṣetraṃ strī yasya caiva yā|
ye doṣā nirapatyānāṃ guṇāḥ putravatāṃ ca ye||
6.2.1.53 |  daśa pañca ca saṃyogā vīryāpatyavivardhanāḥ|
uktāste śaramūlīye pāde puṣṭibalapradāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne vājīkaraṇādhyāye saṃyogaśaramūlīyo nāma vājīkaraṇapādaḥ prathamaḥ||1 | |

vājīkaraṇādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ|
6.2.2.1 |  athāta āsiktakṣīrikaṃ vājīkaraṇapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.2.2.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.2.2.3 |  āsiktakṣīramāpūrṇamaśuṣkaṃ śuddhaṣaṣṭikam|
*udūkhale samāpothya pīḍayet kṣīramarditam||
6.2.2.4 |  gṛhītvā taṃ rasaṃ pūtaṃ gavyena payasā saha|
bījānāmātmaguptāyā dhānyamāṣarasena ca||
6.2.2.5 |  balāyāḥ śūrpaparṇyośca jīvantyā jīvakasya *ca|
ṛddhyarṣabhakakākolīśvadaṃṣṭrāmadhukasya ca||
6.2.2.6 |  śatāvaryā vidāryāśca drākṣākharjūrayorapi|
saṃyuktaṃ mātrayā vaidyaḥ sādhayettatra cāvapet||
6.2.2.7 |  tugākṣīryāḥ samāṣāṇāṃ śālīnāṃ ṣaṣṭikasya ca|
godhūmānāṃ ca cūrṇāni yaiḥ sa sāndrībhavedrasaḥ||
6.2.2.8 |  sāndrībhūtaṃ ca kuryāt prabhūtamadhuśarkaram|
guli(ṭi)kā badaraistulyāstāśca sarpiṣi bharjayet||
6.2.2.9 |  tā yathāgni prayuñjānaḥ kṣīramāṃsarasāśanaḥ|
paśyatyapatyaṃ vipulaṃ vṛddho 'pyātmajamakṣayam||
(ityapatyakarī ṣaṣṭikādiguṭikā|)
6.2.2.10 |  caṭakānāṃ sahaṃsānāṃ dakṣāṇāṃ śikhināṃ tathā|
śiśumārasya nakrasya bhiṣak śukrāṇi saṃharet||
6.2.2.11 |  gavyaṃ sarpirvarāhasya kuliṅgasya vasāmapi|
ṣaṣṭikānāṃ ca cūrṇāni cūrṇaṃ *godhūmakasya ca||
6.2.2.12 |  ebhiḥ pūpalikāḥ kāryāḥ śaṣkulyo cartikāstathā|
pūpā dhānāśca vividhā bhakṣyāścānye pṛthagvidhāḥ||
6.2.2.13 |  eṣāṃ prayogādbhsakṣyāṇāṃ stabdhenāpūrṇaretasā|
śephasā vājivadyāti yāvadicchaṃ striyo naraḥ||
(iti vṛṣyapūpalikādiyogāḥ|)
6.2.2.14 |  ātmaguptāphalaṃ māṣān kharjūrāṇi śatāvarīm|
śṛṅgāṭakāni mṛdvīkāṃ sādhayet prasṛtonmitam||
6.2.2.15 |  kṣīraprasthaṃ jalaprasthametat prasthāvaśeṣitam|
śuddhena vāsasā pūtaṃ yojayet prasṛtaistribhiḥ||
6.2.2.16 |  śarkarāyāstugākṣīryāḥ sarpiṣo 'bhinavasya ca|
tat pāyayeta sakṣaudraṃ ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ ca bhojayet||
6.2.2.17 |  jarāparīto 'pyabalo yogenānena vindati|
naro 'patyaṃ suvipulaṃ yuveva ca sa hṛṣyati||
(ityapatyakaraḥ svarasaḥ|)
6.2.2.18 |  kharjūrīmastakaṃ māṣān payasyāṃ ca śatttvarīm|
kharjūrāṇi madhūkāni mṛdvīkāmajaḍāphalam||
6.2.2.19 |  palonmitāni *matimān sādhayet salilāḍhake|
tena pādāvaśeṣeṇa kṣīraprasthaṃ vipācayet||
6.2.2.20 |  kṣīraśeṣeṇa tenādyād ghṛtāḍhyaṃ ṣaṣṭikaudanam|
saśarkareṇa saṃyoga eṣa vṛṣyaḥ paraṃ smṛtaḥ||
(iti vṛṣyakṣīram|)
6.2.2.21 |  jīvakarṣabhakau medāṃ jīvantīṃ śrāvaṇīdvayam|
kharjūraṃ ma dhukaṃ drākṣāṃ pippalīṃ viśvabheṣajam||
6.2.2.22 |  śṛṅgāṭakaṃ vidārīṃ ca navaṃ sarpiḥ payo jalam|
siddhaṃ ghṛtāvaśeṣaṃ taccharkarākṣaudrapādikam||
6.2.2.23 |  ṣaṣṭikānnena saṃyuktamupayojyaṃ yathābalam|
vṛṣyaṃ balyaṃ ca kaṇṭhyaṃ bṛṃhaṇamuttamam||
(iti vṛṣyaghṛtam|)
6.2.2.24 |  dadhnaḥ saraṃ śaraccandrasannibhaṃ doṣavarjitam|
śarkarākṣaudramaricaistugākṣīryā ca buddhimān||
6.2.2.25 |  yuktyā yuktaṃ sasūkṣmailaṃ nave *kumbhe śucau paṭe|
mārjitaṃ prakṣipecchīte ghṛtāṭhye ṣaṣṭikaudane||
6.2.2.26 |  pibenmātrāṃ rasālāyāstaṃ bhuktvā *ṣaṣṭikaudanam|
varṇasvarabalopetaḥ pumāṃstena vṛṣāyate||
(vṛṣyo dadhisaraprayogaḥ|)
6.2.2.27 |  candrāṃśukalpaṃ payasā ghṛtāṭhyaṃ ṣaṣṭikaudanam|
śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaṃ prayuñjāno vṛṣāyate||
(iti vṛṣyaḥ ṣaṣṭikaudanaprayogaḥ|)
6.2.2.28 |  tapte sarpiṣi nakrāṇḍaṃ tāmracūḍāṇḍamiśritam|
yuktaṃ ṣaṣṭikacūrṇena sarpiṣā 'bhinavena ca||
6.2.2.29 |  paktvā pūpalikāḥ khādedvāruṇīmaṇḍapo naraḥ|
ya icchedaśvavadgantuṃ prasektuṃ gajavacca yaḥ||
(iti vṛṣyapūpalikāḥ|)
6.2.2.30 |  bhavataścātra---
etaiḥ prayogairvidhivadvapuṣmān *vīryopapanno balavarṇayuktaḥ|
harṣānvito vājivadaṣṭavarṣo bhavet samarthaśca varāṅganāsu||
6.2.2.31 |  yadyacca kiñcinmanasaḥ priyaṃ syādramyā vanāntāḥ pulināni śailāḥ|
iṣṭāḥ striyo bhūṣaṇagandhamālyaṃ priyā vayasyāśca tadatra *yogyam||
6.2.2.32 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
āsiktakṣīrike pāde ye yogāḥ parikīrtitāḥ|
aṣṭāvapatyakāmaiste prayojyāḥ pauruṣārthibhiḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne vājīkaraṇādhyāye āsiktakṣīriko nāma vājīkaraṇapādo dvitīyaḥ||2 | |

vājīkaraṇādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ|
6.2.3.1 |  athāto māṣaparṇabhṛtīyaṃ vājīkaraṇapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.2.3.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.2.3.3 |  māṣaparṇabhṛtāṃ dhenuṃ ghṛṣṭiṃ puṣṭāṃ catuśstanīm|
samānavarṇavatsāṃ ca jīvadvatsāṃ ca buddhimān||
6.2.3.4 |  rohiṇīmathavā kṛṣṇāmūrdhvaśṛṅgīmadāruṇām|
ikṣvādāmarjunādāṃ vā sāndrakṣīrāṃ ca dhārayet||
6.2.3.5 |  kevalaṃ tu payastasyāḥ śṛtaṃ vā 'śṛtameva vā|
śarkarākṣaudrasarpirbhiryuktaṃ tadvṛṣyamuttamam||
6.2.3.6 |  śukralairjīvanīyaiśca bṛṃhaṇairbalavardhanaiḥ|
kṣīrasaṃjanānaiścaiva payaḥ siddhaṃ pṛthak pṛthak||
6.2.3.7 |  yuktaṃ godhūmacūrṇena saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram|
paryāyeṇa prayoktavyamicchatā śukramakṣayam||
6.2.3.8 |  medāṃ payasyāṃ jīvantīṃ vidārīṃ kaṇṭakārikām|
śvadaṃṣṭāṃ kṣīrikāṃ māṣān godhūmāñchāliṣaṣṭikān||
6.2.3.9 |  payasyardhodake *paktvā kārṣikānāḍhakonmite|
vivarjayet payaḥśeṣaṃ tat pūtaṃ kṣaudrasarpiṣā||
6.2.3.10 |  yuktaṃ saśarkaraṃ pītvā vṛddhaḥ saptatiko 'pi vā|
vipulaṃ labhate 'patyaṃ yuveva ca sa hṛṣyati||
6.2.3.11 |  maṇḍalairjātarūpasya tasyā eva payaḥ śṛtam|
apatyajananaṃ siddhaṃ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram||
6.2.3.12 |  triṃśat supiṣṭāḥ pippalyaḥ prakuñce tailasarpiṣoḥ|
bhṛṣṭāḥ saśarkarākṣaudrāḥ kṣīradhārāvadohitāḥ||
6.2.3.13 |  pītvā yathābalaṃ cordhvaṃ ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīrasarpiṣā|
bhuktvā na rātrimastabdhaṃ liṅgaṃ paśyati nā kṣarat||
(iti vṛṣyaḥ pippalīyogaḥ|)
6.2.3.14 |  śvadaṃṣṭrāyā vidāryāśca rase kṣīracaturgaṇe|
ghṛtāḍhyaḥ sādhito vṛṣyo māṣaṣaṣṭikapāyasaḥ||
(iti vṛṣyapāyasayogaḥ|)
6.2.3.15 |  phalānāṃ jīvanīyānāṃ snigdhānāṃ rucikāriṇām|
kuḍavaścūrṇitānāṃ syāt svayaṅguptāphalasya ca||
6.2.3.16 |  kuḍavaścaiva māṣāṇāṃ dvau dvau ca tilamudgayoḥ|
godhūmaśālicūrṇānāṃ kuḍavaḥ kuḍavo bhavet||
6.2.3.17 |  sarpiṣaḥ kuḍavaścaikastat sarvaṃ *kṣīramarditam|
paktvā pūpalikāḥ khādedbahvyaḥ syuryasya yoṣitaḥ||
(iti vṛṣyapūpalikāḥ|)
6.2.3.18 |  ghṛtaṃ śatāvarīgarbhaṃ kṣīre daśaguṇe pacet|
śarkarāpippalīkṣaudrayuktaṃ tadvṛṣyamuttamam||
(iti vṛṣyaṃ śatāvarīghṛtam|)
6.2.3.19 |  karṣaṃ madhukacūrṇasya *ghṛtakṣaudrasamāṃśikam|
prayuṅkte yaḥ *payaścānu nityavegaḥ sa nā bhavet||
(iti vṛṣyamadhukayogaḥ|)
6.2.3.20 |  ghṛtakṣīrāśano nirbhīrnirvyādhirnityago yuvā|
saṅkalpapravaṇo nityaṃ naraḥ strīṣu vṛṣāyate||
6.2.3.21 |  kṛtaikakṛtyāḥ siddhārthā ye cānyo 'nyānuvartinaḥ|
kalāsu kuśalāstulyāḥ sattvena vayasā ca ye||
6.2.3.22 |  kulamāhātmyadākṣiṇyaśīlaśaucasamanvitāḥ|
ye kāmanityā ye hṛṣṭā ye viśokā gatavyathāḥ||
6.2.3.23 |  ye tulyaśīlā ye bhaktā ye priyā ye priyaṃvadāḥ|
tairnaraḥ saha visrabdhaḥ suvayasyairvṛṣāyate||
6.2.3.24 |  abhyaṅgotsādanasnānagandhamālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ|
gṛhaśayyāsanasukhairvāsobhirahataiḥ priyaiḥ||
6.2.3.25 |  vihaṅgānāṃ rutairiṣṭaiḥ strīṇāṃ cābharaṇasvanaiḥ|
saṃvāhanairvarastrīṇāmiṣṭānāṃ ca vṛṣāyate||
6.2.3.26 |  mattadvirephācaritāḥ sapadmāḥ salilāśayāḥ|
jātyutpalasugandhīni śītagarbhagṛhāṇi ca||
6.2.3.27 |  nadyaḥ phenottarīyāśca girayo nīlasānavaḥ|
unnatirnīlameghānāṃ, ramyacandrodayā niśāḥ||
6.2.3.28 |  vāyavaḥ sukhasaṃsparśāḥ kumudākaragandhinaḥ|
ratibhogakṣamā *rātryaḥ saṅkocāguruvallabhāḥ||
6.2.3.29 |  sukhāḥ sahāyāḥ parapuṣṭaghuṣṭāḥ phullā vanāntā viśadānnapānāḥ|
gāndharvaśabdāśca sugandhayogāḥ sattvaṃ viśālaṃ nirupadravaṃ ca||
6.2.3.30 |  siddhārthatā cābhinavaśca kāmaḥ strī cāyudhaṃ sarvamihātmajasya|
vayo navaṃ jātamadaśca kālo harṣasya yoniḥ paramā narāṇām||
6.2.3.31 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
praharṣayonayo yogā vyākhyātā daśa pañca ca|
māṣaparṇabhṛtīye 'smin pāde *śukrabalapradāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne vājīkaraṇādhyāye māṣaparṇabhṛtīyo nāma vājīkaraṇapādastṛtīyaḥ||3 | |


vājīkaraṇādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ|
6.2.4.1 |  athātaḥ pumāñjātabalādikaṃ vājīkaraṇapādaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.2.4.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.2.4.3 |  pumān yathā jātabalo yāvadicchaṃ striyo vrajet|
yathā cāpatyavān sadyo bhavettadupadekṣyate||
6.2.4.4 |  na hi jātabalāḥ sarve narāścāpatyabhāginaḥ|
bṛhaccharīrā balinaḥ santi nārīṣu durbalāḥ||
6.2.4.5 |  santi *cālpāśrayāḥ strīṣu balavanto bahuprajāḥ|
prakṛtyā cābalāḥ santi santi cāmayadurbalāḥ||
6.2.4.6 |  narāścaṭakavat kecid vrajanti bahuśaḥ striyam|
gajavacca prasiñcanti kecinna bahugāminaḥ||
6.2.4.7 |  kālayogabalāḥ kecit kecidabhyasanadhruvāḥ|
kecit *prayotnairvyajyante vṛṣāḥ kecit svabhāvataḥ||
6.2.4.8 |  tasmāt prayogān vakṣyāmo durbalānāṃ balapradān|
sukhopabhogān balināṃ bhūyaśca balavardhanān||
6.2.4.9 |  pūrvaṃ śuddhaśarīrāṇāṃ *nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ|
balāpekṣī prayuñjīta śukrāpatyavivardhanān||
6.2.4.10 |  ghṛtatailarasakṣīraśarkarāmadhusaṃyutāḥ|
bastyaḥ saṃvidhātavyāḥ kṣīramāṃsarasāśinām||
6.2.4.11 |  piṣṭvā varāhamāṃsāni dattvā maricasaindhave|
kolavadgulikāḥ kṛtvā tapte sarpiṣi *vartayet||
6.2.4.12 |  *vartanastambhitāstāśca prakṣepyāḥ kaukkuṭe rase|
ghṛtāḍhye gandhapiśune dadhidāḍimasārike||
6.2.4.13 |  yathā na bhindyādguli(ṭi)kāstathā taṃ sādhayedrasam|
taṃ piban bhakṣayaṃstāśca labhate śukramakṣayam||
6.2.4.14 |  māṃsānāmevamanyeṣāṃ medyānāṃ kārayedbhiṣak|
guṭikāḥ sarasāstāsāṃ prayogaḥ śukravardhanaḥ||
(iti vṛṣyā māṃsaguṭikāḥ|)
6.2.4.15 |  māṣānaṅkuritāñchuddhān vituṣān sājaḍāphalān|
ghṛtāḍhye māhiṣarase dadhidāḍimasārike||
6.2.4.16 |  prakṣipenmātrayā yukto dhānyajīrakanāgaraiḥ|
bhuktaḥ pītaśca sa rasaḥ kurute śukramakṣayam||
(iti vṛṣyo māhiṣarasaḥ|)
6.2.4.17 |  ārdrāṇi matsyamāṃsāni śapharīrvā subharjitāḥ|
tapte sarpiṣi yaḥ khādet sa gacchet strīṣu na kṣayam||
6.2.4.18 |  ghṛtabhṛṣṭān rase cchāge rohitān phalasārike|
anupītarasān snigdhānapatyārthī prayojayet||
(iti vṛṣyavṛtabhṛṣṭamatsyamāṃsāni|)
6.2.4.19 |  *kuṭṭakaṃ matsayamāṃsānāṃ hiṅgusaindhavadhānyakaiḥ|
yuktaṃ godhūmacūrṇena ghṛte pūpalikāḥ pacet||
6.2.4.20 |  māhiṣe ca rase matsyān snigdhāmlalavaṇān pacet|
rase cānugate māṃsaṃ pothayettatre cāvapet||
6.2.4.21 |  maricaṃ jīrakaṃ dhānyamalpaṃ hiṅgu navaṃ ghṛtam|
māṣapūpalikānāṃ tadgarbhārthamupakalpayet||
6.2.4.22 |  etau pūpalikāyogau bṛṃhaṇau balavardhanau|
harṣasaubhāgyadau putryau paraṃ śukrābhivardhanau||
(iti vṛṣyau pūpalikāyogau|)
6.2.4.23 |  māṣātmaguptāgodhūmaśāliṣaṣṭikapaiṣṭikam|
śarkarāyā vidāryāśca cūrṇamikṣurakasya ca||
6.2.4.24 |  saṃyojya masṛṇe kṣīre ghṛte pūpalikāḥ pacet|
payo 'nupānāstāḥ śīghraṃ kurvanti vṛṣatāṃ parām||
(iti vṛṣyā māṣādipūpalikāḥ|)
6.2.4.25 |  śarkarāyāstulaikā syādekā gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ|
prastho vidāryāścūrṇasya pippalyāḥ prastha eva ca||
6.2.4.26 |  ardhāḍhakaṃ tugākṣīryāḥ kṣaudrasyābhinavasya ca|
tatsarvaṃ mūrcchitaṃ tiṣṭhenmārtike ghṛtabhājane||
6.2.4.27 |  mātrāmagnisamāṃ tasya prātaḥ prātaḥ prayojayet|
eṣa vṛṣyaḥ paraṃ yogo balyo bṛṃhaṇa eva ca||
6.2.4.28 |  śatāvaryā vidāryāśca tathā māṣātmaguptayoḥ|
śvadaṃṣṭrāyāśca *niṣkvāthāñjaleṣu ca pṛthak pṛthak||
6.2.4.29 |  sādhayitvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ payasyaṣṭaguṇe punaḥ|
śarkarāmadhuyuktaṃ tadapatyārthī prayojayet||
(ityapatyakaraṃ ghṛtam|)
6.2.4.30 |  ghṛtapātraṃ śataguṇe vidārīsvarase pacet|
siddhaṃ punaḥ śataguṇe gavye payasi sādhayet||
6.2.4.31 |  śarkarāyāstugākṣīryāḥ kṣaudrasyekṣurakasya ca|
pippalyāḥ sājaḍāyāśca bhāgaiḥ pādāṃśikairyutam||
6.2.4.32 |  guli(ṭi)kāḥ kārayedvaidyo yathā sthūlamudumbaram|
tāsāṃ prayogāt puruṣaḥ kuliṅga iva hṛṣyati||
(iti vṛṣyaguṭikāḥ|)
6.2.4.33 |  sitopalāpalaśataṃ tadardhaṃ navasarpiṣaḥ|
kṣaudrapādena saṃyuktaṃ sādhayejjalapādikam||
6.2.4.34 |  sāndraṃ godhūmacūrṇānāṃ pādaṃ stīrṇe śilātale|
śucau ślakṣṇe samutkīrya mardanenopapādayet||
6.2.4.35 |  śuddhā utkārikāḥ kāryāścandramaṇḍalasannibhāḥ|
tāsāṃ prayogādgajavannārīḥ saṃtarpayennaraḥ||
(iti vṛṣyotkārikā|)
6.2.4.36 |  yat kiñcinmadhuraṃ snigdhaṃ jīvanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ guru|
harṣaṇaṃ manasaścaiva sarvaṃ tadvṛṣyamucyate||
6.2.4.37 |  dravyairevaṃvidhaistasmādbhāvitaḥ pramadāṃ vrajet|
ātmavegena codīrṇaḥ strīguṇaiśca praharṣitaḥ||
6.2.4.38 |  gatvā snātvā payaḥ pītvā rasaṃ vā 'nu śayīta nā|
tathā 'syāpyāye bhūyaḥ śukraṃ ca balameva ca||
6.2.4.39 |  yathā mukulapuṣpasya su(sva)gandho nopalabhyate|
labhyate tadvikāśāttu tathā śukraṃ hi dehinām||
6.2.4.40 |  narte vai ṣoḍaśādvarṣāt saptatyāḥ parato na ca|
āyuṣkāmo naraḥ strībhiḥ saṃyogaṃ kartumarhati||
6.2.4.41 |  atibālo hyasaṃpūrṇasarvadhātuḥ striyaṃ vrajan|
upaśuṣyeta sahasā taḍāgamiva kājalam||
6.2.4.42 |  śuṣkaṃ rūkṣaṃ yathā kāṣṭhaṃ jantudagdhaṃ vijarjaram|
spṛṣṭamāśu viśīryeta tathā vṛddhaḥ striyo vrajan||
6.2.4.43 |  jarayā cintayā śukraṃ vyādhibhiḥ karmakarṣaṇāt|
kṣayaṃ gacchatyanaśanāt strīṇāṃ cātiniṣevaṇāt||
6.2.4.44 |  kṣayādbhayādaviśrambhācchokāt strīdoṣadarśanāt|
nārīṇāmarasajñatvādavicāarādasevanāt||
6.2.4.45 |  tṛptasyāpi striyo gantuṃ na śaktirupajāyate|
dehasattvabalāpekṣī harṣaḥ śaktiśca harṣajā||
6.2.4.46 |  rasa ikṣau yathā dadhni sarpistailaṃ tile yathā|
sarvatrānugataṃ dehe śukraṃ saṃsparśane tathā||
6.2.4.47 |  tat strīpuruṣasaṃyoge ceṣṭāsaṃkalpapīḍanāt|
śukraṃ pracyavate sthānājjalamārdrāt paṭādiva||
6.2.4.48 |  harṣāttarṣāt saratvācca paicchilyādgauravādapi|
aṇupravaṇabhāvācca drutatvānmārutasya ca||
6.2.4.49 |  aṣṭābhya ebhyo hetubhyaḥ śukraṃ dehāt prasicyate|
carato viśvarūpasya rūpadravyaṃ yaducyate||
6.2.4.50 |  bahalaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhamavisraṃ guru picchilam|
śuklaṃ bahu ca yacchukraṃ phalavattadasaṃśayam||
6.2.4.51 |  yena nārīṣu sāmarthyaṃ *vājīvallabhate naraḥ|
vrajeccābhyadhikaṃ yena vājīkaraṇameva tat||
6.2.4.52 |  tatra ślokau---
heturyogopadeśasya yogā dvādaśa cottamāḥ|
yat pūrvaṃ maithunāt sevyaṃ sevyaṃ yanmaithunādanu||
6.2.4.53 |  yadā na sevyāḥ pramadāḥ kṛtsnaḥ śukraviniścayaḥ|
niruktaṃ ceha nirdiṣṭaṃ pumāñjātabalādike||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne vājīkaraṇādhyāye pumāñjātabalādiko nāma vājīkaraṇapādaścaturthaḥ||4 | |

samāptaścāyaṃ dvitīyo vājīkaraṇādhyāyaḥ||2 | |

tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.3.1 |  athāto jvaracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.3.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.3.3 |  vijvaraṃ jvarasaṃdehaṃ paryapṛcchat punarvasum|
vivikte śāntamāsīnamagniveśaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ||
6.3.4 |  dehendriyamanastāpī sarvarogāgrajo balī|
jvaraḥ pradhāno rogāṇāmukto bhagavatā purā||
6.3.5 |  tasya prāṇisapatnasya dhruvasya pralayodaye|
prakṛtiṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca prabhāvaṃ kāraṇāni ca||
6.3.6 |  pūrvarūpamadhiṣṭhānaṃ balakālātmalakṣaṇam|
vyāsakto *vidhibhedācca pṛthagbhinnasya cākṛtim||
6.3.7 |  liṅgamāmasya jīrṇasya sauṣadhaṃ ca kriyākramam|
vimuñcataḥ praśāntasya cihnaṃ yacca pṛthak pṛthak||
6.3.8 |  jvarāvasṛṣṭo rakṣyaśca yāvatkālaṃ yato yataḥ|
praśāntaḥ kāraṇairyaiśca punarāvartate jvaraḥ||
6.3.9 |  yāścāpi punarāvṛttaṃ kriyāḥ praśamayanti tam|
jagaddhitārthaṃ tat sarvaṃ bhagavan! vaktumarhasi||
6.3.10 |  tadagniveśasya vaco niśamya gururabravīt|
jvarādhikāre yadvācyaṃ tat saumya! nikhilaṃ śṛṇu||
6.3.11 |  jvaro vikāro rogaśca vyādhirātaṅka eva ca|
*eko 'rtho nāmaparyāyairvividhairabhidhīyate||
6.3.12 |  tasya prakṛtiruddiṣṭā doṣāḥ śārīramānasāḥ|
dehinaṃ na hi nirdoṣaṃ jvaraḥ samupasevate||
6.3.13 |  kṣayastamo jvaraḥ pāpmā *mṛtyuścoktā yamātmakāḥ|
pañcatvapratyayānnṛṛṇāṃ kliśyatāṃ svena karmaṇā||
6.3.14 |  ityasya prakṛtiḥ proktā,pravṛttistu parigrahāt|
nidāne pūrvamuddiṣṭā rudrakopācca dāruṇāt||
6.3.15 |  dvitīye hi yuge śarvamakrodhavratamāsthitam|
divyaṃ sahasraṃ varṣāṇāmasurā abhidudruvuḥ||
6.3.16 |  tapovrighnāśanāḥ *kartuṃ tapovighnaṃ mahātmanaḥ|
paśyan samarthaścopekṣāṃ cakre dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ||
6.3.17 |  punarmāheśvaraṃ bhāgaṃ dhruvaṃ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ|
yajñe na kalpayāmāsa procyamānaḥ surairapi||
6.3.18 |  ṛcaḥ paśupateryāśca śaivya āhatayaśca yāḥ|
yajñasiddhipradāstābhirhīnaṃ caiva sa iṣṭavān||
6.3.19 |  athottīrṇavrato devo buddhvā dakṣavyatikramam|
rudro raudraṃ puraskṛtya bhāvamātmavidātmanaḥ||
6.3.20 |  *sṛṣṭvā lalāṭe cakṣurvai dagdhvā tānasurān prabhuḥ|
bālaṃ krodhāgnisantaptamasṛjat satranāśanam||
6.3.21 |  tato yajñaḥ sa vidhvasto vyathitāśca divaukasaḥ|
dāhavyathāparītāśca bhrāntā bhūtagaṇā diśaḥ||
6.3.22 |  atheśvaraṃ devagaṇaḥ saha saptarṣibhirvibhum|
tamṛgbhirastuvan yāvacchaive bhāve śivaḥ sthitaḥ||
6.3.23 |  śivaṃ śivāya bhūtānāṃ sthitaṃ jñātvā kṛtāñjaliḥ|
bhiyā bhasmapraharaṇastriśirā navalocanaḥ||
6.3.24 |  jvālāmālākulo raudro hrasvajaṅghodaraḥ kramāt|
krodhāgniruktavān devamahaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi te||
6.3.25 |  tamuvāceśvaraḥ krodhaṃ jvaro loke bhaviṣyasi|
janmādau nidhane ca tvamapacārāntareṣu ca||
6.3.26 |  saṃtāpaḥ sārucistṛṣṇā sāṅgamardo hṛdi vyathā|
jvaraprabhāvo, janmādau nidhane ca mahattamaḥ||
6.3.27 |  prakṛtiśca pravṛttiśca prabhāvaśca pradarśitaḥ|
nidāne kāraṇānyaṣṭau *pūrvoktāni vibhāgaśaḥ||
6.3.28 |  ālasyaṃ nayane sāsre jṛmbhaṇaṃ gauravaṃ klamaḥ|
jvalanātapavāyvambubhaktidveṣāvaniścitau||
6.3.29 |  avipākāsyavairasye hāniśca balavarṇayoḥ|
śīlavaikṛtamalpaṃ ca jvaralakṣaṇamagrajam||
6.3.30 |  kevalaṃ samanaskaṃ ca jvarādhiṣṭhānamucyate|
śarīraṃ, balakālastu nidāne saṃpradarśitaḥ||
6.3.31 |  jvarapratyātmikaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃtāpo dehamānasaḥ|
jvareṇāviṣatā bhūtaṃ na hi kiñcinna tapyate||
6.3.32 |  dvividho vidhibhedena jvaraḥ śārīramānasaḥ|
punaśca dvividho dṛṣṭaḥ saumyaścāgneya eva vā||
6.3.33 |  antarvego bahirvego dvividhaḥ punarucyate|
prākṛto vaikṛtaścaiva sādhyaścāsādhya eva ca||
6.3.34 |  punaḥ pañcavidho dṛṣṭo doṣakālabalābalāt|
saṃtataḥ satato 'nyedyustṛtīyakacaturthakau||
6.3.35 |  punarāśrayabhedena dhātūnāṃ saptadhā mataḥ|
bhinnaḥ kāraṇabhedena punaraṣṭavidho jvaraḥ||
6.3.36 |  śārīro jāyate pūrvaṃ dehe, manasi mānasaḥ|
vaicittyamaratirglānirmanasastāpalakṣaṇam||
6.3.37 |  indriyāṇāṃ ca vaikṛtyaṃ *jñeyaṃ saṃtāpalakṣaṇam|
cātapittātmakaḥ sītamuṣṇaṃ vātakaphātmakaḥ||
6.3.38 |  icchatyubhayametattu jvaro vyāmiśralakṣaṇaḥ|
yogavāhaḥ paraṃ vāyuḥ saṃyogādubhayārthakṛt||
6.3.39 |  dāhakṛttejasā yuktaḥ, śītakṛt somasaṃśrayāt|
antardāho 'dhikastṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ||
6.3.40 |  sandhyasthiśūlamasvedo doṣavarcovinigrahaḥ|
antarvegasya liṅgāni jvarasyaitāni lakṣayet||
6.3.41 |  saṃtāpo 'bhyadhiko bāhyastṛṣṇādīnāṃ ca mārdavam|
bahirvegasya liṅgāni sukhasādhyatvameva ca||
6.3.42 |  prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhyastu vasantaśaradudbhavaḥ|
uṣṇamuṣṇena saṃvṛddhaṃ pittaṃ śaradi kupyati||
6.3.43 |  citaḥ śīte kaphaścaivaṃ vasante samudīryate|
varṣāsvamlavipākābhiradbhiroṣadhibhistathā||
6.3.44 |  saṃcitaṃ *pittamudriktaṃ śaradyādityatejasā|
jvaraṃ saṃjanayatyāśu tasya cānubalaḥ kaphaḥ||
6.3.45 |  *prakṛtyaiva visargasya tatra nānaśanādbhayam|
adbhiroṣadhibhiścaiva madhurābhiścitaḥ kaphaḥ||
6.3.46 |  hemante, śūryasaṃtaptaḥ sa vasante prakupyati|
vasante śleṣmaṇā tasmājjvaraḥ samupajāyate||
6.3.47 |  ādānamadhye tasyāpi vātapittaṃ bhavedanu|
ādāvante ca madhye ca buddhvā doṣabalābalam||
6.3.48 |  śaradvasantayorvidvāñjvarasya pratikārayet|
kālaprakṛtimuddiśya nirdiṣṭaḥ prākṛto jvaraḥ||
6.3.49 |  prāyeṇānilayo duḥkhaḥ kāleṣvanyeṣu vaikṛtaḥ|
hetavo vividhāstasya nidāne saṃpradarśitāḥ||
6.3.50 |  balavatsvalpadoṣeṣu jvaraḥ sādhyo 'nupadravaḥ|
hetubhirbahubhirjāto balibhirbahulakṣaṇaḥ||
6.3.51 |  jvaraḥ prāṇāntakṛdyaśca śīghramindriyanāśanaḥ|
saptāhādvā daśāhādvā dvādaśāhāttathaiva ca||
6.3.52 |  sapralāpabhramaśvāsastīkṣṇo hanyājjvaro naram|
jvaraḥ kṣīṇasya śūnasya gambhīro dairgharātrikaḥ||
6.3.53 |  asādhyo balavān yaśca keśasīmantakṛjjvaraḥ|
srotobhirvisṛtā doṣā guravo rasavāhibhiḥ||
6.3.54 |  sarvadehānugāḥ stabdhā jvaraṃ kurvanti santatam|
daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā suduḥsahaḥ||
6.3.55 |  sa śīghraṃ śīghrakāritvāt praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā|
kāladūṣyaprakṛtibhirdoṣastulyo hi santatam||
6.3.56 |  niṣpratyanīkaḥ kurute tasmājjñeyaḥ suduḥsahaḥ|
yathā *dhātūṃstathā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ cānilādayaḥ||
6.3.57 |  yugapaccānupadyante *niyamāt santate jvare|
sa śuddhyā vā 'pyaśuddhyā vā rasādīnāmaśeṣataḥ||
6.3.58 |  saptāhādiṣu kāleṣu praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā|
yadā tu nātiśudhyanti na vā śudhyanti sarvaśaḥ||
6.3.59 |  dvādaśaite samuddiṣṭāḥ santatasyāśrayāstadā|
visargaṃ dvādaśe kṛtvā divase 'vyaktalakṣaṇam||
6.3.60 |  durlabhopaśamaḥ kālaṃ dīrghamapyanuvartate|
iti buddhvā jvaraṃ vaidya upakrāmettu *santatam||
6.3.61 |  kriyākramavidhau yuktaḥ prāyaḥ prāgapatarpaṇaiḥ|
raktadhātvāśrayaḥ prāyo doṣaḥ satatakaṃ jvaram||

6.3.62 |  sapratyanīkaḥ kurute kālavṛddhikṣayātmakam|
ahorātre satatako dvau kālāvanuvartate||
6.3.63 |  kālaprakṛtidūṣyāṇāṃ prāpyaivānyatamādbalam|
anyedyuṣkaṃ doṣo ruddhvā medovahāḥ sirāḥ||
6.3.64 |  sapratyanīko janayatyekakālamaharniśi|
doṣo 'sthimajjagaḥ kuryāttṛtīyakacaturthakau||
6.3.65 |  gatirdvekāntarā+*anyedyurdoṣasyottā 'nyathā paraiḥ|
anyedyuṣkaṃ jvaraṃ kuryādapi saṃśritya śoṇitam||
6.3.66 |  māṃsasrotāṃsyanugato janayettu tṛtīyakam|
saṃśrito medaso mārgaṃ doṣaścāpi *caturthakam||
6.3.67 |  anyedyuṣkaḥ pratidinaṃ dinaṃ hitvā tṛtīyakaḥ|
dinadvayaṃ yo viśramya pratyeti sa caturthakaḥ||
6.3.68 |  adhiśete yathā bhūmiṃ bījaṃ kāle ca rohati|
adhiśete tathā dhātuṃ doṣaḥ kāle ca kupyati||
6.3.69 |  sa vṛddhiṃ balakālaṃ ca prāpya doṣastṛtīyakam|
caturthakaṃ ca kurute pratyanīkabalakṣayāt||
6.3.70 |  kṛtvā vegaṃ gatabalāḥ sve sve sthāne vyavasthitāḥ|
punarvivṛddhāḥ sve kāle jvarayanti naraṃ malāḥ||
6.3.71 |  kaphapittāttrikagrāhī pṛṣṭhādvātakaphātmakaḥ|
vātapittācchirogrāhī trividhaḥ syāttṛtīyakaḥ||
6.3.72 |  caturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ|
jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto 'nilasaṃbhavaḥ||
6.3.73 |  viṣamajvā evānyaścaturthakaviparyayaḥ|
trividho dhāturekaiko dvidhātusthaḥ karoti yam||
6.3.74 |  prāyaśaḥ sannipātena dṛṣṭaḥ pañcavidho jvaraḥ|
sannipāte tu yo bhūyān sa doṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||
6.3.75 |  *ṛtvahorātradoṣāṇāṃ manasaśca balābalāt|
kālamarthavaśāccaiva jvarastaṃ taṃ prapadyate||
6.3.76 |  gurutvaṃ dainyamudvegaḥ sadanaṃ chardyarocakau|
rasasthite bahistāpaḥ sāṅgamardo vijṛmbhaṃam||
6.3.77 |  raktoṣṇāḥ piḍakāstṛṣṇā saraktaṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ muhuḥ|
dāharāgabhramamadapralāpā raktasaṃsthite||
6.3.78 |  antardāhaḥ satṛṇmohaḥ saglāniḥ sṛṣṭaviṭkatā|
daurgandhyaṃ gātravikṣepo jvare māṃsasthite bhavet||
6.3.79 |  svedastīvrā pipāsā ca pralāpo vamyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ|
svagandhasyāsahatvaṃ ca medaḥsthe glānyarocakau||
6.3.80 |  virekavamane cobhe sāsthibhedaṃ prakūjanam|
vikṣepaṇaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ śvāsaścāsthigate jvare||
6.3.81 |  hikkā śvāsastathā kāsastamasaścātidarśanam|
marmacchedo bahiḥ śaityaṃ dāho 'ntaścaiva majjage||
6.3.82 |  śukrasthānagataḥ śukramokṣaṃ kṛtvā vināśya ca|
prāṇaṃ vāyvagnisomaiśca sārdhaṃ gacchatyasau vibhuḥ||
6.3.83 |  rasaraktāśritaḥ sādhyo medomāṃsagataśca yaḥ|
asthimajjagāḥ kṛcchraḥ śukrastho naiva siddhyati||
6.3.84 |  hetubhirlakṣaṇaiścoktaḥ pūrvasmaṣṭavigho jvaraḥ|
samāsenopadiṣṭasya vyāsataḥ śṛṇu lakṣaṇam||
6.3.85 |  śiroruk parvaṇāṃ bhedo dāho romṇāṃ praharṣaṇam|
kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣo vamathustṛṣṇā mūrcchā bhramo 'ruciḥ||
6.3.86 |  svapnanāśo 'tivāgjṛmbhā vātapittajvarākṛtiḥ|
śītako gauravaṃ tandrā staimityaṃ parvaṇāṃ ca ruk||
6.3.87 |  śirograhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ kāsaḥ svedāpravartanam|
santāpo madhyavegaśca vātaśleṣmajvarākṛtiḥ||
6.3.88 |  muhurdāho muhuḥ śītaṃ *svedastambho muhurmuhuḥ|
mohaḥ kāso 'rucistṛṣṇā śleṣmapittapravartanam||
6.3.89 |  liptatiktāsyatā tandrā śleṣmapittajvarākṛtiḥ|
ityete dvandvajāḥ proktāḥ sannipātaja ucyate||
6.3.90 |  sannipātajvarasyordhvaṃ trayodaśavidhasya hi|
prāksūtritasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ vai pṛthak pṛthak||
6.3.91 |  bhramaḥ pipāsā dāhaśca gauravaṃ śiraso 'tiruk|
vātapittolbaṇe vidyālliṅgaṃ mandakaphe jvare||
6.3.92 |  śaityaṃ kāso 'rucistandrāpipāsādāharugvyathāḥ|
vātaśleṣmolbaṇe vyādhau liṅgaṃ pittāvare viduḥ||
6.3.93 |  chardiḥ śaityaṃ muhurdāhastṛṣṇā moho 'sthivedanā|
mandavāte vyavasyanti liṅgaṃ pittakapholbaṇe||
6.3.94 |  sandhyasthiśirasaḥ śūlaṃ pralāpo gauravaṃ bhramaḥ|
vātolbaṇe syād dvyanuge tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhāsyaśuṣkatā||
6.3.95 |  raktaviṇmūtratā dāhaḥ svedastṛḍ balasaṃkṣayaḥ|
mūrcchā ceti tridoṣe syālliṅgaṃ pitte garīyasi||
6.3.96 |  ālasyārucihṛllāsadāhavamyaratibhramaiḥ|
kapholbaṇaṃ sannipātaṃ tandrākāsena cādiśet||
6.3.97 |  pratiśyā chardirālasyaṃ tandrā 'rucyagnimārdavam|
hīnavāte pittamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike matam||
6.3.98 |  hāridramūtranetratvaṃ dāhastṛṣṇā bhramo 'ruciḥ|
hīnavāte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ pittādhike matam||
6.3.99 |  śirorugvepathuḥ śvāsaḥ pralāpaśchardyarocakau|
hīnapitte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ syānmārutādhike||
6.3.100 |  śītako gauravaṃ tandrā pralāpo 'sthiśiro 'tiruk|
hīnapitte vātamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike viduḥ||
6.3.101 |  śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ pratiśyāyo mukhaśoṣo 'tipārśvaruk|
kaphahīne pittamadhye liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam||
6.3.102 |  *varcobhedo 'gnidaurbalyaṃ tṛṣṇā dāho 'cirbhramaḥ|
kaphahīne vātamadhye liṅgaṃ pittādhike viduḥ||
6.3.103 |  sannipātajvarasyordhvamato vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|
kṣaṇe dāhaḥ kṣaṇe śītamasthisandhiśirorujā||
6.3.104 |  sāsrāve kaluṣe rakte nirbhugne cāpi *darśane|
sasvanau sarujau karṇau kaṇṭhaḥ śūkairivāvṛtaḥ||
6.3.105 |  tandrā mohaḥ pralāpaśca kāsaḥ śvāso 'rucirbhramaḥ|
paridagdhā kharasparśā jihvā srastāṅgatā param||
6.3.106 |  ṣṭhīvanaṃ raktapittasya kaphenonmiśritasya ca|
śiraso loṭhanaṃ tṛṣṇā nidrānāśo hṛdi vyathā||
6.3.107 |  svedamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ cirāddarśanamalpaśaḥ|
kṛśatvaṃ nātigātrāṇāṃ pratataṃ kaṇṭhakūjanam||
6.3.108 |  koṭhānāṃ śyāvaraktānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanam|
mūkatvaṃ srotasāṃ pāko gurutvamudarasya ca||
6.3.109 |  cirāt pākaśca doṣāṇāṃ sannipātajvarākṛtiḥ|
doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe 'gnau sarvasaṃpūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ||
6.3.110 |  sannipātajvaro 'sādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyastvato 'nyathā|
nidāne trividhā proktā yā pṛthagjjvarākṛtiḥ||
6.3.111 |  saṃsargasannipātānāṃ *tayā coktaṃ svalakṣaṇam|
āganturaṣṭamo yastu sa nirdiṣṭaścaturvidhaḥ||
6.3.112 |  abhighātābhiṣaṅgābhyāmabhicārābhiśāpataḥ|
śastraloṣṭakaśākāṣṭhamuṣṭyaratnitaladvijaiḥ||
6.3.113 |  tadvidhaiśca hate gātre jvaraḥ syādabhighātajaḥ|
tatrabhighātaje bāyuḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan||
6.3.114 |  savyathāśophavaivarṇyaṃ karoti sarujaṃ jvaram|
kāmaśokabhayakrodhairabhiṣaktasya yo jvaraḥ||
6.3.115 |  so 'bhiṣaṅgājvaro jñeyo yaśca bhūtābhiṣaṅgajaḥ|
kāmaśokabhayādvāyuḥ, krodhāt pittaṃ, trayo malāḥ||
6.3.116 |  bhūtābhiṣaṅgāt kupyanti bhūtasāmānyalakṣaṇāḥ|
bhūtādhikāre vyākhyātaṃ tadaṣṭavidhalakṣaṇam||
6.3.117 |  viṣavṛkṣānilasparśāttathā 'nyairviṣasaṃbhavaiḥ|
abhiṣaktasya cāpyāhurjvarameke 'bhiṣaṅgajam||
6.3.118 |  cikitsayā viṣaghnyaiva sa śamaṃ labhate naraḥ|
abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ siddhānāṃ yaḥ pravartate||
6.3.119 |  sannipātajvaro ghoraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ suduḥsahaḥ|
sannipātajvarasyoktaṃ liṅgaṃ yattasya tat smṛtam||
6.3.120 |  cittendriyaśarīrāṇāmartayo 'nyāśca naikaśaḥ|
prayogaṃ tvabhicārasya dṛṣṭvā śāpasya caiva hi||
6.3.121 |  svayaṃ śrutvā 'numānena *lakṣyate praśamena vā|
vaividhyādabhicārasya śāpasya ca tadātmake||
6.3.122 |  yathākarmaprayogeṇa lakṣaṇaṃ syāt pṛthagvidham|
dhyānaniḥśvāsabahulaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmajvare smṛtam||
6.3.123 |  śokaje bāṣpabahulaṃ trāsaprāyaṃ bhayajvare|
krodhaje bahusaṃrambhaṃ bhūtāveśe tvamānuṣam||
6.3.124 |  mūrcchāmohamadaglānibhūyiṣṭhaṃ viṣasaṃbhave|
keṣāñcideṣāṃ liṅgānāṃ saṃtāpo jāyate puraḥ||
6.3.125 |  paścāttulyaṃ tu keṣāñcideṣu kāmajvarādiṣu|
kāmādijānāmuddiṣṭaṃ jvarāṇāṃ yadviśeṣaṇam||
6.3.126 |  kāmādijānāṃ rogāṇāmanyeṣāmapi tat smṛtam|
manasyabhihate pūrvaṃ kāmādyairna tathā balam||
6.3.127 |  jvaraḥ prāpjñoti vātādyairdeho yāvanna dūṣyati|
dehe cābhiha(dru)te pūrvaṃ vātādyairna tathā balam||
6.3.128 |  jvaraḥ prāpnoti kāmādyairmano yāvanna dūṣyati|
te pūrvaṃ kevalāḥ paścānnijairvyāmiśralakṣaṇāḥ||
6.3.129 |  hetvauṣadhaviśiṣṭāśca bhavantyāgantavo jvarāḥ|
saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sannipatitāḥ pṛthagvā kupitā malāḥ||
6.3.130 |  rasākhyaṃ dhātumanvetya *paktiṃ sthānānnirasya ca|
svena tenoṣmaṇā caiva kṛtvā dehoṣmaṇo balam||
6.3.131 |  srotāṃsi ruddhvā saṃprāptāḥ kevalaṃ dehamulbaṇāḥ|
saṃtāpamadhikaṃ dehe janayanti narastadā||
6.3.132 |  bhavatyatyuṣṇasarvāṅgo jvaritastena cocyate|
srotasāṃ saṃniruddhatvāt svedaṃ nā nādhigacchati||
6.3.133 |  svasthānāt pracyute cāgnau prāyaśastaruṇe jvare|
aruciścāvipākaśca gurutvamudarasya ca||
6.3.134 |  hṛdayasyāviśuddhiśca tandrā cālasyameva ca|
jvaro 'visargī balavān doṣāṇāmapravartanam||
6.3.135 |  lālāpraseko hṛllāsaḥ kṣunnāśo *virasaṃ mukham|
stabdhasuptagurutvaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ bahumūtratā||
6.3.136 |  na viḍ jīrṇā na ca glānirjvarasyāmasya lakṣaṇam|
jvaravego 'dhikastṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ||
6.3.137 |  malapravṛttirutkleśaḥ pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam|
kṣut kṣāmatā laghutṛvaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ jvaramārdavam||
6.3.138 |  doṣapravṛttiraṣṭāho nirāmajvaralakṣaṇam|
navajvare divāsvapnasnānābhyaṅgānnamaithunam||
6.3.139 |  krodhapravātavyāyāmān kaṣāyāṃśca vivarjayet|
jvare laṅghanamevādāvupadiṣṭamṛte jvarāt||
1.140 |  *kṣayāvilabhayakrodhakāmaśokaśramodbhavāt|
laṅghanena kṣayaṃ nīte doṣe saṃdhukṣite 'nale||
6.3.141 |  vijvaratvaṃ laghutvaṃ ca *kṣuccaivāsyopajāyate|
prāṇāvirodhinā cainaṃ laṅghanenopapādayet||
6.3.142 |  balādhiṣṭhānamārogyaṃ yadartho 'yaṃ kriyākramaḥ|
laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ kālo yavāgvastiktako rasaḥ||
6.3.143 |  pācanānyavipakvānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ taruṇe jvare|
tṛṣyate salilaṃ coṣṇaṃ *dadyādvātakaphajvare||
6.3.144 |  madyotthe paittike cātha śītalaṃ tiktakaiḥ śṛtam|
dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ caiva jvaraghnamubhayaṃ hi tat||
6.3.145 |  srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ balyaṃ rucisvedakaraṃ śivam|
mustaparpaṭakośīracandanodīcyanāgaraiḥ||
6.3.146 |  śṛtaśītaṃ jalaṃ dadyāt pipāsājvaraśāntaye|
kaphapradhānānutkliṣṭān doṣānāmāśayasthitān||
6.3.147 |  buddhvā jvarakarān kāle vamyānāṃ vamanairharet|
anupasthitadoṣāṇāṃ vamanaṃ taruṇe jvare||
6.3.148 |  hṛdrogaṃ śvāsamānāhaṃ *mohaṃ ca janayedbhṛśam|
sarvadehānugāḥ sāmā dhātusthā *asunirharāḥ||
6.3.149 |  doṣāḥ phalānāmāmānāṃ svarasā iva sātyayāḥ|
vamitaṃ laṅghitaṃ kāle yavāgūbhirupācaret||
6.3.150 |  yathāsvauṣadhasiddhābhirmaṇḍapūrvābhirāditaḥ|
yāvajjvaramṛdūbhāvāt ṣaḍahaṃ vā vicakṣaṇaḥ||
6.3.151 |  tasyāgnirdīpyate tābhiḥ samidbhiriva pāvakaḥ|
tāśca bheṣajasaṃyogāllaghutvāccāgnidīpanāḥ||
6.3.152 |  vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ *doṣāṇāṃ cānulomanāḥ|
svedanāya dravoṣṇatvāddravatvāttṛṭpraśāntaye||
6.3.153 |  āhārabhāvāt prāṇāya saratvāllāghavāya ca|
jvaraghnyo *jvarasātmyatvāttasmāt peyābhirāditaḥ||
6.3.154 |  *jvarānupacareddhīmānṛte madyasamutthitāt|
madātyaye madyanitye grīṣme pittakaphādhike||
6.3.155 |  ūrdhvage raktapitte ca yavāgūrna hitā jvare|
tatra tarpaṇamevāgre *prayojyaṃ lājasaktubhiḥ||
6.3.156 |  jvarāpahaiḥ phalarasairyuktaṃ samadhuśarkaram|
tataḥ sātmyabalāpekṣī bhojayejjīrṇatarpaṇam||
6.3.157 |  tanunā mudgayūṣeṇa jāṅgalānāṃ rasena vā|
annakāleṣu cāpyasmai vidheyaṃ dantadhāvanam||
6.3.158 |  yo 'sya vaktrarasastasmādviparītaṃ priyaṃ ca yat|
tadasya mukhavaiśadyaṃ prakāṅkṣāṃ cānnapānayoḥ||
6.3.159 |  dhatte rasaviśeṣāṇāmabhijñatvaṃ karoti yat|
viśodhya drumaśākhāgrairāsyaṃ prakṣālya cāsakṛt||
6.3.160 |  mastvikṣurasamadyādyairyathāhāramavāpnuyāt|
pācanaṃ śamanīyaṃ vā kaṣāyaṃ pāyayedbhiṣak||
6.3.161 |  jvaritaṃ ṣaḍahe 'tīte laghvannapratibhojitam|
stabhyante *na vipacyante kurvati viṣamajvaram||
6.3.162 |  doṣā baddhāḥ kaṣāyeṇa stambhitvāttaruṇe jvare|
na tu kalpanamuddiśya kaṣāyaḥ pratiṣidhyate||
6.3.163 |  yaḥ *kaṣāyakaṣāyaḥ syāt sa varjyastaruṇajvare|
yūṣairamlairanamlairvā jāṅgalairvā rasairhitaiḥ||
6.3.164 |  daśāhaṃ yāvadaśnīyāllaghvannaṃ jvaraśāntaye|
ata ūrdhvaṃ kaphe mande vātapittottare jvare||
6.3.165 |  paripakveṣu doṣeṣu sarpiṣpānaṃ yathā 'mṛtam|
nirdaśāhamapi jñātvā kaphottaramalaṅghitam||
6.3.166 |  na sarpiḥ pāyayedvaidyaḥ *kaṣāyaistamupācaret|
yāvallaghutvādaśanaṃ dadyānmāṃsarasena ca||
6.3.167 |  balaṃ hyalaṃ nigrahāya doṣāṇāṃ, balakṛcca *tat|
dāhatṛṣṇāparītasya vātapittottaraṃ jvaram||
6.3.168 |  baddhapracyutadoṣaṃ vā nirāmaṃ payasā jeyet|
kriyābhirābhiḥ praśamaṃ na prayāti yadā jvaraḥ||
6.3.169 |  *akṣīṇabalamāṃsāgneḥ śamayettaṃ virecanaiḥ|
jvarakṣīṇasya na hitaṃ vamanaṃ na virecanam||
6.3.170 |  kāmaṃ tu payasā tasya virūhairvā harenmalān|
nirūho balamāgniṃ ca vijvaratvaṃ mudaṃ rucim||
6.3.171 |  paripakveṣu doṣeṣu prayuktaḥ śīghramāvahet|
pittaṃ vā kaphapittaṃ vā pittāśayagataṃ haret||
6.3.172 |  sraṃsanaṃ, trīnmalān bastirharet pakvāśayasthitān|
jvare purāṇe saṃkṣīṇe kaphapitte dṛḍhāgnaye||
6.3.173 |  rukṣabaddhapurīṣāya pradadyādanuvāsanam|
gaurave śirasaḥ śūle vibaddheṣvindriyeṣu ca||
6.3.174 |  jīrṇajvare rucikaraṃ kuryānmūrdhavirecanam|
abhyaṅgāṃśca pradehāṃśca pariṣekāvagāhane||
6.3.175 |  vibhajya *śītoṣṇakṛtaṃ kuryājjīrṇe jvare bhiṣak|
tairāśu praśamaṃ yāti bahirmārgagato jvaraḥ||
6.3.176 |  labhante sukhamaṅgāni balaṃ varṇaśca vardhate|
dhūpanāñjanayogaiśca yānti yīrṇajvarāḥ śamam||
6.3.177 |  tvaṅmātraśeṣā yeṣāṃ ca bhavatyāganturanvayaḥ|
iti kriyākramaḥ siddho jvaraghnaḥ saṃprakāśitaḥ||
6.3.178 |  yeṣāṃ tveṣa kramastāni dravyāṇyūrdhvamataḥ śrṇu|
rakaśālyādayaḥ śastāḥ purāṇāḥ ṣaṣṭikaiḥ saha||
6.3.179 |  yavāgvodanalājārthe jvaritānāṃ jvarāpahāḥ|
lājapeyāṃ sukhajarāṃ pippalīnāgaraiḥ śrtām||
6.3.180 |  pibejjvarī jvaraharāṃ kṣudvānalpāgnirāditaḥ|
amlābhilāṣī tāmeva dāḍimāmlāṃ sanāgarām||
6.3.181 |  sṛṣṭaviṭ paittiko vā 'tha śītāṃ madhuyutāṃ pibet|
peyāṃ vā raktaśālīnāṃ pārśvabastiśiroruji||
6.3.182 |  śvadaṃṣṭrākaṇṭakāribhyāṃ siddhāṃ jvaraharāṃ pibet|
jvarātisārī peyāṃ vā pibet sāmlāṃ śṛtāṃ naraḥ||
6.3.183 |  pṛśniparṇībalābilvanāgarotpaladhānyakaiḥ|
śṛtāṃ vidārīgandhādyairpīpanīṃ svedanīṃ naraḥ||
6.3.184 |  kāsī śvāsī ca hikkī ca yavāgūṃ jvaritaḥ pibet|
vibaddhavarcāḥ sayavāṃ pippalyāmalakaiḥ śṛtām||
6.3.185 |  sarpiṣmatīṃ pibet peyāṃ jvarī doṣānulomanīm|
koṣṭhe vibaddhe saruji pibet peyāṃ śṛtāṃ jvarī||
6.3.186 |  mṛdvīkāpippalīmūlacavyāmalakanāgaraiḥ|
pibet sabilvāṃ peyāṃ vā jvare saparikartike||
6.3.187 |  balāvṛkṣāmlakolāmlakalaśīdhāvanīśṛtām|
asvedanidrastṛṣṇārtaḥ pibet peyāṃ saśarkarām||
6.3.188 |  nāgarāmalakaiḥ siddhāṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭāṃ jvarāpahām|
mudgānmasūrāṃścaṇakān kulatthān samakuṣṭakān||
("agniveśasaṃhitā" in cakrapānidatta's commentary)
6.3.189 |  yūṣārthe *yūṣasātmyānāṃ jvaritānāṃ pradāpayet|
paṭolapatraṃ saphalaṃ kulakaṃ pāpacelikam||
6.3.190 |  karkoṭakaṃ kaṭhillaṃ ca vidyācchākaṃ jvare hitam|
lāvān kapiñjalāneṇāṃśvakorānupacakrakān||
6.3.191 |  kuraṅgān kālapucchāṃśca hariṇān pṛṣatāñchaśān|
pradadyānmāṃsasātmyāya jvaritāya jvarāpahān||
6.3.192 |  īṣadamlānanamalān vā sarān kāle vicakṣaṇaḥ|
kukkuṭāṃśca mayūrāṃśca tittirikrauñcavartakān||
6.3.193 |  gurūṣṇatvānna śaṃsanti jvare keciccikitsakāḥ|
laṅghanenānilabalaṃ jvare yadyadhikaṃ bhavet||
6.3.194 |  *bhiṣaṅmātrāvikalpajño dadyāttānapi kālavit|
dharmāmbu cānupānārthaṃ tṛṣitāya pradāpayet||
6.3.195 |  madyaṃ vā madyasātmyāya yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam|
gurūṣṇasnigdhamadhurān kaṣāyāṃśca navajvare||
6.3.196 |  āhārān doṣapaktyarthaṃ prāyaśaḥ parivarjayet|
annapānakramaḥ siddho jvaraghnaḥ saṃprakāśitaḥ||
6.3.197 |  ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyante kaṣāyā jvaranāśanāḥ|
pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā mustaparpaṭakaṃ pibet||
6.3.198 |  sanāgaraṃ parpaṭakaṃ pibedvā sadurālabham|
kirātatiktakaṃ mustaṃ guḍūcīṃ viśvabheṣajam||
6.3.199 |  pāṭhāmuśīraṃ sodīcyaṃ pibedvā jvaraśāntaye|
jvaraghnā dīpanāścaite kaṣāyā doṣapācanāḥ||
6.3.200 |  tṛṣṇārucipraśamanā mukhavairasyanāśanāḥ|
kaliṅgakāḥ paṭolasya patraṃ kaṭukarohiṇī||
6.3.201 |  paṭolaḥ sārivā mustaṃ pāṭhā kaṭukarohiṇī|
nimbaḥ paṭolastriphalā mṛdvīkā mustavatsakau||
6.3.202 |  kirātatiktamamṛtā candanaṃ viśvabheṣajam|
guḍūcyāmalakaṃ mustamardhaślokasamāpanāḥ||
6.3.203 |  kaṣāyāḥ śamayantyāśu pañca pañcavidhāñjvarān|
saṃtataṃ satatānyedyustṛtīyakacaturthakān||
6.3.204 |  vatsakāragvadhau pāṭhāṃ ṣaḍgranthāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm|
mūrvāṃ sātiviṣāṃ nimbaṃ paṭolaṃ dhanvayāsakam||
6.3.205 |  vacāṃ mustamuśīraṃ ca madhukaṃ triphalāṃ balām|
pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā pibejjvaraharaṃ naraḥ||
6.3.206 |  madhūkamustamṛdvīkākāśmaryāṇi parūṣakam|
trāyamāṇāmuśīraṃ ca triphalaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.3.207 |  pītvā niśisthitaṃ janturjvarācchīghraṃ vimucyate|
jātyāmalakamustāni tadvaddhanvayavāsakam||
6.3.208 |  vibaddhadoṣo jvaritaḥ kaṣāyaṃ saguḍaṃ pibet|
triphalāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca mṛdvīkāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.3.209 |  pittaśleṣmaharastveṣa kaṣāyo hyānulomikaḥ|
trivṛtāśarkarāyuktaḥ pittaśleṣmajvarāpahaḥ||
6.3.210 |  bṛhatyau vatsakaṃ mustaṃ devadāru mahauṣadham|
kolavallī ca yogo 'yaṃ saṃnipātajvarāpahaḥ||
6.3.211 |  śaṭī puṣkaramūlaṃ ca vyāghrī śṛṅgī durālabhā|
guḍūcī nāgaraṃ pāṭhā kirātaṃ kaṭurohiṇī||
6.3.212 |  eṣa śaṭyādiko vargaḥ sannipātajvarāpahaḥ|
kāsahṛdgrahapārśvārtiśvāsatandrāsu śasyate||
6.3.213 |  bṛhatyau pauṣkaraṃ bhārgī śaṭī śṛṅgī durālabhā|
vatsakasya ca bījāni paṭolaṃ kaṭurohiṇī||
6.3.214 |  bṛhatyādirgaṇaḥ proktaḥ sannipātajvarāpahaḥ|
kāsādiṣu ca sarveṣu dadyāt sopadraveṣu ca||
6.3.215 |  kaṣāyāśca yavāgvaśca pipāsājvaranāśanāḥ|
nirdiṣṭā bheṣajādhyāye bhiṣaktānapi yojayet||
6.3.216 |  jvarāḥ kaṣāyairvamanairlaṅghanairlaghubhojanaiḥ|
rūkṣasya ye na śāmyanti sarpisteṣāṃ bhiṣagjitam||
6.3.217 |  rūkṣaṃ tejo jvarakaraṃ tejasā rūkṣitasya ca|
yaḥ syādanubalo dhātuḥ *snehavadhyaḥ sa cānilaḥ||
6.3.218 |  kaṣāyāḥ sarva evaite sarpiṣā saha yojitāḥ|
prayojyā jvaraśāntyarthamagnisaṃdhukṣaṇāḥ śivāḥ||
6.3.219 |  pippalyaścandanaṃ mustamuśīraṃ kaṭurohiṇī|
kaliṅgakāstāmalakī sārivā 'tiviṣā sthirā||
6.3.220 |  drākṣāmalakabilvāni trāyamāṇā nidigdhikā|
siddhametairghṛtaṃ sadyo jīrṇajvaramapohati||
6.3.221 |  kṣayaṃ kāsaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ halīmakam|
aṃsābhitāpamagniṃ ca viṣamaṃ saṃniyacchati||
6.3.222 |  vasāṃ guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ yavāsakam|
paktvā tena kaṣāyeṇa payasā dviguṇena ca||
6.3.223 |  pippalīmustamṛdvīkācandanotpalanāgaraiḥ|
kalkīkṛtaiśca vipacedghṛtaṃ jīrṇajvarāpaham||
6.3.224 |  balāṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ vṛhatīṃ kalasīṃ dhāvanīṃ sthirām|
nimbaṃ parpaṭakaṃ mustaṃ trāyamāṇāṃ durālabhām||
6.3.225 |  kṛtvā kaṣāyaṃ peṣyārthe dadyāttāmalakīṃ śaṭīm|
drākṣāṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ ca medāmāmalakāni ca||
6.3.226 |  ghṛtaṃ payaśca tat siddhaṃ sarpirjvaraharaṃ param|
*kṣayakāsaśiraḥśūlapārśvaśūlāṃsatāpanut||
6.3.227 |  jvaribhyo bahudoṣebhya ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca buddhimān|
dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ kāle kalpe yadupadekṣyate||
6.3.228 |  madanaṃ pippalībhirvā kaliṅgairmadhukena vā|
yuktamuṣṇāmbunā peyaṃ vamanaṃ jvaraśāntaye||
6.3.229 |  kṣaudrāmbunā rasenekṣorathavā lavaṇāmbunā|
jvare pracchardanaṃ śastaṃ madyairvā tarpaṇena vā||
6.3.230 |  mṛdvīkāmalakānāṃ vā rasaṃ praskandanaṃ pibet|
rasamāmalakānāṃ vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ jvarāpaham||
6.3.231 |  lihyādvā traivṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ saṃyuktaṃ madhusarpiṣā|
pibedvā kṣaudramāvāpya saghṛtaṃ triphalārasam||
6.3.232 |  āragvadhaṃ vā payasā mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā|
trivṛtāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ vā payasā jvaritaḥ pibet||
6.3.233 |  jvarādvimucyate pītvā mṛdvīkābhiḥ sahābhayām|
payo 'nupānamuṣṇaṃ vā pītvā drākṣārasaṃ naraḥ||
6.3.234 |  kāsācchvāsācchiraḥśūlātpārśvaśūlaccirajvarāt|
mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ payaḥ||
6.3.235 |  eraṇḍamūlotkvathitaṃ jvarāt saparikartikāt|
payo vimucyate pītvā tadvadbilvaśalāṭubhiḥ||
6.3.236 |  trikaṇṭakabalāvyāghrīguḍanāgarasādhitam|
varcomūtravibandhaghnaṃ śophajvaraharaṃ payaḥ||
6.3.237 |  sanāgaraṃ samṛdvīkaṃ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram|
śṛtaṃ payaḥ sakharjūraṃ pipāsājvaranāśanam||
6.3.238 |  caturguṇenāmbhasā vā śṛtaṃ jvaraharaṃ payaḥ|
dhāroṣṇaṃ vā payaḥ sadyo vātapittajvaraṃ jayet||
6.3.239 |  jīrṇajvarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ payaḥ praśamanaṃ param|
peyaṃ taduṣṇaṃ śītaṃ vā yathāsvaṃ bheṣajaiḥ śṛtam||
6.3.240 |  prayojayejjvaraharānnirūhān sānuvāsanān|
pakvāśayagate doṣe vakṣyante ye ca siddhiṣu||
6.3.241 |  paṭolāriṣṭapatrāṇi sośīraścaturaṅgulaḥ|
hrīberaṃ rohiṇī tiktā śvadaṃṣṭrā madanāni ca||
6.3.242 |  sthirā balā ca tat sarvaṃ payasyardodake śṛtam|
kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ niryūhaṃ saṃyuktaṃ madhusarpiṣā||
6.3.243 |  kalkairmadanamustānāṃ pippalyā madhukasya ca|
vatsakasya ca saṃyuktaṃ bastiṃ dadyājjvarāpaham||
6.3.244 |  śuddhe mārge hṛte doṣe viprasanneṣu dhātuṣu|
gatāṅgaśūlo laghvaṅgaḥ sadyo bhavati vijvaraḥ||
6.3.245 |  āragvadhamuśīraṃ ca madanasya phalaṃ tathā|
catasraḥ *parṇinīścaiva niryūhamupakalpayet||
6.3.246 |  priyaṅgurmadanaṃ mustaṃ śatāhvā madhuyaṣṭikā|
kalkaḥ sarpirguḍaḥ kṣaudraṃ jvaraghno bastiruttamaḥ||
6.3.247 |  guḍūcīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca candanaṃ madhukaṃ vṛṣam|
sthirāṃ balāṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ madanaṃ ceti sādhayet||
6.3.248 |  rasaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsasya rasena sahitaṃ bhiṣak|
pippalīphalamustānāṃ kalkena madhukasya ca||
6.3.249 |  īṣatsalavaṇaṃ yuktyā nirūhaṃ madhusarpiṣā|
jvarapraśamanaṃ dadyādbalasvedarucipradam||
6.3.250 |  jīvantīṃ madhukaṃ medāṃ pippalīṃ madanaṃ vacām|
ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ balāṃ *viśvaṃ śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm||
6.3.251 |  piṣṭvā kṣīraṃ jalaṃ sarpistailaṃ ca vipacedbhiṣak|
ānuvāsanikaṃ snehametaṃ vidyājjvarāpaham||
6.3.252 |  paṭolapicumardābhyāṃ guḍūcyā madhukena ca|
madanaiśca śṛtaḥ sneho jvaraghnamanuvāsanam||
6.3.253 |  candanāgurukāśmaryapaṭolamadhukotpalaiḥ|
siddhaḥ sneho jvaraharaḥ snehabastiḥ praśasyate||
6.3.254 |  yaduktaṃ bheṣajādhyāye vimāne rogabheṣaje|
śirovirecanaṃ kuryādyuktijñastajjvarāpaham||
6.3.255 |  yacca nāvanikaṃ tailaṃ yāśca prāgdhūmavartayaḥ|
mātrāśitīye nirdiṣṭāḥ prayojyāstā jvareṣvapi||
6.3.256 |  abhyaṅgāṃśca pradehāṃśca pariṣekāṃśca kārayet|
yathābhilāṣaṃ śītoṣṇaṃ vibhajya dvividhaṃ jvaram||
6.3.257 |  sahasradhautaṃ sarpirvā tailaṃ vā candanādikam|
dāhajvarapraśamanaṃ dadyādbhyañjanaṃ bhiṣak||
6.3.258 |  atha candanādyaṃ tailamupadekṣyāmaḥ---candanabhadraśrīkālānusāryakālīyakapadmāpadmakośīrasārivāmadhukaprapauṇḍarīkanāgapuṣpodīcyavanyapadmotpalanalinakumudasaugandhikapuṇḍarīkaśatapatrabisamṛṇālaśālūkaśauvālakaśerukānantākuśakāśekṣudarbhaśaranalaśālimūlajambuvetasavānīragundrākakubhāsanāśvakarṇasyandanavātapothaśālatāladhavatiniśakhadirakadarakadambakāśmaryaphalasarjaplakṣavaṭakapītanodumbarāśvatthanyagrodhadhātakīdūrvetkaṭaśṛṅgāṭakamañjiṣṭhājyotiṣmatīpuṣkarabījakrauñcādanabadarīkovidārakadalīsaṃvartakāriṣṭaśataparvāśīta-*kumbhikāśatāvarīśrīparṇīśrāvaṇīmahāśrāvaṇīrohiṇīśītapākyodanapākīkālābalāpayasyāvidārījīvakarṣabhakamedāmahāmedāmadhurasarṣyaproktātṛṇaśūnyamocarasāṭarūṣakabakulakuṭajapaṭolanimbaśālmalīnārikelakharjūramṛdvīkāpriyālapriyaṅgudhanvanātmaguptāmadhūkānāmanyeṣāṃ ca śītavīryāṇāṃ yathālābhamauṣadhānāṃ kaṣāyaṃ kārayet|
tena kaṣāyeṇa dviguṇitapayasā teṣāmeva ca kalkena kaṣāyārdhamātraṃ mṛdvagninā sādhayettailam|
etatailamabhyaṅgāt sadyo dāhajvaramapanayati|
etaireva cauṣadhairaślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ suśītaiḥ pradehaṃ kārayet|
etaireva ca śṛtaśītaṃ salilamavagāhapariṣekārthaṃ prayuñjīta||
iti candanādyaṃ tailam||
6.3.259 |  madhvāranālakṣīradadhighṛtasalilasekāvagāhāśca sadyo dāhajvaramapanayanti śītasparśatvāt||
6.3.260 |  bhavanti cātra---
pauṣkareṣu suśīteṣu padmotpaladaleṣu ca|
kadalīnāṃ ca patreṣu kṣaumeṣu vimaleṣu ca||
6.3.261 |  candanodakaśīteṣu *śīte dhāragṛhe 'pi vā|
himāmbusikte sadane *dāhārtaḥ saṃviśet sukham||
6.3.262 |  hemaśaṅkhapravālānāṃ maṇīnāṃ mauktikasya ca|
candanodakaśītānāṃ *saṃsparśānurasān spṛśet||
6.3.263 |  sragbhirnīlotpalaiḥ padmairvyajanairvividhairapi|
*śītavātāvahairvyajjyeccandanodakavarṣibhiḥ||
6.3.264 |  nadyastaḍāgāḥ padminyo hradāśca vimalodakāḥ|
avagāhe hitā dāhatṛṣṇāglānijvarāpahāḥ||
6.3.265 |  priyāḥ pradakṣiṇācārāḥ pramadāścandanokṣitāḥ|
sāntvayeyuḥ paraiḥ kāmairmaṇimauktikabhūṣaṇāḥ||
6.3.266 |  śītāni cānnapānāni śītānyupavanāni ca|
vāyavaścandrapādāśca śītā dāhajvarāpahāḥ||
6.3.267 |  athoṣṇābhiprāyiṇāṃ jvaritānāmabhyaṅgādīnupakramānupadekṣyāmaḥ---agurukuṣṭhatagarapatranaladaśaileyadhyāmakahareṇukāsthauṇeyakakṣemakailāvaraṅgadalapuratamālapatrabhūtīkarohiṣasaralaśallakīdevadārvagnimanthabilvasyonākakāśmaryapāṭalāpunarnavāvṛścīrakaṇṭakārībṛhatīśālaparṇīpṛśniparṇīmāṣaparṇīmudgaparṇīgokṣurakairaṇḍaśobhāñjanakavaruṇārkacirabilvatilvakaśaṭīpuṣkaramūlagaṇḍīrorubūkapattūrākṣīvāśmantakaśigrumātuluṅgapīlukamūlakaparṇītilaparṇīpīluparṇīmeṣaśṛṅgīhiṃsrādantaśaṭhairāvatakabhallātakāsphota-*kāṇḍīrātmajaikeṣīkākarañjadhānyakājamodapṛthvīkāsumukha-*surasakuṭherakakālamālakaparṇāsakṣavakaphaṇijjhakabhūstṛṇaśṛṅgaverapippalīsarṣapāśvagandhārāsnā-*ruhārohāvacābalātibalāguḍūcīśatapuṣpāśītavallīnākulīgandhanākulīśvetājyotiṣmatīcitrakādhyaṇḍāmlacāṅgerītilabadarakulatthamāṣāṇāmevaṃvidhānāmanyeṣāṃ coṣṇavīryāṇāṃ yathālābhamauṣadhānāṃ kaṣāyaṃ kārayet, tena kaṣāyeṇa teṣāmeva ca kalkena surāsauvīrakatuṣodakamaireyamedakadadhimaṇḍāranālakaṭvaraprativinītena tailapātraṃ vipācayet|
tena sukhoṣṇena tailenoṣṇābhiprāyiṇaṃ jvaritamabhyañjyāt, tathā śītajvaraḥ praśāmyati; etaireva cauṣadhaiḥ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ pradehaṃ kārayet, etaireva ca śṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ salilamavagāhanārthaṃ pariṣekārthaṃ ca prayuñjīta śītajvarapraśamārtham|| ityagurvādyaṃ tailam|
6.3.268 |  bhavanti cātra---
trayodaśavidhaḥ svedaḥ svedādhyāye nidarśitaḥ|
mātrākālavidā yuktaḥ sa ca śītajvarāpahaḥ||
6.3.269 |  sā kuṭī tacca śayanaṃ taccāvacchādanaṃ jvaram|
śītaṃ praśamayantyāśu dhūpāścāgurujā ghanāḥ||
6.3.270 |  cārūpacitagātryaśca taruṇyo yauvanoṣmaṇā|
āśleṣācchamayantyāśu pramadāḥ śiśirajvaram||
6.3.271 |  svedanānyannapānāni vātaśleṣmaharāṇi ca|
śītajvaraṃ jayantyāśu saṃsargabalayojanāt||
6.3.272 |  vātaje śramaje caiva purāṇe ksataje jvare|
laṅghanaṃ na hitaṃ vidyācchamanaistānupācaret||
6.3.273 |  vikṣipyāmāśayoṣmāṇaṃ yasmādgatvā rasaṃ nṛṇām|
jvaraṃ kurvanti doṣāstu hīyate 'gnivbalaṃ tataḥ||
6.3.274 |  yathā prajvalito vahniḥ sthālyāmindhanavānapi|
na pacatyodanaṃ samyaganilaprerito bahiḥ||
6.3.275 |  paktisthānāttathā dosairūṣmā kṣipto bahirnṛṇām|
na pacatyabhyavahṛtaṃ kṛcchāt pacati vā laghu||
6.3.276 |  ato 'gnibalarakṣārthaṃ laṅghanādikramo hitaḥ|
saptāhena hi pacyante saptadhātugatā malāḥ||
6.3.277 |  nirāmaścāpyataḥ prokto jvaraḥ prāyo 'ṣṭame 'hani|
urīrṇadoṣastvalpāgniraśnan guru niśeṣataḥ||
6.3.278 |  mucyate sahasā prāṇaiściraṃ kliśyati vā naraḥ|
etasmātkāraṇādvidvān vātike 'pyādito jvare||
6.3.279 |  nāti gurvati vā snigdhaṃ bhojayet sahasā naram|
jvare mārutaje tvādāvanapekṣyāpi hi kramam||
6.3.280 |  kuryānniranubandhānāmabhyaṅgādīnupakramān|
pāyayitvā kaṣāyaṃ ca bhojayedrasabhojanam||
6.3.281 |  jīrṇajvaraharaṃ kuryāt sarvaśaścāpyupakramam|
śleṣmalānāmavātānāṃ jvaro+*anuṣṇaḥ kaphādhikaḥ||
6.3.282 |  paripākaṃ na saptāhenāpi yāti mṛdūṣmaṇām|
taṃ krameṇa yathoktena laṅghanālpāśanādinā||
6.3.283 |  ādaśāhamupakramya kaṣāyādyairupācaret|
sāmā ye ye ca kaphajāḥ kaphapittajvarāśca ye||
6.3.284 |  laṅghanaṃ laṅghanīyoktaṃ teṣu kāryaṃ prati prati|
vamanaiśca virekaiśca bastibhiśca yathākramam||
6.3.285 |  jvarānupacareddhīmān kaphapittānilodbhavān|
saṃsṛṣṭān sannipatitān buddhvā taratamaiḥ samaiḥ||
6.3.286 |  jvarān doṣakramāpekṣī yathoktairauṣadhairjayet|
vardhanenaikadoṣasya kṣapaṇenocchritasya vā||
6.3.287 |  kaphasthānānupūrvyā vā sannipātajvaraṃ jayet|
sannipātajvarasyānte karṇamūle sudāruṇaḥ||
6.3.288 |  śothaḥ saṃjāyate tena kaścideva pramucyate|
raktāvasecanaiḥ śīghraṃ sarpiṣpānaiśca taṃ jayet||
6.3.289 |  pradehaiḥ kaphapittaghnairnāvanaiḥ kavalagrahaiḥ|
śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairjvaro yasya na śāmyati||
6.3.290 |  śākhānusārī *raktasya so 'vasekāt praśāmyati|
visarpeṇābhighātena yaśca visphoṭakairjvaraḥ||
6.3.291 |  tatrādau sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ kaphapittottaro na cet|
daurbalyāddehadhātūnāṃ jvaro jīrṇo 'nuvartate||
6.3.292 |  balyaiḥ saṃbṛṃhaṇaistasmādāhāraistamupācaret|
karma sādhāraṇaṃ *jahyāttṛtīyakacaturthakau||
6.3.293 |  āganturanubandho hi prāyaśo viṣamajvare|
vātapradhānaṃ sarpirbhirbastibhiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ||
6.3.294 |  snigdhoṣṇairannapānaiśca śamayedviṣamajvaram|
virecaneana payasā sarpiṣā saṃskṛtena ca||
6.3.295 |  viṣamaṃ tiktaśītaiśca jvaraṃ pittottaraṃ jayet|
vamanaṃ pācanaṃ rūkṣamannapānaṃ vilaṅghanam||
6.3.296 |  kaṣāyoṣṇaṃ ca viṣame jvare śastaṃ kaphottare|
yogāḥ *parāḥ pravakṣyante viṣamajvaranāśanāḥ||
6.3.297 |  prayoktavyā matimatā doṣādīn pravibhajya te|
surā samaṇḍā pānārthe bhakṣyārthe caraṇāyudhaḥ||
6.3.298 |  tittiriśca mayūraśca prayojyā viṣamajvare|
pibedvā ṣaṭpalaṃ sarpirabhayāṃ vā prayojayet||
6.3.299 |  triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyaṃ vā guḍūcyā rasameva vā|
nīlinīmajagandhāṃ ca trivṛtāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.3.300 |  pibejjvarāgame yuktyā snehasvedopapāditaḥ|
sarpiṣo mahatīṃ mātrāṃ pītvā vā chardayet punaḥ||
6.3.301 |  upayujyānnapānaṃ vā prabhūtaṃ punarullikhet|
sānnaṃ madyaṃ prabhūtaṃ vā pītvā svapyājjvarāgame||
6.3.302 |  āsthāpanaṃ yāpanaṃ vā kārayedviṣamajvare|
payasā vṛṣadaṃśasya *śakṛdvā tadahaḥ pibet||
6.3.303 |  vṛṣasya dadhimaṇḍena surayā *vā sasaindhavam|
pippalyāstriphalāyāśca dadhnastakrasya sarpiṣaḥ||
6.3.304 |  pañcagavyasya payasaḥ prayogo viṣamajvare|
rasonasya satailasya prāgbhaktamupasevanam||
6.3.305 |  medyānāmuṣṇavīryāṇāmāmiṣāṇāṃ ca bhakṣaṇam|
hiṅgutulyā tu vaiyāghrī vasā nasyaṃ sasaindhavā||
6.3.306 |  purāṇasarpiḥ siṃhasya vasā tadvat sasaindhavā|
saindhavaṃ pippalīnāṃ ca taṇḍulāḥ samanaḥśilāḥ||
6.3.307 |  netrāñjanaṃ tailapiṣṭaṃ śasyate viṣamajvare|
palaṅkaṣā nimbapatraṃ vacā kuṣṭhaṃ harītakī||
6.3.308 |  sarṣapāḥ sayavāḥ sarpirdhūpanaṃ jvaranāśanam|
ye dhūmā dhūpanaṃ yacca nāvanaṃ cāñjanaṃ ca yat||
6.3.309 |  manovikāre nirdiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ tadviṣamajvare|
maṇīnāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca maṅgalyānāṃ viṣasya ca||
6.3.310 |  dhāraṇādagadānāṃ ca sevanānna bhavejjvaraḥ|
somaṃ sānucaraṃ devaṃ samātṛgaṇamīśvaram||
6.3.311 |  pūjayan prayataḥ śīghraṃ mucyate viṣamajvarāt|
viṣṇuṃ sahasramūrdhānaṃ carācarapatiṃ vibhum||
6.3.312 |  stuvannāmasahasreṇa jvarān sarvānapohati|
brahmāṇamaśvināvindraṃ hutabhakṣaṃ himācalam||
6.3.313 |  gaṅgāṃ *marudgaṇāṃśceṣṭyā pūjayañjayati jvarān|
bhaktyā mātuḥ pituścaiva gurūṇāṃ pūjanena ca||
6.3.314 |  brahmacaryeṇa tapasā satyena niyamena ca|
japagomapradānena vedānāṃ śravaṇena ca||
6.3.315 |  jvarādvimucyate śīghraṃ sādhūnāṃ darśanena ca|
jvare rasasthe vamanamupavāsaṃ ca kārayet||
6.3.316 |  sekapradehau raktasthe tathā saṃśamanāni ca|
virecanaṃ sopavāsaṃ māṃsamedaḥsthite hitam||
6.3.317 |  asthimajjagate deyā nirūhāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ|
śāpābhicārādbhūtānāmabhiṣaṅgācca yo jvaraḥ||
6.3.318 |  daivavyapāśrayaṃ tatra sarvamauṣadhamiṣyate|
abhighātajvaro *naśyet pānābhyaṅgena sarpiṣaḥ||
6.3.319 |  *raktāvasekairmadyaiśca sātmyairmāṃsarasaudanaiḥ|
sānāho madyasātmyānāṃ madirārasabhojanaiḥ||
6.3.320 |  kṣatānāṃ vraṇitānāṃ ca kṣatavraṇacikitsayā|
āśvāceneṣṭalābhena vāyoḥ praśamanena ca||
6.3.321 |  harṣaṇaiśca śamaṃ yānti kāmaśokabhayajvarāḥ|
kāmyairarthairmanojñaiśca pittaghnaiścāpyupakramaiḥ||
6.3.322 |  sadvākyaiśca śamaṃ yāti jvaraḥ krodhasamuthitaḥ|
kāmāt krodhajvaro nāśaṃ krodhāt kāmasamudbhavaḥ||
6.3.323 |  yāti tābhyāmubhābhyāṃ ca bhayaśokasamutthitaḥ|
jvarasya vegaṃ kālaṃ ca cintayañjvaryate tu yaḥ||
6.3.324 |  jvarapramokṣe puruṣaḥ kūjan vamati ceṣṭate|
śvasanvivarṇaḥ svinnāṅgo vepate līyate muhuḥ||
6.3.325 |  pralapatyuṣṇasarvāṅgaḥ śītāṅgaśca bhavatyapi|
visaṃjño jvaravegārtaḥ sakrodha iva *vīkṣyate||
6.3.326 |  sadoṣaśabdaṃ ca śakṛddravaṃ sravati vegavat|
liṅgānyetāni jānīyājjvaramokṣe vicakṣaṇaḥ||
6.3.327 |  bahudoṣasya *balavān prāyeṇābhinavo jvaraḥ|
*satkriyādoṣapaktyā cedvimuñcati sudāruṇam||
6.3.328 |  kṛtvā doṣavaśādvegaṃ kramāduparamanti ye|
teṣāmadāruṇo mokṣo jvarāṇāṃ cirakāriṇām||
6.3.329 |  vigataklamasaṃtāpamavyathaṃ vimalendriyam|
yuktaṃ prakṛtisattvena vidyāt puruṣamajvaram||
6.3.330 |  sajvaro jvaramuktaśca vidāhīni gurūṇi ca|
asātmyānyannapānāni viruddhāni ca varjayet||
6.3.331 |  vyavāyamaticeṣṭāśca snānamatyaśanāni ca|
tathā jvaraḥ śamaṃ yāti praśānto jāyate na ca||
6.3.332 |  vyāyāmaṃ ca vyavāyaṃ ca snānaṃ caṅkramaṇāni ca|
jvaramukto na seveta yāvanna balavān bhavet||
6.3.333 |  asaṃjātabalo yastu jvaramukto niṣevate|
varjyametannarastasya punarāvartate jvaraḥ||
6.3.334 |  durhṛteṣu ca doṣeṣu yasya vā vinivartate|
svalpenāpyapacāreṇa tasya vayāvatate punaḥ||
6.3.335 |  cirakālaparikliṣṭaṃ durbalaṃ *hīnatejasam|
acireṇaiva kālena sa hanti punarāgataḥ||
6.3.336 |  *athavā 'pi parīpākaṃ dhātuṣveva kramānmalāḥ|
yānti jvaramakurvantaste tathā 'pyapakurvate||
6.3.337 |  dīnatāṃ śvayathuṃ glāniṃ pāṇḍutāṃ nānnakāmatām|
kaṇḍūrutkoṭhapiḍakāḥ kurvantyagniṃ ca te mṛdum||
6.3.338 |  evamanye 'pi ca gadā vyāvartante punargatāḥ|
anirghātena doṣāṇāmalpairapyahitairnṛṇām||
6.3.339 |  nirvṛtte 'pi jvare tasmādyathāvasthaṃ yathābalam|
yathāprāṇaṃ hareddoṣaṃ prayogairvā śamaṃ nayet||
6.3.340 |  mṛdubhiḥ śodhanaiḥ śuddhiryāpanā bastayo hitāḥ|
hitāśca laghavo yūṣā jāṅgalāmiṣajā rasāḥ||
6.3.341 |  abhyaṅgodvartanasnānadhūpanānyañjanāni ca|
hitāni punarāvṛtte jvare tiktaghṛtāni ca||
6.3.342 |  gurvyabhiṣyandyasātmyānāṃ bhojanāt punarāgate|
laṅghanoṣṇopacārādiḥ kramaḥ kāryaśca pūrvavat||
6.3.343 |  kirātatiktakaṃ tiktā mustaṃ parpaṭako 'mṛtā|
ghnanti pītāni cābhyāsāt punarāvartakaṃ jvaram||
6.3.344 |  tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ jvaritānāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ|
jvarakriyākramāpekṣī kuryāttattaccikitsitam||
6.3.345 |  rogarāṭra sarvabhūtānāmantakṛddāruṇo jvaraḥ|
tasmādviśeṣatastasya yateta praśame bhiṣak||
6.3.346 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
yathākramaṃ yathāpraśnamuktaṃ jvaracikitsitam|
ātreyeṇāgniveśāya bhūtānāṃ hitakāmyayā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsitasthāne jvaracikitsitaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||3 | |

caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.4.1 |  athāto raktapittacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.4.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.4.3 |  viharantaṃ jitātmānaṃ pañcagaṅge punarvasum|
praṇamyovāca nirmohamagniveśo 'gnivarcasam||
6.4.4 |  bhagavan raktapittasya heturuktaḥ salakṣaṇaḥ|
vaktavyaṃ yat paraṃ tasya vaktumarhasi tadguro||
6.4.5 |  gururuvāca---
mahāgadaṃ mahāvegamagnivacchīghrakāri ca|
hetulakṣaṇavicchīghraṃ raktapittamupācaret||
6.4.6 |  tasyoṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇamamlaṃ ca kaṭūni lavaṇāni ca|
gharmaścānnavidāhaśca hetuḥ pūrvaṃ nidarśitaḥ||
6.4.7 |  tairhetubhiḥ samutkliṣṭaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ prapadyate|
tadyonitvāt prapannaṃ ca vardhate tat pradūṣayat||
6.4.8 |  tasyoṣmaṇā dravo dhāturdhātordhātoḥ prasicyate|
svidyatastena saṃvṛddhiṃ bhūyastadadhigacchati||
6.4.9 |  saṃyogādbūṣaṇāttattu sāmānyādgandhavarṇayoḥ|
raktasya pittamākhyātaṃ raktapittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ||
6.4.10 |  plīhānaṃ ca yakṛccaiva tadadhiṣṭhāya vartate|
srotāṃsi raktavāhīni tanmūlāni hi dehinām||
6.4.11 |  sāndraṃ sapāṇḍu sasnehaṃ picchilaṃ ca kaphānvitam|
śyāvāruṇaṃ saphenaṃ ca tanu rūkṣaṃ ca vātikam||
6.4.12 |  raktapittaṃ kaṣāyābhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gomūtrasaṃnibham|
mecakāgāradhūmābhamañjanābhaṃ ca paittikam||
6.4.13 |  saṃsṛṣṭāliṅgaṃ saṃsargāttriliṅgaṃ sānnipātikam|
ekadoṣānugaṃ sādhyaṃ dvidoṣaṃ yāpyamucyate||
6.4.14 |  yattridoṣamasādhyaṃ tanmandāgnerativegavat|
vyādhibhiḥ kṣīṇadehasya vṛddhasyānaśnataśca yat||
6.4.15 |  gatirūrdhvamadhaścaiva raktapittasya darśitā|
ūrdhvā saptavidhadvārā dvidvārā tvadharā gatiḥ||
6.4.16 |  sapta cchidrāṇi śirasi dve cādhaḥ, sādhyamūrdhvagam|
yāpyaṃ tvadhogaṃ, mārgau tu dvāvasādhyaṃ prapadyate||
6.4.17 |  yadā tu sarvacchidrebhyo romakūpebhya eva ca|
vartate tāmasaḍkhyeyāṃ gatiṃ tasyāhurāntikīm||
6.4.18 |  yaccobhayābhyāṃ mārgābhyāmatimātraṃ pravartate|
tulyaṃ kuṇapagandhena raktaṃ kṛṣṇamatīva ca||
6.4.19 |  saṃsṛṣṭaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ *kaṇṭhe sajjati cāpi yat|
yaccāpyupadravaiḥ sarvairyathoktaiḥ samabhidrutam||
6.4.20 |  hāridravīlaharitatāmrairvarṇairupadrutam|
kṣīṇasya kāsamānasya yacca tacca na sidhyati||
6.4.21 |  yaddvidoṣānugaṃ yadvā śāntaṃ *śāntaṃ prakupyati|
mārgānmārgaṃ caredyadvā yāpyaṃ pittamasṛk ca tat||
6.4.22 |  ekamārgaṃ balavato nātivegaṃ navotthitam|
raktapittaṃ sukhe kāle sādhyaṃ syānnirupadravam||
6.4.23 |  snigdhoṣṇamuṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca raktapittasya kāraṇam|
adhogasyottaraṃ prāyaḥ, pūrvaṃ syādūrdhvagasya tu||
6.4.24 |  ūrdhvagaṃ kaphasaṃsṛṣṭamadhogaṃ mārutānugam|
dvimārgaṃ kaphavātābhyāmubhābhyāmanubadhyate||
6.4.25 |  akṣīṇabalamāṃsasya raktapittaṃ yadaśnataḥ|
taddoṣaduṣṭāmutkliṣṭaṃ nādau stambhanamarhati||
6.4.26 |  galagrahaṃ pūtinasyaṃ mūrcchāyamaruciṃ jvaram|
gulmaṃ plīhānamānāhaṃ kilāsaṃ kṛcchramūtratām||
6.4.27 |  kuṣṭhānyarśaṃsi vīsarpaṃ varṇanāśaṃ bhagandaram|
buddhīnriyoparodhaṃ ca kuryāt sambhitamāditaḥ||
6.4.28 |  tasmādupekṣyaṃ balino *baladoṣavicāriṇā|
raktapittaṃ prathamataḥ *pravṛddhaṃ siddhimicchatā||
6.4.29 |  prāyeṇa hi samutkliṣṭamāmadoṣāccharīriṇām|
vṛddhiṃ prayāti pittāsṛktasmāttallaṅghyamāditaḥ||
6.4.30 |  mārgau doṣānubandhaṃ ca nidānaṃ prasamīkṣya ca|
laṅghanaṃ raktapittādau tarpaṇaṃ vā prayojayet||
6.4.31 |  hrīberacandanośīramustaparpaṭakaiḥ śṛtam|
kevalaṃ śṛtaśītaṃ vā dadyāttoyaṃ pipāsave||
6.4.32 |  ūrdhvage tarpaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ peyāṃ pūrvamadhogate|
kālasātmyānubandhajño dadyāt prakṛtikalpavit||
6.4.33 |  jalaṃ kharjūramṛdvīkāmadhūkaiḥ saparūṣakaiḥ|
śṛtaśītaṃ prayoktavyaṃ tarpaṇārthe saśarkaram||
6.4.34 |  tarpaṇaṃ saghṛtakṣaudraṃ lājacūrṇaiḥ pradāpayet|
ūrdhvagaṃ raktapittaṃ tat pītaṃ kāle vyapohati||
6.4.35 |  mandāgneramlasātmyāya tat sāmlamapi kalpayet|
*dāḍimāmalakairvidvānamlārthaṃ cānudāpayet||
6.4.36 |  śāliṣaṣṭikanīvārakoradūṣapraśāntikāḥ|
śyāmākaśca priyaṅguśca bhojanaṃ raktapittinām||
6.4.37 |  mudgā masūrāścaṇakāḥ samakuṣṭhāḍhakīphalāḥ|
praśastāḥ sūpayūṣārthe kalpitā raktapittinām||
6.4.38 |  paṭolanimbavetrāgraplakṣavetasapallavāḥ|
kirātatiktakaṃ śākaṃ *gaṇḍīraḥ sakaṭhillakaḥ||
6.4.39 |  kovidārasya puṣpāṇi kāśmaryasyātha śālmaleḥ|
annapānavidhau śākaṃ yaccānyadraktapittanut||
6.4.40 |  śākārthaṃ śākasātmyānāṃ tacchastaṃ raktapittinām|
svinnaṃ vā sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭaṃ yūṣavadvā vipācitam||
6.4.41 |  pārāvatān kapotāṃśca lāvān raktākṣavartakān|
śaśān kapiñjalāneṇān hariṇānkālapucchakān||
6.4.42 |  raktapitte hitān vidyādrasāṃsteṣāṃ prayojayet|
īṣadamlānanamlān vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭān saśarakarān||
6.4.43 |  kaphānuge yūṣaśākaṃ dadyādvātānuge rasam|
raktapitte yavāgūnāmataḥ kalpaḥ pravakṣyate||
6.4.44 |  padmotpalānāṃ kiñjalkaḥ pṛśniparṇī priyaṅgukāḥ|
jale sādhyā rase tasmin peyā syādraktapittinām||
6.4.45 |  candanośīraloghrāṇāṃ rase dadvat sanāgare|
kirātatiktakośīramustānāṃ tadvadeva ca||
6.4.46 |  dhātakīdhanvayāsāmbubilvānāṃ vā rase śṛtā|
masūrapṛśniparṇyorvā sthirāmudgarase 'tha vā||
6.4.47 |  rase hareṇukānāṃ vā saghṛte sabalārase|
siddhāḥ pārāvatādīnāṃ rase vā syuḥ pṛthakpṛthak||
6.4.48 |  ityuktā raktapittaghnyaḥ śītāḥ samadhuśarkarāḥ|
yavāgvaḥ kalpanā caiṣā kāryā māṃsaraseṣvapi||
6.4.49 |  śaśaḥ savāstukaḥ śasto vibandhe raktapittinām|
vātolvaṇe nittiriḥ syādudumbararase śṛtaḥ||
6.4.50 |  mayūraḥ plakṣaniryūhe nyagrodhasya ca kukkuṭaḥ|
rase *bilvotpalādīnāṃ vartakakrakarau hitau||
6.4.51 |  tṛṣyate tiktakaiḥ siddhaṃ tṛṣṇāghnaṃ vā phalodakam|
siddhaṃ *vidārigandhādyairathavā śṛtaśītalam||
6.4.52 |  jñātvā doṣāvanubalau balamāhārameva ca|
jalaṃ pipāsave *dadyādvisargādalpaśo 'pi vā||
6.4.53 |  nidānaṃ raktapittasya yatkiṃcit saṃprakāśitam|
jīvitārogyakāmaistanna sevyaṃ raktapittibhiḥ||
6.4.54 |  ityannapānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ kramaśo raktapittanut|
vakṣyate bahudoṣāṇāṃ kāryaṃ balavatāṃ ca yat||
6.4.55 |  akṣīṇabalamāṃsasya yasya saṃtarpaṇotthitam|
bahudoṣaṃ balavato raktapittaṃ śarīriṇaḥ||
6.4.56 |  kāle saṃśodhanārhasya taddharennirupadravam|
virecanenordhvabhāgamadhogaṃ vamanena ca||
6.4.57 |  trivṛtāmabhayāṃ prājñaḥ phalānyāragvadhasya vā|
trāyamāṇāṃ gavākṣyā vā mūlamāmalakāni vā||
6.4.58 |  virecanaṃ prayuñjīta prabhūtamadhuśarkaram|
rasaḥ praśasyate teṣāṃ raktapitte viśeṣataḥ||
6.4.59 |  bamanaṃ madanonmiśro manthaḥ sakṣaudraśarkaraḥ|
saśarkaraṃ vā salilamikṣūṇāṃ rasa eva vā||
6.4.60 |  vatsakasya phalaṃ mustaṃ madanaṃ madhukaṃ madhu|
adhovahe *raktapitte bamanaṃ paramucyate||
6.4.61 |  ūrdhvage śuddhakoṣṭhasya tarpaṇādiḥ kramo hitaḥ|
adhogate yavāgvādirna cetsyānmāruto balī||
6.4.62 |  balamāṃsaparikṣīṇāṃ śokabhārādhvakarśitam|
jvalanādityasaṃtaptamanyairvā kṣīṇamāmayaiḥ||
6.4.63 |  garbhiṇīṃ sthaviraṃ bālaṃ rūkṣālpapramitāśinam|
avamyamavirecyaṃ vā yaṃ paśyedraktapittinam||
6.4.64 |  śoṣeṇa sānubandhaṃ vā tasya saṃśamanī kriyā|
śasyate raktapittasya paraṃ sā'tha pravakṣyate||
6.4.65 |  aṭarūṣakamṛdvīkāpathyākvāthaḥ saśarkaraḥ|
madhumiśraḥ śvāsakāsaraktapittanibarhaṇaḥ||
6.4.66 |  aṭarūṣakaniryūhe priyaṅguṃ mṛttikāñjane|
vinīya lodhraṃ kṣaudraṃ ca raktapittaharaṃ pibet||
6.4.67 |  padmakaṃ padmakiñjalkaṃ dūrvāṃ vāstūkamutpalam|
nāgapuṣpaṃ ca lodhraṃ ca tenaiva vidhinā pibet||
6.4.68 |  prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ madhu cāśvaśakṛdrase|
yavāsabhṛṅgarajasormūlaṃ vā gośakṛdrase||
6.4.69 |  vinīya raktapittaghnaṃ peyaṃ syāttaṇḍulāmbunā|
yuktaṃ vā madhusarpirbhyāṃ lihyādnośvaśakṛdrasam||
6.4.70 |  khadirasya priyaṅgūṇāṃ kovidārasya śālmaleḥ|
puṣpacūrṇāni madhunā lihyānnā raktapittikaḥ||
6.4.71 |  śṛṅgāṭakānāṃ lājānāṃ mustakharjūrayorapi|
lihyāccūrṇāni madhunā padmānāṃ keśarasya ca||
6.4.72 |  dhanvajānāmasṛglihyānmadhunā mṛgapakṣiṇām|
sakṣaudraṃ grathite rakte lihyāt pārāvataṃ śakṛt||
6.4.73 |  uśīrakālīyakaloghrapadmakapriyaṅgukākaṭphalaśaṅkhagairikāḥ|
