pṛthak pṛthak candanatulyabhāgikāḥ saśarkarāstaṇḍuladhāvanāplutāḥ||
6.4.74 |  raktaṃ sapittaṃ tamakaṃ pipāsāṃ dāhaṃ ca pītāḥ śamayanti sadyaḥ|
kirātatiktaṃ kramukaṃ samustaṃ prapauṇḍarīkaṃ kamalotpale ca||
6.4.75 |  hrīberamūlāni paṭolapatraṃ durālabhā parpaṭako mṛṇālam|
dhanañjayodumbaravetasatvaṅnyagrodhaśāleyayavāsakatvak||
6.4.76 |  *tugālatāvetasataṇḍulīyaṃ sasārivaṃ mocarasaḥ samaṅgā|
pṛthak pṛthak candanayojitāni tenaiva kalpena hitāni tatra||
6.4.77 |  niśi sthitā vā svarasīkṛtā vā *kalkīkṛtā vā mṛditāḥ śṛtā vā|
ete samastā gaṇaśaḥ pṛthagvā raktaṃ sapittaṃ *śamayanti yogāḥ||
6.4.78 |  mudgāḥ salājāḥ sayavāḥ sakṛṣṇāḥ sośīramustāḥ saha candanena|
balājale paryuṣitāḥ kaṣāyā raktaṃ sapittaṃ śamayantyudīrṇam||
6.4.79 |  vaidūryamuktāmaṇigairikāṇāṃ mṛcchaṅkhahemāmalakodakānām|
madhūdakasyekṣurasasya caiva pānācchamaṃ gacchati raktapittam||
6.4.80 |  uśīrapadmotpalacandanānāṃ pakvasya loṣṭasya ca yaḥ prasādaḥ|
saśarkaraḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ suśīto raktātiyogapraśamāya deyaḥ||
6.4.81 |  priyaṅgukācandanalodhrasārivāmadhūkamustābhayadhātakījalam|
samṛtprasādaṃ saha *yaṣṭikāmbunā saśarkaraṃ raktanibarhaṇaṃ param||
6.4.82 |  kaṣāyayogairvividhairyathoktairdīpte 'nale śleṣmaṇi nirjite ca|
yadraktapittaṃ praśamaṃ na yāti tatrānilaḥ syādanu tatra kāryam||
6.4.83 |  chāgaṃ payaḥ syāt paramaṃ prayoge gavyaṃ śṛtaṃ pañcaguṇe jale vā|
saśarkaraṃ mākṣikasaṃprayuktaṃ vidārigandhādigaṇaiḥ śṛtaṃ vā||
6.4.84 |  drākṣāśṛtaṃ nāgarakaiḥ śṛtaṃ vā balāśṛtaṃ gokṣurakaiḥ śṛtaṃ vā|
sajīvakaṃ sarṣabhakaṃ sasarpiḥ payaḥ prayojyaṃ sitayā śṛtaṃ vā||
6.4.85 |  śatāvarīgokṣurakaiḥ śṛtaṃ vā śṛtaṃ payo vā 'pyatha parṇinībhiḥ|
raktaṃ nihantyāśu viśeṣatastu yanmūtramārgāt sarujaṃ prayāti||
6.4.86 |  viśeṣato viṭpathasaṃpravṛtte payo mataṃ mocarasena siddham|
vaṭāvarohairvaṭaśuṅgakairvā hrīberanīlotpalanāgarairvā||
6.4.87 |  kaṣāyayogān payasā purā vā pītvā 'nu cādyāt payasaiva śālīn|
kaṣāyayogairathavā vipakvametaiḥ pibet sarpiratisrave ca||
6.4.88 |  vāsāṃ saśākhāṃ sapalāśamūlāṃ kṛtvā kaṣāyaṃ kusumāni cāsyāḥ|
pradāya kalkaṃ vipacedghṛtaṃ tat sakṣaudramāśveva nihanti raktam||
iti vāsāghṛtam|
6.4.89 |  palāśavṛntasvarasena siddhaṃ tasyaiva kalkena madhudraveṇa|
lihyādghṛtaṃ vatsakakalkasiddhaṃ tadvat samaṅgotpalalodhrasiddham||
6.4.90 |  syāttrāyamāṇāvidhireṣa eva sodumbare caiva paṭolapatre|
sarpīṣi pittajvaranāśanāni sarvāṇi śastāni ca raktapitte||
6.4.91 |  abhyaṅgayogāḥ pariṣecanāni sekāvagāhāḥ śayanāni veśma|
śīto vidhirbastividhānamagryaṃ pittajvare yat praśamāya diṣṭam||
6.4.92 |  tadraktapitte nikhilena kāryaṃ kālaṃ ca mātrāṃ ca purā samīkṣya|
sarpirguḍā ye ca hītāḥ kṣatebhyaste raktapittaṃ śamayanti sadyaḥ||
6.4.93 |  kaphānubandhe rudhire sapitte kaṇṭhāgate syādgrathite prayogaḥ|
yuktasya yuktyā madhusarpiṣośca kṣārasya caivotplanālajasya||
6.4.94 |  mṛṇālapadmotpalakeśarāṇāṃ tathā palāśasya tathā priyaṅgoḥ|
tathā madhūkasya tathā 'sanasya kṣārāḥ prayojyā vidhinaiva tena||
6.4.95 |  śatāvarīdāḍimatintiḍīkaṃ kākolimede madhukaṃ vidārīm|
piṣṭvā ca mūlaṃ phalapūrakasya ghṛtaṃ pacet kṣīracaturguṇaṃ jñaḥ||
6.4.96 |  kāsajvarānāhavibandhaśūlaṃ tadraktapittaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ nihanyāt|
yat pañcamūlairatha pañcabhirvā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ tacca tadarthakāri||
iti śatāvaryādighṛtam|
6.4.97 |  kaṣāyayogā ya ihopadiṣṭāste cāvapīṭe bhiṣajā prayojyāḥ|
ghrāṇāt pravṛttaṃ rudhiraṃ sapītaṃ yadā bhavenniḥsṛtaduṣṭadoṣam||
6.4.98 |  rakte praduṣṭe hyavapīḍabandhe duṣṭapratiśyāyaśirovikārāḥ|
raktaṃ sapūyaṃ *kuṇapaśca gandhaḥ syād ghrāṇanāśaḥ kṛmayaśca duṣṭāḥ||
6.4.99 |  nīlotpalaṃ gairikaśaṅkhayuktaṃ sacandanaṃ syāttu sitājalena|
nasyaṃ tathā++āmrāsthirasaḥ samaṅgā sadhātakīmocarasaḥ salodhraḥ||
6.4.100 |  drākṣārasasyekṣurasasya nasyaṃ kṣīrasya dūrvāsvarasasya caiva|
yavāsamūlāni palāṇḍumūlaṃ nāsyaṃ tathā dāḍimapuṣpatoyam||
6.4.101 |  priyālatailaṃ madhukaṃ payaśca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ māhiṣamājikaṃ vā|
āmrāsthipūrvaiḥ payasā ca nasyaṃ sasārivaiḥ syāt kamalotpalaiśca||
6.4.102 |  bhadraśriyaṃ lohitacandanaṃ ca prapauṇḍarīkaṃ kamalotpale ca|
uśīravānīrajalaṃ mṛṇālaṃ sahasravīryā madhukaṃ payasyā||
6.4.103 |  śālīkṣumūlāni yavāsagundrāmūlaṃ nalānāṃ kuśakāśayośca|
kucandanaṃ śaivalamapyanantā kālānusāryā tṛṇamūlamṛddhiḥ||
6.4.104 |  mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca vārijānāṃ pralepanaṃ puṣkariṇīmṛdaśca|
udumbarāśvatthamadhūkalodhrāḥ kaṣāyavṛkṣāḥ śiśirāśca sarve||
6.4.105 |  pradehakalpe pariṣecane ca tathā 'vagāhe ghṛtatailailasiddhau|
raktasya pittasya ca śāntimicchan bhadraśriyādīni bhiṣak prayuñjyāt||
6.4.106 |  dhārāgṛhaṃ bhūmigṛhaṃ suśītaṃ vanaṃ ca ramyaṃ jalavātaśītam|
vaidūryamuktāmaṇibhājanānāṃ sparśāśca dāhe śiśirāmbuśītāḥ||
6.4.107 |  patrāṇi puṣpāṇi ca vārijānāṃ kṣaumaṃ ca śītaṃ kadalīdalāni|
pracchādanārthaṃ śayanāsanānāṃ padmotpalānāṃ ca dalāḥ praśastāḥ||
6.4.108 |  priyaṅgukācandanarūṣitānāṃ sparśāḥ priyāṇāṃ ca varāṅganānām|
dāhe praśastāḥ sajalāḥ suśītāḥ padmotpalānāṃ ca kalāpavātāḥ||
6.4.109 |  sariddhradānāṃ himavaddarīṇāṃ candrodayānāṃ kamalākarāṇām|
mano 'nukūlāḥ śiśirāśca sarvāḥ kathāḥ saraktaṃ śamayanti pittam||
6.4.110 |  tatra ślokau---
hetuṃ vṛddhiṃ saṃjñāṃ sthānaṃ liṅgaṃ pṛthak praduṣṭasya|
mārgau sādhyamasādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ kāryakramaṃ caiva||
6.4.111 |  pānānnamiṣṭameva ca varjyaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ ca śamanaṃ ca|
gururuktavānyathāvaccikitsite raktapittasya||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsitasthāne raktapittacikitsitaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4 | |

pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.5.1 |  athāto gulmacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.5.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.5.3 |  sarvaprajānāṃ pitṛvaccharaṇyaḥ punarvasurbhūtabhaviṣyadīśaḥ|
cikitsitaṃ gulmanibarhaṇārthaṃ provāca siddhaṃ vadatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ||
6.5.4 |  viṭśleṣmapittātiparisravādvā taireva vṛddhaiḥ paripīḍanādvā|
vegairudīrṇaivihatairadho vā bāhyābhighātairatipīḍanairvā||
6.5.5 |  rūkṣānnapānairatisevitairvā śokena mithyāpratikarmaṇā vā|
viceṣṭitairvā viṣamātimātraiḥ koṣṭhe prakopaṃ samupaiti vāyuḥ||
6.5.6 |  kaphaṃ ca pittaṃ ca sa *duṣṭavāyuruddhūya mārgān vinibaddhya tābhyām|hṛnnābhipārśvodarabastiśūlaṃ karotyatho yāti na baddhamārgaḥ||
6.5.7 |  pakvāśaye pittakaphāśaye vā sthitaḥ svatantraḥ parasaṃśrayo vā|
sparśopalabhyaḥ paripiṇḍitatvādgulmo yathadoṣamupaiti nāma||
6.5.8 |  bastau ca nābhyāṃ hṛdi pārśvayorvā sthānāni gulmasya bhavanti pañca|
pañcātmakasya prabhavaṃ tu tasya vakṣyāmi liṅgāni cikitsitaṃ ca||
6.5.9 |  rūkṣānnapānaṃ viṣamātimātraṃ viceṣṭitaṃ vegavinigrahaśca|
śoko 'bhighāto 'timalakṣayaśca nirannatā cānilagulmahetuḥ||
6.5.10 |  yaḥ sthānasaṃsthānarujāṃ vikalpaṃ viḍvātasaṅgaṃ galavaktraśoṣam|
śyāvāruṇatvaṃ śiśirajvaraṃ ca hṛtkukṣipārśvaṃsaśirorujaṃ ca||
6.5.11 |  karoti jīrṇe 'bhyadhikaṃ prakopaṃ bhukte mṛdutvaṃ samupaiti yaśca|
vātāt sa gulmo na ca tatra rūkṣaṃ kaṣāyatiktaṃ kaṭu copaśete||
6.5.12 |  kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇavidāhirūkṣakrodhātimadyārkahutāśasevā|
*āmābhighāto rudhiraṃ ca duṣṭaṃ paittasya gulmasya nimittamuktam||
6.5.13 |  jvaraḥ pipāsā vadanāṅgarāgaḥ śūlaṃ mahajjīryati bhojane ca|
svedo vidāho vraṇavacca gulmaḥ sparśāsahaḥ paittikagulmarūpam||
6.5.14 |  śītaṃ guru snigdhamaceṣṭanaṃ ca saṃpūraṇaṃ prasvapanaṃ divā ca|
gulmasya hetuḥ kaphasaṃbhavasya sarvastu diṣṭo nicayātmakasya||
6.5.15 |  staimityaśītajvaragātrasādahṛllāsakāsārucigauravāṇi|
śaityaṃ rugalpā kaṭhinonnatatvaṃ gulmasya rūpāṇi kaphātmakasya||
6.5.16 |  nimittaliṅgānyupalabhya gulme dvidoṣaje doṣabalābalaṃ ca|
vyāmiśraliṅgānaparāṃstu gulmāṃstrīnādiśedauṣadhakalpanārtham||
6.5.17 |  mahārujaṃ dāhaparītamaśmavadghanonnataṃ śīghravidāhi dāruṇam|
manaḥśarīrāgnibalāpahāriṇaṃ tridoṣajaṃ gulmamasādhyamādiśet||
6.5.18 |  ṛtāvanāhārataya  bhayena virūkṣaṇairvegavinigrahaiśca|
saṃstambhanollekhanayonidoṣairgulmaḥ striyaṃ raktabhavo 'bhyupaiti||
6.5.19 |  yaḥ spandate piṇḍita eva nāṅgaiścirāt saśūlaḥ samagarbhaliṅgaḥ|
sa raudhiraḥ strībhava eva gulmo māse vyatīte daśame cikitsyaḥ||
6.5.20 |  kriyākramamataḥ siddhaṃ gulmināṃ gulmanāśanam|
pravakṣyāmyata ūrdhvaṃ ca yogān gulmanibarhaṇān||
6.5.21 |  rūkṣavyāyāmajaṃ gulmaṃ vātikaṃ tīvravedanam|
baddhaviṇmārutaṃ snehairāditaḥ samupācaret||
6.5.22 |  bhojanābhyañjanaiḥ pānairnirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ|
snigdhasya bhiṣajā svedaḥ kartavyo gulmaśāntaye||
6.5.23 |  srotasāṃ mārdavaṃ kṛtvā jitvā mārutamulbaṇam|
bhittvā vibandhaṃ snigdhasya svedo gulmamapohati||
6.5.24 |  snehapānaṃ hitaṃ gulme viśeṣeṇordhvanābhije|
pakvāśayagate bastirubhayaṃ jaṭharāśraye||
6.5.25 |  dīpte 'gnau vātike gulme vibandhe 'nilavarcasoḥ|
vṛṃhaṇānyannapānāni snigdhoṣṇāni prayojayet||
6.5.26 |  punaḥ punaḥ snehapānaṃ nirūhāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ|
prayojyā vātagulmeṣu kaphapittānurākṣiṇā||
6.5.27 |  kapho vāte jitaprāye pittaṃ śoṇitameva vā|
yadi kupyati vā tasya kriyamāṇe cikitsite||
6.5.28 |  yatholbaṇasya doṣasya tatra kāryaṃ bhiṣagjitam|
ādāvante ca madhye ca mārutaṃ parirakṣatā||
6.5.29 |  vātagulme kapho vṛddho hatvā 'gnimaruciṃ yadi|
hṛllāsaṃ gauravaṃ tandrāṃ janayedullikhettu tam||
6.5.30 |  śūlānāhavibandheṣu gulme vātakapholbaṇe|
vartayo guṭikāścūrṇaṃ kaphavātaharaṃ hitam||
6.5.31 |  pittaṃ vā yadi saṃvṛddhaṃ saṃtāpaṃ vātagulminaḥ|
kuryādvirecyaḥ sa bhavet sasnehairānulomikaiḥ||
6.5.32 |  gulmo yadyanilādīnāṃ kṛte samyagbhiṣagjite|
na praśāmyati raktasya so 'vasekāt praśāmyati||
6.5.33 |  snigdhoṣṇenodite gulme paittike sraṃsanaṃ hitam|
rūkṣoṣṇena tu saṃbhūte sarpiḥ praśamanaṃ param||
6.5.34 |  pittaṃ vā pittagulmaṃ vā jñātvā pakvāśayasthitam|
kālavinnirharet sadyaḥ satiktaiḥ kṣīrabastibhiḥ||
6.5.35 |  payasā vā sukhoṣṇena satiktena virecayet|
bhiṣagagnibalāpekṣī sarpiṣā tailvakena vā||
6.5.36 |  tṛṣṇājvaraparīdāhaśūlasvedāgnimārdave|
gulmināmarucau cāpi raktamevāvasecayet||
6.5.37 |  cchinnamūlā vidahyante na gulmā yānti ca kṣayam|
raktaṃ hi vyamlatāṃ yāti, tacca nāsti na cāsti ruk||
6.5.38 |  hṛtadoṣaṃ parimlānaṃ jāṅgalaistarpitaṃ rasaiḥ|
samāśvastaṃ saśeṣārtiṃ sarpirabhyāsayet punaḥ||
6.5.39 |  raktapittātivṛddhatvāt kriyāmanupalabhya ca|
yadi gulmo vidahyeta śastraṃ tatra bhiṣagjitam||
6.5.40 |  guruḥ kaṭhinasaṃsthāno gūḍhamāṃsāntarāśrayaḥ|
avivarṇaḥ sthiraścaiva hyapakvo gulm ucyate||
6.5.41 |  dāhaśūlārtisaṃkṣobhasvapnanāśāratijvaraiḥ|
vidahyamānaṃ jānīyādgulmaṃ tamupanāhayet||
6.5.42 |  vidāhalakṣaṇe gulme bahistuṅge samunnate|
śyāve saraktaparyante saṃsparśe bastisaṃnibhe||
6.5.43 |  nipīḍitonnate stabdhe *supte tatpārśvapīḍanāt|
tatraiva piṇḍite śūle saṃpakvaṃ gulmamādiśet||
6.5.44 |  tatra dhānvantarīyāṇāmadhikāraḥ kriyāvidhau|
vaidyānāṃ kṛtayogyānāṃ vyadhaśodhanaropaṇe||
6.5.45 |  antarbhāgasya cāpyetat pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam|
hṛtkroḍaśūnatā+*antaḥsthe pārśvanirgatiḥ||
6.5.46 |  pakvaḥ srotāṃsi saṃkledya vrajatyūrdhvamado 'pi vā|
svayaṃpravṛttaṃ taṃ doṣamupekṣeta *hitāśanaiḥ||
6.5.47 |  daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā rakṣan bhiṣagupadravān|
ata ūrdhvaṃ hitaṃ pānaṃ sarpiṣaḥ saviśodhanam||
6.5.48 |  śuddhasya tiktaṃ sakṣaudraṃ prayoge sarpiriṣyate|
śītalairgurubhiḥ snigdhairgulme jāte kaphātmake||
6.5.49 |  avamyasyālpakāyāgneḥ kuryāllaṅghanamāditaḥ|
mando 'gnirvedanā mandā gurustimitakoṣṭhatā||
6.5.50 |  sotkleśā cāruciryasya sa gulmī vamanopagaḥ|
uṣṇirevopacaryaśca kṛte vamanalaṅghane||
6.5.51 |  yojyaścāhārasaṃsargo bheṣajaiḥ kaṭutiktakaiḥ|
sānāhaṃ savibandhaṃ ca gulmaṃ kaṭhinamunnatam||
6.5.52 |  dṛṣṭvā++ādau svedayedyuktyā svinnaṃ ca vilayedbhiṣak|
laṅghanollekhane svede kṛte 'gnau saṃpradhukṣite||
6.5.53 |  kaphagulmī pibet kāle sakṣārakaṭukaṃ ghṛtam|
sthānādapasṛtaṃ jñātvā kaphagulmaṃ virecanaiḥ||
6.5.54 |  sasnehairbastibhirvā 'pi śodhayeddāśamūlikaiḥ|
mande 'gnāvanile mūḍhe jñātvā sasnehamāśayam||
6.5.55 |  guṭikācūrṇanuryūhāḥ prayojyāḥ kaphagulminām|
kṛtamūlaṃ mahāvāstuṃ kaṭhinaṃ stimitaṃ gurum||
6.5.56 |  jayetkaphakṛtaṃ gulmaṃ kṣārāriṣṭāgnikarmabhiḥ|
doṣaprakṛtigulmartuyogaṃ buddhvā kapholbaṇe||
6.5.57 |  baladoṣapramāṇajñaḥ kṣāraṃ gulme prayojayet|
ekāntaraṃ dvyantaraṃ vā tryahaṃ viśramya vā punaḥ||
6.5.58 |  śarīrabaladoṣāṇāṃ vṛddhikṣapaṇakovidaḥ|
śleṣmāṇaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ māṃsakṣīraghṛtāśinaḥ||
6.5.59 |  chittvā chittvā++āśayāt kṣāraḥ kṣaratvāt kṣārayatyadhaḥ|
mande 'gnāvarucau sātmye madye sasnehamaśnatām||
6.5.60 |  prayojyā mārgaśuddhyarthamariṣṭāḥ kaphagulminām|
laṅghanollekhanaiḥ svedaiḥ sarpiḥpānairvirecanaiḥ||
6.5.61 |  bastibhirguṭikācūrṇakṣārāriṣṭagaṇairapi|
ślaiṣmikaḥ kṛtamūlatvādyasya gulmo na śāmyati||
6.5.62 |  tasya dāho hṛto rakte śaramohādibhirhitaḥ|
auṣṇyāttaikṣṇyācca śamayedagnirgulme kaphānilau||
6.5.63 |  tayoḥ śamācca saṃghāto gulmasya vinirvartate|
dāhe dhānvantarīyāṇāmatrāpi bhiṣajāṃ balam||
6.5.64 |  kṣāraprayoge bhiṣajāṃ kṣāratantravidāṃ balam|
vyāmiśradoṣe vyāmiśra eṣa eva kriyākramaḥ||
6.5.65 |  siddhānataḥ pravakṣyāmi yogān gulmanibarhaṇān|
tryūṣaṇatriphalādhānyaviḍaṅgacavyacitrakaiḥ||
6.5.66 |  kalkīkṛtairghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ sakṣīraṃ vātagulmanut|
iti tryūṣaṇādighṛtam|
eta eva ca kalkāḥ syuḥ kaṣāyaḥ *pañcamūlikaḥ||
6.5.67 |  dvipañcamūliko vā 'pi tadghṛtaṃ gulmanut param|
iti tryūṣaṇādighṛtamaparam|
(ṣaṭpalaṃ vā pibet sarpiryaduktaṃ rājayakṣmaṇi||)
6.5.68 |  prasannayā vā *kṣīrārthaṃ surayā dāḍimena vā|
dadhnaḥ sareṇa vā kāryaṃ ghṛtaṃ mārutagulmanut||
6.5.69 |  hiṅgusauvarcalājājībiḍadāḍimidīpyakaiḥ|
puṣkaravyoṣadhanyākavetasakṣāracitrakaiḥ||
6.5.70 |  śaṭīvacājagandhailāsurasaiśca vipācitam|
śūlānāhaharaṃ sarpirdadhnā cānilagulminām||
iti hiṅgusauvarcalādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.71 |  hapuṣāvyoṣapṛthvīkācavyacitrakasaindhavaiḥ|
sājājīpippalīmūladīpyakairvipacedghṛtam||
6.5.72 |  sakolamūlakarasaṃ sakṣīradadhidāḍimam|
tat paraṃ vātagulmaghnaṃ śūlānāhavimokṣaṇam||
6.5.73 |  yonyarśograhaṇīdoṣaśvāsakāsārucijvarān|
bastihṛtpārśvaśūlaṃ ca ghṛtametadvyapohiti||
iti hapuṣādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.74 |  pippalyā picuradhyardho dāḍimāddvipalaṃ palaṃ|
dhānyātpañca ghṛtācchuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaḥ kṣīraṃ caturguṇam||
6.5.75 |  siddhametairghṛtaṃ sadyo vātagulmaṃ vyapohati|
yoniśūlaṃ śiraḥśūlamarśāṃsi viṣamajvaram||
iti pippalyādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.76 |  ghṛtānāmauṣadhagaṇā ya ete parikīrtitāḥ|
te cūrṇayogā vartyastāḥ kaṣāyāste ca gulminām||
6.5.77 |  koladāḍimagharmāmbusurāmaṇḍāmlakāñjikaiḥ|
śūlānāhaharī peyā bījapūrarasena vā||
6.5.78 |  cūrṇāni mātuluṅgasya bhāvitāni rasena vā|
kuryādvartīḥ saguṭikā gulmānāhārtiśāntaye||
6.5.79 |  hiṅgu trikaṭukaṃ pāṭhāṃ hapuṣāmabhayāṃ śaṭīm|
ajamodājagandhe ca tintiḍīkāmlavetasau||
6.5.80 |  dāḍimaṃ puṣkaraṃ dhānyamajājīṃ citrakaṃ vacām|
dvau kṣārau lavaṇe dve ca cavyaṃ caikatra cūrṇayet||
6.5.81 |  cūrṇametat prayoktavyamannapāneṣvanatyayam|
prāgbhaktamathavā peyaṃ madyenoṣṇodakena vā||
6.5.82 |  pārśvahṛdbastiśūleṣu gulme vātakaphātmake|
ānāhe mūtrakṛcchre ca śūle ca gudayonije||
6.5.83 |  grahaṇyarṇovikāreṣu plīhni pāṇḍvāmaye 'rucau|
urovibandhe hikkāyāṃ kāse śvāse galagrahe||
6.5.84 |  bhāvitaṃ mātuluṅgasya cūrṇametadrasena vā|
bahuśo guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ kārmukāḥ syustato 'dhikam||
iti hiṅvādicūrṇaṃ guṭikā ca|
6.5.85 |  mātuluṅgaraso hiṅgu dāḍimaṃ biḍasaindhave|
surāmaṇḍena pātavyaṃ vātagulmarujāpaham||
6.5.86 |  śaṭīpuṣkarahiṅgvamlavetasakṣāracitrakān|
dhānyakaṃ ca yavānīṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ saindhavaṃ vacām||
6.5.87 |  sacavyapippalīmūlāmajagandhāṃ sadāḍimām|
ajājīṃ cājamodāṃ ca cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā prayojayet||
6.5.88 |  rasena mātuluṅgasya madhuśuktena vā punaḥ|
bhāvitaṃ guṭikāṃ kṛtvā supiṣṭāṃ kolasaṃmitām||
6.5.89 |  gulmaṃ plīhānamānāhaṃ śvāsaṃ kāsamarocakam|
hikkāṃ hṛdrogamarśāṃsi vividhāṃ śiraso rujam||
6.5.90 |  pāṇḍvāmayaṃ kaphotkleśaṃ sarvajāṃ ca pravāhikām|
pārśvahṛdbastiśūlaṃ ca guṭikaiṣā vyapohati||
6.5.91 |  nāgarārdhapalaṃ piṣṭvā dve pale luñcitasya ca|
tilasyaikaṃ guḍapalaṃ kṣīreṇoṣṇena nā pibet||
6.5.92 |  vātagulmamudāvartaṃ yoniśūlaṃ ca nāśayet|
pibederaṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ vāruṇīmaṇḍamiśritam||
6.5.93 |  tadeva tailaṃ payasā vātagulmī pibennaraḥ|
śleṣmaṇyanubale pūrvaṃ hitaṃ pittānuge param||
6.5.94 |  sādhayecchuddhaśuṣkasya laśunasya catuṣpalam|
*kṣīrodake 'ṣṭaguṇite kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca nā pibet||
6.5.95 |  vātagulmamudāvartaṃ gṛdhrasīṃ viṣamajvaram|
hṛdrogaṃ vidradhiṃ śothaṃ sādhayasyāśu tatpayaḥ||
iti laśunakṣīram|
6.5.96 |  tailaṃ prasannā gomūtramāranālaṃ yavāgrajam|
gulmaṃ jaṭharamānāhaṃ pītamekatra sādhayet||
iti tailapañcakam|
6.5.97 |  pañcamūlīkaṣāyeṇa *sakṣāreṇa śilājatu|
pibettasya prayogeṇa vātagulmāt pramucyate||
iti śilājaturayogaḥ|
6.5.98 |  vāṭyaṃ pippalīyūṣeṇa mūlakānāṃ rasena vā|
bhuktvā snigdhamudāvartādvātagulmādvimucyate||
6.5.99 |  śūlānāhavibandhārtaṃ svedayedvātagulminam|
svedaiḥ svedavidhāvuktairnāḍīprastarasaṅkaraiḥ||
6.5.100 |  bastikarma paraṃ vidyādgulmaghnaṃ tāddhi mārutam|
sve sthāne prathamaṃ jitvā sadyo gulmamapohati||
6.5.101 |  tasmādabhīkṣṇaśo gulmā nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ|
prayujyamānaiḥ śāmyanti vātapittakaphātmakāḥ||
6.5.102 |  gulmaghnā vividhā diṣṭāḥ siddhāḥ siddhiṣu bastayaḥ|
gulmaghnāni ca tailāni vakṣyante vātarogike||
6.5.103 |  tāni mārutaje gulme pānābhyaṅgānuvāsanaiḥ|
prayuktānyāśu sidhyanti tailaṃ *hyanilajitparam||
6.5.104 |  nīlinīcūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ghṛtameva|
samalāya pradātavyaṃ śodhanaṃ vātagulmine||
6.5.105 |  nīlinītrivṛtādantīpathyākampillakaiḥ saha|
śodhanārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ sabiḍakṣāranāgaram||
6.5.106 |  nīlinīṃ triphalāṃ rāsnāṃ balāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm|
pacedviḍaṅgaṃ vyāghrīṃ ca palikāni jalāḍhake||
6.5.107 |  tena pādāvaśeṣeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
dadhnaḥ prasthena saṃyojya sudhākṣīrapalena ca||
6.5.108 |  tato ghṛtapalaṃ dadyādyavāgūmaṇḍamiśritam|
jīrṇe samyagviriktaṃ ca bhojayedrasabhojanam||
6.5.109 |  gulmakuṣṭhodaravyaṅgaśophapāṇḍvāmayajvarān|
śvitraṃ palīhānamunmādaṃ ghṛtametadvyapohati||
iti nīlinyādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.110 |  kukkuṭāśca mayūrāśca tittirikrauñcavartakāḥ|
śālayo madirā sarpirvātagulmabhiṣagjitam||
6.5.111 |  hitamuṣṇaṃ dravaṃ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ vātagulminām|
samaṇḍavāruṇīpānaṃ pakvaṃ vā dhānyakairjalam||
6.5.112 |  mande 'gnau vardhate gulmo dīpte cāgnau praśāmyati|
tasmānnā nātisauhityaṃ kuryānnātivilaṅghanam||
6.5.113 |  sarvatra gulme prathamaṃ snehasvedopapādite|
yā kriyā kriyate siddhiṃ sā yāti na virūkṣite||
6.5.114 |  bhiṣagātyayikaṃ buddhvā pittagulmamupācaret|
vairecanikasiddhena sarpiṣā *tiktakena vā||
6.5.115 |  rohiṇīkaṭukānimbamadhukatriphalātvacaḥ|
karṣāṃśāstrāyamāṇā ca paṭolatrivṛtoḥ pale||
6.5.116 |  dve pale ca masūrāṇāṃ sādhyamaṣṭaguṇe 'mbhasi|
śṛtāccheṣaṃ ghṛtasamaṃ sarpiṣaśca catuṣpalam||
6.5.117 |  pibet saṃmūrcchitaṃ tena gulmaḥ śāmyati paittikaḥ|
jvarastṛṣṇā ca śūlaṃ ca bhramo mūrcchā 'rucistathā||
iti rohiṇyādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.118 |  jale daśaguṇe sādhyaṃ trāyamāṇācatuṣpalam|
pañcabhāgasthitaṃ pūtaṃ kalkaiḥ saṃyojya kārṣikaiḥ||
6.5.119 |  rohiṇī kaṭukā mustā trāyamāṇā durālabhā|
kalkaistāmalakīvīrājīvantīcandanotpalaiḥ||
6.5.120 |  rasasyāmalakānāṃ ca kṣīrasya ca ghṛtasya ca|
palāni pṛthagaṣṭāṣṭau dattvā samyagvipācayet||
6.5.121 |  pittaraktabhavaṃ gulmaṃ vīsarpaṃ paittikaṃ jvaram|
hṛdrogaṃ kāmalāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hanyādetadghṛtottamam||
iti trāyamāṇādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.122 |  rasenāmalakekṣūṇāṃ *ghṛtapādaṃ vipācayet|
pathyāpādaṃ pibetsarpistatsiddhaṃ pittagulmanut||
ityāmalakādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.123 |  drākṣāṃ madhūkaṃ kharjūraṃ vidārīṃ saśatāvarīm|
parūṣakāṇi triphalāṃ sādhayetpalasaṃmitam||
6.5.124 |  jalāḍhake pādaśeṣe rasamāmalakasya ca|
ghṛtamikṣurasaṃ kṣīramabhayākalkapādikam||
6.5.125 |  sādhayettadghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ śarkarākṣaudrapādikam|
prayogāt pittagulmaghnaṃ sarvapittavikāranut||
iti drākṣādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.126 |  vṛṣaṃ samūlamāpothya pacedaṣṭaguṇe jale|
śeṣe 'ṣṭabhāge tasyaiva puṣpakalkaṃ pradāpayet||
6.5.127 |  tena siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ śītaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pittagulmanut|
raktapittajvaraśvāsakāsahṛdroganāśanam||
iti vāsāghṛtam|
6.5.128 |  dvipalaṃ trāyamāṇāyā jaladviprasthasādhitam|
aṣṭabhāgasthitaṃ pūtaṃ koṣṇaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ pibet||
6.5.129 |  pibedupari tasyoṣṇaṃ kṣīrameva yathābalam|
tena nirhṛtadoṣasya gulmaḥ śāmyati paittikaḥ||
6.5.130 |  drākṣābhayārasaṃ gulme paittike saguḍaṃ pibet|
lihyātkampillakaṃ vā 'pi virekārthaṃ madhudravam||
6.5.131 |  dāhapraśamano 'bhyaṅgaḥ sarpiṣā pittagulminām|
candanādyena tailena tailena madhukasya vā||
6.5.132 |  ye ca *pittajvaraharāḥ satiktāḥ kṣīrabastayaḥ|
hitāste pittagulmibhyo vakṣyante ye ca siddhiṣu||
6.5.133 |  śālayo jāṅgalaṃ māṃsaṃ gavyāje payasī ghṛtam|
kharjūrāmalakaṃ drākṣāṃ dāḍimaṃ saparūṣakam||
6.5.134 |  āhārārthaṃ prayoktavyaṃ pānārthaṃ salilaṃ śṛtam|
balāvidārīgandhādyaiḥ pittagulmacikitsitam||
6.5.135 |  āmānvaye pittagulme sāme vā kaphavātike|
yavāgūbhiḥ khaḍairyūṣaiḥ saṃdhukṣyo 'gnirvilaṅghite||
6.5.136 |  śamaprakopau doṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāmagnisaṃśritau|
tasmādagniṃ sadā rakṣennidānāni ca varjayet||
6.5.137 |  vamanaṃ vamanārhāya pradadyāt kaphagulmine|
snigdhasvinnaśarīrāya gulme śaithilyamāgate||
6.5.138 |  pariveṣṭya pradīptāṃstu balvajānathavā kuśān|
bhiṣakkumbhe samāvāpya gulmaṃ ghaṭamukhe nyaset||
6.5.139 |  *saṃgṛhīto yadā gulmastadā ghaṭamathoddharet|
vastrāntaraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā *bhindyādgulmaṃ pramāṇavit||
6.5.140 |  vimārgājapadādarśauryathālābhaṃ prapīḍayet|
mṛdgīyādgulmamevaikaṃ na *tvantrahṛdayaṃ spṛśet||
6.5.141 |  tilairaṇḍātasībījasarṣapaiḥ parilipya ca|
śleṣmagulmamayaḥpātraiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ svedayedbhiṣak||
6.5.142 |  savyoṣakṣāralavaṇaṃ daśamūlīśṛtaṃ ghṛtam|
kaphagulmaṃ jayatyāśu sahiṅgubiḍadāḍimam||
iti daśamūlīghṛtam|
6.5.143 |  bhallātakānāṃ dvipalaṃ pañcamūlaṃ palonmitam|
sādhyaṃ vidārīgandhādyamāpothya salilāḍhake||
6.5.144 |  pādaśeṣe rase tasmin pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ vacām|
viḍaṅgaṃ saindhavaṃ hiṅgu yāvaśūkaṃ biḍaṃ śaṭīm||
6.5.145 |  citrakaṃ madhukaṃ rāsnāṃ piṣṭvā karṣasamaṃ bhiṣak|
prasthaṃ ca payaso dattvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||
6.5.146 |  etadbhallātakaghṛtaṃ kaphagulmaharaṃ param|
plīhapāṇḍvāmayaśvāsagrahaṇīrogakāsanut||
iti bhallātakādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.147 |  pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ|
palikaiḥ sayavakṣārairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||
6.5.148 |  kṣīraprasthaṃ ca tat sarpihanti gulmaṃ kaphātmakam|
grahaṇīpāṇḍurogaghnaṃ plīhakāsajvarāpaham||
iti kṣīraṣaṭpalakaṃ ghṛtam|
6.5.149 |  trivṛtāṃ triphalāṃ dantīṃ kaśamūlaṃ palonmitam|
jale caturguṇe paktvā caturbhāgasthitaṃ rasam||
6.5.150 |  sarpireraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ kṣīraṃ caikatra sādhayet|
sa siddho miśrakasnehaḥ sakṣaudraḥ kaphagulmanut||
6.5.151 |  kaphavātavibandheṣu kuṣṭhaplīhodareṣu ca|
prayojyo miśrakaḥ sneho yoniśūleṣu cādhikam||
iti miśrakaḥ snehaḥ|
6.5.152 |  yaduktaṃ vātagulmaghnaṃ sraṃsanaṃ nīlinīghṛtam|
dviguṇaṃ tadvirekārthaṃ prayojyaṃ kaphagulminām||
6.5.153 |  sudhākṣīradrave cūrṇaṃ trivṛtāyāḥ subhāvitam|
kārṣikaṃ madhusarpibhyāṃ *līḍhvā sādhu virecyate||
6.5.154 |  jaladroṇe vipaktavyā viṃśatiḥ pañca cābhayāḥ|
dantyāḥ palāni tāvanti citrakasya tathaiva ca||
6.5.155 |  aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu rasaṃ pūtamadhikṣipet|
dantīsamaṃ guḍaṃ pūtaṃ kṣipettatrābhayāśca tāḥ||
6.5.156 |  tailārdhakuḍavaṃ caiva trivṛtāyāścatuṣpalam|
cūrṇitaṃ *palamekaṃ tu pippalīviśvabheṣajam||
6.5.157 |  tat sādhyaṃ lehavacchīte tasmiṃstailasamaṃ madhu|
kṣipeccūrṇapalaṃ caikaṃ tvagelāpatrakeśarāt||
6.5.158 |  tato lehapalaṃ līḍvā jagdhvā caikāṃ harītakīm|
sukhaṃ viricyate snigdho doṣaprasthamanāmayam||
6.5.159 |  gulmaṃ śvayathumarśāṃsi pāṇḍurogamarocakam|
hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīdoṣaṃ kāmalāṃ viṣamajvaram||
6.5.160 |  kuṣṭhaṃ plīhānamānāhameṣā hanyupasevitā|
niratyayaḥ kramaścāsyā dravo māṃsarasaudanaḥ||
iti dantīharītakī|
6.5.161 |  siddhāḥ siddhiṣu vakṣyante nirūhāḥ kaphagulminām|
ariṣṭayogāḥ siddhāśca grahaṇyarśaścikitsite||
6.5.162 |  yaccūrṇaṃ guṭikā yāśca vihitā vātagulminām|
dviguṇakṣārahiṅgvamlavetasāstāḥ kaphe hitāḥ||
6.5.163 |  ya eva grahaṇīdoṣe kṣārāste kaphagulminām|
siddhā niratyayāḥ śastā dāhastvante praśasyate||
6.5.164 |  prapurāṇāni dhānyāni jāṅgalā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ|
kaulattho mudgayūṣaśca pippalyā nāgarasya ca||
6.5.165 |  śuṣkamūlakayūṣaśca bilvasya *varuṇasya ca|
cirabilvāṅkurāṇāṃ ca yavānyāścitrakasya ca||
6.5.166 |  bījapūrakahiṅgvamlavetasakṣāradāḍimaiḥ|
takreṇa tailasarpirbhyāṃ vyañjanānyupakalpayet||
6.5.167 |  pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ toyaṃ purāṇaṃ vāruṇīrasam|
kaphagulmī pibetkāle jīrṇaṃ mādhvīkameva vā||
6.5.168 |  yavānīcūrṇitaṃ takraṃ biḍena lavaṇīkṛtam|
pibet saṃdīpanaṃ *vātakaphamūtrānulomanam||
6.5.169 |  saṃcitaḥ kramaśo gulmo mahāvāstuparigrahaḥ|
kṛtamūlaḥ sirānaddho yadā kūrma ivonnataḥ||
6.5.170 |  *daurbalyārucihṛllāsakāsavamyaratijvaraiḥ|
tṛṣṇātandrāpratiśyāyairyujyate na sa sidhyati||
6.5.171 |  gṛhītvā sajvaraśvāsaṃ vamyatīsārapīḍitam|
hṛnnābhihastapādeṣu śophaḥ karṣati gulminam||
6.5.172 |  raudhirasya tu gulmasya garbhakālavyatikrame|
snigdhāsvinnaśarīrāyai dadyāt snehavirecanam||
6.5.173 |  palāśakṣārapātre dve dve pātre tailasarpiṣoḥ|
gulmaśaithilyajananīṃ paktvā mātrāṃ prayojayet||
6.5.174 |  prabhidyeta na yadyevaṃ *dadyādyoniviśodhanam|
kṣāreṇa yuktaṃ palalaṃ sudhākṣīreṇa va punaḥ||
6.5.175 |  ābhyāṃ vā bhāvitān dadyādyonau kaṭukamatsyakān|
varāhamatsyapittābhyāṃ laktakān vā subhāvitān||
6.5.176 |  adhoharaiścordhvaharairbhāvitān vā samākṣikaiḥ|
kiṇvaṃ vā saguḍakṣāraṃ dadyādyoniviśodhanam||
6.5.177 |  raktapittaharaṃ kṣāraṃ lehayenmadhusarpiṣā|
laśunaṃ madirāṃ tīkṣṇāṃ matsyāṃścāsyai pradāpayet||
6.5.178 |  bastiṃ sakṣīragomūtraṃ sakṣāraṃ dāśamūlikam|
adṛśyamāne rudhire dadyādgulmaprabhedanam||
6.5.179 |  pravatamāne rudhire dadyānmāṃsarasaudanam|
ghṛtatailena cābhyaṅgaṃ pānārthaṃ taruṇīṃ surām||
6.5.180 |  rudhire 'tipravṛtte tu raktapittaharīḥ kriyāḥ|
kāryā vātarugārtāyāḥ sarvā vātaharīḥ punaḥ||
6.5.181 |  ghṛtatailāvasekāṃśca tittirīṃścaraṇāyudhān|
surāṃ samaṇḍāṃ pūrvaṃ ca pānamamlasya sarpiṣaḥ||
6.5.182 |  prayojayeduttaraṃ vā jīvanīyena sarpiṣā|
atipravṛtte rudhire satiktenānuvāsanam||
6.5.183 |  tatra ślokāḥ
snehaḥ svedaḥ sarpirbastiścūrṇāni bṛṃhaṇaṃ guḍikāḥ|
vamanavirekau mokṣaḥ kṣatajasya ca vātagulmavatām||
6.5.184 |  sarpiḥ satiktasiddhaṃ kṣīraṃ prasraṃsanaṃ nirūhāśca|
raktasya cāvasecanamāśvāsanasaṃśamanayogāḥ||
6.5.185 |  upanāhanaṃ saśastraṃ pakvasyābhyantaraprabhinnasya|
saṃśodhanasaṃśamane pittaprabhavasya gulmasya||
6.5.186 |  snehaḥ svedo bhedo laṅghanamullekhanaṃ virekaśca|
sarpirbastirguṭikāścūrṇamariṣṭāśca sakṣārāḥ||
6.5.187 |  gulmasyānte dāhaḥ kaphajasyāgre 'panītaraktasya|
gulmasya raudhirasya kriyākramaḥ strībhavasyoktaḥ||
6.5.188 |  pathyānnapānasevā hetūnāṃ varjanaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca|
nityaṃ cāgnisamādhiḥ snigdhasya ca sarvakarmāṇi||

heturliṅgaṃ siddhiḥ kriyākramaḥ sādhyatā na yogāśca|
gulmacikitsitasaṃgraha etāvān vyāhṛto 'gniveśasya

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsitasthāne gulmacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||

ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.6.1 |  athātaḥ pramehacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.6.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.6.3 |  nirmohamānānuśayo nirāśaḥ punarvasurjñānatapoviśālaḥ|
kāle 'gniveśāya sahituliṅgānuvāca mehāñśamanaṃ ca teṣām||
6.6.4 |  āsyāsukhaṃ svapnasukhaṃ dadhīni grāmyaudakānūparasāḥ payāṃsi|
navānnapānaṃ guḍavaikṛtaṃ ca pramehahetuḥ kaphakṛcca sarvam||
6.6.5 |  medaśca māṃsaṃ ca śarīrajaṃ ca kledaṃ kapho bastigataṃ pradūṣya|
karoti mehān samudīrṇamuṣṇaistāneva pittaṃ paridūṣya cāpi||
6.6.6 |  kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣvavakṛṣya bastau dhātūn pramehānanilaḥ karoti|
doṣo hi bastiṃ samupetya mūtraṃ saṃdūṣya mehāñjanayedyathāsvam||
6.6.7 |  dādhyāḥ kaphotthā daśa, pittajāḥ ṣaṭ yāpyā, na sādhyaḥ pavanāccātuṣkaḥ|
samakriyatvādviṣamakriyatvānmahātyayatvācca yathākramaṃ te||
6.6.8 |  kaphaḥ sapittaḥ pavanaśca doṣā medo 'sraśukrāmbuvasālasīkāḥ|
majjā rasaujaḥ piśitaṃ ca *dūṣyāḥ pramehiṇāṃ, viṃśatireva mehāḥ||
6.6.9 |  jalopamaṃ cekṣurasopamaṃ vā ghanaṃ ghanaṃ copari viprasannam|
śuklaṃ saśukraṃ śiśiraṃ śanairvā lāleva vā vālukayā yutaṃ vā||
6.6.10 |  vidyāt pramehān kaphajān daśaitān kṣāropamaṃ kālamathāpi nīlam|
hāridramāñjiṣṭhamathāpi raktametān pramehān ṣaḍuśanti pittāt||
6.6.11 |  majjojasā vā vasayā 'nvitaṃ vā lasīkayā vā satataṃ vibaddham|
caturvidhaṃ *mūtrayatīha vātāccheṣeṣu dhātuṣvapakarṣiteṣu||
6.6.12 |  varṇaṃ rasaṃ sparśamathāpi gandhaṃ yathāsvadoṣaṃ bhajate pramehaḥ|
śyāvāruṇo vātakṛtaḥ saśūlo majjādisādguṇyamupaityasādhyaḥ||
6.6.13 |  svedo 'ṅgagandhaḥ śithilāṅgatā ca śayyāsanasvapnasukhe ratiśca|
hṛnnetrajihvāśravaṇopadeho ghanāṅgatā keśanakhātivṛddhiḥ||
6.6.14 |  śītapriyatvaṃ galatāluśoṣo mādhuryamāsye karapādadāhaḥ|
bhaviṣyato mehagadasya rūpaṃ mūtre 'bhidhāvanti pipīlikāśca||
6.6.15 |  sthūlaḥ pramehī balavānihaikaḥ kṛśastathaikaḥ paridurbalaśca|
saṃbṛṃhaṇaṃ tatra kṛśasya kāryaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ doṣabalādhikasya||
6.6.16 |  snigdhasya yogā vividhāḥ prayojyāḥ kalpopadiṣṭā *malaśodhanāya|
ūrdhvaṃ tathā 'dhaśca male 'panīte meheṣu saṃtarpaṇameva kāryam||
6.6.17 |  gulmaḥ kṣayo mehanabastiśūlaṃ mūtragrahaścāpyapatarpaṇena|
pramehiṇaḥ syuḥ, *paritarpaṇāni kāryāṇi *tasya prasamīkṣya vahnim||
6.6.18 |  saṃśodhanaṃ nārhati yaḥ pramehī tasya kriyā saṃśamanī prayojyā|
manthāḥ kaṣāyā yavacūrṇalehāḥ pramehaśāntyai laghavaśca bhakṣyāḥ||
6.6.19 |  ye viṣkirā ye pratudā vihaṅgāsteṣāṃ rasairjāṅgalajairmanojñaiḥ|
yavaudanaṃ rūkṣamathāpi *vāṭyamadyāt sasaktūnapi cāpyapūpān||
6.6.20 |  mudgādiyūṣairatha tiktaśākaiḥ purāṇaśālyodanamādadīta|
dantīṅgudītailayutaṃ pramehī tathā 'tasīsarṣapatailayuktam||
6.6.21 |  saṣaṣṭikaṃ syāttṛṇadhānyamannaṃ yavapradhānastu bhavet pramehī|
yavasya bhakṣyān vividhāṃstathā 'dyāt kaphapramehī madhusaṃprayuktān||
6.6.22 |  niśithitānāṃ triphalākaṣāye syustarpaṇāḥ kṣaudrayutā yavānām|
tān sīdhuyuktān prapibet pramehī prāyogikānmehavadhārthameva||
6.6.23 |  ye śleṣmamehe vihitāḥ kaṣāyāstairbhāvitānāṃ ca pṛthagyavānām|
saktūnapūpān saguḍān sadhānān bhakṣyāṃstathā 'nyān vividhāṃśca khādet||
6.6.24 |  kharāśvagohaṃsapṛṣadbhṛtānāṃ tathā yavānāṃ vividhāśca bhakṣyāḥ|
deyāstathā veṇuyavā yavānāṃ kalpena godhūmamayāśca bhakṣyāḥ||
6.6.25 |  saṃśodhanollekhanalaṅghanāni kāle prayuktāni kaphapramehān|
jayanti pittaprabhavān virekaḥ saṃtarpaṇaḥ saṃśamano vidhiśca||
6.6.26 |  dārvīṃ surāhvāṃ triphalāṃ samustāṃ kaṣāyamutkkāthya pibet pramehī|
kṣaudreṇa yuktāmathavā haridrāṃ pibedrasenāmalakīphalānām||
6.6.27 |  harītakīkaṭaphalamustalodhraṃ pāṭhāviḍaṅgārjunadhanvanāśca|
ubhe haridre tagaraṃ viḍaṅgaṃ kadambaśālārjunadīpyakāśca||
6.6.28 |  dārvī viḍaṅgaṃ khadiro dhavaśca surāhvakuṣṭhāgurucandanāni|
dārvyagnimanthau triphalā sapāṭhā pāṭhā ca mūrvā ca tathā śvadaṃṣṭrā||6.6.29 |  yavānyuśīrāṇyabhayāguḍūcīcavyābhayācitrakasaptaparṇāḥ|
pādaiḥ kaṣāyāḥ kaphamehināṃ te daśopadiṣṭā madhusaṃprayuktāḥ||
6.6.30 |  uśīralodhrāñjanacandanānāmuśīramustāmalakābhayānām|
paṭolanimbāmalakāmṛtānāṃ mustābhayāpadmakavṛkṣakāṇām||
6.6.31 |  lodhrāmbukālīyakadhātakīnāṃ nimbārjunāmrātaniśotpalānām|
śirīṣasarjārjunakeśarāṇāṃ priyaṅgupadmotpalakiṃśukānām||
6.6.32 |  *aśvatthapāṭhāsanavetasānāṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryutpalamustakānām|
paitteṣu meheṣu daśa pradiṣṭāḥ pādaiḥ kaṣāyā madhusaṃprayuktāḥ||
6.6.33 |  sarveṣu meheṣu matau tu pūrvau kaṣāyayogau vihitāstu sarve|
manthasya pāne yavabhāvanāyāṃ syurbhojane pānavidhau pṛthak ca||
6.6.34 |  siddhāni tailāni ghṛtāni caiva *deyāni meheṣvanilātmakeṣu|
medaḥ kaphaścaiva kaṣāyayogaiḥ snehaiśca vāyuḥ śamameti teṣām||
6.6.35 |  kampillasaptacchadaśālajāni baibhītarauhitakakauṭajāni|
kapitthapuṣpāṇi ca cūrṇitāni kṣaudreṇa lihyāt kaphapittamehī||
6.6.36 |  pibedrasenāmalakasya cāpi kalkīkṛtānyakṣasamāni kāle|
jīrṇe ca bhuñjīta purāṇamannaṃ mehī rasairjāṅgalajairmanojñaiḥ||
6.6.37 |  dṛṣṭvā 'nubandhaṃ pavanāt kaphasya pittasya vā snehavidhirvikalpyaḥ|
tailaṃ kaphe syāt svakaṣāyasiddhaṃ pitte ghṛtaṃ pittaharaiḥ kaṣāyaiḥ||
6.6.38 |  trikaṇṭakāśmantakasomavalkairbhallātakaiḥ sātiviṣaiḥ salodhraiḥ|
*vacāpaṭolārjunanimbamustairharidrayā padmakadīpyakaiśca||
6.6.39 |  mañjiṣṭhayā cāgurucandanaiśca sarvaiḥ samastaiḥ kaphavātajeṣu|
meheṣu tailaṃ vipaced, ghṛtaṃ tu paitteṣu, miśraṃ triṣu lakṣaṇeṣu||
6.6.40 |  phalatrikaṃ dāruniśāṃ viśālāṃ mustāṃ ca niḥkvāthya niśāṃ sakalkām|
pebet kaṣāyaṃ madhusaṃprayuktaṃ sarvaprameheṣu samuddhateṣu||
6.6.41 |  lodhraṃ śaṭīṃ puṣkaramūlamelāṃ mūrvāṃ viḍaṅgaṃ triphalāṃ yamānīm|
cavyaṃ priyaṅguṃ kramukaṃ viśālāṃ kirātatiktaṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca||
6.6.42 |  bhāṅgīṃ nataṃ citrakapippalīnāṃ mūlaṃ sakuṣṭhātiviṣaṃ sapāṭham|
kaliṅgakān keśaramindrasāhvāṃ nakhaṃ sapatraṃ maricaṃ plavaṃ ca||
6.6.43 |  droṇe 'mbhasaḥ karṣasamāni paktvā pūte caturbhāgajalāvaśeṣe|
rase 'rdhabhāgaṃ madhunaḥ pradāya pakṣaṃ nidheyo ghṛtabhājanasthaḥ||
6.6.44 |  *madhvāsavo 'yaṃ kaphapittamehān kṣipraṃ nihanyāddvipalaprayogāt|
pāṇḍvāmayārśāṃsyaruciṃ grahaṇyā doṣaṃ kilāsaṃ vividhaṃ ca kuṣṭham||
iti madhvāsavaḥ|
6.6.45 |  kvāthaḥ sa evāṣṭapalaṃ ca dantyā bhallātakānāṃ ca catuṣpalaṃ syāt|
sitopalātvaṣṭapalā viśeṣaḥ kṣaudraṃ ca tāvat pṛthagāsavau tau||
6.6.46 |  sārodakaṃ vā 'tha kuśodakaṃ vā madhūdakaṃ vā triphalārasaṃ vā|
sīdhuṃ pibedvā nigadaṃ pramehī mādhvīkamagryaṃ cirasaṃsthitaṃ vā||
6.6.47 |  māṃsāni śūlyāni mṛgadvijānāṃ khādedyavānāṃ vividhāṃśca bhakṣyān|
saṃśodhanāriṣṭakaṣāyalehaiḥ saṃtarpaṇotthāñ śamayet pramehān||
6.6.48 |  bhṛṣṭān yavān bhakṣayataḥ prayogācchuṣkāṃśca saktūnna bhavanti mehāḥ|
śvitraṃ ca kṛcchraṃ kaphajaṃ ca kuṣṭhaṃ tathaiva mudgāmalakaprayogān||
6.6.49 |  saṃtarpaṇottheṣu gadeṣu yogā medasvināṃ ye ca mayopadiṣṭāḥ|
virūkṣaṇārthaṃ kaphapittajeṣu siddhāḥ prameheṣvapi te prayojyāḥ||
6.6.50 |  vyāyāmayogairvividhaiḥ pragāḍhairudvartanaiḥ snānajalāvasekaiḥ|
sevyatvagelānurucandanādyair-*vilepanaiścāśu na santi mehāḥ||
6.6.51 |  kledaśca medaśca kaphaśca vṛddhaḥ pramehahetuḥ prasamīkṣya tasmāt|
vaidyena pūrvaṃ kaphapittajeṣu meheṣu kāryāṇyapatarpaṇāni||
6.6.52 |  yā vātamehān prati pūrvamuktā vātolbaṇānāṃ vihitā kriyā sā|
vāyurhi meheṣvatikarśitānāṃ kupyatyasādhyān prati nāsti cintā||
6.6.53 |  yairhetubhirye prabhavanti mehāsteṣu prameheṣu na te nibevyāḥ|
hetorasevā vihitā yathaiva jātasya rogasya bhaveccikitsā||
6.6.54 |  hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya hi pūrvarūpaiḥ|
yo mūtrayettaṃ na vadet pramehaṃ raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaḥ||
6.6.55 |  dṛṣṭvā pramehaṃ madhuraṃ sapicchaṃ madhūpamaṃ syāddvividho vicāraḥ|
kṣīṇeṣu doṣesvanilātmakaḥ syāt saṃtarpaṇādvā kaphasaṃbhavaḥ syāt||
6.6.56 |  sapūrvarūpāḥ kaphapittamehāḥ krameṇa ye vātakṛtāśca mehāḥ|
sādhyā na te, pittakṛtāstu yāpyāḥ, sādhyāstu medo yadi na praduṣṭam||
6.6.57 |  jātaḥ pramehī madhumehino vā na sādhya uktaḥ sa hi bījadoṣāt|
ye cāpi kecit kulajā vikārā bhavanti tāṃśca pravadantyasādhyān||
6.6.58 |  pramehiṇāṃ yāḥ piḍakā mayoktā rogādhikāre pṛthageva sapta|
tāḥ śalyavidbhiḥ kuśalaiścikitsyāḥ śastreṇa saṃśodhanaropaṇaiśca||
6.6.59 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
heturdoso dūṣyaṃ mehānāṃ sādhyatānurūpaśca|
mehī *dvividhastrividhaṃ bhiṣagjitamatikṣapaṇadoṣaḥ||
6.6.60 |  ādyā yāvānnavikṛtirmanthā mehāpahāḥ kaṣāyāśca|
tailaghṛtalehayogā bhakṣyāḥ pravarāsavāḥ siddhāḥ||
6.6.61 |  vyāyāmavidhirvividhaḥ snānānyudvartanāni gandhāśca|
mehānāṃ praśamārthaṃ cikitsite diṣṭametāvat||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsitasthāne pramehacikitsitaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6 | |

saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.7.1 |  athātaḥ kuṣṭhacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.7.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.7.3 |  hetuṃ dravyaṃ liṅgaṃ kuṣṭhānāmāśrayaṃ praśamanaṃ ca|
śṛṇvagniveśa! samyagviśeṣataḥ sparśanaghnānām||
6.7.4 |  virodhīnyannapānāni dravyasvigdhagurūṇi ca|
bhajatāmāgatāṃ chardiṃ vegāṃścānyānpratighnatām||
6.7.5 |  vyāyāmamatisaṃtāpamatibhuktvopasevinām|
śītoṣṇalaṅghanāhārān kramaṃ muktvā niṣeviṇām||
6.7.6 |  gharmaśramabhayārtānāṃ drutaṃ śītāmbusevinām|
ajīrṇādhyaśināṃ caiva pañcakarmāpacāriṇām||
6.7.7 |  navānnadadhimatsyātilavaṇāmlaniṣeviṇām|
māṣamūlakapiṣṭānnatilakṣīraguḍāśinām||
6.7.8 |  vyavāyaṃ cāpyajīrṇe 'nne nidrāṃ ca bhajatāṃ divā|
viprān gurūn dharṣayatāṃ pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām||
6.7.9 |  vātādayastrayo duṣṭāstvagraktaṃ māṃsamambu ca|
dūṣayanti sa kuṣṭhānāṃ saptako dravyasaṃgrahaḥ||
6.7.10 |  ataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante sapta caikādaśaiva ca|
na caikadoṣajaṃ kiñcit kuṣṭhaṃ samupalabhyate||
6.7.11 |  sparśājñatvamatisvedo na vā vaivarṇyamunnatiḥ|
koṭhānāṃ lomaharṣaśca kaṇḍūstodaḥ śramaḥ klamaḥ||
6.7.12 |  vraṇānāmadhikaṃ śūlaṃ śīghrotpattiścirasthitiḥ|
*dāhaḥ suptāṅgatā ceti kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamagrajam||
6.7.13 |  ata ūrdhvamaṣṭādaśānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ kapālodumbaramaṇḍalarṣyajihvapuṇḍarīkasidhmakākaṇakaikakuṣṭhacarmākhyakiṭimavipādikālasakadadrucarmadalapāmāviskoṭakaśatārurvicarcikānāṃ lakṣaṇānyupadekṣyāmaḥ||
6.7.14 |  kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ yadrūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu|
kāpālaṃ todabahulaṃ tatkuṣṭhaṃ viṣamaṃ smṛtam||
6.7.15 |  dāhakaṇḍūrujārāgaparītaṃ lomapiñjaram|
udumbaraphalābhāsaṃ kuṣṭhamaudumbaraṃ viduḥ||
6.7.16 |  śvetaṃ raktaṃ sthiraṃ styānaṃ snigdhamutsannamaṇḍalam|
kṛcchramanyonyasaṃsaktaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalamucyate||
6.7.17 |  karkaśaṃ raktaparyantamantaḥ śyāvaṃ savedanam|
yadṛṣyajihvāsaṃsthānamṛṣyajihvaṃ taducyate||
6.7.18 |  saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ puṇḍarīkadalopamam|
sotsedhaṃ ca sadāhaṃ ca puṇḍarīkaṃ taducyate||
6.7.19 |  śvetaṃ tāmraṃ tanu ca *yadrajo ghṛṣṭaṃ vimuñcati|
alābūpuṣpavarṇaṃ tat sidhmaṃ prāyeṇa corasi||
6.7.20 |  yat kākaṇantikāvarṇamapākaṃ tīvravedanam|
tridoṣaliṅgaṃ tat kuṣṭhaṃ kākaṇaṃ naiva sidhyati||
iti saptamahākuṣṭhāni|
6.7.21 |  asvedanaṃ mahāvāstu yanmatsyaśakalopamam|
tadekakuṣṭhaṃ, carmākhyaṃ bahalaṃ hasticarmavat||
6.7.22 |  śyāvaṃ kiṇakharasparśaṃ paruṣaṃ kiṭimaṃ smṛtam|
vaipādikaṃ pāṇipādasphuṭanaṃ tīvravedanam||
6.7.23 |  kaṇḍūmadbhiḥ sarāgaiśca gaṇḍairalasakaṃ citam|
sakaṇḍūrāgapiḍakaṃ dadrumṇḍalamudgatam||
6.7.24 |  *raktaṃ sakaṇḍu sasphoṭaṃ sarugdalati cāpi yat|
taccarmadalamākhyātaṃ saṃsparśāsahamucyate||
6.7.25 |  pāmā śvetāruṇaśyāvāḥ kaṇḍūlāḥ piḍakā bhṛśam|
sphoṭāḥ śvetāruṇābhāso visphoṭāḥ syustanutvacaḥ||
6.7.26 |  raktaṃ śyāvaṃ sadāhārti śatāruḥ syādbahuvraṇam|
sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā śyāvā bahusrāvā vicarcikā||
ityekādśa kṣudrakuṣṭhāni|
6.7.27 |  vāte 'dhikatare kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kaphe|
pitte tvaudumbaraṃ vidyāt kākaṇaṃ tu tridoṣajam||
6.7.28 |  vātapitte śleṣmapitte vātaśleṣmaṇi cādhike|
ṛṣyajihvaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ sidhmakuṣṭhaṃ ca jāyate||
6.7.29 |  carmākhyamekakuṣṭhaṃ ca kiṭimaṃ savipādikam|
kuṣṭhaṃ cālasakaṃ jñeyaṃ prāyo vātakaphādhikam||
6.7.30 |  pāmā śatārurvisphoṭaṃ dadruścarmadalaṃ tathā|
pittaśleṣmādhikaṃ prāyaḥ kaphaprāyā vicarcikā||
6.7.31 |  sarvaṃ tridoṣajaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ doṣāṇāṃ tu balābalam|
yathāsvairlakṣaṇairbuddhvā kuṣṭhānāṃ kriyate kriyā||
6.7.32 |  doṣasya yasya paśyet kuṣṭheṣu viśeṣaliṅgamudriktam|
tasyaiva śamaṃ kuryāttataḥ paraṃ cānubandhasya||
6.7.33 |  kuṣṭhaviśeṣairdoṣā doṣaviśeṣaiḥ punaśca kuṣṭhāni|
jñāyante *tairheturhetustāṃśca prakāśayati||
6.7.34 |  raukṣyaṃ śoṣastodaḥ śūlaṃ saṃkocanaṃ tathā+āyāmaḥ|
pāruṣyaṃ kharabhāvo harṣaḥ śyāvāruṇatvaṃ ca||
6.7.35 |  kuṣṭheṣu vātaliṅgaṃ, dāho rāgaḥ parisravaḥ pākaḥ|
visro gandhaḥ kledastathā 'ṅgapatanaṃ ca pittakṛtam||
6.7.36 |  śvaityaṃ śaityaṃ kaṇḍūḥ sthairyaṃ cotsedhagauravasnehāḥ|
kuṣṭheṣu tu kaphaliṅgaṃ jantubhirabhirabhibhakṣaṇaṃ kledaḥ||
6.7.37 |  sarvairliṅgairyuktaṃ matimān vivarjayedbalam|
tṛṣṇādāhaparītaṃ śāntāgniṃ jantubhirjagdham||
6.7.38 |  vātakaphaprabalaṃ yadyadekadoṣolbaṇaṃ na tat kṛcchram|
kaphapitta-vātapittaprabalāni tu kṛcchrasādhyāni||
6.7.39 |  vātottareṣu sarpirvamanaṃ śleṣmottareṣu kuṣṭheṣu|
pittottareṣu mokṣo raktasya virecanaṃ cāgre||
6.7.40 |  vamanavirecanayogāḥ kalpoktāḥ kuṣṭināṃ prayoktavyāḥ|
pracchanamalpe kuṣṭhe mahati ca śastaṃ sirāvyadhanam||
6.7.41 |  bahudoṣaḥ saṃśodhyaḥ kuṣṭhī bahuśo 'nurakṣatā prāṇān|
doṣe hyatimātrahṛte vāyurhanyādabalamāśu||
6.7.42 |  snehasya pānamiṣṭaṃ śuddhe koṣṭhe pravāhite rakte|
vāyurhi śuddhakoṣṭhaṃ kuṣṭhinamabalaṃ viśati śīghram||
6.7.43 |  doṣotkliṣṭe hṛdaye vāmyaḥ kuṣṭheṣu cordhvabhāgeṣu|
kuṭajaphalamadanamadhukaiḥ sapaṭolairnimbarasayuktaiḥ||
6.7.44 |  śītarasaḥ pakvaraso madhūni madhukaṃ ca vamanāni|
kuṣṭheṣu trivṛtā dantī triphalā ca virecane śastā||
6.7.45 |  sauvīrakaṃ tuṣodakamāloḍanamāsavāśca sīdhūni|
śaṃsantyadhoharāṇāṃ yathāvirekaṃ kramaśceṣṭaḥ||
6.7.46 |  dārvībṛhatīsevyaiḥ paṭolapicumardanakṛtamālaiḥ|
sasnehairāsthāpyaḥ kuṣṭhī sakaliṅgayavamustaiḥ||
6.7.47 |  vātolbaṇaṃ viriktaṃ nirūḍhamanuvāsanārhamālakṣya|
phalamadhukanimbakuṭajaiḥ sapaṭolaiḥ sādhayetsneham||
6.7.48 |  saindhavadantīmaricaṃ phaṇijjhakaḥ pippalī karañjaphalam|
nasyaṃ syātsaviḍaṅgaṃ krimikuṣṭha-*kaphaprakopaghnam||
6.7.49 |  vairecanikairdhūmaiḥ ślokasthāneritaiḥ praśāmyanti|
kṛmayaḥ kuṣṭhakilāsāḥ prayojitairuttamāṅgasthāḥ||
6.7.50 |  sthirakaṭhinamaṇḍalānāṃ svinnānāṃ prastarapraṇāḍībhiḥ|
kūrcairvighaṭṭitānāṃ raktotkleśo 'panetavyaḥ||
6.7.51 |  ānūpavārijānāṃ māṃsānāṃ poṭṭalaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiśca|
*svinnotsannaṃ vilikhet kuṣṭhaṃ tīkṣṇena śastreṇa||
6.7.52 |  rudhirāgamārthamathavā *śṛṅgālābūni yojayet kuṣṭhe|
pracchitamalpaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ virecayedvā jalaukobhiḥ||
6.7.53 |  ye lepāḥ kuṣṭhānāṃ yujyante nirhṛtāsradoṣāṇām|
saṃśodhitāśayānāṃ sadyaḥ siddhirbhavetteṣām||
6.7.54 |  yeṣu na śastraṃ kramate sparśendriyanāśanāni yāni syuḥ|
teṣu nipātyaḥ kṣāro raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya||
6.7.55 |  pāṣāṇakaṭhinaparuṣe supte kuṣṭhe sthire purāṇe ca|
pītāgadasya kāryo viṣaiḥ pradeho 'gadaiścānu||
6.7.56 |  stabdhāni suptasuptānyasvedanakaṇḍulāni kuṣṭhāni|
kūrcairdantītrivṛtākaravīrakarañjakuṭajānām||
6.7.57 |  jātyarkanimbajairvā patraiḥ śastraiḥ samudraphenairvā|
ghṛṣṭāni gomayairvā tataḥ pradehaiḥ pradehyāni||
6.7.58 |  mārutakaphakuṣṭhaghnaṃ karmoktaṃ pittakuṣṭhināṃ kāryam|
kaphapittaraktaharaṇaṃ tiktakaṣāyaiḥ praśamanaṃ ca||
6.7.59 |  sarpīṣi tiktakāni ca *yaccānyadraktapittanut karma|
bāhyābhyantaramagryaṃ tat kāryaṃ pittakuṣṭheṣu||
6.7.60 |  doṣādhikyavibhāgādityetat karma kuṣṭhanut proktam|
vakṣyāmi kuṣṭhaśamanaṃ prāyastvagdoṣasāmānyāt||
6.7.61 |  dārvī rasāñjanaṃ vā gomūtreṇa prabādhate kuṣṭham|
abhayā prayojitā vā māsaṃ savyoṣaguḍatailā||
6.7.62 |  mūlaṃ paṭolasya tathā gavākṣyāḥ pṛthak palāṃśaṃ *triphalātvacaśca|
syāttrāyamāṇā kaṭurohiṇī ca bhāgārdhikā nāgarapādayuktā||
6.7.63 |  palaṃ tathaiṣāṃ saha cūrṇitānāṃ jale śṛtaṃ doṣaharaṃ pibennā|
jīrṇe rasairdhanvamṛgadvijānāṃ purāṇaśālyodanamādadīta||
6.7.64 |  kuṣṭhāni śophaṃ grahaṇīpradoṣamarśāsi kṛcchrāṇi halīmakaṃ ca|
ṣaḍrātrayogena nihanti caiṣa hṛdbastiśūlaṃ viṣamajvaraṃ ca||
6.7.65 |  mustaṃ vyoṣaṃ triphalā mañjiṣṭhā dāru pañcamūlyau dve|
saptacchadanimbatvak saviśālaścitrako mūrvā||
6.7.66 |  cūrṇaṃ tarpaṇabhāgairnavabhiḥ saṃyojitaṃ *samadhvājyam|
siddhaṃ kuṣṭhanibarhaṇametat prāyogikaṃ bhakṣyam||
6.7.67 |  śvayathuṃ sapāṇḍurogaṃ śvitraṃ grahaṇīpradoṣamarśāṃsi|
braghnabhagandarapiḍakākaṇḍūkoṭhāṃśca vinihanti||
iti mustādicūrṇam|
6.7.68 |  triphalātiviṣākaṭukānimbakaliṅgakavacāpaṭolānām|
māgadhikārajanīdvayapadmakamūrvāviśālānām||
6.7.69 |  bhūnimbapalāśānāṃ dadyāddvipalaṃ tatastrivṛddviguṇā|
tasyāśca punarbrāhmī taccūrṇaṃ suptinut paramam||
6.7.70 |  *lelītakaprayogo rasena jātyāḥ samākṣikaḥ paramaḥ|
saptadaśakuṣṭhaghātī mākṣikadhātuśca mūtreṇa||
6.7.71 |  *śreṣṭhaṃ gandhakayogāt suvarṇamākṣikaprayogādvā|
sarvavyādhinibarhaṇamadyāt kuṣṭhī rasaṃ ca nigṛhītam||
6.7.72 |  vajraśilājatusahitaṃ sahitaṃ vā yogarājena|
sarvavyādhipraśamanamadyātkuṣṭhī nigṛhya nityaṃ ca||
6.7.73 |  khadirasuradārusāraṃ śrapayitvā tadrasena toyārthaḥ|
kṣaudraprasthe kāryaḥ kārye te cāṣṭapalike ca||
6.7.74 |  tatrāyaścūrṇānāmaṣṭapalaṃ prakṣipettathā 'mūni|
triphalaile tvaṅnaricaṃ patraṃ kanakaṃ ca karṣāṃśam||
6.7.75 |  matsyaṇḍikā madhusamā tanmāsaṃ jātamāyase bhāṇḍe|
madhvāsavamācarataḥ kuṣṭhakilāse śamaṃ yātaḥ||
iti madhvāsavaḥ|
6.7.76 |  khadirakaṣāyadroṇaṃ kumbhe ghṛtabhāvite samāvāpya|
dravyāṇi cūrṇitāni ca ṣaṭpalikānyatra deyāni||
6.7.77 |  triphalāvyoṣaviḍaṅgarajanīmustāṭarūṣakendrayavāḥ|
sauvarṇī ca tathā tvak chinnaruhā ceti tanmāsam||
6.7.78 |  nidadhīta dhānyamadhye prātaḥ prātaḥ pibettato yuktyā|
māsena mahākuṣṭhaṃ hantyevālpaṃ tu pakṣeṇa||
6.7.79 |  arśaḥśvāsabhagandarakāsakilāsapramehaśoṣāṃśca|
nā bhavati kanakavarṇaḥ pītvā 'riṣṭaṃ kanakabindum||
iti kanakabindvariṣṭam|
6.7.80 |  kuṣṭheṣvanilakaphakṛteṣvevaṃ peyastathā 'pi paitteṣu|
kṛtamālakvāthaścāpyeṣa viśeṣāt kaphakṛteṣu||
6.7.81 |  triphalāsavaśca gauḍaḥ sacitrakaḥ kuṣṭharogavinihantā|
kramukadaśamūladantīvarāṅgamadhuyogasaṃyuktaḥ||
6.7.82 |  laghūni cānnāni hitāni vidyāt kuṣṭheṣu śākāni ca tiktakāni|
bhallātakaiḥ satriphalaiḥ sanimbairyuktāni cānnāni ghṛtāni caiva||
6.7.83 |  purāṇadhānyānyatha jāṅgalāni māṃsāni mudgāśca paṭolayuktāḥ|
śastā, na gurvamlapayodadhīni nānūpamatsyā na guḍastilāśca||
6.7.84 |  elā kuṣṭhaṃ dārvī śatapuṣpā citrako viḍaṅgaśca|
kuṣṭhālepanamiṣṭaṃ rasāñjanaṃ cābhayā caiva||
6.7.85 |  citrakamelāṃ *bimbīṃ vṛṣakaṃ trivṛdarkanāgarakam|
cūrṇīkṛtamaṣṭāhaṃ bhāvayitavyaṃ palāśasya||
6.7.86 |  kṣāreṇa gavāṃ mūtrasrutena tenāsya maṇḍalānyāśu|
bhidyante vilayanti ca liptānyarkābhitaptāni||
6.7.87 |  māṃsī maricaṃ lavaṇaṃ rajanī tagaraṃ sudhā gṛhāddhūmaḥ|
mūtraṃ *pittaṃ kṣāraḥ pālāśaḥ kuṣṭhahā lepaḥ||
6.7.88 |  trapu sīsamayaścūrṇaṃ maṇḍalanut phalgucitrakau bṛhatī|
godhārasaḥ salavaṇo dāru ca mūtraṃ ca maṇḍalanut||
6.7.89 |  kadalīpalāśapāṭaliniculakṣārāmbhasā prasannena|
māṃseṣu toyakāryaṃ kāryaṃ piṣṭe ca *kiṇve ca||
6.7.90 |  tairmedakaḥ sujātaḥ kiṇvairjanitaṃ pralepanaṃ śastam|
maṇḍalakuṣṭhavināśanamātapasaṃsthaṃ kṛmighnaṃ ca||
6.7.91 |  mustaṃ madanaṃ triphalā karañja āragvadhakaliṅgayavāḥ|
dārvī sasaptaparṇā snānaṃ siddhārhakaṃ nāma||
6.7.92 |  eṣa kaṣāyo vamanaṃ virecanaṃ varṇakastathodgharṣaḥ|
tvagdoṣakuṣṭhaśophaprabādhanaḥ pāṇḍurogaghnaḥ||
6.7.93 |  kuṣṭhaṃ karañjabījānyeḍagajaḥ kuṣṭhasūdano lepaḥ|
prapunnāḍabījasaindhavarasāñjanakapitthalodhrāśca||
6.7.94 |  śvetakaravīramūlaṃ kuṭajakarañjayoḥ phalaṃ tvaco dārvyāḥ|
sumanaḥpravālayukto lepaḥ kuṣṭhāpahaḥ siddhaḥ||
6.7.95 |  lodhrasya dhātakīnāṃ vatsakabījasya naktamālasya|
kalkaśca mālatīnāṃ kuṣṭheṣūnmardanālepau||
6.7.96 |  śairīṣī tvak puṣpaṃ kārpāsyā rājavṛkṣapatrāṇi|
piṣṭā ca kākamācī caturvidhaḥ kuṣṭhanullepaḥ||
iti lepāḥ|
6.7.97 |  dārvyā rasāñjanasya ca nimbapaṭolasya khadirasārasya|
āragvadhavṛkṣakayostriphalāyāḥ saptaparṇasya||
6.7.98 |  iti ṣaṭ kaṣāyayogāḥ kuṣṭhaghnāḥ saptamaśca tiniśasya|
snāne pāne ca hitāstathā 'ṣṭhamaścāśvamārasya||
6.7.99 |  ālepanaṃ pragharṣaṇamavacūrṇanameta eva ca kaṣāyāḥ|
tailaghṛtapākayoge ceṣyante kuṣṭhaśāntyartham||
6.7.100 |  triphalā nimbapaṭolaṃ mañjiṣṭhā rohiṇī vacā rajanī|
eṣakaṣāyo 'bhyasto nihanti kaphapittajaṃ kuṣṭham||
6.7.101 |  etaireva ca sarpiḥ siddhaṃ vātolbaṇaṃ jayati kuṣṭham|
eṣa ca kalpo diṣṭhaḥ khadirāsanadārunimbānām||
6.7.102 |  kuṣṭhārkatutthakaṭphalamūlakabījāni rohiṇī kaṭukā|
kuṭajaphalotpalamustaṃ bṛhatīkaravīrakāsīsam||
6.7.103 |  eḍagajanimbapāṭhā kūrālabhā citrako viḍaṅgaśca|
tiktālābukabījaṃ kampillakasarṣapau vacā dārvī||
6.7.104 |  etaistailaṃ siddhaṃ kuṣṭhaghnaṃ yoga eṣa cālepaḥ|
udvartanaṃ pragharṣaṇamavacūrṇanameṣa eveṣṭhaḥ||
6.7.105 |  śvetakaravīrakaraso gomūtraṃ citrako viḍaṅgaśca|
kuṣṭheṣu tailayogaḥ siddho 'yaṃ saṃmato bhiṣajām||
iti śvetakaravīrādyaṃ tailam|
6.7.106 |  śvetakaravīrapallavamūlatvagvatsako viḍaṅgaśca|
kuṣṭhārkamūlasarṣapaśigrutvagrohiṇī kaṭukā||
6.7.107 |  etaistailaṃ siddhaṃ kalkaiḥ pādāṃśikairgavāṃ mūtram|
dattvā tailacaturguṇamabhyaṅgāt kuṣṭhakaṇḍūghnam||
iti śvetakaravīrapallavādyaṃ tailam|
6.7.108 |  tiktālābukabījaṃ dve tutthe rocanā haridre dve|
bṛhatīphalameraṇḍaḥ saviśālaścitrako mūrvā||
6.7.109 |  kāsīsahiṅguśigrutryūṣaṇasuradārutumburuviḍaṅgam|
lāṅgalakaṃ kuṭajatvak kaṭukākhyā rohiṇī caiva||
6.7.110 |  sarṣapatailaṃ kalkairetairmūtre caturguṇe sādhyam|
kaṇḍūkuṣṭhavināśanamabhyaṅgānmārutakaphahantṛ||
iti tiktekṣvākvāditailam|
6.7.111 |  kanakakṣīrī śailā bhārgī dantyāḥ phalāni mūlaṃ ca|
jātīpravālasarṣapalaśunaviḍaṅgaṃ karañjatvak||
6.7.112 |  saptacchadārkapallavamūlatvaṅnambacitrakāsphotāḥ|
guñjairaṇḍaṃ bṛhatīmūlakasurasārjakaphalāni||
6.7.113 |  *kuṣṭhaṃ pāṭhā mustaṃ tumburumūrvāvacāḥ saṣaḍgranthāḥ|
eḍagajakuṭajaśigrutryūṣaṇabhallātakakṣavakāḥ||
6.7.114 |  haritālamavākpuṣpī tutthaṃ kampillako 'mṛtāsaṃjñaḥ|
saurāṣṭrī kāsīsaṃ dārvītvak sarjikālavaṇam||
6.7.115 |  kalkairetaistailaṃ karavīrakamūlapallavakaṣāye|
sārṣapamathavā tailaṃ gomūtracaturguṇaṃ sādhyam||
6.7.116 |  sthāpyaṃ kaṭukālābuni tatsiddhaṃ tena maṇḍalānyāśu|
bhindyādbhiṣagabhyaṅgātkṛmīṃśca kaṇḍūṃ ca vinihanyāt||
iti kanakakṣīrītailam|
6.7.117 |  kuṣṭhaṃ tamālapatraṃ maricaṃ samanaḥśilaṃ sakāsīsam|
tailena yuktamuṣitaṃ saptāhaṃ bhājane tāmre||
6.7.118 |  tenāliptaṃ sidhmaṃ *saptāhādvyeti tiṣṭhato gharme|
māsānnavaṃ kilāsaṃ snānaṃ muktvā viśuddhatanoḥ||
iti sidhme lepaḥ|
6.7.119 |  sarṣapakarañjakoṣātakīnāṃ tailānyatheṅgudīnāṃ ca|
kuṣṭheṣu hitānyāhustailaṃ yacāpi khadirasārasya||
6.7.120 |  jīvantī mañjiṣṭhā dārvī kampillakaḥ payastuttham|
eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ siddhaḥ ca sarjarasaḥ||
6.7.121 |  deyaḥ samadhūcchiṣṭo vipādikā tena śāmyate 'bhyaktā|
carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭimaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śāmyatyalasakaṃ ca||
iti vipādikāharaghṛtataile|
6.7.122 |  *kiṇvaṃ varāharudhiraṃ pṛthvīkā saindhavaṃ ca lepaḥ syāt|
lepo yojyaḥ kustumburūṇi kuṣṭhaṃ ca maṇḍalanut||
6.7.123 |  pūtīkadārujaṭilāḥ pakvasurā kṣaudramudgaparṇyau ca|
lepaḥ sakākanāso maṇḍalakuṣṭhāpahaḥ siddhaḥ||
6.7.124 |  citrakaśobhāñjanakau guḍūcyapāmārgadevadārūṇi|
khadiro dhavaścalepaḥ śyāmā dantī dravantī ca||
6.7.125 |  lākṣārasāñjanailāḥ punarnavā ceti kuṣṭhino lepāḥ|
dadhimaṇḍayutāḥ sarve deyāḥ ṣaṇmārutakaphakuṣṭhaghnāḥ||
6.7.126 |  eḍagajakuṣṭhasindhavasauvīrakasarṣapaiḥ kṛmighnaiśca|
kṛmikuṣṭhamaṇḍalākhyaṃ dadrūkuṣṭhaṃ ca śamamupaiti||
6.7.127 |  eḍagajaḥ sarjaraso mūlakabījaṃ ca sidhmakuṣṭhānām|
kāñjikayuktaṃ tu pṛthaṅnatamidamudvartanaṃ lepāḥ||
6.7.128 |  vāsā triphalā pāne snāne codvartane pralepe ca|
bṛhatīsevyapaṭolāḥ sasārivā rohiṇī caiva||
6.7.129 |  khadirāvaghātakakubharohītakalodhrakuṭajadhavanimbāḥ|
saptacchadakaravīrāḥ śasyante snānapāneṣu||
6.7.130 |  jalavāpyalohakeśarapatraplavacandanaṃ mṛṇālāni|
bhāgottarāṇi siddhaṃ pralepanaṃ pittakaphakuṣṭhe||
6.7.131 |  yaṣṭyāhvalodhrapadmakapaṭolapicumardacandanarasāśca|
snāne pāne ca hitāḥ suśītalāḥ pittakuṣṭhibhyaḥ||
6.7.132 |  ālepanaṃ priyaṅgurhareṇukā vatsakasya ca phalāni|
sātiviṣā ca sasevyā sacandanā rohiṇī kaṭukā||
6.7.133 |  tiktaghṛtairdhautaghṛtairabhyaṅgo dahyamānakuṣṭheṣu|
tailaiścandanamadhukaprapauṇḍarīkotpalayutaiśca||
6.7.134 |  klede prapatati cāṅge dāhe visphoṭake sacarmadale|
śītāḥ pradehasekā vyadho vireko ghṛtaṃ tiktam||
6.7.135 |  khadiraghṛtaṃ nimbaghṛtaṃ dārvīghṛtamuttamaṃ paṭolaghṛtam|
kuṣṭheṣu raktapittaprabaleṣu bhiṣagjitaṃ siddham||
6.7.136 |  triphalātvaco 'rdhapalikāḥ paṭolapatraṃ ca kārṣikāḥ śeṣāḥ|
kaṭurohiṇī sanimbā yaṣṭyāhvā trāyamāṇā ca||
6.7.137 |  eṣa kaṣāyaḥ sādhyo dattvā dvipalaṃ masūravidalānām|
salilāḍhake 'ṣṭabhage śeṣe pūto raso grāhyaḥ||
6.7.138 |  te *ca kaṣāye 'ṣṭapale catuṣpalaṃ sarpiṣaśca paktavyam|
yāvatsyādaṣṭapalaṃ śeṣaṃ peyaṃ tataḥ koṣṇam||
6.7.139 |  tadvātapittakuṣṭhaṃ vīsarpaṃ vātaśoṇitaṃ prabalam|
jvaradāhagulmavidradhivibhramavisphoṭakān hanti||
6.7.140 |  nimbapaṭolaṃ dārvīṃ durālabhāṃ tiktarohiṇīṃ triphalām|
kuryādardhadalāṃśaṃ parpaṭakaṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca||
6.7.141 |  salilāḍhakasiddhānāṃ rase 'ṣṭabhāgasthite kṣipet pūte|
candanakirātatiktakamāgadhikāstrāyamāṇāṃ ca||
6.7.142 |  mustaṃ vatsakabījaṃ kalkīkṛtyārdhakārṣikān bhāgān|
navasarpiṣaśca *ṣaṭpalametatsiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ peyam||
6.7.143 |  kuṣṭhajvaragulmārśograhaṇīpāṇḍvāmayaśvayathuhāri|
pāmāvisarpapiḍakākaṇḍūmadagaṇḍanutsiddham||
iti tiktaṣaṭpalakaṃ ghṛtam|
6.7.144 |  saptacchadaṃ prativiṣāṃ śampākaṃ tiktarohiṇīṃ pāṭhām|
mustamuśīraṃ triphalāṃ paṭolapicumardaparpaṭakam||
6.7.145 |  dhanvayavāsaṃ candanamupakulyāṃ padmakaṃ haridre dve|
ṣaḍgranthāṃ saviśālāṃ śatāvarīṃ sārive cobhe||
6.7.146 |  vatsakabījaṃ *yāsaṃ mūrvāmamṛtāṃ kirātatiktaṃ ca|
kalkān kuryānmatimānyaṣṭyāhvaṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca||
6.7.147 |  *kalkaścāturbhāgo jalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ raso 'mṛtaphalānām|
dviguṇo ghṛtātpradeyastatsarpiḥ pāyayetsiddham||
6.7.148 |  kuṣṭhāni raktapittaprabalānyarśāṃsi raktavāhīni|
*vīsarpamamlapittaṃ vātāsṛk pāṇḍarogaṃ ca||
6.7.149 |  visphoṭakānsapāmānunmādaṃ kāmalāṃ jvaraṃ kaṇḍūm|
hṛdrogagulmapiḍakā asṛgdaraṃ gaṇḍamālāṃ ca||
6.7.150 |  hanyādetat sarpiḥ pītaṃ kāle yathābalaṃ sadyaḥ|
yogaśatairapyajitānmahāvikārānmahātiktam||
iti mahātiktakaṃ ghṛtam|
6.7.151 |  deṣe hṛte 'panīte rakte bāhyāntare kṛte *śamane|
snehe ca kālayukte na kuṣṭham-*anuvartate sādhyam||
6.7.152 |  khadirasya tulāḥ pañca śiṃśapāsanayostule|
tulārdhāḥ sarva evaite karañjāriṣṭavetasāḥ||
6.7.153 |  parpaṭaḥ kuṭajaścaiva vṛṣaḥ kṛmiharastathā|
haridre kṛtamālaśca guḍūcī triphalā trivṛt||
6.7.154 |  saptaparṇaśca saṃkṣuṇṇā daśadroṇeṣu vāriṇaḥ|
aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu kaṣāyamavatārayet||
6.7.155 |  dhātrīrasaṃ ca tulyāṃśaṃ sarpiṣaścāḍhakaṃ pacet|
mahātiktakakalkaistu yathoktaiḥ palasaṃmitaiḥ||
6.7.156 |  nihanti sarvakuṣṭhāni pānābhyaṅganiṣevaṇāt|
mahākhadiramityetat paraṃ kuṣṭhavikāranut||
iti mahākhadiraṃ ghṛtam|
6.7.157 |  prapatatasu lasīkāprasruteṣu gātreṣu jantujagdheṣu|
mātraṃ nimbaviḍaṅge snānaṃ pānaṃ pradehaśca||
6.7.158 |  vṛṣakuṭajasaptaparṇāḥ karavīrakarañjanimbakhadirāśca|
snāne pāne lepe krimikuṣṭhanudaḥ sagomūtrāḥ||
6.7.159 |  pānāhāravidhāne prasecane dhūpane pradehe ca|
kṛmināśanaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate kuṣṭhahā khadiraḥ||
6.7.160 |  eḍagajaḥ saviḍaṅgo mūlānyāragvadhasya kuṣṭhānām|
uddālanaṃ śvadantā gośvavarāhoṣṭradantāśca||
6.7.161 |  eḍagajaḥ saviḍaṅgo dve ca niśe rājavṛkṣamūlaṃ ca|
kuṣṭhoddālanamagryaṃ sapippalīpākalaṃ yojyam||
6.7.162 |  śvitrāṇāṃ *saviśeṣaṃ yoktavyaṃ sarvato viśuddhānām|
śvitre sraṃsanamagryaṃ malapūrasa iṣyate saguḍaḥ||
6.7.163 |  taṃ pītvā susnigdho yathābalaṃ sūryapādasaṃtāpam|
saṃseveta viriktastryahaṃ pipāsuḥ pibet peyām||
6.7.164 |  śvitre 'ṅge ye sphoṭā jāyante kaṇṭakena tānbhindyāt|
sphoṭeṣu visruteṣu prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet pakṣam||
6.7.165 |  malapūmasanaṃ priyaṅguṃ śatapuṣpāṃ cāmbhasā samutkkāthya|
pālāśaṃ vā kṣāraṃ yathābalaṃ phāṇitopetam||
6.7.166 |  yaccānyat kuṣṭhaghnaṃ śvitrāṇāṃ sarvameva tacchastam|
khadirodakasaṃyuktaṃ khadirodakapānamagryaṃ vā||
6.7.167 |  samanaḥśilaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ kāsīsaṃ rocanāṃ kanakapuṣpīm|
śvitrāṇāṃ praśamāarthaṃ sasaindhavaṃ lepanaṃ dadyāt||
6.7.168 |  kadalīkṣārayutaṃ vā kharāsthi dagdhaṃ gavāṃ rudhirayuktam|
hastimadādhyuṣitaṃ vā mālatyāḥ korakakṣāram||
6.7.169 |  nīlotpalaṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ hastimūtrapiṣṭaṃ vā|
mūlakabījāvalgujalepaḥ piṣṭo gavāṃ mūtre||
6.7.170 |  kākodumbarikā vā sāvalgujacitrakā gavāṃ mūtre|
piṣṭā manaḥśilā vā saṃyuktā barhipittena||
6.7.171 |  lepaḥ kilāsahantā bījānyāvalgujāni lākṣā ca|
gopittamañjane dve pippalyaḥ kālaloharajaḥ||
6.7.172 |  śuddhyā śoṇitamokṣairvirūkṣaṇaiśca saktūnām|
śvitraṃ kasyacideva praṇaśyati kṣīṇapāpasya||
6.7.173 |  dāruṇaṃ *cāruṇaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ nāmabhistribhiḥ|
vijñeyaṃ trividhaṃ *tacca tridoṣaṃ prāyaśaśca tat||
6.7.174 |  doṣe raktāśrite raktaṃ tāmraṃ māṃsasamāśrite|
śvetaṃ medaḥśrite śvitraṃ guru taccottarottaram||
6.7.175 |  yat parasparato 'bhinnaṃ bahu yadraktalomavat|
yacca varṣagaṇotpannaṃ tacchvitraṃ naiva sidhyati||
6.7.176 |  araktaloma tanu yat pāṇḍu nāticirotthitam|
madhyāvakāśe cocchūnaṃ śvitraṃ tatsādhyamucyate||
6.7.177 |  vacāṃsyatathyāni kṛtaghnabhāvo nindā *surāṇāṃ gurudharṣaṇaṃ ca|
pāpakriyā pūrvakṛtaṃ ca karma hetuḥ kilāsasya virodhi cānnam||
6.7.178 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
heturdravyaṃ liṅgaṃ vividhaṃ ye yeṣu cādhikā doṣāḥ|
kuṣṭheṣu doṣaliṅgaṃ samāsato doṣanirdeśaḥ||
6.7.179 |  sādhyamasādhyaṃ kṛcchraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kuṣṭhāpahāśca ye yogāḥ|
siddhāḥ kilāsaheturliṅgaṃ gurulāghavaṃ tathā śāntiḥ||
6.7.180 |  iti saṃgrahaḥ praṇīto maharṣiṇā kuṣṭhanāśane 'dhyāye|
smṛtibuddhivardhanārhtaṃ śiṣyāya hutāśaveśāya||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakasaṃskṛte cikitsitasthāne kuṣṭhacikitsitaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7 | |

aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.8.1 |  athāto rājayakṣmacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.8.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.8.3 |  divaukasāṃ kathayatāmṛṣibhirvai śrutā kathā|
kāmavyasanasaṃyuktā paurāṇī śaśinaṃ prati||
6.8.4 |  rohiṇyāmatisaktasya śarīraṃ nānurakṣataḥ|
ājagāmālpatāmindordehaḥ snehaparikṣayāt||
6.8.5 |  duhitṛṛṇāmasaṃbhogāccheṣāṇāṃ ca prajāpateḥ|
krodho niḥśvāsarūpeṇa mūrtimān niḥsṛto mukhāt||
6.8.6 |  prajāpaterhi duhitṛṛraṣṭāviṃśatimaṃśumān|
bhāryārthaṃ pratijagrāha na ca sarvāsvavartata||
6.8.7 |  guruṇā tamavadhyātaṃ bhāryāsvasamavartinam|
rajaḥparītamabalaṃ yakṣmā śaśinamāviśat||
6.8.8 |  so 'bhibhūto+*atimahatā gurukrodhena niṣprabhaḥ|
devadevarṣisahito jagāma śaraṇaṃ gurum||
6.8.9 |  atha candramasaḥ śuddhāṃ matiṃ buddhā prajāpatiḥ|
prasādaṃ kṛtavān somastato 'śvibhyāṃ cikitsitaḥ||
6.8.10 |  sa vimuktagrahaścandro virarāja viśeṣataḥ|
*aujasā vardhito 'śvibhyāṃ śuddhaṃ sattvamavāpa ca||
6.8.11 |  krodho yakṣmā jvaro roga ekārtho duḥkhasaṃjñakaḥ|
yasmāt sa rājñaḥ prāgāsīdrājayakṣmā tato mataḥ||
6.8.12 |  sa yakṣmā huṅkṛto 'śvibhyāṃ mānuṣaṃ lokamāgataḥ|
labdhvā caturvidhaṃ hetuṃ samāviśati mānavān||
6.8.13 |  ayathābalamārambhaṃ vegasaṃdhāraṇaṃ kṣayam|
yakṣmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ vidyāccaturthaṃ viṣamāśanam||
6.8.14 |  yuddhādhyayanabhārādhvalaṅghanaplavanādibhiḥ|
patanairabhighātairvā sāhasairvā tathā 'paraiḥ||
6.8.15 |  ayathābalamārambhairjantorurasi vikṣate|
vāyuḥ prakupito doṣāvudīryobhau pradhāvati||
6.8.16 |  sa śiraḥsthaḥ śiraḥśūlaṃ karoti galamāśritaḥ|
kaṇṭhoddhvaṃsaṃ ca kāsaṃ ca svarabhedamarocakam||
6.8.17 |  pārśvaśūlaṃ ca pārśvastho varcobhedaṃ gude sthitaḥ|
jṛmbhāṃ jvaraṃ ca sandhistha uraḥsthaścoraso rujam||
6.8.18 |  *kṣaṇanādurasaḥ kāsāt kaphaṃ ṣṭhīvet saśoṇitam|
jarjareṇorasā kṛcchramuraḥśūlātipīṭitaḥ||
6.8.19 |  iti sāhasiko yakṣmā rūpairetaiḥ prapadyate|
ekādaśabhirātmajño *bhajettasmānna sāhasam||
6.8.20 |  hrīmattvādvā ghṛṇitvādvā bhayādvā vegamāgatam|
vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ nigṛhṇāti yadā naraḥ||
6.8.21 |  tadā vegapratīghātāt kaphapitte samīrayan|
ūrdhvaṃ tiryagadhaścaiva vikārān kurute 'nilaḥ||
6.8.22 |  pratiśyāyaṃ ca kāsaṃ ca svarabhedamarocakam|
pārśvaśūlaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ jvaramaṃsāvamardanam||
6.8.23 |  aṅgamardaṃ muhuśchardiṃ varcobhedaṃ trilakṣaṇam|
rūpāṇyekādaśaitāni yakṣmā yairucyate mahān||
6.8.24 |  īrṣyotkaṇṭhābhayatrāsakrodhaśokātikarśanāt|
ativyavāyānaśanācchrukramojaśca hīyate||
6.8.25 |  tataḥ snehakṣayādvāyurvṛddho doṣāvudīrayan|
pratiśyāyaṃ jvaraṃ kāsamaṅgamardaṃ śirorujam||
6.8.26 |  śvāsaṃ viḍbhedamaruciṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ svarakṣayam|
karoti cāṃsasaṃtāpam-*ekādaśagadānimān||
6.8.27 |  liṅgānyāvedayantyetānyekādaśa mahāgadam|
saṃprāptaṃ rājayakṣmāṇaṃ kṣayāt prāṇakṣayapradam||
6.8.28 |  vividhānyannapānāni vaiṣamyeṇa samaśnataḥ|
janayantyāmayān ghorānviṣamānmārutādayaḥ||
6.8.29 |  srotāṃsi rudhirādīnāṃ vaiṣamyādviṣamaṃ gatāḥ|
ruddhvā rogāya kalpante puṣyanti ca na dhātavaḥ||
6.8.30 |  pratiśyāyaṃ prasekaṃ ca kāsaṃ chardimarocakam|
jvaramaṃsābhitāpaṃ ca chardanaṃ rudhirasya ca||
6.8.31 |  pārśvaśūlaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ svarabhedamathāpi ca|
kaphapittānilakṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ vidyādyathākramam||
6.8.32 |  iti vyādhisamūhasya *rogarājasya hetujam|
rūpamekādaśavidhaṃ hetuścoktaścaturvidhaḥ||
6.8.33 |  pūrvarūpaṃ pratiśyāyo daurbalyaṃ doṣadarśanam|
adoṣeṣvapi bhāveṣu kāye bībhatsadarśanam||
6.8.34 |  ghṛṇitvamaśnataścāpi balamāṃsaparikṣayaḥ|
strīmadyamāṃsapriyatā priyatā cāvaguṇṭhane||
6.8.35 |  makṣikāghuṇakeśānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ patanāni ca|
prāyo 'nnapāne keśānāṃ nakhānāṃ cābhivardhanam||
6.8.36 |  patatribhiḥ pataṅgaiśca śvāpadaiścābhidharṣaṇam|
svapne keśāsthirāśīnāṃ bhasmanaścādhirohaṇam||
6.8.37 |  jalāśayānāṃ śailānāṃ vanānāṃ jyotiṣāmapi|
śuṣyatāṃ kṣīyamāṇānāṃ patatāṃ yacca darśanam||
6.8.38 |  prāgrūpaṃ bahurūpasya tajjñeyaṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ|
rūpaṃ tvasya yathoddeśaṃ *nirdekṣyāmi sabheṣajam||
6.8.39 |  yathāsvenoṣmaṇā pākaṃ śārīrā yānti dhātavaḥ|
srotasā ca yathāsvena dhātuḥ puṣyati dhātutaḥ||
6.8.40 |  srotasāṃ saṃnirodhācca raktādīnāṃ ca saṃkṣayāt|
dhātūṣmaṇāṃ cāpacayādrājayakṣmā pravartate||
6.8.41 |  tasmin kāle pacatyagniryadannaṃ koṣṭhasaṃśritam|
malībhavati tat prāyaḥ kalpate kiṃcidojase||
6.8.42 |  tasmāt purīṣaṃ saṃrakṣyaṃ viśeṣādrājayakṣmiṇaḥ|
sarvadhātukṣayārtasya balaṃ tasya hi viḍbalam||
6.8.43 |  rasaḥ srotaḥsu ruddheṣu svasthānastho *vidahyate|
sa ūrdhvaṃ kāsavegena bahurūpaḥ pravatate||
6.8.44 |  jāyante vyādhayaścātaḥ ṣaḍekādaśa vā punaḥ|
yeṣāṃ saṃghātayogena rājayakṣmeti kathyate||
6.8.45 |  kāṃso 'satāpo vaisvaryaṃ jvaraḥ pārśvaśirorujā|
chardanaṃ raktakaphayoḥ śvāsavarcogado 'ruciḥ||
6.8.46 |  rūpāṇyekādaśaitāni yakṣmaṇaḥ ṣaḍimāni vā|
kāso jvaraḥ pārśvaśūlaṃ svaravarcogado 'ruciḥ||
6.8.47 |  sarvairardhaistribhirvā 'pi liṅgairmāṃsabalakṣaye|
yukto varjyaścikitsyastu sarvarūpo 'pyato 'nyathā||
6.8.48 |  ghrāṇamūle sthitaḥ śleṣmā rudhiraṃ pittameva vā|
mārutādhmātaśiraso mārutaṃ śyāyate prati||
6.8.49 |  pratiśyāyastato ghoro jāyate dehakarśanaḥ|
tasya rūpaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ gauravaṃ ghrāṇaviplavaḥ||
6.8.50 |  jvaraḥ kāsaḥ kaphotkleśaḥ svarabhedo 'ruciḥ klamaḥ|
indriyāṇāmasāmarthyaṃ yakṣmā *cātaḥ prajāyate||
6.8.51 |  picchilaṃ bahalaṃ visraṃ haritaṃ śvetapītakam|
kāsamāno rasaṃ yakṣmī *niṣṭhīvati kaphānugam||
6.8.52 |  aṃsapārśvābhitāpaśca *saṃtāpaḥ karapādayoḥ|
jvaraḥ sarvāṅgagaśceti lakṣaṇaṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ||
6.8.53 |  vātātpittātkaphādraktāt kāsavegāt sapīnasāt|
svarabhedo bhavedvātādrūkṣaḥ kṣāmaścalaḥ svaraḥ||
6.8.54 |  tālukaṇṭhapariploṣaḥ pittādvaktumasūyate|
*kaphādbhedo vibaddhaśca svaraḥ *khurakhurāyate||
6.8.55 |  sanno raktavibaddhatvāt svaraḥ kṛcchrāt pravartate|
kāsātivegāt *kaṣaṇaḥ pīnasātkaphavātikaḥ||
6.8.56 |  pārśvaśūlaṃ tvaniyataṃ saṃkocāyāmalakṣaṇam|
śiraḥśūlaṃ sasaṃtāpaṃ yakṣmiṇaḥ syātsagauravam||
6.8.57 |  *abhisanne śarīre tu yakṣmiṇo viṣamāśanāt|
kaṇṭhātpravartate raktaṃ śleṣmā cotkliṣṭasaṃcitaḥ||
6.8.58 |  raktaṃ vibaddhamārgatvānmāṃsādīnn-*ānupadyate|
āmāśayasthamutkliṣṭaṃ bahutvāt kaṇṭhameti ca||
6.8.59 |  vātaśleṣmavibaddhatvādurasaḥ śvāsamṛcchati|
doṣairupahate cāgnau sapicchamatisāryate||
6.8.60 |  pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastairvā jihvāhṛdayasaṃśritaiḥ|
jāyate 'rucirāhāre dviṣṭairarthaiśca mānasaiḥ||
6.8.61 |  kaṣāyatiktamadhurairvidyānmukharasaiḥ kramāt|
vātādyairaruciṃ jātāṃ mānasīṃ doṣadarśanāt||
6.8.62 |  arocakāt kāsavegāddoṣotkleśādbhayādapi|
chardiryā sā vikārāṇāmanyeṣāmapyupadravaḥ||
6.8.63 |  sarvastridoṣajo yakṣmā doṣāṇāṃ tu balābalam|
parīkṣyāvāsthikaṃ vaidyaḥ śoṣiṇaṃ samupācaret||
6.8.64 |  pratiśyāye śiraḥśūle kāse śvāse svarakṣaye|
pārśvaśūle ca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ sādhāraṇīḥ śṛṇu||
6.8.65 |  pīnase svedamabhyaṅgaṃ dhūmamālepanāni ca|
pariṣekāvagāhāṃśca *yāvakaṃ vāṭyameva ca||
6.8.66 |  lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇāṃśca rasān snehopabṛṃhitān|
lāvatittiridakṣāṇāṃ vartakānāṃ ca kalpayet||
6.8.67 |  sapippalīkaṃ sayavaṃ sakulatthaṃ sanāgaram|
dāḍimāmalakopetaṃ snigdhamājaṃ rasaṃ pibet||
6.8.68 |  tena ṣaḍvinivartante vikārāḥ pīnasādayaḥ|
mūlakānāṃ kulatthānāṃ yūṣairvā *sūpakalpitaiḥ||
6.8.69 |  yavagodhūmaśālyannairyathāsātmyamupācaret|
pibetprasādaṃ vāruṇyā jalaṃ vā pāñcamūlikam||
6.8.70 |  dhānyanāgarasiddhaṃ vā tāmalakyā 'thavā śṛtam|
parṇinībhiścatasṛbhistena cānnāni kalpayet||
6.8.71 |  kṛśarotkārikāmāṣakulatthayavapāyasaiḥ|
saṃkarasvedavidhinā kaṇṭhaṃ pārśvamuraḥ śiraḥ||
6.8.72 |  svedayet patrabhaṅgeṇa śiraśca pariṣecayet|
balāguḍūcīmadhukaśṛtairṛvā vāribhiḥ sukhaiḥ||
6.8.73 |  bastamatsyaśirobhirvā nāḍīsvedaṃ prayojayet|
kaṇṭhe śirasi pārśve ca payobhirvā savātikaiḥ||
6.8.74 |  audakānūpamāṃsāni salilaṃ pāñcamūlikam|
sasnehamāranālaṃ vā nāḍīsvede prayojayet||
6.8.75 |  jīvantyāḥ śatapuṣpāyā balāyā madhukasya ca|
vacāyā veśavārasya vidāryā mūlakasya ca||
6.8.76 |  audakānūpamāṃsānāmupanāhāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ|
śasyante sacatuḥsnehāḥ śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūlinām||
6.8.77 |  śatapuṣpā samadhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tagaracandane|
ālepanaṃ syāt saghṛtaṃ śiraḥpārśvaṃsaśūlanut||
6.8.78 |  balā rāsnā tilāḥ sarpirmadhukaṃ nīlamutpalam|
palaṅkaṣā devadāru candanaṃ keśaraṃ ghṛtam||
6.8.79 |  vīrā balā vidārī ca kṛṣṇagandhā punarnavā|
śatāvarī payasyā ca kattṛṇaṃ madhukaṃ ghṛtam||
6.8.80 |  catvāra ete ślokārdhaiḥ pradehāḥ parikīrtitāḥ|
śastāḥ saṃsṛṣṭakoṣāṇāṃ śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūlinām||
6.8.81 |  nāvanaṃ dhūmapānāni snehāścauttarabhaktikāḥ|
*tailānyabhyaṅgayogīni bastikarma tathā param||
6.8.82 |  śṛṅgālābujalaukobhiḥ praduṣṭaṃ vyadhanena vā|
śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūleṣu rudhiraṃ tasya nirharet||
6.8.83 |  pradehaḥ saghṛtaśceṣṭaḥ padmakośīracandanaiḥ|
dūrvāmadhukamañjiṣṭhākeśarairvā ghṛtāplutaiḥ||
6.8.84 |  *prapauṇḍarīkanirguṇḍīpadmakeśaramutpalam|
kaśerukāḥ payasyā ca sasarpiṣkaṃ pralepanam||
6.8.85 |  candanādyena tailena śatadhautena sarpiṣā|
abhyaṅgaḥ, payasā sekaḥ śastaśca madhukāmbunā||
6.8.86 |  māhendreṇa suśītena candanādiśṛtena vā|
pariṣekaḥ prayoktavya iti saṃśamanī kriyā||
6.8.87 |  doṣādhikānāṃ vamanaṃ śasyate savirecanam|
snehasvedopapannānāṃ sasnehaṃ yanna karśanam||
6.8.88 |  śoṣī muñcati gātrāṇi purīṣasraṃsanādapi|
abalāpekṣiṇīṃ mātrāṃ kiṃ punaryo viricyate||
6.8.89 |  yogān saṃśuddhakoṣṭhānāṃ kāse śvāse svarakṣaye|
śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūleṣu siddhānetānprayojayet||
6.8.90 |  *balāvidārigandhādyairvidāryā madhukena vā|
siddhaṃ salavaṇaṃ sarpirnasyaṃ syātsvaryamuttamam||
6.8.91 |  prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ pippalī bṛhatī balā|
*kṣīraṃ sarpiśca tatsiddhaṃ svaryaṃ syānnāvanaṃ param||
6.8.92 |  śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūlaghnaṃ kāsaśvāsanibarhaṇam|
prayujyamānaṃ bahuśo ghṛtaṃ cauttarabhaktikam||
6.8.93 |  daśamūlena payasā siddhaṃ māṃsarasena ca|
balāgarbhaṃ ghṛtaṃ sadyo rogānetān prabādhate||
6.8.94 |  bhaktasyopari madhye vā yathāgnyabhyavacāritam|
rāsnāghṛtaṃ vā sakṣīraṃ sakṣīraṃ vā balāghṛtam||
6.8.95 |  lehān kāsāpahān svaryāñ śvāsahikkā nibarhaṇān|
śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūlaghnān snehāṃścātaḥ paraṃ śṛṇu||
6.8.96 |  ghṛtaṃ *kharjūramṛdvīkāśarkarākṣaudrasṃyutam|
sapippalīkaṃ vaisvaryakāsaśvāsajvarāpaham||
6.8.97 |  daśamūlaśṛtāt kṣīrāt sarpiryadudiyānnavam|
sapippalīkaṃ sakṣaudraṃ tat paraṃ svarabodhanam||
6.8.98 |  śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūlaghnaṃ kāsaśvāsajvarāpaham|
pañcabhiḥ pañcamūlairvā śṛtādyadudyādghṛtam||
6.8.99 |  pañcānāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ rase kṣīracaturguṇe|
siddhaṃ sarpirjayatyetadyakṣmaṇaḥ saptakaṃ balam||
6.8.100 |  kharjūraṃ pippalī drākṣā pathyā śṛṅgī durālabhā|
triphalā pippalī mustaṃ śṛṅgāṭaguḍaśarkarāḥ||
6.8.101 |  vīrā śaṭī puṣkarākhyaṃ surasaḥ śarkarā guḍaḥ|
nāgaraṃ citrako lājāḥ pippalyāmalakaṃ guḍaḥ||
6.8.102 |  ślokārdhairvihitānetāṃllihyānnā madhusarpiṣā|
kāsaśvāsāpahānsvaryānpārśvaśūlāpahāṃstathā||
6.8.103 |  sitopalāṃ tugākṣīrīṃ pippalīṃ bahulāṃ tvacam|
antyādūrdhvaṃ dviguṇitaṃ lehayenmadhusarpiṣā||
6.8.104 |  cūrṇitaṃ prāśayedvā *tacchvāsakāsakaphāturam|
suptajihvārocakinamalpāgniṃ pārśvaśūlinam||
6.8.105 |  hastapādāṅgadāheṣu jvare rakte tathordhvage|
vāsāghṛtaṃ śatāvaryā siddhaṃ vā paramaṃ hitam||
6.8.106 |  durālabhāṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ ca catasraḥ parṇinīrbalām|
bhāgānpalonmitān kṛtvā palaṃ parpaṭakasya ca||
6.8.107 |  paceddaśaguṇe toye daśabhāgāvaśeṣite|
rase supūte dravyāṇāmeṣāṃ kalkān samāvapet||
6.8.108 |  śaṭhyāḥ puṣkaramūlasya pippalītrāyamāṇayoḥ|
tāmalakyāḥ kirātānāṃ tiktasya kuṭajasya ca||
6.8.109 |  phalānāṃ sārivāyāśca supiṣṭān karṣasaṃmitān|
tatastena ghṛtaprasthaṃ kṣīradviguṇitaṃ pacet||
6.8.110 |  jvaraṃ dāhaṃ bhramaṃ kāsamaṃsapārśvaśirorujam|
tṛṣṇāṃ chardimatīsārametat sarpirvyapohati||
6.8.111 |  jīvantīṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ phalāni kuṭajasya ca|
śaṭīṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ ca vyāghrīṃ gokṣurakaṃ balām||
6.8.112 |  nīlotpalaṃ tāmalakīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ kurālabhām|
pippalīṃ ca samaṃ piṣṭvā ghṛtaṃ vaidyo vipācayet||
6.8.113 |  etadvyādhisamūhasya rogeśasya samutthitam|
rūpamekādaśavidhaṃ sarpiragryaṃ vyapohati||
6.8.114 |  balāṃ sthirāṃ pṛśnipaṇīṃ bṛhatīṃ snidigdhikām|
sādhayitvā rase tasminpayo gavyaṃ sanāgaram||
6.8.115 |  drākṣākharjūrasarpirbhiḥ pippalyā ca śṛtaṃ saha|
sakṣaudraṃ jvarakāsaghnaṃ svaryaṃ caitat prayojayet||
6.8.116 |  ājasya payasaścaivaṃ prayogo jāṅgalā rasāḥ|
yūṣārthe caṇakā mudgā makuṣṭhāścopakalpitāḥ||
6.8.117 |  jvarāṇāṃ śamanīyo yaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ|
yakṣmiṇāṃ jṛvaradāheṣu sasarpiṣkaḥ praśasyate||
6.8.118 |  kaphapraseke balavāñ ślaiṣmikaśchardayennaraḥ|
payasā phalayuktena *mādhukena rasena vā ||
6.8.119 |  sarpiṣmatyā yavāgvā vā vamanīyopasiddhayā|
vānto 'nnakāle laghvannamādadīta sadīpanam||
6.8.120 |  yavagodhūmamādhvīkasidhvariṣṭasurāsavān|
jāṅgalāni ca śūlyāni sevamānaḥ kaphaṃ jayet||
6.8.121 |  śleṣmaṇo 'tiprasekena vāyuḥ śleṣmāṇamasyati|
kaphaprasekaṃ taṃ vidvān snigdhoṣṇenaiva nirjayet||
6.8.122 |  kriyā kaphapraseke yā vamyāṃ saiva praśasyate|
hṛdyāni cānnapānāni vātaghnāni laghūni ca||
6.8.123 |  prāyeṇopahatāgnitvāt sapicchamatisāryate|
prāpnoti cāsyavairasyaṃ na cānnamabhinandati||
6.8.124 |  tasyāgnidīpanān yogānatīsāranibarhaṇān|
vaktraśuddhikarān kuryādarucipratibādhakān||
6.8.125 |  sanāgarānindrayavān pāyayettaṇḍulāmbunā|
siddhāṃ yavāgūṃ jīrṇe ca cāṅgerītakradāḍimaiḥ||
6.8.126 |  pāṭhā bilvaṃ yamānī ca pātavyaṃ takrasaṃyutam|
durālabhā śṛṅgaveraṃ pāṭhā ca surayā saha||
6.8.127 |  jambvāmramadhyaṃ bilvaṃ ca sakapitthaṃ sanāgaram|
peyāmaṇḍena pātavyamatīsāranivṛttaye||
6.8.128 |  etāneva ca yogāṃstrīn pāṭhādīn kārayet khaḍān|
*sasūpyadhānyānsasnehān sāmlānsaṃgrahaṇān param||
6.8.129 |  vetasārjunajambūnāṃ mṛṇālīkṛṣṇagandhayoḥ|
śrīparṇyā madayantyāśca yūthikāyāśca pallavān||
6.8.130 |  mātuluṅgasya dhātakyā dāḍimasya ca kārayet|
snehāmlalavaṇopetān khaḍān sāṃgrāhikān param||
6.8.131 |  cāṅgeryāścukrikāyāśca dugdhikāyāśca kārayet|
khaḍāndadhisaropetān sasarpiṣkānsadāḍimān||
6.8.132 |  māṃsānāṃ laghupākānāṃ rasāḥ sāṃgrāhikairyutāḥ|
vyaṅjanārthaṃ praśasyante bhojyārthaṃ raktaśālayaḥ||
6.8.133 |  sthirādipañcamūlena pāne śastaṃ śṛtaṃ jalam|
takraṃ surā sacukrīkā dāḍimasyāthavā rasaḥ||
6.8.134 |  ityuktaṃ bhinnaśakṛtāṃ dīpanaṃ grāhi bheṣajam|
paraṃ mukhasya vairasyanāśanaṃ rocanaṃ *śṛṇu||
6.8.135 |  dvau kālau dantapavanaṃ bhakṣayenmukhadhāvanam|
tadvat prakṣālayedāsyaṃ dhārayet kavalagrahān||
6.8.136 |  pibeddhūmaṃ tato mṛṣṭamadyāddīpanapācanam|
bheṣajaṃ pānamannaṃ ca hitamiṣṭopakalpitam||
6.8.137 |  tvaṅmustamelā dhānyāni mustamāmalakaṃ tvacam|
dārvītvaco yavānī ca tejohvā pippalī tathā||
6.8.138 |  yavānī tintiḍīkaṃ ca pañcaite mukhadhāvanāḥ|
ślokapādeṣvabhihitā rocanā mukhaśodhanāḥ||
6.8.139 |  guṭikāṃ dhārayedāsye cūrṇairvā śodhayenmukham|
eṣāmāloḍitānāṃ vā dhārayet kavalagrahān||
6.8.140 |  surāmādhvīkasīdhūnāṃ tailasya madhusarpiṣoḥ|
kavalān dhārayediṣṭān kṣīrasyekṣurasasya ca||
6.8.141 |  yavānīṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca nāgaraṃ sāmlavetasam|
dāḍimaṃ badaraṃ cāmlaṃ kārṣikaṃ copakalpayet||
6.8.142 |  dhānyasauvarcalājājīvarāṅgaṃ cārdhakārṣikam|
pippalīnāṃ śataṃ caikaṃ dve śate maricasya ca||
6.8.143 |  śarkarāyāśca catvāri palānyekatra cūrṇayet|
jihvāviśodhanaṃ hṛdyaṃ taccūrṇaṃ bhaktarocanam||
6.8.144 |  hṛtplīhapārśvaśūlaghnaṃ vibandhānāhanāśanam|
kāsaśvāsaharaṃ grāhi grahaṇyarśovikāranut||
iti yavānīṣāḍavam|
6.8.145 |  tālīśapatraṃ maricaṃ nāgaraṃ pippalī śubhā|
yathottaraṃ bhāgavṛddhyā tvagele cārdhabhāgike||
6.8.146 |  pippalyaṣṭaguṇā cātra pradeyā sitaśarkarā|
kāsaśvāsāruciharaṃ taccūrṇaṃ dīpanaṃ param||
6.8.147 |  hṛtpāṇḍugrahaṇīdoṣaśoṣaplīhajvarāpaham|
vamyatīsāraśūlaghnaṃ mūḍhavātānulomanam||
6.8.148 |  kalpayedguṭikāṃ caitaccūrṇaṃ paktvā sitopalām|
guṭikā hyagnisaṃyogāccūrṇāllaghutarāḥ smṛtāḥ||
iti tālīśādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ guṭikāśca|
6.8.149 |  śuṣyatāṃ kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ kalpitāni vidhānavit|
dadyānmāṃsādamāṃsāni bṛṃhaṇāni viśeṣataḥ||
6.8.150 |  śoṣiṇe bārhiṇaṃ dadyādbarhiśabdena cāparān|
gṛdhrānulūkāṃścāṣāṃśca vidhivat sūpakalpitān||
6.8.151 |  kākāṃstittiriśabdena varmiśabdena coragān|
bhṛṣṭān matsyāntraśabdena dadyādgaṇḍūpadānapi||
6.8.152 |  lopākān sthūlanakulān biḍālāṃścopakalpitān|
śṛgālaśābvāṃśca bhiṣak śaśaśabdena dāpayet||
6.8.153 |  siṃhānṛkṣāṃstarakṣūraṃśca vyāghrānevaṃvidhāṃstathā|
māṃsādān mṛgaśabdena dadyānmāṃsābhivṛddhaye||
6.8.154 |  gajakhaṅgituraṅgāṇāṃ veśavārīkṛtaṃ bhiṣak|
dadyānmahiṣaśabdena māṃsaṃ māṃsābhivṛddhaye||
6.8.155 |  māṃsenopacitāṅgānāṃ māṃsaṃ māṃsakaraṃ param|
tīkṣṇoṣṇalāghavācchastaṃ viśeṣānmṛgapakṣiṇām||
6.8.156 |  māṃsāni yānyanabhyāsādaniṣṭāani prayojayet|
teṣūpadhā, sukhaṃ bhoktuṃ tathā śakyāni tāni hi||
6.8.157 |  jānañjugupsannaivādyājjagdhaṃ vā punarullikhet|
tasmācchadmopasiddhāni māṃsānyetāni dāpayet||
6.8.158 |  barhitittiridakṣāṇāṃ haṃsānāṃ śūkaroṣṭrayoḥ|
kharagomahiṣāṇāṃ ca māṃsaṃ māṃsakaraṃ param||
6.8.159 |  yoniraṣṭavidhā coktā māṃsānāmannapānike|
tāṃ parīkṣya bhiṣagvidvān dadyānmāṃsāni śoṣiṇe||
6.8.160 |  prasahā bhūśayānūpavārijā vāricāriṇaḥ|
āhārārthaṃ pradātavyā mātrayā vātaśoṣiṇe||
6.8.161 |  pratudā viṣkirāścaiva dhanvajāśca mṛgadvijāḥ|
kaphapittaparītānāṃ prayojyāḥ śoṣarogiṇām||
6.8.162 |  vidhivatsūpasiddhāni manojñāni mṛdūni ca|
rasavanti sugandhīni māṃsānyetāni bhakṣayet||
6.8.163 |  māṃsamevāśnataḥ śoṣo mādhvīkaṃ pibato 'pi ca|
niniyatānalpacittasya ciraṃ kāye na tiṣṭhati||
6.8.164 |  vāruṇīmaṇḍanityasya bahirmārjanasevinaḥ|
avidhāritavegasya yakṣmā na labhate 'ntaram||
6.8.165 |  prasannāṃ vāruṇīṃ sīdhumariṣṭānāsavānmadhu|
yathārhamanupānārthaṃ pibenmāṃsāni bhakṣayan||
6.8.166 |  madyaṃ taikṣṇyauṣṇyavaiśadyasūkṣmatvāt srotasāṃ mukham|
pramathya vivṛṇotyāśu tanmokṣāt sapta dhātavaḥ||
6.8.167 |  puṣyanti dhātupoṣācca śīghraṃ śoṣaḥ praśāmyati|
māṃsādamāṃsasvarase siddhaṃ sarpiḥ prayojayet||
6.8.168 |  sakṣaudraṃ, payasā siddhaṃ sarpirdaśaguṇena vā|
siddhaṃ madhurakairdravyairdaśamūlakaṣāyakaiḥ||
6.8.169 |  kṣīramāṃsarasopetairdhṛtaṃ śoṣaharaṃ param|
pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ||
6.8.170 |  sayāvaśūkaiḥ sakṣīraiḥ srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ ghṛtam|
rāsnābalāgokṣurakasthirāvarṣābhusādhitam||
6.8.171 |  jīvantīpippalīgarbhaṃ sakṣīraṃ śoṣanudghṛtam|
yavāgvā vā pibenmātrāṃ lihyādvā madhunā saha||
6.8.172 |  siddhānāṃ sarpiṣāmeṣāmadyādannena vā saha|
śuṣyatāmeṣa nirdiṣṭo vidhirābhyavahārikaḥ||
6.8.173 |  bahiḥsparśanamāśritya bakṣyate 'taḥ paraṃ vidhiḥ|
snehakṣīrāmbukoṣṭheṣu svabhyaktamavagāhayet||
6.8.174 |  srotovibandhamokṣārthaṃ balaṣuṣṭyarthameva ca|
uttīrṇaṃ miśrakaiḥ snehaiḥ punarāktaiḥ sukhaiḥ karaiḥ||
6.8.175 |  mṛdgīyāt sukhamāsīnaṃ sukhaṃ cotsādayennaram|
jīvantīṃ śatavīryāṃ ca vikasāṃ sapunarnavām||
6.8.176 |  aśvagandhāmapāmārgaṃ tarkārīṃ madhukaṃ balām|
vidārīṃ sarṣapaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ taṇḍulānatasīphalam||
6.8.177 |  māṣāṃstilāṃśca kiṇvaṃ ca sarvamekatra cūrṇayet|
yavacūrṇatriguṇitaṃ dadhnā yuktaṃ samākṣikam||
6.8.178 |  etadutsādanaṃ kāryaṃ puṣṭivarṇabalapradam|
gaurasarṣapakalkena kalkaiścāpi sugandhibhiḥ||
6.8.179 |  snāyādṛtusukhaistoyairjīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ śṛtaiḥ|
gandhaiḥ samālyairvāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitaḥ||
6.8.180 |  spṛśyān saṃspṛśya saṃpūjya devatāḥ sabhiṣagdvajāḥ|
iṣṭavarṇarasasparśagandhavat pānabhojanam||
6.8.181 |  iṣṭamiṣṭairupahitaṃ *sukhamadyāt sukhapradam|
samātītāni dhānyāni kalpanīyāni śuṣyatām||
6.8.182 |  laghūnyahīnavīryāṇi svādūni gandhavanti ca|
yāni praharṣakārīṇi tāni pathyatamāni hi||
6.8.183 |  yaccopadekṣyate *pathyaṃ kṣatakṣīṇacikitsite|
yakṣimaṇastat prayoktavyaṃ balamāṃsābhivṛddhaye||
6.8.184 |  abhyaṅgotsādanaiścaiva vāsobhirahataiḥ priyaiḥ|
yathartuvihitaiḥ snānairavagāhairvimārjanaiḥ||
6.8.185 |  bastibhiḥ kṣīrasarpirbhirmāṃsairmāṃsarasaudanaiḥ|
iṣṭairmadyairmanojñānāṃ gandhānāmupasevanaiḥ||
6.8.186 |  suhṛdāṃ ramaṇīyānāṃ pramadānāṃ ca darśanaiḥ|
gītavāditraśabdaiśca priyaśrutibhireva ca||
6.8.187 |  harṣaṇāśvāsanairnityaṃ gurūṇāṃ samupāsanaiḥ|
brahmacaryeṇa dānena tapasā devatārcanaiḥ||
6.8.188 |  satyenācārayogena maṅgalyairapyahiṃsayā|
vaidyaviprārcanāccaiva rogarājo nivartate||
6.8.189 |  yayā prayuktayā ceṣṭyā rājayakṣmā purā jitaḥ|
tāṃ vedavihitāmiṣṭim-*ārogyārthī prayojayet||
6.8.190 |  tatra ślokau---
prāgutpattirnimittāni prāgrūpaṃ rūpasaṃgrahaḥ|
samāsād vyāsataścoktaṃ bheṣajaṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ||
6.8.191 |  nāmaheturasādhyatvaṃ sādhyatvaṃ kṛcchrasādhyatā|
ityuktaḥ saṃgrahaḥ kṛtsno rājayakṣmacikitsite||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne rājayakṣmacikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8 | |

navamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.9.1 |  athāta unmādacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.9.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.9.3 |  buddhismṛtijñānataponivāsaḥ punarvasuḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ śaraṇyaḥ|
unmādahetvākṛtibheṣajāni kāle 'gniveśāya śaśaṃsa pṛṣṭaḥ||
6.9.4 |  viruddhaduṣṭāśucibhojanāni pradharṣaṇaṃ devagurudvijānām|
unmādaheturbhayaharṣapūrvo mano 'bhighāto viṣamāśca ceṣṭāḥ||
6.9.5 |  tairalpasattvasya malāḥ praduṣṭā buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya|
srotāṃsyadhiṣṭhāya manovahāni pramohayantyāśu narasya cetaḥ||
6.9.6 |  dhīvibhramaḥ sattvapariplavaśca paryākulā dṛṣṭiradhīratā ca|
abaddhavāktvaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca śūnyaṃ sāmānyamunmādagadasya liṅgam||
6.9.7 |  sa mūḍhacetā na sukhaṃ na duḥkhaṃ nācāradharmau kuta eva śāntim|
vindatyapāstasmṛtibuddhisaṃjño bhramatyayaṃ ceta itastataśca||
6.9.8 |  samudbhramaṃ buddhimanaḥsmṛtīnāmunmādamāgantunijotthamāhuḥ|
tasyodbhavaṃ pañcavidhaṃ pṛthak tu vakṣyāmi liṅgāni cikitsitaṃ ca||
6.9.9 |  rūkṣālpaśītānnavirekadhātukṣayopavāsairanilo 'tivṛddhaḥ|
*cintādijuṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ cāpyupahanti śīghram||
6.9.10 |  asthānahāsasmitanṛtyagītabāgaṅgavikṣepaṇarodanāni|
pāruṣyakārśyāruṇavarṇatāśca jīrṇe balaṃ cānilajasya rūpam||
6.9.11 |  ajīrṇakaṭvamlavidāhyaśītairbhojyaiścitaṃ pittamudīrṇavegam|
unmādamatyugramanātmakasya hṛdi śritaṃ pūrvavadāśu kuryāt||
6.9.12 |  amarṣasaṃrambhavinagnabhāvāḥ *saṃtarjanātidravaṇauṣṇyaroṣāḥ|
pracchāyaśītānnajalābhilāṣāḥ pītā ca bhāḥ pittakṛtasya liṅgam||
6.9.13 |  saṃpūraṇairmandaviceṣṭitasya soṣmā kapho marmaṇi saṃpravṛddhaḥ|
buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ cāpyupahatya cittaṃ pramohayan saṃjanayedvikāram||
6.9.14 |  vākceṣṭitaṃ mandamarocakaśca nārīviviktapriyatā 'tinidrā|
chardiśca lālā ca balaṃ ca bhuṅkte nakhādiśauklyaṃ ca kaphātmakasya||
6.9.15 |  yaḥ sannipātaprabhavo 'tighoraḥ sarvaiḥ samastaiḥ sa ca hetubhiḥ syāt|
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bibharti tādṛgvirudghabhaiṣajyavidhirvivarjyaḥ||
6.9.16 |  devarṣigandharvapiśācayakṣarakṣaḥpitṛṛṇāmabhidharṣaṇāni|
āgantuheturniyamavratādi mithyākṛtaṃ karma ca pūrvadehe||
6.9.17 |  amartyavāgvikramavīryaceṣṭo jñānādivijñānabalādibhiryaḥ|
unmādakālo 'niyataśca yasya bhūtottyamunmādamudāharettam||
6.9.18 |  adūṣayantaḥ puruṣasya dehaṃ devādayaḥ svaistu guṇaprabhāvaiḥ|
viśantyadṛśyāstarasā yathaiva cchāyātapau darpaṇasūryakāntau||
6.9.19 |  āghātakālo hi sa pūrvarūpaḥ prokto nidāne 'tha surādibhiśca|
unmādarūpāṇi pṛthaṅnibodha kālaṃ ca gamyān puruṣāṃśca teṣām||
6.9.20 |  tadyathā---saumyadṛṣṭiṃ
 gambhīramadhṛṣyamakopanamasvapnabhojanābhilāṣiṇamalpasvedamūtrapurīṣa-*vātaṃ śubhagandhaṃ phullapadmavadanamiti devonmattaṃ vidyāt; guruvṛddhasiddharṣīṇāmabhiśāpābhicārābhidhyānānurūpaceṣṭāhāravyāhāraṃ tairunmattaṃ vidyāt; aprasannadṛṣṭimapaśyantaṃ vidrāluṃ pratihatavācamanannābhilāṣamarocakāvipākaparītaṃ ca pitṛbhirunmattaṃ vidyāt; (*caṇḍaṃ sāhasikaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ gambhīramadhṛṣyaṃ) mukhavādyanṛtyagītānnapānasnānamālyadhūpagandharatiṃ raktavastrabalikarmahāsyakathānuyogapriyaṃ śubhagandhaṃ ca gandharvonmattaṃ vidyāt; asakṛtsvapna-*rodanahāsyaṃ nṛtyagītavādyapāṭhakathānnapānasnānamālyadhūpagandharatiṃ raktaviplutākṣaṃ dvijātivaidyaparivādinaṃ rahasyabhāṣiṇaṃ ca yakṣonmattaṃ vidyāt; naṣṭanidramannapānadviṣiṇamanāhāramapyatibalinaṃ śastraśoṇitamāṃsaraktamālyābhilāṣiṇaṃ saṃtarjakaṃ ca rākṣasonmattaṃ vidyāt; prahāsanṛtyapradhānaṃ devavipravaidyadveṣāvajñābhiḥ stutivedamantraśāstrodāharaṇaiḥ kāṣṭhādibhirātmapīḍanena ca brahmarākṣasonmattaṃ vidyāt; asvasthacittaṃ sthānamalabhamānaṃ nṛtyagītahāsinaṃ baddhābaddhapralāpinaṃ saṃkarakūṭamalinarathyācelatṛṇāśmakāṣṭhādhirohaṇaratiṃ *bhinnarūkṣasvaraṃ nagnaṃ vidhāvantaṃ naikatra tiṣṭhantaṃ duḥkhānyāvedayantaṃ naṣṭasmṛtiṃ ca piśāconmattaṃ vidyāt||
6.9.21 |  tatra caukṣācāraṃ tapaḥsvādhyāyakovidaṃ naraṃ prāyaḥ śuklapratipadi trayodaśyāṃ ca *chidramavekṣyābhidharṣayantidevāḥ, snānaśuciviviktasevinaṃ dharmaśāstraśrutivākyakuśalaṃ prāyaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ navamyāṃ carṣayaḥ, mātṛpitṛguruvṛddhasiddhācāryopasevinaṃ prāyo daśamyāmamāvasyāyāṃ ca pitaraḥ, gandharvāḥ stutigītavāditraratiṃ paradāragandhamālyapriyaṃ caukṣācāraṃ prāyo dvādaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca, sattvabalarūpagarvaśauryayuktaṃ mālyānulepanahāsyapriyam-*ativākkaraṇaṃ prāyaḥ śuklaikādaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ ca yakṣāḥ, svādhyāyataponiyamopavāsabrahmacaryadevayatigurupūjā 'ratiṃ bhraṣṭaśaucaṃ brāhmaṇamabrāhmaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇavādinaṃ śūramāninaṃ devāgārasalilakrīḍanaratiṃ prāyaḥ śuklapañcamyāṃ pūrṇacandradarśane ca brahmarākṣasāḥ, rakṣaḥpiśācāstu hīnasattvaṃ piśunaṃ *straiṇaṃ lubdhaṃ śaṭhaṃ *prāyo dvitīyātṛtīyāṣṭamīṣu; ityaparisaṃkhyeyānāṃ grahāṇāmāviṣkṛtatamā hyaṣṭāvetevyākhyātāḥ||
6.9.22 |  sarveṣvapi tu khaveṣu yo hastāvudyamya roṣasaṃrambhānniḥśaṅkamanyeṣvātmani vā nipātayet sa hyasādhyo jñeyaḥ; tathā yaḥ sāśrunetro miḍhrapravṛttaraktaḥ kṣatajihvaḥ prasrutanāsikaśchidyamānacarmā 'pratihanyamānavāṇiḥ satataṃ vikūjan *durvarṇastṛṣārtaḥ pūtigandhaśca sa hiṃsārthinonmatto jñeyaḥ; taṃ parivarjayet||
6.9.23 |  ratyarcanākāmonmādinau tu bhiṣag-*abhiprāyācārābhyāṃ buddhvā tadaṅgopahārabalimiśreṇa|
mantrabhaiṣajyavidhinopakramet||
6.9.24 |  tatra dvayorapi nijāgantunimittayorunmādayoḥ samāsavistarābhyāṃ bheṣajavidhimanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.9.25 |  unmāde vātaje pūrvaṃ snehapānaṃ viśeṣavit|
kuryādāvṛtamārge tu sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanam||
6.9.26 |  kaphapittodbhave 'pyādau vamanaṃ savirecanam|
snigdhasvinnasya kartavyaṃ śuddhe saṃsarjanakramaḥ||
6.9.27 |  nirūhaṃ snehabastiṃ ca śirasaśca virecanam|
tataḥ kuryādyathādoṣaṃ teṣāṃ bhūyastvamācaret||
6.9.28 |  hṛdindriyaśiraḥkoṣṭhe saṃśuddhe vamanādibhiḥ|
manaḥprasādamāpnoti smṛtiṃ saṃjñāṃ ca vindati||
6.9.29 |  śuddhasyācāravibhraṃśe tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanamañjanam|
tāḍanaṃ ca manobuddhidehasaṃvejanaṃ hitam||
6.9.30 |  yaḥ *sakto 'vinaye paṭṭaiḥ saṃyamya sudṛḍhaiḥ sukhaiḥ|
apetalohakāṣṭhādye saṃrodhyaśca tamogṛhe||
6.9.31 |  tarjanaṃ trāsanaṃ dānaṃ harṣaṇaṃ sāntvanaṃ bhayam|
vismayo vismṛterhetornayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ||
6.9.32 |  pradehotsādanābhyaṅgadhūmāḥ pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ|
prayoktavyaṃ manobuddhismṛtisaṃjñāprabodhanam||
6.9.33 |  sarpiḥpānādirāgantormantrādiśceṣyate vidhiḥ|
ataḥ siddhatamānyogāñchṛṇūnmādavināśanān||
6.9.34 |  hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣairdvipalāṃśairghṛtāḍhakam|
caturguṇe gavāṃ mūtre siddhamunmādanāśanam||
6.9.35 |  viśālā triphalā *kauntī devadārvelavālukam|
