sthirā nataṃ rajanyau dve sārive dve priyaṅgukā||
6.9.36 |  nīlotpalailāmañjiṣṭhādantīdāḍimakeśaram|
tālīśapatraṃ bṛhatī mālatyāḥ kusumaṃ navam||
6.9.37 |  viḍaṅgaṃ pṛśniparṇī ca kuṣṭhaṃ candanapadmakau|
aṣṭāviṃśatibhiḥ kalkairetairakṣasamanvitaiḥ||
6.9.38 |  *caturguṇe jale samyagghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
apasmāre jvare kāse śoṣe mande 'nale kṣaye||
6.9.39 |  vātarakte pratiśyāye tṛtīyakacaturthake|
chardyarśomūtrakṛcchreṣu visarpopahateṣu ca||
6.9.40 |  kaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmayonmādaviṣamehagadeṣu ca|
bhūtopahatacittānāṃ gadgadānāmacesām||
6.9.41 |  śastaṃ strīṇāṃ ca vandhyānāṃ dhanyamāyurbalapradam|
alakṣmīpāparakṣoghnaṃ sarvagrahavināśanam||
6.9.42 |  kalyāṇakamidaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃsavaneṣu ca|
iti kalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtam|
ebhya eva sthirādīni jale paktvaikaviṃśatim||
6.9.43 |  rase tasmin pacet sarpirgṛṣṭikṣīre caturguṇe|
vīrārdramāṣakākolīsvayaṃguptarṣabhardhibhiḥ||
6.9.44 |  medayā ca samaiḥ kalkaistat syāt kalyāṇakaṃ mahat|
bṛṃhaṇīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa sannipātaharaṃ param||
iti mahākalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtam|
6.9.45 |  jaṭilāṃ pūtanāṃ keśīṃ cāraṭīṃ markaṭīṃ vacām|
trāyamāṇāṃ jayāṃ vīrāṃ corakaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.9.46 |  vayaḥsthāṃ śūkarīṃ chatrāmaticchatrāṃ palaṅkaṣām|
mahāpuruṣadantāṃ ca kāyasthāṃ nākulīdvayam||
6.9.47 |  kaṭambharāṃ vṛścikālīṃ sthirāṃ cāhṛtya tairghṛtam|
siddhaṃ cāturthakonmādagrahāpasmāranāśanam||
6.9.48 |  mahāpaiśācikaṃ nāma ghṛtametadyathā 'mṛtam|
buddhismṛtikaraṃ caiva bālānāṃ cāṅgavardhanam||
iti mahāpaiśācikaṃ ghṛtam|
6.9.49 |  laśunānāṃ śataṃ triṃśadabhayāstryūṣaṇāt palam|
gavāṃ carmamasīprastho dvyāḍhakaṃ kṣīramūtrayoḥ||
6.9.50 |  purāṇasarpiṣaḥ prastha ebhiḥ siddhaṃ prayojayet|
hiṅgucūrṇapalaṃ śīte dattvā ca madhumāṇikām||
6.9.51 |  taddoṣāgantusaṃbhūtānunmādān viṣamajvarān|
apasmārāṃśca hantyāśu pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ||
iti laśunādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.9.52 |  laśunasyāvinaṣṭasya tulārdhaṃ nistuṣīkṛtam|
tadardhaṃ daśamūlasya dvyāḍhake 'pāṃ vipācayet||
6.9.53 |  pādaśeṣe ghṛtaprasthaṃ laśunasya rasaṃ tathā|
kolamūlakavṛkṣāmlamātuluṅgārdrakai rasaiḥ||
6.9.54 |  dāḍimāmbusurāmastukāñjikāmlaistadardhikaiḥ|
sādhayettriphalādārulavaṇavyoṣadīpyakaiḥ||
6.9.55 |  yavānīcavyahiṅgvamlavetasaiśca palārdhikaiḥ|
siddhametat pibecchūlagulmārśojaṭharāpaham||
6.9.56 |  bradhnapāṇḍvāmayaplīhayonidoṣajvarakṛmīn|
vātaśleṣmāmayān sarvānunmādāṃścāpakarṣati||
ityaparaṃ laśunādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.9.57 |  hiṅgunā hiṅguparṇyā ca sakāyasthavayaḥsthayā|
siddhaṃ sarpirhitaṃ tadvadvayaḥsthāhiṅgucorakaiḥ||
6.9.58 |  kevalaṃ siddhamebhirvā purāṇaṃ pāyayedghṛtam|
pāyayitvottamāṃ mātrāṃ śvabhre rundhyādgṛhe 'pi vā||
6.9.59 |  viśeṣataḥ purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ taṃ pāyayedbhiṣak|
tridoṣaghnaṃ pavitratvādviśeṣādgrahanāśanam||
6.9.60 |  guṇakarmādhikaṃ pānādāsvādāt kaṭutiktakam|
ugragandhaṃ purāṇaṃ syāddaśavarṣasthitaṃ ghṛtam||
6.9.61 |  lākṣārasanibhaṃ śītaṃ taddhi sarvagrahāpaham|
medhyaṃ virecaneṣvagryaṃ prapurāṇamataḥ param||
6.9.62 |  nāsādhyaṃ nāma tasyāsti yat syādvarṣaśatasthitam|
dṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭamathāghrātaṃ taddhi sarvagrahāpaham||
6.9.63 |  apasmāragrahonmādavatāṃ śastaṃ viśeṣataḥ|
etānauṣadhayogān vā vidheyatvamagacchati||
6.9.64 |  añjanotsādanālepanāvanādiṣu yojayet|
śirīṣo madhukaṃ hiṅguṃ laśunaṃ tagaraṃ vacā||
6.9.65 |  kuṣṭhaṃ ca bastamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ syānnāvanāñjanam|
tadvadhyoṣaṃ haridre dve mañjiṣṭhāhiṅgusarṣapāḥ||
6.9.66 |  śirīṣabījaṃ conmādagrahāpasmāranāśanam|
piṣṭvā *tulyamapāmārgaṃ hiṅgvālaṃ hiṅgupatrikām||
6.9.67 |  vartiḥ syānmaricārdhāṃśā pittābhyāṃ gośṛgālayoḥ|
tayā 'ñjayedapasmārabhūtonmādajvarārditān||
6.9.68 |  bhūtārtānamarārtāṃśca narāṃścaiva dṛgāmaye|
maricaṃ cātape māṃsaṃ sapittaṃ sthitamañjanam||
6.9.69 |  vaikṛtaṃ paśyataḥ kāryaṃ doṣabhūtahatasmṛteḥ|
siddhārthako vacā hiṅgu karañjo devadāru ca||
6.9.70 |  mañjiṣṭhā triphalā śvetā kaṭanbhītvak kaṭutrikam|
samāṃśāni priyaṅguśca śirīṣo rajanīdvayam||
6.9.71 |  bastamūtreṇa piṣṭo 'yamagadaḥ pājamañjanam|
nasyamālepanaṃ caiva snānamudvartanaṃ tathā||
6.9.72 |  apasmāraviṣonmādakṛtyālakṣmījvarāpahaḥ|
bhūtebhyaśca bhayaṃ hanti rājadvāre ca śasyate||
6.9.73 |  sarpiretena siddhaṃ vā sagomūtraṃ tadarthakṛt|
praseke pīnase gandhairdhūmavartiṃ kṛtāṃ pibet||
6.9.74 |  vairecanikadhūmoktaiḥ śvetādyairvā sahiṅgubhiḥ|
śallakolūkamārjārajambūkavṛkabastajaiḥ||
6.9.75 |  mūtrapittaśakṛllomanakhaiścarmabhireva ca|
sekāñjanaṃ pradhamanaṃ nasyaṃ dhūmaṃ ca kārayet||
6.9.76 |  vātaśleṣmātmake prāyaḥ paittike tu praśasyate|
tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaśca miśrakaḥ||
6.9.77 |  śītāni cānnāanāni madhurāṇi *mṛdūni ca|
śaṅkhakeśāntasandhau vā mokṣayejjño bhiṣak sirām|
janmāde viṣame caiva jvare 'pasmāra eva ca||
6.9.78 |  ghṛtamāṃsavitṛptaṃ vā nivāte sthāpayet sukham|
tyaktvā matismṛtibhraṃśaṃ saṃjñāṃ labdhvā *pramucyate||
6.9.79 |  āśvāsayet suhṛdvā taṃ vākyairdharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ|
brūyādiṣṭavināśaṃ vā darśayedadbhutāni vā||
6.9.80 |  baddhaṃ sarṣapatailāktaṃ vyasedvottānamātape|
kapikacchvā 'thavā taptairlohatailajalaiḥ spṛśet||
6.9.81 |  kaśābhistāḍayitvā vā subaddhaṃ vijane gṛhe|
rundhyācceto hi vibhrāntaṃ vrajatyasya tathā śamam||
6.9.82 |  sarpeṇoddhṛtadaṃṣṭreṇa dāntaiḥ siṃhairgajaiśca tam|
trāsayecchastrahastairvā taskaraiḥ śatrubhistathā||
6.9.83 |  athavā rājapuruṣā bahirnītvā susaṃyatam|
trāsayeyurvadhenainaṃ tarjayanto nṛpājñayā||
6.9.84 |  dehaduḥkhabhayebhyo hi paraṃ prāṇabhayaṃ smṛtam|
tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ||
6.9.85 |  iṣṭadravyavināśāttu mano yasyopahanyate|
tasya tatsadṛśaprāptisāntvāśvāsaiḥ śamaṃ nayet||
6.9.86 |  kāmaśokabhayakrodhaharṣerṣyālobhasaṃbhavān|
parasparapratidvandvairebhireva śamaṃ nayet||
6.9.87 |  buddhvā deśaṃ vayaḥ sātmyaṃ doṣaṃ kālaṃ balābale|
cikitsitamidaṃ kuryādunmāde bhūtadoṣaje||
6.9.88 |  devarṣipitṛgandharvairunmattasya tu buddhimān|
varjayedañjanādini tīkṣṇāni krūrakarma ca||
6.9.89 |  sarpiṣpānādi tasyeha mṛdu bhaiṣajyamācaret|
pūjāṃ balyupahārāṃśca mantrāñjanavidhīṃstathā||
6.9.90 |  śāntikrameṣṭihomāṃśca japasvastyayanāni ca|
vedoktān niyamāṃścāpi prāyaścittāni cācaret||
6.9.91 |  bhūtānāmadhipaṃ devamīśvaraṃ jagataḥ prabhum|
pūjayan prayato nityaṃ jayatyunmādajaṃ bhayam||
6.9.92 |  rudrasya pramathā nāma gaṇā loke caranti ye|
teṣāṃ pūjāṃ ca kurvāṇa unmādebhyaḥ pramucyate||
6.9.93 |  balibhirmaṅgalairhomairoṣadhyagadadhāraṇaiḥ|
satyācāratapojñānapradānaniyamavrataiḥ||
6.9.94 |  devagobrāhmaṇānāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ pūjanena ca|
āgantuḥ praśamaṃ yāti siddhairmantrauṣadhaistathā||
6.9.95 |  yaccopadekṣyate kiṃcidapasmāracikitsite|
unmāde tacca kartavyaṃ sāmānyāddhetudūṣyayoḥ||
6.9.96 |  nivṛttāmiṣamadyo yo hitāśī prayataḥ śuciḥ|
nijāgantubhirunmādaiḥ sattvavān na sa yujyate||
6.9.97 |  prasādaścendriyārthānāṃ buddhyātmamanasāṃ tathā|
dhātūnāṃ prakṛtisthatvaṃ vigatonmādalakṣaṇam||
6.9.98 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
unmādānāṃ samutthānaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sacikitsitam|
nijāgantunimittānāmuktavān bhiṣaguttamaḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalapūrite cikitsāsthāne unmādacikitsitaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ||9 | |

daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.10.1 |  athāto 'pasmāracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.10.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.10.3 |  smṛterapagamaṃ prāhurapasmāraṃ bhiṣagvidaḥ|
tamaḥpradeśaṃ bībhatsaceṣṭaṃ dhīsattvasaṃplavāt||
6.10.4 |  vibhrāntabahudoṣāṇām*ahitāśucibhojanāt|
6.10.5 |  cintākāmabhayakrodhaśokodvegādibhistathā|
manasyabhihate nṛṛṇāmapasmāraḥ pravartate||
6.10.6 |  dhamanībhiḥ śritā doṣā hṛdayaṃ pīḍayanti hi|
saṃpīḍyamāno vyathate mūḍho bhrāntena cetasā||
6.10.7 |  paśyatyasanti rūpāṇi patati prasphuratyapi|
jihvākṣibhrūḥ sravallālo hastau pādau ca vikṣipan||
6.10.8 |  doṣavege ca vigate suptavat pratibuddhyate|
pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca vakṣyate sa caturvidhaḥ||
6.10.9 |  kampate pradaśehantān phenodvāmī śvasityapi|
paruṣāruṇakṛṣṇāni paśyedrūpāṇi cānilāt||
6.10.10 |  pītaphenāṅgavaktrākṣaḥ pītāsṛgrūpadarśanaḥ|
*satṛṣṇoṣṇānalavyāptalokadarśīṃ ca paittikaḥ||
6.10.11 |  śuklaphenāṅgavaktrākṣaḥ śīto hṛṣṭāṅgajo guruḥ|
paśyañchuklāni rūpāṇi ślaiṣmiko mucyate cirāt||
6.10.12 |  sarvairetaiḥ samastaistu liṅgairujñeyastridoṣajaḥ|
apasmāraḥ sa cāsādhyo yaḥ kṣīṇasyānavaśca yaḥ||
6.10.13 |  pakṣādvā dvādaśāhādvā māsādvā kupitā malāḥ|
apasmārāya kurvanti vegaṃ kiṃcidathāntaram||
6.10.14 |  tairāvṛtānāṃ hṛtsrotomanasāṃ saṃprabodhanam|
tīkṣṇairādau bhiṣak kuryāt karmabhirvamanādibhiḥ||
6.10.15 |  vātikaṃ bastibhūyiṣṭhaiḥ paittaṃ prāyo virecanaiḥ|
ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyairapasmāramupācaret||
6.10.16 |  sarvataḥ suviśuddhasya samyagāśvāsitasya ca|
apasmāravimokṣārthaṃ yogān saṃśamanāñchṛṇu||
6.10.17 |  gośakṛdrasadadhyamlakṣīramūtraiḥ samairghṛtam|
siddhaṃ pibedapasmārakāmalājvaranāśanam||
iti pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.10.18 |  dve pañcamūlyau triphalā rajanyau kuṭajatvacam|
saptaparṇamapāmārgaṃ nīlinīṃ kaṭarohiṇīm||
6.10.19 |  śampākaṃ phalgumūlaṃ ca pauṣkaraṃ sadurālabham|
dvipalāni jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite||
6.10.20 |  bhāgīṃ pāṭhāṃ trikaṭukaṃ trivṛtāṃ viculāni ca|
śreyasīmāḍhakīṃ mūrvāṃ dantīṃ bhūnimbacitrakau||
6.10.21 |  dve sārive rohiṣaṃ ca bhūtīkaṃ madayantikām|
kṣipetpiṣṭvā 'kṣamātrāṇi *tena prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet||
6.10.22 |  gośakṛdrasadadhyamlakṣīramūtraiśca tatsamaiḥ|
pañcagavyamiti khyātaṃ mahattadamṛtopamam||
6.10.23 |  apasmāre *tathonmāde śvayathāvudareṣu ca|
gulmārśaḥpāṇḍurogeṣu kāmalāyāṃ halīmake||
6.10.24 |  śasyate ghṛtametattu prayoktavyaṃ dine dine|
alakṣmīgraharogaghnaṃ cāturthakavināśanam||
iti mahāpañcagavyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.10.25 |  brāhmīrasavacākuṣṭhaśaṅkhapuṣpībhireva ca|
purāṇaṃ ghṛtamunmādālakṣmyapasmārapāpanut||
6.10.26 |  ghṛtaṃ saindhavahiṅgubhyāṃ vārṣe baste caturguṇe|
mūtre siddhamapasmārahṛdgrahāmayanāśanam||
6.10.27 |  vacāśampākakaiṭaryavayaḥsthāhiṅgucorakaiḥ|
siddhaṃ palaṅkaṣāyuktairvātaśleṣmātmake ghṛtam||
6.10.28 |  tailaprasthaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ|
kṣīradroṇe pacet siddhamapasmāravināśanam||
6.10.29 |  kaṃse kṣīrekṣurasayoḥ kāśmarye 'ṣṭaguṇe rase|
kārṣikairjīvanīyaiśca ghṛtaprasthṃ vipācayet||
6.10.30 |  vātapittodbhavaṃ kṣipramapasmāraṃ niyacchati|
tadvat kāśavidārīkṣukuśakkāthaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam||
6.10.31 |  madhukadvipale kalke droṇe cāmalakīrasāt|
tadvat siddho ghṛtaprasthaḥ pittāpasmārabheṣajam||
6.10.32 |  abhyaṅgaḥ sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ bastamūtre caturguṇe|
siddhaṃ syādgośakṛnmūtraiḥ snānotsādanameva ca||
6.10.33 |  kaṭabhīnimbakaṭvaṅgamadhuśigrutvacāṃ rase|
siddhaṃ mūtrasamaṃ tailamabhyaṅgārthe praśasyate||
6.10.34 |  pālaṅkaṣāvacāpathyāvṛścikālyarkasarṣapaiḥ|
jaṭilāpūtanākeśīnākulīhiṅgucorakaiḥ||
6.10.35 |  laśunātirasācitrākuṣṭhairviḍbhiśca pakṣiṇām|
māṃsāśināṃ yathālābhaṃ bastamūtre caturguṇe||
6.10.36 |  siddhamabhyañjanaṃ tailamapasmāravināśanam|
etaiścaivauṣadhaiḥ kāryaṃ dhūpanaṃ sapralepanam||
6.10.37 |  pippalīṃ lavaṇaṃ *citrāṃ hiṅgu hiṅguśivāṭikām|
kakolīṃ sarṣapān kākanāsāṃ kaiṭaryacandane||
6.10.38 |  śunaḥskandhāsthinakharān parśukāṃ ceti peṣayet|
bastamūtreṇa puṣyarkṣe pradehaḥ syāt sadhūpanaḥ||
6.10.39 |  apetarākṣasīkuṣṭhapūtanākeśicorakaiḥ|
utsādanaṃ mūtrapiṣṭairmūtrairevāvasecanam||
6.10.40 |  jalaukaḥśakṛtā tadvaddagdhairvā bastaromabhiḥ|
kharāsthibhirhastinakhaistathā gopucchalomabhiḥ||
6.10.41 |  kapilānāṃ gavāṃ *mūtraṃ nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam|
śvaśṛgālabiḍālānāṃ siṃhādīnāṃ ca śasyate||
6.10.42 |  bhārgī vacā nāgadantī śvetā *śvetā viṣāṇikā|
jyotiṣmatī nāgadantī pādoktā mūtrapeṣitāḥ||
6.10.43 |  yogāstrayo 'taḥ ṣaḍ bindūn pañca vā nāvayedbhiṣak|
triphalāvyoṣapītadruyavakṣāraphaṇijjhakaiḥ||
6.10.44 |  śyāmāpāmārgakārañjaphalairmūtre 'tha bastaje|
sādhitaṃ nāvanaṃ tailamapasmāravināśanam||
6.10.45 |  pippalī vṛścikālī ca kuṣṭhaṃ ca lavaṇāni ca|
bhārgī ca cūrṇitaṃ kāryaṃ pradhamanaṃ param||
6.10.46 |  kāyasthāṃ śāradānmudgānmustośīrayavāṃstathā|
savyoṣān bastamūtreṇa piṣṭvā vartīḥ prakalpayet||
6.10.47 |  apasmāre tathonmāde sarpadaṣṭe garārdite|
viṣapīte jalamṛte caitāḥ syuramṛtopamāḥ||
6.10.48 |  mustaṃ vayaḥsthāṃ triphalāṃ kāyasthāṃ hiṅgu śādvalam|
vyoṣaṃ māṣān yavānmūtrairvāstamaiṣārṣabhaistribhiḥ||
6.10.49 |  piṣṭvā kṛtvā ca tāṃ vartimapasmāre prayojayet|
kilāse ca tathonmāde jvareṣu viṣameṣu ca||
6.10.50 |  puṣyoddṛtaṃ śunaḥ pittamapasmāraghnamañjanam|
tadeva sarpiṣā yuktaṃ dhūpanaṃ paramaṃ matam||
6.10.51 |  nakulolūkamārjāragṛdhrakīṭāhikākajaiḥ|
*tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiśca dhūpanaṃ kārayedbhiṣak||
6.10.52 |  ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhirhṛdayaṃ saṃprabudhyate|
srotāṃsi cāpi śudhyanti *tataḥ saṃjñāṃ sa vindati||
6.10.53 |  yasyānubandhastvāganturdoṣaliṅgādhikākṛtiḥ|
dṛśyeta tasya kāryaṃ syādāgantūnmādabheṣajam||
6.10.54 |  anantaramuvācedamagniveśaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ|
bhagavan! prāk samuddiṣṭaḥ ślokasthāne mahāgadaḥ||
6.10.55 |  atattvābhiniveśo yastaddhetvākṛtibhiṣajam|
tatra noktamataḥ śrotumicchāmi tadihocyatām||
6.10.56 |  śuśrūṣave vacaḥ śrutvā śiṣyāyāha punarvasuḥ|
mahāgadaṃ saumya! śṛṇu sahetvākṛtibheṣajam||
6.10.57 |  malināhāraśīlasya vegān prāptānnigṛhnataḥ|
śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairhetubhiścātisevitaiḥ||
6.10.58 |  hṛdayaṃ samupāśritya manobuddhivahāḥ sirāḥ|
doṣāḥ saṃdūṣya tiṣṭhanti rajomohāvṛtātmanaḥ||
6.10.59 |  rajastamobhyāṃ vṛddhābhyāṃ *buddhau manasi cāvṛte|
hṛdaye vyākule doṣairatha *mūḍho 'lpacetanaḥ||
6.10.60 |  viṣamāṃ kurute buddhiṃ nityānitye hitāhite|
atattvābhiniveśaṃ tamāhurāptā mahāgadam||
6.10.61 |  snehasvedopapannaṃ taṃ saṃśodhya vamanādibhiḥ|
kṛtasaṃsarjanaṃ medhyairannapānairupācaret||
6.10.62 |  brāhmīsvarasayuktaṃ yat pañcagavyamudāhṛtam|
tat sevyaṃ śaṅkhapuṣpī ca yacca medhyaṃ rasāyanam||
6.10.63 |  suhṛdaścānukūlāstaṃ svāptā dharmārthavādinaḥ|
saṃyojayeyur*vijñānadhairyasmṛtisamādhibhiḥ||
6.10.64 |  prayuñjyāttailalaśunaṃ payasā vā śatāvarīm|
brāhmīrasaṃ kuṣṭharasaṃ vacāṃ vā madhusaṃyutām||
6.10.65 |  duścikitsyo hyapasmāraścirakārī *kṛtāspadaḥ|
tasmādrasāyanairenaṃ prāyaśaḥ samupācaret||
6.10.66 |  jalāgnidrumaśailebhyo viṣamebhyaśca taṃ sadā|
rakṣedunmādinaṃ caiva sadyaḥ prāṇaharā hi te||
6.10.67 |  tatra ślokau---
hetuṃ kurvantyapasmāraṃ doṣāḥ prakupitā yathā|
sāmānyataḥ pṛthaktvācca liṅgaṃ teṣāṃ ca bheṣajam||
6.10.68 |  mahāgadasamutthānaṃ liṅgaṃ covāca sauṣadham|
munirvyāsasamāsābhyām*apasmāracikitsite||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne 'pasmāracikitsitaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||10 | |

ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.11.1 |  athātaḥ kṣatakṣīṇacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.11.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.11.3 |  udārakīrtirbrahmarṣirātreyaḥ paramārthavit|
kṣatakṣīṇacikitsārthamidamāha cikitsitam||
6.11.4 |  dhanuṣā++āyasyato 'tyarthaṃ bhāramudvahato gurum|
patato viṣamoccebhyo balibhiḥ saha yudhyataḥ||
6.11.5 |  vṛṣaṃ hayaṃ vā dhāvantaṃ damyaṃ vā 'nyaṃ nigṛhṇataḥ|
śilākāṣṭhāśmanirghātān kṣipato nighnataḥ parān||
6.11.6 |  adhīyānasya vā 'tyuccairdūraṃ vā vrajato drutam|
mahānadīṃ vā tarato hayairvā saha dhāvataḥ||
6.11.7 |  sahasotpatato *dūraṃ tūrṇaṃ cātipranṛtyataḥ|
tathā 'nyaiḥ karmabhiḥ krūrairbhṛśamabhyāhatasya ca||
6.11.8 |  vikṣate vakṣasi vyādhirbalavān samudīryate|
strīṣu cātiprasaktasya rūkṣālpapramitāśinaḥ||
6.11.9 |  uro virujyate tasya bhidyate 'tha vibhajyate|
prapīḍyete tataḥ pārśve śuṣyatyaṅgaṃ pravepate||
6.11.10 |  kramādvīryaṃ balaṃ varṇo ruciragniśca hīyate|
jvaro vyathā manodainyaṃ viḍbhedo 'gnivadhādapi||
6.11.11 |  duṣṭaḥ śyāvaḥ sudurgandhaḥ pīto vigrathito bahuḥ|
kāsamānasya *ca śleṣmā saraktaḥ saṃpravartate||
6.11.12 |  sa kṣataḥ kṣīyate 'tyarthaṃ tathā śukraujasoḥ kṣayāt|
avyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya pūrvarūpamiti smṛtam||
6.11.13 |  urorukśoṇitacchardiḥ kāso vaiśeṣikaḥ kṣate|
kṣīṇe saraktamūtratvaṃ pārśvapṛṣṭhakaṭigrahaḥ||
6.11.14 |  alpaliṅgasya dīptāgneḥ sādhyo balavato navaḥ|
parisaṃvatsaro yāpyaḥ sarvaliṅgaṃ tu varjayet||
6.11.15 |  uro matvā kṣataṃ lākṣāṃ payasā madhusaṃyutām|
sadya eva pibejjīeṇe payasā 'dyāt saśarkaram||
6.11.16 |  pārśvabastirujī cālpapittāgnistāṃ surāyutām|
bhinnaviṭkaḥ samustātiviṣāpāṭhāṃ savatsakām||
6.11.17 |  lākṣāṃ sarpirmadhūcchiṣṭaṃjī vanīyagaṇaṃ sitām|
tvakkṣīrīṃ samitāṃ kṣīre paktvā dīptānalaḥ pibet||
6.11.18 |  ikṣvālikābisagranthipadmakeśaracandanaiḥ|
śṛtaṃ payo madhuyutaṃ sandhānārthaṃ pibet kṣatī||
6.11.19 |  yavānāṃ cūrṇamādāya kṣīrasiddhaṃ ghṛtaplutam|
jvare dāhe sitākṣaudrasaktūn vā payasā pibet||
6.11.20 |  madhūkamadhukadrākṣātvakkṣīrīpippalībalāḥ|
kāsī pārśvāsthiśūlī ca lihyātsaghṛtamākṣikāḥ||
6.11.21 |  elāpatratvaco 'rdhākṣāḥ pippalyardhapalaṃ tathā|
sitāmadhukakharjūramṛdvīkāśca palonmitāḥ||
6.11.22 |  saṃcūrṇya madhunā yuktā guṭikāḥ saṃprakalpayet|
akṣamātrāṃ tataścaikāṃ bhakṣayennā dine dine||
6.11.23 |  kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ hikkāṃ chardiṃ mūrcchāṃ madaṃ bhramam|
raktaniṣṭhīvanaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ pārśvaśūlamarocakam||
6.11.24 |  śoṣaplīhāḍhyavātāṃśca svarabhedaṃ kṣataṃ kṣayam|
guṭikā tarpaṇī vṛṣyā raktapittaṃ ca nāśayet||
ityelādiguṭikā|
6.11.25 |  rakte 'tivṛtte dakṣāṇḍaṃ yūṣaistoyena vā pibet|
caṭakāṇḍarasaṃ vā 'pi raktaṃ vā chāgajāṅgalam||
6.11.26 |  cūrṇaṃ paunarnavaṃ raktaśālitaṇḍulaśarkaram|
raktaṣṭhīvī pibet siddhaṃ drākṣārasapayoghṛtaiḥ||
6.11.27 |  madhūkamadhukakṣīrasiddhaṃ vā taṇḍulīyakam|
mūḍhavātastvajāmedaḥ surābhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam||
6.11.28 |  kṣāmaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kṣatoraskastvanidraḥ sabale 'nile|
śṛtakṣīrasareṇādyāt sakṣaudraghṛtaśarkaram||
6.11.29 |  śarkarāṃ yavagodhūmau jīvakarṣabhakau madhu|
śṛtakṣīrānupānaṃ vā lihyāt kṣīṇaḥ kṣatī kṛśaḥ||
6.11.30 |  kravyādamāṃsaniryūhaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ pibecca saḥ|
pippalīkṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ māṃsaśoṇitavardhanam||
6.11.31 |  nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣaśālapriyaṅgubhiḥ|
tālamastakajambūtvakpriyālaiśca sapadmakaiḥ||
6.11.32 |  sāśvakarṇaiḥ śṛtāt kṣīrādadyājjātena sarpiṣā|
śālyodanaṃ kṣatoraskaḥ kṣīṇaśukraśca mānavaḥ||
6.11.33 |  yaṣṭyāhvanāgabalayoḥ kvāthe kṣīrasamaṃ ghṛtam|
payasyāpippalīvāṃśīkalkasiddhaṃ kṣate śubham||
6.11.34 |  kolalākṣārase tadvat kṣīrāṣṭaguṇasādhitam|
kalkaiḥ kaṭvaṅgadārvītvagvatsakatvakphalairghṛtam||
6.11.35 |  jīvakarṣabhakau vīrāṃ jīvantīṃ nāgaraṃ śaṭīm|
catasraḥ parṇinīrmede kākolyau dve nidigdhike||
6.11.36 |  punarnave dve madhukamātmaguptāṃ śatāvarīm|
ṛddhiṃ parūṣakaṃ bhārgīṃ būhatīṃ tathā||
6.11.37 |  śṛṅgāṭakaṃ tāmalakīṃ payasyāṃ pippalīṃ balām|
badarākṣoṭakharjūravātāmābhiṣukāṇyapi||
6.11.38 |  phalāni caivamādīni kalkān kurvīta kārṣikān|
dhātrīrasavidārīkṣucchāgamāṃsarasaṃ payaḥ||
6.11.39 |  kuryāt prasthonmitaṃ tena ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
prasthārdhaṃ madhunaḥ śīte śarkarārdhatulāṃ tathā||
6.11.40 |  *dvikārṣikāṇi patrailāhematvaṅnaricāni ca|
vinīya cūrṇitaṃ tasmāllihyānmātrāṃ sadā naraḥ||
6.11.41 |  amṛtaprāśamityetannarāṇāmamṛtaṃ ghṛtam|
sudhāmṛtarasaṃ prāśyaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasāśinā||
6.11.42 |  naṣṭaśukrakṣatakṣīṇadurbalavyādhikarśitān|
strīprasaktān kṛśān varṇasvarahīnāṃśca bṛṃhayet||
6.11.43 |  kāsahikkājvaraśvāsadāhatṛṣṇāsrapittanut|
putradaṃ vamimūrcchāhṛdyonimūtrāmayāpaham||
ityamṛtaprāśaghṛtam|
6.11.44 |  śvadaṃṣṭrośīramañjiṣṭhābalākāśmaryakattṛṇam|
darbhamūlaṃ pṛthakparṇīṃ palāśarṣabhakau sthirām||
6.11.45 |  palikaṃ sādhayetteṣāṃ rase kṣīracaturguṇe|
kalakaḥ svaguptājīvantīmedarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ||
6.11.46 |  śatāvaryṛddhimṛdvīkāśarkarāśrāvaṇībisaiḥ|
prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtādvātapittahṛddra(dbha)vaśūlanut||
6.11.47 |  mūtrakṛcchrapramehārśaḥkāsaśoṣakṣayāpahaḥ|
dhanuḥstrīmadyabhārādhvasvinnānāṃ balamāṃsadaḥ||
iti śvadaṃṣṭrādighṛtam|
6.11.48 |  madhukāṣṭapaladrākṣāprasthakvāthe ghṛtaṃ pacet|
pippalyaṣṭapale kalke prasthaṃ siddhe ca śītale||
6.11.49 |  pṛthagaṣṭapalaṃ kṣaudraśarkarābhyāṃ vimiśrayet|
samasaktu kṣatakṣīṇe raktagulme ca taddhitam||
6.11.50 |  dhātrīphalavidārīkṣujīvanīyarasairghṛtam|
ajāgopayasoścaiva sapta prasthān pacedbhiṣak||
6.11.51 |  siddhaśīte sitākṣaudradviprasthaṃ vinayecca tat|
yakṣmāpasmārapittāsṛkkāsamehakṣayāpaham||
6.11.52 |  vayaḥsthāpanamāyuṣyaṃ māṃsaśukrabalapradam|
ghṛtaṃ tu pitte 'bhyadhike lihyādvāte 'dhike pibet||
6.11.53 |  līḍhaṃ nirvāpayet pittamalpatvāddhanti nānalam|
ākrāmatyanilaṃ pītamūṣmāṇaṃ niruṇaddhi ca||
6.11.54 |  kṣāmakṣīṇakṛśāṅgānāmetānyeva ghṛtāni tu|
*tvakkṣīrīśarkarālājacūrṇaiḥ styānāni yojayet||
6.11.55 |  sarpirguḍān samadhvaṃśāñjagdhvā cānu payaḥ pibet|
reto vīryaṃ balaṃ puṣṭiṃ tairāśutaramāpnuyāt||
iti sarpirguḍāḥ|
6.11.56 |  balā vidārī hrasvā ca pañcamūlī punarnavā|
pañcānāṃ kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ śuṅgā muṣṭyaṃśakā api||
6.11.57 |  eṣāṃ kaṣāye dvikṣīre vidāryājarasāṃśike|
jīvanīyaiḥ pacet kalkairakṣamātrairghṛtāḍhakam||
6.11.58 |  sitāpalāni pūte ca śīte dvātriṃśataṃ kṣipet|
godhūmapippalīvāṃśīcūrṇaṃ śṛṅgāṭakasya ca||
6.11.59 |  samākṣikaṃ kauḍavikaṃ tat sarvaṃ khajamūrcchitam|
styānaṃ sarpirguḍān kṛtvā bhūrjapatreṇa veṣṭayet||
6.11.60 |  tāñjagdhvā palikān kṣīraṃ madyaṃ vā 'nupibet kaphe|
śoṣe kāse kṣate kṣīṇe śramastrībhārakarśite||
6.11.61 |  raktaniṣṭhīvane tāpe pīnase corasi sthite|
śastāḥ pārśvaśiraḥśūle bhede ca svaravarṇayoḥ||
iti dvitīyasarpirguḍāḥ|
6.11.62 |  tvakkṣīrīśrāvaṇīdrākṣāmūrvarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ|
vīrardhikṣīrakākolībṛhatīkapikacchrubhiḥ||
6.11.63 |  kharjūraphalamedābhiḥ kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ palonmitaiḥ|
dhātrīvidārīkṣurasaprasthaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet||
6.11.64 |  śarkarārdhatulāṃ śīte kṣaudrārdhaprasthameṛva ca|
dattvā sarpirguḍān kuryātkāsahikkājvarāpahān||
6.11.65 |  yakṣmāṇaṃ tamakaṃ śvāsaṃ raktapittaṃ halīmakam|
śukranidrākṣayaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ hanyuḥ kārśyaṃ sakāmalam||
iti tṛtīyāḥ sarpirguḍāḥ|
6.11.66 |  navamāmalakaṃ drākṣāmātmaguptāṃ punarnavām|
śatāvarīṃ vidārīṃ ca samaṅgāṃ pippalīṃ tathā||
6.11.67 |  pṛthagdaśapalān bhāgān palānyaṣṭau ca nāgarāt|
yaṣṭyāhvasauvarcalayordvipalaṃ maricasya ca||
6.11.68 |  kṣīratailaghṛtānāṃ ca tryāḍhake śarkarāśate|
kvathite tāni cūrṇāni dattvā bilvasamān guḍān||
6.11.69 |  kuryāttān bhakṣayet kṣīṇaḥ kṣataḥ śuṣkaśca mānavaḥ|
tena sadyo rasādīnāṃ vṛddhyā puṣṭiṃ sa vindati||
iti caturthasarpirguḍāḥ|
6.11.70 |  gokṣīrārdhāḍhakaṃ sarpiḥ prasthamikṣurasāḍhakam|
vidāryāḥ svarasātprasthaṃ rasātprasthaṃ ca taittirāt||
6.11.71 |  dadyāt sidhyati tasmiṃstu piṣṭānikṣurasairimān|
madhūkapuṣpakuḍavaṃ priyālakuḍavaṃ tathā||
6.11.72 |  kuḍavārdhaṃ tugākṣīryāḥ kharjūrāṇāṃ ca viṃśatim|
pṛthagbibhītakānāṃ ca pippalyāśca caturthikām||
6.11.73 |  triṇśatpalāni khaṇḍācca madhukāt karṣameva ca|
tathā 'rdhapalikānyatra jīvanīyāni dāpayet||
6.11.74 |  siddhe 'smin kuḍavaṃ kṣaudraṃ śīte kṣiptvā 'tha modakān|
kārayenmaricājājīpalacūrṇāvacūrṇitān||
6.11.75 |  vātāsṛkpittarogeṣu kṣatakāsakṣayeṣu ca|
śuṣyatāṃ kṣīṇaśukrāṇāṃ rakte corasi saṃsthite||
6.11.76 |  kṛśadurbalavṛddhānāṃ puṣṭivarṇabalārthinām|
yonidoṣakṛtasrāvahatānāṃ cāpi yoṣitām||
6.11.77 |  garbhārthinīnāṃ garbhaśca sravedyāsāṃ mriyeta vā|
dhanyā balayā hitāstābhyaḥ śukraśoṇitavardhanāḥ||
iti pañcasarpirmodakāḥ|
6.11.78 |  bastideśe vikurvāṇe strīprasaktasya mārute|
vātaghnān bṛṃhaṇān vṛṣyān yogāṃstasya prayojayet||
6.11.79 |  śarkarāpippalīcūrṇaiḥ sarpiṣā mākṣikeṇa ca|
saṃyuktaṃ vā śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet kāsajvarāpaham||
6.11.80 |  phalāmlaṃ sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭaṃ vidārīkṣurase śṛtam|
strīṣu kṣīṇaḥ pibedyūṣaṃ jīvanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ param||
6.11.81 |  saktūnāṃ vastrapūtānāṃ manthaṃ kṣaudraghṛtānvitam|
*yavānnasātmyo dīptāgniḥ kṣatakṣīṇaḥ pibennaraḥ||
6.11.82 |  jīvanīyopasiddhaṃ vā jāṅgalaṃ ghṛtabharjitam|
rasaṃ prayojayet kṣīṇe vyañjanārthaṃ saśarkaram||
6.11.83 |  gomahiṣyaśvanāgājaiḥ kṣīrairmāṃsarasaistathā|
*yavānnaṃ bhojayedyūṣaiḥ phalāmlairghṛtasaṃskṛtaiḥ||
6.11.84 |  dīpte 'gnau vidhireṣaḥ syānmande dīpanapācanaḥ|
yakṣmiṇāṃ vihito grāhī bhinne śakṛti ceṣyate||
6.11.85 |  palikaṃ saindhavaṃ śuṇṭhī dve ca sauvarcalāt pale|
kuḍavāṃśāni vṛkṣāmlaṃ dāḍimaṃ patramarjakāt||
6.11.86 |  ekaikaṃ maricājājyordhānyakāddve caturthike|
śarkarāyāḥ palānyatra daśa dve ca pradāpayet||
6.11.87 |  kṛtvā cūrṇamato mātrāmannapāne prayojayet|
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ balyaṃ pārśvārtiśvāsakāsanut||
iti saindhavādicūrṇam|
6.11.88 |  ekā ṣoḍaśikā dhānyāddve dve 'jājyajamodayoḥ|
tābhyāṃ dāḍimavṛkṣāmlaṃ dvirdviḥ sauvarcalātpalam||
6.11.89 |  śuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaṃ dadhitthasya madhyāt pañca palāni ca|
taccūrṇaṃ ṣoḍaśapale  śarkarāyā vimiśrayet||
6.11.90 |  ṣāḍavo 'yaṃ pradeyaḥ syādannapāneṣu pūrvavat|
mandānale śakṛdbhede yakṣmiṇāmagnivardhanaḥ||
iti ṣāḍavaḥ|
6.11.91 |  pibennāgabalāmūla-*mardhakarṣavivardhitam|
palaṃ kṣīrayutaṃ māsaṃ kṣīravṛttiranannabhuk||
6.11.92 |  eṣa prayogaḥ puṣṭyāyurbalārogyakaraḥ paraḥ|
maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ kalyo 'yaṃ śuṇṭhīmadhukayostathā||
6.11.93 |  yadyat saṃtarpaṇaṃ śītamavidāhi hitaṃ laghu|
annapānaṃ niṣevyaṃ tatkṣatakṣīṇaiḥ sukhārthibhiḥ||
6.11.94 |  yaccoktaṃ yakṣmiṇāṃ pathyaṃ kāsināṃ raktapittinām|
tacca kuryādavekṣyāgniṃ vyādhiṃ sātmyaṃ balaṃ tathā||
6.11.95 |  upṃkṣite bhavettasminnanubandho hi yakṣmaṇaḥ|
prāgevāgamanāttasya tasmāttaṃ tvarayā jayet||
6.11.96 |  tatra ślokau---
kṣatakṣayasamutthānaṃ sāmānyapṛthagākṛtim|
asādhyayāpyasādhyatvaṃ sādhyānāṃ siddhimeva ca||
6.11.97 |  uktavāñjyeṣṭhaśiṣyāya kṣatakṣiṇacikitsite|
tattvārthavi-*dvītarajastamodoṣaḥ punarvasuḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre 'prāpte dṛḍhabalapūrite cikitsitasthāne kṣatakṣīṇacikitsitaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||11 | |


dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.12.1 |  athātaḥ śvayathucikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.12.2 |  iti ha smāha bhāgavānātreyaḥ||
6.12.3 |  bhiṣagvariṣṭhaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭaṃ munīndramatryātmajamagniveśaḥ|
mahāgadasya śvayathoryathāvat prakoparūpapraśamānapṛcchat||
6.12.4 |  tasmai jagādāgadavedasindhupravartanādripravaro 'trijastān|
vātādibhedāttrividhasya samyaṅnijānijaikāṅgajasarvajasya||
6.12.5 |  śuddhyāmayābhaktakṛśābalānāṃ kṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇagurūpasevā|
dadhyāmamṛcchākavirodhiduṣṭagaropasṛṣṭānnaniṣevaṇaṃ ca||
6.12.6 |  arśāṃsyaceṣṭā na ca dehaśuddhirmarmopaghāto viṣamā prasūtiḥ|
mithyopacāraḥ pratikarmaṇāṃ ca nijasya hetuḥ śvayathoḥ pradiṣṭaḥ||
6.12.7 |  bāhyāstvaco dūṣayitā 'bhighātaḥ *kāṣṭhāśmaśastrāgniviṣāyasādyaiḥ|
āgantuhetuḥ trividho nijaśca sarvārdhagātrāvayavāśritatvāt||
6.12.8 |  bāhyāḥ sirāḥ prāpya yadā kaphāsṛkpittāni saṃdūṣayatīha vāyuḥ|
tairbaddhamārgaḥ sa tadā visarpannutsedhaliṅgaṃ śvayathuṃ karoti||
6.12.9 |  *uraḥsthitairūrdhvamadhustu vāyoḥ sthānasthitairmadhyagataistu madhye|
sarvāṅgagaḥ sarvagataiḥ kvacitsthairdoṣaiḥ kvacit syācchvayathustadākhyaḥ||
6.12.10 |  ūṣmā tathā syāddavathuḥ sirāṇāmāyāma ityeva ca pūrvarūpam|
sarvastridoṣo 'dhikadoṣaliṅgaistacchabdamabhyeti bhiṣagjitaṃ ca||
6.12.11 |  sagauravaṃ syādanavasthitatvaṃ sotsedhamuṣmā 'tha sirātanutvam|
salomaharṣā 'ṅgavivarṇatā ca sāmānyaliṅgaṃ śvayathoḥ pradiṣṭam||
6.12.12 |  calastanutvakparuṣo 'ruṇo 'sitaḥ prasuptiharṣārtiyuto 'nimittataḥ|
praśāmyati pronnamati prapīḍito divābalī ca śvayathuḥ samīraṇāt||
6.12.13 |  mṛduḥ sagandho 'sitapītarāgavān bhramajvarasvedatṛṣāmadānvitaḥ|
ya uṣyate *sparśarugakṣirāgakṛt sa pittaśotho bhṛśadāhapākavān||
6.12.14 |  guruḥ sthiraḥ pāṇḍurarocakānvitaḥ prasekanidrāvamivahnimāndyakṛt|
sa kṛcchrajanmapraśamo nipīḍito na connamedrātribalī kaphātmakaḥ||
6.12.15 |  kṛśasya rogairabalasya yo bhavedupadravairvā vamipūrvakairyutaḥ|
sa hanti marmānugato 'tha rājimān parisraveddhīnabalasya sarvagaḥ||
6.12.16 |  ahīnamāṃsasya ya ekadoṣajo navo balasthasya sukhaḥ sa sādhane|
nidānadoṣartuviparyayakramairupācarettaṃ baladoṣakālavit||
6.12.17 |  athāmajaṃ laṅghanapācanakramairviśodhanairulbaṇadoṣamāditaḥ|
śirogataṃ *śīrṣavirecanairadho virecanairūrdhvaharaistathordhvajam||
6.12.18 |  upācaret snehabhavaṃ virūkṣaṇaiḥ prakalpayet snehavidhiṃ ca rūkṣaje|
vibaddhaviṭke 'nilaje nirūhaṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ tu pittānilaje satiktakam||
6.12.19 |  payaśca mūrcchāratidāhatarṣite viśodhanīye tu samūtramiṣyate|
kaphotthitaṃ kṣārakaṭūṣṇasaṃyutaiḥ samūtratakrāsavayuktibhirjayet||
6.12.20 |  grāmyābjānūpaṃ piśitamabalaṃ śuṣkaśākaṃ navānnaṃ gauḍaṃ piṣṭānnaṃ dadhi *tilakṛtaṃ *vijjalaṃ madyamamlam|
dhānā vallūraṃ samaśanamatho gurvasātmyaṃ vidāhi svapnaṃ cārātrau śvayathugadavān varjayenmaithunaṃ ca||
6.12.21 |  vyoṣaṃ trivṛttiktakarohiṇī ca sāyorajaskā triphalārasena|
pītaṃ kaphotthaṃ śamayettu śophaṃ gavyena mūtreṇa harītakī ca||
6.12.22 |  harītakīnāgaradevadāru sukhāmbuyuktaṃ sapunarnavaṃ vā|
sarvaṃ pibettriṣvapi mūtrayuktaṃ snātaśca jīrṇe payasā 'nnamadyāt||
6.12.23 |  punarnavānāgaramustakalkān prasthena dhīraḥ payasā 'kṣamātrān|
mayūrakaṃ māgadhikāṃ samūlāṃ sanāgarāṃ vā prapibet savāte||
6.12.24 |  dantītrivṛttryūṣaṇacitrakairvā payaḥ śṛtaṃ doṣaharaṃ pibennā|
dviprasthamātraṃ tu palārdhikaistairardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ pavane sapitte||
6.12.25 |  saśuṇṭhipītadrurasaṃ prayojyaṃ śyāmorubūkoṣaṇasādhitaṃ vā|
tvagdāruvarṣābhumahauṣadairvā guḍūcikānāgaradantibhirvā||
6.12.26 |  saptāhamauṣṭraṃ tvathavā 'pi māsaṃ payaḥ pibedbhojanavārivarjī|
gavyaṃ samūtraṃ mahiṣīpayo vā kṣīrāśano mūtramatho gavāṃ vā||
6.12.27 |  takraṃ pibedvā gurubhinnavarcāḥ savyoṣasauvarcalamākṣikaṃ ca|
guḍābhayāṃ vā guḍanāgaraṃ vā sadoṣabhinnāmavibaddhavarcāḥ||
6.12.28 |  viḍvātasaṅge payasā rasairvā *prāgbhaktamadyādurubūkatailam|
srotovibandhe 'gnirucipraṇāśe madyānyariṣṭāṃśca pibet sujātān||
6.12.29 |  gaṇḍīrabhallātakacitrakāṃśca vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ bṛhatīdvayaṃ ca|
dviprasthikaṃ gomayapāvakena droṇe pacet *kurcikamastunastu||
6.12.30 |  tribhāgaśeṣaṃ ca supūtaśītaṃ droṇena tat prākṛtamastunā ca|
sitopalāyāśca śatena yuktaṃ lipte ghaṭe citrakapippalīnām||
6.12.31 |  vaihāyase sthāpitamādaśāhāt prayojayaṃstadvinihanti śophān|
bhagandarārśaḥkrimikuṣṭhamehān vaivarṇyakārśyānilahikkanaṃ ca||
iti gaṇḍīrādyariṣṭaḥ|
6.12.32 |  kāśmaryadhātrīmaricābhayā-*kṣadrākṣāphalānāṃ ca sapippalīnām|
śataṃ śataṃ *jīrṇaguḍāttulāṃ ca saṃkṣudya kumbhe madhunā pralipte||
6.12.33 |  saptāhamuṣṇe dviguṇaṃ tu śīte sthitaṃ jaladroṇayutaṃ pibennā|
śophān vibandhān kaphavātajāṃśca nihantyariṣṭo 'ṣṭaśato 'gnikṛcca||
ityaṣṭaśato 'riṣṭaḥ|
6.12.34 |  punarnave dve ca bale sapāṭhe *dantīṃ guḍūcīmatha citrakaṃ ca|
nidigdhikāṃ ca triphalāni paktvā droṇāvaśeṣe salile tatastam||
6.12.35 |  pūtvā rasaṃ dve ca guḍāt purāṇāttule madhuprasthayutaṃ suśītam|
māsaṃ nidadhyādghṛtabhājanasthaṃ palle yavānāṃ paratastu māsāt||
6.12.36 |  cūrṇīkṛtairardhapalāṃśikaistaṃ *patratvagelāmaricāmbulohaiḥ|
gandhānvitaṃ kṣaudraghṛtapradigdhe jīrṇe pibed vyādhibalaṃ salīkṣya||
6.12.37 |  hṛtpāṇḍurogaṃ śvayathuṃ pravṛddhaṃ plīhajvarārocakamehagulmān|
bhagandaraṃ baḍjaṭharāṇi kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ grahaṇyāmayakuṣṭhakaṇḍūḥ||
6.12.38 |  śākhānilaṃ baddhapurīṣatāṃ ca hikkāṃ kilāsaṃ ca halīmakaṃ ca|
kṣipraṃ jayedvarṇabalāyurojastejonvito māṃsarasānnabhojī||
iti punarnavādyariṣṭaḥ|
6.12.39 |  phalatrikaṃ dīpyakacitrakau ca sapippalīloharajo viḍaṅgam|
cūrṇīkṛtaṃ kauḍavikaṃ dviraṃśaṃ kṣaudraṃ purāṇasya tulāṃ guḍasya||
6.12.40 |  māsaṃ nidadhyādghṛtabhājanasthaṃ yaveṣu tāneva nihanti rogān|
ye cārśasāṃ paṇḍuvikāriṇāṃ ca proktā hitāḥ śophiṣu te 'pyariṣṭāḥ||
iti triphalādyariṣṭaḥ|
6.12.41 |  kṛṣṇā sapāṭhā gajapippalī ca nidigdhikā citrakanāgare ca|
sapippalīmūlarajanyajājīmustaṃ ca cūrṇaṃ sukhatoyapītam||
6.12.42 |  hanyāttridoṣaṃ cirajaṃ ca śophaṃ kalkaśca bhūnimbamahauṣadhasya|
ayorajastryūṣaṇayāvaśūkacūrṇaṃ ca pītaṃ triphalārasena||
6.12.43 |  kṣāradvayaṃ syāllavaṇāni catvāryayorajo vyoṣaphalatrike ca|
sapippalīmūlaviḍaṅgasāraṃ mustājamodāmaradārubilvam||
6.12.44 |  kaliṅgakāścitrakamūlapāṭhe yaṣṭyāhvayaṃ sātiviṣaṃ palāṃśam|
sahiṅgukarṣaṃ tvaṇuśuṣkacūrṇaṃ droṇaṃ tathā mūlakaśuṇṭhakānām||
6.12.45 |  syādbhasmanastat salilena sādhyamāloḍya yāvadghanamapradagdham|
styānaṃ tataḥ kolasamāṃ tu mātrāṃ kṛtvā suśuṣkāṃ vidhinopayuñjyāt||
6.12.46 |  plīhodaraśvitrahalīmakārśaḥpāṇḍvāmayārocakaśoṣaśophān|
visūcikāgulmagarāśmarīśca saśvāsakāsāḥ praṇudet sakuṣṭhāḥ||
iti kṣāraguḍikā|
6.12.47 |  prayojayedārdrakanāgaraṃ vā tulyaṃ guḍenārdhapalābhivṛddhyā|
mātrā paraṃ pañcapalāni māsaṃ jīrṇe payo yūṣarasāśca bhaktam||
6.12.48 |  gulmodarārśaḥśvayathupramehāñ śvāsapratiśyālasakāvipākān|
sakāmalāśoṣamanovikārān kāsaṃ kaphaṃ caiva jayet prayogaḥ||
6.12.49 |  rasastathaivārdrakanāgarasya peyo 'tha jīrṇe payasā 'nnamadyāt|
*jatvaśmajaṃ ca triphalārasena hanyāttridoṣaṃ śvayathuṃ prasahya||
iti śilājatuprayogaḥ|
6.12.50 |  dvipañcamūlasya pacet kaṣāye kaṃse 'bhayānāṃ ca śataṃ guḍasya|
lehe susiddhe 'tha vinīya cūrṇaṃ vyoṣaṃ trisaugandhyamuṣāsthite ca||
6.12.51 |  prasthārdhamātraṃ madhunaḥ suśīte kiṃcicca cūrṇādapi yavaśūkāt|
ekābhayāṃ prāśya tataśca lehācchuktiṃ nihanti śvayathuṃ pravṛddham||
6.12.52 |  śvāsajvarārocakamehagulmaplīhatridoṣodarapāṇḍurogān|
kārśyāmavātāvasṛgamlapittavaivarṇyamūtrānilaśukradoṣān||
iti kaṃsaharītakī|
6.12.53 |  paṭolamūlāmaradārudantītrāyantipippalyabhayāviśālāḥ|
yaṣṭyāhvayaṃ tiktakarohiṇī ca sacandanā syānniculāni dārvī||
6.12.54 |  karṣonmitaistaiḥ kvathitaḥ kaṣāyo ghṛtena peyaḥ kuḍavena yuktaḥ|
vīsarpadāhajvarasannipātatṛṣṇāviṣāṇi śvayathuṃ ca hanti||
6.12.55 |  *sacitrakaṃ dhānyayavānyajājīsauvarcalaṃ tryūṣaṇavetasāmlam|
bilvāt phalaṃ dāḍimayāvaśūkau sapippalīmūlamathāpi cavyam||
6.12.56 |  piṣṭvā 'kṣamātrāṇi jalāḍhakena paktvā ghṛtaprasthamatha prayuñjyāt|arśāṃsi gulmaṃ śvayathuṃ ca kṛcchraṃ nihanti vahniṃ ca karoti dīptam||
6.12.57 |  pibedghṛtaṃ vā 'ṣṭaguṇāmbusiddhaṃ sacitrakakṣāramudāravīryam|
kalyāṇakaṃ vā 'pi sapañcagavyaṃ tiktaṃ mahadvā 'pyatha tiktakaṃ vā||
6.12.58 |  kṣīraṃ ghaṭe citrakakalkalipte dadhyāgataṃ sādhu vimathya tena|
tajjaṃ ghṛtaṃ citrakamūlagarbhaṃ takreṇa siddhaṃ śvayathughnamagryam||
6.12.59 |  *arśo 'tisārānilagulmamehāṃścaitannihantyagnibalapradaṃ ca|
takreṇa cādyāt saghṛtena tena bhojyāni saddhāmathavā yavāgūm||
iti citrakaghṛtam|
6.12.60 |  jīvantyajājīśaṭipuṣkarāhvaiḥ sakāravīcitrakabilvamadhyaiḥ|
sayāvaśūkairbadarapramāṇairvṛkṣāmlayuktā ghṛtatailabhṛṣṭā||
6.12.61 |  arśo 'tisārānilagulmaśophahṛdrogamandāgnihitā yavāgūḥ|
yā *pañcakolairvidhinaiva tena siddhā bhavet sā ca samā tathaiva||
6.12.62 |  kulatthayūṣaśca sapippalīko maudgaśca satryūṣaṇayāvaśūkaḥ|
rasastathā viṣkirajāṅgalānāṃ sakūrmagodhāśikhiśallakānām||
6.12.63 |  suvarcalā gṛñjanakaṃ paṭolaṃ savāyasīmūlakavetranimbam|
śākārthināṃ śākamiti praśastaṃ bhojye purāṇaśca yavaḥ saśāliḥ||
6.12.64 |  ābhyantaraṃ bheṣajamuktametadvarhirhitaṃ yacchṛṇu tadyathāvat|
snehān pradehān pariṣecanāni svedāṃśca vātaprabalasya kuryāt||
6.12.65 |  śaileyakuṣṭhāgurudārukauntītvakpadmakailāmbupalāśamustaiḥ|
priyaṅguthauṇeyakahemamāṃsītālīśapatraplavapatradhānyaiḥ||
6.12.66 |  śrīveṣṭakadhyāmakapippalībhiḥ spṛkkānakhaiścaiva yathopalābham|
vātānvite 'bhyaṅgamuśanti tailaṃ siddhaṃ supiṣṭairapi ca pradeham||
6.12.67 |  *jalaiśca vāsārkakarañjaśigrukāśmaryapatrārjakajaiśca siddhaiḥ|
*svinno mṛdūṣṇai ravitaptatoyaiḥ snātaśca gandhairanulepanīyaḥ||
6.12.68 |  savetasāḥ kṣīravatāṃ drumāṇāṃ tvacaḥ samañjiṣṭhalatāmṛṇālāḥ|
sacandanāḥ padmakavālakau ca paitte pradehastu satailapākaḥ||
6.12.69 |  āktasya tenāmbu raviprataptaṃ sacandanaṃ sābhayapadmakaṃ ca|
snāne hitaṃ kṣīravatāṃ kaṣāyaḥ kṣīrodakaṃ candanalepanaṃ ca||
6.12.70 |  kaphe tu kṛṣṇāsikatāpurāṇapiṇyākaśigrutvagumāpralepaḥ|
kulatthaśuṇṭhījalamūtrasekaścaṇḍāgurubhyāmanulepanaṃ ca||
6.12.71 |  bibhītakānāṃ phalamadhyalepaḥ sarveṣu dāhārtiharaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ|
yaṣṭyāhvamustaiḥ sakapitthapatraiḥ sacandanaistatpiḍakāsu lepaḥ||
6.12.72 |  rāsnāvṛṣārkatriphalāviḍaṅgaṃ śigrutvaco mūṣikaparṇikā ca|
nimbārjakau vyāghranakhaḥ sadūrvā suvarcalā tiktakarohiṇī ca||
6.12.73 |  sakākamācī bṛhatī sakuṣṭhā punarnavā citrakanāgare ca|
unmardanaṃ śophiṣu mūtrapiṣṭaṃ śastastathā mūlakatoyasekaḥ||
6.12.74 |  śophāstu gātrāvayavāśritā ye te sthānadūṣyākṛtināmabhedāt|
*anekasaṃkhyāḥ katicicca teṣāṃ nidarśanārthaṃ gadato nibodha||
6.12.75 |  doṣāstrayaḥ svaiḥ kupitā nidānaiḥ kurvanti śophaṃ śirasaḥ sughoram|
antargale ghurghurikānvitaṃ ca śālūkamucchvāsanirodhakāri||
6.12.76 |  galasya sandhau cibuke gale ca sadāharāgaḥ *śvasanāsu cograḥ|
śopho bhṛśārtistu *biḍālikā syāddhvyādgale cedvalayīkṛtā sā||
6.12.77 |  syāttāluvidradhyapi dāharāgapākānvitastāluni sā tridoṣāt|
jihvopariṣṭādupajihvikā syāt kaphādadhastādadhijihvikā ca||
6.12.78 |  yo dantamāṃseṣu tu raktapittāt pāko bhavet sopakuśaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ|
syāddantavidradhyapi dantamāṃse śophaḥ kaphācchoṇitasaṃcayotthaḥ||
6.12.79 |  galasya pārśve galagaṇḍa ekaḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhistu gaṇḍaiḥ|
sādhyāḥ smṛtāḥ pīnasapārśvaśūlakāsajvaracchardiyutāstvasādhyāḥ||
6.12.80 |  teṣāṃ sirākāyaśirovirekā dhūmaḥ purāṇasya ghṛtasya pānam|
syāllaṅghanaṃ vaktrabhaveṣu cāpi pragharṣaṇaṃ syāt kavalagrahaśca||
6.12.81 |  aṅgaikadeśeṣvanilādibhiḥ syāt svarūpadhārī sphuraṇaḥ sirābhiḥ|
granthirmahānmāṃsabhavastvanartirmedobhavaḥ snigdhatamaścalaśca||
6.12.82 |  saṃśodhite sveditamaśmakāṣṭhaiḥ sāṅguṣṭhadaṇḍairvilayedapakvam|
vipāṭya coddhṛtya bhiṣak sakośaṃ śastreṇa dagdhvā vraṇavaccikitset||
6.12.83 |  adagdha īṣat pariśeṣitaśca prayāti bhūyo 'pi śanairvivṛddhim|
tasmādaśeṣaḥ kuśalaiḥ samantācchedyo bhavedvīkṣya śarīradeśān||
6.12.84 |  śeṣe kṛte pākavaśena śīryāttataḥ kṣatotthaḥ prasaredvisarpaḥ|
upadravaṃ taṃ pravicārya *tajjñastairbheṣajaiḥ pūrvatarairyathoktaiḥ||
6.12.85 |  *nivārayedādita eva yatnādvidhānavit svasvavidhiṃ vidhāya|
tataḥ krameṇāsya yathāvidhānaṃ vraṇaṃ vraṇajñastvarayā cikitset||
6.12.86 |  vivarjayet kukṣyudarāśritaṃ ca tathā gale marmaṇi saṃśritaṃ ca|
sthūlaḥ kharaścāpi bhavedvivarjyo yaścāpi bālasthavirābalānām||
6.12.87 |  granthyarbudānāṃ ca yato 'viśeṣaḥ pradeśahetvākṛtidoṣadūṣyaiḥ|
tataścikitsedbhiṣagarbudāni vidhānavidgranthicikitsitena||
6.12.88 |  tāmrā *saśūlā piḍakā bhavedyā sā cālajī nāma parisrutāgrā|
śopho+*akṣataścarmanakhāntare syānmāṃsāsradūṣī bhṛśaśīghrapākaḥ||
6.12.89 |  jvarānvitā vaṅkṣaṇakakṣajā yā vartirnirartiḥ kaṭhināyatā ca|
vidārikā sā kaphamārutābhyāṃ teṣāṃ yathādoṣamupakramaḥ syāt||
6.12.90 |  visrāvaṇaṃ piṇḍikayopanāhaḥ pakveṣu caiva vraṇavaccikitsā|
visphoṭakāḥ sarvaśarīragāstu *sphoṭāḥ sarāgajvaratarṣayuktāḥ||
6.12.91 |  yajñopavītapratimāḥ prabhūtāḥ pittānilābhyāṃ janitāstu *kakṣāḥ|
yaścāparāḥ syuḥ piḍakāḥ prakīrṇāḥ sthūlāṇumadhyā api pittajāstāḥ||
6.12.92 |  kṣudrapramāṇāḥ piḍakāḥ śarīre sarvāṅgagāḥ sajvaradāhatṛṣṇāḥ|
kaṇḍūyutāḥ sārucisaprasekā romāntikāḥ pittakaphāt pradiṣṭāḥ||
6.12.93 |  yāḥ sarvagātreṣu masūramātrā masūrikāḥ pittakaphāt pradiṣṭāḥ|
vīsarpaśāntyai vihitā kriyā yā tāṃ *teṣu kuṣṭhe ca hitāṃ vidadhyāt||
6.12.94 |  *bradhno 'nilādyairvṛṣaṇe svaliṅgairantraṃ nireti praviśenmuhuśca|
mūtreṇa pūrṇaṃ mṛdu medasā cet snigdhaṃ ca vidyāt kaṭhinaṃ ca śotham||
6.12.95 |  virecanābhyaṅganiruhalepāḥ pakveṣu caiva vraṇavaccikitsā|
*syānmūtrasekaḥ kaphajaṃ vipaṭhya viśodhya sīvyedvraṇavacca pakvam||
6.12.96 |  *krimyasthisūkṣmakṣaṇanavyavāyapravāhaṇānyutkaṭakāśvapṛṣṭhaiḥ|
gudasya pārśve piḍakā bhṛśārtiḥ pakvaprabhinnā tu bhagandaraḥ syāt||
6.12.97 |  virecanaṃ caiṣaṇapāṭanaṃ ca viśuddhamārgasya ca tailadāhaḥ|
syāt kṣāramūtreṇa *supācitena chinnasya cāsya vraṇavaccikitsā||
6.12.98 |  *jaṅghāsu piṇḍīprapadopariṣṭāt syācchlīpadaṃ māṃsakaphāsradoṣāt|
sirākaphaghnaśca vidhiḥ samagrastatreṣyate sarṣapalepanaṃ ca||
6.12.99 |  mandāstu pittaprabalāḥ praduṣṭā doṣāḥ sutīvraṃ tanuraktapākam|
kurvānti śothaṃ jvaratarṣayuktaṃ visarpaṇaṃ jālakagardabhākhyam||
6.12.100 |  vilaṅghanaṃ raktavimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāyaviśodhanaṃ ca|
dhātrīprayogāñ śiśirān pradehān kuryāt sadā jālakagardabhasya||
6.12.101 |  evaṃviddhāṃścāpyaparān parīkṣyaśothaprakārānanilādiliṅgaiḥ|
śāntiṃ nayeddoṣaharairyathāsvamālepanacchedanabhedadāhaiḥ||
6.12.102 |  prāyo 'bhighātādanilaḥ saraktaḥ śothaṃ sarāgaṃ prakaroti tatra|
vīsarpanunmārutaraktanucca kāryaṃ viṣaghnaṃ viṣaje ca karma||
6.12.(103?)| tatra ślokaḥ---
trividhasya doṣabhedāt sarvārdhāvayavagātrabhedācca|
*śvayathordvividhasya liṅgāni cikitsitaṃ coktam||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne śvayathucikitsitaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||12 | |

trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.13.1 |  athāta udaracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.13.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.13.3 |  siddhavidyādharākīrṇe kailāse nandanopame|
tapyamānaṃ tapastīvraṃ sākṣāddharmamiva sthitam||
6.13.4 |  āyurvedavidāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhiṣagvidyāpravartakam|
punarvasuṃ jitātmānamagniveśo 'bravīdvacaḥ||
6.13.5 |  bhagavannudarairduḥkhairdṛśyante hyārditā narāḥ|
śuṣkavaktrāḥ kṛśairgātrairādhmātodarakukṣayaḥ||
6.13.6 |  pranaṣṭānnibalāhārāḥ sarvaceṣṭāsvanīśvarāḥ|
dīnāḥ pratikriyābhāvājjahato 'sūnanāthavat||
6.13.7 |  teṣāmāyatanaṃ saṃkhyāṃ prāgrūpākṛtibheṣajam|
yathāvacchrotumicchāmi guruṇā samyagīritam||
6.13.8 |  sarvabhūtahitāyarṣiḥ śiṣyeṇaivaṃ pracoditaḥ|
sarvabhūtahitaṃ vākyaṃ vyāhartumupacakrame||
6.13.9 |  agnidoṣānmanuṣyāṇāṃ rogasaṅghāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ|
malavṛddhyā pravartante viśeṣeṇodarāṇi tu||
6.13.10 |  mande 'gnau malinairbhuktairapākāddoṣasaṃcayaḥ|
prāṇāgnyapānān saṃdūṣya mārgānruddhvā 'dharottarān||
6.13.11 |  tvaṅmāṃsāntaramāgamya kukṣimādhmāpayan bhṛśam|
janayatyudaraṃ tasya hetuṃ śṛṇu salakṣaṇam||
6.13.12 |  atyuṣṇalavaṇakṣāravidāhyamlagarāśanāt|
mithyāsaṃsarjanādrūkṣaviruddhāśucibhojanāt||
6.13.13 |  plīhārśograhaṇīdoṣakarśanāt karmavibhramāt|
kliṣṭānāmapratīkārādraukṣyādvegavidhāraṇāt||
6.13.14 |  srotasāṃ dūṣaṇādāmāt saṃkṣobhādatipūraṇāt|
arśobālaśakṛdrodhādantrasphuṭanabhedanāt||
6.13.15 |  atisaṃcitadoṣāṇāṃ pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām|
udarāṇyupajāyante mandāgnīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ||
6.13.16 |  kṣunnāśaḥ svādvatisnigdhagurvannaṃ pacyate cirāt|
bhuktaṃ vidahyate sarvaṃ jīrṇājīrṇaṃ na vetti ca||
6.13.17 |  sahate nātisauhityamīṣacchophaśca pādayoḥ|
śaśvadbalakṣayo 'lpe 'pi vyāyāme śvāsamṛcchati||
6.13.18 |  vṛddhiḥ *purīṣanicayo rūkṣodāvartahetukā|
bastisandhau rugādhmānaṃ vardhate pāṭhyate 'pi ca||
6.13.19 |  ātanyate ca *jaṭharamapi laghvalpabhojanāt|
rājījanma valīnāśa iti liṅgaṃ bhaviṣyatām||
6.13.20 |  ruddhvā svedāmbuvāhīni doṣāḥ srotāṃsi saṃcitāḥ|
prāṇāgnyapānān saṃdūṣya janayantyudaraṃ nṛṇām||
6.13.21 |  kukṣerādhmānamāṭopaḥ śophaḥ pādakarasya ca|
mando 'gniḥ ślakṣṇagaṇḍatvaṃ kārśyaṃ codaralakṣaṇam||
6.13.22 |  pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca plīhabaddhakṣatodakaiḥ|
saṃbhavantyudarāṇyaṣṭau teṣāṃ liṅgāṃ pṛthak śṛṇu||
6.13.23 |  rūkṣālpabhojanāyāsavegodāvartakarśanaiḥ|
vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ kukṣihṛdbastigudamārgagaḥ||
6.13.24 |  hatvā 'gniṃ kaphamuddhūya tena ruddhagatistataḥ|
ācinotyudaraṃ jantostvaṅmāṃsāntaramāśritaḥ||
6.13.25 |  tasya rūpāṇi---kukṣipāṇipādavṛṣaṇaśvayathuḥ, udaravipāṭanam, aniyatau ca vṛddhihrāsau, kukṣipārśvaśūlodāvartāṅgamardaparvabhedaśuṣkakāsakārśyadaurbalyārocakāvipākāḥ, adhogurutvaṃ, vātavarcomūtrasaṅgaḥ, śyāvāruṇatvaṃ ca nakhanayanavadanatvaṅmūtravarcasām, api codaraṃ tanvasitarājīsirāsaṃtatam, āhatamādhmātadṛtiśabdavadbhavati, vāyuścordhvamadhastiryak ca saśūlaśabdaścarati, etadvātodaramiti vidyāt||
6.13.26 |  kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇatīkṣṇāgnyātapasevanaiḥ|
vidāhyadhyaśanājīrṇaiścāśu pittaṃ samācitam||
6.13.27 |  prāpyānilakaphau ruddhvā mārgamunmārgamāsthitam|
nihantyāmāśaye vahniṃ janayatyudaraṃ tataḥ||
6.13.28 |  tasya rūpāṇi---dāhajvaratṛṣṇāmūrcchātīsārabhramāḥ, kaṭukāsyatvaṃ, *haritaharidratvaṃ ca nakhanayanavadanatvaṅmūtravarcasām, api codaraṃ nīlapītahāridraharitatāmrarājīsirāvanaddhaṃ, dahyate, dūyate, dhūpyate, ūṣmāyate, svidyate, klidyate, mṛdusparśaṃ kṣiprapākaṃ ca bhavati; etat pittodaramiti vidyāt||
6.13.29 |  avyāyāmadivāsvapnasvādvatisnigdhapicchilaiḥ|
dadhidugdhaudakānūpamāṃsaiścāpyatisevitaiḥ||
6.13.30 |  kruddhena śleṣmaṇā srotaḥsvāvṛteṣvāvṛto 'nilaḥ|
tameva pīḍayan kuryādudaraṃ *bahirantragaḥ||
6.13.31 |  tasya rūpāṇi---gauravārocakāvipākāṅgamardāḥ, suptiḥ, pāṇipādamuṣkoruśophaḥ, utkleśanidrākāsaśvāsāḥ, śuklatvaṃ ca nakhanayanavadanatvaṅmūtravarcasām; api codaraṃ śuklarājīsirāsaṃtataṃ, guru, stimitaṃ, sthiraṃ, kaṭhinaṃ ca bhavati; etacchleṣmodaramiti vidyāt||
6.13.32 |  durbalāgnerapathyāmavirodhigurubhojanaiḥ|
strīdattaiśca rajoromaviṇmūtrāsthinakhādibhiḥ||
6.13.33 |  viṣaiśca mandairvātādyāḥ kupitāḥ saṃcayaṃ trayaḥ|
śanaiḥ koṣṭhe prakurvanto janayantyudaraṃ nṛṇām||
6.13.34 |  tasya rūpāṇi---sarveṣāmeva doṣāṇāṃ samastāni liṅgānyupalabhyante, varṇāśca sarve nakhādiṣu, udaramapi nānāvarṇarājīsirāsaṃtataṃ bhavati; etat sannipātodaramiti vidyāt||
6.13.35 |  aśitasyātisaṃkṣobhādyānayānāticeṣṭitaiḥ|
ativyavāyabhārādhvavamanavyādhikarśanaiḥ||
6.13.36 |  vāmapārśvāśritaḥ plīhā cyutaḥ sthānāt pravardhate|
śoṇitaṃ vā rasādibhyo vivṛddhaṃ taṃ vivardhayet||
6.13.37 |  tasya plīhā kaṭhino+*aṣṭhīlevādau vardhamānaḥ kacchapasaṃsthāna upalabhyate; sa copekṣitaḥ krameṇa kukṣiṃ jaṭharamagnyadhiṣṭhānaṃ ca parikṣipannudaramabhinirvartayati||
6.13.38 |  tasya rūpāṇi---daurbalyārocakāvipākavarcomūtragrahatamaḥpraveśapipāsāṅgamardacchardimūrcchāṅgasādakāsaśvāsamṛdujvarānāhāgnināśakārśyāsyavairasyaparvabhedakoṣṭhavātaśūlāni, api codaramaruṇavarṇaṃ vivarṇaṃ vā nīlaharitahāridrarājimadbhavati; evameva yakṛdapi dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ kuryāt, tulyahetuliṅgauṣadhatvāttasya plīhajaṭhara evāvarodha iti; etat plīhodaramiti vidyāt||
6.13.39 |  pakṣmabālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktairbaddhāyane gude|
udāvartaistathā 'rśobhirantrasaṃmūrcchanena vā||
6.13.40 |  apāno mārgasaṃrodhāddhatvā 'gniṃ kupito 'nilaḥ|
varcaḥpittakaphān ruddhvā janayatyudaraṃ tataḥ||
6.13.41 |  tasya rūpāṇi---tṛṣṇādāhajvaramukhatāluśoṣorusādakāsaśvāsadaurbalyārocakāvipākavarcomūtrasaṅgādhmānacchardikṣavathuśirohṛnnābhigudaśūlāni, api codaraṃ mūṭhavātaṃ sthiramaruṇaṃ nīlarāji sirāvanaddharājikaṃ vā prāyo nābhyupari gopucchavadabhinirvartata iti; etadbaddhagudodaramiti vidyāt||6.13.42 |  śarkarātṛṇakāṣṭhāsthikaṇṭakairannasaṃyutaiḥ|
bhidyetāntraṃ yadā bhuktairjṛmbhayā 'tyaśanena vā||
6.13.43 |  pākaṃ gacchedrasastebhyaśchidrebhyaḥ prasravadbahiḥ|
pūrayan gudamantraṃ ca janayatyudaraṃ tataḥ||
6.13.44 |  tasya rūpāṇi---tadadho nābhyāḥ prāyo 'bhivardhamānamudakodaraṃ bhavati, yathābalaṃ ca doṣāṇāṃ rūpāṇi darśayati, api cāturaḥ salohitanīlapītapicchilakuṇapagandhyāmavarca upaveśate, hikkāśvāsakāsatṛṣṇāpramehārocakāvipākadaurbalyaparītaśca bhavati; etacchidrodaramiti vidyāt||
6.13.45 |  snehapītasya mandāgneḥ kṣīṇasyātikṛśasya vā|
atyambupānānnaṣṭe 'gnau mārutaḥ klomni saṃsthitaḥ||
6.13.46 |  srotaḥsu ruddhamārgeṣu kaphaścodakamūrcchitaḥ|
vardhayetāṃ tadevāmbu svasthānādudarāya tau||
6.13.47 |  tasya rūpāṇi---anannakāṅkṣāpipāsāgudasrāvaśūlaśvāsakāsadaurbalyāni, api codaraṃ nānāvarṇarājisirāsaṃtatamudakapūrṇadṛtikṣobhasaṃsparśaṃ bhavati, etadudakodaramiti vidyāt||
6.13.48 |  tatra acirotpannamanupadravamanudakamaprāptamudaraṃ tvaramāṇaścikitset; upekṣitānāṃ hyeṣāṃ doṣāḥ svasthānādapavṛttā paripākāddravībhūtāḥ sandhīn srotāṃsi copakledayanti, svedaśca bāhyeṣu srotaḥsu pratihatagatistaryagavatiṣṭhamānastadevodakamāpyāyayati; tatra piccotpattau maṇḍalamudaraṃ guru stimitamākoṭhitamaśabdaṃ mṛdusparśamapagatarājīkamākrāntaṃ nābhyāmevopasarpati|
tato 'nantaramudakaprādurbhāvaḥ|
tasya rūpāṇi---kukṣeratimātravṛddhiḥ, sirāntardhanagamanam, udakapūrṇadṛtisaṃkṣobhasaṃsparśatvaṃ ca||
6.13.49 |  tadā++āturamupadravāḥ spṛśanti---chardyatīsāratamakatṛṣṇāśvāsakāsahikkādaurbalyapārśvaśūlarucisvaramedamūtrasaṅgādayaḥ; tathāvidhamacikitsyaṃ vidyāditi||
6.13.50 |  bhavanti cātra---
vātātpittātkaphāt plīhnaḥ sannipātāttathodakāt|
paraṃ paraṃ kṛcchrataramudaraṃ bhiṣagādiśet||
6.13.51 |  pakṣādbaddhagudaṃ tūrdhvaṃ sarvaṃ jātodakaṃ tathā|
prāyo bhavatyabhāvāya cchidrāntraṃ codaraṃ nṛṇām||
6.13.52 |  śūnākṣaṃ kuṭilopasthamupaklinnatanutvacam|
balaśoṇitamāṃsāgniparikṣīṇaṃ ca varjayet||
6.13.53 |  śvayathuḥ sarvamarmotthaḥ śvāso hikkā 'ruciḥ satṛṭ|
mūrcchā cchardiratīsāro nihantyudariṇaṃ naram||
6.13.54 |  janmanaivodaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchratamaṃ matam|
balinastadajātāmbu yatnasādhyaṃ navotthitam||
6.13.55 |  *ajātaśothamaruṇaṃ saśabdaṃ nātibhārikam|
sadā *guḍaguḍāyacca sirājālagavākṣitam||
6.13.56 |  nābhiṃ viṣṭabhya *pāyau tu vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati|
hṛnnābhivaṅkṣaṇakaṭīgudapratyekaśūlinaḥ||
6.13.57 |  karkaśaṃ sṛjayo vātaṃ nātimande ca pāvake|
*lolasyāvirase cāsye mūtre 'lpe saṃhate viṣi||
6.13.58 |  ajātodakamityetairliṅgairvijñāya tattvataḥ|
upākramidbhiṣagdoṣabalakālaviśeṣavit||
6.13.59 |  vātodaraṃ balamataḥ pūrvaṃ snehairupācaret|
snigdhāya sveditāṅgāya dadyāt snehavirecanam||
6.13.60 |  hṛte doṣe parimlānaṃ veṣṭayedvāsasodaram|
tathā 'syānavakāśatvādvāyurnādhmāpayet punaḥ||
6.13.61 |  doṣātimātropacayāt srotomārganirodhanāt|
saṃbhavatyudaraṃ tasmānnityameva virecayet||
6.13.62 |  śuddhaṃ saṃsṛjya ca kṣīraṃ balārthaṃ pāyayettu tam|
prāgutkleśānnivartyaṃ ca bale labdhe kramāt payaḥ||
6.13.63 |  yūṣai rasairvā mandāmlalavaṇairedhitānalam|
sodāvartaṃ punaḥ snigdhaṃ svinnamāsthāpayennaram||
6.13.64 |  sphuraṇākṣepasandhyasthipārśvapṛṣṭhatrikārtiṣu|
dīptāgniṃ baddhaviṅvātaṃ rūkṣamapyanuvāsayet||
6.13.65 |  tīkṣṇādhobhāgayukto 'sya virūho dāśamūlikaḥ|
vātaghnāmlaśṛtairaṇḍatilatailānuvāsanam||
6.13.66 |  avirecyaṃ tu yaṃ vidyāddurbalaṃ sthaviraṃ śiśum|
sukumāraṃ prakṛtyā 'lpadoṣaṃ vā 'tholbaṇānilam||
6.13.67 |  taṃ bhiṣak śamanaiḥ sarpiryūṣamāṃsarasaudanaiḥ|
bastyabhyaṅgānuvāsaiśca kṣīraiścopācaredbudhaḥ||
6.13.68 |  pittodare tu balinaṃ pūrvameva virenayet|
durbalaṃ tvanuvāsyādau śodhayet kṣīrabastinā||
6.13.69 |  saṃjātabalakāyāgniṃ punaḥ snigdhaṃ virecayet|
payasā satrivṛtkalkenorubūkaśṛtena vā||
6.13.70 |  sātalātrāyamāṇābhyāṃ śṛtenāragvadhena vā|
sakaphe vā samūtreṇa savāte tiktasarpiṣā||
6.13.71 |  punaḥ kṣīraprayogaṃ ca bastikarma virecanam|
krameṇa dhruvamātiṣṭhan yuktaḥ pittodaraṃ jayet||
6.13.72 |  snigdhaṃ svinnaṃ viśuddhaṃ tu kaphodariṇamāturam|
saṃsarjayet kaṭukṣārayuktairannaiḥ kaphāpahaiḥ||
6.13.73 |  gomūtrāriṣṭapānaiśca cūrṇāyaskṛtibhistathā|
sakṣāraistailapānaiśca śamayettu kaphodaram||
6.13.74 |  sannipātodare sarvā yathoktāḥ kārayet kriyāḥ|
sopadravaṃ tu nirvṛttaṃ pratyākhyeyaṃ vijānatā||
6.13.75 |  udāvartarujānāhairdāhamohatṛṣājvaraiḥ|
gauravārucikāṭhinyaiścānilādīn yathākramam||
6.13.76 |  liṅgaiḥ *plīhnyadhikān dṛṣṭvā raktaṃ cāpi svalakṣaṇaiḥ|
cikitsāṃ saṃprakurvīta yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam||
6.13.77 |  snehaṃ svedaṃ virekaṃ ca nirūhamanuvāsanam|
samīkṣya kārayedbāhau vāne vā vyadhayet sirām||
6.13.78 |  ṣaṭpalaṃ pāyayet sarpiḥ pippalīrvā prayojayet|
saguḍāmabhayāṃ vā 'pi kṣārāriṣṭagaṇāṃstathā||
6.13.79 |  eṣa kriyākramaḥ prokto yogān saṃśamanāñchṛṇu|
pippalī nāgaraṃ dantī citrakaṃ dviguṇābhayam||
6.13.80 |  viḍaṅgāṃśayutaṃ cūrṇametaduṣṇāmbunā pibet|
viḍaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ saghṛtāṃ saindhavaṃ vacām||
6.13.81 |  dagdhvā kapāle payasā gulmaplīhāpahaṃ pibet|
rohītakalatānāṃ tu kāṇḍakānabhayājale||
6.13.82 |  mūtre vā sunuyāttacca saptarātrasthitaṃ pibet|
kāmalāgulmamehārśaḥplīhasarvodarakrimīn||
6.13.83 |  sa hanyājjāṅgalarasairjīrṇe syāccātra bhojanam|
rohītakatvacaḥ kṛtvā palānāṃ pañcaviṃśatim||
6.13.84 |  koladviprasthasaṃyuktaṃ kaṣāyamupakalpayet|
palikaiḥ pañcakolaistu taiḥ sarvaiścāpi tulyayā||
6.13.85 |  rohītakatvacā piṣṭairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
plīhābhivṛddhiṃ śamayatyetadāśu prayojitam||
6.13.86 |  tathā gulmodaraśvāsakrimipāṇḍutvakāmalāḥ|
agnikarma ca kurvīta bhiṣagvātakapholbaṇe||
6.13.87 |  paittike jīvanīyāni sarpīṣi kṣīrabastayaḥ|
raktāvasekaḥ saṃśuddhiḥ kṣīrapānaṃ ca śasyate||
6.13.88 |  yūṣairmāṃsarasaiścāpi dīpanīyasamāyutaiḥ|
yakṛti plīhavat sarvaṃ tulyatvādbheṣajaṃ matam||
6.13.89 |  laghūnyannāni saṃsṛjya dadyāt plīhodare bhiṣak|
svinnāya baddhodariṇe mūtratīkṣṇauṣadhānvitam||
6.13.90 |  satailalavaṇaṃ dadyānnirūhaṃ sānuvāsanam|
parisraṃsīni cānnāni tīkṣṇaṃ caiva virecanam||
6.13.91 |  udāvartaharaṃ karma kāryaṃ vātaghnameva ca|
chidrodaramṛte svedācchleṣmodaravadācaret||
6.13.92 |  jātaṃ jātaṃ jalaṃ srāvyamevaṃ tadyāpayedbhiṣak|
tṛṣṇākāsajvarārtaṃ tu kṣīṇamāṃsāgnibhojanam||
6.13.93 |  varjayecchvāsinaṃ tadvacchūlinaṃ durbalendriyam|
apāṃ doṣaharāṇyādau pradadyādudakodare||
6.13.94 |  mūtrayuktāni tīkṣṇāni vividhakṣāravanti ca|
dīpanīyaiḥ kaphaghnaiśca tamāhārairupācaret||
6.13.95 |  dravebhyaścodakādibhyo niyacchedanupūrvaśaḥ|
sarvamevodaraṃ prāyo doṣasaṅghātajaṃ matam||
6.13.96 |  tasmāttridoṣaśamanīṃ kriyāṃ sarvatra kārayet|
doṣaiḥ kukṣau hi sṃpūrṇe vahnirmandatvamṛcchati||
6.13.97 |  tasmādbhojyāni bhojyāni dīpanāni laghūni ca|
raktaśālān yavānmudgāñjāṅgalāṃśca mṛgadvijān||
6.13.98 |  payomūtrāsavāriṣṭānmadhusīdhuṃ tathā surām|
yavāgūmodanaṃ vā 'pi yūṣairadyādrasairapi||
6.13.99 |  mandāmlasnehakaṭubhiḥ pañcamūlopasādhitaiḥ|
audakānūpajaṃ māṃsaṃ śākaṃ piṣṭakṛtaṃ tilān||
6.13.100 |  vyāyāmādhvadivāsvapnaṃ yānayānaṃ ca varjayet|
tathoṣṇalavaṇāmlāni vidāhīni gurūṇi ca||
6.13.101 |  nādyādannāni jaṭharī toyapānaṃ ca varjayet|
nātisāndraṃ hitaṃ pāne svādu takramapelavam||
6.13.102 |  tryūṣaṇakṣāralavaṇairyuktaṃ tu nicayodarī|
vātodarī pibettakraṃ pippalīlavaṇānvitam||
6.13.103 |  *śarkarāmadhukopetaṃ svādu pittodarī pibet|
yavānīsaindhavājājīvyoṣayuktaṃ kaphodarī||
6.13.104 |  pibenmadhuyutaṃ takraṃ *kavoṣṇaṃ nātipelavam|
madhutailavacāśuṇṭhīśatāhvākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ||
6.13.105 |  yuktaṃ plīhodarī jātaṃ savyoṣaṃ tūdakodarī|
baddhodarī tu hapuṣāyavānyajājisaindhavaiḥ||
6.13.106 |  pibecchidrodarī takraṃ pippalīkṣaudrasaṃyutam|
gauravārocakārtānāṃ samandāgnyatisāriṇām||
6.13.107 |  takraṃ vātakaphārtānāmamṛtatvāya kalpate|
śophānāhārtitṛṇmūrcchāpīḍite kārabhaṃ payaḥ||
6.13.108 |  śuddhānāṃ kṣāmadehānāṃ gavyaṃ chāgaṃ samāhiṣam|
devadārupalāśārkahastipippaliśigrukaiḥ||
6.13.109 |  sāśvagandhaiḥ sagomūtraiḥ pradihyādudaraṃ samaiḥ|
vṛścikālīṃ vacāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ pañcamūlīṃ punarnavām||
6.13.110 |  *bhūtīkaṃ nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ jale paktvā 'vasecayet|
palāśaṃ kattṛṇaṃ rāsnāṃ tadvat paktvā 'vasecayet||
6.13.111 |  mūtraṇyaṣṭāvudariṇāṃ seke pāne ca yojayet|
rūkṣāṇāṃ bahuvātānāṃ tathā saṃśodhanārthinām||
6.13.112 |  dīpanīyāni sarpīṃṣi jaṭharaghnāni cakṣmāhe|
pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ||
6.13.113 |  sakṣārairardhapalikairdviprasthaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pacet|
kalkairdvipañcamūlasya tulārdhasvarasena ca||
6.13.114 |  dadhimaṇḍāḍhakopetaṃ tat sarpirjaṭharāpaham|
śvayathuṃ vātaviṣṭambhaṃ gulmārśāṃsi ca nāśayet||
6.13.115 |  nāgaratriphalāprasthaṃ ghṛtatailāttathā++āḍhakam|
mastunaḥ sādhayitvaitat pibet sarvodarāpaham||
6.13.116 |  kaphamārutasaṃbhūte gulme caitat praśasyate|
caturguṇe jale mūtre dviguṇe citrakāt pale||
6.13.117 |  kalke siddhaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ sakṣāraṃ jaṭharī pibet|
yavakolakulatthānāṃ pañcamūlarasena ca||
6.13.118 |  surāsauvīrakābhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ vā 'pi pibedghṛtam|
ebhiḥ snigdhāya saṃjāte bale śānte ca mārute||
6.13.119 |  sraste doṣāśaye dadyāt kalpadiṣṭaṃ virecanam|
paṭolamūlaṃ rajanīṃ rajanīṃ viḍaṅgaṃ triphalātvacam||
6.13.120 |  kampillakaṃ nīlinīṃ ca trivṛtāṃ ceti cūrṇayet|
ṣaḍādyān kārṣikānantyāṃstrīṃśca dvitricaturguṇān||
6.13.121 |  kṛtvā cūrṇamato muṣṭiṃ gavāṃ mūtreṇa nā pibet|
virikto mṛdu bhuñjīta bhojanaṃ jāṅgalai rasaiḥ||
6.13.122 |  maṇḍaṃ peyāṃ ca pītvā nā savyoṣaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ payaḥ|
śṛtaṃ pibettataścūrṇaṃ pibedevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ||
6.13.123 |  hanti sarvodarāṇyetaccūrṇaṃ jātodakānyapi|
kāmalāṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca śvayathuṃ cāpakarṣati||
6.13.124 |  paṭolādyamidaṃ cūrṇamudareṣu prapūjitam|
gavākṣīṃ śaṅkhinīṃ dantīṃ tilvakasya tvacaṃ vacām||
6.13.125 |  pibeddrākṣāmbugomūtrakolakarkandhusīdhubhiḥ|
yavānī hapuṣā dhānyaṃ triphalā copakuñcikā||
6.13.126 |  kāravī pippalīmūlamajagandhā śaṭī vacā|
śatāhvā jīrakaṃ vyoṣaṃ svarṇakṣīri sacitrakā||
6.13.127 |  dvau kṣārau puṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇapañcakam|
viḍaṅgaṃ ca samāṃśāni dantyā bhāgatrayaṃ tathā||
6.13.128 |  trivṛdviśāle dviguṇe sātalā syāccaturguṇā|
etannārāyaṇaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ rogagaṇāpaham||
6.13.129 |  nainat prāpyātivatante rogā viṣṇumivāsurāḥ|
takreṇodaribhiḥ peyaṃ gulmibhirbadarāmbunā||
6.13.130 |  ānaddhavāte surayā vātaroge prasannayā|
dadhimaṇḍena viṭsaṅge dāḍimāmbubhirarśasaiḥ||
6.13.131 |  parikarte savṛkṣāmlamuṣṇāmbubhirajīrṇake|
bhagandare pāṇḍuroge śvāse kāse galagrahe||
6.13.132 |  hṛdroge grahaṇīdoṣe kuṣṭhe mande 'nale jvare|
daṃṣṭrāviṣe mūlaviṣe sagare kṛtrime viṣe||
6.13.133 |  yathārhaṃ snigdhakoṣṭhena peyametadvirecanam|
iti nārāyaṇacūrṇam|
hapuṣāṃ kāñcanakṣīrīṃ triphalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.13.134 |  nīlinīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca sātalāṃ trivṛtāṃ vacām|
saindhavaṃ kālalavaṇaṃ pippalīṃ ceti cūrṇāyet||
6.13.135 |  dāḍimatriphalāmāṃsarasamūtrasukhodakaiḥ|
peyo 'yaṃ sarvagulmeṣu plīhni sarvodareṣu ca||
6.13.136 |  śvitre kuṣṭhe sarujake savāte viṣamāgniṣu|
śothārśaḥpāṇḍurogeṣu kāmalāyāṃ halīmake||
6.13.137 |  vātaṃ pittaṃ kaphaṃ cāśu virekāt saṃprasādhayet|
iti hapuṣādyaṃ cūrṇam|
nīlinīṃ niculaṃ vyoṣaṃ dvau kṣārau lavaṇāni ca||
6.13.138 |  citrakaṃ ca pibeccūrṇaṃ sarpiṣodaragulmanut|
iti nīlinyādyaṃ cūrṇam|
kṣīradroṇaṃ sudhākṣīraprasthārdhasahitaṃ dadhi||
6.13.139 |  jātaṃ vimathya tadyuktyā trivṛtsiddhaṃ pibedghṛtam|
tathā siddhaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ payasyaṣṭaguṇe pibet||
6.13.140 |  snukkṣīrapalakalkena trivṛtāṣaṭpalena ca|
gulmānāṃ garadoṣāṇāmudarāṇāṃ ca śāntaye||
iti snuhīkṣīraghṛtam|
6.13.141 |  dadhimaṇḍāḍhake siddhāt snukkṣīrapalakalkitāt|
ghṛtaprasthāt pibenmātrāṃ tadvajjaṭharaśāntaye||
6.13.142 |  eṣāṃ cānu pibet peyāṃ payo vā svādu vā rasam|
ghṛte jīrṇe viriktastu koṣṇaṃ nāgarakaiḥ śṛtam||
6.13.143 |  pibedambu tataḥ peyāṃ yūṣaṃ kaulatthakaṃ tataḥ|
pibedrūkṣastryahaṃ tvevaṃ *bhūyo vā pratibhojitaḥ||
6.13.144 |  punaḥ punaḥ pibet sarpirānupūrvyā tayaiva ca|
ghṛtānyetāni siddhāni vidadhyāt kuśalo bhiṣak||
6.13.145 |  gulmānāṃ garadoṣāṇāmudarāṇāṃ ca śāntaye|
pilukalkopasiddhaṃ vā ghṛtamānāhabhedanam||
6.13.146 |  gulmaghnaṃ nīlinīsarpiḥ snehaṃ vā miśrakaṃ pibet|
kramānnirhṛtadoṣāṇāṃ *jāṅgalapratibhojinām|
6.13.147 |  doṣaśeṣanivṛttyarthaṃ yogān vakṣyāmyataḥ param|
citrakāmaradārubhyāṃ kalkaṃ kṣīreṇa nā pibet||
6.13.148 |  māsaṃ yuktastathā hastipippalī viśvabheṣajam|
viḍaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ dantī cavyaṃ vyoṣaṃ ca taiḥ payaḥ||
6.13.149 |  kalkaiḥ kolasamaiḥ pītvā pravṛddhamudaraṃ jayet|
pibet kaṣāyaṃ triphalādantīrohitakaiḥ śṛtam||
6.13.150 |  vyoṣakṣārayutaṃ jīrṇe rasairadyāttu jāṅgalaiḥ|
māṃsaṃ vā bhojanaṃ bhojyaṃ sudhākṣīraghṛtānvitam||
6.13.151 |  kṣīrānupānāṃ gomūtreṇābhayāṃ vā prayojayet|
saptāhaṃ māhiṣaṃ mūtraṃ kṣīraṃ cānannabhuk pibet||
6.13.152 |  māsamauṣṭraṃ payaśchāgaṃ trīnmāsān vyoṣasaṃyutam|
harītakīsahasraṃ vā kṣīrāśī vā śilājatu||
6.13.153 |  śilājatuvidhānena gugguluṃ vā prayojayet|
śṛṅgaverārdrakarasaḥ pāne kṣīrasamo hitaḥ||
6.13.154 |  tailaṃ rasena tenaiva siddhaṃ daśaguṇena vā|
dantīdravantīphalajaṃ tailaṃ dūṣyodare hitam||
6.13.155 |  śūlānāhavibandheṣu mastuyūṣarasādibhiḥ|
saralāmadhuśigrūṇāṃ bījebhyo mūlakasya ca||
6.13.156 |  tailānyabhyaṅgapānārthaṃ śūlaghnānyanilodare|
staimityārucihṛllāse mande 'gnau madyapāya ca||
6.13.157 |  ariṣṭān dāpayet kṣārān kaphastyānasthirodare|
śleṣmaṇo vilayārthaṃ tu doṣaṃ vīkṣy bhiṣagvaraḥ||
6.13.158 |  pippalīṃ *tilvakaṃ hiṅgu nāgaraṃ hastipippalīm|
bhallātakaṃ śigruphalaṃ triphalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.13.159 |  devadāru haridre dve saralātiveṣe *vacām|
kuṣṭhaṃ mustaṃ tathā pañca lavaṇāni prakalpya ca||
6.13.160 |  dadhisarpirvasāmajjatailayuktāni dāhayet|
annādūrdhvamataḥ kṣārādbiḍālakapadaṃ pibet||
6.13.161 |  madirādadhimaṇḍoṣṇajalāriṣṭasurāsavaiḥ|
hṛdrogaṃ śvayathuṃ gulmaṃ plīhārśojaṭharāṇi ca||
6.13.162 |  visūcikāmudāvartaṃ vatāṣṭhīlāṃ ca nāśayet|
kṣāraṃ cājakarīṣāṇāṃ srutaṃ mūtrairvipācayet||
6.13.163 |  kārṣikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pañcaiva lavaṇāni ca|
pippalīṃ citrakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ triphalāṃ trivṛtāṃ vacām||
6.13.164 |  dvau kṣārau sātalāṃ dantīṃ svarṇakṣīrīṃ viṣāṇikām|
kolapramāṇāṃ vaṭikāṃ pibet sauvīrasaṃyutām||
6.13.165 |  śvayathāvavipāke ca pravṛddhe ca dakodare|
bhāvitānāṃ gavāṃ mūtre ṣaṣṭikānāṃ tu taṇḍulaiḥ||
6.13.166 |  yavāgūṃ payasā siddhāṃ prakāmaṃ bhojayennaram|
pibedikṣurasaṃ cānu jaṭharāṇāṃ nivṛttaye||
6.13.167 |  svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ vrajantyevaṃ tathā pittakaphānilāḥ|
śaṅkhinīsnuktrivṛddantīcirabilvādipallavaiḥ||
6.13.168 |  *śākaṃ gāḍhapurīṣāya prāgbhaktaṃ dāpayedbhiṣak|
tato 'smai śithilībhūtavarcodoṣāya śāstravit||
6.13.169 |  dadyānmūtrayutaṃ *kṣīraṃ doṣaśeṣaharaṃ śivam|
pārśvaśūlamupastambhaṃ hṛdgrahaṃ cāpi mārutaḥ||
6.13.170 |  janayedyasya taṃ tailaṃ bilvakṣāreṇa pāyayet|
tathā 'gnimanthasyonākapalāśatilanālajaiḥ||
6.13.171 |  balākadalyapāmārgakṣāraiḥ pratyekaśaḥ srutaiḥ|
tailaṃ paktvā bhiṣagdadyādudarāṇāṃ praśāntaye||
6.13.172 |  nivartate codariṇāṃ hṛdgrahaścānilodbhavaḥ|
kaphe vātena pittena tābhyāṃ vā 'pyāvṛte 'nile||
6.13.173 |  balinaḥ svauṣadhayutaṃ tailameraṇḍajaṃ hitam|
suvirikto naro yastu punarādhmāpito bhavet||
6.13.174 |  susnidhairamlalavaṇairnirūhaistamupācaret|
sopastambho 'pi vā vāyurādhmāpayati yaṃ naram||
6.13.175 |  tīkṣṇaiḥ sakṣāragomūtrairbastibhistamupācaret|
kriyātivṛtte jaṭhare tridoṣe cāpraśāmyati||
6.13.176 |  jñātīna sasuhṛdo dārān brāhmaṇānnṛpatīn gurūn|
anujñāpya bhiṣak karma vidadhyāt saṃśayaṃ bruvan||
6.13.177 |  akriyāyāṃ dhruvo mṛtyuḥ kriyāyāṃ saṃśayo bhavet|
evamākhyāya tasyedamanujñātaḥ suhṛdgaṇaiḥ||
6.13.178 |  pānabhojanasaṃyuktaṃ viṣamasmai prayojayet|
yasmin vā kupitaḥ sarpo visṛjeddhi phale viṣam||
6.13.179 |  bhojayettadudariṇaṃ pravicārya bhiṣagvaraḥ|
tenāsya doṣasaṅghātaḥ sthiro līno vimārgagaḥ||
6.13.180 |  viṣeṇāśupramāthitvādāśu bhinnaḥ pravartate|
viṣeṇa hṛtadoṣaṃ taṃ śītāmbupariṣecitam||
6.13.181 |  pāyayeta bhiṣagdugdhaṃ yavāgūṃ vā yathābalam|
trivṛnmaṇḍūkaparṇyośca śākaṃ sayavavāstukam||
6.13.182 |  bhakṣayet kālaśākaṃ vā *svarasodakasādhitam|
niramlalavaṇasnehaṃ svinnāsvinnamanannabhuk||
6.13.183 |  māsamekaṃ tataścaiva tṛṣitaḥ svarasaṃ pibet|
evaṃ vinirhṛte doṣe śākairmāsāt paraṃ tataḥ||
6.13.184 |  durbalāya prayuñjīta prāṇabhṛt kārabhaṃ payaḥ|
idaṃ tu śalyahartṛṛṇāṃ karma syāddṛṣṭakarmaṇām||
6.13.185 |  vāmaṃ kukṣiṃ māpayitvā nābhyadhaścaturaṅgulam|
mātrāyuktena śastreṇa pāṭayenmatimān bhiṣak||
6.13.186 |  vipāṭhyāntraṃ tataḥ paścādvīkṣya baddhakṣatāntrayoḥ|
sarpiṣā 'bhyajya keśādīnavamṛjya vimokṣayet||
6.13.187 |  mūrcchanādyacca saṃmūḍhamantraṃ tacca vimokṣayet|
chidrāṇyantrasya tu sthūlairdaṃśayitvā pipīlikaiḥ||
6.13.188 |  bahuśaḥ saṃgṛhītāni jñātvā cchitvā pipīlikān|
*pratiyogaiḥ praveśyāntraṃ *preyaiḥ sīvyedvraṇaṃ tataḥ||
6.13.189 |  tathā jātodakaṃ sarvamudaraṃ vyadhayedbhiṣak|
*vāmapārśve tvadho nābhernāḍīṃ dattvā ca gālayet||
6.13.190 |  visrāvya ca vimṛdyaitadveṣṭayedvāsasodaram|
tathā vastivirekādyairmlānaṃ sarvaṃ ca veṣṭayet||
6.13.191 |  niḥsrute laṅghitaḥ peyāmasnehalavaṇāṃ pibet|
ataḥ paraṃ tu ṣaṇmāsān kṣīravṛttirbhavennaraḥ||
6.13.192 |  trīn māsān payasā peyāṃ pibettrīṃścāpi bhojayet|
*śyāmākaṃ koradūṣaṃ vā kṣīreṇālavaṇaṃ laghu||
6.13.193 |  naraḥ saṃvatsareṇaivaṃ jayet prāptaṃ jalodaram|
prayogāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāmanu kṣīraṃ prayojayet||
6.13.194 |  doṣānubandharakṣārthaṃ balasthairyārthameva ca|
prayogāpacitāṅgānāṃ hitaṃ hyudariṇāṃ payaḥ|
sarvadhātukṣayārtānāṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ yathā||
6.13.195 |  tatra ślokau---
hetuṃ prāgrūpamaṣṭānāṃ liṅgaṃ vyāsasamāsataḥ|
upadravān garīyastvaṃ sādhyāsādhyatvameva ca||
6.13.196 |  jātājātāmbuliṅgāni cikitsāṃ coktavānṛṣiḥ|
samāsavyāsanirdeśairudarāṇāṃ cikitsite||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre 'prāpte dṛḍhabalapūrite cikitsāsthāne udaracikitsitaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||13 | |

caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.14.1 |  athāto 'rśāścikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.14.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.14.3 |  āsīnaṃ munimavyagraṃ kṛtajāpyaṃ kṛtakṣaṇam|
pṛṣṭavānarśasāṃ *yuktamagniveśaḥ punarvasum||
6.14.4 |  prakopahetuṃ saṃsthānaṃ sthānaṃ liṅgaṃ cikitsitam|
sādhyāsādhyavibhāgaṃ ca tasmai tanmunirabravīt||
6.14.5 |  iha khalvagniveśa ! dvividhānyarśāṃsi---kānicit sahajāni, kānicijjātasyottarakālajāni|
tatra bījaṃ gudavalibījopataptamāyatanamarśasāṃ sahajānām|
tatra dvividho bījopataptau hetuḥ---mātāpitrorapacāraḥ, pūrvakṛtaṃ ca karma; tathā 'nyeṣāmapi sahajānāṃ vikārāṇām|
tatra sahajāni saha jātāni śarīreṇa, arśāṃsītyadhimāṃsavikārāḥ||
6.14.6 |  sarveṣāṃ cārśasāṃ kṣetraṃ---gudasyārdhapañcamāṅgulāvakāṇe tribhāgāntarāstisro gudavalayaḥ kṣetramiti; kecittu bhūyāṃsameva deśamupadiśantyarśasāṃ---śiśnamapatyapathaṃ galatālummukhanāsikākarṇākṣivartmāni tvak ceti|
tadastyadhimāṃsadeśatayā, *gudavalijānāṃ tvarśāṃsīti saṃjñā tantre 'smin|sarveṣāṃ cārśasāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ---medo māṃsaṃ tvak ca||
6.14.7 |  tatra sahajānyarśāṃsi kānicidaṇūni, kānicinmahānti, kāniciddīrghāṇi, kāniciddhrasvāni, kānicidvṛttāni, kānicidviṣamavisṛtāni, kānicidantaḥkuṭilāni, kānicidbahiḥkuṭilāni, kānicijjaṭilāni, kānicidantarmukhāni, yathāsvaṃ doṣānubandhavarṇāni||
6.14.8 |  tairupahato janmaprabhṛti bhavatyatikṛśo vivarṇaḥ kṣāmo dīnaḥ pracuravibaddhavātamūtrapurīṣaḥ śarkarāśmarīmān, tathā 'niyatavibaddhamuktapakvāmaśuṣkabhinnavarcā antarā 'ntarā śvetapāṇḍuharitapītaraktāruṇatanusāndrapicchilakuṇapagandhyāmapurīṣopaveśī, nābhibastivaṃkṣaṇoddeśe pracuraparikartikānvitaḥ, sagudaśūlapravāhikāpariharṣapramehaprasaktaviṣṭambhāntrakūjodāvartahṛdayendriyopalepaḥ pracuravibaddhatiktāmlodgāraḥ, sudurbalaḥ, sudurbalāgniḥ, alpaśukraḥ, krodhano, duḥkhopacāraśīlaḥ, kāsaśvāsatamakatṛṣṇāhṛllāsacchardyarocakāvipākapīnasakṣavathuparītaḥ, taimirikaḥ, śirāḥśūlī, kṣāmabhinnasannasaktajarjarasvaraḥ, karṇarogī, śūnapāṇipādavadanākṣikūṭaḥ, sajvaraḥ, sāṅgamardaḥ, sarvaparvāsthiśūlī ca, antarā 'ntarā pārśvakukṣibastihṛdayapṛṣṭhatrikagrahopataptaḥ, pradhyānaparaḥ, paramālasaśceti; janmaprabhṛtyasya gudajairāvṛto *mārgoparodhādvāyurapānaḥ pratyārohan samānavyānaprāṇodānām pittaśleṣmāṇau ca prakopayati, ete sarva eva prakupitāḥ pañca vāyavaḥ pittaśleṣmāṇau cārśasamabhidravanta etān vikārānupajanayanti; etyuktāni sahajānyarśāṃsi||
6.14.9 |  ata ūrdhvaṃ jātasyottarakālajāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ---gurumadhuraśītābhiṣyandividāhiviruddhājīrṇapramitāśanāsātmyabhojanādgavyamātsyavārāhamāhiṣājāvikapiśitabhakṣaṇāt kṛśaśuṣkapūtimāṃsapaiṣṭikaparamānnakṣīradadhimaṇḍatilaguḍavikṛtisevanānmāṣayūṣekṣurasapiṇyākapiṇḍālukaśuṣkaśākaśuktalaśunakilāṭatakrapiṇḍakabisamṛṇālaśālūkakrauñcādanakaśerukaśṛṅgāṭakatarūṭavirūḍhanavaśūkaśamīdhānyāmamūlakopayogādguruphalaśākarāgaharitakamardakavasāśiraspadaparyuṣitapūtiśītasaṃkīrṇānnābhyavahārānmandakātikrāntamadyapānādvyāpannagurusalilapānādatisnehapānādasaṃśodhanādbastikarmavibhramādavyāyāmādavyavāyāddivāsvapnāt sukhaśayanāsanasthānasevanāccopahatāgnermalopacayo bhavatyatimātraṃ, tathotkaṭakaviṣamakaṭhināsanasevanādudbhrāntayānoṣṭrayānādativyavāyādbastinetrāsamyakpraṇidhānādgudakṣaṇanādabhīkṣṇaṃ śītāmbusaṃsparśāccelaloṣṭatṛṇādigharṣaṇāt pratatātinirvāhaṇādvātamūtrapurīṣavegodīraṇāt samudīrṇavegavinigrahāt strīṇāṃ cāmagarbhabhraṃśādgarbhotpīḍanādviṣamaprasūtibhiśca prakupito vāyurapānastaṃ malamupacitamadhogamāsādya gudavaliṣvādhatte, tatastāsvarśāṃsi prādurbhavanti||
6.14.10 |  sarṣapamasūramāṣamudgamakuṣṭhakayavakalāyapiṇḍiṭiṇṭikerakebukatindukakarkandhukākaṇantikābimbībadarakarīrodumbarakharjūrajāmbavagostanāṅguṣṭhakaśeruśṛṅgāṭakaśṛṅgīdakṣaśikhiśukatuṇḍajihvāpadmamukulakarṇikāsaṃsthānāni sāmānyādvātapittakaphaprabalāni||
6.14.11 |  teṣāmayaṃ viśeṣaḥ---śuṣkamlānakaṭhinaparuṣarūkṣaśyāvāni, tīkṣṇāgrāṇi, vakrāṇi, sphuṭitamukhāni, viṣamavisṛtāni, śūlākṣepatodasphuraṇacimicimāsaṃharṣaparītāni, snigdhoṣṇopaśayāni, pravāhikādhmānaśiśnavṛṣaṇabastivaṅkṣaṇahṛdgrahāṅgamardahṛdayadravaprabalāni, pratatavibaddhavātamūtravarcāṃsi, ūrukaṭīpṛṣṭhatrikapārśvakukṣibastiśūlaśiro 'bhitāpakṣavathūdgārapratiśyāyakāsodāvartāyāmaśoṣaśothamūrcchārocakamukhavairasyataimiryakaṇḍūnāsākarṇaśaṅkṣaśūlasvaropaghātakarāṇi, śyāvāruṇaparuṣanakhanayanavadanatvaṅmūtrapurīṣasya vātolbaṇānyarśāṃsīti vidyāt||
6.14.12 |  bhavataścātra---
kaṣāyakaṭutiktāni rūkṣaśītalaghūni ca|
pramitālpāśanaṃ tīkṣṇamadyamaithunasevanam||
6.14.13 |  laṅghanaṃ deśakālau ca śītau vyāyāmakarma ca|
śoko vātātapasparśo heturvātārśasāṃ mataḥ||
6.14.14 |  mṛduśithilasukumārāṇyasparśasahāni, raktapītanīlakṛṣṇāni, svedopakledabahulāni, *visragandhitanupītaraktasrāvīṇi, rudhiravahāni, dāhakaṇḍūśūlanistodapākavanti, śītopaśayāni, saṃbhinnapītaharitavarcāṃsi, pītavisragandhipracuraviṇmūtrāṇi, pipāsājvaratamakasaṃmohabhojanadveṣakarāṇi pītanakhanayanatvaṅmūtrapurīṣasya pittolbaṇānyarśāṃsīti vidyāt||
6.14.15 |  *kaṭūṣṇalavaṇakṣāravyāyāmāgnyātapaprabhāḥ|
deśakālāvaśiśirau krodho madyamasūyanam||
6.14.16 |  vidāhi tīkṣṇamuṣṇaṃ ca sarvaṃ pānannabheṣajam|
pittolbaṇānāṃ vijñeyaḥ prakope heturarśasām||
6.14.17 |  tatra yāni pramāṇavanti, upacitāni, ślakṣṇāni, *sparśasahāni, snigdhaśvetapāṇḍupicchilāni, stabdhāni, gurūṇi, stimitāni, suptasuptāni, sthiraśvayayūni, kaṇḍūbahulāni, bahupratatapiñjaraśvetaraktapicchāsrāvīṇi, gurupicchilaśvetamūtrapurīṣāṇi, rūkṣoṣṇopaśayāni, pravāhikātimātrotthānavaṅkṣaṇānāhavanti, parikartikāhṛllāsaniṣṭhīvikākāsārocakapratiśyāyagauravacchardimūtrakṛcchraśoṣaśothapāṇḍurogaśītajvarāśmarīśarkarāhṛdayendriyopalepāsyamādhuryapramehakarāṇi, *dīrghakālānubandhīni, atimātramagnimārdavaklaibyakarāṇi, āmavikāraprabalāni, śuklanakhanayanavadanatvaṅmūtrapurīṣasya śleṣmolbaṇānyarśāṃsiti vidyāt||
6.14.18 |  bhavataścātra---
madhurasnigdhaśītāni lavaṇāmlagurūṇi ca|
avyāyāmo divāsvapnaḥ śayyāsanasukhe ratiḥ||
6.14.19 |  prāgvātasevā śītau ca deśakālāvacintanam|
ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ samuddiṣṭametat kāraṇamarśasām||
6.14.20 |  hetulakṣaṇasaṃsargādvidyāddvandvolbaṇāni ca|
sarvo hetustridoṣāṇāṃ sahajairlakṣaṇaiḥ samam||
6.14.21 |  viṣṭambho 'nnasya daurbalyaṃ kukṣerāṭopa eva ca|
kārśyamudgārabāhulyaṃ sakthisādo 'lpaviṭkatā||
6.14.22 |  grahaṇīdoṣapāṇḍvarterāśaṅkā codarasya ca|
pūrvarūpāṇi nirdiṣṭānyarśasāmabhivṛddhaye||
6.14.23 |  arśāṃsi khalu jāyante nāsannipatitaistribhiḥ|
doṣairdoṣaviśeṣāttu viśeṣaḥ kalpyate 'rśasām||
6.14.24 |  pañcātmā mārutaḥ pittaṃ kapho gudavalitrayam|
sarva eva prakupyanti gudajānāṃ samudbhave||
6.14.25 |  tasmādarśāṃsi duḥkhāni bahuvyādhikarāṇi ca|
sarvadehopatāpīni prāyaḥ kṛcchratamāni ca||
6.14.26 |  haste pāde mukhe nābhyāṃ gude vṛṣaṇayostathā|
śotho hṛtpārśvaśūlaṃ ca yasyāsādhyo 'rśaso hi saḥ||
6.14.27 |  hṛtpārśvaśūlaṃ saṃmohaśchardiraṅgasya rug jvaraḥ|
tṛṣṇā gudasya pākaśca nihanyargudajāturam||
6.14.28 |  sahajāni tridoṣāṇi yāni cābhyantarāṃ valim|
jāyante 'rśāṃsi saṃśritya tānyasādhyāni nirdiśet||
6.14.29 |  śeṣatvādāyuṣastāni catuṣpādasamanvite|
yāpyante dīptakāyāgneḥ pratyākhyeyānyato 'nyathā||
6.14.30 |  dvandvajāni dvitīyāyāṃ valau yānyāśritāni ca|
kṛcchrasādhyāni tānyāhuḥ parisaṃvatsarāṇi ca||
6.14.31 |  bāhyāyāṃ tu valau jātānyekadoṣolbaṇāni ca|
arśāṃsi sukhasādhyāni na cirotpatitāni ca||
6.14.32 |  teṣāṃ praśamane yatnamāśu kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ|
tānyāśu hi gudaṃ baddhvā kuryurbaddhagudodaram||
6.14.33 |  tatrāhureke śastreṇa kartanaṃ hitamarśasām|
dāhaṃ kṣāreṇa cāpyeke, dāhameke tathā 'gninā||
6.14.34 |  *astyetadbhūritantreṇa dhīmatā dṛṣṭakarmaṇā|
kriyate trividhaṃ karma bhraṃśastatra sudāruṇaḥ||
6.14.35 |  puṃstvopaghātaḥ śvayathurgude vegavinigrahaḥ|
ādhmānaṃ dāruṇaṃ śūlaṃ vyathā raktātivartanam||
6.14.36 |  punarviroho rūḍhānāṃ kledo bhraṃśo gudasya ca|
maraṇaṃ vā bhavecchīghraṃ śastrakṣārāgnivibhramāt||
6.14.37 |  yattu karma sukhopāyamalpabhraṃśamadāruṇam|
tadarśasāṃ pravakṣyāma samūlānāṃ nivṛttaye||
6.14.38 |  vātaśleṣmolbaṇānyāhuḥ śuṣkāṇyarśāṃsi tadvidaḥ|
prasrāvīṇi tathā++ārdrāṇi raktapittolbaṇāni ca||
6.14.39 |  tatra śuṣkārśasāṃ pūrvaṃ pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam|
stabdhāni svedayet pūrvaṃ śophaśūlānvitāni ca||
6.14.40 |  citrakakṣārabilvānāṃ tailenābhyajya buddhimān|
yavamāṣakulatthānāṃ pulākānāṃ ca poṭṭalaiḥ||
6.14.41 |  gokharāśvaśakṛtpiṇḍaistilakalkaistuṣaistathā|
vacāśatāhvāpiṇḍairvā sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiḥ||
6.14.42 |  śaktūnāṃ piṇḍikābhirvā snigdhānāṃ tailasarpiṣā|
śuṣkamūlakapiṇḍairvā piṇḍairvā kārṣṇagandhikaiḥ||
6.14.43 |  rāsnāpiṇḍaiḥ sukhoṣṇairvā sasnehairhāpuṣairapi|
iṣṭakasya kharāhvāyāḥ śākairgṛñjanakasya vā||
6.14.44 |  abhyajya kuṣṭhatailena svedayet poṭṭalīkṛtaiḥ|
bṛṣārkairaṇḍabilvānāṃ patrotkkāthaiśca secayet||
6.14.45 |  mūlakatriphalārkāṇāṃ veṇūnāṃ varuṇasya ca|
agnimanthasya śigrośca patrāṇyaśmantakasya ca||
6.14.46 |  jalenotkkāthya śūlārtaṃ svabhyaktamavagāhayet|
kolotkkāthe 'thavā koṣṇe sauvīrakatuṣodake||
6.14.47 |  bilvakkāthe 'thavā takre dadhimaṇḍāmlakāñjike|
gomūtre vā sukhoṣṇe taṃ svabhyaktamavagāhayet||
6.14.48 |  kṛṣṇasarpavarāhoṣṭrajatukāvṛṣadaṃśajām|
vasāmabhyañjane dadyāddhūpanaṃ cārśasāṃ hitam||
6.14.49 |  nṛkeśāḥ sarpanirmoko vṛṣadaṃśasya carma ca|
arkamūlaṃ śamīpatramarśobhyo dhūpanaṃ hitam||
6.14.50 |  tumburūṇi viḍaṅgāni devadārvakṣatā ghṛtam|
bṛhatī cāśvagandhā ca pippalyaḥ surasā ghṛtam||
6.14.51 |  varāhavṛṣaviṭ caiva dhūpana saktavo ghṛtam|
kuñjarasya purīṣaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ sarjarasastathā||
6.14.52 |  haridrācūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ sudhākṣīraṃ pralepanam|
gopittapiṣṭāḥ pippalyaḥ saharidrāḥ pralepanam||
6.14.53 |  śirīṣabījaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca pippalyaḥ saindhavaṃ guḍaḥ|
arkakṣīraṃ sudhākṣīraṃ triphalā ca pralepanam||
6.14.54 |  pippalyaścitrakaḥ śyāmā kiṇvaṃ madanataṇḍulāḥ|
pralepaḥ kukkuṭaśakṛddharidrāguḍasaṃyutaḥ||
6.14.55 |  dantī śyāmā 'mṛtāsaṅgaḥ pārāvataśakṛdguḍaḥ|
pralepaḥ syādgajāsthīni nimbo bhallātakāni ca||
6.14.56 |  pralepaḥ syādalaṃ koṣṇaṃ vāsantakavasāyutam|
śūlaśvayathuhṛdyuktaṃ culūkīvasayā 'thavā||
6.14.57 |  ārkaṃ *payaḥ sudhākāṇḍaṃ kaṭukālābupallavāḥ|
arañjo bastamūtraṃ ca lepanaṃ śreṣṭhamarśasām||
6.14.58 |  abhyaṅgādyāḥ pradehāntā ya ete parikīrtitāḥ|
stambhaśvayathukaṇḍvartiśamanāste 'rśasāṃ matāḥ||
6.14.59 |  pradehāntairupakrāntānyarśāṃsi prasravanti hi|
saṃcitaṃ duṣṭarudhiraṃ tataḥ saṃpadyate sukhī||
6.14.60 |  śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣairhi na vyādhirupaśāmyati|
rakte duṣṭe bhiṣak tasmādraktamevāvasecayet||
6.14.61 |  jalaukobhistathā śastraiḥ sūcībhirvā punaḥ punaḥ|
avartamānaṃ rudhiraṃ raktārśobhyaḥ pravāhayet||
6.14.62 |  gudaśvayathuśūlārtaṃ mandāgniṃ pāyayettu tam|
tryūṣaṇaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pāṭhāṃ hiṅgu sacitrakam||
6.14.63 |  sauvarcalaṃ puṣkarākhyamajājīṃ bilvapeṣikām|
biḍaṃ yavānīṃ hapuṣāṃ viḍaṅgaṃ saindhavaṃ vacām||
6.14.64 |  tintiḍīkaṃ ca maṇḍena madyenoṣṇodakena vā|
tathā 'rśograhaṇīdoṣaśūlānāhādvimucyate||
6.14.65 |  pācanaṃ pāyayedvā *tadyaduktaṃ hyātisārike|
saguḍāmabhayāṃ vā 'pi prāśayet paurvabhaktikīm||
6.14.66 |  pāyayedvā trivṛccūrṇaṃ triphalārasasaṃyutam|
hṛte gudāśraye doṣe *gacchantyarśāṃsi saṃkṣayam||
6.14.67 |  gomūtrādhyuṣitāṃ dadyāt saguḍāṃ vā harītakīm
harītakīṃ takrayutāṃ triphalāṃ vā prayojayet||
6.14.68 |  sanāgaraṃ citrakaṃ vā sīghuyuktaṃ prayojayet|
dāpayeccavyayuktaṃ vā sīdhuṃ sājājicitrakam||
6.14.69 |  surāṃ sahapuṣāpāṭhāṃ dadyāt sauvarcalānvitām|
dadhitthabilvasaṃyuktaṃ yuktaṃ vā cavyacitrkaiḥ||
6.14.70 |  bhallātakayutaṃ vā 'pi pradadyāttakratarpaṇam|
bilvanāgarayuktaṃ vā yavānyā citrakeṇa ca||
6.14.71 |  citrakaṃ hapuṣāṃ hiṅguṃ dadyādvā takrasaṃyutam|
pañcakolayutaṃ vā 'pi takramasmai pradāpayet||
6.14.72 |  hapuṣāṃ kuñcikāṃ dhānyamajājīṃ kāravīṃ śaṭīm|
pippalīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ citrakaṃ hastipippalīm||
6.14.73 |  yavānīṃ cājamodāṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ takrasaṃyutam|
mandāmlakaṭukaṃ vidvān sthāpayeddhṛtabhājane||
6.14.74 |  vyaktāmlakaṭukaṃ jātaṃ takrāriṣṭaṃ mukhapriyam|
prapibenmātrayā kāleṣvannasya tṛṣitastriṣu||
6.14.75 |  dīpanaṃ rocanaṃ varṇyaṃ kaphavātānulomanam|
gudaśvayathukaṇḍvartināśanaṃ balavardhanam||
iti takrāriṣṭaḥ|
6.14.76 |  tvacaṃ citrakamūlasya piṣṭvā kumbhaṃ pralepayet|
takraṃ vā dadhi vā tatra jātamarśoharaṃ pibet||
6.14.77 |  ghātaśleṣmārśasāṃ takrāt paraṃ nāstīha bheṣajam|
tat prayojyaṃ yathādoṣaṃ sasnehaṃ rūkṣameva vā||
6.14.78 |  saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā pakṣaṃ māsamathāpi vā|
balakālaviśeṣajño bhiṣak takraṃ prayojayet||
6.14.79 |  atyarthamṛdukāyāgnestakramevāvacārayet|
sāyaṃ vā lājaśaktūnāṃ dadyāttakrāvalehikām||
6.14.80 |  jīrṇe takre pradadyādvā takrapeyāṃ sasaindhavām|
takrānupānaṃ sasnehaṃ takraudanamataḥ param||
6.14.81 |  yūṣairmāṃsarasairvā 'pi bhojayettakrasaṃyutaiḥ|
*yūṣai rasena vā 'pyūrdhvaṃ takrasiddhena bhojayet||
6.14.82 |  kālakramajñaḥ sahasā na ca takraṃ nivartayet|
takraprayogo māsāntaḥ krameṇoparamo hitaḥ||
6.14.83 |  apakarṣo yathotkarṣo na tvannādapakṛṣyate|
śaktyāgamanarakṣārthaṃ dārḍhyārthamanalasya ca||
6.14.84 |  balopacayavarṇārthameṣa nirdiśyate kramaḥ|
rūkṣamardhoddhṛtasnehaṃ yataścānuddhṛtaṃ ghṛtam||
6.14.85 |  takraṃ doṣāgnibalavittrividhaṃ tat prayojayet|
hatāni na virohanti takreṇa gudajāni tu||
6.14.86 |  bhūmāvapi niṣiktaṃ taddahettakraṃ tṛṇolupam|
kiṃ punardīptakāyāgneḥ śuṣkāṇyarśāṃsi dehinaḥ||
6.14.87 |  srotaḥsu takraśuddheṣu rasaḥ samyagupaiti yaḥ|
tena puṣṭirbalaṃ varṇaḥ praharṣaścopajāyate||
6.14.88 |  vātaśleṣmavikārāṇāṃ śataṃ cāpi nivartate|
nāsti takrāt paraṃ kiṃcidauṣadhaṃ kaphavātaje||
6.14.89 |  pippalīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ citrakaṃ hastipippalīm|
śṛṅgaveramajājīṃ ca kāravīṃ dhānyatumburu||
6.14.90 |  bilvaṃ karkaṭakaṃ pāṭhāṃ piṣṭvā peyāṃ vipācayet|
phalāmlāṃ yamakairbhṛṣṭāṃ tāṃ dadyādgudajāpahām||
6.14.91 |  etaiścaiva khaḍān kuryādetaiśca vipacejjalam|
etaiścaiva ghṛtaṃ sādhyamarśasāṃ vinivṛttaye||
6.14.92 |  śaṭīpalāśasiddhāṃ vā pipplyā nāgareṇa vā|
dadyādyavāgūṃ takrāmlāṃ maricairavacūrṇitām||
6.14.93 |  śuṣkamūlakayūṣaṃ vā yūṣaṃ kaulatthameva vā|
dadhitthabilvayūṣaṃ vā sakulatthamakuṣṭhakam||
6.14.94 |  chāgalaṃ vā *rasaṃ dadyādyūṣairebhirvimiśritam|
lāvādīnāṃ phalāmlaṃ vā satakraṃ grāhibhiryutam||
6.14.95 |  raktaśālirmahāśāliḥ kalamo lāṅgalaḥ sitaḥ|
śāradaḥ ṣaṣṭikaścaiva syādannavidhirarśasām||
6.14.96 |  ityukto bhinnaśakṛtāmarśasāṃ ca kriyākramaḥ|
ye 'tyarhtaṃ gāḍhaśakṛtasteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi bheṣajam||
6.14.97 |  sasnehaiḥ śaktubhiryuktāṃ prasannāṃ lavaṇīkṛtām|
dadyānmatsyaṇḍikāṃ pūrvaṃ bhakṣayitvā sanāgarām||
6.14.98 |  guḍaṃ sanāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ phalāmlaṃ pāyayecca tam|
guḍaṃ ghṛtayavakṣārayuktaṃ vā 'pi prayojayet||
6.14.99 |  yavānīṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ dāḍimasya rasṃ guḍam|
satakralavaṇaṃ dadyādvātavarco 'nulomanam||
6.14.100 |  duḥsparśakena bilvena yavānyā nāgareṇa vā|
ekaikenāpi saṃyuktā pāṭhā hantyarśasāṃ rujam||
6.14.101 |  *prāgbhaktaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭān saktubhiścāvacūrṇitān|
karañjapallavān dadyādvātavarco 'nulomanān||
6.14.102 |  madirāṃ vā salavaṇāṃ sīdhuṃ sauvīrakaṃ tathā|
*guḍanāgarasaṃyuktaṃ pibedvā paurvabhaktikam||
6.14.103 |  pippalīnāgarakṣārakāravīdhānyajīrakaiḥ|
phāṇitena ca saṃyojya phalāmlaṃ dāpayedghṛtam||
6.14.104 |  pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ citrako hastipippalī|
śṛṅgaverayavakṣārau taiḥ siddhaṃ vā pibedghṛtam||
6.14.105 |  cavyacitrakasiddhaṃ vā guḍakṣārasamanvitam|
pippalīmūlasiddhaṃ vā *saguḍakṣāranāgaram||
6.14.106 |  pippalīpippalīmūladadhi-*dāḍimadhānyakaiḥ|
siddhaṃ sarpirvidhātavyaṃ vātavarcovibandhanut||
6.14.107 |  cavyaṃ trikaṭukaṃ pāṭhāṃ kṣāraṃ kustumburūṇi ca|
yavānīṃ pippalīmūlamubhe ca viḍasaindhave||
6.14.108 |  citrakaṃ bilvamabhayāṃ piṣṭvā sarpirvipācayet|
śakṛdvātānulomyārthaṃ jāte dadhni caturguṇe||
6.14.109 |  pravāhikāṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ parisravam|
gudavaṅkṣaṇaśūlaṃ ca ghṛtametadvyapohati||
6.14.110 |  nāgaraṃ pipplīmūlaṃ citrako hastipippalī|
śvadaṃṣṭrā pippalī dhānyaṃ bilvaṃ pāṭhā yavānikā||
6.14.111 |  cāṅgerīsvarase sarpiḥ kalkairetairvipācayet|
caturguṇena dadhnā ca tadghṛtaṃ kaphavātanut||
6.14.112 |  arśāṃsi grahaṇīdoṣaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām|
gudabhraṃśārtimānāhaṃ ghṛtametadvyapohati||
6.14.113 |  pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak|
bhāgāṃstripalikān kṛtvā kaṣāyamupakalpayet||
6.14.114 |  gaṇḍīraṃ pippalīmūlaṃ vyoṣaṃ cavyaṃ ca citrakam|
piṣṭvā kaṣāye vinayet *pūte dvipalikaṃ bhiṣak||
6.14.115 |  palāni sarpiṣastasmiṃścatvāriṃśat pradāpayet|
cāṅgerīsvarasaṃ tulyaṃ sarpiṣā dadhi ṣaḍguṇaṃ||
6.14.116 |  mṛdvagninā tataḥ sādhyaṃ siddhaṃ sarpirnidhāpayet|
tadāhāre vidhātavyaṃ pāne prāyogike vidhau||
6.14.117 |  grahaṇyarśovikāraghnaṃ gulmahṛdroganāśanam|
śothaplīhodarānāhamūtrakṛcchrajvarāpaham||
6.14.118 |  kāsahikkāruciśvāsasūdanaṃ pārśvaśūlanut|
balapuṣṭikaraṃ varṇyamagnisaṃdīpanaṃ param||
6.14.119 |  saguḍāṃ pippalīyuktāṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭāṃ harītakīm|
trivṛddantīyutāṃ vā 'pi bhakṣayedānulomikīm||
6.14.120 |  viḍvātakaphapittānām-*ānulomye 'tha nirvṛte|
guḍe 'rśāṃsi praśāmyanti pāvakaścābhivardhate||
6.14.121 |  barhitittirilāvānāṃ rasānamlān susaṃskṛtān|
dakṣāṇāṃ vartakānāṃ ca dadyādviḍvātasaṃgrahe||
6.14.122 |  trivṛddantīpalāśānāṃ cāṅgeryāścitrakasya ca|
yamake bharjitaṃ dadyācchākaṃ dadhisamanvitam||
6.14.123 |  upodikāṃ taṇḍulīyaṃ vīrāṃ vāstukapallavān|
suvarcalāṃ saloṇīkāṃ yavaśākamavalgujam||
6.14.124 |  kākamācīṃ ruhāpatraṃ mahāpatraṃ tathā 'mlikām|
jīvantīṃ śaṭiśākaṃ ca śākaṃ gṛñjanakasya ca||
6.14.125 |  dadhidāḍimasiddhāni yamake bharjitāni ca|
dhānyanāgarayuktāni śākānyetāni dāpayet||
6.14.126 |  godhālopākamārjāraśvāviduṣṭragavāmapi|
kūrmaśallakayoścaiva sādhayecchākavadrasān||
6.14.127 |  raktaśālyodanaṃ dadyādrasaistairvātaśāntaye|
jñātvā vātolbaṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ mandāgniṃ gudajāturam||
6.14.128 |  madirāṃ śārkaraṃ jātaṃ sīdhuṃ takraṃ tuṣodakam|
ariṣṭaṃ dadhimaṇḍaṃ vā śṛtaṃ vā śiśiraṃ jalam||
6.14.129 |  kaṇṭakāryā śṛtaṃ vā 'pi śṛtaṃ nāgaradhānyakaiḥ|
anupānaṃ bhiṣagdadyādvātavarco 'nulomanam||
6.14.130 |  udāvartaparītā ye ye cātyarthaṃ virūkṣitāḥ|
vilomavātāḥ śūlārtāsteṣviṣṭamanuvāsanam||
6.14.131 |  pippalīṃ madanaṃ bilvaṃ śatāhvāṃ madhukaṃ vacām|
kuṣṭhaṃ śaṭīṃ puṣkarākhyaṃ citrakaṃ devadāru ca||
6.14.132 |  piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipaktavyaṃ *payasā dviguṇena ca|
arśasāṃ mūḍhavātānāṃ tacchreṣṭhamanuvāsanam||
6.14.133 |  gudaniḥsaraṇaṃ śūlaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām|
kaṭyūrupṛṣṭhadaurbalyamānāhaṃ vaṅkṣaṇāśrayam||
6.14.134 |  picchāsrāvaṃ gude śophaṃ vātavarcovinigraham|
utthānaṃ bahuśo yacca jayettaccānuvāsanāt||
6.14.135 |  ānuvāsanikaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiḥ|
*dārvantaiḥ stabdhaśūlāni gudajāni pralepayet||
6.14.136 |  digdhāstaiḥ prasravantyāśu śleṣmapicchāṃ saśoṇitām|
kaṇḍūḥ stambhaḥ saruk śophaḥ srutānāṃ vinivartate||
6.14.137 |  nirūhaṃ vā prayuñjīta sakṣīraṃ dāśamūlikam|
samūtrasnehalavaṇaṃ kalkairyuktaṃ phalādibhiḥ||
6.14.138 |  harītakīnāṃ prasthārdhaṃ prasthamāmalakasya ca|
syāt kapitthāddaśapalaṃ tato 'rdhā cendravāruṇī||
6.14.139 |  viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī lodhraṃ maricaṃ sailavālukam|
dvipalāṃśaṃ jalasyaitaccaturdroṇe vipācayet||
6.14.140 |  droṇaśeṣe rase tasmin pūte śīte samāvapet|
guḍasya dviśataṃ tiṣṭhettat pakṣaṃ ghṛtabhājane||
6.14.141 |  pakṣādūrdhvaṃ bhavet peyā tato mātrā yathābalam|
asyābhyāsādariṣṭasya gudajā yānti saṃkṣayam||
6.14.142 |  grahaṇīpāṇḍuhṛdrogaplīhagulmodarāpahaḥ|
kuṣṭhaśophāruciharo balavarṇāgnivardhanaḥ||
6.14.143 |  siddho 'yamabhayāriṣṭaḥ kāmalāśvitranāśanaḥ|
kṛmigranthyarbudavyaṅgarājayakṣmajvarāntakṛt||
ityabhayāriṣṭaḥ|
6.14.144 |  dantīcitrakamūlānāmubhayoḥ pañcamūlayoḥ|
