bhāgān palāṃśānāpothya jaladroṇe vipācayet||
6.14.145 |  tripalaṃ triphalāyāśca dalānāṃ tatra dāpayet|
rase caturthaśeṣe tu pūte śīte samāvapet||
6.14.146 |  tulāṃ guḍasya tattiṣṭhenmāsārdhaṃ ghṛtabhājane|
tanmātrayā pibannityamarśobhyo vipramucyate||
6.14.147 |  grahaṇīpāṇḍurogaghnaṃ vātavarco 'nulomanam|
dīpanaṃ cārucighnaṃ ca dantyariṣṭamimaṃ viduḥ||
iti dantyariṣṭaḥ|
6.14.148 |  harītakīphalaprasthaṃ prasthamāmalakasya ca|
viśālāyā dadhitthasya pāṭhācitrakamūlayoḥ||
6.14.149 |  dve dve pale samāpothya dvidroṇe sādhayedapām|
pādāvaśeṣe pūte ca rase tasmin pradāpayet||
6.14.150 |  guḍasyaikāṃ tulāṃ vaidyastat sthāpyaṃ ghṛtabhājane|
pakṣasthitaṃ pibedenaṃ grahaṇyarśovikāravān||
6.14.151 |  hṛtpāṇḍurogaṃ plīhānaṃ kāmalāṃ viṣamajvaram|
varcomūtrānilakṛtān vibandhānagnimārdavam||
6.14.152 |  kāsaṃ gulmamudāvartaṃ phalāriṣṭo vyapohati|
agnisaṃdīpano hyeṣa kṛṣṇātreyeṇa bhāṣitaḥ||
iti phalāriṣṭaḥ|
6.14.153 |  durālabhāyāḥ prasthaḥ syāccitrakasya vṛṣasya ca|
pathyāmalakayoścaiva pāṭhāyā nāgarasya ca||
6.14.154 |  dantyāśca dvipalān bhāgāñjaladroṇe vipācayet|
pādāvaśeṣe *pūte ca suśīte śarkarāśatam||
6.14.155 |  prakṣipya sthāpayet kumbhe māsārdhaṃ ghṛtabhāvite|
pralipte pippalīcavyapriyaṅgukṣaudrasarpiṣā||
6.14.156 |  tasya mātrāṃ pibet kāle śārkarasya yathābalam|
arśāṃsi grahaṇīdoṣamudāvartamarocakam||
6.14.157 |  śakṛnmūtrāvilodgāravibandhānagnimārdavam|
hṛdrogaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca sarvametena sādhayet||
iti *dvitīyaphalāriṣṭaḥ|
6.14.158 |  navasyāmalakasyaikāṃ kuryājjarjaritāṃ tulām|
kuḍavāṃśāśca pippalyo viḍaṅgaṃ maricaṃ tathā||
6.14.159 |  *pāṭhāṃ ca pippalīmūlaṃ kramukaṃ cavyacitrakau|
mañjiṣṭhailvālukaṃ lodhraṃ palikānupakalpayet||
6.14.160 |  kuṣṭhaṃ dāruharidrāṃ ca surāhvaṃ sārivādvayam|
indrāhvaṃ bhadramustaṃ ca kuryādardhapalonmitam||
6.14.161 |  catvāri nāgapuṣpasya palānyabhinavasya ca|
droṇābhyāmambhaso dvābhyāṃ sādhayitvā 'vatārayet||
6.14.162 |  pādāvaśeṣe pūte ca śīte tasmin pradāpayet|
mṛdvīkādvyāḍhakarasaṃ śītaṃ niryūhasaṃmitam||
6.14.163 |  śarkarāyāśca bhinnāyā dadyāddviguṇitāṃ tulām|
kusumasya rasasyaikamardhaprasthaṃ navasya ca||
6.14.164 |  tvagelāplavapatrāmbusevyakramukakeśarān|
cūrṇayitvā tu matimān kārṣikānatra dāpayet||
6.14.165 |  tat sarvaṃ sthāpayet pakṣaṃ sucaukṣe ghṛtabhājane|
pralipte sarpiṣā kiṃciccharkarāgurudhūpite||
6.14.166 |  pakṣādūrdhvamariṣṭo 'yaṃ kanako nāma viśrutaḥ|
peyaḥ svāduraso hṛdyaḥ prayogādbhaktarocanaḥ||
6.14.167 |  arśāṃsi grahaṇīdoṣamānāhamudaraṃ jvaram|
hṛdrogaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ śothaṃ gulmaṃ varcovinigraham||
6.14.168 |  kāsaṃ śleṣmāmayāṃścogrān sarvānevāpakarṣati|
valīpalitakhālityaṃ doṣajaṃ ca vyapohati||
iti kanakāriṣṭaḥ|
6.14.169 |  patrabhaṅgodakaiḥ śaucaṃ kuryāduṣṇena vā 'mbhasā|
iti śuṣkārśasāṃ siddhamuktametaccikitsitam||
6.14.170 |  *cikitsitamidaṃ siddhaṃ srāviṇāṃ śṛṇvataḥ param|
tatrānubandho dvividhaḥ śleṣmaṇo mārutasya ca||
6.14.171 |  viṭ śyāvaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ cādho vāyurna vartate|
tanu cāruṇavarṇaṃ ca phenilaṃ cāsṛgarśasām||
6.14.172 |  kaṭhyūrugudaśūlaṃ ca daurbalyaṃ yadi cādhikam|
tatrānubandho vātasya heturyadi ca rūkṣaṇam||
6.14.173 |  śithilaṃ śvetapītaṃ ca viṭ snigdhaṃ guru śītalam|
yadyarśasāṃ ghanaṃ cāsṛk tantumat pāṇḍu picchilam||
6.14.174 |  gudaṃ sapicchaṃ stimitaṃ guru snigdhaṃ ca kāraṇam|
śleṣmānubandho vijñeyastatra raktārśasāṃ budhaiḥ||
6.14.175 |  snigdhaśītaṃ hitaṃ vāte rūkṣaśītaṃ kaphānuge|
cikitsitamidaṃ tasmāt saṃpradhārya prayojayet||
6.14.176 |  pittaśleṣmādhikaṃ matvā śodhanenopapādayet|
sravaṇaṃ cāpyupekṣeta laṅghanairvā samācaret||
6.14.177 |  pravṛttamādāvarśobhyo yo nigṛhṇātyabuddhimān|
śoṇitaṃ doṣamanilaṃ tadrogāñjanayedbahūn||
6.14.178 |  raktapittaṃ jvaraṃ tṛṣṇāmagnisādamarocakam|
kāmalāṃ śvayathuṃ śūlaṃ gudavaṅkṣaṇasaṃśrayam||
6.14.179 |  kaṇḍvaruḥkoṭhapiḍakāḥ kuṣṭhaṃ pāṇḍvāhvayaṃ gadam|
vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ vibandhaṃ śiraso rujam||
6.14.180 |  staimityaṃ gurugātratvaṃ tathā 'nyān raktajān gadān|
tasmāt srute duṣṭarakte raktasaṃgrahaṇaṃ hitam||
6.14.181 |  hetulakṣaṇakālajño balaśoṇitavarṇavit|
kālaṃ tāvadupekṣeta yāvannātyayamāpnuyāt||
6.14.182 |  agnisaṃdīpanārthaṃ ca raktasaṃgrahaṇāya ca|
doṣāṇāṃ pācanārhtaṃ ca paraṃ tiktairupācaret||
6.14.183 |  yattu prakṣīṇadoṣasya raktaṃ vātolbaṇasya ca|
vartate snehasādhyaṃ tat pānābhyaṅgānuvāsanaiḥ||
6.14.184 |  yattu pittolbaṇaṃ raktaṃ gharmakāle pravartate|
stambhanīyaṃ tadekāntānna cedvātakaphānugam||
6.14.185 |  kuṭajatvaṅniryūhaḥ sanāgaraḥ snigdharaktasaṃgrahaṇaḥ|
tvagdāḍimasya tadvat sanāgaraścandanarasaśca||
6.14.186 |  candanakirātatiktakadhanvayavāsāḥ sanāgarāḥ kvathitāḥ|
raktārśasāṃ praśamanā dārvītvaguṇīranimbāśca||
6.14.187 |  sātiviṣā kuṭajatvak phalaṃ ca sarasāñjanaṃ madhuyutāni|
raktāpahāni dadyāt pipāsave paṇḍulajalena||
6.14.188 |  kuṭajatvaco vipācyaṃ palaśatamārdraṃ mahendrasalilena|
yāvatsyādgatarasaṃ taddravyaṃ pūto rasastato grāhyaḥ||
6.14.189 |  mocarasaḥ sasamaṅgaḥ phalinī ca *samāṃśikaistribhistaiśca|
vatsakabījaṃ tulyaṃ cūrṇitamatra pradātavyam||
6.14.190 |  pūtotkvathitaḥ sāndraḥ sa raso darvīpralepano grāhyaḥ|
mātrākālopahitā rasakriyaiṣā jayatyasṛksrāvam||
6.14.191 |  chagalīpayasā pītā peyāmaṇḍena vā yathāgnibalam|
jīrṇauṣadhaśca śālīn payasā chāgena bhuñjīta||
6.14.192 |  raktārśāṃsyatisāraṃ raktaṃ sāsṛgrujo nihantyāśu|
balavacca raktapittaṃ rasakriyaiṣā *jayatyubhayabhāgam||
iti kuṭajādirasakriyā|
6.14.193 |  nīlotpalaṃ samaṅgā mocarasaścandanaṃ tilā lodhram|
pītvā cchagalīpayasā bhojyaṃ payasaiva śālyannam||
6.14.194 |  chāgalipayaḥ prayuktaṃ nihanti raktaṃ savāstukarasaṃ ca|
dhanvavihaṅgamṛgāṇāṃ raso niramlaḥ kadamlo vā||
6.14.195 |  pāṭhā vatsakabījaṃ rasāñjanaṃ nāgaraṃ yavānyaśca|
bilvamiti cārśasaiścūrṇitāni peyāni śūleṣu||
6.14.196 |  dārvī kirātatiktaṃ mustaṃ duḥsparśakaśca rudhiraghnam|
rakte 'tivartamāne śūle ca ghṛtaṃ vidhātavyam||
6.14.197 |  kuṭajaphalavalkakeśaranīlotpalalodhradhātakīkalkaiḥ|
siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ śūle raktārśasāṃ bhiṣajā||
6.14.198 |  sarpiḥ sadāḍimarasaṃ sayāvaśūkaṃ śṛtaṃ jayatyāśu|
raktaṃ saśūlamathavā nidigdhikādugdhikāsiddham||
6.14.199 |  lājāpeyā pītā sacukrikā keśarotpalaiḥ siddhā|
hantyāśvasrasrāvaṃ tathā balāpṛśniparṇībhyām||
6.14.200 |  hrīverabilvanāgaraniryūhe sādhitāṃ sanavanītām|
vṛkṣāmladāḍimāmlāmamlīkāmlāṃ sakolāmlām||
6.14.201 |  gṛñjanakasurāsiddhāṃ dadyādyamakena bhirjitāṃ peyām|
raktātisāraśūlapravāhikāśothanigrahaṇīm||
6.14.202 |  kāśmaryāmalakānāṃ *sakarbudārān phalāmlāṃśca|
gṛñjanakaśālmalīnāṃ kṣīriṇyāścukrikāyāśca||
6.14.203 |  nyagrodhaśuṅgakānāṃ khaṇḍāṃstathā kovidārapuṣpāṇām|
dadhnaḥ sareṇa siddhān dadyādrakte pravṛtte 'ti||
6.14.204 |  siddhaṃ palāṇḍuśākaṃ takreṇopodikāṃ sabadarāmlām|
rudhirasrave pradadyānmasūrasūpaṃ ca takrāmlam||
6.14.205 |  payasā śṛtena *yūṣairmasūramudgāḍhakīmakuṣṭhānām|
bhojanamadyādamlaiḥ śāliśyāmākakodravajam||
6.14.206 |  śaśahariṇalāvamāṃsaiḥ kapiñjalaiṇeyakaiḥ susiddhaiśca|
bhojanamadyādamlairmadhurairīṣat samaricairvā||
6.14.207 |  dakṣaśikhitittirirasairdvikakudalopākajaiśca madhurāmlaiḥ|
adyādrasairativaheṣvarśaḥsvanilolbaṇaśarīraḥ||
6.14.208 |  *rasakhaḍayūṣayavāgūsaṃyogataḥ kevalo 'thavā jayati|
raktamativartamānaṃ vātaṃ ca palāṇḍurupayuktaḥ||
6.14.209 |  chāgāntarādhi taruṇaṃ sarudhiramupasādhitaṃ bahupalāṇḍu|
vyatyāsānmadhurāmlaṃ viṭśoṇitasaṃkṣaye deyam||
6.14.210 |  navanītatilābhyāsāt keśaranavanītaśarkarābhyāsāt|
dadhisaramathitābhyāsādarśāṃsyapayānti raktāni||
6.14.211 |  navanītaghṛtaṃ chāgaṃ māṃsaṃ ca saṣaṣṭikaḥ śāliḥ|
taruṇaśca surāmaṇḍastaruṇī ca surā nihantyasram||
6.14.212 |  prāyeṇa vātabahulānyarśāṃsi bhavantyatisrute rakte|
duṣṭe 'pi ca kaphapitte tasmādanilo 'dhiko jñeyaḥ||
6.14.213 |  dṛṣṭvā tu raktapittaṃ prabalaṃ kaphāvātaliṅgamalpaṃ ca|
śītā kriyā prayojyā yatheritā vakṣyate *cānyā||
6.14.214 |  madhukaṃ sapañcavalkaṃ badarītvagudumbaraṃ dhavapaṭolam|
pariṣecane vidadhyādvṛṣakakumayavāsanimbāṃśca||
6.14.215 |  rakte 'tivartamāne dāhe klede 'vagāhayeccāpi|
madhukamṛṇālapadmakacandanakuśakāśaniṣkvāthe||
6.14.216 |  ikṣurasamadhukavetasaniryūhe śītale payasi vā tam|
avagāhayet pradigdhaṃ pūrvaṃ śiśireṇa tailena||
6.14.217 |  dattvā ghṛtaṃ saśarkaramupasthadeśe gude trikadeśe ca|
śiśirajalasparśasukhā dhārā prastambhanī yojyā||
6.14.218 |  kadalīdalairabhinavaiḥ puṣkarapatraiśca śītajalasiktaiḥ|
pracchādanaṃ muhurmuhuriṣṭaṃ padmotpaladalaiśca||
6.14.219 |  dūrvāghṛtapradehaḥ śatadhautasahasradhautamapi sarpiḥ|
vyajanapavanaḥ suśīto raktasrāvaṃ jayatyāśu||
6.14.220 |  samaṅgāmadhukābhyāṃ tilamadhukābhyāṃ rasāñjanaghṛtābhyām|
sarjarasaghṛtābhyāṃ vā nimbaghṛtābhyāṃ madhughṛtābhyāṃ vā||
6.14.221 |  dārvītvaksarpirbhyāṃ sacandanābhyāmathotpalaghṛtābhayām|
dāhe klede ca gudabhraṃśe gudajāḥ pratisāraṇīyāḥ syuḥ||
6.14.222 |  ābhiḥ kriyābhirathavā śītābhiryasya tiṣṭhati na raktam|
taṃ kāle snigdhoṣṇairmāṃsarasaistarpayenmatimān||
6.14.223 |  avapīḍakasarpirbhiḥ koṣṇairghṛtatailikaistathā 'bhyaṅgaiḥ|
kṣīraghṛtatailasekaiḥ koṣṇaistamupācaredāśu||
6.14.224 |  koṣṇena vātaprabale ghṛtamaṇḍenānuvāsayecchīghram|
picchābastiṃ dadyāt kāle tasyāthavā siddham||
6.14.225 |  yavāsakuśakāśānāṃ mūlaṃ puṣpaṃ ca śālmalam|
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaśuṅgāśca dvipalonmitāḥ||
6.14.226 |  triprasthaṃ salilasyaitat kṣīraprasthaṃ ca sādhayet|
kṣīraśeṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ ca pūtaṃ kalkairvimiśrayet||
6.14.227 |  kalkāḥ śālmaliniryāsasamaṅgācandanotpalam|
vatsakasya ca bījāni priyaṅguḥ padmakeśaram||
6.14.228 |  picchābastirayaṃ siddhaḥ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaraḥ|
pravāhikāgudabhraṃśaraktasrāvajvarāpahaḥ||
6.14.229 |  prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ *picchābastau yatheritān|
piṣṭvā 'nuvāsanaṃ snehaṃ kṣīradviguṇitaṃ pacet||
iti picchābastiḥ|
6.14.230 |  hrīveramutpalaṃ lodhraṃ samaṅgācavyacandanam|
pāṭhā sātiviṣā bilvaṃ dhātakī devadāru ca||
6.14.231 |  dārvītvaṅ nāgaraṃ māṃsī mustaṃ kṣāro yavāgrajaḥ|
citrakaśceti peṣyāṇi cāṅgerīsvarase ghṛtam||
6.14.232 |  aikadhyaṃ sādhayet sarvaṃ tat sarpiḥ paramauṣadham|
arśotisāragrahaṇīpāṇḍuroge jvare 'rucau||
6.14.233 |  mūtrakṛcchre gudabhraṃśe bastyānāhe pravāhaṇe|
picchāsrāve 'rśasāṃ śūle yojyametattridoṣanut||
iti hrīverādighṛtam|
6.14.234 |  avākpuṣpī balā dārvī pṛśniparṇī trikaṇṭakaḥ|
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaśuṅgāśca dvipalonmitāḥ||
6.14.235 |  kaṣāya eṣāṃ peṣyāstu jīvantī kaṭurohiṇī|
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ nāgaraṃ suradāru ca||
6.14.236 |  kaliṅgāḥ śālmalaṃ puṣpaṃ vīrā *candanamutpalam|
kaṭphalaṃ citrako mustaṃ priyaṅgvativiṣāsthirāḥ||
6.14.237 |  padmotpalānāṃ kiñjalkaḥ samaṅgā sanidigdhikā|
bilvaṃ mocarasaḥ pāṭhā bhāgāḥ karṣasamanvitāḥ||
6.14.238 |  catuṣprasthe śṛtaṃ prasthaṃ kaṣāyamavatārayet|
triṃśatpalāni prastho 'tra vijñeyo dvipalādhikaḥ||
6.14.239 |  suniṣaṇṇakacāṅgeryoḥ prasthau dvau svarasasya ca|
sarvairetairyathoddiṣṭairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||
6.14.240 |  etadarśaḥsvatīsāre raktasrāve tridoṣaje|
pravāhaṇe gudabhraṃśe picchāsu vividhāsu ca||
6.14.241 |  utthāne cātibahuśaḥ śothaśūle gudāśraye|
mūtragrahe mūḍhavāte mande 'gnāvarucāvapi||
6.14.242 |  prayojyaṃ vidhivat sarpirbalavarṇāgnivardhanam|
vividheṣvannapāneṣu kevalaṃ vā niratyayam||
iti suniṣaṇṇakacāṅgerīghṛtam|
6.14.243 |  bhavanti cātra---
vyatyāsānmadhurāmlāni śītoṣṇāni ca yojayet|
nityamagnibalāpekṣī jayatyarśaḥkṛtān gadān||
6.14.244 |  trayo vikārāḥ prāyeṇa ye parasparahetavaḥ|
arśāṃsi cātisāraśca grahaṇīdoṣa eva ca||
6.14.245 |  eṣāmagnibale hīne vṛddhirvṛddhe parikṣayaḥ|
tasmādagnibalaṃ rakṣyameṣu triṣu viśeṣataḥ||
6.14.246 |  bhṛṣṭaiḥ śākairyavāgūbhiryūṣairmāṃsarasaiḥ khaḍaiḥ|
kṣīratakraprayogaiśca vividhairgudajāñjayet||
6.14.247 |  yadvāyorānulomyāya yadagnibalavṛddhaye|
annapānauṣadhadravyaṃ tat sevyaṃ nityamarśasaiḥ||
6.14.248 |  yadato viparītaṃ syānnidāne yacca darśitam|
gudajābhiparītena tat sevyaṃ na kadācana||
6.14.249 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
arśasāṃ dvividhaṃ janma pṛthagāyatanāni ca|
sthānasaṃsthānaliṅgāni sādhyāsādhyaviniścayaḥ||
6.14.250 |  abhyaṅgāḥ svedanaṃ dhūmāḥ sāvagāhāḥ pralepanāḥ|
śoṇitasyāvasekaśca yogā dīpanapācanāḥ||
6.14.251 |  pānānnavidhiragryaśca vātavarco 'nulomanaḥ|
yogāḥ saṃśamanīyāśca sarpīṃṣi vividhāni ca||
6.14.252 |  bastayastakrayogāśca varāriṣṭāḥ saśarkarāḥ|
*śuṣkāṇāmarśasāṃ śastāḥ srāviṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca||
6.14.253 |  dvividhaṃ sānubandhānāṃ teṣāṃ ceṣṭaṃ yadauṣadham|
raktasaṃgrahaṇāḥ kvāthāḥ peṣyāśca vividhātmakāḥ||
6.14.254 |  snehāhāravidhiścāgryo yogāśca pratisāraṇāḥ|
prakṣālanāvagāhāśca pradehāḥ secanāni ca||
6.14.255 |  ativṛttasya raktasya vidhātavyaṃ yadauṣadham|
tatsarvamiha nirdiṣṭaṃ gudajānāṃ cikitsite||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne 'rśaścikitsitaṃ nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||14 | |

pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.15.1 |  athāto grahaṇīdoṣacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.15.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.15.3 |  āyurvarṇo balaṃ svāsthyamutsāhopacayau prabhā|
aujastejo 'gnyaḥ prāṇāścoktā dehāgnihetukāḥ||
6.15.4 |  śānte 'gnau mriyate, yukte ciraṃ jīvatyanāmayaḥ|
rogī syādvikṛte, mūlamagnistasmānnirucyate||
6.15.5 |  yadannaṃ dehadhātvojobalavarṇādipoṣakam|
tatrāgnirheturāhārānna hyapakvādrasādayaḥ||
6.15.6 |  annamādānakarmā tu prāṇaḥ koṣṭhaṃ prakarṣati|
taddravairbhinnasaṃghātaṃ snehena mṛdutāṃ gatam||
6.15.7 |  samānenāvadhūto+*agnirudaryaḥ pavanodvahaḥ|
kāle bhuktaṃ samaṃ samyak pacatyāyurvivṛddhaye||
6.15.8 |  evaṃ rasamalāyānnamāśayasthamadhaḥsthitaḥ|
pacatyagniryathā sthālyāmodanāyāmbutaṇḍulam||
6.15.9 |  annasya bhuktamātrasya ṣaḍrasasya prapākataḥ|
madhurādyāt kapho bhāvāt *phenabhūta udīryate||
6.15.10 |  paraṃ tu pacyamānasya vidagdhasyāmlabhāvataḥ|
āśayāccyavamānasya pittamacchamudīryate||
6.15.11 |  pakvāśayaṃ tu prāptasya śoṣyamāṇasya vahninā|
paripiṇḍitapakvasya vāyuḥ syāt kaṭubhāvataḥ||
6.15.12 |  annamiṣṭaṃ *hyupahitamiṣṭairgandhādibhiḥ pṛthak|
dehe prīṇāti gandhādīn *ghrāṇādīnīndriyāṇi ca||
6.15.13 |  bhaumāpyāgneyavāyavyāḥ pañcoṣmāṇaḥ sanābhasāḥ|
pañcāhāraguṇānsvānsvānpārthivādīnpacanti||
6.15.14 |  yathāsvaṃ svaṃ ca puṣṇanti dehe dravyaguṇāḥ pṛthak|
pārthivāḥ pārthivāneva śeṣāḥ śeṣāṃśca kṛtsnaśaḥ||
6.15.15 |  saptabhirdehadhātāro dhātavo dvividhaṃ punaḥ|
yathāsvamagnibhiḥ pākaṃ yānti *kiṭṭaprasādavat||
6.15.16 |  rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedastato 'sthi ca|
asthno majjā tataḥ śukraṃ śukrādgarbhaḥ prasādajaḥ||
6.15.17 |  rasāt stanyaṃ *tato raktamasṛjaḥ kaṇḍarāḥ sirāḥ|
māṃsādvasā tvacaḥ ṣaṭ ca medasaḥ *snāyusaṃbhavaḥ||
6.15.18 |  kiṭṭamannasya viṇmūtraṃ, rasasya tu kapho 'sṛjaḥ|
pittaṃ, māṃsasya khamalā, malaḥ svedastu medasaḥ||
6.15.19 |  syātkiṭṭaṃ keśalomāsthno, majjñaḥ sneho 'kṣiviṭtvacṛāṃ|
prasādakiṭṭe dhātūnāṃ *pākādevaṃvidharcchataḥ||
6.15.20 |  parasparopasaṃstambdhā *dhātusnehaparamparā|
vṛṣyādīnāṃ prabhāvastu puṣṇāti balamāśu hi||
6.15.21 |  ṣaḍbhiḥ kecidahorātrairicchanti parivartanam|
saṃtatyā bhojyadhātūnāṃ parivṛttistu cakravat||
(6.15.22 |  *ityuktavantamācāryaṃ śiṣyastvidamacodayat|
rasādraktaṃ *visadṛśāt kathaṃ dehe 'bhijāyate||
6.15.23 |  rasasya ca na rāgo 'sti sa kathaṃ yāti raktatām|
dravādraktātsthiraṃ māṃsaṃ kathaṃ tajjāyate nṛṇām||
6.15.24 |  *dravadhātoḥ sthirānmāṃsānmedasaḥ saṃbhavaḥ katham|
ślakṣṇābhyāṃ māṃsamedobhyāṃ kharatvaṃ kathamasthiṣu||
6.15.25 |  khareṣvasthiṣu majjā ca kena snigdho mṛdustathā|
majjñaśca pariṇāmena yadi śukraṃ pravartate||
6.15.26 |  sarvadehagataṃ śukraṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ|
tathā 'sthimadhyamajjñaśca śukraṃ bhavati dehinām||
6.15.27 |  chidraṃ na dṛśyate 'sthnāṃ ca tanniḥsarati vā katham|
evamuktastu śiṣyeṇa guruḥ prāhedamuttaram||
6.15.28 |  tejo rasānāṃ sarveṣāṃ manujānāṃ yaducyate|
pittoṣmaṇaḥ sa rāgeṇa raso raktatvamṛcchati||
6.15.29 |  vāyvambutejasā raktamūṣmaṇā cābhisaṃyutam|
sthiratāṃ prāpya māṃsaṃ syāt svoṣmaṇā pakvameva *tat||
6.15.30 |  svatejo 'mbuguṇasnigdhodriktaṃ medo 'bhijāyate|
pṛthivyagnyanilādīnāṃ saṃghātaḥ *svoṣmaṇā kṛtaḥ||
6.15.31 |  kharatvaṃ prakarotyasya jāyate 'sthi tato nṛṇām|
karoti tatra sauṣiryamasthnāṃ madhye samīraṇaḥ||
6.15.32 |  medasastāni pūryante sneho majjā tataḥ smṛtaḥ|
tasmānmajjñastu yaḥ snehaḥ śukraṃ saṃjāyate tataḥ||
6.15.33 |  vāyvākāśādibhirbhāvaiḥ sauṣiryaṃ jāyate 'sthiṣu|
tena sravati tacchukraṃ navāt kumbhādivodakam||
6.15.34 |  srotobhiḥ syandate dehāt *samantācchukravāhibhiḥ|
harṣeṇodīritaṃ vegāt saṃkalpācca manobhavāt||
6.15.35 |  vilīnaṃ ghṛtavadvyāyāmoṣmaṇā sthānavicyutam|
bastau saṃbhṛtya niryāti sthalānnimnādivodakam||)
6.15.36 |  vyānena rasadhāturhi vikṣepocitakarmaṇā|
yugapat sarvato 'jasraṃ dehe vikṣipyate sadā||
6.15.37 |  kṣipyamāṇaḥ khavaiguṇyādrasaḥ sajjati yatra saḥ|
*karoti vikṛtiṃ tatra khe varṣamiva toyadaḥ||
6.15.38 |  doṣāṇāmapi caivaṃ *syādekadeśaprakopaṇam|
iti bhautikadhātvannapaktṛṛṇāṃ karma bhāṣitam||
6.15.39 |  annasya paktā sarveṣāṃ paktṛṛṇāmadhipo mataḥ|
tanmūlāste hi tadvṛddhikṣayavṛddhikṣayātmakāḥ||
6.15.40 |  tasmāttaṃ vidhivadyuktairannapānendhanairhitaiḥ|
pālayet prayatastasya sthitau hyāyurbalasthitiḥ||
6.15.41 |  yo hi bhuṅkte vidhiṃ tyaktvā grahaṇīdoṣajān gadān|
sa laulyāllabhate śīghraṃ, vakṣyante 'taḥ paraṃ tu te||
6.15.42 |  abhojanādajīrṇātibhojanādviṣamāśanāt|
asātmyaguruṇītātirūkṣasaṃduṣṭabhojanāt||
6.15.43 |  virekavamanasnehavibhramādvyādhikarṣaṇāt|
deśakālartuvaiṣamyādvegānāṃ ca vidhāraṇāt||
6.15.44 |  duṣyatyagniḥ, sa duṣṭo 'nnaṃ na tat pacati laghvapi|
apacyamānaṃ śuktatvaṃ yātyannaṃ *viṣarūpatām||
6.15.45 |  tasya liṅgamajīrṇasya viṣṭambhaḥ sadanaṃ tathā|
śiraso ruk ca mūrcchā ca bhramaḥ pṛṣṭhakaṭigrahaḥ||
6.15.46 |  jṛmbhā 'ṅgamardastṛṣṇā ca jvaraśchardiḥ pravāhaṇam|
arocako 'vipākaśca, ghoramannaviṣaṃ ca tat||
6.15.47 |  *saṃsṛjyamānaṃ pittena dāhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ mukhāmayān|
janayatyamlapittaṃ ca pittajāṃścāparān gadān||
6.15.48 |  yakṣmapīnasamehādīn kaphajān kaphasaṅgatam|
karoti vātasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ *vātajāṃśca gadān bahūn||
6.15.49 |  mūtrarogāṃśca mūtrasthaṃ kukṣirogān śakṛdgatam|
rasādibhiśca saṃsṛṣṭaṃ kuryādrogān rasādijān||
6.15.50 |  viṣamo dhātuvaiṣamyaṃ karoti viṣamaṃ pacan|
tīkṣṇo mandendhano dhātūn viśoṣayati pāvakaḥ||
6.15.51 |  yuktaṃ bhuktavato yukto dhātusāmyaṃ samaṃ pacan|
durbalo vidahatyannaṃ tadyātyūrdhvamadho 'pi vā||
6.15.52 |  adhastu pakvamāmaṃ vā pravṛttaṃ grahaṇīgadaḥ|
ucyate sarvamevānnaṃ prāyo hyasya vidahyate||
6.15.53 |  atisṛṣṭaṃ vibaddhaṃ vā dravaṃ tadupadiśyate|
tṛṣṇārocakavairasyaprasekatamakānvitaḥ||
6.15.54 |  śūnapādakaraḥ sāsthiparvaruk chardanaṃ jvaraḥ|
*lohāmagandhistiktāmla udgāraścāsya jāyate||
6.15.55 |  pūrvarūpaṃ tu tasyedaṃ tṛṣṇā++ālasyaṃ balakṣayaḥ|
vidāho 'nnasya pākaśca cirāt kāyasya gauravam||
6.15.56 |  agnyadhiṣṭhānamannasya 'grahaṇādgrahaṇī matā|
*nābheruparyahyagnibalenopaṣṭabdhopabṛṃhitā||
6.15.57 |  apakvaṃ dhāratyannaṃ pakvaṃ sṛjati pārśvataḥ|
durbalāgnibalā duṣṭā tvāmameva vimuñcati||
6.15.58 |  vātāt pittāt kaphācca syāttadrogastribhya eva ca|
hetuṃ liṅgaṃ *rūpabhedāñ śṛṇu tasya pṛthak pṛthak||
6.15.59 |  kaṭutiktakaṣāyātirūkṣaśītalabhojanaiḥ|
pramitānaśanātyadhvaveganigrahamaithunaiḥ||
6.15.60 |  karoti kupito mandamagniṃ saṃchādya *mārutaḥ|
tasyānnaṃ pacyate duḥkhaṃ śuktapākaṃ kharāṅgatā||
6.15.61 |  kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇā timiraṃ karṇayoḥ svanaḥ|
pārśvoruvaṅkṣaṇagrīvārujo 'bhīkṣṇaṃ visūcikā||
6.15.62 |  hṛtpīḍā kārśyadaurbalyaṃ vairasyaṃ parikartikā|
gṛddhiḥ sarvarasānāṃ ca manasaḥ sadanaṃ tathā||
6.15.63 |  jīrṇe jīryati cādhmānaṃ bhukte svāsthyamupaiti ca|
sa vātagulmahṛdrogaplīhāśaṅkī ca mānavaḥ||
6.15.64 |  cirāguḥkhaṃ dravaṃ śuṣkaṃ tanvāmaṃ śabdaphenavat|
punaḥ punaḥ sṛjedvarcaḥ kāsaśvāsārdito 'nilāt||
6.15.65 |  kaṭvājīrṇavidāhyamlakṣārādyaiḥ pittamulbaṇam|
*agnimāplāvayaddhanti jalaṃ taptamivānalam||
6.15.66 |  so 'jīrṇaṃ nīlapītābhaṃ pītābhaḥ sāryate dravam|
pūtyamlodgārahṛtkaṇṭhadāhārucitṛḍarditaḥ||
6.15.67 |  gurvatisnigdhaśītādibhojanādatibhojanāt|
bhuktamātrasya ca svapnāddhantyagniṃ kupitaḥ kaphaḥ||
6.15.68 |  tasyānnaṃ pacyate duḥkhaṃ hṛllāsacchardyarocakāḥ|
āsyopadehamādhuryakāsaṣṭhīvanapīnasāḥ||
6.15.69 |  hṛdyaṃ manyate styānamudaraṃ stimitaṃ guru|
duṣṭo madhura udgāraḥ sadanaṃ strīṣvaharṣaṇam||
6.15.70 |  bhinnāmaśleṣmasaṃsṛṣṭaguruvarcaḥpravartanam|
akṛśasyāpi daurbalyamālasyaṃ ca kaphātmake||
6.15.71 |  yaścāgniḥ pūrvamuddiṣṭo rogānīke caturvidhaḥ|
taṃ cāpi grahaṇīdoṣaṃ samavarjaṃ pracakṣmahe||
6.15.72 |  pṛthagvātādinirdiṣṭahetuliṅgasamāgame|
tridoṣaṃ nirdiśetteṣāṃ *bheṣajaṃ śṛṇvataḥ param||
6.15.73 |  grahaṇīmāśritaṃ doṣaṃ vidagdhāhāramūrcchitam|
saviṣṭambhaprasekārtividāhārucigauravaiḥ||
6.15.74 |  āmaliṅgānvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhoṣṇenāmbunoddharet|
phalānāṃ vā kaṣāyeṇa pippalīsarṣapaistathā||
6.15.75 |  līnaṃ pakvāśayasthaṃ vā+āpyāmaṃ srāvyaṃ sadīpanaiḥ|
śarīrānugate sāme rase laṅghanapācanam||
6.15.76 |  viśuddhāmāśayāyāsmai pañcakolādibhiḥ śṛtam|
dadyāt peyādi laghvannaṃ punaryogāṃśca dīpanān||
6.15.77 |  jñātvā tu paripakvāmaṃ mārutagrahaṇīgadam|
dīpanīyayutaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayetālpaśo bhiṣak||
6.15.78 |  kiṃcitsandhukṣite tvagnau saktaviṇmūtramārutam|
dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā saṃsnehya svinnābhyaktaṃ nirūhayet||
6.15.79 |  tata eraṇḍatailena sarpiṣā tailvakena vā|
sakṣāreṇānile śānte srastadoṣaṃ virecayet||
6.15.80 |  śuddhaṃ rūkṣāśayaṃ baddhavarcasaṃ cānuvāsayet|
dīpanīyāmlavātaghnasiddhatailena mātrayā||
6.15.81 |  nīrūḍhaṃ ca viriktaṃ ca samyak caivānuvāsitam|
laghvannaṃ pratisaṃbhuktaṃ sarpirabhyāsayet punaḥ||
6.15.82 |  dve pañcamūle saralaṃ devadāru sanāgaram|
pippalīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ citrakaṃ hastipippalīm||
6.15.83 |  śaṇabījaṃ yavān kolān kulatthān *suṣavīṃ tathā|
pācayedāranālena dadhnā sauvīrakeṇa vā||
6.15.84 |  caturbhāgāvaśeṣeṇa pacettena ghṛtāḍhakam|
svarjikāyāvaśūkākhyau kṣārau dattvā ca yuktitaḥ||
6.15.85 |  saindhavaudbhidasāmudrabiḍānāṃ romakasya ca|
sasauvarcalapākyānāṃ bhāgāndvipalikān pṛthak||
6.15.86 |  vinīya cūrṇitān tasmāt pāyayet prasṛtaṃ buddhaḥ|
karotyagniṃ balaṃ varṇaṃ vātaghnaṃ bhuktapācanam||
iti daśamūlādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.15.87 |  tryūṣaṇatriphalākalke bilvamātre guḍāt pale|
sarpiṣo 'ṣṭapalaṃ paktvā mātrāṃ mandānalaḥ pibet||
iti tryūṣaṇādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.15.88 |  pañcamūlābhayāvyoṣapippalīmūlasaindhavaiḥ|
rāsnākṣāradvayājājīviḍaṅgaśaṭibhirghṛtam||
6.15.89 |  śuktena mātuluṅgasya svarasenārdrakasya ca|
śuṣkamūlakakolāmbucukrikādāḍimasya ca||
6.15.90 |  takramastusurāmaṇḍasauvīrakatuṣodakaiḥ|
kāñjikena ca tat pakvamagnidīptikaraṃ param||
6.15.91 |  śūlagulmodaraśvāsakāsānilakaphāpaham|
sabījapūrakarasaṃ siddhaṃ vā pāyayedghṛtam||
6.15.92 |  siddhamabhyañjanārthaṃ ca tailametaiḥ prayojayet|
eteṣāmauṣadhānāṃ vā pibeccūrṇaṃ sukhāmbunā||
6.15.93 |  vāte śleṣmāvṛte sāme kaphe vā vāyunoddhate|
dadyāccūrṇaṃ pācanārthamagnisandīpanaṃ param||
iti pañcamūlādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ ca|
6.15.94 |  majjatyāmā gurutvādviṭ pakvā tūtplavate jale|
vinā 'tidravasaṅghātaśaityaśleṣmapradūṣaṇāt||
6.15.95 |  parīkṣyaivaṃ purā sāmaṃ nirāmaṃ cāmadoṣiṇam|
vidhinopācaret samyak pācanenetareṇa vā||
6.15.96 |  citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ dvau kṣārau lavaṇāni ca|
vyoṣaṃ hiṅgvajamodāṃ ca cavyaṃ caikatra cūrṇayet||
6.15.97 |  guṭikā mātuluṅgasya dāḍimasya rasena vā|
kṛtā vipācayatyāmaṃ dīpayatyāśu cālanam||
iti citrakādyā guṭikā|
6.15.98 |  nāgarātiviṣāmustakvāthaḥ syādāmapācanaḥ|
mustāntakalkaḥ pathyā vā nāgaraṃ coṣṇavāriṇā||
6.15.99 |  devadāruvacāmustanāgarātiviṣābhayāḥ|
vāruṇyāmāsutāstoye koṣṇe vā 'lavaṇāḥ pibet||
6.15.100 |  varcasyāme saśūle ca pibedvā dāḍimāmbunā|
*viḍena lavaṇaṃ piṣṭaṃ bilvaṃ citrakanāgaram||
6.15.101 |  sāme vā sakaphe vāte koṣṭhaśūlakare pibet|
kaliṅgahiṅgvativiṣāvacāsauvarcalābhayāḥ||
6.15.102 |  chardyarśogranthiśūleṣu pibeduṣṇena vāriṇā|
pathyāsauvarcalājājīcūrṇaṃ maricasaṃyutam||
6.15.103 |  abhayāṃ pippalīmūlaṃ vacāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm|
pāṭhāṃ vatsakabījāni citrakaṃ viśvabheṣajam||
6.15.104 |  pibenniṣkvāthya cūrṇaṃ vā kṛtvā koṣṇena vāriṇā|
pittaśleṣmābhibhūtāyāṃ grahaṇyāṃ śūlanuddhitam||
6.15.105 |  sāme sātiviṣaṃ vyoṣaṃ lavaṇakṣārahiṅgu ca|
niḥkvāthya pāyayeccūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vā koṣṇavāriṇā||
6.15.106 |  pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ sārivāṃ bṛhatīdvayam|
citrakaṃ kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ lavaṇānyatha pañca ca||
6.15.107 |  taccūrṇaṃ sayavakṣāraṃ dadhyuṣṇāmbusurādibhiḥ|
pibedagnivivṛddhyarthaṃ koṣṭhavātaharaṃ naraḥ||
6.15.108 |  maricaṃ kuñcikāmbaṣṭhāvṛkṣāmlāḥ kuḍavāḥ pṛthak|
*palāni daśa cāmlasya vetasasya palārdhikam||
6.15.109 |  sauvarcalaṃ biḍaṃ pākyaṃ yavakṣāraḥ sasaindhavaḥ|
śaṭīpuṣkaramūlāni hiṅgu hiṅguśivāṭikā||
6.15.110 |  tat sarvamekataḥ sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā prayojayet|
hitaṃ vātābhibhūtāyāṃ grahaṇyāmarucau tathā||
iti maricādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ|
6.15.111 |  caturṇāṃ prasthamamlānāṃ tryūṣaṇasya palatrayam|
lavaṇānāṃ ca catvāri śarkarāyāḥ palāṣṭakam|
saṃcūrṇya śākasūpānnarāgādiṣvavacārayet||
6.15.112 |  kāsājīrṇāruciśvāsahṛtpāṇḍvāmayaśūlanut|
cavyatvakpippalīmūladhātakīvyoṣacitrakān||
6.15.113 |  kapitthaṃ bilvamambaṣṭhāṃ śālmalaṃ hastipippalīm|
śilodbhedaṃ tathā 'jājīṃ piṣṭvā badarasaṃmitam||
6.15.114 |  paribharjya ghṛte dadhnā yavāgūṃ sādhayedbhiṣak|
rasaiḥ kapitthacukrīkāvṛkṣāmlairdāḍimasya ca||
6.15.115 |  sarvātisāragrahaṇīgulmārśaḥplīhanāśinī|
pañcakolakayūṣaśca mūlakānāṃ ca soṣaṇaḥ||
6.15.116 |  snigdho dāḍimatakrāmlo jāṅgalaḥ saṃskṛto rasaḥ|
kravyādasvarasaḥ śasto bhojanārthe sadīpanaḥ||
6.15.117 |  takrāranālamadyāni pānāyāriṣṭa eva ca|
takraṃ tu grahaṇīdoṣe dīpanagrāhilāghavāt||
6.15.118 |  śreṣṭhaṃ madhurapākitvānna ca pittaṃ prakopayet|
kaṣāyoṣṇavikāśitvādraukṣyāccaiva kaphe hitam||
6.15.119 |  vāte svādvamlasāndratvāt sadyaskamavidāhi tat|
tasmāt takraprayogā ye jaṭharāṇāṃ tathā 'rśasām||
6.15.120 |  vihitā grahaṇīdoṣe sarvaśastān prayojayet|
yavānyāmalake pathyā maricaṃ tripalāṃśikam||
6.15.121 |  lavaṇāni palāṃśāni pañca caikatra cūrṇayet|
takre *tadāsutaṃ jātaṃ takrāriṣṭaṃ pibennaraḥ|
dīpanaṃ śothagulmārśaḥkrimimehodarāpaham||
iti takrāriṣṭaḥ|
6.15.122 |  svasthānagatamutkliṣṭamagninirvāpakaṃ bhiṣak|
pittaṃ jñātvā virekeṇa nirharedvamanena vā||
6.15.123 |  avidāhibhirannaiśca laghubhistiktasaṃyutaiḥ|
jāṅgalānāṃ rasairyūṣairmudgādīnāṃ khaḍairapi||
6.15.124 |  dāḍimāmlaiḥ sasarpiṣkairdīpanagrāhisaṃyutaiḥ|
tasyāgniṃ dīpayeccūrṇaiḥ sarpirbhiścāpi tiktakaiḥ||
6.15.125 |  candanaṃ padmakośīraṃ pāṭhāṃ mūrvāṃ kuṭannaṭam|
ṣaḍgranthāsārivāsphotāsaptaparṇāṭarūṣakān||
6.15.126 |  paṭolodumbarāśvatthavaṭaplakṣakapītanān|
kaṭukāṃ rohiṇīṃ mustaṃ nimbaṃ ca dvipalāṃśikam||
6.15.127 |  droṇe 'pāṃ sādhayet pādaśeṣe prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet|
kirātatiktendrayavavīrāmāgadhikotpalaiḥ||
6.15.128 |  kalkairakṣasamaiḥ peyaṃ tat pittagrahaṇīgade|
tiktakaṃ yadghṛtaṃ coktaṃ kauṣṭhike tacca dāpayet||
iti candanādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.15.129 |  nāgarātiviṣe mustaṃ dhātakīṃ ca rasāñjanam|
vatsakatvakphalaṃ bilvaṃ pāṭhāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm||
6.15.130 |  pibet samāṃśaṃ taccūurṇaṃ sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunā|
paittike grahaṇīdoṣe raktaṃ yaccopaveśyate||
6.15.131 |  arśāṃsi ca gude śūlaṃ jayeccaiva pravāhikām|
nāgarādyamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇātreyeṇa pūjitam||
iti nāgarādyaṃ cūrṇam|
6.15.132 |  bhūnimbakaṭukāvyoṣamustakendrayavān samān|
dvau citrakādvatsakatvagbhāgān ṣoḍaśa cūrṇayet||
6.15.133 |  guḍaśītāmbunā pītaṃ grahaṇīdoṣagulmanut|
kāmalājvarapāṇḍutvamehārucyatisāranut||
iti bhūnimbādyaṃ cūrṇam|
6.15.134 |  vacāmativiṣāṃ pāṭhāṃ saptaparṇaṃ rasāñjanam|
syonākodīcyakaṭvaṅgavatsakatvagdurālabhāḥ||
6.15.135 |  dārvīṃ parpaṭakaṃ pāṭhāṃ yavānīṃ madhuśigrukam|
paṭolapatraṃ siddhārthān yūthikāṃ jātipallavān||
6.15.136 |  jambvāmrabilvamadhyāni nimbaśākaphalāni ca|
tadrogaśamamanvicchan bhūnimbādyena yojayet||
6.15.137 |  kirātatiktaḥ ṣaḍgranthā trāyamāṇā kaṭutrikam|
candanaṃ padmakośīraṃ dārvītvak kaṭurohiṇī||
6.15.138 |  kaṭajatvakphalaṃ mustaṃ yavānī devadāru ca|
paṭolanimbapatrailāsaurāṣṭryativiṣātvacaḥ||
6.15.139 |  madhuśigrośca bījāni mūrvā parpaṭakastathā|
taccūrṇaṃ madhunā lehyaṃ peyaṃ madyairjalena vā||
6.15.140 |  hṛtpāṇḍugrahaṇīrogagulmaśūlārucijvarān|
kāmalāṃ sannipātaṃ ca mukharogāṃśca nāśayet||
iti kirātādyaṃ cūrṇam|
6.15.141 |  grahaṇyāṃ śleṣmaduṣṭāyāṃ vamitasya yathāvidhi|
kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāraistiktaiścāgniṃ vivardhayet||
6.15.142 |  palāśaṃ citrakaṃ cavyaṃ mātuluṅgaṃ harītakīm|
pippalīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pāṭhāṃ nāgaradhānyakam||
6.15.143 |  kārṣikāṇyudakaprasthe paktvā pādāvaśeṣitam|
pānīyārthaṃ prayuñjīta yavāgūṃ taiśca sādhayet||
6.15.144 |  śuṣkamūlakayūṣeṇa kaulatthenāthavā punaḥ|
kaṭvamlakṣārapaṭunā laghūnyannāni bhojayet||
6.15.145 |  amlaṃ cānu pibettakraṃ takrāriṣṭamathāpi vā|
madirāṃ madhvariṣṭaṃ vā nigadaṃ sīdhumeva vā||
6.15.146 |  droṇaṃ madhūkapuṣpāṇāṃ viḍaṅgānāṃ tato 'rdhataḥ|
citrakasya tato 'rdhaṃ syāttathā bhallātakāḍhakam||
6.15.147 |  *mañjiṣṭhāṣṭapalaṃ caiva tridroṇe 'pāṃ vipācayet|
droṇaśeṣaṃ tu tacchītaṃ madhvardhāḍhakasaṃyutam||
6.15.148 |  elāmṛṇālāgurubhiścandanena ca rūṣite|
kumbhe māsasthitaṃ jātamāsavaṃ taṃ prayojayet||
6.15.149 |  grahaṇīṃ dīpayatyeva *bṛṃhaṇaḥ kaphapittajit|
śothaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsaṃ ca pramehāṃśca praṇāśayet||
iti madhūkāsavaḥ|
6.15.150 |  madhūkapuṣpasvarasaṃ śṛtamardhakṣayīkṛtam|
kṣaudrapādayutaṃ śītaṃ pūrvavat sannidhāpayet||
6.15.151 |  taṃ piban grahaṇīdoṣāñjayet sarvān hitāśanaḥ|
*tadvaddrākṣukharjūrasvarasānāsutān pibet||
6.15.152 |  prasthau durālabhāyā dvau prasthamāmalakasya ca|
*dantīcitrakamuṣṭī dve pratyagraṃ cābhayāśatam||
6.15.153 |  caturdroṇe 'mbhasaḥ paktvā śītaṃ droṇāvaśeṣitam|
saguḍadviśataṃ pūtaṃ madhunaḥ kuḍavāyutam||
6.15.154 |  tadvat praiyaṅgoḥ pippalyā viḍaṅgānāṃ ca cūrṇitaiḥ|
kuḍavairghṛtakumbhasthaṃ pakṣājjātaṃ tataḥ pibet||
6.15.155 |  grahaṇīpāṇḍurogārśaḥkuṣṭhavīsarpamehanut|
svaravarṇakaraścaiṣa raktapittakaphāpahaḥ||
iti durālabhāsavaḥ|
6.15.156 |  haridrā pañcamūle dve vīrarṣabhakajīvakam|
*eṣāṃ pañcapalān bhāgāṃścaturdroṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacet||
6.15.157 |  droṇaśeṣe rase pūte guḍasya dviśataṃ bhiṣak|
cūrṇitān kuḍavārdhāṃśān prakṣipecca samākṣikān||
6.15.158 |  priyaṅgumustamañjiṣṭhāviḍaṅgamadhukaplavān|
lodhraṃ śābarakaṃ caiva māsārdhasthaṃ pibettu tam||
6.15.159 |  eṣa mūlāsavaḥ siddho dīpano raktapittajit|
ānāhakaphahṛdrogapāṇḍurogāṅgasādanut||
iti mūlāsavaḥ|

6.15.160 |  *prāsthikaṃ pippalīṃ piṣṭvā guḍaṃ madhyaṃ bibhītakāt|
udakaprasthasaṃyuktaṃ yavapalle nidhāpayet||
6.15.161 |  tasmāt palaṃ sujātāttu salilāñjalisaṃyutam|
pibetpiṇḍāsavo hyeṣa rogānīkavināśanaḥ||
6.15.162 |  svastho 'pyenaṃ pibenmāsaṃ naraḥ *snigdharasāśanaḥ|
icchaṃsteṣāmanutpattiṃ rogāṇāṃ ye 'tra kīrtitāḥ||
iti piṇḍāsavaḥ|
6.15.163 |  nave pippalimadhvākte kalase 'gurudhūpite|
madhvāḍhakaṃ jalasamaṃ cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet||
6.15.164 |  kuḍavārdhaṃ viḍaṅgānāṃ pippalyāḥ kuḍavaṃ tathā|
carurthikāṃśāṃ tvakkṣīrīṃ keśaraṃ maricāni ca||
6.15.165 |  tvagelāpatrakaśaṭīkramukātiviṣāghanān|
hareṇvelvālutejohvāpippalīmūlacitrakān||
6.15.166 |  kārṣikāṃstat sthitaṃ māsamata ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet|
mandaṃ saṃdīpayatyagniṃ karoti viṣamaṃ samam||
6.15.167 |  hṛtpāṇḍugrahaṇīrogakuṣṭhārśaḥśvayathujvarān|
vātaśleṣmāmayāṃścānyānmadhvariṣṭo vyapohati||
iti madhvariṣṭaḥ|
6.15.168 |  samūlāṃ pippalīṃ kṣārau dvau pañca lavaṇāni ca|
mātuluṅgābhayārāsnāśaṭīmaricanāgaram||
6.15.169 |  kṛtvā samāṃśaṃ taccūrṇaṃ pibet prātaḥ sukhāmbunā|
ślaiṣmike grahaṇīdoṣe balavarṇāgnivardhanam||
6.15.170 |  etairevauṣadhaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpiḥ peyaṃ samārute|
gaulmike ṣaṭpalaṃ proktaṃ bhallātakaghṛtaṃ ca yat||
6.15.171 |  biḍaṃ kālotthalavaṇaṃ sarjikāyavaśūkajam|
saptalāṃ kaṇṭakārīṃ ca citrakaṃ ceti dāhayet||
6.15.172 |  saptakṛtvaḥ srutasyāsya *kṣārasya dvyāḍhakena tu|
āḍhakaṃ sarpiṣaḥ paktvā pibedagnivivardhanam||
iti kṣāraghṛtam|
6.15.173 |  samūlāṃ pippalīṃ pāṭhāṃ cavyendrayavanāgaram|
citrakātiviṣe hiṅgu śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.15.174 |  vacāṃ ca kārṣikaṃ pañcalavaṇānāṃ palāni ca|
dadhnaḥ prasthadvaye tailasarpiṣoḥ kuḍavadvaye||
6.15.175 |  khaṇḍīkṛtāni niṣkvāthya śanairantargate rase|
antardhūmaṃ tato dagdhvā cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtāplutam||
6.15.176 |  pibet pāṇitalaṃ tasmiñjīrṇe syānmadhurāśanaḥ|
vātaśleṣmāmayānsarvānhanyādviṣagarāṃśca saḥ||
6.15.177 |  bhallātakaṃ trikaṭukaṃ triphalāṃ lavaṇatrayam|
antardhūmaṃ dvipalikaṃ gopurīṣāgninā dahet||
6.15.178 |  sa kṣāraḥ sarpiṣā pīto bhojye vā 'pyavacūrṇitaḥ|
hṛtpāṇḍugrahaṇīdoṣagulmodāvartaśūlanut||
6.15.179 |  durālabhāṃ karañjau dvau saptaparṇaṃ savatsakam|
ṣaḍgranthāṃ madanaṃ mūrvāṃ pāṭhāmāragvadhaṃ tathā||
6.15.180 |  gomūtreṇa samāṃśāni kṛtvā cūrṇāni dāhayet|
dagdhvā ca taṃ pibet kṣāraṃ grahaṇībalavardhanam||
6.15.181 |  bhūnimbaṃ rohiṇīṃ tiktāṃ paṭolaṃ nimbaparpaṭam|
dahenmāhiṣamūtreṇa kṣāra eṣo 'gnivardhanaḥ||
6.15.182 |  dve haridre vacā kuṣṭhaṃ citrakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī|
mustaṃ ca bastamūtreṇ dahet kṣāro 'gnivardhanaḥ||
6.15.183 |  catuṣpalaṃ sudhākāṇḍāttripalaṃ lavaṇatrayāt|
vārtākīkuḍavaṃ cārkādaṣṭau dve citrakāt pale||
6.15.184 |  dagdhāni vārtākurase guṭikā bhojanottarāḥ|
bhuktaṃ bhuktaṃ pacantyāśu kāsaśvāsārśasāṃ hitāḥ||
6.15.185 |  visūcikāpratiśyāyahṛdrogaśamanāśca tāḥ|
ityeṣā kṣāraguṭikā kṛṣṇātreyeṇa kīrtitā||
iti kṣāraguḍikā|
6.15.186 |  vatsakātiviṣe pāṭhāṃ duḥsparśāṃ hiṅgu citrakam|
cūrṇīkṛtya palāśāgrakṣāre mūtrasrute pacet||
6.15.187 |  āyase bhājane *sāndrāttasmāt kolaṃ sukhāmbunā|
madyairvā grahaṇīdoṣaśothārśaḥpāṇḍumān pibet||
iti caturthakṣāraḥ|
6.15.188 |  tripalāṃ kaṭabhīṃ cavyaṃ bilvamadhyamayorajaḥ|
rohiṇīṃ kaṭukāṃ mustaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ pāṭhāṃ ca hiṅgu ca||
6.15.189 |  madhukaṃ muṣkakayavakṣārau trikaṭukaṃ vacām|
viḍaṅgaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ svarjikāṃ nimbacitrakau||
6.15.190 |  mūrvājamodendrayavān guḍūcīṃ devaśāru ca|
kārṣikaṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca pañcānāṃ palikānpṛthak||
6.15.191 |  bhāgān dadhni trikuḍave ghṛtatailena mūrcchitam|
antardhūmaṃ śanairdagdhvā tasmāt pāṇitalaṃ pibet||
6.15.192 |  sarpiṣā kaphavātārśograhaṇīpāṇḍurogavān|
plīhamūtragrahaśvāsahikkākāsakrimujvarān||
6.15.193 |  śoṣātisārau śvayathuṃ pramehānāhahṛdgrahān|
hanyāt *sarvaviṣaṃ caiva kṣāro 'gnijanano varaḥ||
6.15.194 |  jīrṇe rasairvā madhurairaśnīyāt payasā 'pi vā|
iti pañcamakṣāraḥ|
tridoṣe vidhividvaidyaḥ pañca karmāṇi kārayet||
6.15.195 |  ghṛtakṣārāsavāriṣṭān dadyāccāgnivivardhanān|
kriyā yā cānilādīnāṃ nirdiṣṭā grahaṇīṃ prati||
6.15.196 |  vyatyāsāttāṃ samastāṃ vā kuryāddoṣaviśeṣavit|
snehanaṃ svedanaṃ śuddhirlaṅghanaṃ dīpanaṃ ca yat||
6.15.197 |  cūrṇāni lavaṇākṣāramadhvariṣṭasurāsavāḥ|
vividhāstakrayogāśca dīpanānāṃ ca sarpiṣām||
6.15.198 |  grahaṇīrogibhiḥ sevyāḥ, kriyāṃ cāvasthikīṃ śṛṇu|
ṣṭhīvanaṃ ślaiṣmike rūkṣaṃ dīpanaṃ tiktasaṃyutam||
6.15.199 |  sakṛdrūkṣaṃ sakṛtsnigdhaṃ kṛśe bahukaphe hitam|
parīkṣyāmaṃ śarīrasya dīpanaṃ snehasaṃyutam||
6.15.200 |  dīpanaṃ bahupittasya tiktaṃ madhurasaṃyutam|
bahūvātasya tu snehalavaṇāmlayutaṃ hitam||
6.15.201 |  sandhukṣati tathā vahnireṣāṃ vidhivadindhanaiḥ|
snehameva paraṃ vidyāddurbalānaladīpanam||
6.15.202 |  nālaṃ snehasamiddhasya śamāyānnaṃ sugurvapi|
mandāgniravipakvaṃ tu purīṣaṃ yo 'tisāryate||
6.15.203 |  dīpanīyauṣadhairyuktāṃ ghṛtamātrāṃ pibettu saḥ|
tayā samānaḥ pavanaḥ *prasanno mārgamāsthitaḥ||
6.15.204 |  agneḥ samīpacāritvādāśu prakurute balam|
kāṭhinyādyaḥ purīṣaṃ tu kṛcchrānmuñcati mānavaḥ||
6.15.205 |  saghṛtaṃ lavaṇairyuktaṃ naro 'nnāvagrahaṃ pibet|
raukṣyānmande pibetsarpistailaṃ vā dīpanairyutam||
6.15.206 |  atisnehāttu mande 'gnau cūrṇāriṣṭāsavā hitāḥ|
bhinne gudopalepāttu male tailasurāsavāḥ||
6.15.207 |  udāvartāttu mande 'gnau nirūhāḥ snehabastayaḥ|
doṣavṛddhyā tu mande 'gnau śuddho doṣavidhiṃ caret||
6.15.208 |  vyādhiyuktasya mande tu sarpirevāgnidīpanam|
upavāsācca mande 'gnau yavāgūbhiḥ pibedghṛtam||
6.15.209 |  annāvapīḍitaṃ balyaṃ dīpanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca tat|
dīrghakālaprasaṅgāttu kṣāmakṣīṇakṛśānnarān||
6.15.210 |  prasahānāṃ rasaiḥ sāmlairbhojayet piśitāśinām|
laghu, tīkṣṇoṣṇaśodhitvāddīpayantyāśu te 'nalam||
6.15.211 |  māṃsopacitamāṃsatvāttathā++āśutarabṛṃhaṇāḥ|
nābhojanena kāyāgnirdīpyate nātibhojanāt||
6.15.212 |  yathā nirindhano vahniralpo vā 'tīndhanāvṛtaḥ|
*snehānnavidhibhiścitraiścūrṇāriṣṭasurāsavaiḥ||
6.15.213 |  samyakprayuktairbhiṣajā balamagneḥ pravardhate|
yathā hi sāradārvagniḥ sthiraḥ saṃtiṣṭhate ciram||
6.15.214 |  snehānnavidhibhistadvadantaragnirbhavet sthiraḥ|
hitaṃ jīrṇe mitaṃ cāśnaṃściramārogyamaśnute||
6.15.215 |  avaiṣamyeṇa dhātūnāmagnivṛddhau yateta nā|
samairdoṣaiḥ samo madhye dehasyoṣmā 'gnisaṃsthitaḥ||
6.15.216 |  pacatyannaṃ tadārogyapuṣṭyāyurbalavṛddhaye|
doṣairmando 'tivṛddho vā viṣamairjanayedgadān||
6.15.217 |  vācyaṃ mandasya tatroktamativṛddhasya vakṣyate|
nare kṣīṇakaphe pittaṃ kupitaṃ mārutānugam||
6.15.218 |  svoṣmaṇā pāvakasthāne balamagneḥ prayacchati|
tadā labdhabalo dehe virūkṣe sānilo 'nalaḥ||
6.15.219 |  paribhūya pacatyannaṃ taikṣṇyādāśu muhurmuhuḥ|
paktvā 'nnaṃ sa tato dhātūñchoṇitādīn pacatyapi||
6.15.220 |  tato daurbalyamātaṅkānmṛtyuṃ copanayennaram|
bhukte 'nne labhate śāntiṃ jīrṇamātre pratāmyati||
6.15.221 |  tṛṭśvāsadāhamūrcchādyā vyādhayo 'tyagnisaṃbhavāḥ|
tamatyagniṃ gurusnigdhaśītairmadhuravijjalaiḥ||
6.15.222 |  annapānairnayecchāntiṃ dīptamagnimivāmbubhiḥ|
muhurmuhurajīrṇe 'pi bhojyānyasyopahārayet||
6.15.223 |  nirindhano 'ntaraṃ labdhvā yathainaṃ na vipādayet|
pāyasaṃ kṛśarāṃ snigdhaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ guḍavaikṛtam||
6.15.224 |  adyāttathaudakānūpapiśitāni bhṛtāni ca|
matsyānviśeṣataḥ ślakṣṇānathiratoyacarāṃstathā||
6.15.225 |  āvikaṃ ca bhṛtaṃ *māṃsamadyādatyagnināśanam|
yavāgūṃ samadhūcchiṣṭāṃ ghṛtaṃ vā kṣudhitaḥ pibet||
6.15.226 |  godhūmacūrṇamanthaṃ vā vyadhayitvā sirāṃ pibet|
payo vā śarkarāsarpirjīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ śṛtam||
6.15.227 |  phalānāṃ *tailayonīnāmutkriñcāśca saśarkarāḥ|
mārdavaṃ janayantyagneḥ snigdhā māṃsarasāstathā||
6.15.228 |  pibecchītāmbunā sarpirmadhūcchiṣṭena saṃyutam|
godhūmacūrṇaṃ payasā sasarpiṣkaṃ pibennaraḥ||
6.15.229 |  ānūparasasiddhān vā trīn snehāṃstailavarjitān|
payasā *saṃmitaṃ cāpi ghanaṃ trisnehasaṃyutam||
6.15.230 |  narīstanyena saṃyuktāṃ pibedaudumbarīṃ tvacam|
tābhyāṃ vā pāyasaṃ siddhamadyādatyagniśāntaye||
6.15.231 |  śyāmātrivṛdvipakvaṃ vā payo dadyādvirecanam|
asakṛt pittaśāntyarthaṃ pāyasapratibhojanam||
6.15.232 |  prasamīkṣya bhiṣak prāñjastasmai dadyādvidhānavit|
yatkiñcinmadhuraṃ medyaṃ śleṣmalaṃ gurubhojanam||
6.15.233 |  sarvaṃ tadatyagnihitaṃ bhuktvā prasvapanaṃ divā|
medyānyannāni yo+*atyagnāvapratāntaḥ samaśnute||
6.15.234 |  na tannimittaṃ vyasanaṃ labhate puṣṭimeva ca|
kaphe vṛddhe jite pitte mārute cānalaḥ samaḥ||
6.15.235 |  samadhātoḥ pacatyannaṃ puṣṭyāyurbalavṛddhaye|
bhavanti cātra---
pathyāpathyamihaikatra bhuktaṃ samaśanaṃ matam||
6.15.236 |  viṣamaṃ bahu vā 'lpaṃ vā 'pyaprāptātītakālayoḥ|
bhuktaṃ pūrvānnaśeṣe tu punaradhyaśanaṃ matam||
6.15.237 |  trīṇyapyetāni mṛtyuṃ vā ghorān vyādhīnsṛjanti vā|
prātarāśe tvajīrṇe 'pi sāyamāśo na duṣyati||
6.15.238 |  divā prabudhyate 'rkeṇa hṛdayaṃ puṇḍarīkavat|
tasminvibuddhe srotāṃsi sphuṭatvaṃ yānti sarvaśaḥ||
6.15.239 |  vyāyāmācca vihārācca vikṣiptatvācca cetasaḥ|
na kledamupagacchanti divā tenāsya dhātavaḥ||
6.15.240 |  aklinneṣvannamāsiktamanyatteṣu na duṣyti|
avidagdha iva kṣīre kṣīramanyadvimiśritam||
6.15.241 |  naiva dūṣyati tenaiva samaṃ saṃpadyate yathā|
rātrau tu hṛdaye mlāne saṃvṛteṣvayaneṣu ca|
yānti koṣṭhe parikledaṃ saṃvṛte dehadhātavaḥ||
6.15.242 |  klenneṣvanyadapakveṣu teṣvāsiktaṃ praduṣyati|
vidagdheṣu payaḥsvanyat payastaptamivārpitam||
6.15.243 |  naiśeṣvāhārajāteṣu nāvipakveṣu buddhimān|
tasmādanyatsamaśnīyātpālayiṣyanbalāyuṣī||
6.15.244 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
antaragniguṇā dehaṃ yathā dhārayate ca saḥ|
yathā 'nnaṃ pacyate yāṃśca yathā++āharaḥ karotyapi||
6.15.245 |  ye 'gnayo yāṃśca puṣyanti yāvanto ye pacanti yān|
rasādīnāṃ kramotpattirmalānāṃ tebhya eva ca||
6.15.246 |  vṛṣyāṇāmāśukṛddheturdhātukālodbhavakramaḥ|
rogaukadeśakṛddheturantaragniryathā 'dhikaḥ||
6.15.247 |  praduṣyati yathā duṣṭo yān rogāñjanayatyapi|
grahaṇī yā *yathā yacca grahaṇīdoṣalakṣaṇam||
6.15.248 |  pūrvarūpaṃ pṛthak caiva vyañjanaṃ sacikitsitam|
caturvidhasya nirdiṣṭaṃ tathā cāvasthikī kriyā||
6.15.249 |  jāyate ca yathā 'tyagniryacca tasya cikitsitam|
uktavāniha tat sarvaṃ grahaṇīdoṣake muniḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne grahaṇīcikitsitaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||15 | |

ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.16.1 |  athā pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.16.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.16.3 |  pāṇḍurogāḥ smṛtāḥ pañca vātapittakaphaistrayaḥ|
caturthaḥ sannipātena pañcamo bhakṣaṇānmṛdaḥ||
6.16.4 |  doṣāḥ pittapradhānāstu yasya kupyanti dhātuṣu|
śaisthilyaṃ tasya dhātūnāṃ gauravaṃ copajāyate||
6.16.5 |  tato varṇabalasnehā ye cānye 'pyojaso guṇāḥ|
vrajanti kṣayamatyarthaṃ doṣadūṣyapradūṣaṇāt||
6.16.6 |  so 'lparakto 'lpamedasko niḥsāraḥ śithilendriyaḥ|
vaivarṇyaṃ bhajate, tasya hetuṃ śṛṇu salakṣaṇam||
6.16.7 |  kṣārāmlalavaṇātyuṣṇaviruddhāsātmyabhojanāt|
niṣpāvamāṣapiṇyākatilatailaniṣevaṇāt||
6.16.8 |  vidagdhe 'nne divāsvapnādvyāyāmānmaithunāttathā|
pratikarmaturvaiṣamyādvegānāṃ ca vidhāraṇāt||
6.16.9 |  kāmacintābhayakrodhaśokopahatacetasaḥ|
samudīrṇaṃ yadā pittaṃ hṛdaye samavasthitam||
6.16.10 |  vāyunā balinā kṣiptaṃ saṃprāpya dhamanīrdaśa|
prapannaṃ kevalaṃ dehaṃ tvaṅnāṃsāntaramāśritam||
6.16.11 |  pradūṣya kaphavātāsṛktvaṅnāṃsāni karoti tat|
pāṇḍuhāridraharitān varṇān bahuvidhāṃstvaci||
6.16.12 |  sa pāṇḍuroga ityuktaḥ tasya liṅgaṃ bhaviṣyataḥ|
hṛdayaspandanaṃ raukṣyaṃ svedābhāvaḥ śramastathā||
6.16.13 |  saṃbhūte 'smin bhavet sarvaḥ karṇakṣveḍī hatānalaḥ|
durbalaḥ sadano 'nnadviṭ śramabhramanipīḍitaḥ||
6.16.14 |  gātraśūlajvaraśvāsagauravārucimānnaraḥ|
mṛditairiva gātraiśca pīḍitonmathitairiva||
6.16.15 |  śūnākṣikūṭo haritaḥ śīrṇalomā hataprabhaḥ|
kopanaḥ śiśiradveṣī nidrāluḥ ṣṭhīvano 'lpavāk||
6.16.16 |  piṇḍikodveṣṭakaṭyūrupādaruksadanāni ca|
*bhavantyārohaṇāyāsairviśeṣaścāsya vakṣyate||
6.16.17 |  āhārairupacāraiśca vātalaiḥ kupito 'nilaḥ|
janayet-*kṛṣṇapāṇḍutvaṃ tathā rūkṣāruṇāṅgatām||
6.16.18 |  aṅgamardaṃ rujaṃ todaṃ kampaṃ pārśvaśirorujam|
varcaḥśoṣāsyavairasyaśophānāhabalakṣayān||
6.16.19 |  pittalasyācitaṃ pittaṃ yathoktaiḥ svaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ|
dūṣayitvā tu raktādīn pāṇḍurogāya kalpate||
6.16.20 |  sa pīto haritābho vā jvaradāhasamanvitaḥ|
*tṛṣṇāmūrcchāpipāsārtaḥ pītamūtraśakṛnnaraḥ||
6.16.21 |  svedanaḥ śītakāmaśca na cānnamabhinandati|
kaṭukāsyo na cāsyoṣṇamupaśete 'mlameva ca||
6.16.22 |  udgāro 'mlo vidāhaśca vidagdhe 'nne 'sya jāyate|
daurgandhyaṃ bhinnavarcastvaṃ daurbalyaṃ tama eva ca||
6.16.23 |  vivṛddhaḥ śleṣmalaiḥ śleṣmā pāṇḍurogaṃ sa pūrvavat|
karoti gauravaṃ tandrāṃ chardiṃ śvetāvabhāsatām||
6.16.24 |  prasekaṃ lomaharṣaṃ ca sādaṃ mūrcchāṃ bhramaṃ klamam|
śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ tathā++ālasyamaruciṃ vāksvaragraham||
6.16.25 |  śuklamūtrākṣivarcastvaṃ kaṭurūkṣoṣṇakāmatām|
śvayathuṃ *madhurāsyatvamiti pāṇḍvāmayaḥ kaphāt||
6.16.26 |  sarvānnasevinaḥ sarve duṣṭā doṣāstridoṣajam|
tridoṣaliṅgaṃ kurvanti pāṇḍurogaṃ suduḥsaham||
6.16.27 |  mṛttikādanaśīlasya kupyatyanyatamo malaḥ|
kaṣāyā mārutaṃ, pittamūṣarā, madhurā kapham||
6.16.28 |  kopayenmṛdrasādīṃśca raukṣyādbhuktaṃ *virūkṣayet|
pūrayatyavipakvaiva srotāṃsi niruṇaddhi ca||
6.16.29 |  indriyāṇāṃ balaṃ hatvā tejo vīryaujasī tathā|
pāṇḍurogaṃ karotyāśu balavarṇāgnināśanam||
6.16.30 |  *śūnagaṇḍākṣikūṭabhrūḥ śūnapānnābhimehanaḥ|
krimikoṣṭho 'tisāryeta malaṃ sāsṛk kaphānvitam||
6.16.31 |  pāṇḍurogaścirotpannaḥ kharībhūto na sidhyati|
*kālaprakarṣācchūno nā yaśca pītāni paśyati||
6.16.32 |  baddhālpaviṭkaṃ sakaphaṃ haritaṃ yo 'tisāryate|
dīnaḥ śvetātidigdhāṅgaśchardimūrcchātṛṣārditaḥ||
6.16.33 |  sa nāstyasṛkkṣayādyaśca pāṇḍuḥ śvetatvamāpnuyāt|
iti pañcavidhasyoktaṃ pāṇḍurogasya lakṣaṇam||
6.16.34 |  pāṇḍurogī tu yo 'tyarthaṃ pittalāni niṣevate|
tasya pittamasṛgmāṃsaṃ dagdhvā rogāya kalpate||
6.16.35 |  hāridranetraḥ sa bhṛśaṃ hāridratvaṅnakhānanaḥ|
raktapītaśakṛnmūtro bhekavarṇo hatendriyaḥ||
6.16.36 |  dāhāvipākadaurbalyasadanārucikarṣitaḥ|
kāmalā bahupittaiṣā koṣṭhaśākhāśrayā matā||
6.16.37 |  kālāntarāt kharībhūtā kṛcchrā syāt kumbhakāmalā|
*kṛṣṇapītaśakṛnmūtro bhṛśaṃ śūnaśca mānavaḥ||
6.16.38 |  saraktākṣimukhacchardiviṇmūtro yaśca tāmyati|
dāhārucitṛṣānāhatandrāmohasamanvitaḥ||
6.16.39 |  naṣṭāgnisaṃjñaḥ kṣipraṃ hi kāmalāvān vipadyate|
sādhyānāmitareṣāṃ tu pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam||
6.16.40 |  tatra pāṇḍvāmayī snigdhastīkṣṇairūrdhvānulomikaiḥ|
saṃśodhyo mṛdubhistiktaiḥ kāmalī tu virecanaiḥ||
6.16.41 |  tābhyāṃ saṃśuddhakoṣṭhābhyāṃ pathyānyannāni dāpayet|
śālīn sayavagodhūmān purāṇān yūṣasaṃhitān||
6.16.42 |  mudgāḍhakīmasūraiśca jāṅgalaiśca rasairhitaiḥ|
yathādoṣaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca tayorbhaiṣajyamācaret||
6.16.43 |  pañcagavyaṃ mahātiktaṃ kalyāṇakamathāpi vā|
snehanārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyāt kāmalāpāṇḍurogiṇe||
6.16.44 |  dāḍimāt kuḍavo dhānyāt kuḍavārdhaṃ palaṃ palam|
citrakācchṛṅgaverācca pippalyaṣṭamikā tathā||
6.16.45 |  taiḥ kalkairviṃśatipalaṃ ghṛtasya salilāḍhake|
siddhaṃ hṛtpāṇḍugulmārśaḥplīhavātakaphārtinut||
6.16.46 |  dīpanaṃ śvāsakāsaghnaṃ mūḍhavāte ca śasyate|
duḥkhaprasavinīnāṃ ca vandhyānāṃ caiva garbhadam||
iti dāḍimādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.16.47 |  kaṭukā rohiṇī mustaṃ haridre vatsakāt palam|
paṭolaṃ candanaṃ mūrvā trāyamāṇā durālabhā||
6.16.48 |  kṛṣṇā parpaṭako nimbo bhūnimbo devadāru ca|
taiḥ kārṣikairghṛtaprasthaḥ siddhaḥ *kṣīracaturguṇaḥ||
6.16.49 |  raktapittaṃ jvaraṃ dāhaṃ śvayathuṃ sabhagandaram|
arśāṃsyasṛgdaraṃ caiva hanti visphoṭakāṃstathā||
iti kaṭukādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.16.50 |  pathyāśatarase pathyāvṛntārdhaśatakalkavān|
prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtāt peyaḥ sa pāṇḍvāmayagulmanut||
iti pathyāghṛtam|
6.16.51 |  dantyāścatuṣpalarase piṣṭairdantīśalāṭubhiḥ|
tadvatprastho ghṛtātsiddhaḥ plīhapāṇḍvartiśophajit||
iti dantīghṛtam|
6.16.52 |  purāṇasarpiṣaḥ prastho drākṣārdhaprasthasādhitaḥ|
kāmalāgulmapāṇḍvartijvaramehodarāpahaḥ||
iti drākṣāghṛtam|
6.16.53 |  haridrātriphalānimbabalāmadhukasādhitam|
sakṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ sarpiḥ kāmalāharamuttamam||
iti haridrādighṛtam|
6.16.54 |  gomūtre dviguṇe dārvyāḥ kalkākṣadvayasādhitaḥ|
dārvyāḥ pañcapalakvāthe kalke kālīyake paraḥ||
6.16.55 |  māhiṣāt sarpiṣaḥ prasthaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrve pare paraḥ|
snehairebhirupakramya snigdhaṃ matvā virecayet||
6.16.56 |  payasā mūtrayuktena bahuśaḥ kevalena vā|
dantīphalarase koṣṇe kāśmaryāñjalinā śṛtam||
6.16.57 |  krākṣāñjaliṃ mṛditvā vā dadyāt pāṇḍvāmayāpaham|
dviśarkaraṃ trivṛccūrṇaṃ palārdhaṃ paittikaḥ pibet||
6.16.58 |  kaphapāṇḍustu *gomūtraklinnayuktāṃ harītakīm|
*āragvadhaṃ rasenekṣorvidāryāmalakasya ca||
6.16.59 |  satryūṣaṇaṃ bilvapatraṃ pibennā kāmalāpaham|
dantyardhapalakalkaṃ vā dviguḍaṃ śītavāriṇā||
6.16.60 |  kāmalī trivṛtāṃ vā 'pi triphalāyā rasaiḥ pibet|
viśālātriphalāmustakuṣṭhadārukaliṅgakān||
6.16.61 |  kārṣikānardhakarṣāṃśāṃ kuryādativiṣāṃ tathā|
karṣau madhurasāyā dvau *sarvametat sukhāmbunā||
6.16.62 |  mṛditaṃ taṃ rasaṃ pūtaṃ pītvā lihyācca madhvanu|
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ dāhaṃ pāṇḍurogamarocakam||
6.16.63 |  gulmānāhāmavātāṃśca raktapittaṃ ca nāśayet|
triphalāyā guḍūcyā vā dārvyā nimbasya vā rasam||
6.16.64 |  śītaṃ madhuyutaṃ prātaḥ kāmalārtaḥ pibennaraḥ|
kṣīramūtraṃ pibet pakṣaṃ gavyaṃ māhiṣameva vā||
6.16.65 |  pāṇḍurgomūtrayuktaṃ vā saptāhaṃ triphalārasam|
tarujān jvalitānmūtre nirvāpyāmṛdya cāṅkurān||
6.16.66 |  mātuluṅgasya tat pūtaṃ pāṇḍuśothaharaṃ pibet|
svarṇakṣīrī trivṛcchyāme bhadradāru sanāgaram||
6.16.67 |  gomūtrāñjalinā piṣṭaṃ mūtre vā kvathitaṃ pibet|
kṣīramebhiḥ śṛtaṃ vā 'pi pibeddoṣānulomanam||
6.16.68 |  harītakīṃ prayogeṇa gomūtreṇāthavā pibet|
jīrṇe kṣīreṇa bhuñjīta rasena madhureṇa vā||
6.16.69 |  saptarātraṃ gavāṃ mūtre bhāvitaṃ vā 'pyayorajaḥ|
pāṇḍurogapraśāntyarhtaṃ payasā pāyayedbhiṣak||
6.16.70 |  tryūṣaṇatriphalāmustaviḍaṅgacitrakāḥ samāḥ|
navāyorajaso bhāgāstaccūrṇaṃ kṣaudrasarpiṣā||
6.16.71 |  bhakṣayet pāṇḍuhṛdrogakuṣṭhārśaḥkāmalāpaham|
navāyasamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇātreyeṇa bhāṣitam||
iti navāyasacūrṇam|
6.16.72 |  guḍanāgaramaṇḍūratilāṃśānmānataḥ samān|
pippalīdviguṇāṃ kuryādguṭikāṃ pāṇḍurogiṇe||
6.16.73 |  tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalā mmustaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ cavyacitrakau|
dārvītvaṅnākṣiko dhāturgranthikaṃ devadāru ca||
6.16.74 |  etān dvipalikānbhāgāṃścūrṇaṃ kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak|
maṇḍūraṃ dviguṇaṃ cūrṇācchuddhamañjanasannibham||
6.16.75 |  gomūtre 'ṣṭaguṇe paktvā tasmiṃstat prakṣipettataḥ|
udumbarasamānkṛtvā vaṭakāṃstān yathāgni nā||
6.16.76 |  upayuñjīta takreṇa sātmyaṃ jīrṇe ca bhojanam|
maṇḍūravaṭakā hyete prāṇadāḥ pāṇḍurogiṇām||
6.16.77 |  kuṣṭhānyajīrṇakaṃ śothamūrustambhaṃ kaphāmayān|
arśāṃsi kāmalāṃ mehaṃ plīhānaṃ śamayanti ca||
iti maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ|
6.16.78 |  tāpyādrijaturūpyāyomalāḥ pañcapalāḥ pṛthak|
citrakatriphalāvyoṣaviḍaṅgaiḥ palikaiḥ saha||
6.16.79 |  śarkarāṣṭapalonmiśrāścūrṇitā madhunā++āplutāḥ|
abhyasyāstvakṣamātrā hi jīrṇe hitamitāśinā||
6.16.80 |  kulatthakākamācyādikapotaparihāriṇā|
triphalāyāstrayo bhāgāstrayastrikaṭukasya ca||
6.16.81 |  bhāgaścitrakamūlasya viḍaṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca|
pañcāśmajatuno bhāgāstathā rūpyamalasya ca||
6.16.82 |  mākṣikasya ca śuddhasya lauhasya rajasastathā|
aṣṭau bhāgāḥ sitāyāśca tatsarvaṃ sūkṣmacūrṇitam||
6.16.83 |  mākṣikeṇāplutaṃ sthāpyamāyase bhājane śubhe|
udumbarasamāṃ mātrāṃ tataḥ khādedyathāgni nā||
6.16.84 |  dine dine prayuñjīta jīrṇe bhojyaṃ yathepsitam|
varjayitvā kulatthāni kākamācīṃ kapotakam||
6.16.85 |  yogarāja iti khyāto yogo 'yamamṛtopamaḥ|
rasāyanamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ srvarogaharaṃ śivam||
6.16.86 |  pāṇḍurogaṃ viṣaṃ kāsaṃ yakṣmāṇaṃ viṣamajvaram|
kuṣṭhānyajīrṇakaṃ mehaṃ śoṣaṃ śvāsamarocakam||
6.16.87 |  viśeṣāddhantyapasmāraṃ kāmalāṃ gudajāni ca|
iti yogarājaḥ|
kauṭajatriphalānimbapaṭolaghananāgaraiḥ||
6.16.88 |  bhāvitāni daśāhāni rasairdvitriguṇāni vā|
śilājatupalānyaṣṭau tāvatī sitaśarkarā||
6.16.89 |  tvakkṣīrī pippalī dhātrī karkaṭākhyā palonmitā|
nidigdhyāḥ phalamūlābhyāṃ palaṃ yuktyā trigandhakam||
6.16.90 |  cūrṇitaṃ madhunaḥ kuryāttripalenākṣikān guḍān|
dāḍimāmbupayaḥpakṣirasatoyasurāsavān||
6.16.91 |  tān bhakṣayitvā 'nupibenniranno bhukta eva vā|
pāṇḍukuṣṭhajvaraplīhatamakārśobhagandarān||
6.16.92 |  *pūtihṛcchukramūtrāgnidoṣaśoṣagarodarān|
kāsāsṛgdarapittāsṛkśothagulmagalāmayān||
6.16.93 |  te ca sarvavraṇān hanyuḥ sarvarogaharāḥ śivāḥ|
iti śilājatuvaṭakāḥ|
punarnavā trivṛdvyoṣaviḍaṅgaṃ dāru citrakam||
6.16.94 |  kuṣṭhaṃ haridre triphalā dantī cavyaṃ kaliṅgakāḥ|
*pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ mustaṃ ceti palonmitam||
6.16.95 |  maṇḍūraṃ dviguṇaṃ cūrṇādgomūtre dvyāḍhake pacet|
kolavaḍguṭikāḥ kṛtvā takreṇāloḍya nā pibet||
6.16.96 |  tāḥ pāṇḍurogān plīhānamarśāṃsi viṣamajvaram|
śvayathuṃ grahaṇīdoṣaṃ hanyuḥ kuṣṭhaṃ krimīṃstathā||
iti punarnavamaṇḍūram|
6.16.97 |  dārvītvak triphalā vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgamayaso rajaḥ|
madhusarpiryutaṃ ligyāt kāmalāpāṇḍurogavān||
6.16.98 |  tulyā ayorajaḥpathyāharidrāḥ kṣaudrasarpiṣā|
cūrṇitāḥ kāmalī ligyādguḍakṣaudreṇa vā 'bhayāḥ||
6.16.99 |  triphalā dve haridre ca kaṭurohiṇyayorajaḥ|
cūrṇitaṃ kṣaudrasarpirbhyāṃ sa lehaḥ kāmalāpahaḥ||
6.16.100 |  dvipalāṃśāṃ tugākṣīrīṃ nāgaraṃ madhuyaṣṭikām|
prāsthikīṃ pippalīṃ krākṣāṃ śarkarārdhatulāṃ śubhām||
6.16.101 |  dhātrīphalarasadroṇe cūrṇitaṃ lehavat pacet|
śītaṃ madhuprasthayutaṃ lihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ||
6.16.102 |  hanyeṣa kāmalāṃ pittaṃ pāṇḍuṃ kāsaṃ halīmakam|
iti dhātryavalehaḥ|
tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalā cavyaṃ citrako devadāru ca||
6.16.103 |  viḍaṅgānyatha mustaṃ ca vatsakaṃ ceti cūrṇayet|
maṇḍūratulyaṃ taccūrṇaṃ gomūtre 'ṣṭaguṇe pacet||
6.16.104 |  śanaiḥ siddhāstathā śītāḥ kāryāḥ karṣasamā guḍāḥ|
yathāgni bhakṣaṇīyāste plīhapāṇḍvāmayāpahāḥ||
6.16.105 |  grahaṇyarśonudaścaiva takravāṭyāśinaḥ smṛtāḥ|
iti maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ|
mañjiṣṭhā rajanī drākṣā balāmūlānyayorajaḥ||
6.16.106 |  lodhraṃ caiteṣu gauḍaḥ syādariṣṭaḥ pāṇḍurogiṇām|
iti gauḍo 'riṣṭaḥ|
bījakātṣoḍaśapalaṃ triphalāyāśca viṃśatiḥ||
6.16.107 |  drākṣāyāḥ pañca lākṣāyāḥ sapta droṇe jalasya tat|
sādhyaṃ pādāvaśeṣe tu pūtaśeṣe samāvapet||
6.16.108 |  śarkarāyāstulāṃ prasthaṃ mākṣikasya ca kārṣikam|
vyoṣaṃ vyāghranakhośīraṃ kramukaṃ sailavālukam||
6.16.109 |  madhukaṃ kuṣṭhamityetaccūrṇitaṃ ghṛtabhājane|
yaveṣu daśārātraṃ tadgrīṣme dviḥ śiśire sthitam||
6.16.110 |  pibettadgrahaṇīpāṇḍurogārśaḥśothagulmanut|
mūtrakṛcchrāśmarīmehakāmalāsannipātajit||
6.16.111 |  bījakāriṣṭa ityeṣa ātreyeṇa prakīrtitaḥ|
iti bījakāriṣṭaḥ|
dhātrīphalasahasre dve pīḍayitvā rasaṃ tu tam||
6.16.112 |  kṣaudrāṣṭāṃśena saṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇārdhakuḍavena ca|
śarkarārdhatulonmiśraṃ pakṣaṃ snigdhaghaṭe sthitam||
6.16.113 |  prapibenmātrayā prātarjīrṇe hitamitāśanaḥ|
kāmalāpāṇḍuhṛdrogavātāsṛgviṣamajvarān||
6.16.114 |  kāsahikkāruciśvāsāṃścaiṣo 'riṣṭaḥ praṇāśayet|
iti dhātryariṣṭaḥ|
sthirādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ toyaṃ pānāhāre praśasyate||
6.16.115 |  pāṇḍūnāṃ, kāmalārtānāṃ mṛdvīkāmalakīrasaḥ|
pāṇḍurogapraśāntyarhtamiti proktaṃ maharṣiṇā||
6.16.116 |  vikalpyametadbhiṣajā pṛthagdoṣabalaṃ prati|
vātike shehabhūyiṣṭaṃ, paittike tiktaśītalam||
6.16.117 |  ślaiṣmike *kaṭutiktoṣṇaṃ, vimiśraṃ sānnipātike|
nipātayeccharīrāttu mṛttikāṃ bhakṣitāṃ bhiṣak||
6.16.118 |  yuktijñaḥ śodhanaistīkṣṇaiḥ prasamīkṣya balābalam|
śuddhakāyasya sarpīṃṣi balādhānāni yojayet||
6.16.119 |  vyoṣaṃ bilvaṃ haridre dve triphalā dve punarnave|
mustānyayorajaḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca||
6.16.120 |  vṛścikālī ca bhārgī ca *sakṣīraistaiḥ samairghṛtam|
sādhayitvā pibedyuktyā naro mṛddoṣapīḍitaḥ||
6.16.121 |  tadvat keśarayaṣṭyāhvapippalīkṣāraśādvalaiḥ|
mṛdbhakṣaṇādāturasya laulyādavinivartinaḥ||
6.16.122 |  dveṣyārthaṃ bhāvitāṃ kāmaṃ dadyāttaddoṣanāśanaiḥ|
viḍaṅgailātiviṣayā nimbapatreṇa pāṭhayā||
6.16.123 |  vārtākaiḥ kaṭurohiṇyā kauṭajairmūrvayā 'pi vā|
yathādoṣaṃ prakurvīta bhaiṣajyaṃ pāṇḍurogiṇām||
6.16.124 |  kriyāviśeṣa eṣo 'sya mato hetuviśeṣataḥ|
tilapiṣṭanibhaṃ yastu varcaḥ sṛjati kāmalī||
6.16.125 |  śleṣmaṇā ruddhamārgaṃ tat pittaṃ kaphaharairjayet|
rūkṣaśītagurusvāduvyāyāmairveganigrahaiḥ||
6.16.126 |  kaphasaṃmūrcchito vāyuḥ sthānāt pittaṃ kṣipedbalī|
hāridranetramūtratvak śvetavarcāstadā naraḥ||
6.16.127 |  bhavet sāṭopaviṣṭambho guruṇā hṛdayena ca|
daurbalyālpāgnipārśvārtihikkāśvāsārucijvaraiḥ||
6.16.128 |  krameṇālpe+*anusajyeta pitte śākhāsamāśrite|
barhitittiridakṣāṇāṃ rūkṣāmlaiḥ kaṭukai rasaiḥ||
6.16.129 |  śuṣkamūlakakaulatthairyūṣaiścānnāni bhojayet|
mātuluṅgarasaṃ kṣaudrapippalīmaricānvitam||
6.16.130 |  sanāgaraṃ pibet pittaṃ tathā 'syaiti svamāśayam|
kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇairbhṛśāmlaiścāpyupakramaḥ||
6.16.131 |  *āpittarāgācchakṛto vāyoścāpraśamādbhavet|
svasthānamāgate pitte purīṣe pittarañjite||
6.16.132 |  nivṛttopadravasya syāt pūrvaḥ kāmaliko vidhiḥ|
yadā tu pāṇḍorvarṇaḥ syāddharitaśyāvapītakaḥ||
6.16.133 |  balotsāhakṣayastandrā mandrāgnitvaṃ mṛdujvaraḥ|
strīṣvaharṣo 'ṅgamardaśca śvāsastṛṣṇā 'rucirbhramaḥ||
6.16.134 |  halīmakaṃ tadā tasya vidyādanilapittataḥ|
guḍūcīsvarasakṣīrasādhitaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam||
6.16.135 |  sa pibettrivṛtāṃ snigdho rasenāmalakasya tu|
virikto madhuraprāyaṃ bhajet pitānilāpaham||
6.16.136 |  drākṣālehaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ sarpīṃṣi madhurāṇi ca|
yāpanān kṣīrabastīṃśca śīlayetsānuvāsanān||
6.16.137 |  mārdvīkāriṣṭayogāṃśca pibedyuktyā 'gnivṛddhaye|
kāsikaṃ cābhayālehaṃ pippalīṃ madhukaṃ balām||
6.16.138 |  payasā ca prayuñjīta yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam|
tatra ślokau---
pāṇḍoḥ pañcavidhasyoktaṃ hetulakṣaṇabheṣajam||
6.16.139 |  kāmalā dvividhā teṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyatvameva ca|
teṣāṃ vikalpo yaścānyo mahāvyādhirhalīmakaḥ|
tasya coktaṃ samāsena vyañjanaṃ sacikitsitam||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||16 | |

saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.17.1 |  athāto hikkāśvāsacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.17.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.17.3 |  devalokārthatattvavjñamātreyamṛṣimuttamam|
apṛcchat saṃśayaṃ dhīmānagniveśaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ||
6.17.4 |  ya ime dvividhāḥ proktāstridoṣāstriprakopaṇāḥ|
rogā nānātmakāsteṣāṃ kasko bhavati durjayaḥ||
6.17.5 |  agniveśasya tadvākyaṃ śrutvā matimatāṃ varaḥ|
uvāca paramaprītaḥ paramārthaviniścayam||
6.17.6 |  kāmaṃ prāṇaharā rogā bahavo na tu te tathā|
yathā śvāsaśca hikkā ca prāṇānāśu nikṛntataḥ||
6.17.7 |  anyairapyupasṛṣṭasya rogairjantoḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ|
ante saṃjāyate hikkā śvāso vā tīvravedanaḥ||
6.17.8 |  kaphavātātmakāvetau pittasthānasamudbhavau|
hṛdayasya rasādīnāṃ dhātūnāṃ copaśoṣaṇau||
6.17.9 |  tasmāt sādhāraṇāvetau matau paramadurjayau|
mithyopacaritau kruddhau hata āśīviṣāviva||
6.17.10 |  pṛthak pañcavidhāvetau nirdiṣṭau rogasaṃgrahe|
tayoḥ śṛṇu samutthānaṃ liṅgaṃ ca sabhiṣagjitam||
6.17.11 |  rajasā dhūmavātābhyāṃ śītasthānāmbusevanāt|
vyāyāmādgrāmyadharmādhvarūkṣānnaviṣamāśanāt||
6.17.12 |  āmapradoṣādānāhādraukṣyādatyapatarpaṇāt|
daurbalyānmarmaṇo ghātāddvandvācchuddhyatiyogataḥ||
6.17.13 |  atīsārajvaracchardipratiśyāyakṣatakṣayāt|
raktapittādudāvartādvisūcyalasakādapi||
6.17.14 |  pāṇḍurogādviṣāccaiva pravartete gadāvimau|
niṣpāvamāṣapiṇyākatilatailaniṣevaṇāt||
6.17.15 |  piṣṭaśālūkaviṣṭambhividāhigurubhojanāt|
jalajānūpapiśitadadhyāmakṣīrasevanāt||
6.17.16 |  abhiṣyandyupacārācca śleṣmalānāṃ ca sevanāt|
kaṇṭhorasaḥ pratīghātādvibandhaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ||
6.17.17 |  mārutaḥ prāṇavāhīni srotāṃsyāviśya kupyati|
uraḥsthaḥ kaphamuddhūya hikkāśvāsān karoti saḥ||
6.17.18 |  ghorān prāṇoparodhāya prāṇināṃ pañca pañca ca|
ubhayoḥ pūrvarūpāṇi śṛṇu vakṣyāmyataḥ param||
6.17.19 |  kaṇṭhorasorgurutvaṃ ca vadanasya kaṣāyatā|
hikkānāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi kukṣerāṭopa eva ca||
6.17.20 |  ānāhaḥ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca pīḍanaṃ hṛdayasya ca|
prāṇasya ca vilomatvaṃ śvāsānāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam||
6.17.21 |  prāṇodakānnavāhīni srotāṃsi sakapho 'nilaḥ|
hikkāḥ karoti saṃrudhya tāsāṃ liṅgaṃ pṛthak śṛṇu||
6.17.22 |  kṣīṇamāṃsabalaprāṇatejasaḥ sakapho 'nilaḥ|
gṛhītvā sahasā kaṇṭhamuccairghoṣavatīṃ bhṛśam||
6.17.23 |  karoti satataṃ hikkāmekadvitriguṇāṃ tathā|
prāṇaḥ srotāṃsi marmāṇi saṃrudhyoṣmāṇameva ca||
6.17.24 |  saṃjñāṃ muṣṇāti gātrāṇāṃ stambhaṃ saṃjanayatyapi|
mārgaṃ caivānnapānānāṃ ruṇaddhyupahatasmṛteḥ||
6.17.25 |  sāśruviplutanetrasya stabdhaśaṅkhacyutabhruvaḥ|
saktajalpapralāpasya nirvṛtiṃ nādhigacchataḥ||
6.17.26 |  mahāmūlā mahāvegā mahāśabdā mahābalā|
mahāhikketi sā nṛṛṇāṃ sadyaḥ prāṇaharā matā||
iti mahāhikkā|
6.17.27 |  hikkate yaḥ pravṛddhastu kṛśo dīnamanā naraḥ|
jarjareṇorasā kṛcchraṃ gambhīramanunādayan||
6.17.28 |  saṃjṛmbhan saṃkṣipaṃścaiva tathā 'ṅgāni prasārayan|
pārśve cobhe samāyamya kūjan stambharugarditaḥ||
6.17.29 |  nābheḥ pakvāśayādvā 'pi hikkā cāsyopajāyate|
kṣobhayantī bhṛśaṃ dehaṃ nāmayantīva tāmyataḥ||
6.17.30 |  ruṇaddhyucchvāsamārgaṃ tu pranaṣṭabalacetasaḥ|
gambhīrā nāma sā tasya hikkā prāṇāntikī matā||
iti gambhīrā hikkā|
6.17.31 |  vyapetā jāyate hikkā yā 'nnapāne caturvidhe|
āhārapariṇāmānte bhūyaśca labhate balam||
6.17.32 |  pralāpavamyatīsāratṛṣṇārtasya vicetasaḥ|
jṛmbhiṇo viplutākṣasya śuṣkāsyasya vināminaḥ||
6.17.33 |  paryādhmātasya hikkā yā jatrumūlādasantatā|
sā vyapeteti vijñeyā hikkā prāṇoparodhinī||
iti vyapetā hikkā|
6.17.34 |  kṣudravāto yadā koṣṭhādvyāyāmaparighaṭṭitaḥ|
kaṇṭhe prapadyate hikkāṃ tadākṣudrāṃ karoti saḥ||
6.17.35 |  atiduḥkhā na sā coraḥśiromarmaprabādhinī|
na cocchvāsānnapānānāṃ mārgamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati||
6.17.36 |  vṛddhimāyasyato yāti bhuktamātre ca mārdavam|
yataḥ pravartate pūrvaṃ tata eva nirvatate||
6.17.37 |  hṛdayaṃ kloma kaṇṭhaṃ ca tālukaṃ ca samāśritā|
mṛdvī sā kṣudrahikketi nṛṇāṃ sādhyā prakīrtitā||
iti kṣudrahikkā|
6.17.38 |  sahasā 'tyabhyavahṛtauḥ pānānnaiḥ pīḍito 'nilaḥ|
ūrdhvaṃ prapadyate koṣṭhānmadyairvā 'timadapradaiḥ||
6.17.39 |  tathā 'tiroṣabhāṣyādhvahāsyabhārātivatanaiḥ|
vāyuḥ koṣṭhagato dhāvan pānabhojyaprapīḍitaḥ||
6.17.40 |  uraḥsrotaḥ samāviśya kuryāddhikkāṃ tato 'nnajām|
tathā śanairasaṃbandhaṃ kṣuvaṃścāpi sa hikkate||
6.17.41 |  na marmabādhājananī nendriyāṇāṃ prabādhinī|
hikkā pīte tathā bhukte śamaṃ yāti ca sā 'nnajā||
ityannajā hikkā|
6.17.42 |  atisaṃcitadoṣasya bhaktacchedakṛśasya ca|
vyādhibhiḥ kṣīṇadehasya vṛddhasyātivyavāyinaḥ||
6.17.43 |  āsāṃ yā sā samutpannā hikkā hantyāśu jīvitam|
yamikā ca pralāpārtitṛṣṇāmohasamanvitā||
6.17.44 |  akṣīṇaścāpyadīnaśca sthiradhātvindriyaśca yaḥ|
tasya sādhayituṃ śakyā yamikā hantyato 'nyathā||
6.17.45 |  yadā srotāṃsi saṃrudhya mārutaḥ kaphapūrvakaḥ|
viṣvagvrajati saṃruddhastadā śvāsānkaroti saḥ||
6.17.46 |  uddhūyamānavāto yaḥ śabdavadduḥkhito naraḥ|
uccaiḥ śvasiti saṃruddho mattarṣabha ivāniśam||
6.17.47 |  pranaṣṭajñānavijñānastathā vibhrāntalocanaḥ|
vikṛtākṣyānano baddhamūtravarcā viśīrṇavāk||
6.17.48 |  dīnaḥ praśvasitaṃ cāsya dūrādvijñāyate bhṛśam|
mahāśvāsopasṛṣṭaḥ sa kṣiprameva vipadyate||
iti mahāśvāsaḥ|
6.17.49 |  dīrghaṃ śvasiti yastūrdhvaṃ na ca pratyāharatyadhaḥ|
śleṣmāvṛtamukhasrotāḥ kruddhagandhavahārditaḥ||
6.17.50 |  ūrdhvadṛṣṭirvipaśyaṃśca vibhrāntākṣa itastataḥ|
pramudhyan vedanārtaśca śuṣkāsyo 'ratipīḍitaḥ||
6.17.51 |  ūrdhvaśvāse *prakupite hyadhaḥśvāso nirudhyate|
mudhyatastāmyataścordhvaṃ śvāsastasyaiva hantyasūn||
ityūrdhvaśvāsaḥ|
6.17.52 |  yastu śvasiti vicchinnaṃ sarvaprāṇena pīḍitaḥ|
na vā śvasiti duḥkhārto marmacchedarugarditaḥ||
6.17.53 |  ānāhasvedamūrcchārto dadyamānena bastinā|
viplutākṣaḥ parikṣīṇaḥ śvasan raktaikalocanaḥ||
6.17.54 |  vicetāḥ pariśuṣkāsyo vivarṇaḥ pralapannaraḥ|
chinnaśvāsena vicchinnaḥ sa śīghraṃ prajahātyasūn||
iti chinnaśvāsaḥ|
6.17.55 |  pratilomaṃ yadā vāyuḥ srotāṃsi pratipadyate|
grīvāṃ śiraśca saṃgṛhya śleṣmāṇaṃ samudīrya ca||
6.17.56 |  karoti pīnasaṃ tena ruddho ghurghurukaṃ tathā|
atīva tīvravegaṃ ca śvāsaṃ prāṇaprapīḍakam||
6.17.57 |  pratābhyatyativegācca kāsate sannirudhyate|
pramohaṃ kāsamānaśca sa gacchati muhurmuhuḥ||
6.17.58 |  śleṣmaṇyamucyamāne tu bhṛśaṃ bhavati duḥkhitaḥ|
tasyaiva ca vimokṣānte muhūrtaṃ labhate sukham||
6.17.59 |  athāsyoddhvaṃsate kaṇṭhaḥ kṛcchrācchaknoti bhāṣitum|
na cāpi nidrāṃ labhate śayānaḥ śvāsapīḍitaḥ||
6.17.60 |  pārśve tasyāvagṛhṇāti śayānasya samīraṇaḥ|
āsīno labhate saudhyamuṣṇaṃ caivābhinandati||
6.17.61 |  ucchritākṣo lalāṭena svidyatā bhṛśamartimān|
viśuṣkāsyo muhuḥ śvāso muhuścaivāvadhamyate||
6.17.62 |  meghāmbuśītaprāgvātaiḥ śleṣmalaiścābhivardhate|
sa yāpyastamakaśvāsaḥ sādhyo vā syānnavotthitaḥ||
iti tamakaśvāsaḥ|
6.17.63 |  jvaramūrcchāparītasya vidyāt pratamakaṃ tu tam|
udāvartarajo 'jīrṇaklinnakāyanirodhajaḥ||
6.17.64 |  tamasā vardhate 'tyarthaṃ śītaiścāśu praśāmyati|
majjatastamasīvā 'sya vidyāt saṃtamakaṃ tu tam||
iti pratamakasaṃtamakaśvāsau|
6.17.65 |  rūkṣāyāsodbhavaḥ koṣṭhe kṣudro vāta udīrayan|
kṣudraśvāso na so 'tyarthaṃ duḥkhenāṅgaprabādhakaḥ||
6.17.66 |  hinasti na sa gātrāṇi na ca duḥkho yathetare|
na ca bhojanapānānāṃ niruṇaddhyucitāṃ gatim||
6.17.67 |  nendriyāṇāṃ vyathāṃ nāpi kāṃcidāpādayedrujam|
sa sādhya ukto balinaḥ sarve cāvyaktalakṣaṇāḥ||
6.17.68 |  iti śvāsāḥ samuddiṣṭā hikkāścaiva svalakṣaṇaiḥ|
eṣāṃ prāṇaharā varjyā ghorāste hyāśukāriṇaḥ||
6.17.69 |  bheṣajaiḥ sādhyayāpyāṃstu kṣipraṃ bhiṣagupācaret|
upekṣitā daheyurhi śuṣkaṃ kakṣamivānalaḥ||
6.17.70 |  kāraṇasthānamūlaikyādekameva cikitsitam|
dvayorapi yathādṛṣṭamṛṣibhistannibodhata||
6.17.71 |  hikkāśvāsārditaṃ snigdhairādau svedairupācaret|
āktaṃ lavaṇatailena nāḍīprastarasaṃkaraiḥ||
6.17.72 |  tairasya grathitaḥ śleṣmā srotaḥsvabhivilīyate|
khāni mārdavamāyānti tato vātānulomatā||
6.17.73 |  yathā 'drikuñjeṣvarkāṃśutaptaṃ viṣyandate himam|
śleṣmā taptaḥ sthiro dehe svedairviṣyandate tathā||
6.17.74 |  svinnaṃ jñātvā tatastūrṇaṃ bhojayet snigdhamodanam|
matsyānāṃ śūkarāṇāṃ vā rasairdadhyuttareṇa vā||
6.17.75 |  tataḥ śleṣmaṇi saṃvṛddhe vamanaṃ pāyayettu tam|
pippalīsaindhavakṣaudrairyuktaṃ vātāvirodhi yat||
6.17.76 |  nirhṛte sukhamāpnoti sa kaphe duṣṭavigrahe|
srotaḥsu ca viśuddheṣu caratyavihato 'nilaḥ||
6.17.77 |  līnaśceddoṣaśeṣaḥ syāddhūmaistaṃ nirharedbudhaḥ|
haridrāṃ patrameraṇḍamūlaṃ lākṣāṃ manaḥśilām||
6.17.78 |  sadevadārvalaṃ māṃsīṃ piṣṭvā vartiṃ prakalpayet|
tāṃ ghṛtāktāṃ pibeddhūmaṃ yavairvā ghṛtasaṃyutaiḥ||
6.17.79 |  madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sarjarasaṃ ghṛtaṃ mallakasaṃpuṭe|
kṛtvā dhūmaṃ pibecchṛṅgaṃ bālaṃ vā snāyu vā gavām||
6.17.80 |  syonākavardhamānānāṃ nāḍīṃ śuṣkāṃ kuśasya vā|
padmakaṃ guggulaṃ lohaṃ śallakīṃ vā ghṛtāplutam||
6.17.81 |  svarakṣiṇātisārāsṛkpittadāhānubandhajān|
madhurasnigdhaśītādyairhikkāśvāsānupācaret||
6.17.82 |  na svedyāḥ pittadāhārtā raktasvedātivartinaḥ|
kṣīṇadhātubalā rūkṣā garbhiṇyaścāpi pittalāḥ||
6.17.83 |  koṣṇaiḥ kāmamuraḥkaṇṭhaṃ snehasekaiḥ saśarkaraiḥ|
utkārikopanāhaiśca svedayen mṛdubhiḥ kṣaṇam||
6.17.84 |  tilomāmāṣagodhūmacūrṇairvātaharaiḥ saha|
snehaiścotkārikā sāmlaiḥ sakṣīrairvā kṛtā hitā||
6.17.85 |  navajvarāmadoṣeṣu rūkṣasvedaṃ vilaṅghanam|
samīkṣyollekhanaṃ vā 'pi kārayellavaṇāmbunā||
6.17.86 |  atiyogoddhataṃ vātaṃ dṛṣṭvā vātaharairbhiṣak|
rasādyairnātiśītoṣṇairabhyaṅgaiśca śamaṃ nayet||
6.17.87 |  udāvarte tathā++ādhmāne mātuluṅgāmlavetasaiḥ|
hiṅgupīlubiḍaiścānnaṃ yuktaṃ syādanulomanam||
6.17.88 |  hikkāśvāsāmayī hyeko balavān durbalo 'paraḥ|
kaphādhikastathainaiko rūkṣo bahvanilo 'paraḥ||
6.17.89 |  kakādhike balasthe ca vamanaṃ savirecanam|
kuryāt pathyāśine dhūmalehādiśamanaṃ tataḥ||
6.17.90 |  vātikān durbalān bālān vṛddhāṃścānilasūdanaiḥ|
tarpayedeva śamanaiḥ snehayūṣarasādibhiḥ||
6.17.91 |  anutkliṣṭakaphāsvinnadurbalānāṃ viśodhanāt|
vāyurlabdhāspado marma saṃśoṣyāśu haredasūn||
6.17.92 |  dṛḍhān bahukaphāṃstasmādrasairānūpavārijaiḥ|
tṛptānviśodhayetsvinnān bṛṃhayeditarān bhiṣak||
6.17.93 |  barhitittiridakṣāśca jāṅgalāśca mṛgadvijāḥ|
daśamūlīrase siddhāḥ kaulatthe vā rase hitāḥ||
6.17.94 |  nidigdhikāṃ bilvamadhyaṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ durālabhām|
trikaṇṭakaṃ guḍūcīṃ ca kulatthāṃśca sacitrakān||
6.17.95 |  jale paktvā rasaḥ pūtaḥ pippalīghṛtabharjitaḥ|
sanāgaraḥ salavaṇaḥ syādyūṣo bhojane hitaḥ||
6.17.96 |  rāsnāṃ balāṃ pañcamūlaṃ hrasvaṃ mudgān sacitrakān|
paktvā 'mbhasi rase tasmin yūṣaḥ sādhyaśca pūrvavat||
6.17.97 |  pallavānmātuluṅgasya nimbasya kulakasya ca|
paktvā mudgāṃśca savyoṣān kṣārayūṣaṃ vipācayet||
6.17.98 |  dattvā salavaṇaṃ kṣāraṃ śigrūṇi maricāni ca|
yuktyā saṃsādhito yūṣo hikkāśvāsavikāranut||
6.17.99 |  kāsamardakapatrāṇāṃ yūṣaḥ śobhāñjanasya ca|
śuṣkamūlakayūṣaśca hikkāśvāsanivāraṇaḥ||
6.17.100 |  sadadhivyoṣasarpiṣko yūṣo vārtākajo hitaḥ|
śāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmayavānnānyanavāni ca||
6.17.101 |  hiṅgusauvarcalājājībiḍapauṣkaracitrakaiḥ|
siddhā karkaṭaśṛṅgyā ca yavāgūḥ śvāsahikkinām||
6.17.102 |  daśamūlīśaṭīrasnāpippalīmūlapauṣkaraiḥ|
śṛṅgītāmalakībhārgīguḍūcīnāgarāmbubhiḥ||
6.17.103 |  yavāgūṃ vidhinā siddhāṃ kaṣāyaṃ vā pibennaraḥ|
kāsahṛdgrahapārśvārtihikkāśvāsapraśāntaye||
6.17.104 |  puṣkarāhvaśaṭīvyoṣamātuluṅgāmlavetasaiḥ|
yojayedannapānāni sasārpirbiḍahiṅgubhiḥ||
6.17.105 |  daśamūlasya vā kvāthamathavā devadāruṇaḥ|
tṛṣito madirāṃ vā 'pi hikkāśvāsī pibennaraḥ||
6.17.106 |  pāṭhāṃ madhurasāṃ rāsnāṃ saralaṃ devadāru ca|
prakṣālya jarjarīkṛtya surāmaṇḍe nidhāpayet||
6.17.107 |  taṃ mandalavaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhiṣak prasṛtasaṃmitam|
pāyayettu tato hikkā śvāsaścaivopaśāmyati||
6.17.108 |  hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ kolaṃ samaṅgāṃ pippalīṃ balām|
mātuluṅgarase piṣṭamāranālena vā pibet||
6.17.109 |  sauvarcalaṃ nāgaraṃ ca bhārgīṃ dviśarkarāyutam|
uṣṇāmbunā pibedetaddhikkāśvāsavikāranut||
6.17.110 |  bhārgīnāgarayoḥ kalkaṃ maricakṣārayostathā|
pītadrucitrakāsphotāmūrvāṇāṃ cāmbunā pibet||
6.17.111 |  madhūlikā tugākṣīrī nāgaraṃ pippalī tathā|
utkārikā ghṛte siddhā śvāse pittānubandhaje||
6.17.112 |  śvāvidhaṃ śaśamāṃsaṃ ca śallakasya ca śoṇitam|
pippalīghṛtasiddhāni śvāse vātānubandhaje||
6.17.113 |  suvarcalāraso dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ trikaṭukānvitam|
śālyodanasyānupānaṃ vātapittānuge hitam||
6.17.114 |  śirīṣapuṣpasvarasaḥ saptaparṇasya vā punaḥ|
pippalīmadhusaṃyuktaḥ kaphapittānuge mataḥ||
6.17.115 |  madhukaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ guḍo *gośvaśakṛdrasaḥ|
ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ kāsaśvāsahikkābhiṣyandināṃ śubham||
6.17.116 |  kharāśvoṣṭravarāhāṇāṃ meṣasya ca gajasya ca|
śakṛdrasaṃ bahukaphe caikaikaṃ madhunā pibet||
6.17.117 |  kṣāraṃ cāpyaśvagandhāyā lihyānnā kṣaudrasarpiṣā|
mayūrapādanālaṃ vā śakalaṃ śallakasya vā||
6.17.118 |  *śvāvijjāṇḍakacāṣāṇāṃ romāṇi kurarasya vā|
*śṛṅgyekadviśaphānāṃ vā carmāsthīni khurāṃstathā||
6.17.119 |  sarvāṇyekaikaśo vā 'pi dagdhvā kṣaudraghṛtānvitam|
cūrṇaṃ līḍhvā jayet kāsaṃ hikkāṃ śvāsaṃ ca dāruṇam||
6.17.120 |  ete hi kaphasaṃruddhagati-*prāṇaprakopajāḥ|
tasmāttanmārgaśuddhyarthaṃ deyā lehā na niṣkaphe||
6.17.121 |  kāsine cchardanaṃ dadyāt svarabhaṅge ca buddhimān|
vātaśleṣmaharairyuktaṃ tamake tu virecanam||
6.17.122 |  udīryate bhṛśataraṃ mārgarodhādvahajjalam|
yathā tathā 'nilastasya mārgaṃ nityaṃ viśodhayet||
6.17.123 |  śaṭīcorakajīvantīvantītvaṅmustaṃ puṣkarāhvayam|
surasaṃ tāmalakyelā pippalyaguru nāgaram||
6.17.124 |  vālakaṃ ca samaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā 'ṣṭaguṇaśarkaram|
sarvathā tamake śvāse hikkāyāṃ ca prayojayet||
6.17.125 |  muktāpravālavaidūryaśaṅkhasphaṭikamañjanam|
*sasāragandhakācārkasūkṣmailālavaṇadvayam||
6.17.126 |  tāmrāyorajasī rūpyaṃ *sasaugandhikasīsakam|
jātīphalaṃ śaṇādbījamapāmārgasya taṇḍulāḥ||
6.17.127 |  eṣāṃ pāṇitalaṃ cūrṇaṃ tulyānāṃ kṣaudrasarpiṣā|
hikkāṃ śvāsaṃ ca kāsaṃ ca līḍhamāśu niyacchati||
6.17.128 |  añjanāttimiraṃ kācaṃ nīlikāṃ puṣpakaṃ tamaḥ|
*malyaṃ kaṇḍūmabhiṣyandamarma caiva praṇāśayet||
iti muktādyaṃ cūrṇam|
6.17.129 |  śaṭīpuṣkaramūlānāṃ cūrṇamāmalakasya ca|
madhunā saṃyutaṃ lehyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā kālalohajam||
6.17.130 |  saśarkarāṃ tāmalakīṃ drākṣāṃ gośvaśakṛdrasam|
tulyaṃ guḍaṃ nāgaraṃ ca prāśayennāvayettathā||
6.17.131 |  laśunasya palāṇḍorvā mūlaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā|
nāvayeccandanaṃ vā 'pi nārīkṣīreṇa saṃyutam||
6.17.132 |  sukhoṣṇaṃ ghṛtamaṇḍaṃ vā saindhavenāvacūrṇitam|
nāvayenmākṣikīṃ viṣṭhāmalaktakarasena vā||
6.17.133 |  nārīkṣīreṇa siddhaṃ vā sarpirmadhurakairapi|
pītaṃ nasto niṣiktaṃ vā sadyo hikkāṃ niyacchati||
6.17.134 |  sakṛduṣṇaṃ sakṛcchītaṃ vyatyāsāddhikkināṃ payaḥ|
pāne nastaḥkriyāyāṃ vā śarkarāmadhusaṃyutam||
6.17.135 |  adhobhāgairghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ sadyo hikkāṃ niyacchati|
pippalīmadhuyuktau vā rasau dhātrīkapitthayoḥ||
6.17.136 |  lājālākṣāmadhudrākṣāpippalyaśvaśakṛdrasān|
lihyāt kolamadhudrākṣāpippalīnāgarāṇi vā||
6.17.137 |  śītāmbusekaḥ sahasā trāso vismāpanaṃ bhayam|
krodhaharṣapriyodvegā hikkāpracyāvanā matāḥ||
6.17.138 |  hikkāśvāsavikārāṇāṃ nidānaṃ yat prakīrtitam|
varjyamārogyakāmaistaddhikkāśvāsavikāribhiḥ||
6.17.139 |  *hikkāśvāsānubandhā ye śuṣkoraḥkaṇṭhatālukāḥ|
prakṛtyā rūkṣadehāśca sarpirbhistānupācaret||
6.17.140 |  daśamūlarase sarpirdadhimaṇḍe ca sādhayet|
kṛṣṇāsauvarcalakṣāravayaḥsthāhiṅgucorakaiḥ||
6.17.141 |  kāyasthayā ca tat pānāddhikkāśvāsau praṇāśayet|
tejovatyabhayā kuṣṭhaṃ pippalī kaṭurohiṇī||
6.17.142 |  bhūtīkaṃ pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ palāśaścitrakaḥ śaṭī|
sauvarcalaṃ tāmalakī saindhavaṃ bilvapeśikā||
6.17.143 |  tālīsapatraṃ jīvantī vacā tairakṣasaṃmitaiḥ|
hiṅgupādairghṛtaprasthaṃ pacettoye caturguṇe||
6.17.144 |  etadyathābalaṃ pītvā hikkāśvāsau jayennaraḥ|
*śothānilārśograhaṇīhṛtpārśvaruja eva ca||
iti tejovatyādighṛtam|
6.17.145 |  manaḥśilāsarjarasalākṣārajanipadmakaiḥ|
mañjiṣṭhailaiśca karṣāṃśaiḥ prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtāddhitaḥ||
6.17.146 |  jīvanīyopasiddhaṃ vā sakṣaudraṃ lehayedghṛtam|
tryūṣaṇaṃ dādhikaṃ vā 'pi pibedvāsāghṛtaṃ tathā||
iti manaḥśilādighṛtam|
6.17.147 |  yatkiṃcit kaphavātaghnamuṣṇaṃ vātānulomanam|
bheṣajaṃ pānamannaṃ vā taddhitaṃ śvāsahikkine||
6.17.148 |  vātakṛdvā kaphaharaṃ kaphakṛdvā 'nilāpaham|
kāryaṃ naikāntikaṃ tābhyāṃ prāyaḥ śreyo 'nilāpaham||
6.17.149 |  sarveṣāṃ bṛṃhaṇe hyalpaḥ śakyaśca prāyaśo bhavet|
*nātyarthaṃ śamane 'pāyo bhṛśo 'śakyaśca karśane||
6.17.150 |  tasmācchuddhānaśuddhāṃśca śamanairbṛṃhaṇairapi|
hikkāśvāsārditāñjantūn prāyaśaḥ samupācaret||
6.17.151 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
durjayatve samutpattau kriyaikatve ca kāraṇam|
liṅgaṃ pathyaṃ ca hikkānāṃ śvāsānāṃ ceha darśitam||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne hikkāśvāsacikitsitaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||17 | |

aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.18.1 |  athātaḥ kāsacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.18.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.18.3 |  tapasā yaśasā dhṛtyā dhiyā ca parayā 'nvitaḥ|
ātreyaḥ kāsaśāntyarthaṃ prāha siddhaṃ cikitsitam||
6.18.4 |  vātādijāstrayo ye ca kṣatajaḥ kṣayajastathā|
pañcaite syurnṛṇāṃ kāsā vardhamānāḥ kṣayapradāḥ||
6.18.5 |  pūrvarūpaṃ bhavetteṣāṃ śūkapūrṇagalāsyatā|
kaṇṭhe kaṇḍūśca bhojyānāmavarodhaśca jāyate||
6.18.6 |  adhaḥpratihato vāyurūrdhvasrotaḥsamāśritaḥ|
udānabhāvamāpannaḥ kaṇṭhe saktastathorasi||
6.18.7 |  āviśya śirasaḥ khāni sarvāṇi pratipūrayan|
ābhañjannākṣipan dehaṃ hanumanye tathā 'kṣiṇī||
6.18.8 |  netre pṛṣṭhamuraḥpārśve nirbhujya stambhayaṃstataḥ|
śuṣko vā sakapho vā 'pi kasanātkāsa ucyate||
6.18.9 |  pratighātaviśeṣeṇa tasya vāyoḥ saraṃhasaḥ|
*vedanāśabdavaiśiṣṭyaṃ kāsānāmupajāyate||
6.18.10 |  rūkṣaśītakaṣāyālpapramitānaśanaṃ striyaḥ|
vegadhāraṇamāyāso vātakāsapravartakāḥ||
6.18.11 |  hṛtpārśvoraḥśūlasvarobhedakaro bhṛśam|
śuṣkoraśkaṇṭhavaktrasya hṛṣṭalomnaḥ pratāmyataḥ||
6.18.12 |  nirghoṣadainyastananadaurbalyakṣobhamohakṛt|
śuṣkakāsaḥ kaphaṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛcchrānmuktvā 'lpatāṃ vrajet||
6.18.13 |  snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇaiśca bhuktapītaiḥ praśāmyati|
ūrdhvavātasya jīrṇe 'nne vegavānmāruto bhavet||
6.18.14 |  kaṭukoṣṇavidāhyamlakṣārāṇāmatisevanam|
pittakāsakaraṃ krodhaḥ saṃtāpaścāgnisūryajaḥ||
6.18.15 |  pītaniṣṭhīvanākṣitvaṃ tiktāsyatvaṃ svarāmayaḥ|
urodhūmāyanaṃ tṛṣṇā dāho moho 'rucirbhramaḥ||
6.18.16 |  pratataṃ kāsamānaśca jyotīṃṣīva ca paśyati|
śleṣmāṇaṃ pittasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ niṣṭhīvati ca paittike||
6.18.17 |  gurvabhiṣyandimadhurasnigdhasvapnāviceṣṭanaiḥ|
vṛddhaḥ śleṣmā 'nilaṃ ruddhvā *kaphakāsaṃ karoti hi||
6.18.18 |  mandāgnitvārucicchardipīnasotkleśagauravaiḥ|
lomaharṣāsyamādhuryakledasaṃsadanairyutam||
6.18.19 |  bahulaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ niṣṭhīvati ghanaṃ kapham|
kāsamāno hyarug vakṣaḥ saṃpūrṇamiva manyate||
6.18.20 |  ativyavāyabhārādhvayuddhāśvagajavigrahaiḥ|
rūkṣasyoraḥ kṣataṃ vāyurgṛhītvā kāsamāvahet||
6.18.21 |  sa pūrvaṃ kāsate śuṣkaṃ tataḥ ṣṭhīvet saśoṇitam|
kaṇṭhena rujatā 'tyarthaṃ virugṇeneva corasā||
6.18.22 |  sūcībhiriva tīkṣṇābhistudyamānena śūlinā|
duḥkhasparśona śūlena bhedapīḍābhitāpinā||
6.18.23 |  parvabhedajvaraśvāsatṛṣṇāvaisvaryapīḍitaḥ|
pārāvata ivākūjan kāsavegātkṣatodbhavāt||
6.18.24 |  viṣamāsātmyabhojyātivyavāyādveganigrahāt|
ghṛṇināṃ śocatāṃ nṛṛṇāṃ vyāpanne 'gnau trayo malāḥ||
6.18.25 |  kupitāḥ kṣayajaṃ kāsaṃ kuryurdehakṣayapradam|
kurgandhaṃ haritaṃ raktaṃ ṣṭhīvet pūyopamaṃ kapham||
6.18.26 |  sthānādutkāsamānaśca hṛdayaṃ manyate *cyutam|
akasmāduṣṇaśītārto bahvāśī durbalaḥ kṛśaḥ||
6.18.27 |  snigdhācchamukhavarṇatva *śrīmaddarśanalocanaḥ|
pāṇipādatalaiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ *satatāsūyako ghṛṇī||
6.18.28 |  jvaro miśrākṛtistasya pārśvaruk pīnaso 'ruciḥ|
*bhinnasaṃhatavarcastvaṃ svarabhedo 'nimittataḥ||
6.18.29 |  ityeṣa kṣayajaḥ kāsaḥ kṣīṇānāṃ dehanāśanaḥ|
sādhyo balavatāṃ vā syādyāpyastvevaṃ kṣatotthitaḥ||
6.18.30 |  navau kadācit sidhyetāmetau pādaguṇānvitau|
sthavirāṇāṃ jarākāsaḥ sarvo yāpyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ||
6.18.31 |  trīnsādhyānsādhayetpūrvān pathyairyāpyāṃśca yāpayet|
cikitsāmata ūrdhvaṃ tu śṛṇu kāsanibarhiṇīm||
6.18.32 |  rūkṣasyānilajaṃ kāsamādau snehairupācaret|
sarpirbhirbastibhiḥ peyāyūṣakṣīrarasādibhiḥ||
6.18.33 |  vātaghnasiddhaiḥ snehādyairdhūmairlehaiśca yuktitaḥ|
abhyaṅgaiḥ pariṣekaiśca snigdhaiḥ svedaiśca buddhimān||
6.18.34 |  bastibhirbaddhaviḍvātaṃ śuṣkordhṛvaṃ cordhvabhaktikaiḥ|
ghṛtaiḥ sapittaṃ sakaphaṃ jayet snehavirecanaiḥ||
6.18.35 |  kaṇṭakārīguḍūcībhyāṃ pṛthak triṃśatpalādrase|
prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtādvātakāsanudvahnidīpanaḥ||
iti kaṇṭakārīghṛtam|
6.18.36 |  pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ|
dhānyapāṭhāvacārāsnāyaṣṭyāhvakṣārahiṅgubhiḥ||
6.18.37 |  kolamātrairghṛtaprasthāddaśamūlīrasāḍhake|
siddhāccaturthikāṃ pītvā peyāmaṇḍaṃ pibedanu||
6.18.38 |  tacchvāsakāsahṛtpārśvagrahaṇīdoṣagulmanut|
pippalyādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ caitadātreyeṇa prakīrtitam||
iti pippalyādighṛtam|
6.18.39 |  tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ kāśmaryāṇi parūṣakam|
dve pāṭhe devadārvṛddhiṃ svaguptāṃ citrakaṃ śaṭīm||
6.18.40 |  *brāhmīṃ tāmalakīṃ medāṃ kākanāsāṃ śatāvarīm|
trikaṇṭakaṃ vidārīṃ ca piṣṭvā karṣasamaṃ ghṛtāt||
6.18.41 |  prasthaṃ caturguṇe kṣīre siddhaṃ kāsaharaṃ pibet|
jvaragulmāruciplīhaśirohṛtpārśvaśūlanut||
6.18.42 |  kāmalārśo 'nilāṣṭhīlākṣataśoṣakṣayāpaham|
tryūṣaṇaṃ nāma vikhyātametadghṛtamanuttamam||
iti tryūṣaṇādyaṃ ghṛtam|
6.18.43 |  droṇe 'pāṃ sādhayedrāsnāṃ daśamūlīṃ śatāvarīm|
palikāṃ māṇikāṃśāṃstu kulatthānbadarānyavān||
6.18.44 |  tulārdhaṃ cājamāṃsasya pādaśeṣeṇa tena ca|
ghṛtāḍhakaṃ samakṣīraṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||
6.18.45 |  siddhaṃ taddaśabhiḥ kalkairnasyapānānuvāsanaiḥ|
samīkṣya vātarogeṣu yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet||
6.18.46 |  pañcakāsān śiraḥkampaṃ śūlaṃ vaṅkṣaṇayonijam|
sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogāṃśca saplīhordhvānilāñjayet||
iti rāsnāghṛtam|
6.18.47 |  viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ rāsnā pippalī hiṅgu saindhavam|
bhārgī kṣāraśca taccūrṇaṃ pibedvā ghṛtamātrayā||
6.18.48 |  sakaphe 'nilaje kāse śvāsahikkāhatāgniṣu|
dvau kṣārau pañcakolāni pañcava lavaṇāni ca||
6.18.49 |  śaṭīnāgarakodīcyakalkaṃ vā vastragālitam|
pāyayeta ghṛtonmiśraṃ vātakāsanibarhaṇam||
6.18.50 |  durālabhāṃ śaṭīṃ drākṣāṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ sitopalām|
lihyāt karkaṭaśṛṅgīṃ ca kāse tailena vātaje||
6.18.51 |  duḥsparśāṃ pippalīṃ mustaṃ bhārgīṃ karkaṭakīṃ śaṭīm|
purāṇaguḍatailābhyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ vā 'pi lehayet||
6.18.52 |  viḍaṅgaṃ saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu manaḥśilām|
*madhusarpiryutaṃ kāsahikkāśvāsaṃ jayellihan||
6.18.53 |  citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu durālabhām|
śaṭīṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ ca śreyasīṃ surasāṃ vacām||
6.18.54 |  bhārgīṃ chinnaruhāṃ rāsnāṃ śṛṅgīṃ drākṣāṃ ca kārṣikān|
*kalkānardhatulākvāthe nidigdhyāḥ palaviṃśatim||
6.18.55 |  dattvā matsyaṇḍikāyāśca ghṛtācca kuḍavaṃ pacet|
siddhaṃ śītaṃ pṛthak kṣaudrapippalīkuḍavānvitam||
6.18.56 |  catuṣpalaṃ tugākṣīryāścūrṇitaṃ tatra dāpayet|
lehayet kāsahṛdrogaśvāsagulmanivāraṇam||
iti citrakādilehaḥ|
6.18.57 |  daśamūlīṃ svayaṅguptāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ śaṭīṃ balām|
hastipippalyapāmārgapippalīmūlacitrakān||
6.18.58 |  bhārgīṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ ca dvipalāṃśaṃ yavāḍhakam|
harītakīśataṃ caikaṃ jale pañcāḍhake pacet||
6.18.59 |  yavaiḥ svinnaiḥ kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtaṃ taccābhayāśatam|
pacedguḍatulāṃ dattvā kuḍavaṃ ca pṛthagghṛtāt||
6.18.60 |  tailāt sapippalīcūrṇāt siddhaśīte ca mākṣikāt|
lihyāddve cābhaye nityamataḥ khādedrasāyanāt||
6.18.61 |  tadvalīpalitaṃ hanti varṇāyurbalavardhanam|
pañcakāsān kṣayaṃ śvāsaṃ hikkāṃ ca viṣamajvaram||
6.18.62 |  hanyāttathā 'rśograhaṇīhṛdrogārucipīnasān|
agastyavihitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rasāyanamidaṃ śubham||
ityagastyaharītakī|
6.18.63 |  saindhavaṃ pippalīṃ bhārgīṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ durālabhām|
dāḍimāmlena koṣṇena bhārgīnāgaramambunā||
6.18.64 |  *pibet khadirasāraṃ vā madirādadhimastubhiḥ|
athavā pippalīkalkaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam||
6.18.65 |  śirasaḥ pīḍane srāve nāsāyā hṛdi tāmyati|
kāsapratiśyāyavatāṃ dhūmaṃ vaidyaḥ prayojayet||
6.18.66 |  daśāṅgulonmitāṃ nāḍīmathavā 'ṣṭāṅgulonmitām|
śarāvasaṃpuṭacchidre kṛtvā jihmāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ||
6.18.67 |  vairecanaṃ mukhenaiva kāsavān dhūmamāpibet|
tamuraḥ kevalaṃ prāptaṃ mukhenaivodvamet punaḥ||
6.18.68 |  sa hyasya taikṣṇyādvicchidya śleṣmāṇamurasi sthitam|
niṣkṛṣya śamayet kāsaṃ vātaśleṣmasamudbhavam||
6.18.69 |  manaḥśilālamadhukamāṃsīmusteṅgudaiḥ pibet|
dhūmaṃ tasyānu ca kṣīraṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ saguḍaṃ pibet||
6.18.70 |  eṣa kāsān pṛthagdoṣasannipātasamudbhavān|
dhūmo hanyādasaṃsiddhānanyairyogaśatairapi||
6.18.71 |  prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ śārṅgeṣṭāṃ samanaḥśilām|
maricaṃ pippalīṃ drākṣāmelāṃ surasamañjarīm||
6.18.72 |  kṛtvā vartīṃ pibeddhūmaṃ kṣaumacelānuvartitām|
ghṛtāktāmanu ca kṣīraṃ guḍodakamathāpi vā||
6.18.73 |  manaḥśilailāmaricakṣārāñjanakuṭannaṭaiḥ|
*vaṃśalekhanasevyālakṣaumalaktakarohiṣaiḥ||
6.18.74 |  pūrvakalpena dhūmo 'yaṃ sānupāno vidhīyate|
manaḥśilāle tadvacca pippalīnāgaraiḥ saha||
6.18.75 |  tvagaiṅgudī bṛhatyau dve tālamūlī manaḥśilā|
kārpāsāsthyaśvagandhā ca dhūmaḥ kāsavināśanaḥ||
6.18.76 |  grāmyānūpaudakaiḥ śāliyavagodhūmaṣaṣṭikān|
rasairmāṣātmaguptānāṃ yūṣairvā bhojayeddhitān||
6.18.77 |  yavānīpippalībilvamadhyanāgaracitrakaiḥ|
rāsnājājīpṛthakparṇīpalāśaśaṭipauṣkaraiḥ||
6.18.78 |  snigdhāmlalavaṇāṃ siddhāṃ peyāmanilaje pibet|
kaṭīhṛtpārśvakoṣṭhārtiśvāsahikkāpraṇāśinīm||
6.18.79 |  daśamūlarase tadvatpañcakolaguḍānvitām|
siddhāṃ samatilāṃ dadyātkṣīre vā 'pi sasaindhavām||
6.18.80 |  mātsyakaukkuṭavārāhairāmiṣairvā ghṛtānvitām|
*siddhāṃ sasaindhavāṃ peyāṃ vātakāsī pibennaraḥ||
6.18.81 |  vāstuko vāyasīśākaṃ mūlakaṃ suniṣaṇṇakam|
snehāstailādayo bhakṣyāḥ kṣīrekṣurasagauḍikāḥ||
6.18.82 |  dadhyāranālāmlaphalaprasannāpānameva ca|
śasyate vātakāse tu svādvamlalavaṇāni ca||
iti vātakāsacikitsā|
6.18.83 |  paittike sakaphe kāse vamanaṃ sarpiṣā hitam|
tathā madanakāśmaryamadhukakkathitairjalaiḥ||
6.18.84 |  yaṣṭyāhvaphalakalkairvā vidārīkṣurasāyutaiḥ|
hṛtadoṣastataḥ śītaṃ madhuraṃ ca kramaṃ bhajet||
6.18.85 |  paitte tanukaphe kāse trivṛtāṃ madhurairyutām|
dadyādghanakaphe tiktairvirekārthe yutāṃ bhiṣak||
6.18.86 |  snigdhaśītastanukaphe rūkṣaśītaḥ kaphe ghane|
kramaḥ kāryaḥ paraṃ bhojyaiḥ snehairlehaiśca śasyate||
6.18.87 |  śṛṅgāṭakaṃ padmabījaṃ nīlīsārāṇi pippalī|
pippalīmustayaṣṭyāhvadrākṣāmūrvāmahauṣadham||
6.18.88 |  lājā 'mṛtaphalā drākṣā tvakkṣīrī pippalī sitā|
pippalīpadmakadrākṣā bṛhatyāśca phalādrasaḥ||
6.18.89 |  kharjūraṃ pippalī vāṃśī śvadaṃṣṭrā ceti pañca te|
ghṛtakṣaudrayutā lehāḥ ślokārdhaiḥ pittakāsinām||
6.18.90 |  śarkarācandanadrākṣāmadhudhātrīphalotpalaiḥ|
paitte, samustamaricaḥ sakaphe, saghṛto 'nile||
6.18.91 |  mṛdvīkārdhaśataṃ triṃśatpippalīḥ śarkarāpalam|
lehayenmadhunā gorvā *kṣīrapaṃ ca śakṛdrasam||
6.18.92 |  tvagelāvyoṣamṛdvīkāpippalīmūlapauṣkaraiḥ|
lājāmustaśaṭīrāsnādhātrīphalabibhītakaiḥ||
6.18.93 |  śarkarākṣaudrasarpirbhirlehaḥ kāsavināśanaḥ|
śvāsaṃ hikkāṃ kṣayaṃ caiva hṛdrogaṃ ca praṇāśayet||
6.18.94 |  pippalyāmalakaṃ drākṣāṃ lākṣāṃ lājāṃ sitopalām|
kṣīre paktvā ghanaṃ śītaṃ lihyāt kṣaudrāṣṭabhāgikam||
6.18.95 |  vidārīkṣumṛṇālānāṃ rasān kṣīraṃ sitopalām|
pibedvā madhusaṃyuktaṃ pittakāsaharaṃ param||
6.18.96 |  madhurairjāṅgalarasaiḥ śyāmākayavakodravāḥ|
mudgādiyūṣaiḥ śākaiśca tiktakairmātrayā hitāḥ||
6.18.97 |  ghanaśleṣmaṇi lehāstu tiktakā madhusaṃyutāḥ|
śālayaḥ syustanukaphe ṣaṣṭikāśca rasādibhiḥ||
