6.18.98 |  śarkarāmbho 'nupānārthaṃ drākṣekṣūṇāṃ rasāḥ payaḥ|
sarvaṃ ca madhuraṃ śītamavidāhi praśasyate||
6.18.99 |  kākolībṛhatīmedāyugmaiḥ savṛṣanāgaraiḥ|
pittakāse rasān kṣīraṃ yūṣāṃścāpyupakalpayet||
6.18.100 |  śarādipañcamūlasya pippalīdrākṣayostathā|
kaṣāyeṇa śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet samadhuśarkaram||
6.18.101 |  sthirāsitāpṛśniparṇīśrāvaṇībṛhatīyugaiḥ|
jīvakarṣabhakākolītāmalakyṛddhijīvakaiḥ||
6.18.102 |  śṛtaṃ payaḥ pibet kāsī jvarī dāhī kṣatakṣayī|
tajjaṃ vā sādhayet sarpiḥ sakṣīrekṣurasaṃ bhiṣak||
6.18.103 |  jīvakādyairmadhurakaiḥ phalaiścābhiṣukādibhiḥ|
kalkaistrikārṣikaiḥ siddhe pūtaśīte pradāpayet||
6.18.104 |  śarkarāpippalīcūrṇaṃ tvakkṣīryā maricasya ca|
śṛṅgāṭakasya cāvāpya kṣaudragarbhānpalonmitān||
6.18.105 |  guḍān godhūmacūrṇena kṛtvā khādeddhitāśanaḥ|
śukrāsṛgdoṣaśoṣeṣu kāse kṣīṇakṣateṣu ca||
6.18.106 |  śarkarānāgarodīcyaṃ kaṇṭakārīṃ śaṭīṃ samam|
piṣṭvā rasaṃ pibetpūtaṃ vastreṇa ghṛtamūrcchitam||
6.18.107 |  mahiṣyajāvigokṣīradhātrīphalarasaiḥ samaiḥ|
sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibedyuktyā pittakāsanibarhaṇam||
iti pittakāsacikitsā|
6.18.108 |  balinaṃ vamanairādau śodhitaṃ kaphakāsinam|
yavānnaiḥ kaṭurūkṣoṣṇaiḥ kaphaghnaiścāpyupācaret||
6.18.109 |  pippalīkṣārikairyūṣaiḥ kaulatthairmūlakasya ca|
laghūnyannāni bhuñjīta rasairvā kaṭukānvitaiḥ||
6.18.110 |  dhānvabailarasaiḥ snehaistilasarṣapabilvajaiḥ|
madhvamloṣṇāmbutakraṃ vā madyaṃ vā nigadaṃ pibet||
6.18.111 |  pauṣkarāragvadhaṃ mūlaṃ paṭolaṃ tairniśāsthitam|
jalaṃ madhuyutaṃ peyaṃ kāleṣvannasya vā triṣu||
6.18.112 |  kaṭphalaṃ kattṛṇaṃ bhārgīṃ mustaṃ dhānyaṃ vacābhaye|
śuṇṭhīṃ parpaṭakaṃ śṛṅgīṃ surāhvaṃ ca śṛtaṃ jale||
6.18.113 |  madhuhiṅguyutaṃ peyaṃ kāse vātakaphātmake|
kaṇṭharoge mukhe śūne śvāsahikkājvareṣu ca||
6.18.114 |  pāṭhāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ mūrvāṃ gavākṣīṃ mustapippalīm|
piṣṭvā gharmāmbunā hiṅgusaindhavābhyāṃ yutāṃ pibet||
6.18.115 |  nāgarātiviṣe mustaṃ śṛṅgīṃ karkaṭakasya ca|
harītakīṃ śaṭīṃ caiva tenaiva vidhinā pibet||
6.18.116 |  tailabhṛṣṭaṃ ca pippalyāḥ kalkākṣaṃ sasitopalam|
pibedvā śleṣmakāsaghnaṃ kulattharasasaṃyutam||
6.18.117 |  kāsamardāśvaviṭbhṛṅgarājavārtākajo rasaḥ|
sakṣaudraḥ kaphakāsaghnaḥ surasasyāsitasya ca||
6.18.118 |  devadāru śaṭī rāsnā karkaṭākhyā durālabhā|
pippalī nāgaraṃ mustaṃ pathyādhātrīsitopalāḥ||
6.18.119 |  madhutailayutāvetau lehau vātānuge kaphe|
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ citrako hastipippalī||
6.18.120 |  pathyā tāmalakī dhātrī bhadramustā ca pippalī|
devadārvabhayā mustaṃ pippalī viśvabheṣajam||
6.18.121 |  viśālā pippalī mustaṃ trivṛtā ceti lehayet|
caturo madhunā lehān kaphakāsaharān bhiṣak||
6.18.122 |  sauvarcalābhayādhātrīpippalīkṣāranāgaram|
cūrṇitaṃ sarpiṣā vātakaphakāsaharaṃ pibet||
6.18.123 |  daśamūlāḍhake prasthaṃ ghṛtasyākṣasamaiḥ pacet|
puṣkarāhvaśaṭībilvasurasavyoṣahiṅgubhiḥ||
6.18.124 |  peyānupānaṃ tat peyaṃ kāse vātakaphātmake|
śvāsarogeṣu sarveṣu kaphavātātmakeṣu ca||
iti daśamūlādighṛtam|
6.18.125 |  samūlaphalapatrāyāḥ kaṇṭakāryā rasāḍhake|
ghṛtaprasthaṃ balāvyoṣaviḍaṅgaśaṭicitrakaiḥ||
6.18.126 |  sauvarcalayavakṣārapippalīmūlapauṣkaraiḥ|
vṛścīrabṛhatīpathyāyavānīdāḍimardhibhiḥ||
6.18.127 |  drākṣāpunarnavācavyadurālambhāmlavetasaiḥ|
śṛṅgītāmalakībhārgīrāsnāgokṣurakaiḥ pacet||
6.18.128 |  kalkaistat sarvakāseṣu hikkāśvāseṣu śasyate|
kaṇṭakārīghṛtaṃ hyetat kaphavyādhinisūdanam||
iti kaṇṭakārīghṛtam|
6.18.129 |  kulattharasayuktaṃ vā pañcakolaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam|
pāyayet kaphaje kāse hikkāśvāse ca śasyate||
iti kulatthādighṛtam|
6.18.130 |  dhūmāṃstāneva dadyācca ye proktā vātakāsinām|
kośātakīphalānmadhyaṃ pibedvā samanaḥśilam||
6.18.131 |  tamakaḥ kaphakāse tu syāccet pittānubandhajaḥ|
pittakāsakriyāṃ tatra yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet||
6.18.132 |  vāte kaphānubandhe tu kuryāt kaphaharīṃ kriyām|
pittānubandhayorvātakaphayoḥ pittanāśinīm||
6.18.133 |  ārdre virūkṣaṇaṃ, śuṣke snigdhaṃ, vātakaphātmake|
kāse 'nnapānaṃ kaphaje sapitte tiktasaṃyutam||
iti kaphajakāsacikitsā|
6.18.134 |  kāsamātyayikaṃ matvā kṣatajaṃ tvarayā jayet|
madhurairjīvanīyaiśca balamāṃsavivardhanaiḥ||
6.18.135 |  pippalī madhukaṃ piṣṭaṃ kārṣikaṃ sasitopalam|
prāsthikaṃ gavyamājaṃ ca kṣīramikṣurasastathā||
6.18.136 |  yavagodhūmamṛdvīkācūrṇamāmalakādrasaḥ|
tailaṃ ca prasṛtāṃśāni tat sarvaṃ mṛdunā 'gninā||
6.18.137 |  pacellehaṃ ghṛtakṣaudrayuktaḥ sa kṣatakāsahā|
śvāsahṛdrogakārśyeṣu hito vṛddhe 'lparetasi||
6.18.138 |  kṣatakāsābhibhūtānāṃ vṛttiḥ syāt pittakāsikī|
kṣīrasarpirmadhuprāyā saṃsarge tu viśeṣaṇam||
6.18.139 |  vātapittārdite 'bhyaṅgo gātrabhede ghṛtairhitaḥ|
tailairmārutarogaghnaiḥ pīḍyamāne ca vāyunā||
6.18.140 |  hṛtpārśvārtiṣu pānaṃ syājjīvanīyasya sarpiṣaḥ|
sadāhaṃ kāsino raktaṃ ṣṭhīvataḥ sabale 'nale||
6.18.141 |  māṃsocitebhyaḥ kṣāmebhyo lāvādīnāṃ rasā hitāḥ|
tṛṣṇārtānāṃ payaśchāgaṃ śaramūlādibhiḥ śṛtam||
6.18.142 |  rakte srotobhya āsyādvā 'pyāgate kṣīrajaṃ ghṛtam|
nasyaṃ pānaṃ yavāgūrvā śrānte kṣāme hatānale||
6.18.143 |  stambhāyāmeṣu mahatīṃ mātrāṃ vā sarpiṣaḥ pibet|
kuryādvā vātarogaghnaṃ pittaraktāvirodhi yat||
6.18.144 |  nivṛtte kṣatadoṣe tu kaphe vṛddha *uraḥ kṣate|
dālyate kāsino yasya sa dhūmānnā pibedimān||
6.18.145 |  dve mede madhukraṃ dve ca bale taiḥ kṣaumalaktakaiḥ|
vartitairdhūmamāpīya jīvanīyaghṛtaṃ pibet||
6.18.146 |  manaḥśilāpalāśājagandhātvakkṣīrināgaraiḥ|
bhāvayitvā pibet kṣaumamanu cekṣuguḍodakam||
6.18.147 |  piṣṭvā manaḥśilāṃ tulyāmārdrayā vaṭaśuṅgayā|
sasarpiṣkaṃ pibeddhūmaṃ tittiripratibhojanam||
6.18.148 |  bhāvitaṃ jīvanīyairvā kuliṅgāṇḍarasāyutaiḥ|
kṣaumaṃ dhūmaṃ pibet kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ cāyoguḍairanu||
iti kṣatajakāsacikitsā|
6.18.149 |  saṃpūrṇarūpaṃ kṣayajaṃ durbalasya vivarjayet|
navotthitaṃ balavataḥ pratyākhyāyācaret kriyām||
6.18.150 |  tasmai bṛṃhaṇamevādau kuryādagneśca dīpanam|
bahudoṣāya sasnehaṃ mṛdu dadyādvirecanam||
6.18.151 |  śampākena trivṛtayā mṛdvīkārasayuktayā|
tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa vidārīsvarasena ca||
6.18.152 |  sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibedyuktyā kṣīṇadeho viśodhanam|
(hitaṃ taddehabalayorasya saṃrakṣaṇaṃ *matam||)
6.18.153 |  pitte kaphe ca saṃkṣīṇe parikṣīṇeṣu dhātuṣu|
ghṛtaṃ karkaṭakīkṣīradvibalāsādhitaṃ pibet||
6.18.154 |  vidārībhiḥ kadambairvā tālasasyaistathā śṛtam|
ghṛtaṃ payaśca mūtrasya vaivarṇye kṛcchranirgame||
6.18.155 |  śūne savedane meḍhre pāyau saśroṇivaṃkṣaṇe|
ghṛtamaṇḍena *madhunā 'nuvāsyo miśrakeṇa vā||
6.18.156 |  jāṅgalaiḥ pratibhuktasya vartakādyā bileśayāḥ|
kramaśaḥ prasahāścaiva prayojyāḥ piśitāśinaḥ||
6.18.157 |  auṣṇyāt pramāthibhāvācca srotobhyaścyāvayanti te|
kaphaṃ, śuddhaiśca taiḥ puṣṭiṃ kuryātsamyagvahanrasaḥ||
6.18.158 |  dvipañcamūlītriphalācavikābhārgicitrakaiḥ|
kulatthapippalīmūlapāṭhakolayavairjale||
6.18.159 |  śṛtairnāgaraduḥsparśāpippalīśaṭipauṣkaraiḥ|
kalaiḥ karkaṭaśṛṅgyā ca samaiḥ sarpirvipācayet||
6.18.160 |  siddhe 'smiṃścūrṇitau kṣārau dvau pañca lavaṇāni ca|
dattvā yuktyā pibenmātrāṃ kṣayakāsanipīḍitaḥ||
iti dvipañcamūlādighṛtam|
6.18.161 |  guḍūcīṃ pippalīṃ mūrvāṃ haridrāṃ śreyasīṃ vacām|
nidigdhikāṃ kāsamardaṃ pāṭhāṃ citrakanāgaram||
6.18.162 |  jale caturguṇe paktvā pādaśeṣeṇa tatsamam|
siddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibedgulmaśvāsārtikṣayakāsanut||
iti guḍūcyādighṛtam|
6.18.163 |  kāsamardābhayāmustapāṭhākaṭphalanāgaraiḥ|
pippalīkaṭukādrākṣākāśmaryasurasaistathā||
6.18.164 |  akṣamātrairghṛtaprasthaṃ kṣīradrākṣārasāḍhake|
pacecchoṣajvaraplīhasarvakāsaharaṃ śivam||
6.18.165 |  dhātrīphalaiḥ kṣīrasiddhaiḥ sarpirvā 'pyavacūrṇitam|
dviguṇe dāḍimarase vipakvaṃ vyoṣasaṃyutam||
6.18.166 |  pibedupari bhaktasya yavakṣāraghṛtaṃ naraḥ|
pippalīguḍasiddhaṃ vā cchāgakṣīrayutaṃ ghṛtam||
6.18.167 |  etānyagnivivṛddhyarthaṃ sarpīṃṣi kṣayakāsinām|
syurdoṣabaddhakoṣṭhoraḥsrotasāṃ ca viśuddhaye||
6.18.168 |  harītakīryavakvāthadvyāḍhake viṃśatiṃ pacet|
svinnā mṛditvā tāstasmin purāṇaṃ guḍaṣaṭpalam||
6.18.169 |  dadyānmanaḥśilākarṣaṃ karṣāṃrdhaṃ ca rasāñjanāt|
kuḍavārdhaṃ ca pipplyāḥ sa lehaḥ śvāsakāsanut||
iti harītakīlehaḥ|
6.18.170 |  śvāvidhaḥ sūcayo dagdhāḥ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkarāḥ|
śvāsakāsaharā barhipādau vā kṣaudrasarpiṣā||
6.18.171 |  eraṇḍapatrakṣāraṃ vā vyoṣatailaguḍānvitam|
lihyādetena vidhinā surasairaṇḍapatrajam||
6.18.172 |  drākṣāpadmakavārtākapippalīḥ kṣaudrasarpiṣā|
lihyāttryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ vā purāṇaguḍasarpiṣā||
6.18.173 |  citrakaṃ triphalājājī karkaṭākhyā kaṭutrikam|
drākṣāṃ ca kṣaudrasarpirbhyāṃ lihyādadyādguḍena vā||
6.18.174 |  padmakaṃ triphalāṃ vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ suradāru ca|
balāṃ rāsnāṃ ca tulyāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet||
6.18.175 |  sarvairebhiḥ samaṃ cūrṇaiḥ pṛthak kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ sitām|
vimathya lehayellehaṃ sarvakāsaharaṃ śivam||
6.18.176 |  jīvantīṃ madhukaṃ pāṭhāṃ tvakkṣīrīṃ triphalāṃ śaṭīm|
mustaile padmakaṃ drākṣāṃ dve bṛhatyau vitunnakam||
6.18.177 |  sārivāṃ pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ rasāñjanam|
punarnavāṃ loharajastrāyamāṇāṃ yavānikām||
6.18.178 |  bhārgīṃ tāmalakīmṛddhiṃ viḍaṅgaṃ dhanvayāsakam|
kṣāracitrakacavyāmlavetasavyoṣadāru ca||
6.18.179 |  cūrṇīkṛtya samāṃśāni lehayet kṣaudrasarpiṣā|
cūrṇātpāṇitalaṃ pañca kāsānetad vyapohati||
iti padmakādilehaḥ|
6.18.180 |  lihyānmaricacūrṇaṃ vā saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram|
badarīpatrakalkaṃ vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam||
6.18.181 |  *svarabhede ca kāse ca lehametaṃ prayojayet|
patrakalkaṃ ghṛtairbhṛṣṭaṃ tilvakasya saśarkaram||
6.18.182 |  peyā cotkārikā ccharditṛṭkāsāmātisāranut|
gaurasarṣapagaṇḍīraviḍaṅgavyoṣacitrakān|
sābhayān sādhayettoye yavāgūṃ tena cāmbhasā||
6.18.183 |  sasarpirlavaṇāṃ kāse hikkāśvāse sapīnase|
pāṇḍvāmaye kṣaye *śothe karṇaśūle ca dāpayet||
6.18.184 |  kaṇṭakārīrase siddho mudgayūṣaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ|
sagaurāmalakaḥ sāmlaḥ sarvakāsabhiṣagjitam||
6.18.185 |  vātaghnauṣadhaniṣkvāthaṃ kṣīraṃ yūṣān rasānapi|
vaiṣkirapratudān bailān dāpayet kṣayakāsine||
6.18.186 |  kṣatakāse ca ye dhūmāḥ sānupānā nidarśitāḥ|
kṣayakāse 'pi tāneva yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet||
6.18.187 |  dīpanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ caiva srotasāṃ ca viśodhanam|
vyatyāsātkṣayakāsibhyo balyaṃ sarvaṃ hitaṃ bhavet||
6.18.188 |  sannipātabhavo 'pyeṣa kṣayakāsaḥ sudāruṇaḥ|
sannipātahitaṃ tasmāt sadā kāryaṃ bhiṣagjitam||
6.18.189 |  doṣānubalayogācca haredrogabalābalam|
kāseṣveṣu garīyāṃsaṃ jānīyāduttarottaram||
6.18.190 |  bhojyaṃ pānāni sarpīṃṣi *lehāśca saha pānakaiḥ|
kṣīraṃ sarpirguḍā dhūmāḥ kāsabhaiṣajyasaṃgrahaḥ||
6.18.191 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
saṃkhyā nimittaṃ rūpāṇi sādhyāsādhyatvameva ca|
kāsānāṃ bheḍajaṃ proktaṃ garīyastvaṃ ca kāsinaḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne kāsacikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||18 | |

ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.19.1 |  athāto 'tīsāracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.19.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.19.3 |  bhagavantaṃ khalvātreyaṃ kṛtāhnikaṃ hutāgnihotramāsīnamṛṣigaṇaparivṛtamuttare himavataḥ pārśve vinayādupetyābhivādya cāgniveśa uvāca --- bhagavan! atīsārasya prāgutpattinimittalakṣaṇopaśamanāni prajānugrahārthamākhyātumarhasīti||
6.19.4 |  atha bhagavān punarvasurātreyastadagniveśavacanamanuniśamyovāca --- śrūyatāmagniveśa! sarvametadakhilena vākhyāyamānam|
ādikāle khalu yajñeṣu paśavaḥ samālabhanīyā babhūvurnālambhāya prakriyante sma|
tato dakṣayajñaṃ pratyavarakālaṃ manoḥ putrāṇāṃ nariṣyannābhāgekṣvākunṛgaśaryātyādīnāṃ kratuṣu paśūnāmevābhyanujñānāt paśavaḥ prokṣaṇamavāpuḥ|
ataśca pratyavarakālaṃ pṛṣadhreṇa dīrghasatreṇa yajatā paśūnāmalābhādgavāmālambhaḥ pravartitaḥ|
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pravyathitā bhūtagaṇāḥ, teṣāṃ copayogādupākṛtānāṃ gavāṃ *gauravādauṣṇyādasātmyatvādaśastopayogāccopahatāgnīnāmupahatamanasāṃ cātīsāraḥ pūrvamutpannaḥ pṛṣadhrayajñe||
6.19.5 |  athāvarakālaṃ vātalasya vātātapavyāyāmātimātriniṣeviṇo rūkṣālpapramitāśinastīkṣṇamadyavyavāyanityasyodāvartayataśca vegān vāyuḥ; prakopamāpadyate, paktā copahanyate; sa vāyuḥ kupito 'gnāvupahate mūtrasvedau purīṣāśayamupahṛtya, tābhyāṃ purīṣaṃ dravīkṛtya, atīsārāya prakalpate|
tasya rūpāṇi---vijjalamāmaṃ viplutamavasādi rūkṣaṃ dravaṃ saśūlamāmagandhamīṣacchabdamaśabdaṃ vā vibaddhamūtravātamatisāryate purīṣaṃ, vāyuścāntaḥkoṣṭhe saśabdaśūlastiryak carati vibaddha ityāmātisāro vātāt|
pakvaṃ vā vibaddhamalpālpaṃ saśabdaṃ saśūlaphenapicchāparikartikaṃ hṛṣṭaromā viniḥśvasañ śuṣkamukhaḥ kaṭyūrutrikajānupṛṣṭhapārśvaśūlī bhraṣṭagudo muhurmuhurvigrathitamupaveśyate purīṣaṃ vātāt; tamāhuranugrathitamityeke, vātānugrathitavarcastvāt||
6.19.6 |  pittalasya punaramlalavaṇakaṭukakṣāroṣṇatīkṣṇātimātraniṣeviṇaḥ pratatāgnisūryasaṃtāpoṣṇamārutopahatagātrasya krodherṣyābahulasya pittaṃ prakopamāpadyate|
tat prakupitaṃ dravatvādūṣmāṇamupahatya purīṣāśayavisṛtamauṣṇyād dravatvāt saratvācca bhittvā purīṣamatisārāya prakalpate|
tasya rūpāṇi---hāridraṃ haritaṃ nīlaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ *raktapittopahitamatidurgandhamatisāryate purīṣaṃ, tṛṣṇādāhasvedamūrcchāśūlabradhnasaṃtāpapākaparīta iti pittātisāraḥ||
6.19.7 |  śleṣmalasya tu gurumadhuraśītasnigdhopasevinaḥ saṃpūrakasyācintayato divāsvapnaparasyālasasya śleṣmāprakopamāpadyate|
sa svabhāvād gurumadhuraśītasnigdhaḥ srasto 'gnimupahatya saumyasvabhāvāt purīṣāśayamupahatyopapledya purīṣamatisārāya kalpate|
tasya rūpāṇi---snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ picchilaṃ tantumadāmaṃ guru durgandhaṃ śleṣmopahitamanubaddhaśūlamalpālpamabhīkṣṇamatisāryate sapravāhikaṃ, gurūdaragudabastivaṃkṣaṇadeśaḥ kṛte 'pyakṛtasaṃjñaḥ salomaharṣaḥ sotkleśo nidrālasyaparītaḥ sadano 'nnadveṣī ceti śleṣmātisāraḥ||
6.19.8 |  atiśītasnigdharūkṣoṣṇagurukharakaṭhinaviṣamaviruddhāsātmyabhojanādabhojanāt kālātītabhojanād yatkiṃcidabhyavaharaṇāt praduṣṭamadyapānīyapānādatimadyapānādasaṃśodhanāt pratikarmaṇāṃ viṣamagamanādanupacārājjvalanādityapavanasalilātisevanādasvapnādatisvapnādvegavidhārāṇādṛtuviparyayādayathābalamārambhādbhayaśokacittodvegātiyogāt kṛmiśoṣajvarārśovikārātikarṣaṇādvā vyāpannāgnestrayo doṣāḥ prakupitā bhūya evāgnimupahatya pakvāśayamanupraviśyātīsāraṃ sarvadoṣaliṅgaṃ janayanti||
6.19.9 |  api ca śoṇitādīn *dhātūnatiprakṛṣṭaṃ dūṣayanto dhātudoṣasvabhāvakṛtānatīsāravarṇānupadarśayanti|
tatra śoṇitādiṣu dhātuṣvatipraduṣṭeṣu hāridraharitanīlamāñjiṣṭhamāṃsadhāvanasannikāśaṃ raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ varāhabhedaḥsadṛśamanubaddhavedanamavedanaṃ vā samāsavyatyāsādupaveśyate śakṛd grathitamāmaṃ sakṛt, sakṛdapi pakvamanatikṣīṇamāṃsaśoṇitabalo mandāgnirvihatamukharasaśca; tādṛśamāturaṃ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ vidyāt|
ebhirvarṇairatisāryamāṇaṃ sopadravamāturamasādhyo 'yamiti pratyācakṣīta; tadyathā---pakvaṃśoṇitābhaṃ yakṛtkhaṇḍopamaṃ medomāṃsodakasannikāśaṃ dadhighṛtamajjatailavasākṣīravesavārābhamatinīlamatiraktamatikṛṣṇamudakamivācchaṃ punarmecakābhamatisnigdhaṃ haritanīlakaṣāyavarṇaṃ karburamāvilaṃ picchilaṃ tantumadāmaṃ candrakopagatamatikuṇapapūtipūyagandhyāmāmamatsyagandhi *makṣikākāntaṃ kuthitabahudhātusrāvamalpapurīṣamapurīṣaṃ vā 'tisāryamāṇaṃ tṛṣṇādāhajvarabhramatamakahikkāśvāsānubandhamativedanamavedanaṃ vava srastapakvagudaṃ paritagudavaliṃ muktanālamatikṣīṇabalamāṃsaśoṇitaṃ sarvaparvāsthiśūlinamarocakāratipralāpasaṃmohaparītaṃ sahasoparatavikāramatisāriṇamacikitsyaṃ vidyāt; iti sannipātātisāraḥ||
6.19.10 |  tamasādhyatāmasaṃprāptaṃ cikitsed yathāpradhānopakrameṇa hetūpaśayadoṣaviśeṣaparīkṣayā ceti||
6.19.11 |  āgantū dvāvatīsārau mānasau bhayaśokajau|
tattayorlakṣaṇaṃ vāyoryadatīsāralakṣaṇam||
6.19.12 |  māruto bhayaśokābhyāṃ śīghraṃ hi parikupyati|
tayoḥ kriyā vātaharī harṣaṇāśvāsanāni ca||
6.19.13 |  ityuktāḥ ṣaḍatīsārāḥ, sādhyānāṃ sādhanaṃ tvataḥ|
pravakṣyāmyanupūrveṇa yathāvattannibodhata||
6.19.14 |  doṣāḥ sannicitā yasya vidagdhāhāramūrcchitāḥ|
atīsārāya kalpante bhūyastān saṃpravartayet||
6.19.15 |  na tu saṃgrahaṇaṃ deyaṃ pūrvamāmātisāriṇe|
vibadhyamānāḥ prāgdoṣā janayantyāmayān bahūn||
6.19.16 |  daṇḍakālasakādhmānagrahaṇyarśogadāṃstathā|
śothapāṇḍvāmayaplīhakuṣṭhagulmodarajvarān||
6.19.17 |  tasmādupekṣetotkliṣṭān vartamānān svayaṃ malān|
kṛchraṃ vā vahatāṃ dadyādabhayāṃ saṃpravartinīm||
6.19.18 |  tayā pravāhite doṣe praśāmyatyudarāmayaḥ|
jāyate dehalaghutā jaṭharāgniśca vardhate||
6.19.19 |  pramathyāṃ madhyadoṣāṇāṃ dadyāddīpanapācanīm|
laṅghanaṃ cālpadoṣāṇāṃ praśastamatisāriṇām||
6.19.20 |  pippalī nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ bhūtīkamabhayā vacā|
hrīveraṃ bhadramustāni bilvaṃ nāgaradhānyakam||
6.19.21 |  pṛśniparṇī śvadaṃṣṭrā ca samaṅgā kaṇṭakārikā|
tisraḥ pramathyā vihitāḥ ślokārdhairatisāriṇām||
6.19.22 |  vacāprativiṣābhyāṃ vā mustaparpaṭakena vā|
hrīveraśṛṅgaverābhyāaṃ pakvaṃ vā pāyayejjalam||
6.19.23 |  yukte 'nnakāle kṣutkṣāmaṃ laghūnyannāni bhojayet|
tathā sa śīghramāpnoti rucimagnibalaṃ balam||
6.19.24 |  takreṇāvantisomena yavāgvā tarpaṇena vā|
surayā madhunā cādau yathāsātmyamupācaret||
6.19.25 |  yavāgūbhirvilepībhiḥ khaḍairyūṣai rasaudanaiḥ|
dīpanagrāhisaṃyuktaiḥ kramaśca syādataḥ param||
6.19.26 |  śālaparṇīṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām|
balāṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ bilvāni pāṭhāṃ nāgaradhānyakam||
6.19.27 |  śaṭīṃ palāśaṃ hapuṣāṃ vacāṃ jīrakapippalīm|
yavānīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ citrakaṃ hastipippalīm||
6.19.28 |  vṛkṣāmlaṃ dāḍimāmlaṃ ca sahiṅgu biḍasaindhavam|
prayojayedannapāne vidhinā sūpakalpitam||
6.19.29 |  vātaśleṣmaharo hyeṣa gaṇo dīpanapācanaḥ|
grāhī balyo rocanaśca tasmācchasto 'tisāriṇām||
6.19.30 |  āme pariṇate yastu vibaddhamatisāryate|
saśūlapicchamalpālpaṃ bahuśaḥ sapravāhikam||
6.19.31 |  yūṣeṇa mūlakānāṃ taṃ badarāṇāmathāpi vā|
upodikāyāḥ kṣīriṇyā yavānyā vāstukasya vā||
6.19.32 |  suvarcalāyāścañcorvā śākenāvalgujasya vā|
śaṭyāḥ karkārukāṇāṃ vā jīvantyāścirbhaṭasya vā||
6.19.33 |  loṇikāyāḥ sapāṭhāyāḥ śuṣkaśākena vā punaḥ|
dadhidāḍimasiddhena bahusnehena bhojayet||
6.19.34 |  kalkaḥ syādbālabilvānāṃ tilakalkaśca tatsamaḥ|
dadhnaḥ saro 'mlasnehādyaḥ khaḍo hanyāt pravāhikām||
6.19.35 |  yavānāṃ mudgamāṣāṇāṃ śālīnāṃ ca tilasya ca|
kolānāṃ bālabilvānāṃ dhānyayūṣaṃ prakalpayet||
6.19.36 |  aikadhyaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ dadhidāḍimasārikam|
varcaḥkṣaye śuṣkamukhaṃ śālyannaṃ tena bhojayet||
6.19.37 |  dadhnaḥ saraṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ saguḍanāgaram|
surāṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭāṃ vyañjanārthe pradāpayet||
6.19.38 |  phalāmlaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ yūṣaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā|
lopākarasamamlaṃ vā snigdhāmlaṃ kacchapasya vā||
6.19.39 |  barhitittiridakṣāṇāṃ vartakānāṃ tathā rasāḥ|
snigdhāmlāḥ śālayaścāgryā varcaḥkṣayarujāpahāḥ||
6.19.40 |  antarādhirasaṃ pūtvā raktaṃ meṣasya cobhayam|
paceddāḍimasārāmlaṃ sadhānyasnehanāgaram||
6.19.41 |  *audanaṃ raktaśālīnāṃ tenādyāt prapibecca tat|
tathā varcaḥkṣayakṛtairvyādhibhirvipramucyate||
6.19.42 |  gudaniḥsaraṇe śūle pānamamlasya sarpiṣaḥ|
praśasyate nirāmāṇāmathavā 'pyanuvāsanam||
6.19.43 |  cāṅgerīkoladadhyamlanāgarakṣārasaṃyutam|
ghṛtamutkvathitaṃ peyaṃ gudabhraṃśarujāpaham||
iti cāṅgerīghṛtam|
6.19.44 |  sacavyapippalīmūlaṃ savyoṣaviḍadāḍimam|
peyamamlaṃ ghṛtaṃ yuktyā sadhānyājājicitrakam||
iti gudabhraṃśe cavyādighṛtam|
6.19.45 |  daśamūlopasiddhaṃ vā sabilvamanuvāsanam|
śaṭīśatāhvābilvairvā vacayā citrakeṇa vā||
iti gudabhraṃśe 'nuvāsanam|
6.19.46 |  stabdhabhraṣṭagude pūrvaṃ snehasvedau prayojayet|
susvinnaṃ taṃ bhṛdūbhūtaṃ picunā saṃpraveśayet||
6.19.47 |  vibaddhavātavarcāstu bahuśūlapravāhikaḥ|
saraktapicchastṛṣṇārtaḥ kṣīrasauhityamarhati||
6.19.48 |  yamakasyopari kṣīraṃ dhāroṣṇaṃ vā pibennaraḥ|
śṛtameraṇḍamūlena bālabilvena vā *payaḥ||
6.19.49 |  evaṃ kṣīraprayogeṇa raktaṃ picchā ca śāmyati|
śūlaṃ pravāhikā caiva vibandhaścopaśāmyati||
6.19.50 |  pittātisāraṃ punarnidānopaśayākṛtibhirāmānvayamupalabhya yathābalaṃ laṅghanapācanābhyāmupācaret|
tṛṣyatastu mustaparpaṭakośīrasārivācandanakirātatiktakodīcyavāribhirupacāraḥ|
laṅghitasya cāhārakāle balātibalāsūrpaparṇīśālaparṇīpṛśniparṇībṛhatīkaṇṭakārikāśatāvarīśvadaṃṣṭrāniryūhasaṃyuktena yathāsātmyaṃ yavāgūmaṇḍādinā tarpaṇādinā vā krameṇopacāraḥ|
mudgamasūrahareṇumakuṣṭhakāḍhakīyūṣairvā lavakapiñjalaśaśahariṇaiṇakālapucchakarasairīṣadamlairanamlairvā kramaśo 'gniṃ sandhukṣayet|
anubandhe tvasya dīpanīyapācanīyopaśamanīyasaṃgrahaṇīyān yogān saṃprayojayediti||
6.19.51 |  sakṣaudrātiviṣaṃ piṣṭvā vatsakasya phalatvacam|
pibet pittātisāraghnaṃ taṇḍulodakasaṃyutam||
6.19.52 |  kirātatiktako mustaṃ vatsakaḥ sarasāñjanaḥ|
bilvaṃ dāruharidrā tvak hrīberaṃ sadurālabham||
6.19.53 |  candanaṃ ca bhṛṇālaṃ ca nāgaraṃ lodhramutpalam|
tilā mocaraso lodhraṃ samaṅgā kamalotpalam||
6.19.54 |  utpalaṃ dhātakīpuṣpaṃ dāḍimatvaṅgahauṣadham|
kaṭphalaṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhā jambvāmrāsthidurālabhāḥ||
6.19.55 |  yogāḥ ṣaḍete sakṣaudrāstaṇḍulodakasaṃyutāḥ|
peyāḥ pittātisāraghnāḥ ślokārdhena nidarśitāḥ||
6.19.56 |  jīeṇoṣadhānāṃ śasyante yathāyogaṃ prakalpitaiḥ|
rasaiḥ sāṃgrāhikairyuktāḥ purāṇā raktaśālayaḥ||
6.19.57 |  pittātisāro dīpāgneḥ kṣipraṃ samupaśāmyati|
ajākṣīraprayogeṇa balaṃ varṇaśca vardhate||
6.19.58 |  bahudoṣasya dīptāgneḥ saprāṇasya na tiṣṭhati|
aittiko yadyatīsāraḥ payasā taṃ virecayet||
6.19.59 |  palāśaphalaniryūhaṃ payasā saha pāyayet|
tato 'nupāyayet koṣṇaṃ kṣīrameva yathābalam||
6.19.60 |  pravāhite tena male praśāmyatyudarāmayaḥ|
palāśavat prayojyā vā trāyamāṇā viśodhinī||
6.19.61 |  sāṃsargyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ śūlaṃ yadyanuvartate|
srutadoṣasya taṃ śīghraṃ yathāvadanuvāsayet||
6.19.62 |  śatapuṣpāvarībhyāṃ ca payasā madhukena ca|
tailapādaṃ ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ sabilvamanuvāsanam||
6.19.63 |  kṛtānuvāsanasyāsya kṛtasaṃsarjanasya ca|
vartate yadyatīsāraḥ picchābastirataḥ param||
6.19.64 |  pariveṣṭya kuśairārdrairārdravṛntāni śālmaleḥ|
kṛṣṇamṛttikayā++ālipya svedayedgomayāgninā||
6.19.65 |  suśuṣkāṃ mṛttikāṃ jñātvā tāni vṛntāni śālmaleḥ|
śṛte payasi mṛdgīyādāpothyolūkhale tataḥ||
6.19.66 |  piṇḍaṃ muṣṭisamaṃ prasthe tat pūtaṃ tailasarpiṣoḥ|
*snehitaṃ mātrayā yuktaṃ kalkena madhukasya ca||
6.19.67 |  bastimabhyaktagātrāya dadyāt pratyāgate tataḥ|
snātvā bhuñjīta payasā jāṅgalānāṃ rasena vā||
6.19.68 |  pittāpisārajvaraśothagulmajīrṇātisāragrahaṇīpradoṣān|
jayatyayaṃ śīghramatipravṛddhān virecanāsthāpanayośca *bastiḥ||
6.19.69 |  pittātisārī yastvetāṃ kriyāṃ muktvā niṣevate|
pittalānyannapānāni tasya pittaṃ mahābalam||
6.19.70 |  kuryādraktātisāraṃ tu raktamāśu pradūṣayet|
tṛṣṇāṃ śūlaṃ vidāhaṃ ca gudapākaṃ ca dāruṇam||
6.19.71 |  tatra cchāgaṃ payaḥ śastaṃ śītaṃ samadhuśarkaram|
pānārthaṃ bhojanārthaṃ ca gudaprakṣālane tathā||
6.19.72 |  audanaṃ raktaśālīnāṃ payasā tena bhojayet|
rasaiḥ pārāvatādīnāṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaiḥ saśarkaraiḥ||
6.19.73 |  śaśapakṣimṛgāṇāṃ ca śītānāṃ dhanvacāriṇām|
rasairanamlaiḥ saghṛtairbhojayettaṃ saśarkaraiḥ||
6.19.74 |  rudhiraṃ mārgamājaṃ vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ praśasyate|
kāśmaryaphalayūṣo vā kiṃcidamlaḥ saśarkaraḥ||
6.19.75 |  nīlotpalaṃ mocarasaṃ samaṅgā padmakeśaram|
ajākṣīrayutaṃ dadyājjīrṇe ca payasaudanam||
6.19.76 |  durbalaṃ pāyayitvā vā tasyaivopari bhojayet|
prāgbhaktaṃ navanītaṃ vā dadyāt samadhuśarkaram||
6.19.77 |  prāśya kṣīrotthitaṃ sarpiḥ kapiñjalarasāśanaḥ|
tryahādārogyamāpnoti payasā kṣīrabhuk tathā||
6.19.78 |  pītvā śatāvarīkalkaṃ payasā kṣīrabhugjayet|
raktātisāraṃ pītvā vā tayā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ naraḥ||
6.19.79 |  ghṛtaṃ yavāgūmaṇḍena kuṭajasya phalaiḥ śṛtam|
peyaṃ tasyānu pātavyā peyā raktopaśāntaye||
6.19.80 |  tvak ca dāruharidrāyāḥ kuṭajasya phalāni ca|
pippalī śṛṅgaveraṃ ca drākṣā kaṭukarohiṇī||
6.19.81 |  ṣaḍbhiretairghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ peyāmaṇḍāvacāritam|
atīsāraṃ jayecchīghraṃ tridoṣamapi dāruṇam||
6.19.82 |  kṛṣṇamṛnmadhukaṃ śaṅkhaṃ rudhiraṃ taṇḍulodakam|
pītamekatra sakṣaudraṃ raktasaṃgrahaṇaṃ param||
6.19.83 |  pītaḥ priyaṅgukākalkaḥ sakṣaudrastaṇḍulāmbhasā|
raktasrāvaṃ jayecchīghraṃ dhanvamāṃsarasāśinaḥ||
6.19.84 |  kalkastilānāṃ kṛṣṇānāṃ śarkarāpañcabhāgikaḥ|
ājena payasā pītaḥ sadyo raktaṃ niyacchati||
6.19.85 |  palaṃ vatsakabījasya śrapayitvā rasaṃ pibet|
yo rasāśī jayecchīghraṃ sa paittaṃ jaṭharāmayam||
6.19.86 |  pītvā saśarkarākṣaudraṃ candanaṃ taṇḍulāmbhasā|
dāhatṛṣṇāpramehebhyo raktasrāvācca mucyate||
6.19.87 |  godo bahubhirutthānairyasya pittena pacyate|
secayettaṃ suśītena paṭolamadhukāmbunā||
6.19.88 |  pañcavalkamadhūkānāṃ rasairikṣurasairghṛtaiḥ|
chāgairgavyaiḥ payobhirvā śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyutaiḥ||
6.19.89 |  prakṣālanānāṃ kalkairvā sasarpiṣkaiḥ pralepayet|
eṣāṃ vā sukṛtaiścūrṇaistaṃ gudaṃ pratisārayet||
6.19.90 |  dhātakīlodhracūrṇairvā samāṃśaiḥ pratisārayet|
tathā sravati no raktaṃ gudaṃ taiḥ pratisāritam||
6.19.91 |  pakvatā praśamaṃ yāti vedanā copaśāmyati|
yathoktaiḥ secanaiḥ śītaiḥ śoṇite 'tisravatyapi||
6.19.92 |  gudavaṅkṣaṇakaṭyūru secayedghṛtabhāvitam|
candanādyena tailena śatadhautena sarpiṣā||
6.19.93 |  kārpāsasaṃgṛhītena secayedgudavaṅkṣaṇam|
alpālpaṃ bahuśo raktaṃ saśūlamupaveśyate||
6.19.94 |  yadā vāyurvibaddhaśca kṛcchraṃ carati vā na vā|
picchābastiṃ tadā tasya yathoktamupakalpayet||
6.19.95 |  prapaiṇḍarīkasiddhena sarpiṣā cānuvāsayet|
prāyaśo durbalagudāścirakālātisāriṇaḥ||
6.19.96 |  tasmādabhīkṣṇaśasteṣāṃ gude snehaṃ prayojayet|
pavano 'tipravṛtto hi sve sthāne labhate 'dhikam||
6.19.97 |  balaṃ tasya sapittasya jayārthe bastiruttamaḥ|
raktaṃ viṭasahitaṃ pūrvaṃ paścādvā yo 'tisāryate||
6.19.98 |  śatāvarīghṛtaṃ tasya lehārthamupakalpayet|
śarkarārdhāṃśikaṃ līḍhaṃ navanītaṃ navoddhṛtam||
6.19.99 |  kṣaudrapādaṃ jayecchīgraṃ taṃ vikāraṃ hitāśinaḥ|
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaśuṅgānāpothya vāsayet||
6.19.100 |  ahorātraṃ jale tapte ghṛtaṃ tenāmbhasā pacet|
tadardhaśarkarāyuktaṃ lihyāt sakṣaudrapādikam||
6.19.101 |  adho vā yadi vā 'pyūrdhvaṃ yasya raktaṃ pravartate|
yastvevaṃ durbalo mohāt pittalānyeva sevate||
6.19.102 |  dāruṇaṃ sa valīpākaṃ prāpya śīghraṃ vipadyate|
śleṣmātisāre prathamaṃ hitaṃ laṅghanapācanam||
6.19.103 |  yojyaścāmātisāraghno yathokto dīpano gaṇaḥ|
laṅghitasyānupūrvyāṃ ca kṛtāyāṃ na nivartate||
6.19.104 |  kaphajo yadyatīsāraḥ kaphaghnaistamupācaret|
bilvaṃ karkaṭikā mustamabhayā viśvabheṣajam||
6.19.105 |  vacā viḍaṅgaṃ bhūtīkaṃ dhānyakaṃ devadāru ca|
kuṣṭhaṃ sātiviṣā pāṭhā cavyaṃ kaṭukarohiṇī||
6.19.106 |  pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ citrakaṃ hastipippalī|
yogāñchlokārdhavihitāṃścaturastān prayojayet||
6.19.107 |  śṛtāñchleṣmātisāreṣu kāyāgnibalavardhanān|
ajājīmasitāṃ pāṭhāṃ nāgaraṃ maricāni ca||
6.19.108 |  dhātakīdviguṇaṃ dadyānmātuluṅgarasāplutam|
rasāñjanaṃ sātiviṣaṃ kuṭajasya phalāni ca||
6.19.109 |  dhātakīdviguṇaṃ dadyāt pātuṃ sakṣaudranāgaram|
dhātakī nāgaraṃ bilvaṃ lodhraṃ padmasya keśaram||
6.19.110 |  jambūtvaṅnāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ pāṭhā mocaraso balā|
samaṅgā dhātakī bilvamadhyaṃ jambvāmrayostvacaḥ||
6.19.111 |  kapitthāni viḍaṅgāni nāgaraṃ maricāni ca|
cāṅgerīkolatakrāmlāṃścaturastān kaphottare||
6.19.112 |  ślokārdhavihitān dadyāt sasnehalavaṇāt khaḍān|
kapitthamadhyaṃ līḍhvā tu savyoṣakṣaudraśarkaram||
6.19.113 |  kaṭphalaṃ madhuyuktaṃ vā mucyate jaṭharāmayāt|
kaṇāṃ madhuyutāṃ pītvā takraṃ pītvā sacitrakam||
6.19.114 |  jagdhvā vā bālabilvāni mucyate jaṭharāmayāt|
bālabilvaṃ guḍaṃ tailaṃ pippalīṃ viśvabheṣajam|
lihyādvāte pratihate saśūlaḥ sapravāhikaḥ||
6.19.115 |  bhojyaṃ mūlakaṣāyeṇa vātaghnaiścopasevanaiḥ|
vātātisāravihitairyūṣairmāṃsarasaiḥ khaḍaiḥ||
6.19.116 |  pūrvoktamamlasarpirvā ṣaṭpalaṃ vā yathābalam|
purāṇaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ dadyādyavāgūmaṇḍamiśritam||
6.19.117 |  vātaśleṣmavibandhe vā kaphe vā 'tisravatyapi|
śūle pravāhikāyāṃ vā picchābastiṃ prayojayet||
6.19.118 |  pippalībilvakuṣṭhānāṃ śatāgvāvacayorapi|
kalkaiḥ salavaṇairyuktaṃ pūrvoktaṃ sannidhāpayet||
6.19.119 |  pratyāgate sukhaṃ snātaṃ kṛtāhāraṃ dinātyaye|
bilvatailena matimānsukhoṣṇenānuvāsayet||
6.19.120 |  vacāntairathavā kalkaistailaṃ paktvā 'nuvāsayet|
bahuśaḥ kaphavātārtastathā sa labhate sukham||
6.19.121 |  sve sthāne māruto 'vaśyaṃ vardhate kaphasaṃkṣaye|
sa vṛddhaḥ sahasā hanyāttasmāttaṃ tvarayā jayet||
6.19.122 |  vātasyānu jayet pittaṃ, pittasyānu jayet kapham|
trayāṇāṃ vā jayet pūrvaṃ yo bhavedbalavattamaḥ||
6.19.123 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
prāgutpattinimittāni lakṣaṇaṃ sādhyatā na ca|
kriyā cāvasthikī siddhā nirdiṣṭā hyatisāriṇām||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne 'tisāracikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||19 | |

viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.20.1 |  athātaśchardicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.20.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.20.3 |  yaśasvinaṃ brahmatapodyutibhyāṃ jvalantamagnyarkasamaprabhāvam|
punarvasuṃ bhūtahite niviṣṭaṃ papraccha śiṣyo 'trijamagniveśaḥ||
6.20.4 |  yāśchardayaḥ pañca purā tvayoktā rogādhikāre bhiṣajāṃ variṣṭha!|
tāsāṃ cikitsāṃ sanidānaliṅgāṃ yathāvadācakṣva nṛṇāṃ hitārtham||
6.20.5 |  tadagniveśasya vaco niśamya prīto bhiṣakśreṣṭha idaṃ jagāda|
yāśchardayaḥ pañca purā mayoktāstā vistareṇa bruvato nibadha||
6.20.6 |  doṣaiḥ *pṛthaktriprabhavāścatasro dviṣṭārthayogādapi pañcamī syāt|
tāsāṃ hṛdutkleśakaphaprasekau dveṣo 'śane caiva hi pūrvarūpam||
6.20.7 |  vyāyāmatīkṣṇauṣadhaśokarogabhayopavāsādyatikarśitasya|
*vāyurmahāsrotasi saṃpravṛddha utkleśya doṣāṃstata ūrdhvamasyan||
6.20.8 |  āmāśayotkleśakṛtāṃ ca marma prapīḍayaṃśchardimudīrayettu|
hṛtpārśvapīḍāmukhaśoṣamūrdhanābhyartikāsasvarabhedatodaiḥ||
6.20.9 |  udgāraśabdaprabalaṃ saphenaṃ vicchinnakṛṣṇaṃ tanukaṃ kaṣāyam|
kṛcchreṇa cālpaṃ mahatā ca vegenārto 'nilācchardayatīha duḥkham||
6.20.10 |  ajīrṇakaṭvamlavidāhyaśītairāmāśaye pittamudīrṇavegam|
rasāyanībhirvisṛtaṃ prapīḍya marmordhvamāgamya vamiṃ karoti||
6.20.11 |  mūrcchāpipāsāmukhaśoṣamūrdhatālvakṣisaṃtāpatamobhramārtaḥ|
pītaṃ bhṛśoṣṇaṃ haritaṃ satiktaṃ dhūmraṃ ca pittena vamet sadāham||
6.20.12 |  snigdhātigurvāmavidāhibhojyaiḥ svapnādibhiścaiva kapho 'tivṛddhaḥ|
uraḥ śiro marma rasāyanīśca sarvāḥ samāvṛtya vamiṃ karoti||
6.20.13 |  tandrāsyamādhuryakaphaprasekasaṃtoṣanidrārucigauravārtaḥ|
snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ svādu kaphādviśuddhaṃ salomaharṣo 'lparujaṃ vamettu||
6.20.14 |  samaśnataḥ sarvarasān prasaktamāmapradoṣartuviparyayaiśca|
sarve prakopaṃ yugapat prapannāśchardiṃ tridoṣāṃ janayanti doṣāḥ||
6.20.15 |  śūlāvipākārucidāhatṛṣṇāśvāsapramohaprabalā prasaktam|
chardistridoṣāllavaṇāmlanīlasāndroṣṇaraktaṃ vamatāṃ nṛṇāṃ syāt||
6.20.16 |  viṭsvedamūtrāmbuvahāni vāyuḥ srotāṃsi saṃrudhya yadordhvameti|
utsannadoṣasya samācitaṃ taṃ doṣaṃ samuddhūya narasya koṣṭhāt||
6.20.17 |  viṇmūtrayostat samavarṇagandhaṃ tṛṭśvāsahikkārtiyutaṃ prasaktam|
pracchardayedduṣṭamihātivegāttayā 'rditaścāśu vināśameti||
6.20.18 |  dviṣṭapratīpāśucipūtyamedhyabībhatsagandhāśanadarśanaiśca|
yacchardayettaptamanā manoghnairdviṣṭārthasaṃyogabhavā matā sā||
6.20.19 |  kṣīṇasya yā chardiratipravṛddhā sopadravā śoṇitapūyayuktā|
sacandridāṃ tāṃ pravadantyasādhyāṃ sādhyāṃ cikitsedanupadravāṃ ca||
6.20.20 |  āmāśayotkleśabhavā hi sarvāśchardyo matā laṅghanameva tasmāt|
prākkārayenmārutajāṃ vimucya saṃśodhanaṃ vā kaphapittahāri||
6.20.21 |  cūrṇāni ligyānmadhunā 'bhayānāṃ hṛdyāni vā yāni virecanāni|
madyaiḥ payobhiśca yutāni yuktyā nayantyadho doṣamudīrṇamūrdhvam||
6.20.22 |  vallīphalādyairvamanaṃ pibedvā yo durbalastaṃ śamanaiścikitset|
rasairmanojñairlaghubhirviśuṣkairbhakṣyaiḥ sabhojyairvividhaiśca pānaiḥ||
6.20.23 |  susaṃskṛtāstittiribarhilāvarasā vyapohantyanilapravṛttām|
chardiṃ tathā kolakulatthadhānyabilvādimūlāmlayavaiśca yūṣaḥ||
6.20.24 |  *vātātmikāyāṃ hṛdayadravārto naraḥ pibet saindhavavadghṛtaṃ tu|
siddhaṃ tathā dhānyakanāgarābhyāṃ dadhnā ca toyena ca dāḍimasya||
6.20.25 |  vyoṣeṇa yuktāṃ lavaṇaistribhiśca ghṛtasya mātrāmathavā vidadhyāt|
snigdhāni gṛdyāni ca bhojanāni rasaiḥ sayūṣairdadhidāḍimāmlaiḥ||
6.20.26 |  pittātmikāyāmanulomanārthaṃ drākṣāvidārīkṣurasaistrivṛt syāt|
kaphāśayasthaṃ tvatimātravṛddhaṃ pittaṃ haret svādubhirūrdhvameva||
6.20.27 |  śuddhāya kāle madhuśarkarābhyāṃ lājaiśca manthaṃ yadi vā 'pi peyām|
pradāpayenmudgarasena vā 'pi śālyodanaṃ jāṅgalajai rasairvā||
6.20.28 |  sitopalāmākṣikapippalībhiḥ kulmāṣalājāyavasaktugṛñjān|
kharjūramāṃsānyatha nārikelaṃ drākṣāmatho vā badarāṇi lihyāt||
6.20.29 |  srotojalājotpalakolamajjacūrṇāni lihyānmadhumā 'bhayāṃ ca|
kolāsthimajjāñjanamakṣikāviḍlājāsitāmāgadhikākaṇān vā||
6.20.30 |  drākṣārasaṃ vā 'pi pibet suśītaṃ mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭaprabhavaṃ jalaṃ vā|
jambvāmrayoḥ pallavajaṃ kaṣāyaṃ pibet suśītaṃ madhusaṃyutaṃ vā||
6.20.31 |  niśi sthitaṃ vāri samudgakṛṣṇaṃ sośīradhānyaṃ caṇakodakaṃ vā|
gavedhukāmūlajalaṃ guḍūcyā jalaṃ pibedikṣurasaṃ payo vā||
6.20.32 |  sevayaṃ pibet kāñcanagairikaṃ vā sabālakaṃ taṇḍuladhāvanena|
dhātrīrasenottamacandanaṃ vā tṛṣṇāvamighnāni samākṣikāṇi||
6.20.33 |  kalkaṃ tathā candanacavyamāṃsīdrākṣottamābālakagairikāṇām|
śītāmbunā gairikaśālicūrṇaṃ mūrvāṃ tathā taṇḍuladhāvanana||
6.20.34 |  kaphātmikāyāṃ vamanaṃ praśastaṃ sapippalīsarṣapanimbatoyaiḥ|
piṇḍītakaiḥ saindhavasaṃprayuktairvamyāṃ kaphāmāśayaśodhanārtham||
6.20.35 |  godhūmaśālīn sayavān purāṇān yūṣaiḥ paṭolāmṛtacitrakāṇām|
vyoṣasya nimbasya ca takrasiddhairyūṣaiḥ phalāmlaiḥ kaṭubhistathā 'dyāt||
6.20.36 |  rasāṃśca śūlyāni ca jāṅgalānāṃ māṃsāni jīrṇānmadhusīdhvariṣṭān|
rāgāṃstathā ṣāḍavapānakāni drākṣākapitthaiḥ phalapūrakaiśca||
6.20.37 |  mudgānmasūrāṃścaṇakān kalāyān bhṛṣṭān yutānnāgaramākṣikābhyām|
lihyāttathaiva triphalāviḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ *viḍaṅgaplavayoratho vā||
6.20.38 |  sajāmbavaṃ vā *badarāmlacūrṇaṃ mustāyutāṃ karkaṭakasya śṛṅgīm|
durālabhāṃ vā madhusaṃprayuktāṃ lihyāt kaphacchardivinigrahārtham||
6.20.39 |  manaḥśilāyāḥ phalapūrakasya rasaiḥ kapitthasya ca pippalīnām|
kṣaudreṇa cūrṇaṃ maricaiśca yuktaṃ lihañjayecchardimudīrṇavegām||
6.20.40 |  yaiṣā pṛthaktvena mayā kriyoktā tāṃ sannipāte 'pi *samasya buddhyā|
doṣarturogāgnibalānyavekṣya prayojayecchāstravidapramattaḥ||
6.20.41 |  manobhighāte tu manonukūlā vācaḥ samāśvāsanaharṣaṇāni|
lokaprasiddhāḥ śrutayo vayasyāḥ śṛṅgārikāścaiva hitā vihārāḥ||
6.20.42 |  gandhā vicitrā manaso 'nukūlā mṛtpuṣpaśuktāmlaphalādikānām|
śākāni bhojyānyatha pānakāni susaṃskṛtāḥ ṣāḍavarāgalehāḥ||
6.20.43 |  yūṣā rasāḥ kāmbalikā khaḍāśca māṃsāni dhānā vividhāśca bhakṣyāḥ|
phalāni mūlāni ca gandhavarṇarasairupetāni vamiṃ jayanti||
6.20.44 |  gandhaṃ rasaṃ sparśamathāpi śabdaṃ rūpaṃ ca yadyat priyamapyasātmyam|
tadeva dadyāt praśamāya tasyāstajjo hi rogaḥ sukha eva jetum||
6.20.45 |  chardyutthitānāṃ ca cikitsitāt svāccikitsitaṃ kāryamupadravāṇām|
atipravṛttāsu virecanasya karmātiyoge vihitaṃ vidheyam||
6.20.46 |  vamiprasaṅgāt pavano 'pyavaśyaṃ dhātukṣayādvṛddhimupaiti tasmāt|
cirapravṛttāsvanilāpahāni kāryāṇyupastambhavabṛṃhaṇāni||
6.20.47 |  sarpirguḍāḥ kṣīravidhirghṛtāni kalyāṇakatryūṣaṇajīvanāni|
vṛṣyāstathā māṃsarasāḥ salehāściraprasaktāṃ ca vamiṃ jayanti||
6.20.48 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
hetuṃ saṃkhyāṃ lakṣaṇamupadravān sādhyatāṃ na yogāṃśca|
chardīnāṃ praśamārthaṃ prāha cikitsitaṃ munivaryaḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne chardicikitsitaṃ nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||20 | |

ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.21.1 |  athāto visarpacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.21.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.21.3 |  kailāse kinnarākīrṇe bahuprasravaṇauṣadhe|
pādapairvividhaiḥ snigdhairnityaṃ kusumasaṃpadā||
6.21.4 |  vamadbhirmadhurān gandhān sarvataḥ svabhyalaṅkṛte|
viharantaṃ jitātmānamātreyamṛṣivanditam||
6.21.5 |  maharṣibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ sarvabhūtahite rasam|
agniveśo guruṃ kāle vinayādidamuktavān||
6.21.6 |  bhagavan! dāruṇaṃ rogamāśīviṣaviṣopamam|
visarpantaṃ śarīreṣu dehināmupalaksaye||
6.21.7 |  sahasaiva narāstena parītāḥ śīghrakāriṇā|
vinaśyantyanupakrāntāstatra naḥ saṃśayo mahān||
6.21.8 |  sa nāmnā kena vijñeyaḥ saṃjñitaḥ kena hetunā|
katibhedaḥ kiyaddhātuḥ kiṃnidānaḥ kimāśrayaḥ||
6.21.9 |  sukhasādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyo jñeyo yaścānupakramaḥ|
kathaṃ kairlakṣaṇaiḥ kiṃ ca bhagavan! tasya bheṣajam||
6.21.10 |  tadagniveśasya vacaḥ śrutvā++ātreyaḥ punarvasuḥ|
yathāvadakhilaṃ sarvaṃ provāca munisattamaḥ||
6.21.11 |  vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpastena sa smṛtaḥ|
parisarpo 'thavā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt||
6.21.12 |  sa ca saptavidho doṣairvijñeyaḥ saptadhātukaḥ|
pṛthak trayastribhiścaiko visarpo dvandvajāstrayaḥ||
6.21.13 |  vātikaḥ paittikaścaiva kaphajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ|
catvāra ete visarpā vakṣyante dvandvajāstrayaḥ||
6.21.14 |  āgneyo vātapittābhyāṃ granthyākhyaḥ kaphavātajaḥ|
yastu kardamako ghoraḥ sa pittakaphasaṃbhavaḥ||
6.21.15 |  raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅnāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ|
visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ||
6.21.16 |  lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇānāṃ rasānāmatisevanāt|
dadhyamlamastuśuktānāṃ surāsauvīrakasya ca||
6.21.17 |  vyāpannabahumadyoṣṇarāgaṣāḍavasevanāt|
śākānāṃ haritānāṃ ca sevanācca vidāhinām||
6.21.18 |  kūrcikānāṃ kilāṭānāṃ sevanānmandakasya ca|
dadhnaḥ śāṇḍākipūrvāṇāmāsutānāṃ ca sevanāt||
6.21.19 |  tilamāṣakulatthānāṃ tailānāṃ paiṣṭikasya ca|
grāmyānūpaudakānāṃ ca māṃsānāṃ laśunasya ca||
6.21.20 |  praklinnānāmasātmyānāṃ viruddhānāṃ ca sevanāt|
atyādānāddivāsvapnādajīrṇādhyaśanāt kṣatāt||
6.21.21 |  *kṣatabandhaprapatanāddharmakarmātisevanāt|
viṣavātāgnidoṣācca visarpāṇāṃ samudbhavaḥ||
6.21.22 |  etairnidānairvyāmiśraiḥ kupitā mārutādayaḥ|
dūṣyān saṃdūṣya raktādīn visarpantyahitāśinām||
6.21.23 |  bahiḥśritaḥ śritaścāntastathā cobhayasaṃśritaḥ|
visarpo balameteṣāṃ jñeyaṃ guru yathottaram||
6.21.24 |  bahirmārgāśritaṃ sādhyamasādhyamubhayāśritam|
visarpaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt sukṛcchraṃ tvantarāśrayam||
6.21.25 |  antaḥprakupitā doṣā visarpantyantarāśraye|
bahirbahiḥprakupitāḥ sarvatrobhayasaṃśritāḥ||
6.21.26 |  marmopaghātāt saṃmohādayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt|
tūṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamāṇāṃ pravartanāt||
6.21.27 |  vidyādvisarpamantarjamāśu cāgnibalakṣayāt|
ato viparyayādbāhyamanyairvidyāt svalakṣaṇaiḥ||
6.21.28 |  yasya sarvāṇi liṅgāni balavadyasya kāraṇam|
yasya copadravāḥ kaṣṭā marmago yaśca hanti saḥ||
6.21.29 |  rūkṣoṣṇaiḥ kevalo vāyuḥ pūraṇairvā samāvṛtaḥ|
praduṣṭo dūṣayan dūṣyān visarpati yathābalam||
6.21.30 |  tasya rūpāṇi---bhramadavathupipāsānistodaśūlāṅgamardodveṣṭanakampajvaratamakakāsāsthisaṃdhibhedaviśleṣaṇavepanārocakāvipākāścakṣuṣorākulatvamasrāgamanaṃ pipīlikāsaṃcāra iva cāṅgeṣu, yasmiṃścāvakāśe visarpo *visarpati so 'vakāśaḥ śyāvāruṇābhāsaḥ śvayathumān nistodabhedaśūlāyāmasaṃkocaharṣasphuraṇairatimātraṃ prapīḍyate, anupakrāntaścopacīyate śīghrabhedaiḥ sphoṭakaistanubhiraruṇābhaiḥ śyāvairvā tanuviśadāruṇālpāsrāvaiḥ, vibaddhavātamūtrapurīṣaśca bhavati, nidānoktāni cāsya nopaśerate viparītāni copaśerata iti vātavisarpaḥ||
6.21.31 |  pittamuṣṇopacāreṇa vidāhyamlāśanaiścitam|
dūṣyān saṃdūṣya *dhamanīḥ pūrayan vai visarpati||
6.21.32 |  tasya rūpāṇi---jvarastṛṣṇā mūrcchā mohaśchardirarocako 'ṅgabhedaḥ svedo 'timātramantardāhaḥ pralāpaḥ śiroruk cakṣuṣorākulatvamasvapnamaratirbhramaḥ śītavātavāritarṣo 'timātraṃ haritahāridranetramūtravarcastvaṃ haritahāridrarūpadarśanaṃ ca, yasmiṃścāvakāśe visarpo 'nusarpati so 'vakāśastāmraharitahāridranīlakṛṣṇaraktānāṃ varṇānāmanyatamaṃ puṣyati, sotsedhaiścātimātraṃ dāhasaṃbhedanaparītaiḥ sphoṭakairupacīyate tulyavarṇāsrāvaiścirapākaiśca, nidānoktāni cāsya nopaśerate viparītāni copaśerati iti pittavisarpaḥ||
6.21.33 |  svādvamlalavaṇasnigdhagurvannasvapnasaṃcitaḥ|
kaphaḥ saṃdūṣayan dūṣyān kṛcchramaṅge visarpati||
6.21.34 |  tasya rūpāṇi---śītakaḥ śītajvaro gauravaṃ nidrā tandrā 'rocako madhurāsyatvamāsyopalepo niṣṭhīvikā chardirālasyaṃ staimityamagnināśo daurbalyaṃ ca, yasmiṃścāvakāśe visarpo 'nusarpati so 'vakāśaḥ śvayathumān pāṇḍurnātiraktaḥ snehasuptistambhagauravairanvito 'lpavedanaḥ kṛcchrapākaiścirakāribhirbahulatvagupalepaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ śvetapāṇḍubhiranubadhyate, prabhinnastu śvetaṃ picchilaṃ tantumadghanamanubaddhaṃ snigdhamāsrāvaṃ sravati, ūrdhvaṃ ca gurubhiḥ sthirairjālāvatataiḥ snigdhairbahulatvagupalepairvraṇairanubadhyate 'nuṣaṅgī ca bhavati, śvetanakhanayanavadanatvaṅmūtravarcastvaṃ, nidānoktāni cāsya nopaśerate viparītāni copaśerata iti śleṣmavisarpaḥ||
6.21.35 |  vātapittaṃ prakupitamatimātraṃ svahetubhiḥ|
parasparaṃ labdhabalaṃ dahadgātraṃ visarpati||
6.21.36 |  tadupatāpādāturaḥ sarvaśarīramaṅgārairivākīryamāṇaṃ manyate, chardyatīsāramūrcchādāhamohajvaratamakārocakāsthisaṃdhibhedatṛṣṇāvipākāṅgabhedādibhiścābhibhūyate, yaṃ yaṃ cāvakāśaṃ visarpo 'nusarpati so 'vakāśaḥ śāntāṅgāraprakāśo 'tirakto vā bhavati, agnidagdhaprakāraiśca sphoṭairupacīyate, sa śīghragatvādāśveva marmānusārī bhavati, marmaṇi copatapte pavano 'tibalo bhinattyaṅgānyatimātraṃ pramohayati saṃjñāṃ, hikkāśvāsau janayati, nāśayati nidrāṃ, sa naṣṭanidraḥ pramūḍhasaṃjño vyathitacetā na kvacana sukhamupalabhate, aratiparītaḥ sthānādāsanācchayyāṃ krāntumicchati, kliṣṭabhūyiṣṭaścāśu nidrāṃ bhajati, durbalo duḥkhaprabodhaśca bhavati; tamevaṃvidhamagnivisarpaparītamacikitsyaṃ vidyāt||
6.21.37 |  kaphapittaṃ prakupittaṃ balavat svena hetunā|
visarpatyekadeśe tu prakledayati dehinam||
6.21.38 |  tadvikārāḥ---śītajvaraḥ śirogurutvaṃ dāhaḥ staimityamaṅgāvasadanaṃ nidrā tandrā moho 'nnadveṣaḥ pralāpo 'gnināśo daurbalyamasthibhedo mūrcchā pipāsā srotasāṃ pralepo jāḍyamindriyāṇāṃ prāyopaveśanamaṅgavikṣepo 'ṅgamardo 'ratirautsukyaṃ copajāyate, prāyaścāmāśaye visarpatyalasaka ekadeśagrāhī ca, yasmiṃścāvakāśe visarpo visarpati so 'vakāśo raktapītapāṇḍupiḍakāvakīrṇa iva mecakābhaḥ kālo malinaḥ snidho bahūṣmā guruḥ stimitavedanaḥ śvayathumān gambhīrapāko nirāsrāvaḥ śīghrakledaḥ svinnaklinnapūtimāṃsatvak keameṇālparuk parāmṛṣṭo 'vadīryate kardama ivāvapīḍito 'ntaraṃ prayacchatyupaklinnapūtimāṃsatyāgī sirāsnāyusaṃdarśī kuṇapagandhī ca bhavati saṃjñāsmṛtihantā ca; taṃ kardamavisarpaparītamacikitsyaṃ vidyāt||
6.21.39 |  sthiragurukaṭhinamadhuraśītasnigdhānnapānābhiṣyandisevināmavyāyāmādisevināmapratikarmaśīlānāṃ śleṣmā vāyuśca prakopamāpadyate, tāvubhau duṣṭapravṛddhāvatibalau pradūṣya dūṣyān visarpāya kalpete; tatra vāyuḥ śleṣmaṇā vibaddhamārgastameva śleṣmāṇamanekadhā bhindan krameṇa granthimālāṃ kṛcchrapākasādhyāṃ kaphāśaye saṃjanayati, utsannaraktasya vā pradūṣya raktaṃ sirāsnāyumāṃsatvagāśritaṃ granthīnāṃ mālāṃ kurute tīvrarujānāṃ sthūlānāmaṇūnāṃ vā dīrghavṛttaraktānāṃ, tadupatāpājjvarātisārakāsahikkāśvāsaśoṣapramohavaivarṇyārocakāvipākaprasekacchardirmūrcchaṅgabhaṅganidrāratisadanādyāḥ prādurbhavantyupadravāḥ; sa etairupadrutaḥ sarvakarmaṇāṃ viṣayamatipatito vivarjanīyo bhavatīti granthivisarpaḥ||
6.21.40 |  upadravastu khalu rogottarakālajo rogāśrayo roga eva sthūlo 'ṇurvā, rogāt paścājjāyata ityupadravasaṃjñaḥ|
tatra pradhāno vyādhiḥ, *vyādherguṇabhūta upadravaḥ, tasya prāyaḥ pradhānapraśame praśamo bhavati|
sa tu pīḍākarataro bhavati paścādutpadyamāno vyādhiparikliṣṭaśarīratvāt; tasmādupadravaṃ tvaramāṇo 'bhibādheta||
6.21.41 |  sarvāyatanasamutthaṃ sarvaliṅgavyāpinaṃ sarvadhātvanusāriṇamāśukāriṇaṃ mahātyayikamiti sannipātavisarpamacikitsyaṃ vidyāt||
6.21.42 |  tatra vātapittaśleṣmanimittā visarpāstrayaḥ sādhyābhavanti; agnikardamākhyau punaranupasṛṣṭe marmaṇi anupagate vā sirāsnāyumāṃsaklede sādhāraṇakriyābhirubhāavevābhyasyamānau praśāntimāpadyeyātām, anādaropakrāntaḥ punastayoranyataro hanyāddehamāśvevāśīviṣavat; tathā granthivisarpamajātopadravamārabheta cikitsitum, upadravopadrutaṃ tvenaṃ pariharet; sannipātajaṃ tu sarvadhātvanusāritvādāśukāritvādviruddhopakramatvāccāsādhyaṃ vidyāt||
6.21.43 |  tatra sādhyānāṃ sādhanamanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.21.44 |  laṅghanollekhane śaste tiktakānāṃ ca sevanam|
kaphasthānagate sāme rūkṣaśītaiḥ pralepayet||
6.21.45 |  pittasthānagate 'pyetat sāme kuryācchikitsitam|
śoṇitasyāvasekaṃ ca virekaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ||
6.21.46 |  mārutāśayasaṃbhūte+pyāditaḥ syādvirūkṣaṇam|
raktapittānvaye 'pyādau snehanaṃ na hitaṃ matam||
6.21.47 |  vātolbaṇe tiktaghṛtaṃ paittike ca praśasyate|
laghudoṣe, mahādoṣe paittike syādvirecanam||
6.21.48 |  na ghṛtaṃ bahudoṣāya deyaṃ *yanna virecayet|
tena doṣo hyupaṣṭabdhastvaṅmāṃsarudhiraṃ pacet||
6.21.49 |  tasmādvirekamevādau śastaṃ vidyādvisarpiṇaḥ|
rudhirasyāvasekaṃ ca taddhyasyāśrayasaṃjñitam||
6.21.50 |  iti vīsarpanut proktaṃ samāsena cikitsitam|
etadeva punaḥ sarvaṃ vyāsataḥ saṃpravakṣyate||
6.21.51 |  madanaṃ madhukaṃ nimbaṃ vatsakasya phalāni ca|
vamanaṃ saṃpradātavyaṃ visarpe kaphapittaje||
6.21.52 |  paṭolapicumardābhyāṃ pippalyā madanena ca|
visarpe vamanaṃ śastaṃ tathā cendrayavaiḥ saha||
6.21.53 |  yāṃśca yogān pravakṣyāmi kalpeṣu kaphapittinām|
visarpiṇāṃ prayojyāste doṣanirharaṇāḥ śivāḥ||
6.21.54 |  mustanimbapaṭolānāṃ candanotpalayorapi|
sārivāmalakośīramustānāṃ vā vicakṣaṇaḥ||
6.21.55 |  kaṣāyān pāyayedvaidyaḥ siddhān vīsarpanāśanān|
kirātatiktakaṃ lodhraṃ candanaṃ sadurālabham||
6.21.56 |  nāgaraṃ padmakiñjalkamutpalaṃ sabibhītakam|
madhukaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca dadyādvīsarpaśāntaye||
6.21.57 |  prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ padmakiñjalkamutpalam|
nāgapuṣpaṃ ca lodhraṃ ca tenaiva vidhinā pibet||
6.21.58 |  drākṣāṃ parpaṭakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ guḍūcīṃ dhanvayāsakam|
niśāparyuṣitaṃ dadyāttṛṣṇāvīsarpaśāntaye||
6.21.59 |  paṭolaṃ picumardaṃ ca dārvīṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm|
yaṣṭyāhvāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca dadyādvīsarpaśāntaye||
6.21.60 |  paṭolādikaṣāyaṃ vā pibettriphalayā saha|
masūravidalairyuktaṃ ghṛtamiśraṃ pradāpayet||
6.21.61 |  paṭolapatramudgānāṃ rasamāmalakasya ca|
pāyayeta ghṛtonmiśraṃ naraṃ vīsarpapīḍitam||
6.21.62 |  yacca sarpirmahātiktaṃ pittakuṣṭhanibarhaṇam|
nirdiṣṭaṃ tadapi prājño dadyādvīsarpaśāntaye||
6.21.63 |  trāyamāṇāghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gaulmike yadudāhṛtam|
visarpāṇāṃ praśāntyarthaṃ dadyāttadapi buddhimān||
6.21.64 |  trivṛccūrṇaṃ samāloḍya sārpiṣā payasā 'pi vā|
gharmāmbunā vā saṃyojya mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā||
6.21.65 |  virekārthaṃ prayoktavyaṃ siddhaṃ vīsarpanāśanam|
trāyamāṇāśṛtaṃ vā 'pi payo dadyādvirecanam||
6.21.66 |  triphalārasasaṃyuktaṃ sarpirstrivṛtayā saha|
prayoktavyaṃ virekārthaṃ visarpajvaranāśanam||
6.21.67 |  rasamāmalakānāṃ vā ghṛtamiśraṃ pradāpayet|
sa eva gurukoṣṭhāya trivṛccūrṇayuto hitaḥ||
6.21.68 |  doṣe koṣṭhagate bhūya etat kuryāccikitsitam|
śākhyāduṣṭe tu rudhire raktamevādito haret||
6.21.69 |  bhiṣagvātānvitaṃ raktaṃ viṣāṇena vinirharet|
pittānvitaṃ jalaukobhiḥ, kaphānvitamalābudhiḥ||
6.21.70 |  yathāsannaṃ vikārasya vyadhayedāśu vā sirām|
tvaṅmāṃsasnāyusaṃkledo raktakledāddhi jāyate||
6.21.71 |  *antaḥśarīre saṃśuddhe doṣe tvaṅmāṃsaṃśrite|
ādito vā 'lpadoṣāṇāṃ kriyā bāhyā pravakṣyate||
6.21.72 |  udumbaratvaṅmadhukaṃ padmakiñjalkamutpalam|
nāgapuṣpaṃ priyaṅguśca pradehaḥ saghṛto hitaḥ||
6.21.73 |  nyagrodhapādāstaruṇāḥ kadalīgarbhasaṃyutāḥ|
bisagranthiśca lepaḥ syācchatadhautaghṛtāplutaḥ||
6.21.74 |  kālīyaṃ madhukaṃ hema vanyaṃ candanapadmakau|
elā mṛṇālaṃ phalinī pralepaḥ syādghṛtāplutaḥ||
6.21.75 |  śādvalaṃ ca mṛṇālaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ candanamutpalam|
vetasasya ca mūlāni pradehaḥ syāt sataṇḍulaḥ||
6.21.76 |  sārivā padmakiñjalkamuśīraṃ nīlamutpalam|
mañjiṣṭhā candanaṃ lodhramabhayā ca pralepanam||
6.21.77 |  naladaṃ ca hareṇuśca lodhraṃ *madhukapadmakau|
dūrvā sarjarasaścaiva saghṛtaṃ syāt pralepanam||
6.21.78 |  yāvakāḥ saktavaścaiva sarpiṣā saha yojitāḥ|
pradeho madhukaṃ vīrā saghṛtā yavasaktavaḥ||
6.21.79 |  balāmutpalaśālūkaṃ vīrāmagurucandanam|
kuryādālepanaṃ vaidyo mṛṇālaṃ ca bisānvitam||
6.21.80 |  yavacūrṇaṃ samadhukaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca pralepanam|
hareṇavo masūrāśca sagudgāḥ śvetaśālayaḥ||
6.21.81 |  pṛthak pṛthak pradehāḥ syuḥ sarve vā sarpiṣā saha|
padminīkardamaḥ śīto mauktikaṃ piṣṭameva vā||
6.21.82 |  śaṅkhaḥ pravālaḥ śuktirvā gairikaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam|
*(pṛhtagete pradehāśca hitā jñeyā visarpiṇām|)
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ balā śālūkamutpalam||
6.21.83 |  nyagrodhapatradugdhīke saghṛtaṃ syāt pralepanam|
bisāni ca mṛṇālaṃ ca saghṛtāśca kaśerukāḥ||
6.21.84 |  śatāvarīvidāryośca kandau dhautaghṛtāplutau|
śaivālaṃ nalamūlāni gojihvā vṛṣakarṇikā||
6.21.85 |  indrāṇiśākaṃ saghṛtaṃ *śirīṣatvagbalāghṛtam|
nyagrodhodumbaraplakṣavetasāśvatthapallavaiḥ||
6.21.86 |  tvakkalkairbahusarpirbhiḥ śītairālepanaṃ hitam|
pradehāḥ sarva evaite *vātapittolbaṇe śubhāḥ||
6.21.87 |  *sakaphe tu pravakṣyāmi pradehānaparān hitān|
triphalāṃ padmakośīraṃ samaṅgāṃ karavīrakam||
6.21.88 |  nalamūlānyanantāṃ ca pradehamupakalpayet|
khadiraṃ saptaparṇaṃ ca mustamāragvadhaṃ dhavam||
6.21.89 |  kuraṇṭakaṃ devadāru dadyādālepanaṃ bhiṣak|
āragvadhasya patrāṇi tvacaṃ śleṣmātakasya ca||
6.21.90 |  indrāṇiśākaṃ kākāhvāṃ śirīṣakusumāni ca|
śauvālaṃ nalamūlāni vīrāṃ gandhapriyaṅgukām||
6.21.91 |  triphalāṃ madhukaṃ vīrāṃ śirīṣakusurmāni ca|
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ hrīberaṃ dārvītvaṅmadhukaṃ balām||
6.21.92 |  pṛthagālepanaṃ kuryāddvandvaśaḥ sarvaśo 'pi vā|
pradehāḥ sarva evaite deyāḥ svalpaghṛtāplutāḥ||
6.21.93 |  vātapittolbaṇe ye tu pradehāste ghṛtādhikāḥ|
ghṛtena śatadhautena pradigyāt kevalena vā||
6.21.94 |  ghṛtamaṇḍena śītena payasā madhukāmbunā|
pañcavalkakaṣāyeṇa secayecchītalena vā||
6.21.95 |  vātāsṛkpittabahulaṃ visarpaṃ bahuśo bhiṣak|
secanāste pradehā ye ta eva ghṛtasādhanāḥ||
6.21.96 |  te cūrṇayogā vīsarpavraṇānāmavacūrṇanāḥ|
dūrvāsvarasasiddhaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ syādvraṇaropaṇam||
6.21.97 |  dārvītvaṅmadhukaṃ lodhraṃ keśaraṃ cāvacūrṇanam|
paṭolaḥ picumardaśca triphalā madhukotpale||
6.21.98 |  etat prakṣālanaṃ sarpirvraṇacūrṇaṃ pralepanam|
pradehāḥ sarva evaite kartavyāḥ *saṃprasādanāḥ||
6.21.99 |  kṣaṇe kṣaṇe prayoktavyāḥ pūrvamuddhṛtya lepanam|
adhāvanoddhṛte pūrve pradehā bahuśo 'ghanāḥ||
6.21.100 |  deyāḥ pradehāḥ kaphaje paryādhānoddṛte ghanāḥ|
tribhāgāṅguṣṭhamātraḥ syāt pralepaḥ kalkapeṣitaḥ||
6.21.101 |  nātisnigdho na rūkṣaśca na piṇḍo na dravaḥ samaḥ|
na ca paryuṣitaṃ lepaṃ kadācidavacārayet||
6.21.102 |  na ca tenaiva lepena punarjātu pralepayet|
kledavīsarpaśūlāni soṣṇābhāvāt pravartayet||
6.21.103 |  lepo hyupari paṭṭasya kṛtaḥ svedayati vraṇam|
svedajāḥ piḍakāstasya kaṇḍūścaivopajāyate||
6.21.104 |  uparyupari lepasya lepo yadyavacāryate|
tāneva doṣāñjanayet paṭṭasyopari yān kṛtaḥ||
6.21.105 |  atisnigdho 'tidravaśca lepo yadyavacāryate|
tvaci na śliṣyate samyaṅna doṣaṃ śamayatyapi||
6.21.106 |  tanvāliptaṃ na kurvīta saṃśuṣko hyāpuṭāyate|
na cauṣadhiraso vyādhiṃ prāpnotyapi ca śuṣyati||
6.21.107 |  tanvāliptena ye doṣāstāneva janayedbhṛśam|
saṃśuṣkaḥ pīḍayedvyādhiṃ niḥsneho hyavacāritaḥ||
6.21.108 |  annapānāni vakṣyāmi visarpāṇāṃ nivṛttaye|
laṅghitebhyo hito mantho rūkṣaḥ sakṣaudraśarkaraḥ||
6.21.109 |  madhuraḥ kiṃcidamlo vā dāḍimāmalakānvitaḥ|
saparūṣakamṛdvīkaḥ sakharjūraḥ śṛtāmbunā||
6.21.110 |  tarpaṇairyavaśālīnāṃ sasnehā cāvalehikā|
jīrṇe purāṇaśālīnāṃ yūṣairbhuñjīta bhojanam||
6.21.111 |  mudgānmasūrāṃśaṇakān yūṣārhtamupakalpayet|
anamlān dāḍimāmlān vā paṭolāmalakaiḥ saha||
6.21.112 |  jāṅgalānāṃ ca māṃsānāṃ rasāṃstasyopakalpayet|
rūkṣān parūṣakadrākṣādāḍimāmalakānvitān||
6.21.113 |  raktāḥ śvetā mahāhvāśca śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikaiḥ saha|
bhojanārthe praśasyante purāṇāḥ suparisrutāḥ||
6.21.114 |  yavagodhūmaśālīnāṃ sātmyānyeva pradāpayet|
yeṣāṃ nātyucitaḥ śālirnarā ye ca kaphādhikāḥ||
6.21.115 |  vidāhīnyannapānāni viruddhaṃ svapanaṃ divā|
krodhavyāyāmasūryāgnipravātāṃśca vivarjayet||
6.21.116 |  kuryāccikitsitādasmācchītaprāyāṇi paittike|
rūkṣaprāyāṇi kaphaje snaihikānyanilātmake||
6.21.117 |  vātapittapraśamanamagnivīsarpaṇe hitam|
kaphapittapraśamanaṃ prāyaḥ kardamasaṃjñite||
6.21.118 |  raktapittottaraṃ dṛṣṭvā granthivīsarpamāditaḥ|
rūkṣaṇairlaṅghanaiḥ sekaiḥ pradehaiḥ pāñcavalkalaiḥ||
6.21.119 |  sirāmokṣairjalaukobhirvamanaiḥ savirecanaiḥ|
*ghṛtaiḥ kaṣāyatiktaiśca kālajñaḥ samupācaret||
6.21.120 |  ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śuddhāya rakte cāpyavasecite|
vātaśleṣmaharaṃ karma granthivīsarpiṇe hitam||
6.21.121 |  utkārikābhiruṣṇābhirupanāhaḥ praśasyate|
snigdhābhirveśavārairvā granthivīsarpaśūlinām||
6.21.122 |  daśamūlopasiddhena tailenoṣṇena secayet|
kuṣṭhatailena coṣṇena pākyakṣārayutena ca||
6.21.123 |  gomūtraiḥ patraniryūhairuṣṇairvā pariṣecayet|
sukhoṣṇayā pradihyādvā piṣṭayā cāśvagandhayā||
6.21.124 |  śuṣkamūlakakalkena naktamālatvacā 'pi vā|
bibhītakatvacāṃ *vā 'pi kalkenoṣṇena lepayet||
6.21.125 |  balāṃ nāgabalāṃ pathyāṃ bhūrjagranthiṃ bibhītakam|
vaṃśapatrāṇyagnimanthaṃ kuryādgranthipralepanam||
6.21.126 |  dantī citrakamūlatvak sudhārkapayasī guḍaḥ|
bhallātakāsthi kāsīsaṃ lepo bhindyācchilāmapi||
6.21.127 |  bahirmārgasthitaṃ granthiṃ kiṃ punaḥ kaphasaṃbhavam|
dīrghakālasthitaṃ granthiṃ bhindyādvā bheṣajairimaiḥ||
6.21.128 |  mūlakānāṃ kulatthānāṃ yūṣaiḥ sakṣāradāḍimaiḥ|
godhūmānnairyavānnairvā sasīdhumadhuśarkaraiḥ||
6.21.129 |  sakṣaudrairvāruṇīmaṇḍairmātuluṅgarasānvitaiḥ|
triphalāyāḥ prayogaiśca pippalīkṣaudrasaṃyutaiḥ||
6.21.130 |  mustabhallātaśaktūnāṃ prayogairmākṣikasya ca|
devadāruguḍūcyośca prayogairgirijasya ca||
6.21.131 |  dhūmairvirekaiḥ śirasaḥ pūrvoktairgulmabhedanaiḥ|
ayolavaṇapāṣāṇahematāmraprapīḍanaiḥ||
6.21.132 |  ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhirvividhābhirbalī sthiraḥ|
granthiḥ pāṣāṇakaṭhino yadā naivopaśāmyati||
6.21.133 |  athāsya dāhaḥ kṣāreṇa *śarairhemnā 'tha vā hitaḥ|
pākibhiḥ pācayitvā vā pāṭayitvā samuddharet||
6.21.134 |  mokṣayedbahuśaścāsya raktamutkleśamāgatam|
*punaścāpahṛte rakte vātaśleṣmajidauṣadham||
6.21.135 |  dhūmo virekaḥ śirasaḥ svedanaṃ parimardanam|
apraśāmyati doṣe ca *pācanaṃ vā praśasyate||
6.21.136 |  praklinnaṃ dāhapākābhyāṃ bhiṣak śodhanaropaṇaiḥ|
bāhyaiścābhyantaraiścaiva vraṇavat samupācaret||
6.21.137 |  kampillakaṃ viḍaṅgāni dārvīṃ kārañjakaṃ phalam|
piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipaktavyaṃ granthivraṇacikitsitam||
6.21.138 |  dvivraṇīyopadiṣṭena karmaṇā cāpyupācaret|
deśakālavibhāgajño vraṇān vīsarpajān budhaḥ||
iti granthivisarpacikitsā|
6.21.139 |  ya eva vidhiruddiṣṭo granthīnāṃ vinivṛttaye|
sa eva galagaṇḍānāṃ kaphajānāṃ nivṛttaye||
6.21.140 |  galagaṇḍāstu vātotthā ye *kaphānugatā nṛṇām|
ghṛtakṣīrakaṣāyāṇāmabhyāsānna bhavanti te||
6.21.141 |  yānīhoktāni karmāṇi visarpāṇāṃ nivṛttaye|
ekatastāni sarvāṇi raktamokṣaṇamekataḥ||
6.21.142 |  visarpo na hyasaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena jāyate|
tasmāt sādhāraṇaṃ sarvamuktametaccikitsitam||
6.21.143 |  viśeṣo doṣavaiṣamyānna ca noktaḥ samāsataḥ|
*samāsavyāsanirdiṣṭāṃ kriyāṃ vidvānupācaret||
6.21.144 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
niruktaṃ nāmabhedāśca doṣā dūṣyāṇi hetavaḥ|
āśrayo mārgataścaiva visarpagurulāghavam||
6.21.145 |  liṅgānyupadravā ye ca yallakṣaṇa upadravaḥ|
sādhyatvaṃ, na ca, sādhyānāṃ sādhanaṃ ca yathākramam||
6.21.146 |  iti piprakṣave siddhimagniveśāya dhīmate|
punarvasuruvācedaṃ visarpāṇāṃ cikitsitam||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne visarpacikitsitaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||21 | |

dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.22.1 |  athātastṛṣṇācikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.22.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.22.3 |  jñānapraśamatapobhiḥ khyāto 'trisuto jagaddhite 'bhirataḥ|
tṛṣṇānāṃ praśamārthaṃ cikitsitaṃ prāha pañcānām||
6.22.4 |  kṣobhādbhayācchramādapiśokātkrodhādvilaṅghanānmadyāt|
kṣārāmlalavaṇakaṭukoṣṇarūkṣaśuṣkānnasevābhiḥ||
6.22.5 |  dhātukṣayagadakarṣaṇavamanādyatiyogasūryasaṃtāpaiḥ|
pittānilau pravṛddhau saumyāndhātūṃśca śoṣayataḥ||
6.22.6 |  rasavāhinīśca *nālīrjihvāmūlagalatālukaklomnaḥ|
saṃśoṣya nṛṇāṃ dehe kurutastṛṣṇāṃ mahābalāvetau||
6.22.7 |  pītaṃ pītaṃ hi jalaṃ śoṣayatastāvato na yāti śamam|
ghoravyādhikṛśānāṃ *prabhavatyupasargabhūtā sā||
6.22.8 |  prāgrūpaṃ mukhaśoṣaḥ, svalakṣaṇaṃ sarvadā 'mbukāmitvam|
tṛṣṇānāṃ sarvasāṃ liṅgānāṃ lāghavamapāyaḥ||
6.22.9 |  mukhaśoṣasvarabhedabhramasaṃtāpapralāpasaṃstambhān|
tālvoṣṭhakaṇṭhajihvākarkaśatāṃ cittanāśaṃ ca||
6.22.10 |  jihvānirgamamaruciṃ bādhiryaṃ marmadūyanaṃ sādam|
tṛṣṇodbhūtā kurute, pañcavidhāṃ liṅgataḥ śṛṇu tām||
6.22.11 |  abdhātuṃ dehasthaṃ kupitaḥ pavano yadā viśoṣayati|
tasmiñśuṣke śuṣyatyabalastṛṣyatyatha viśuṣyan||
6.22.12 |  nidrānāśaḥ śiraso bhramastathā śuṣkavirasamukhatā ca sroto 'varodha iti ca syālliṅgaṃ vātatṛṣṇāyāḥ||
6.22.13 |  pittaṃ matamāgneyaṃ kupitaṃ cettāpayatyapāṃ dhātum|
saṃtaptaḥ sa hi janayettṛṣṇāṃ dāholbaṇāṃ nṛṛṇām||
6.22.14 |  tiktāsyatvaṃ śiraso dāhaḥ śītābhinandatā mūrcchā|
pītākṣimūtravarcastvamākṛtiḥ pittatṛṣṇāyāḥ||
6.22.15 |  tṛṣṇā yā++āmaprabhavā *sā 'pyāgneyā++āmapittajanitatvāt|
liṅgaṃ tasyāścārucirādhmānakaphaprasekau ca||
6.22.16 |  deho rasajo 'mbubhavo rasaśca tasya kṣayācca tṛṣyeddhi|
dīnasvaraḥ pratāmyan *saṃśuṣkahṛdayagalatāluḥ||
6.22.17 |  bhavati khalu yopasargāttṛṣṇā sā śoṣiṇī kaṣṭā|
*jvaramehakṣayaśoṣaśvāsādyupasṛṣṭadehānām||
6.22.18 |  sarvāstvatiprasaktā rogakṛśānāṃ vamiprasaktānām|
ghoropadravayuktāstṛṇā maraṇāya vijñeyāḥ||
6.22.19 |  nāgniṃ vinā hi tarṣaḥ pavanādvā tau hi śoṣaṇe hetū|
abdhātorativṛddhāvapāṃ kṣaye tṛṣyate naro hi||
6.22.20 |  gurvannapayaḥsnehaiḥ saṃmūrcchadbhirvidāhakāle ca|
yastṛṣyedvṛtamārge tatrāpyanilānalau hetū||
6.22.21 |  tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣabhāvānmadyaṃ pittānilau prakopayati|
śoṣayato 'pāṃ dhātuṃ tāveva hi madyaśīlānām||
6.22.22 |  taptāsviva sikatāsu hi toyamāśu śuṣyati kṣiptam|
teṣāṃ saṃtaptānāṃ himajalapānādbhavati śarma||
6.22.23 |  śiśirasnātasyoṣmā ruddhaḥ koṣṭhaṃ prapadya tarṣayati|
tasmānnoṣṇaklānto bhajeta sahasā jalaṃ *śītam||
6.22.24 |  liṅgaṃ *sarvāsvetāsvanilakṣayapittajaṃ bhavatyatha tu|
pṛthagāgamāccikitsitamataḥ pravakṣyāmi tṛṣṇānām||
6.22.25 |  apāṃ kṣayāddhi tṛṣṇā saṃśoṣya naraṃ praṇāśayedāśu|
tasmādaindraṃ toyaṃ samadhu pibettadguṇaṃ vā 'nyat||
6.22.26 |  kiñcittuvarānurasaṃ tanu laghu śītalaṃ sugandhi surasaṃ ca|
anabhiṣyandi ca yattatkṣitigatamapyaindravajjñeyam||
6.22.27 |  śṛtaśītaṃ sasitopalamathavā śarapūrvapañcamūlena|
*lājāsaktusitāhvāmadhuyutamaindreṇa vā mantham||
6.22.28 |  vāṭyaṃ vā++āmayavānāṃ śītaṃ madhuśarkarāyutaṃ dadyāt|
peyāṃ vā śālīnāṃ dadyādvā koradūṣāṇām||
6.22.29 |  payasā śṛtena bhojanamathavā madhuśarkarāyutaṃ yojyam|
pārāvatādikarasairghṛtabhṛṣṭairvā 'pyalavaṇāmlaiḥ||
6.22.30 |  tṛṇapañcamūlamuñjātakaiḥ priyālaiśca jāṅgalāḥ sukṛtāḥ|
śastā rasāḥ payo vā taiḥ siddhaṃ śarkarāmadhumat||
6.22.31 |  śatadhautaghṛtenāktaḥ payaḥ pibecchītatoyamavagāhya|
mudgamasūracaṇakajā rasāstu bhṛṣṭā *ghṛte deyāḥ||
6.22.32 |  madhuraiḥ sajīvanīyaiḥ śītaiśca satiktakaiḥ śṛtaṃ kṣīram|
pānābhyañjanasekeṣviṣṭaṃ madhuśarkarāyuktam||
6.22.33 |  tajjaṃ vā ghṛtamiṣṭaṃ pānābhyaṅgeṣu nasyamapi ca syāt|
nārīpayaḥ saśarkaramuṣṭryā api nasyamikṣurasaḥ||
6.22.34 |  *kṣīrekṣurasaguḍodakasitopalākṣaudrasīdhumārdvīkaiḥ|
vṛkṣāmlamātuluṅgairgaṇḍūṣastāluśoṣaghnāḥ||
6.22.35 |  jambvāmrātakabadarīvetasapañcavalkapañcāmlaiḥ|
hṛnmukhaśiraḥpradehāḥ saghṛtā mūrcchābhramatṛṣṇāghnāḥ syuḥ||
6.22.36 |  dāḍimadadhitthalodhraiḥ savidārībījapūrakaiḥ śirasaḥ|
lepo gaurāmalakairghṛtāranālāyutaiśca hitaḥ||
6.22.37 |  śaivalapaṅkāmburuhaiḥ sāmlaiḥ sāghṛtaiśca śaktubhirlepaḥ|
mastvāranālārdravasanakamalamaṇihārasaṃsparśāḥ||
6.22.38 |  śiśirāmbucandanārdrastanataṭapāṇitalagātrasaṃsparśāḥ kṣaumārdranivasanānāṃ varāṅganānāṃ priyāṇāṃ ca||
6.22.39 |  himavaddarīvanasaritsaro 'mbujapavanendupādaśiśirāṇām|
*ramyaśiśirodakānāṃ smaraṇaṃ kathāśca tṛṣṇāghnāḥ||
6.22.40 |  vātaghnamannapānaṃ mṛdu laghu śītaṃ ca vātatṛṣṇāyām|
kṣayakāsanucchṛtaṃ *kṣīraghṛtamūrdhvavātatṛṣṇāghnam||
6.22.41 |  syājjīvanīyasiddhaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ vātapittaye tarṣa|
paitte drākṣācandanakharjūrośīramadhuyutaṃ toyam||
6.22.42 |  lohitaśālitaṇḍulakharjūraparūṣakotpaladrākṣāḥ|
madhu pakvaloṣṭameva ca jale sthitaṃ śītalaṃ peyam||
6.22.43 |  lohitaśāliprasthaḥ salodhramadhukāñjanotpalaḥ kṣuṇṇaḥ
*pakvāmaloṣṭajalamadhusamāyuto mṛnmaye peyaḥ||
6.22.44 |  vaṭamātuluṅgavetasapallavakuśakāśamūlayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ|
siddhe 'mbhasyagninibhāṃ kṛṣṇamṛdaṃ kṛṣṇasikatāṃ vā||
6.22.45 |  taptāni navakapālānyathavā nirvāpya pāyayetāccham|
āpākaśarkaraṃ vā 'mṛtavallyudakaṃ tṛṣāṃ hanti||
6.22.46 |  kṣīravatāṃ madhurāṇāṃ śītānāṃ śarkarāmadhuvimiśrāḥ|
śītakaṣāyā mṛdbhṛṣṭasaṃyutāḥ pittatṛṣṇāghnāḥ||
6.22.47 |  vyoṣavacābhallātakatiktakaṣāyāstathā++āmatṛṣṇāghnāḥ|
yaccoktaṃ kaphajāyāṃ vamyāṃ taccaiva kāryaṃ syāt||
6.22.48 |  stambhārucyavipākālasyacchardiṣu kaphānugāṃ tṛṣṇām|
jñātvā dadhimadhutarpaṇalavaṇoṣṇajalairvamanamiṣṭam||
6.22.49 |  dāḍimamamlaphalaṃ vā 'pyanyat sakaṣāyamatha leham|
peyamathavā *pradadyādrajanīśarkarāyuktam||
6.22.50 |  kṣayakāsena tu tulyā kṣayatṛṣṇā sā garīyasī nṛṛṇām|
kṣīṇakṣataśoṣahitaistasmāttāṃ bheṣajaiḥ śamayet||
6.22.51 |  pānatṛṣārtaḥ pānaṃ tvardhodakamamlalavaṇagandhāḍhyam|
śiśirasnātaḥ pānaṃ madyāmbu guḍāmbu vā tṛṣitaḥ||
6.22.52 |  bhaktoparodhatṛṣitaḥ snehatṛṣārto 'thavā tanuyavāgūm|
prapibedguruṇā tṛṣito bhuktena taduddharedbhuktam||
6.22.53 |  madhyāmbu vā 'mbu koṣṇaṃ balavāṃstṛṣitaḥ samullikhet pītvā|
māgadhikāviśadamukhaḥ saśarkaraṃ vā pibenmantham||
6.22.54 |  balavāṃstu tāluśoṣe pibedghṛtaṃ tṛṣyamadyācca|
sarpirbhṛṣṭaṃ kṣīraṃ māṃsarasāṃścābalaḥ snigdhān||
6.22.55 |  atirūkṣadurbalānāṃ tarṣaṃ śamayennṛṇāmihāśu payaḥ|
chāgo vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭaḥ śīto madhuro raso hṛdyaḥ||
6.22.56 |  snigdhe 'nne bhukte yā tṛṣṇā syāttāṃ guḍāmbunā śamayet|
tarṣaṃ mūrcchābhihatasya raktapittāpahairhanyāt||
6.22.57 |  *tṛṭdāhamūrcchābhramaklamamadātyayāsraviṣapitte|
śastaṃ svabhāvaśītaṃ, śṛtaśītaṃ sannipāte 'mbhaḥ||
6.22.58 |  hikkāśvāsanavajvarapīnasaghṛtapītapārśvagalaroge|
kaphavātakṛte styāne sadyaḥśuddhe ca hitamuṣṇam||
6.22.59 |  pāṇḍūdarapīnasamehagulmamandānalātisāreṣu|
plīhni ca toyaṃ na hitaṃ kāmamasahye pibedalpam||
6.22.60 |  pūrvamayāturaḥ san dīnastṛṣṇārdito jalaṃ kāṅkṣan|
na labheta sa cenmaraṇamāśvevāpnupāddīrgharogaṃ vā||
6.22.61 |  tasmāddhānyāmbu pibettṛṣyan rogī saśarkarākṣaudram|
yadvā tasyānyatsyāt sātmyaṃ rogasya tacceṣṭam||
6.22.62 |  tasyāṃ vinivṛttāyāṃ tajjanya upadravaḥ sukhaṃ jetum|
tasmāttṛṣṇāṃ pūrvaṃ jayedbahubhyo 'pi rogebhyaḥ||
6.22.63 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
hetū yathā 'gnipavanau kurutaḥ sopadravāṃ ca pañcānām|
tṛṣṇānāṃ pṛthagākṛtirasādhyatā sādhanaṃ coktam||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne tṛṣṇārogacikitsitaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||22 | |

trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.23.1 |  athāto viṣacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.23.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.23.3 |  prāgutpattiṃ guṇān yoniṃ vegāṃ(anunāsika)lliṅgānyupakramān|
ciṣasya bruvataḥ samyagagniveśa nibodha me||
6.23.4 |  amṛtārthaṃ samudre tu mathyamāne surāsuraiḥ|
jajñe prāgamṛtotpatteḥ puruṣo ghoradarśanaḥ||
6.23.5 |  dīptatejāścaturdaṃṣṭro harikeśo 'nalekṣaṇaḥ|
jagadviṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā *tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ||
6.23.6 |  jaṅgamasthāvarāyāṃ tadyonau brahmā nyayojayat|
tadambusaṃbhavaṃ tasmāddbividhaṃ pāvakopamam||
6.23.7 |  aṣṭavegaṃ daśaguṇaṃ caturviṃśatyupakramam|
tadvarṣāsvambuyonitvāt saṃkledaṃ guḍavadgatam||
6.23.8 |  sarpatyambudharāpāye tadagastyo hinasti ca|
prayāti mandavīryatvaṃ viṣaṃ tasmādghanāstyaye||
6.23.9 |  sarpāḥ kīṭondurā lūtā vṛścikā gṛhagodhikāḥ|
jalaukāmatsyamaṇḍūkāḥ *kaṇabhāḥ sakṛkaṇṭakāḥ||
6.23.10 |  śvasiṃhavyāghragomāyutarakṣunakulādayaḥ|
*daṃṣṭriṇo ye viṣaṃ teṣāṃ daṃṣṭrotthaṃ jaṅgamaṃ matam||
6.23.11 |  mustakaṃ pauṣkaraṃ krauñcaṃ vatsanābhaṃ balāhakam|
karkaṭaṃ kālakūṭaṃ ca karavīrakasaṃjñakam||
6.23.12 |  pālakendrāyudhaṃ tailaṃ meghakaṃ kuśapuṣpakam|
rohiṣaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca lāṅgalakyañjanābhakam||
6.23.13 |  saṅkocaṃ markaṭaṃ śṛṅgīviṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ tathā|
evamādīni cānyāni mūlajāni sthirāṇi ca||
6.23.14 |  *garasaṃyogajaṃ cānyadgarasaṃjñaṃ gadapradam|
kālāntaravipākitvānna tadāśu haratyasūn||
6.23.15 |  nidrāṃ tandrāṃ klamaṃ dāhaṃ *sapākaṃ lomaharṣaṇam|
śophaṃ caivātisāraṃ ca janayejjaṅgamaṃ viṣam||
6.23.16 |  sthāvaraṃ tu jvaraṃ hikkāṃ dantaharṣaṃ galagraham|
phenavamyaruciśvāsamūrcchāśca *janayedviṣam||
6.23.17 |  *jaṅgamaṃ syādadhobhāgamūrdhvabhāgaṃ tu mūlajam|
*tasmāddaṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ maulaṃ hanti maulaṃ ca *daṃṣṭrajam||
6.23.18 |  tṛṇmohadantaharṣaprasekavamathuklamā bhavantyādye|
vege rasapradoṣādasṛkpradoṣāddvitīye tu||
6.23.19 |  *vaivarṇyabhramavepathumūrcchājṛmbhāṅgacimicimātamakāḥ|
duṣṭapiśitāttṛtīye maṇḍalakaṇḍūśvayathukoṭhāḥ||
6.23.20 |  vātādijāścaturthe dāhacchardyaṅgaśūlamūrcchādyāḥ|
nīlādīnāṃ tamasaśca darśanaṃ pañcame vege||
6.23.21 |  ṣaṣṭhe hikkā, bhaṅgaḥ skandhasya tu saptame 'ṣṭame maraṇam|
nṛṛṇāṃ, catuṣpadāṃ syāccaturvidhaḥ, pakṣiṇāṃ trividhaḥ||
6.23.22 |  sīdatyādye bhramati ca, catuṣpado vepate, tataḥ *śūnyaḥ|
mandāhāro mriyate śvāsena hi caturthavege tu||
6.23.23 |  *dhyāyati vihagaḥ prathame vege, prabhrāmyati dvitīye tu|
srastāṅgaśca tṛtīye viṣavege yāti pañcatvam||
6.23.24 |  laghu rūkṣamāśu viśadaṃ vyavāyi tīkṣṇaṃ vikāsi sūkṣmaṃ ca|
uṣṇamanirdeśyarasaṃ daśaguṇamuktaṃ viṣaṃ tajjñaiḥ||
6.23.25 |  raukṣyādvātamaśaityātpittaṃ saukṣmyādasṛk prakopayati|
*kaphamavyaktarasatvādannarasāṃścānuvartate śīghram||
6.23.26 |  śīghraṃ vyavāyibhāvādāśu vyāpnoti kevalaṃ deham|
tīkṣṇatvānmarmaghnaṃ prāṇaghnaṃ tadvikāsitvāt||
6.23.27 |  durupakramaṃ laghutvādvaiśadyāt syādasaktagatidoṣam|
doṣasthānaprakṛtīḥ prāpyānyatamaṃ hyudīrayati||
6.23.28 |  syādvātikasya vātasthāne kaphapittaliṅgamīṣattu|
*tṛṇmohāratimūrcchāgalagrahacchardiphenādi||
6.23.29 |  pittāśayasthitaṃ paittikasya *kaphavātayorviṣaṃ tadvat|
*tṛṭkāsajvaravamathuklamadāhatamotisārādi||
6.23.30 |  kaphadeśagaṃ *kaphasya ca darśayedvātapittayośceṣat|
liṅgaṃ śvāsagalagrahakaṇḍūlālāvamathvādi||
6.23.31 |  dūṣīviṣaṃ tu śoṇitaduṣṭyāruḥkiṭimakoṭhaliṅgaṃ ca|
viṣamekaikaṃ doṣaṃ saṃdūṣya haratyasūnevam||
6.23.32 |  kṣarati viṣatejasā 'sṛk tat khāni nirudhya mārayati jantum|
pītaṃ mṛtasya hṛdi tiṣṭhati daṣṭaviddhayordaṃśadeśe syāt||
6.23.33 |  nīlauṣṭhadantaśaithilyakeśapatanāṅgabhaṅgavikṣepāḥ|
śiśirairna lomaharṣo nābhihate daṇḍarājī syāt||
6.23.34 |  kṣatajaṃ kṣatācca nāyātyetāni bhavanti maraṇaliṅgāni|
ebhyo 'nyathā cikitsyāsteṣāṃ copakramāñchṛṇu me||
6.23.35 |  mantrāriṣṭotkartananiṣpīḍanacūṣaṇāgnipariṣekāḥ|
avagāharaktamokṣaṇavamanavirekopadhānāni||
6.23.36 |  *hṛdayāvaraṇāñjananasyadhūmalehauṣadhapraśamanāni|
pratisāraṇaṃ prativiṣaṃ saṃjñāsaṃsthāpanaṃ lepaḥ||
6.23.37 |  mṛtasañjīvanameva ca viṃśatirete caturbhiradhikāḥ|
syurupakramā yathā ye yatra yojyāḥ śṛṇu tathā tān||
6.23.38 |  daṃśāttu viṣaṃ daṣṭasyāvisṛtaṃ veṇikāṃ bhiṣagbaddhvā|
niṣpīḍayedbhṛśaṃ daṃśamuddharenmarmavarjaṃ vā||
6.23.39 |  taṃ daṃśaṃ vā cūṣenmukhena yavacūrṇapāṃśupūrṇena|
pracchanaśṛṅgajalaukāvyadhanaiḥ srāvyaṃ tato raktam||
6.23.40 |  rakte viṣapraduṣṭe duṣyet prakṛtistatastyajet prāṇān|
tasmāt pragharṣaṇairasṛgavartamānaṃ pravartyaṃ syāt||
6.23.41 |  *trikaṭugṛhadhūmarajanīpañcalavaṇarocanāḥ savārtākāḥ|
gharṣaṇamatipravṛtte vaṭādibhiḥ śītalairlepaḥ||
6.23.42 |  raktaṃ hi *viṣādhānaṃ vāyurivāgneḥ pradehasekaistat|
śītaiḥ skandati tasmin skanne vyapayāti viṣavegaḥ||
6.23.43 |  viṣavegānmadamūrcchāviṣādahṛdayadravāḥ pravartante|
śītairnivartayettān *vījyaścālomaharṣāt syāt||
6.23.44 |  taruriva mūlacchedāddaṃśacchedānna vṛddhimeti viṣam|
ācūṣaṇamānayanaṃ jalasya seturyathā tathā 'riṣṭāḥ||
6.23.45 |  tvaṅmāṃsagataṃ dāho dahati viṣaṃ srāvaṇaṃ harati raktāt|
pītaṃ vamanaiḥ sadyo haredvirekairdvitīye tu||
6.23.46 |  ādau hṛdayaṃ rakṣyaṃ tasyāvaraṇaṃ pibedyathālābham|
*madhusarpirmajjapayogairikamatha gomayarasaṃ vā||
6.23.47 |  ikṣuṃ *supakvamathavā kākaṃ niṣpīḍya tadrasaṃ varaṇam|
chāgādīnāṃ vā 'sṛgbhasma mṛdaṃ vā pibedāśu||
6.23.48 |  kṣārāgadastṛtīye *śophaharairlekhanaṃ samadhvambu|
gomayarasaścaturthe vege sakapitthamadhusarpiḥ||
6.23.49 |  kākāṇḍaśirīṣābhyāṃ svarasenāścyotanāñjane nasyam|
syātpañcame 'tha ṣaṣṭhe saṃjñāyāḥ sthāpanaṃ kāryam||
6.23.50 |  gopittayutā rajanī mañjiṣṭhāmaricapippalīpānam|
viṣapānaṃ daṣṭānāṃ viṣapīte daṃśanaṃ cānte||
6.23.51 |  śikhipittārdhayutaṃ syāt palāśabījamagado mṛteṣu varaḥ|
vārtākuphāṇitāgāradhūmagopittanimbaṃ vā||
6.23.52 |  gopittayutairguṭikāḥ *surasāgranthidvirajanīmadhukakuṣṭhaiḥ|
śastā 'mṛtena tulyā śirīṣapuṣpakākāṇḍakarasairvā||
6.23.53 |  kākāṇḍasurasagavākṣīpunarnavāvāyasīśirīṣaphalaiḥ|
udbandhaviṣajalamṛte *lepaupadhinasyapānāni||
6.23.54 |  spṛkkāplavasthauṇeyakāṃkṣīśaileyarocanātagaram|
dhyāmakakuṅkumamāṃsīsurasāgrailālakuṣṭhaghnam||
6.23.55 |  bṛhatī śirīṣapuṣpaṃ śrīveṣṭakapadmacāraṭiviśālāḥ|
suradārupadmakeśarasāvarakamanaḥśilākauntyaḥ||
6.23.56 |  jātyarkapuṣparasarajanīdvayahiṅgupippalīlākṣāḥ|
jalamudgaparṇicandanamadhukamadanasindhuvārāśca||
6.23.57 |  śampākalodhramayūrakagandhaphalānākulīviḍaṅgāśca|
puṣye saṃhṛtya samaṃ piṣṭvā guṭikā vigheyāḥ syuḥ||
6.23.58 |  sarvaviṣaghno jayakṛdviṣamṛtasṃjīvano jvaranihantā|
ghreyavilepanadhāraṇadhūmagrahaṇairgṛhasthaśca||
6.23.59 |  bhūtaviṣajantvalakṣmīkārmaṇamantrāgryaśanyarīn hanyāt|
duḥsvapnastrīdoṣānakālamaraṇāmbucairabhayam||
6.23.60 |  dhanadhānyakāryasiddhiḥ śrīpuṣṭyāyurvivardhano dhanyaḥ|
mṛtasaṃjīvana eṣa prāgamṛtāhbrahmaṇā vihitaḥ||
iti mṛtasaṃjīvano 'gadaḥ|
6.23.61 |  mantrairdhamanībandho 'vamārjanaṃ kāryamātmarakṣā ca|
doṣasya viṣaṃ yasya sthāne syāttaṃ jayetpūrvam||
6.23.62 |  vātasthāne svedo dadhnā natakuṣṭhakalkapānaṃ ca|
ghṛtamadhupayo 'mbupānāvagāhasekāśca pittasthe||
6.23.63 |  kṣārāgadaḥ kaphasthānagate svedastathā sirāvyadhanam|
dūṣīviṣe 'tha raktasthite sirākarma pañcavidham||
6.23.64 |  bheṣajamevaṃ kalpyaṃ bhiṣagvidā++ālakṣya sarvadā sarvam|
sthānaṃ jayeddhi pūrvaṃ sthānasthasyāviruddhaṃ ca||
6.23.65 |  viṣadūṣitakaphamārgaḥ srotaḥsaṃrodharuddhavāyustu|
mṛta iva śvasenmartyaḥ syādasādhyaliṅgairvihīnaśca||
6.23.66 |  carmakaṣāyāḥ kalkaṃ bilvasamaṃ mūrdhni kākapadamasya|
kṛtvā dadyātkaṭabhīkaṭukaṭphalapradhamanaṃ ca||
6.23.67 |  *chāgaṃ gavyaṃ māhiṣaṃ vā māṃsaṃ kaukkuṭameva vā|
dadyāt kākapade tasmiṃstataḥ saṃkramate viṣam||
6.23.68 |  nāsākṣikarṇajihvākaṇṭhanirodheṣu karma nastaḥ syāt|
vārtākubījapūrajyotiṣmatyādibhiḥ piṣṭaiḥ||
6.23.69 |  añjanamakṣyuparodhe kartavyaṃ bastamūtrapiṣṭaistu|
dāruvyoṣaharidrākaravīrakarañjanimbasurasaistu||
6.23.70 |  śvetā vacā+*aśvagandhā hiṅgvamṛtā kuṣṭhasaindhave laśunam|
sarṣapakapitthamadhyaṃ *ṭuṇṭukakarañjabīāni||
6.23.71 |  *vyoṣaṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ dvirajanyau *vaṃśalocanaṃ ca samam|
piṣṭvā 'jasya mūtreṇa *gośvapittena saptāham||
6.23.72 |  vyatyāsabhāvito 'yaṃ nihanti śirasi sthitaṃ viṣaṃ kṣipram|
sarvajvarabhūtagrahavisūcikā jīrṇamūrcchārtīḥ||
6.23.73 |  unmādāpasmārau kācapaṭalanīlikāśirodoṣān|
śuṣkākṣipākapillārbudārmakaṇḍūtamodoṣān||
6.23.74 |  kṣayadaurbalyamadātyayapāṇḍugadāṃścāñjanāttathā mohān|
lopādviṣadigdhakṣatalīḍhadaṣṭapītaviṣaghātī||
6.23.75 |  arśaḥsvānaddheṣu ca gudalepo yonilepanaṃ strīṇām|
mūḍhe garbhe duṣṭe lalāṭalepaḥ pratiśyāye||
6.23.76 |  *vṛddhau kiṭime kuṣṭhe śvitraṛvicarcikādiṣu lepaḥ|
gaja iva tarūn viṣagadānnihantyagadagandhahastyeṣaḥ||
iti gandhahastīnāmā 'gadaḥ|
6.23.77 |  patrāgurumustailā niryāsāḥ pañca candanaṃ spṛkkā|
tvaṅnaladotpalabālakahareṇukośīravanyanakhāḥ||
6.23.78 |  suradārukanakakuṅkumadhyāmakakuṣṭhapriyaṅgavastagaram|
pañcāṅgāni śurīṣādvyoṣālamanaḥśilājājyaḥ||
6.23.79 |  *śvetakaṭabhīkarañjau rakṣoghnī sindhuvārikā rajanī|
surasāñjanagaurikamañjiṣṭhānimbaniryāsāḥ||
6.23.80 |  vaṃśatvagaśvagandhāhiṅgudadhitthāmlavetasaṃ lākṣā|
madhumadhukasomarājīvacāruhārocanātagaram||
6.23.81 |  agado 'yaṃ vaiśravaṇāyākhyātastryambakeṇa ṣaṣṭyaṅgaḥ|
apratihataprabhāvaḥ khyāto mahāgandhahastīti||
6.23.82 |  pittena gavāṃ peṣyo guṭikāḥ kāryāstu puṣyayogena|
pānāñjanapralepaiḥ prasādhayet sarvakarmāṇi||
6.23.83 |  pillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ timiraṃ rātryāndhyaṃ kācamarbudaṃ paṭalam|
hanti satataprayogāddhitamitapathyāśināṃ puṃsām||
6.23.84 |  viṣamajvarānajīrṇāndadruṃ kaṇḍūṃ visūcikāṃ pāmām|
viṣamūṣikalūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pannagānāṃ ca|
āśu viṣaṃ nāśayati samūlajamatha kandajaṃ sarvam||
6.23.85 |  etena liptagātraḥ sarpān gṛhṇāti bhakṣayecca viṣam|
*kālaparīto 'pi naro jīvati nityaṃ nirātaṅkaḥ||
6.23.86 |  ānaddhe gudalepo yonau lepaśca mūḍhagarbhāṇām|
mūrcchārtiṣu ca lalāṭe pralepanamāhuḥ pradhānatamam||
6.23.87 |  bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭahāñchatrāṇyamunā tathā dhvajapatākāḥ|
liptvā 'hiviṣanirastyai padhvanayeddarśayenmatimān||
6.23.88 |  yatra ca sannihito 'yaṃ na tatra bālagrahā na rakṣāṃsi|
na ca kārmaṇavetālā *vahanti nātharvaṇā mantrāḥ||
6.23.89 |  sarvagrahā na tatra prabhavanti na cāgniśastranṛpacaurāḥ|
lakṣmīśca tatra bhajate yatra mahāgandhahastyasti||
6.23.90 |  piṣyamāṇa imaṃ cātra siddhaṃ mantramudīrayet|
mama matā jayā nāma *jayo nāmeti me pitā||
6.23.91 |  so 'haṃ jayajayāputro vijayo 'tha jayāmi ca|
namaḥ puruṣasiṃhāya viṣṇave viśvakarmaṇe||
6.23.92 |  sanātanāya kṛṣṇāya bhavāya vibhavāya ca|
tejo vṛṣākapeḥ sākṣāttejo brahmendrayoryame||
6.23.93 |  yathā 'haṃ nābhijānāmi vāsudevaparājayam|
mātuśca pāṇigrahaṇaṃ samudrasya ca śoṣaṇam||
6.23.94 |  anena satyavākyena sidhyatāmagado hyayam|
hilimilisaṃspṛṣṭe rakṣa sarvabheṣajottame *svāhā||
iti mahāgandhahastīnāmā 'gadaḥ|
6.23.95 |  ṛṣabhakajīvakabhārgīmadhukotpaladhānyakeśarājājyaḥ|
sasitagirikolamadhyāḥ peyāḥ śvāsajvarādiharāḥ||
6.23.96 |  hiṅgu ca kṛṣṇāyuktaṃ kapittharasayuktamagryalavaṇaṃ ca|
samadhusitau pātavyau jvarahikkāśvāsakāsaghnau||
6.23.97 |  lehaḥ kolāsthyañjanalājotpaladhughṛtairvamyām|
bṛhatīdvayāḍhakīpatradhūmavartistu hikkāghnī||
6.23.98 |  śikhibarhibalākāsthīni sarṣapāścandanaṃ ca ghṛtayuktam|
dhūmo gṛhaśayanāsanavastrādiṣu śasyate viṣanut||
6.23.99 |  ghṛtayukte natakuṣṭhe bhujagapatiśiraḥ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ ca|
dhūmāgadaḥ smṛto 'yaṃ sarvaviṣaghnaḥ śvayathuhṛcca||
6.23.100 |  jatusevyapatraguggulubhallātakakakubhapuṣpasarjarasāḥ|
śvetā ca dhūma uragākhukīṭavastrakriminudagryaḥ||
6.23.101 |  taruṇapalāśakṣāraṃ srutaṃ paceccūrṇitaiḥ saha samāṃśaiḥ|
lohitamṛdrajanīdvayaśuklasurasamañjarīmadhukaiḥ||
6.23.102 |  lākṣāsaindhavamāṃsīhareṇuhiṅgudvisārivākuṣṭhaiḥ|
savyoṣairbāhlīkairdarvīvilepanaṃ ghaṭṭayedyāvat||
6.23.103 |  sarvaviṣaśothagulmatvagdoṣārśobhagandaraplīhnaḥ|
śothāpasmārakrimibhūtasvarobhedapāṇḍugadān||
6.23.104 |  mandāgnitvaṃ kāsaṃ sonmādaṃ nāśayeyuratha puṃsām|
guṭikāśchāyāśuṣkāḥ kolasamāstāḥ samupayuktāḥ||
iti kṣārāgadaḥ|
6.23.105 |  viṣapītadaṣṭaviddheṣvetaddigdhe ca cācyamuddiṣṭam|
sāmānyataḥ, pṛthaktvānnirdeśamataḥ śṛṇu yathāvat||
6.23.106 |  ripuyuktebhyo nṛbhyaḥ svebhyaḥ strībhyo 'thavā bhayaṃ nṛpateḥ|
āhāravihāragataṃ tasmāt preṣyān parīkṣeta||
6.23.107 |  atyarthaśāṅkitaḥ syādbahuvāgathavā 'lpavāgvigatalakṣmīḥ|
prāptaḥ prakṛtivikāraṃ viṣapradātā naro jñeyaḥ||
6.23.108 |  dṛṣṭvaivaṃ na tu sahasā bhojyaṃ *kuryāttadannamagnau tu|
saviṣaṃ hi prāpyānnaṃ bahūnvikārān bhajatyagniḥ||
6.23.109 |  *śikhibarhavicitrārcistīkṣṇākṣamarūkṣakuṇapadhūmaśca|
sphuṭati ca saśabdamekāvarto vihatārcirapi ca syāt||
6.23.110 |  pātrasthaṃ ca vivarṇaṃ bhojyaṃ syānmakṣikāṃśca mārayati|
kṣāmasvarāṃśca kākān kuryādvirajeccakorākṣi||
6.23.111 |  pāne nīlā rājī vaivarṇyaṃ svāṃ ca nekṣate chāyām|
paśyati vikṛtāmathavā lavaṇākte phenamālā syāt||
6.23.112 |  pānānnayoḥsaviṣayorgandhena śirorugghṛdica mūrcchā ca|
sparśena pāṇiśothaḥ suptyaṅgulidāhatodanakhabhedāḥ||
6.23.113 |  *mukhagetvoṣṭhacimicimā jihvā śūnā jaḍā vivarṇā ca|
dvijaharṣahanustambhāsyadāhalālāgalavikārāḥ||
6.23.114 |  āmāśayaṃ praviṣṭe vaivarṇyaṃ svedasadanamutkledaḥ|
dṛṣṭihṛdayoparodho binduśataiścīyate cāṅgam||
6.23.115 |  pakvāśayaṃ tu yāte mūrcchāmadamohadāhabalanāśāḥ|
tandrā kārśyaṃ ca viṣe pāṇḍutvaṃ codarasthe syāt||
6.23.116 |  dantapavanasya kūrco viśīryate dantauṣṭhamāṃsaśophaśca|
keśacyutiḥ śiroruggranthayaśca saviṣe 'tha śirobhyaṅge||
6.23.117 |  duṣṭe 'ñjane 'kṣidāhasrāvātyupadehaśotharāgāśca|
khādyairādau koṣṭhaḥ spṛśyaistvagdūṣyate duṣṭaiḥ||
6.23.118 |  snānābhyaṅgotsādanavastrālaṅkāravarṇakairduṣṭaiḥ|
kaṇḍvartikoṭhapiḍakāromodgamacimicimā śothāḥ||
6.23.119 |  ete karacaraṇadāhatodaklamāvipākāśca|
bhūpādukāśvagajavarmaketuśayanāsanairduṣṭaiḥ||
6.23.120 |  mālyamagandhaṃ mlāyati *śirorujālomaharṣakaram|
stambhayati khāni nāsāmupahanti darśanaṃ ca dhūmaḥ||
6.23.121 |  kūpataḍāgādijalaṃ durgandhaṃ sakaluṣaṃ vivarṇaṃ ca|
pītaṃ śvayathuṃ koṭhān piḍakāśca karoti maraṇaṃ ca||
6.23.122 |  ādāvāmāśayage vamanaṃ tvaksthe pradehasekādi|
kuryādbhiṣak cikitsāṃ doṣabalaṃ caiva hi samīkṣya||
6.23.123 |  iti mūlaviṣaviśeṣāḥ proktāḥ śṛṇu jaṅgamasyātaḥ|
saviśeṣacikitsitamevādau tatrocyate tu sarpāṇām||
6.23.124 |  *iha darvīkaraḥ sarpo maṇḍalī rājimāniti|
trayo yathākramaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaprakopaṇāḥ||
6.23.125 |  darvīkaraḥ paṇī jñeyo maṇḍalī maṇḍalāphaṇaḥ|
bindulekhavicitrāṅgaḥ pannagaḥ syāttu rājimān||
6.23.126 |  viśeṣādrūkṣakaṭukamamloṣṇaṃ svādu śītalam|
viṣaṃ yathākramaṃ teṣāṃ tasmādvātādikopanam||
6.23.127 |  darvīkarakṛto daṃśaḥ sūkṣmadaṃṣṭrāpado 'sitaḥ|
niruddharaktaḥ kūrmābho vātavyādhikaro mataḥ||
6.23.128 |  pṛthvarpitaḥ saśothaśca daṃśo maṇḍalinā kṛtaḥ|
pītābhaḥ pītaraktaśca sarvapittavikārakṛt||
6.23.129 |  kṛto rājimatā daṃśaḥ picchilaḥ sthiraśophakṛt|
snigdhaḥ pāṇḍuśca sāndrāsṛk śleṣmavyādhisamīraṇaḥ||
6.23.130 |  vṛttabhogo mahākāyaḥ śvasannūrdhvekṣaṇaḥ pumān|
sthūlamūrdhā samāṅgaśca strī tvataḥ syādviparyayāt||
6.23.131 |  *klībastrasatyadhodṛṣṭiḥ svarahīnaḥ prakampate|
striyā daṣṭo viparyastairetaiḥ puṃsā naro mataḥ||
6.23.132 |  vyāmiśraliṅgairetaistu klībadaṣṭaṃ naraṃ vadet|
ityetaduktaṃ sarpāṇāṃ strīpuṃklībanidarśanam||
6.23.133 |  pāṇḍuvaktrastu garbhiṇyā śūnauṣṭho 'pyasitekṣaṇaḥ|
jṛmbhākrodhopajihvārtaḥ sūtayā raktamūtravān||
6.23.134 |  sarpo gaudhera(ya)ko nāma godhāyāṃ syāccatuṣpadaḥ|
kṛṣṇasarpeṇa tulyaḥ syānnānā syurmiśrajātayaḥ||
6.23.135 |  gūḍhasaṃpāditaṃ vṛttaṃ pīḍitaṃ lambitārpitam|
sarpitaṃ ca bhṛśābādhaṃ, daṃśā ye 'nye na te bhṛśāḥ||
6.23.136 |  taruṇāḥ kṛṣṇasarpāstu gonasāḥ sthavirāstathā|
rājimanto vayomadhye bhavantyāśīviṣopamāḥ||
6.23.137 |  sarpadaṃṣṭrāścatasrastu tāsāṃ vāmādharā sitā|
pītā vāmottarā daṃṣṭrā *raktaśyāvā 'dharottarā||
6.23.138 |  yanmātraḥ patate bindurgobālāt saliloddhṛtāt|
vāmādharāyāṃ daṃṣṭṛāyāṃ tanmātraṃ syādaherviṣam||
6.23.139 |  ekadvitricaturvṛddhaviṣabhāgottarottarāḥ|
savarṇāstatkṛtā daṃśā bahūttaraviṣā bhṛśāḥ||
6.23.140 |  sarpāṇāmeṛva viṇmūtrāt kīṭāḥ syuḥ kīṭasaṃmatāḥ|
dūṣīviṣāḥ prāṇaharā iti saṃkṣepato matāḥ||
6.23.141 |  gātraṃ raktaṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śyāvaṃ vā piḍakānvitam|
sakaṇḍūdāhavīsarpapāki syāt kuthitaṃ tathā||
6.23.142 |  kīṭairdūṣīviṣairdaṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ prāṇaharaṃ śṛṇu|
sarpadaṣṭe yathā śotho vardhate sogragandhyasṛk||
6.23.143 |  daṃśo 'kṣigauravaṃ mūrcchā sa rugārtaḥ śvasityapi|
tṛṣṇāruciparītaśca bhaveddūṣīviṣārditaḥ||
6.23.144 |  daṃśasya madhye yat kṛṣṇaṃ śyāvaṃ vā jālakāvṛtam|
*dagdhākṛti bhṛśaṃ pāki kledaśothajvarānvitam||
6.23.145 |  dūṣīviṣābhirlūtābhistaṃ daṣṭamiti nirdiśet|
sarvāsāmeva tāsāṃ ca daṃśe lakṣaṇamucyate||
6.23.146 |  śophaḥ śvetāsitā raktāḥ pītā vā piḍakā jvaraḥ|
prāṇāntiko bhavecchvāso dāhahikkāśirograhāḥ||
6.23.147 |  ādaṃśācchoṇitaṃ pāṇḍu maṇḍalāni jvaro 'ruciḥ|
lomaharṣaśca dāhaścāpyākhudūṣīviṣārdite||
6.23.148 |  mūrcchāṅgaśothavaivarṇyakledaśabdāśrutijvarāḥ|
śirogurutvaṃ lālāsṛkchardiścāsādhyamūṣikaiḥ||
6.23.149 |  śyāvatvamatha kārṣṇyaṃ vā nānāvarṇatvameva vā|
mohaḥ purīṣabhedaśca daṣṭe syāt kṛkalāsakaiḥ||
6.23.150 |  dahatyagnirivādau tu bhinattīvordhvamāśu ca|
vṛścikasya viṣaṃ yāti daṃśe paścāttu tiṣṭhati||
6.23.151 |  daṣṭo 'sādhyastu *dṛgghrāṇarasanopahato naraḥ|
māṃsaiḥ patadbhiratyarthaṃ vedanārto jahātyasūn||
6.23.152 |  visarpaḥ śvayathuḥ śūlaṃ jvaraśchardirathāpi ca|
lakṣṇaṃ kaṇabhairdaṣṭe daṃśaścaiva viśīryate||
6.23.153 |  hṛṣṭaromocciṭiṅgena stabdhaliṅgo bhṛśārtimān|
daṣṭaḥ śītodakeneva siktānyaṅgāni manyate||
6.23.154 |  ekadaṃṣṭrārditaḥ śūnaḥ saruk syāt pītakaḥ satṛṭ|
chardirnidrā ca maṇḍūkaiḥ saviṣairdaṣṭalakṣaṇam||
6.23.155 |  matsyāstu saviṣāḥ kuryurdāhaśopharujastathā|
kaṇḍūṃ śothaṃ jvaraṃ mūrcchāṃ saviṣāstu jalaukasaḥ||
6.23.156 |  dāhatodasvedaśothakarī tu *gṛhagodhikā|
daṃśe svedaṃ rujaṃ dāhaṃ kuryācchatapadīviṣam||
6.23.157 |  kaṇḍūmānmaśakairīṣacchothaḥ syānmandavedanaḥ|
asādhyakīṭasadṛśamasādhyamaśakakṣatam||
6.23.158 |  sadyaḥprasrāviṇī śyāvā dāhamūrcchājvarānvitā|
pīḍakā makṣikādaṃśe tāsāṃ tu sthagikā 'suhṛt||
6.23.159 |  śmaśānacityavalmīkayajñāśramasurālaye|
pakṣasandhiṣu madhyāhne sārdharātre 'ṣṭamīṣu ca||
6.23.160 |  na siddhyanti narā daṣṭāḥ pāṣaṇḍāyataneṣu ca|
dṛṣṭiśvāsamalasparśaviṣairāśīviṣairtathā||
6.23.161 |  vinaśyantyāśu saṃprāptā daṣṭāḥ sarveṣu marmasu|
(yena kenāpi sarpeṇa saṃbhavaḥ sarva eva ca)||
6.23.162 |  bhītamattābaloṣṇakṣuttṛṣārte vardhate viṣam|
viṣaṃ prakṛtikālau ca tulyau *prāpyālpamanyathā||
6.23.163 |  vāriviprahatāḥ kṣīṇā bhītā nakulanirjitāḥ|
vṛddhā bālāstvaco muktāḥ sarpā mandaviṣāḥ smṛtāḥ||
6.23.164 |  sarvadehāśritaṃ krodhādviṣaṃ sarpo vimuñcati|
tadevāhārahetorvā bhayādvā na pramuñcati||
6.23.165 |  vātolbaṇaviṣāḥ prāya ucciṭiṅgāḥ savṛścikāḥ|
vātapittolbaṇāḥ kīṭāḥ ślaiṣmikāḥ kaṇabhādayaḥ||
6.23.166 |  yasya yasya hi doṣasya liṅgādhikyāni lakṣayet|
tasya tasyauṣadhaiḥ kuryādviparītaguṇaiḥ kriyām||
6.23.167 |  hṛtpīḍordhvānilaḥ stambhaḥ sirāyāmo 'sthiparvaruk|
ghūrṇanodveṣṭanaṃ gātraśyāvatā vātike viṣe||
6.23.168 |  saṃjñānāśoṣṇaniśvāsau hṛddāhaḥ kaṭukāsyatā|
*daṃśāvadaraṇaṃ śotho raktapītaśca paittike||
6.23.169 |  vamyarocakahṛllāsaprasekotkleśagauravaiḥ|
saśaityamukhamādhuryairvidyācchleṣmādhikaṃ viṣam||
6.23.170 |  khaṇḍena ca vraṇālepastailābhyaṅgaśca vātike|
svedo nāḍīpulākādyairbṛṃhaṇaśca vidhirhitaḥ||
6.23.171 |  suśītaiḥ stambhayet sekaiḥ pradehaiścāpi paittikam|
lekhanacchedanasvedavamanaiḥ ślaiṣmikaṃ jayet||
6.23.172 |  viṣeṣvapi ca sarveṣu sarvasthānagateṣu ca|
avṛścikocciṭiṅgeṣu prāyaḥ śīto vidhirhitaḥ||
6.23.173 |  vṛścike svedamabhyaṅgaṃ ghṛtena lavaṇena ca|
sekāṃścoṣṇān prayuñjīta bhojyaṃ pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ||
6.23.174 |  etadevocciṭiṅge 'pi pratilomaṃ ca pāṃśubhiḥ|
udvartanaṃ sukhāmbūṣṇaistathā 'vacchādanaṃ ghanaiḥ||
6.23.175 |  śvā tridoṣaprakopāttu tathā dhātuviparyayāt|
śiro 'bhitāpī lālāsrāvyadhovaktrastathā bhavet||
6.23.176 |  anye 'pyevaṃvidhā vyālāḥ kaphavātaprakopaṇāḥ|
hṛcchirorugjvarastambhatṛṣāmūrcchākarā matāḥ||
6.23.177 |  kaṇḍūnistodavaivarṇyasuptikledopaśoṣaṇam|
vidāharāgarukpākāḥ śopho granthinikuñcanam||
6.23.178 |  *daṃśāvadaraṇaṃ sphoṭāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca|
jvaraśca saviṣe liṅgaṃ viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe||
6.23.179 |  tatra sarve *yathāvasthaṃ prayojyāḥ syurupakramāḥ|
pūrvoktā vidhimanyaṃ ca yathāvadbruvataḥ śṛṇu||
6.23.180 |  hṛdvidāhe praseke vā virekavamanaṃ bhṛśam|
yathāvasthaṃ prayoktavyaṃ śuddhe saṃsarjanakramaḥ||
6.23.181 |  śirogate viṣe nastaḥ kuryānmūlāni buddhimān|
bandhujīvasya bhārgyāśca surasasyāsitasya ca||
6.23.182 |  dakṣakākamayūrāṇāṃ māṃsāsṛṅmastake kṣate|
*upadheyamadhodaṣṭasyordhvadaṣṭasya pādayoḥ||
6.23.183 |  pippalīmaricakṣāravacāsaindhavaśigrukāḥ|
piṣṭā rohitapittena ghnantyakṣigatamañjanāt||
6.23.184 |  kapitthamāmaṃ sasitākṣaudraṃ kaṇṭhagate viṣe|
lihyādāmāśayagate tābhyāṃ cūrṇapalaṃ natāt||
6.23.185 |  viṣe pakvāśayagate pippalīṃ rajanīdvayam|
mañjiṣṭhāṃ ca samaṃ piṣṭvā gopittena naraḥ pibet||
6.23.186 |  raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca godhāyāḥ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ hitam|
viṣe rasagate pānaṃ kapittharasasaṃyutam||
