6.23.187 |  śelormūlatvagagrāṇi bādaraudumbarāṇi ca|
kaṭabhyāśca pibedraktagate, māṃsagate pibet||
6.23.188 |  sakṣaudraṃ khadirāriṣṭaṃ kauṭajaṃ mūlamambhasā|
sarveṣu ca bale dve tu madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ natam||
6.23.189 |  pippalīṃ *nāgaraṃ kṣāraṃ navanītena mūrcchitam|
kaphe bhiṣagudīrṇe tu vidadhyātpratisāraṇam||
6.23.190 |  māṃsīkuṅkumapatratvagrajanīnatacandanaiḥ|
manaḥśilāvyāghranakhasurasairambupeṣitaiḥ||
6.23.191 |  pānanasyāñjanālepāḥ sarvaśothaviṣāpahāḥ|
candanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haridre dve tvageva ca||
6.23.192 |  manaḥśilā tamālaśca rasaḥ kaiśara eva ca|
śārdūlasya nakhaścaiva supiṣṭaṃ taṇḍulāmbunā||
6.23.193 |  hanti sarvaviṣāṇyeva vajrivajramivāsurān|
rase śirīṣapuṣpasya saptāhaṃ maricaṃ sitam||
6.23.194 |  bhāvitaṃ sarpadaṣṭānāṃ nasyapānāñjane hitam|
dvipalaṃ natakuṣṭhābhyāṃ ghṛtakṣaudracatuṣpalam||
6.23.195 |  api takṣakadaṣṭānāṃ pānametat sukhapradam|
sindhuvārasya mūlaṃ ca śvetā ca girikarṇikā||
6.23.196 |  pānaṃ darvīkarairdaṣṭe nasyaṃ samadhu pākalam|
mañjiṣṭhā madhuyaṣṭī ca jīvakarṣabhakau sitā||
6.23.197 |  kāśmaryaṃ vaṭaśuṅgāni pānaṃ maṇḍalināṃ viṣe|
vyoṣaṃ sātiviṣaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ gṛhadhūmo hareṇukā||
6.23.198 |  tagaraṃ kaṭukā kṣaudraṃ hanti rājīmatāṃ viṣam|
gṛhadhūmaṃ haridre dve samūlaṃ taṇḍulīyakam||
6.23.199 |  api vāsukinā daṣṭaḥ *pibenmadhughṛtāplutam|
kṣīrivṛkṣatvagālepaḥ śuddhe kīṭaviṣāpahaḥ||
6.23.200 |  muktālepo varaḥ śothadāhatodajvarāpahaḥ|
candanaṃ padmakośīraṃ śirīṣaḥ sindhuvārikā||
6.23.201 |  kṣīraśuklā nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ pāṭalodīcyasārivāḥ|
śelusvarasapiṣṭo 'yaṃ lūtānāṃ sārvakārmikaḥ||
6.23.202 |  (yathāyogaṃ prayoktavyaḥ samīkṣyālepanādiṣu)|
madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śirīṣodīcyapāṭalāḥ|
sanimbasārivākṣaudrāḥ pānaṃ lūtāviṣāpaham||
6.23.203 |  kusumbhapuṣpaṃ godantaḥ svarṇakṣīrī kapotaviṭ|
dantī trivṛtsaindhavaṃ ca karṇikāpātanaṃ tayoḥ||
6.23.204 |  kaṭabhyarjinaśairīṣaśelukṣīridrumatvacaḥ|
kaṣāyakalkacūrṇāḥ syuḥ kīṭalūtāvraṇāpahāḥ||
6.23.205 |  tvacaṃ ca nāgaraṃ caiva samāṃśaṃ ślakṣṇapeṣitam|
peyamuṣṇāmbunā sarvaṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣāpaham||
6.23.206 |  kuṭajasya phalaṃ piṣṭaṃ tagaraṃ jālamālinī|
tiktekṣvākuśca yogo 'yaṃ pānapradhamanādibhiḥ||
6.23.207 |  vṛścikondurulūtānāṃ sarpāṇāṃ ca viṣaṃ haret|
samāno hyamṛtenāyaṃ garājīrṇaṃ ca nāśayet||
6.23.208 |  sarve 'gadā yathādoṣaṃ prayojyāḥ syuḥ kṛkaṇṭake|
kapotaviṇmātuluṅgaṃ śirīṣakusumādrasaḥ||
6.23.209 |  śaṅkhinyārkaṃ payaḥ śuṇṭhī karañjo madhu vārścike|
śirīṣasya phalaṃ piṣṭaṃ snuhīkṣīreṇa dārdure||
6.23.210 |  mūlāni śvetabhaṇḍīnāṃ vyoṣaṃ sarpiśca matsyaje|
kīṭadaṣṭakriyāḥ sarvāḥ samānāḥ syurjalaukasām||
6.23.211 |  vātapittaharī cāpi kriyā prāyaḥ praśasyate|
vārściko hyucciṭiṅgasya *kaṇabhasyaunduro 'gadaḥ||
6.23.212 |  vacāṃ vaṃśatvacaṃ pāṭhāṃ nataṃ surasamañjarīm|
dve bale nākulīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śirīṣaṃ rajanīdvayam||
6.23.213 |  guhāmatiguhāṃ śvetāmajagandhāṃ śilājatu|
kattṛṇaṃ kaṭabhīṃ kṣāraṃ gṛhadhūmaṃ manaḥśilām||
6.23.214 |  rohītakasya pittena piṣṭvā tu paramo 'gadaḥ|
nasyāñjanādilepeṣu hito viśvambharādiṣu||
6.23.215 |  svarjikā 'jaśakṛtkṣāraḥ surasā+*athākṣipīḍakaḥ|
madirāmaṇḍasaṃyukto hitaḥ śatapadīviṣe||
6.23.216 |  kapitthamakṣipīḍo 'rkabījaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tathā|
karañjo dve haridre ca *gṛhagodhāviṣaṃ jayet||
6.23.217 |  *kākāṇḍarasasaṃyukto viṣāṇāṃ taṇḍulīyakaḥ|
pradhāno barhipittena tadvadvāyasapīlukaḥ||
6.23.218 |  śirīṣaphalamūlatvakpuṣpapatraiḥ samairdhṛtaiḥ|
śreṣṭhaḥ pañcaśirīṣo 'yaṃ viṣāṇāṃ pravaro vadhe||
iti pañcaśirīṣo 'gadaḥ|
6.23.219 |  catuṣpadbhirdvipadbhirvā nakhadantakṣataṃ tu yat|
śūyate pacyate cāpi sravati jvarayatyapi||
6.23.220 |  somavalko 'śvakarṇaśca gojihvā haṃsapadyapi|
rajanyau gairikaṃ lepo nakhadantaviṣāpahaḥ||
6.23.221 |  durandhakāre *viddhasya kenacidviṣaśaṅkayā|
viṣodvegājjvaraśchardirmūrcchā dāho 'pi vā bhavet||
6.23.222 |  glānirmoho 'tisāraścāpyetacchaṅkāviṣaṃ matam|
cikitsitamidaṃ tasya kuryādāśvāsayan budhaḥ||
6.23.223 |  sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu|
pānaṃ samantrapūtāmbu prokṣaṇaṃ sāntvaharṣaṇam||
6.23.224 |  śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikāścaiva koradūṣāḥ priyaṅgavaḥ|
bhojanārthe praśasyante lavaṇārthe ca saindhavam||
6.23.225 |  taṇḍulīyakajīyantīvārtākasuniṣaṇṇakāḥ|
cucūrmaṇḍūkaparṇī ca śākaṃ ca kulakaṃ hitam||
6.23.226 |  dhātrī dāḍimamamlārthe yūṣā mudgahareṇubhiḥ|
rasāścaiṇaśikhiśvāvillāvataittirapārṣatāḥ||
6.23.227 |  viṣaghnauṣadhasaṃyuktā rasā yūṣāśca saṃskṛtāḥ|
avidāhīni cānnāni viṣārtānāṃ bhiṣagjitam||
6.23.228 |  viruddhādhyaśanakrodhakṣudbhayāyāsamaithunam|
varjayedviṣamukto 'pi divāsvapnaṃ viśeṣataḥ||
6.23.229 |  muhurmuhuḥ śironyāsaḥ śothaḥ *srastauṣṭhakarṇatā|
jvaraḥ stabdhākṣigātratvaṃ hanukampo 'ṅgamardanam||
6.23.230 |  romāpagamanaṃ glāniraratirvepathurbhramaḥ|
catuṣpadāṃ bhavatyetaddaṣṭānāmiha lakṣaṇam||
6.23.231 |  devadāru haridre dve *saralaṃ candanāguru|
rāsnā gorocanā 'jājī guggulvikṣuraso natam||
6.23.232 |  cūrṇaṃ sasaindhavānantaṃ gopittamadhusaṃyutam|
catuṣpadānāṃ daṣṭānāmagadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ||
6.23.233 |  saubhāgyārthaṃ striyaḥ svedarajonānāṅgajānmalān|
śatruprayuktāṃśca garān prayacchantyannamiśritān||
6.23.234 |  taiḥ syāt pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo 'lpāgnirgaraścāsyopajāyate|
marmapradhamanādhmānaṃ śvayathuṃ hastapādayoḥ||
6.23.235 |  jaṭharaṃ grahaṇīdoṣo yakṣmā gulmaḥ kṣayo *jvaraḥ|
evaṃvidhasya cānyasya vyādherliṅgāni darśayet||
6.23.236 |  svapne mārjāragomāyuvyālān sanakulān kapīn|
prāyaḥ paśyati nadyādīñchuṣkāṃśca savanaspatīn||
6.23.237 |  kālaśca gauramātmānaṃ svapne gauraśca kālakam|
vikarṇanāsikaṃ vā 'pi *prapaśyedvihatendriyaḥ||
6.23.238 |  tamavekṣya bhiṣak prājñaḥ pṛcchet kiṃ kaiḥ kadā saha|
jagdhamityavagamyāśu pradadyādvamanaṃ bhiṣak||
6.23.239 |  sūkṣmaṃ tāmrarajastasmai sakṣaudraṃ hṛdviśodhanam|
śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet||
6.23.240 |  hema sarvaviṣāṇyāśu garāṃśca viniyacchati|
na sajjate hemapāṅge viṣaṃ padmadale 'mbuvat||
6.23.241 |  nāgadantītrivṛddantīdravantīsnukpayaḥphalaiḥ|
sādhitaṃ māhiṣaṃ sarpiḥ sagomūtrāḍhakaṃ hitam||
6.23.242 |  sarpakīṭaviṣārtānāṃ garārtānāṃ ca śāntaye|
śirīṣatvak trikaṭukaṃ triphalāṃ candanotpale||
6.23.243 |  dve bale sārivāsphotāsurabhīnimbapāṭalāḥ|
bandhujīvāḍhakīmūrvāvāsāsurasavatsakān||
6.23.244 |  pāṭhāṅkolāśvagandhārkamūlayaṣṭyāhvapadmakān|
viśālāṃ bṛhatīṃ lākṣāṃ kovidāraṃ śatāvarīm||
6.23.245 |  kaṭabhīdantyapāmārgān pṛśniparṇīṃ rasāñjanam|
śvetabhaṇḍāśvakhurakau kuṣṭhadārupriyaṅgukān||
6.23.246 |  vidārīṃ madhukāt sāraṃ karañjasya phalatvacau|
rajanyau lodhramakṣāṃśaṃ piṣṭvā sādhyaṃ ghṛtāḍhakam||
6.23.247 |  tulyāmbucchāgagomūtratryāḍhake tadviṣāpaham|
apasmārakṣayonmādabhūtagrahagarodaram||
6.23.248 |  pāṇḍurogakrimīgulmaplīhorustambhakāmalāḥ|
hanuskandhagrahādīṃśca pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ||
6.23.249 |  hanyāt saṃjīvayeccāpi viṣodbandhamṛtānnarān|
nāmnedamamṛtaṃ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ syādghṛtottamam||
ityamṛtaghṛtam|
6.23.250 |  bhavanti cātra---
chatrī jharjharapāṇiśca caredrātrau tathā divā|
tacchāyāśabdavitrastāḥ praṇaśyantyāśu pannagāḥ||
6.23.251 |  daṣṭamātro daśedāśu taṃ sarpaṃ loṣṭameva vā|
uparyariṣṭāṃ badhnīyāddaṃśaṃ chindyāddahettathā||
6.23.252 |  vajraṃ marakataḥ sāraḥ picuko viṣamūṣikā|
karketanaḥ sarpamaṇirvaidūryaṃ gajamauktikam||
6.23.253 |  dhāryaṃ garamaṇiryāśca varauṣadhyo viṣāpahāḥ|
khagāśca śārikākrauñcaśikhihaṃsaśukādayaḥ||
6.23.254 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
itīdamuktaṃ dvividhasya vistarairbahuprakāraṃ viṣarogabheṣajam|
adhītya vijñāya tathā prayojayan varjedviṣāṇāmaviṣahyatāṃ budhaḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne viṣacikitsitaṃ nāma tryoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||23 | |

caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.24.1 |  athāto madātyayacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.24.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.24.3 |  suraiḥ sureśasahitairyā *purā paripūjitā|
sautrāmaṇyāṃ hūyate yā karmibhiryā pratiṣṭhitā||
6.24.4 |  yajñauhī yā yayā śakraḥ somātipatito bhṛśam|
nirojastamasā++āviṣṭastasmāddurgāt samuddhṛtaḥ||
6.24.5 |  vidhibhirvedavihitairvā yajadbhirmahātmabhiḥ|
dṛśyā spṛśyā prakalpyā ca yajñīyā yajñasiddhaye||
6.24.6 |  yonisaṃskāranāmādyairviśeṣairbahudhā ca yā|
bhūtvā bhavatyekavidhā sāmānyānmadalakṣaṇāt||
6.24.7 |  yā devānamṛtaṃ bhūtvā svadhā bhūtvā pitṛṛṃśca yā|
somo bhūtvā dvijātīn yā yuṅkte śreyobhiruttamaiḥ||
6.24.8 |  āśvinaṃ yā mahattejo balaṃ sārasvataṃ ca yā|
vīryamaindraṃ ca yā siddhā somaḥ sautrāmaṇau ca yā||
6.24.9 |  śokāratibhayodveganāśinī yā mahābalā|
yā prītiryā ratiryā vāgyā puṣṭiryā ca nirvṛtiḥ||
6.24.10 |  yā surā suragandharvayakṣarākṣasamānuṣaiḥ|
ratiḥ suretyabhihitā tāṃ surāṃ vidhinā pibet||
6.24.11 |  śarīrakṛtasaṃskāraḥ śuciruttamagandhavān|
prāvṛto nirmalairvastrairyathartūddāmagandhibhiḥ||
6.24.12 |  vicitravividhasragvī ratnābhraṇabhūṣitaḥ|
devadvijātīn saṃpūjya spṛṣṭvā maṅgalamuttamam||
6.24.13 |  deśe yathartuke śaste kusumaprakarīkṛte|
*sarasāsaṃmate mukhye dhūpasaṃmodabodhite||
6.24.14 |  sopadhāne susaṃstīrṇe vihite śayanāsane|
upaviṣṭo 'thavā tiryak svaśarīrasukhe sthitaḥ||
6.24.15 |  sauvarṇau rājataiścāpi tathā maṇimayairapi|
bhājanairvimalaiścānyaiḥ sukṛtaiśca pibet sadā||
6.24.16 |  rūpayauvanamattābhiḥ śikṣitābhirviśeṣataḥ|
vastrābharaṇamālyaiśca bhūṣitābhiryathartukaiḥ||
6.24.17 |  śaucānurāgayuktābhiḥ pramadābhiritastataḥ|
saṃvāhyamāna *iṣṭābhiḥ pibenmadyamanuttamam||
6.24.18 |  madyānukūlairvividhaiḥ phalairharitakaiḥ śubhaiḥ|
lavaṇairgandhapiśunairavadaṃśairyathartukaiḥ||
6.24.19 |  bhṛṣṭairmāṃsairbahuvidhairbhūjalāmbaracāriṇām|
paurogavargavihitairbhakṣyaiśca vividhātmakaiḥ||
6.24.20 |  *pūjayitvā surān pūrmāśiṣaḥ prāk prayujya ca|
pradāya sajalaṃ madyamarthibhyo vasudhātale||
6.24.21 |  abhyaṅgotsādanasnānavāsodhūpānulepanaiḥ|
snigdhoṣṇairbhāvitaścānnairvātiko madyamācaret||
6.24.22 |  śītopacārairvividhairmadhurasnigdhaśītalaiḥ|
paittiko bhāvitaścānnaiḥ pibanmadyaṃ na sīdati||
6.24.23 |  upacārairaśiśirairyavagodhūmabhuk pibet|
ślaiṣmiko dhanvajairmāṃsairmadyaṃ māricakaiḥ saha||
6.24.24 |  vidhirvasumatāmeṣa bhaviṣyadvibhavāśca ye|
yathopapatti tairmadyaṃ pātavyaṃ mātrayā hitam||
6.24.25 |  vātikebhyo hitaṃ madyaṃ prāyo gauḍikapaiṣṭikam|
kaphapittādhikebhyastu mārdvīkaṃ mādhavaṃ ca yat||
6.24.26 |  bahudravyaṃ bahuguṇaṃ bahukarma madātmakam|
guṇairdoṣaiśca tanmadyamubhayaṃ copalakṣyate||
6.24.27 |  vidhinā mātrayā kāle hitairannairyathābalam|
prahṛṣṭo yaḥ pibenmadyaṃ tasya syādamṛtaṃ yathā||
6.24.28 |  yathopetaṃ punarmadyaṃ prasaṅgādyena pīyate|
rūkṣavyāyāmanityena viṣavadyāti tasya tat||
6.24.29 |  madyaṃ hṛdayamāviśya svaguṇairojaso guṇān|
daśabhirdaśa saṃkṣobhya ceto nayati vikriyām||
6.24.30 |  laghūṣṇatīkṣṇasūkṣmāmlavyavāyyāśugameva ca|
rūkṣaṃ vikāśi viśadaṃ madyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam||
6.24.31 |  guru śītaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇaṃ bahalaṃ madhuraṃ sthiram|
prasannaṃ picchilaṃ snigdhamojo daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam||
6.24.32 |  gurutvaṃ lāghavācchaityamauṣṇādamlasvabhāvataḥ|
mādhuryaṃ mārdavaṃ taikṣṇyātprasādaṃ cāśubhāvanāt||
6.24.33 |  raukṣyāt snehaṃ vyavāyitvāt sthiratvaṃ ślakṣṇatāmapi|
vikāsibhāvātpaicchilyaṃ vaiśadyātsāndratāṃ tathā||
6.24.34 |  saukṣmyānmadyaṃ vihantyevamojasaḥ svaguṇairguṇān|
sattvaṃ tadāśrayaṃ cāśu saṃkṣobhya janayenmadam||
6.24.35 |  *rasavātādimārgāṇāṃ sattvabuddhīndriyātmanām|
pradhānasyaujasaścaiva hṛdayaṃ sthānamucyate||
6.24.36 |  atipītena madyena vihatenaujasā ca tat|
hṛdayaṃ yāti vikṛtiṃ tatrasthā ye ca dhātavaḥ||
6.24.37 |  aujasyavihate pūrvo hṛdi ca pratibodhite|
madhyamo vihate 'lpe ca vihate tūttamo madhaḥ||
6.24.38 |  naivaṃ vighātaṃ janayenmadyaṃ paiṣṭikamojasaḥ|
vikāśirūkṣaviśadā guṇāstatra hi nolbaṇāḥ||
6.24.39 |  hṛdi madyaguṇāviṣṭe harṣastarṣo ratiḥ sukham|
vikārāśca yathāsattvaṃ citrā rājasatāmasāḥ||
6.24.40 |  jāyante mohanidrāntā madyasyātiniṣevaṇāt|
sa madyavibhramo nāmnā 'mada' ityabhidhīyate||
6.24.41 |  pīyamānasya madyasya vijñātavyāstrayo madāḥ|
prathamo madhyamo 'ntyaśca lakṣaṇaistān pracakṣmahe||
6.24.42 |  praharṣaṇaḥ prītikaraḥ pānānnaguṇadarśakaḥ|
vādyagītaprahāsānāṃ kathānāṃ ca pravartakaḥ||
6.24.43 |  na ca buddhismṛtiharo viṣayeṣu na cākṣamaḥ|
sukhanidrāprabodhaśca prathamaḥ sukhado madaḥ||
6.24.44 |  muhuḥ smṛtirmuhurmoho*( ')vyaktā sajjati vāṅmuhuḥ|
yuktāyuktapralāpaśca pracalāyanameva ca||
6.24.45 |  sthānapānānnasāṃkathyayojanā saviparyayā|
liṅgānyetāni jānīyādāviṣṭe madhyame made||
6.24.46 |  madhyamaṃ dadamutkramya *madamāprāpya cottamam|
na kiṃcinnāśubhaṃ kuryurnarā rājasatāmasāḥ||
6.24.47 |  ko madaṃ tādṛśaṃ vidvānunmādamiva dāruṇam|
gacchedadhvānamasvantaṃ bahudoṣamivādhvagaḥ||
6.24.48 |  tṛtīyaṃ tu madaṃ prāpya bhagndārviva niṣkriyaḥ|
madamohāvṛtamanā jīvannapi mṛtaiḥ samaḥ||
6.24.49 |  ramaṇīyān sa viṣayānna vetti na suhṛjjanam|
yadarthaṃ pīyate madyaṃ ratiṃ tāṃ ca na vindati||
6.24.50 |  kāryākāryaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ loke yacca hitāhitam|
yadavastho na jānāti ko 'vasthāṃ tāṃ vrajedbudhaḥ||
6.24.51 |  sa dūṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nindyaścāgrāhya eva ca|
vyasanitvādudarke ca sa duḥkhaṃ vyādhimaśnute||
6.24.52 |  pretya ceha ca yacchreyaḥ śreyo mokṣe ca yat param|
manaḥsamādhau tat sarvamāyattaṃ sarvadehinām||
6.24.53 |  madyena manasaścāsya saṃkṣobhaḥ kriyate mahān|
mahāmārutavegena taṭasthasyeva śākhinaḥ||
6.24.54 |  madyaprasaṅgaṃ taṃ cājñā mahādoṣaṃ mahāgadam|
sukhamityadhigacchanti rajomohaparājitāḥ||
6.24.55 |  madyopahatavijñānā viyuktāḥ sāttvikairguṇaiḥ|
śreyobhirviprayujyante madāndhā madalālasāḥ||
6.24.56 |  madye moho bhayaṃ śokaḥ krodho mṛtyuśca saṃśritaḥ|
sonmādamadamūrcchāyāḥ sāpasmārāpatānakāḥ||
6.24.57 |  yatraikaḥ smṛtivibhraṃśastatra sarvamasādhuvat|
ityevaṃ madyadoṣajñā madyaṃ garhanti yatnataḥ||
6.24.58 |  satyamete mahādoṣā madyasyoktā na saṃśayaḥ|
ahitasyātimātrasya pītasya vidhivarjitam||
6.24.59 |  kiṃtu madyaṃ svabhāvena yathaivānnaṃ tathā smṛtam|
ayuktiyuktaṃ rogāya yuktiyuktaṃ yathā 'mṛtam||
6.24.60 |  prāṇāḥ prāṇabhṛtāmannaṃ tadayuktyā nihantyasūn|
viṣaṃ prāṇaharaṃ tacca yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanam||
6.24.61 |  harṣamūrjaṃ mudaṃ puṣṭimārogyaṃ pauruṣaṃ *param|
yuktyā pītaṃ karotyāśu madyaṃ sukhamadapradam||
6.24.62 |  rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ hṛdyaṃ svaravarṇaprasādanam|
prīṇanaṃ bṛṃhanaṃ balyaṃ bhayaśokaśramāpaham||
6.24.63 |  svāpanaṃ naṣṭanidrāṇāṃ mūkānāṃ vāgvibodhanam|
bodhanaṃ cātinidrāṇāṃ vibaddhānāṃ vibandhanut||
6.24.64 |  vadhabandhaparikleśaduḥkhānāṃ cāpyabodhanam|
madyotthānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ madyameva prabādhakam||
6.24.65 |  ratirviṣayasaṃyoge prītisaṃyogavardhanam|
api pravayasāṃ madyamutsavāmodakārakam||
6.24.66 |  pañcasvartheṣu kānteṣu yā ratiḥ prathame made|
yūnāṃ vā sthavirāṇāṃ vā tasya nāstyupamā bhuvi||
6.24.67 |  bahuduḥkhahatasyāsya śokenopahatasya ca|
viśrāmo jīvalokasya madyaṃ yuktyā niṣevitam||
6.24.68 |  annapānavayovyādhibalakālatrikāṇi ṣaṭ|
trīndoṣāṃstrividhaṃ sattvaṃ jñātvā madyaṃ pibetsadā||
6.24.69 |  teṣāṃ trikāṇāmaṣṭānāṃ yojñā yuktirucyate|
yayā yuktyā pibanmadyaṃ madyadoṣairna yujyate||
6.24.70 |  madyasya ca guṇān sarvān yathoktān sa samaśnute|
dharmārthayorapīḍāyai naraḥ sattvaguṇocchritaḥ||
6.24.71 |  sattvāni tu prabudhyante prāyaśaḥ prathame made|
dvitīye 'vyaktatāṃ yānti madhye cottamamadhyayoḥ|
6.24.72 |  sasyasaṃbodhakaṃ varṣaṃ, hemaprakṛtidarśakaḥ|
hutāśaḥ, sarvasattvānāṃ madyaṃ tūbhayakārakam||
6.24.73 |  pradhānāvaramadhyānāṃ *rūpāṇāṃ vyaktidarśakaḥ|
yathā 'gnirevaṃ sattvānāṃ madyaṃ prakṛtidarśakam||
6.24.74 |  sugandhimālyagandharvaṃ supraṇītamamākulam|
miṣṭānnapānaviśadaṃ sadā madhurasaṃkatham||
6.24.75 |  *sukhaprapānaṃ sumadaṃ harṣaprītivivardhanam|
svantaṃ sāttvikamāpānaṃ na cottamamadapradam||
6.24.76 |  vaiguṇyaṃ sahasā yānti madyadoṣairna sāttvikāḥ|
madyaṃ hi balavatsattvaṃ gṛhṇāti sahasā na *tu||
6.24.77 |  saumyāsaumyakathāprāyaṃ viśadāviśadaṃ kṣaṇāt|
citraṃ rājasamāpannaṃ prāyeṇāsvantakākulam||
6.24.78 |  harṣaprītikathāpetamatuṣṭaṃ pānabhojane|
saṃmohakrodhanidrāntamāpānaṃ tāmasaṃ smṛtam||
6.24.79 |  āpāne sāttvikān buddhvā tathā rājasatāmasān|
jahyātsahāyān yaiḥ pītvā madyadoṣānupāśnute||
6.24.80 |  sukhaśīlāḥ susaṃbhāṣāḥ sumukhāḥ saṃmatāḥ satām|
kalāsvabāhyā viśadā viṣayapravaṇāśca ye||
6.24.81 |  parasparavidheyā ye yeṣāmaikyaṃ suhṛttayā|
praharṣaprītimādhuryairāpānaṃ vardhayanti ye||
6.24.82 |  utsavādutsavataraṃ yeṣāmanyonyadarśanam|
te sahāyāḥ sukhāḥ pāne taiḥ pibansaha modate||
6.24.83 |  rūpagandharasasparśaiḥ śabdaiścāpi manoramaiḥ|
pibanti susahāyā ye te vai sukṛtibhiḥ samāḥ||
6.24.84 |  *pañcabhirviṣayairiṣṭairupetairmanasaḥ priyaiḥ|
deśe kāle pibenmadyaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā||
6.24.85 |  sthirasattvaśarīrā ye pūrvānnā madyapānvayāḥ|
bahumadyocitā ye ca mādyanti sahasā na te||
6.24.86 |  *kṣutpipāsāparītāśca durbalā vātapaittikāḥ|
rūkṣālpapramitāhārā viṣṭabdhāḥ sattvadurbalāḥ||
6.24.87 |  krodhino 'nucitāḥ kṣīṇāḥ pariśrāntā madakṣatāḥ|
svalpenāpi madaṃ śīghraṃ yānti madyena mānavāḥ||
6.24.88 |  ūrdhvaṃ madātyayasyātaḥ saṃbhavaṃ svasvalakṣaṇam|
agniveśa! cikitsāṃ ca pravakṣyāmi yathākramam||
6.24.89 |  strīśokabhayabhārādhvakarmabhiryo 'tikarśitaḥ|
rūkṣālpapramitāśī ca yaḥ pibatyatimātrayā||
6.24.90 |  rūkṣaṃ pariṇataṃ madyaṃ niśi nidrāṃ vihatya ca|
karoti tasya tacchīghraṃ vātaprāyaṃ madātyayam||
6.24.91 |  hikkāśvāsaśiraḥkampapārśvaśūlaprajāgaraiḥ|
vidyādbahupralāpasya vātaprāyaṃ madātyayam||
6.24.92 |  tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ madyamamlaṃ ca yo 'timātraṃ niṣevate|
amloṣṇatīkṣṇabhojī ca krodhano 'gnyātapapriyaḥ||
6.24.93 |  tasyopajāyate pittādviśeṣeṇa madātyayaḥ|
*sa tu vātolbaṇasyāśu praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā||
6.24.94 |  tṛṣṇādāhajvarasvedamūrcchātīsāravibhramaiḥ|
vidyāddharitavarṇasya pittaprāyaṃ madātyayam||
6.24.95 |  taruṇaṃ madhuraprāyaṃ gauḍaṃ paiṣṭikameva vā|
madhurasnigdhagurvāśī yaḥ pibatyatimātrayā||
6.24.96 |  avyāyāmadivāsvapnaśayyāsanasukhe rataḥ|
madātyayaṃ kaphaprāyaṃ sa śīghramadhigacchati||
6.24.97 |  chardyarocakahṛllāsatandrāstaimityagauravaiḥ|
vidyācchītaparītasya kaphaprāyaṃ madātyayam||
6.24.98 |  viṣasya ye guṇā dṛṣṭāḥ sannipātaprakopaṇāḥ|
ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe tu balavattarāḥ||
6.24.99 |  hantyāśu hi viṣaṃ kiṃcit kiṃcidrogāya kalpate|
yathā viṣaṃ tathaivāntyo jñeyo madyakṛto madaḥ||
6.24.100 |  tasmāt tridoṣajaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvatrāpi madātyaye|
dṛśyate rūpavaiśeṣyāt pṛthaktvaṃ *cāsya lakṣyate||
6.24.101 |  śarīraduḥkhaṃ balavat *saṃmoho hṛdayavyathā|
aruciḥ *pratatā tṛṣṇā jvaraḥ śītoṣṇalakṣaṇaḥ||
6.24.102 |  śiraḥpārśvāsthisandhīnāṃ *vidyuttulyā ca vedanā|
jāyate 'tibalā jṛmbhā sphuraṇaṃ vepanaṃ śramaḥ||
6.24.103 |  urovibandhaḥ kāsaśca hikkā śvāsaḥ prajāgaraḥ|
śarīrakampaḥ karṇākṣimukharogastrikagrahaḥ||
6.24.104 |  chardyatīsārahṛllāsā vātapittakaphātmakāḥ|
bhramaḥ pralāpo rūpāṇāmasatāṃ caiva darśanam||
6.24.105 |  tṛṇabhasmalatāparṇapāṃśubhiścāvapūraṇam|
pradharṣaṇaṃ vihaṅgaiśca bhrāntacetāḥ sa manyate||
6.24.106 |  vyākulānāmaśastānāṃ svapnānāṃ darśanāni ca|
madātyayasya rūpāṇi sarvāṇyetāni lakṣyate||
6.24.107 |  sarvaṃ madātyayaṃ vidyāt tridoṣamadhikaṃ tu yam|
doṣaṃ madātyaye paśyet tasyādau pratikārayet||
6.24.108 |  kaphasthānānupūrvyā ca kriyā kāryā madātyaye|
pittamārutaparyantaḥ prāyeṇa hi madātyayaḥ||
6.24.109 |  mithyātihīnapītena yo vyādhirupajāyate|
samapītena tenaiva sa madyenopaśāmyati||
6.24.110 |  jīrṇāmamadyadoṣāya madyameva pradāpayet|
prakāṅkṣālāghave jāte yadyadasmai hitaṃ bhavet||
6.24.111 |  sauvarcalānusaṃviddhaṃ śītaṃ sabiḍasaindhavam|
mātuluṅgārdrakopetaṃ jalayuktaṃ *pramāṇavit||
6.24.112 |  tīkṣoṣṇenātimātreṇa pītenāmlavidāhinā|
madyenānnarasotkledo vidagdhaḥ kṣāratāṃ gataḥ||
6.24.113 |  antardāhaṃ jvaraṃ tṛṣṇāṃ pramohaṃ vibhramaṃ madam|
janayatyāśu tacchāntyai madyameva pradāpayet||
6.24.114 |  kṣāro hi yāti mādhuryaṃ śīghramamlopasaṃhitaḥ|
śreṣṭhamamleṣu madyaṃ ca yairguṇaistān paraṃ śṛṇu||
6.24.115 |  madyasyāmlasvabhāvasya catvāro 'nurasāḥ smṛtāḥ|
madhuraśca kaṣāyaśca tiktaḥ kaṭuka eva ca||
6.24.116 |  guṇāśca daśa pūrvoktāstaiścaturdaśabhirguṇaiḥ|
sarveṣāṃ madyamamlānāmuparyupari tiṣṭhati||
6.24.117 |  madhotklaṣṭena doṣeṇa *ruddhaḥ srotaḥsu mārutaḥ|
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ śirasyasthiṣu sandhiṣu||
6.24.118 |  doṣaviṣyandanārthaṃ hi *tasmai madyaṃ viśeṣataḥ|
vyavāyitīkṣṇoṣṇatayā deyamamle(nye)ṣu satsvapi||
6.24.119 |  srotovibandhanunmadyaṃ mārutasyānulomanam|
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ cāgnerabhyāsāt sātmyameva ca||
6.24.120 |  *rujaḥ srotaḥsvaruddheṣu mārute cānulomite|
nivartante vikārāśca śāmyantyasya madodayāḥ||
6.24.121 |  bījapūrakavṛkṣāmlakoladāḍimasaṃyutam|
yavānīhapuṣājājīśṛṅgaverāvacūrṇitam||
6.24.122 |  sasnehaiḥ *śaktubhiryuktamavadaṃśairvirocitam|
dadyāt salavaṇaṃ madyaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ vātaśāntaye||
6.24.123 |  dṛṣṭvā vātolbaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ rasaiścainamupācaret|
lāvatittiradakṣāṇāṃ snigdhāmlaiḥ śikhināmapi||
6.24.124 |  pakṣiṇāṃ mṛgamatsyānāmānūpānāṃ ca saṃskṛtaiḥ|
bhūśayaprasahānāṃ ca rasaiḥ śālyodanena ca||
6.24.125 |  snigdhoṣṇalavaṇāmlaiśca veśavārairmukhapriyaiḥ|
*citrairgaudhūmikaiścānnairvāruṇīmaṇḍasaṃyutaiḥ||
6.24.126 |  piśitārdrakagarbhābhiḥ snigdhābhiḥ pūpavartibhiḥ|
māṣapūpalikābhiśca vātikaṃ samupācaret||
6.24.127 |  nātisnigdhaṃ na cāmlena yuktaṃ samaricārdrakam|
medyaṃ prāguditaṃ māṃsaṃ dāḍimasvarasena vā||
6.24.128 |  pṛthaktrijātakopetaṃ sadhānyamaricārdrakam|
*rasapralepi saṃpūpaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ saṃpradāpayet||
6.24.129 |  *bhukte tu vāruṇīmaṇḍaṃ dadyāt pātuṃ pipāsave|
dāḍimasya rasaṃ vā 'pi jalaṃ vā pāñcamūlikam||
6.24.130 |  dhānyanāgaratoyaṃ ca dadhimaṇḍamathāpi vā|
amlakāñjikamaṇḍaṃ vā śuktodakamathāpi vā||
6.24.131 |  karmaṇā 'nena siddhena vikāra upaśāmyati|
mātrākālaprayuktena balaṃ varṇaśca vardhate||
6.24.132 |  rāgaṣāḍavasaṃyogairvividhairbhaktarocanaiḥ|
piśitaiḥ śākapiṣṭānnairyavagodhūmaśālibhiḥ||
6.24.133 |  abhyaṅgotsādanaiḥ snānairuṣṇaiḥ prāvaraṇairghanaiḥ|
ghaniragurupaṅkaiśca dhūpaiścāgurujairghanaiḥ||
6.24.134 |  nārīṇāṃ yauvanoṣṇānāṃ nirdayairupagūhanaiḥ|
śroṇyūrukucabhāraiśca saṃrodhoṣṇasukhāvahaiḥ||
6.24.135 |  śayanācchādanairuṣṇairuṣṇaiścāntargṛhaiḥ sukhaiḥ|
mārutaprabalaḥ śīghraṃ praśāmyati madātyayaḥ||
6.24.136 |  *bhavyakharjūramṛdvīkāparūṣakarasairyutam|
sadāḍimarasaṃ śītaṃ saktubhiścāvacūrṇitam||
6.24.137 |  saśarkaraṃ śārkaraṃ vā mārdvīkamathavā 'param|
dadyādbahūdakaṃ kāle pātuṃ pittamadātyaye||
6.24.138 |  śaśān kapiñjalāneṇāṃ(anunāsika)ālāvānasitapucchakān|
madhurāmlān prayuñjīta bhojane śāliṣaṣṭikān||
6.24.139 |  paṭolayūṣamiśraṃ vā chāgalaṃ kalpayedrasam|
satīnamudgamiśraṃ vā dāḍimāmalakānvitam||
6.24.140 |  drākṣāmalakakharjūraparūṣakarasena vā|
kalpayettarpaṇān yūṣān rasāṃśca vividhātmakān||
6.24.141 |  āmāśayasthamutkliṣṭaṃ kaphapittaṃ madātyaye|
vijñāya bahudoṣasya *dahyamānasya tṛṣyataḥ||
6.24.142 |  madyaṃ drākṣārasaṃ toyaṃ dattvā tarpaṇameva vā|
niḥśeṣaṃ vāmayecchīghramevaṃ rogādvimucyate||
6.24.143 |  kāle punastarpaṇādyaṃ kramaṃ kuryāt prakāṅkṣite|
tenāgnirdīpyate tasya doṣaśeṣānnapācakaḥ||
6.24.144 |  kāse saraktaniṣṭhīve pārśvastanarujāsu ca|
tṛṣyate savidāhe ca sotkleśe hṛdayorasi||
6.24.145 |  guḍūcībhadramustānāṃ paṭolasyāthavā bhiṣak|
rasaṃ sanāgaraṃ dadyāt *tittiripratibhojanam||
6.24.146 |  tṛṣyate cātibalavadvātapitte samuddhate|
dadyāddrākṣārasaṃ pātuṃ śītaṃ doṣānulomanam||
6.24.147 |  jīrṇe samadhurāmlena chāgamāṃsarasena tam|
bhojanaṃ bhojayenmadyamanutarṣaṃ ca pāyayet||
6.24.148 |  anutarṣasya mātrā sā yayā no *dūṣyate manaḥ|
tṛṣyate madyamalpālpaṃ pradeyaṃ syādbahūdakam||
6.24.149 |  tṛṣṇā yenopaśāmyeta madaṃ yena ca nāpnuyāt|
parūṣakāṇāṃ pīlūnāṃ rasaṃ *śītamathāpi vā||
6.24.150 |  parṇinīnāṃ catasṛṛṇāṃ pibedvā śiśiraṃ jalam|
*mustadāḍimalājānāṃ tṛṣṇāghnaṃ vā pibedrasam||
6.24.151 |  koladāḍimavṛkṣāmlacukrīkācukrikārasaḥ|
pañcāmlako mukhālepaḥ sadyastṛṣṇāṃ niyacchati||
6.24.152 |  śītalānyannapānāni *śītaśayyāsanāni ca|
śītavātajalasparśāḥ śītānyupavanāni ca||
6.24.153 |  kṣaumapadmotpalānāṃ ca maṇīnāṃ mauktikasya ca|
candanodakaśītānāṃ sparśāścandrāṃśuśītalāḥ||
6.24.154 |  hemarājatakāṃsyānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ śītavāribhiḥ|
pūrṇānāṃ himapūrṇānāṃ dṛtīnāṃ pavanāhatāḥ||
6.24.155 |  saṃsparśāścandanārdrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca samārutāḥ|
candanānāṃ ca mukhyānāṃ śastāḥ *pittamadātyaye||
6.24.156 |  śītavīryaṃ yadanyacca tat sarvaṃ viniyojayet|
kumudotpalapatrāṇāṃ siktānāṃ candanāmbunā||
6.24.157 |  hitāḥ sparśā manojñānāṃ dāhe madyasamutthite|
kathāśca vividhāḥ *śastāḥ śabdāśca śikhināṃ śivāḥ||
6.24.158 |  toyadānāṃ ca śabdā hi śamayanti madātyayam|
jalayantrābhivarṣīṇi vātayantravahāni ca||
6.24.159 |  kalpanīyāni bhiṣajā dāhe dhārāgṛhāṇi ca|
phalinīsevyalodhrāmbuhemapatraṃ kuṭannaṭam||
6.24.160 |  kālīyakarasopetaṃ dāhe śastaṃ pralepanam|
badarīpallavotthaśca tathaivāriṣṭakodbhavaḥ||
6.24.161 |  phenilāyāśca yaḥ phenastairdāhe lepanaṃ śubham|
surā samaṇḍā dadhyamlaṃ mātuluṅgaraso madhu||
6.24.162 |  seke pradehe śasyante dāhaghnāḥ sāmlakāñjikāḥ|
pariṣekāvagāheṣu vyañjanānāṃ ca sevane||
6.24.163 |  śasyate śiśiraṃ toyaṃ dāhatṛṣṇāpraśāntaye|
mātrākālaprayuktena karmaṇā 'nena *śāmyati||
6.24.164 |  dhīmato vaidyavaśyasya śīghraṃ pittamadātyayaḥ|
ullekhanopavāsābhyāṃ jayet kaphamadātyayam||
6.24.165 |  tṛṣyate salilaṃ cāsmai dadyāddhrīberasādhitam|
balayā pṛśniparṇyā vā kaṇṭakāryā 'thavā śṛtam||
6.24.166 |  sanāgarābhiḥ sarvābhirjalaṃ vā śṛtaśītalam|
duḥsparśona samustena mustaparpaṭakena vā||
6.24.167 |  jalaṃ mustaiḥ śṛtaṃ vā 'pi dadyāddoṣavipācanam|
etadeva ca pānīyaṃ sarvatrāpi madātyaye||
6.24.168 |  niratyayaṃ pīyamānaṃ pipāsājvaranāśanam|
nirāmaṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ kāle *sakṣaudraṃ pāyayettu tam||
6.24.169 |  śārkaraṃ madhu vā jīrṇamariṣṭaṃ sīdhumeva vā|
*rūkṣatarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yavānīnāgarānvitam||
6.24.170 |  yāvagaudhūmikaṃ cānnaṃ rūkṣayūṣeṇa bhojayet|
kulatthānāṃ suśuṣkāṇāṃ mūlakānāṃ rasena vā||
6.24.171 |  tanunā 'lpena laghunā kaṭvamlenālpasarpiṣā|
paṭolayūṣamamlaṃ vā yūṣamāmalakasya vā||
6.24.172 |  prabhūtakaṭusaṃktaṃ sayavānnaṃ pradāpayet|
vyoṣayūṣamathāmlaṃ vā yūṣaṃ vā sāmlavetasam||
6.24.173 |  chāgamāṃsarasaṃ rūkṣamamlaṃ vā jāṅgalaṃ rasam|
sthālyāṃ vā 'tha kapāle vā bhṛṣṭaṃ *nirdravavartitam||
6.24.174 |  kaṭvamlalavaṇaṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayan vṛṇuyānmadhu|
vyaktamārīcakaṃ māṃsaṃ mātuluṅgarasānvitam||
6.24.175 |  prabhūtakaṭusaṃyuktaṃ yavānīnāgarānvitam|
bhṛṣṭaṃ dāḍimasārāmlamuṣṇapūpopaveṣṭitam||
6.24.176 |  yathāgni bhakṣayet kāle prabhūtārdrakapeśikam|
pibecca nigadaṃ madyaṃ kaphaprāye madātyaye||
6.24.177 |  sauvarcalamajājī ca vṛkṣāmlaṃ sāmalvetasam|
tvagelāmaricārdhāṃśaṃ śarkarābhāgayojitam||
6.24.178 |  etallavaṇamaṣṭāṅgamagnisaṃdīpanaṃ param|
madātyaye kaphaprāye dadyāt srotoviśodhanam||
6.24.179 |  etadeva punaryuktyā madhurāmlairdravījṛtam|
godhūmānnayavānnānāṃ māṃsānāṃ cātirocanam||
6.24.180 |  peṣayet kaṭukairyuktāṃ śvetāṃ bījavivarjitām|
mṛdvīkāṃ mātuluṅgasya dāḍimasya rasena vā||
6.24.181 |  sauvarcalailāmaricairajājībhṛṅgadīpyakaiḥ|
sa rāgaḥ kṣaudrasaṃyuktaḥ śreṣṭho rocanadīpanaḥ||
6.24.182 |  mṛdvīkāyā vidhānena kārayet kāravīmapi|
śuktamatsyaṇḍikopetaṃ rāgaṃ dīpanapācanam||
6.24.183 |  āmrāmalakapeśīnāṃ rāgān kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak|
dhānyasauvarcalājājīkāravīmaricānvitān||
6.24.184 |  *guḍena madhuyuktena vyaktāmlalavaṇīkṛtān|
tairannaṃ rocate digdhaṃ samyagmuktaṃ ca jīryati||
6.24.185 |  *rūkṣoṣṇenānnapānena snānenāśiśireṇa ca|
vyāyāmalaṅghanābhyāṃ ca yuktyā jāgaraṇena ca||
6.24.186 |  kālayuktena rūkṣeṇa snānenodvartanena ca|
prāṇavarṇakarāṇāṃ *ca pragharṣāṇāṃ ca sevayā||
6.24.187 |  sevayā vasanānāṃ ca gurūṇāmagurorapi|
saṃkocoṣṇasukhaṅgīnāmaṅganānāṃ ca sevayā||
6.24.188 |  sukhaśikṣitahastānāṃ strīṇāṃ saṃvāhanena ca|
madātyayaḥ kaphaprāyaḥ śīghramevopaśāmyati||
6.24.189 |  yadidaṃ karma nirdiṣṭaṃ pṛthagdoṣabalaṃ prati|
sannipāte daśavidhe tadvikalpyaṃ bhiṣagvidā||
6.24.190 |  yastu doṣavikalpajño yaścauṣadhivikalpavit|
sa sādhyānsādhayedvyādhīn sādhyāsādhyavibhāgavit||
6.24.191 |  vanāni ramaṇīyāni sapadmāḥ salilāśayāḥ|
viśadānyannapānāni sahāyāśca praharṣaṇāḥ||
6.24.192 |  mālyāni gandhayogāśca vāsāṃsi vimalāni ca|
gāndharvaśabdāḥ kāntāśca goṣṭhyaśca hṛdayapriyāḥ||
6.24.193 |  saṃkathāhāsyagītānāṃ viśadāścaiva yojanāḥ|
priyāścānugatā nāryo nāśayanti madātyayam||
6.24.194 |  nākṣobhya hi mano madyaṃ śarīramavihatya ca|
kuryānmadātyayaṃ tasmādeṣṭavyā harṣaṇī kriyā||
6.24.195 |  ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhiḥ śamaṃ yāti madātyayaḥ|
na cenmadyavidhiṃ muktvā kṣīramasya prayojayet||
6.24.196 |  laṅgnanaiḥ pācanairdoṣaśodhanaiḥ śamanairapi|
vimadyasya kaphe kṣīṇe jāte daubalyalāghave||
6.24.197 |  tasya madyavidagdhasya vātapittādhikasya ca|
grīṣmopataptasya taroryathā varṣaṃ tathā payaḥ||
6.24.198 |  payasā 'bhihṛte roge bale jāte nivartayet|
kṣīraprayogaṃ madyaṃ ca krameṇālpālpamācaret||
6.24.199 |  vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo 'timadyaṃ niṣevate|
*dhvaṃsako vikṣayaścaiva rogastasyopajāyate||
6.24.200 |  vyādhyupakṣīṇadehasya duścikitsyatamau hi tau|
tayorliṅgaṃ cikitsā ca yathāvadupadekṣyate||
6.24.201 |  śleṣmaprasekaḥ kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ śabdāsahiṣṇutā|
tandrānidrātiyogaśca jñeyaṃ dhvaṃsakalakṣaṇam||
6.24.202 |  hṛtkaṇṭharogaḥ saṃmohaśchardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ|
tṛṣṇā kāsaḥ śiraḥśūlametadvikṣayalakṣaṇam||
6.24.203 |  tayoḥ karma tadeveṣṭaṃ vātike yanmadātyaye|
tau hi prakṣīṇadehasya jāyete durbalasya vai||
6.24.204 |  bastayaḥ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ prayogaḥ kṣīrasarpiṣoḥ|
abhyaṅgodvartanasnānānyannapānaṃ ca vātanut||
6.24.205 |  dhvaṃsako vikṣayaścaiva karmaṇā 'nena śāmyati|
yuktamadyasya madyottho na vyādhirupajāyate||
6.24.206 |  nivṛttaḥ sarvamadyebhyo naro yaśca jitendriyaḥ|
śārīramānasairdhīmān vikārairna sa yujyate||
6.24.207 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
yatprabhāvā bhagavatī surā peyā yathā ca sā|
yaddravyā yasya yā ceṣṭā yogaṃ cāpekṣate yathā||
6.24.208 |  yathā madayate yaiśca guṇairyuktā mahāguṇā|
yo mado madabhedāśca ye trayaḥ svasvalakṣaṇāḥ||
6.24.209 |  ye ca madyakṛtā doṣā guṇā ye ca madātmakāḥ|
yacca trividhamāpānaṃ yathāsattvaṃ ca lakṣaṇam||
6.24.210 |  ye sahāyāḥ sukhāḥ *pāne cirakṣipramadā narāḥ|
madātyayasya yo heturlakṣaṇaṃ yad yathā ca yat||
6.24.211 |  madyaṃ madyotthitān rogān hanti yaśca kriyākramaḥ|
sarvaṃ taduktamakhilaṃ madātyayacikitsite||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne madātyayacikitsitaṃ nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||24 | |

pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.25.1 |  athāto dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.25.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.25.3 |  parāvarajñamātreyaṃ gatamānamadavyatham|
agniveśo guruṃ kāle vinayādidamabravīt||
6.25.4 |  bhagavan! pūrvamuddiṣṭau dvau vraṇau rogasaṃgrahe|
tayorliṅgaṃ cikitsāṃ ca vaktumarhasi śarmada!||
6.25.5 |  ityagniveśasya vaco niśamya gururabravīt|
yau vraṇau pūrvamuddiṣṭau nijaścāgantureva ca||
6.25.6 |  śrūyatāṃ vidhivat saumya! tayorliṅgaṃ *ca bheṣajam|
nijaḥ śarīradoṣottha āganturbāhyahetujaḥ||
6.25.7 |  vadhabandhaprapatanāddaṃṣṭrādantanakhakṣatāt|
āgantavo vraṇāstadvadviṣasparśāgniśastrajāḥ||
6.25.8 |  mantrāgadapralepādyairbheṣajairhetubhiśca te|
liṅgaikadeśairnirdiṣṭā viparītā nijairvraṇaiḥ||
6.25.9 |  vraṇānāṃ nijahetūnāmāgantūnāmaśāmyatām|
kuryāddoṣabalāpekṣī nijānāmauṣadhaṃ yathā||
6.25.10 |  yathāsvairhetubhirduṣṭā vātapittakaphā nṛṇām|
vahirmārgaṃ samāśritya janayanti nijān vraṇān||
6.25.11 |  stabdhaḥ kaṭhinasaṃsparśo mandasrāvo+*atitīvraruk|
tudyate sphurati śyāvo vraṇo mārutasaṃbhavaḥ||
6.25.12 |  saṃpūraṇaiḥ snehapānaiḥ snigdhaiḥ svedopanāhanaiḥ|
gradehaiḥ pariṣekaiśca vātavraṇamupācaret||
6.25.13 |  tṛṣṇāmohajvarasve(kle)dadāhaduṣṭyavadāraṇaiḥ|
vraṇaṃ pittakṛtaṃ vidyādgandhaiḥ srāvaiśca pūtikaiḥ||
6.25.14 |  *śītalairmadhuraistiktaiḥ pradehaparibecanaiḥ|
sarpiṣpānairvirekaiśca paittikaṃ śamayedvraṇam||
6.25.15 |  bahupiccho guruḥ snigdhaḥ stimito mandavedanaḥ|
pāṇḍuvarṇo 'lpasṃkledaścirakārī kaphavraṇaḥ||
6.25.16 |  kaṣāyakaṭurūkṣoṣṇaiḥ pradehapariṣecanaiḥ|
kaphavraṇaṃ praśamayettathā *laṅghanapācanaiḥ||
6.25.17 |  tau dvau nānātvabhedena niruktā viṃśatirvraṇāḥ|
teṣāṃ parīkṣā trividhā, praduṣṭā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ||
6.25.18 |  sthānānyaṣṭau tathā gandhāḥ, parisrāvāścaturdaśa|
ṣoḍaśopadravā doṣāścatvāro viṃśatistathā||
6.25.19 |  tathā copakramāḥ siddhāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat samudāhṛtāḥ|
*vibhajyamānāñchṛṇu me sarvānetān yatheritān||
6.25.20 |  *kṛtyotkṛtyastathā duṣṭo 'duṣṭo marmasthito na ca|
saṃvṛto dāruṇaḥ srāvī saviṣo viṣamasthitaḥ||
6.25.21 |  utsaṅgyutsanna eṣāṃ ca vraṇān vidyādviparyayāt|
iti nānātvabhedena *niruktā viṃśatirvraṇāḥ||
6.25.22 |  darśanapraśnasaṃsparśaiḥ parīkṣā trividhā smṛtā|
vayovarṇaśarīrāṇāmindiryāṇāṃ ca darśanāt||
6.25.23 |  hetvartisātmyāgnibalaṃ parīkṣyaṃ vacanādbudhaiḥ|
sparśānmārdavaśaitye ca parīkṣye saviparyaye||
6.25.24 |  *śveto 'vasannavartmā 'tisthūlavartmā 'tipiñjaraḥ|
nīlaḥ śyāvo 'tipiḍako raktaḥ kṛṣṇo 'tipūtikaḥ||
6.25.25 |  ropyaḥ kumbhīmukhaśceti praduṣṭā dvādaśa vraṇāḥ|
*caturviṃśatiruddiṣṭā doṣāḥ kalpāntareṇa vai||
6.25.26 |  tvaksirāmāṃsamedo 'sthisnāyumarmāntarāśrayāḥ|
vraṇasthānāni nirdiṣṭānyaṣṭāvetāni saṃgrahe||
6.25.27 |  sarpistailavasāpūyaraktaśyāvāmlapūtikāḥ|
vraṇānāṃ vraṇagandhajñairaṣṭau gandhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||
6.25.28 |  lasīkājalapūyāsṛgghāridrāruṇapiñjarāḥ|
kaṣāyanīlaharitasnigdharūkṣasitāsitāḥ||
6.25.29 |  iti rūpaiḥ samuddiṣṭā vraṇasrāvāścaturdaśa|
visarpaḥ pakṣaghātaśca sirāstambho 'patānakaḥ||
6.25.30 |  mohonmādavraṇarujo jvarastṛṣṇā hanugrahaḥ|
kāsaśchardiratīsāro hikkā śvāsaḥ savepathuḥ||
6.25.31 |  ṣoḍaśopadravāḥ proktā vraṇānāṃ vraṇacintakaiḥ|
*snāyukledātsirākledādgāmbhīryātkṛmibhakṣaṇāt||
6.25.32 |  asthibhedāt saśalyatvāt *saviṣatvācca sarpaṇāt|
nakhakāṣṭhaprabhedācca *carmalomātighaṭṭanāt||
6.25.33 |  mithyābandhādati snehādatibhaiṣajyakarṣaṇāt|
ajīrṇādatibhuktācca viruddhāsātmyabhojanāt||
6.25.34 |  śokāt krodhāddivāsvapnādvyāyāmānmaithunāttathā|
vraṇā na praśamaṃ yānti niṣkriyatvācca dehinām||
6.25.35 |  parisrāvācca gandhācca doṣāccopadravaiḥ saha|
vraṇānāṃ bahudoṣāṇāṃ kṛcchratvaṃ copajāyate||
6.25.36 |  tvaṅmāṃsajaḥ sukhe deśe taruṇasyānupadraṛvaḥ|
dhīmato 'bhinavaḥ kāle sukhasādhyaḥ smṛto vraṇaḥ||
6.25.37 |  guṇairanyatamairhīnastataḥ kṛcchro vraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ|
sarvairvihīno vijñeyastvasādhyo *nirupakramaḥ||
6.25.38 |  vraṇānāmāditaḥ kāryaḥ yathāsannaṃ viśodhanam|
ūrdhvabhāgairadhobhāgaiḥ śastrairbastibhireva ca||
6.25.39 |  sadyaḥ śuddhaśarīrāṇāṃ praśamaṃ yānti hi vraṇāḥ|
yathākramamataścordhvaṃ śṛṇu sarvānupakramān||
6.25.40 |  śophaghnaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ caiva śastrakarmāvapīḍanam|
virvāpaṇaṃ sasandhānaṃ svedaḥ śamanameṣaṇam||
6.25.41 |  śodhanau ropaṇīyau ca kaṣāyau sapralepanau|
dve taile *tadguṇe patraṃ chādane dve ca bandhane||
6.25.42 |  bhojyamutsādanaṃ dāho dvividhaḥ sāvasādanaḥ|
kāṭhinyamārdavakare dhūpanālepane śubhe||
6.25.43 |  vraṇāvacūrṇanāṃ varṇyaṃ ropaṇaṃ lomarohaṇam|
iti ṣaṭtriṃśaduddiṣṭā vraṇanāṃ samupakramāḥ||
6.25.44 |  pūrvarūpaṃ bhiṣagbuddhvā vraṇānāṃ śophamāditaḥ|
raktāvasecanaṃ kuryādajātavraṇaśāntaye||
6.25.45 |  śodhayedbahudoṣāṃstu svalpadoṣān vilaṅghayet|
pūrvaṃ kaṣāyasarpirbhirjayedvā mārutottarān||
6.25.46 |  vyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣavetasavalkalaiḥ|
sasarpiṣkaiḥ pralepaḥ syācchophanirvāpaṇaḥ param||
6.25.47 |  vijayā madhukaṃ vīrā bisagranthiḥ śatāvarī|
nīlotpalaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ pradehaḥ syāt sacandanaḥ||
6.25.48 |  saktavo madhukaṃ sarpiḥ pradehaḥ syāt sarśakaraḥ|
avidāhīni cānnāni śophe bheṣajamuttamam||
6.25.49 |  sa cedevamupakrāntaḥ śopho na praśamaṃ vrajet|
tasyopanāhaiḥ pakvasya pāṭanaṃ hitamucyate||
6.25.50 |  tailena sarpiṣā vā 'pi tābhyāṃ vā saktupiṇḍikā|
sukhoṣṇā śophapākārthamupanāhaḥ praśasyate||
6.25.51 |  satilā sātasībījā dadhyamlā saktupiṇḍikā|
sakiṇvakuṣṭhalavaṇā śastā syādupanāhane||
6.25.52 |  rugdāharāgatodaiśca vidagdhaṃ śophamādiśet|
jalabastisamasparśaṃ saṃpakvaṃ pīḍitonnatam||
6.25.53 |  umā 'tho gugguluḥ saudhaṃ payo dakṣakapotayoḥ|
viṭ palāśabhavaḥ kṣāro hemakṣīrī mukūlakaḥ||
6.25.54 |  ityukto bheṣajagaṇaḥ pakvaśothaprabhedanaḥ|
sukumārasya, kṛcchrasya śastraṃ tu paramucyate||
6.25.55 |  pāṭanaṃ vyadhanaṃ caiva chedanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā|
pracchanaṃ sīvanaṃ caiva ṣaḍvidhaṃ śastrakarma tat||
6.25.56 |  nāḍīvraṇāḥ pakvaśothāstathā kṣatagudodaram|
antaḥśalyāśca ye *śophāḥ pāṭyāste tadvidhāśca ye||
6.25.57 |  dakodarāṇi saṃpakvā gulmā ye ye ca raktajāḥ|
vyadhyāḥ śoṇitarogāśca visarpapiḍakādayaḥ||
6.25.58 |  uddvṛttān sthūlaparyantānutsannān kaṭhiṇān vraṇān|
arśaḥprabhṛtyadhīmāṃsaṃ chedanenopapādayet||
6.25.59 |  kilāsāni sakuṣṭhāni likhellekhyāni buddhimān|
vātāsṛggranthipiḍakāḥ sakoṭhā raktamaṇḍalam||
6.25.60 |  kuṣṭhānyabhihataṃ cāṅgaṃ śothāṃśca pracchayedbhiṣak|
sīvyaṃ kukṣyudarādyaṃ tu gambhīraṃ yadvipāṭitam||
6.25.61 |  iti ṣaḍvidhamuddiṣṭaṃ śastrakarma manīṣibhiḥ|
sūkṣmānanāḥ koṣavanto ye vraṇāstānprapīḍayet||
6.25.62 |  kalāyāśca masūrāśca godhūmāḥ sahareṇavaḥ|
kalkīkṛtāḥ praśasyante niḥsnehā vraṇapīḍane||
6.25.63 |  śālmalītvagbalāmūlaṃ tathā nyagrodhapallavāḥ|
nyagrodhādikamuddiṣṭaṃ balādikamathāpi vā||
6.25.64 |  ālepanaṃ nirvapaṇaṃ *tadvidyāttaiśca secanam|
sarpiṣā śatadhautena payasā madhukāmbunā||
6.25.65 |  nirvāpayet suśītena raktapittottarān vraṇān|
lambāni vraṇamāṃsāni pralipya madhusarpiṣāḥ||
6.25.66 |  saṃdadhīta samaṃ vaidyo bandhanaiścopapādayet|
tānsamānsusthitāñjñātvā phalinīlodhrakaṭphalaiḥ||
6.25.67 |  samaṅgādhātakīyuktaiścūrṇitairavacūrṇayet|
pañcavalkalacūrṇairvā śukticūrṇasamāyutaiḥ||
6.25.68 |  dhātakīlodhracūrṇairvā tathā rohanti te vraṇāḥ|
asthibhagnaṃ cyutaṃ sandhiṃ saṃdadhīta samaṃ punaḥ||
6.25.69 |  samena samamaṅgena kṛtvā 'nyena vicakṣaṇaḥ|
sthiraiḥ kavalikābandhaiḥ kuśikābhiśca saṃsthitam||
6.25.70 |  paṭṭaiḥ prabhūtasarpiṣkairbadhnīyādacalaṃ sukham|
avidāhibhirannaiśca paiṣṭikaistamupācaret||
6.25.71 |  glānirhi na hitā tasya sandhiviśleṣakārikā|
vicyutābhihatāṅgānāṃ visarpādīnupadravān||
6.25.72 |  *upācaredyathākālaṃ kālajñaḥ svāccikitsitāt|
śuṣkā mahārujaḥ stabdhā ye vraṇā mārutottarāḥ|
svedyāḥ saṅkarakalpena te syuḥ kṛśarapāyasaiḥ||
6.25.73 |  grāmyabailāmbujānūpairvaiśavāraiśca saṃskṛtaiḥ|
utkārikābhiścoṣṇābhiḥ sukhī syādvraṇitastathā||
6.25.74 |  sadāhā vedanāvanto ye vraṇā mārutottarāḥ|
teṣāmumāṃ tilāṃścaiva bhṛṣṭān payasi nirvṛtān||
6.25.75 |  tenaiva payasā piṣṭvā kuryādālepanaṃ bhiṣak|
balā guḍūcī madhukaṃ pṛśniparṇī śatāvarī||
6.25.76 |  jīvantī śarkarā kṣīraṃ tailaṃ matsyavasā ghṛtam|
saṃsiddhā samadhūcchiṣṭā śūlaghnī snehaśarkarā||
6.25.77 |  dvipañcamūlakvathitenāmbhasā *payasā 'thavā|
sarpiṣā vā satailena koṣṇena pariṣecayet||
6.25.78 |  yavacūrṇaṃ samadhukaṃ satilaṃ saha sarpiṣā|
dadyādālepanaṃ koṣṇaṃ dāhaśūlopaśāntaye||
6.25.79 |  upanāhaśca kartavyaḥ satilo mudgapāyasaḥ|
rugdāhayoḥ praśamano vraṇeṣveṣa vidhirhitaḥ||
6.25.80 |  sūkṣmānanā bahusrāvāḥ koṣavantaśca ye vraṇāḥ|
na ca marmāśritāsteṣāmeṣaṇaṃ hitamucyate||
6.25.81 |  dvividhāmeṣaṇīṃ vidyānmṛdvīṃ ca kaṭhināmapi|
audbhidairmṛdubhirnālairlohānāṃ vā śalākayā||
6.25.82 |  gambhīre māṃsale deśe pāṭyaṃ lauhaśalākayā|
eṣyaṃ vidyādvraṇaṃ nālairviparītamato bhiṣak||
6.25.83 |  pūtigandhān vivarṇāṃśca bahusrāvānmahārujaḥ|
vraṇānaśuddhān vijñāya śodhanaiḥ samupācaret||
6.25.84 |  triphalā khadiro dārvī *vyagrodhādirbalā kuśaḥ|
nimbakolakapatrāśi kaṣāyāḥ śodhanā matāḥ||
6.25.85 |  tilakalkaḥ salavaṇo dve haridre trivṛdghṛtam|
madhukaṃ nimbapatrāṇi pralepo vraṇaśodhanaḥ||
6.25.86 |  nātirakto nātipāṇḍurnātiśyāvo na cātiruk|
na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||
6.25.87 |  nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthakadambaplakṣavetasāḥ|
karavīrārkakuṭajāḥ kaṣāyā vraṇaropaṇāḥ||
6.25.88 |  candanaṃ padmakiñjalkaṃ dārvītvaṅnīlamutpalam|
mede mūrvā samaṅgā ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vraṇaropaṇam||
6.25.89 |  prapauṇḍarīkaṃ jīvantī gojihvā dhātakī balā|
ropaṇaṃ satilaṃ dadyāt pralepaṃ saghṛtaṃ vraṇe||
6.25.90 |  kampillakaṃ viḍaṅgāni vatsakaṃ triphalāṃ balām|
paṭolaṃ picumardaṃ ca lodhraṃ mustaṃ priyaṅgukam||
6.25.91 |  khadiraṃ dhātakīṃ sarjamelāmagurucandane|
piṣṭvā sādhyaṃ bhavettailaṃ tat paraṃ vraṇaropaṇam||
6.25.92 |  prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ kākolyau dve ca candane|
siddhametaiḥ samaistailaṃ paraṃ syādvraṇaropaṇam||
6.25.93 |  dūrvāsvarasasiddhaṃ vā tailaṃ kampillakena vā|
dārvītvacaśca kalkena pradhānaṃ vraṇaropaṇam||
6.25.94 |  yenaiva vidhinā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ tenaiva sādhayet|
raktapittottaraṃ dṛṣṭvā ropaṇīyaṃ vraṇaṃ bhiṣak||
6.25.95 |  kadambārjunanimbānāṃ pāṭalyāḥ pippalasya ca|
vraṇapracchādane vidvān patrāṇyarkasya cādiśet||
6.25.96 |  vārkṣo 'thavā++ājinaḥ kṣaumaḥ paṭṭo vraṇahitaḥ smṛtaḥ|
bandhaśca dvividhaḥ śasto vraṇānāṃ savyadakṣiṇaḥ||
6.25.97 |  lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇāni vidāhīni guṇūṇi ca|
varjayedannapānāni vraṇī maithunameva ca||
6.25.98 |  nātiśītagurusnigdhamavidāhi yathāvraṇam|
annapānaṃ vraṇahitaṃ hitaṃ cāsvapanaṃ divā||
6.25.99 |  stanyāni jīvanīyāni bṛṃhaṇīyāni yāni ca|
utsādanārthaṃ nimnānāṃ vraṇānāṃ tāni kalpayet||
6.25.100 |  bhūrjagranthyaśmakāsīsamadhobhāgāni gugguluḥ|
vraṇāvasādanaṃ tadvat kalaviṅkakapotaviṭ||
6.25.101 |  rudhire 'tipravṛtte tu cchinne cchedye 'dhimāṃsake|
kaphagranthiṣu gaṇḍeṣu vātastambhānilārtiṣu||
6.25.102 |  gūḍhapūyalasīkeṣu gambhīreṣu sthireṣu ca|
*klṛpteṣu cāṅgadeśeṣu karmāgneḥ saṃpraśasyate||
6.25.103 |  madhūcchiṣṭena tailena majjakṣaudravasāghṛtaiḥ|
taptairvā vividhairlohairdaheddāhaviśeṣavit||
6.25.104 |  rūkṣāṇāṃ sukumārāṇāṃ gambhīrānmārutottarān|
dahet snehamadhūcchiṣṭairlohaiḥ kṣaudraistato 'nyathā||
6.25.105 |  bāladurbalavṛddhānāṃ garbhiṇyā raktapittinām|
tṛṣṇājvaraparītānāmabalānāṃ viṣādinām||
6.25.106 |  nāgnikarmopadeṣṭavyaṃ snāyumarmavraṇeṣu ca|
saviṣeṣu ca śalyeṣu netrakuṣṭhavraṇeṣu ca||
6.25.107 |  rogadoṣabalāpekṣī mātrākālāgnikovidaḥ|
śastrakarmāgnikṛtyeṣu kṣāramapyavacārayet||
6.25.108 |  kaṭhinatvaṃ vraṇā yānti gandhaiḥ sāraiśca dhūpitāḥ|
sarpirmajjavasādhūpaiḥ śaithilyaṃ yānti hi vraṇāḥ||
6.25.109 |  rujaḥ srāvāśca gandhāśca kṛmayaśca vraṇāśritāḥ|
śaithilyaṃ mārdavaṃ cāpi dhūpanenopaśāmyati||
6.25.110 |  lodhranyagrodhaśuṅgāni khadirastriphalā ghṛtam|
pralepo vraṇaśaithilyasaukumāryaprasādhanaḥ||
6.25.111 |  sarujaḥ kaṭhināḥ stabdhā nirāsrāvāśca ye vraṇāḥ|
yavacūrṇaiḥ sasarpiṣkairbahuśastān pralepayet||
6.25.112 |  mudgaṣaṣṭikaśālīnāṃ pāyasairvā yathākramam|
saghṛtairjīvanīyairvā tarpayettānabhīkṣṇaśaḥ||
6.25.113 |  kakubhodumbarāśvatthalodhrajāmbavakaṭphalaiḥ|
tvacamāśveva gṛhṇanti tvakvcūrṇaiścūrṇitā vraṇāḥ||
6.25.114 |  *manaḥśilailā mañjiṣṭhā lākṣā ca rajanīdvayam|
pralepaḥ saghṛtakṣaudrastvagviśuddhikaraḥ paraḥ||
6.25.115 |  ayorajaḥ sakāsīsaṃ triphalākusumāni ca|
karoti lepaḥ *kṛṣṇatvaṃ sadya eva navatvaci||
6.25.116 |  *kālīyakanatāmrāsthihemakāntārasottamaiḥ|
lepaḥ sagomayarasaḥ savarṇīkaraṇaḥ paraḥ||
6.25.117 |  dhyāmakāśvatthaniculamūlaṃ lākṣā sagairikā|
sahemaścāmṛtāsaṅgaḥ kāsīsaṃ ceti varṇakṛt||
6.25.118 |  catuṣpadānāṃ tvaglomakhuraśṛṅgāsthibhasmanā|
tailāktā cūrṇitā bhūmirbhavellomavatī punaḥ||
6.25.119 |  ṣoḍaśopadravā ye ca vraṇānāṃ parikīrtitāḥ|
teṣāṃ cikitsā nirdiṣṭā yathāsvaṃ sve cikitsite||
6.25.120 |  tatra ślokau---
dvau vraṇau vraṇabhedāśca parīkṣā duṣṭireva ca|
sthānāni gandhāḥ srāvāśca sopasargāḥ kriyāśca yāḥ||
6.25.121 |  vraṇādhikāre sapraśnametannavakamuktavān|
munirvyāsasamāsābhyāmagniveśāya dhīmate||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ nāma pajcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||25 | |

ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.26.1 |  athātastrimarmīyacikitsitamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.26.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.26.3 |  saptottaraṃ marmaśataṃ yaduktaṃ śarīrasaṃkhyāmadhikṛtya tebhyaḥ|
marmāṇi bastiṃ hṛdayaṃ śiraśca pradhānabhūtāni vadanti tajjñāḥ||
6.26.4 |  prāṇāśrayāt, tāni hi pīḍayanto vātādayo 'sūnapi pīḍayanti|
tatsaṃśritānāmanupālanārhtaṃ mahāgadānāṃ śṛṇu saumya rakṣām||
6.26.5 |  kaṣāyatiktoṣaṇarūkṣabhojyaiḥ *saṃdhāraṇābhojanamaithunaiśca|
pakvāśaye kupyati cedapānaḥ srotāṃsyadhogāni balī sa ruddhvā||
6.26.6 |  karoti viṇmārutamūtrasaṅgaṃ kramādudāvartamataḥ sughoram|
rugbastihṛtkukṣyudareṣvabhīkṣṇaṃ sapṛṣṭhapārśveṣvatidāruṇā syāt||
6.26.7 |  ādhmānahṛllāsavikartikāśca todo 'vipākaśca sabastiśothaḥ|
varco 'pravṛttirjaṭhare ca *gaṇḍānyūrdhvaśca vāyurvihato gude syāt||
6.26.8 |  kṛcchreṇa śuṣkasya cirāt pravṛttiḥ syādvā tanuḥ syāt khararūkṣaśītā|
tataśca rogā jvaramūtrakṛcchrapravāhikāhṛdgrahaṇīpradoṣāḥ||
6.26.9 |  vamyāndhyabādhiryaśiro 'bhitāpavātodarāṣṭhīlamanovikārāḥ|
tṛṣṇāsrapittārucigulmakāsaśvāsapratiśyārditapārśvarogāḥ||
6.26.10 |  anye ca rogā bahavo 'nilotthā bhavantyudāvartakṛtāḥ sughorāḥ|
cikitsitaṃ cāsya yathāvadūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyate tacchṛṇu cāgniveśa!||
6.26.11 |  taṃ tailaśītajvaranāśanāktaṃ svedairyathoktaiḥ pravilīnadoṣam|
upācaredvartinirūhabastisnehairvirekairanulomanānnaiḥ||
6.26.12 |  śyāmātrivṛnmāgadhikāṃ sadantīṃ gomūtrapiṣṭāṃ daśabhāgamāṣām|
sanīlīkāṃ dvirlavaṇāṃ guḍena vartiṃ karāṅguṣṭhanibhāṃ vidadhyāt||
6.26.13 |  piṇyākasauvarcalahiṅgubhirvā sasarṣapatryūṣaṇayāvaśūkaiḥ|
krimighnakampillakaśāṅkhinībhiḥ sudhārkajakṣīraguḍairyutābhiḥ||
6.26.14 |  syāt pippalīsarṣaparāḍhaveśmadhūmaiḥ sagomūtraguḍaiśca vartiḥ|
śyāmāphalālābukapippalīnāṃ nāḍyā 'thavā tat pradhamettu cūrṇam||
6.26.15 |  rakṣoghnatumbīkarahāṭakṛṣṇācūrṇaṃ sajīmūtakasaindhavaṃ vā|
snigdhe gude tānyanulomayanti narasya varco 'nilamūtrasaṅgam||
6.26.16 |  teṣāṃ vighāte tu bhiṣagvidadhyāt svabhyaktasusvinnatanornirūham|
ūrdhvānulomauṣadhamūtratailakṣārāmlavātaghnayutaṃ sutīkṣṇam||
6.26.17 |  vāte 'dhike 'mlaṃ lavaṇaṃ satailaṃ, kṣīreṇa pitte tu, kaphe samūtram|
sa mūtravarco 'nilasaṅgamāśu gudaṃ sirāśca praguṇīkaroti||
6.26.18 |  trivṛtsudhāpatratilādiśākagrāmyaudakānūparasairyavānnam|
anyaiśca sṛṣṭānilamūtraviḍbhiradyāt prasannāguḍasīdhupāyī||
6.26.19 |  bhūyo 'nubandhe tu bhavedvirecyo mūtraprasannādadhimaṇḍaśuktaiḥ|
svasthaṃ tu paścādanuvāsayettaṃ raukṣyāddhi saṅgo 'nilavarcasoścet||
6.26.20 |  dviruttaraṃ hiṅgu *vacāgnikuṣṭhaṃ suvarcikā caiva viḍaṅgacūrṇam|
sukhāmbunā++*ānāhavisūcikārtihṛdrogagulmordhvasamīraṇaghnam||
6.26.21 |  vacābhayācitakayāvaśūkān sapippalīkātiviṣān sakuṣṭhān|
uṣṇāmbunā++ānāhavimūḍhavātān pītvā jayedāśu rasaudanāśī||
6.26.22 |  hiṅgūgragandhābiḍaśuṇṭhyajājīharītakīpuṣkaramūlakuṣṭham|
yathottaraṃ bhāgavivṛddhametat plīhodarājīrṇavisūcikāsu||
6.26.23 |  sthirādivargasya punarnavāyāḥ śampākapūtīkakarañjayośca|
siddhaḥ kaṣāye dvipalāṃśikānāṃ prastho ghṛtāt syāt pratiruddhavāte||
6.26.24 |  phalaṃ ca mūlaṃ ca virecanoktaṃ hiṅgvarkamūlaṃ daśamūlamagryam|
snuk citrakaścaiva punarnavā ca tulyāni sarvairlavaṇāni pañca||
6.26.25 |  snehaiḥ samūtraiḥ saha jarjarāṇi śarāvasandhau vipacet sulipte|
pakvaṃ supiṣṭaṃ lavaṇaṃ tadannaiḥ pānaistathā++ānāharujāghnamadyāt||
6.26.26 |  hṛtstambhamūrdhāmayagauravābhyāmudgārasaṅgena sapīnasena|
ānāhamāmaprabhavaṃ jayettu pracchardanailaṅghanapācanaiśca||
(*6.26.27 |  gulmodarabradhnārśaḥplīhodāvartayoniśukragade|
medaḥkaphasaṃsṛṣṭe mārutarakte 'vagāḍhe ca||
6.26.28 |  gṛdhrasipakṣavadhādiṣu virecanārheṣu vātarogeṣu|
vāte vibaddhamārge medaḥkaphapittaraktena||
6.26.29 |  payasā māṃsarasairvā triphalārasayūṣamūtramadirābhiḥ|
doṣānubandhayogāt praśastameraṇḍajaṃ tailam||
6.26.30 |  tadvātanutsvabhāvāt saṃyogavaśādvirecanācca jayet|
medosṛkpittakaphonmiśrānilarogajittasmāt||
6.26.31 |  balakoṣṭhavyādhivaśādāpañcapalā bhavenmātrā|
mṛdukoṣṭhālpabalānāṃ saha bhojyaṃ tatprayojyaṃ syāt||)
ityudāvartacikitsā|
6.26.32 |  vyāyāmatīkṣṇauṣadharūkṣamadyaprasaṅganityadrutapṛṣṭhayānāt|
ānūpamatsyādhyaśanādajīrṇāt syurmūtrakṛcchrāṇi nṛṇāmihāṣṭau||
6.26.33 |  pṛthaṅmalāḥ svaiḥ kupitā nidānaiḥ sarve 'thavā kopamupetya bastau|
mūtrasya mārgaṃ paripīḍayanti yadā tadā mūtrayatīha kṛcchrāt||
6.26.34 |  tīvrā rujo vaṅkṣaṇabastimeḍhre svalpaṃ muhurmūtrayatīha vātāt|
pītaṃ saraktaṃ sarujaṃ sadāhaṃ kṛcchrānmuhurmūtrayatīha pittāt||
6.26.35 |  basteḥ saliṅgasya gurutvaśothau mūtraṃ sapicchaṃ kaphamūtrakṛcche|
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātādbhavanti tat kṛcchratamaṃ hi kṛcchram||
6.26.36 |  viśoṣayedbastigataṃ saśukraṃ mūtraṃ sapittaṃ pavanaḥ kaphaṃ vā|
yadā tadā 'śmaryupajāyate tu krameṇa pitteṣviva rocanā goḥ||
6.26.37 |  kadambapuṣpākṛtiraśmatulyā ślakṣṇā tripuṭyapyathavā 'pi mṛdvī|
mūtrasya cenmārgamupaiti ruddhvā mūtraṃ rujaṃ tasya karoti bastau||
6.26.38 |  sasevanīmehanabastiśūlaṃ viśīrṇadhāraṃ ca karoti mūtram|
mṛdgāti meḍhraṃ sa tu vedanārto muhuḥ śakṛnmuñcati mehate ca||
6.26.39 |  kṣobhāt kṣate mūtrayatīha sāsṛk tasyāḥ sukhaṃ mehati ca vyapāyāt|
eṣā 'śmarī mārutabhinnamūrtiḥ syāccharkarā mūtrapathāt kṣarantī||
(6.26.40 |  reto 'bhighātābhihatasya puṃsaḥ pravartate yasya tu mūtrakṛcchram|
syādvedanā vaṅkṣaṇabastimeḍhre tasyātiśūlaṃ vṛṣaṇātivṛtte||
6.26.41 |  śukreṇa saṃruddhagatipravāho mūtraṃ sa kṛcchreṇa vimuñcatīha|
tamaṇḍayoḥ stabdhamiti bravanti reto 'bhighātāt pravadanti *kṛcchram||)
6.26.42 |  śukraṃ malāścaiva pṛthak pṛthagvā mūtrāśayasthāḥ prativārayanti|
tadvyāhataṃ mehanabastiśūlaṃ mūtraṃ saśukraṃ kurute vibaddham||
6.26.43 |  stabdhaśca śūno bhṛśavedanaśca tudyeta bastirvṛṣaṇau ca tasya|
kṣatābhighātāt kṣatajaṃ kṣayādvā prakopitaṃ bastigataṃ vibaddham||
6.26.44 |  tīvrārti mūtreṇa sahāśmarītvamāyāti tasminnatisaṃcite ca|
ādhmātatāṃ vindati gauravaṃ ca basterlaghutvaṃ ca viniḥsṛte 'smin||
iti mūtrakṛcchranidānam|
6.26.45 |  abhyañjanasnehanirūhabastisnehopanāhottarabastisekān|
sthirādibhirvātaharaiśca siddhān dadyādrasāṃścānilamūtrakṛcchre||
6.26.46 |  punarnavairaṇḍaśatāvarībhiḥ pattūravṛścīrabalāśmabhidbhiḥ|
dvipañcamūlena kulatthakolayavaiśca toyotkvathite kaṣāye||
6.26.47 |  tailaṃ varāharkṣavasā ghṛtaṃ ca taireva kalkairlavaṇaiśca sādhyam|
tanmātrayā++āśu pratihanti pītaṃ śūlānvitaṃ mārutamūtrakṛcchram||
6.26.48 |  etāni cānyāni varauṣadhāni piṣṭāni śastānyapi copanāhe||
syurlābhatastailaphalāni caiva snehāmlayuktāni sukhasvoṣṇavanti||
6.26.49 |  sekāvagāhāḥ śiśirāḥ pradehā graiṣmo vidhirbastipayovirekāḥ|
drākṣāvidārīkṣurasairghṛtaiśca kṛcchreṣu pittaprabhaveṣu kāryāḥ||
6.26.50 |  śatāvarīkāśakuśaśvadaṃṣṭrāvidāriśālīkṣukaśerukāṇām|
kvāthaṃ suśītaṃ madhuśarkarābhyāṃ yuktaṃ pibet paittikamūtrakṛcchrī||
6.26.51 |  pibet kaṣāyaṃ kamalotpalānāṃ śṛṅgāṭakānāmathavā vidāryāḥ|
*daṇḍairakāṇāmathavā 'pi mūlaṃ pūrveṇa kalpena tathā 'mbu śītam||
6.26.52 |  ervārubījaṃ trapuṣāt kusumbhāt sakuṅgkumaḥ syādvṛṣakaśca peyaḥ|
drākṣārasenāśmariśarkarāsu sarveṣu kṛcchreṣu praśasta eṣaḥ||
6.26.53 |  ervārubījaṃ madhukaṃ *sadāru paitte pibettaṇḍuladhāvanena|
dārvīṃ tathaivāmalakīrasena samākṣikāṃ pittakṛte tu kṛcchre||
6.26.54 |  kṣāroṣṇatīkṣṇauṣadhamannapānaṃ svedo yavānnaṃ vamanaṃ nirūhāḥ|
takraṃ satiktauṣadhasiddhatailamabhyaṅgapānaṃ kaphamūtrakṛcchre||
6.26.55 |  vyoṣaṃ *śvadaṃṣṭrātruṭisārasāsthi kolapramāṇaṃ madhumūtrayuktam|
pibettruṭiṃ kṣaudrayutāṃ kadalyā rasena kaiḍaryarasena vā 'pi||
6.26.56 |  takreṇa yuktaṃ śitivārakasya bījaṃ pibet kṛcchravināśahetoḥ|
pibettathā taṇḍuladhāvanena pravālacūrṇaṃ kaphamūtrakṛcchre||
6.26.57 |  saptacchadāragvadhakebukailādhavaṃ karañjaṃ kuṭajaṃ guḍūcīm|
paktvā jale tena pibedyavāgūṃ siddhaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhusaṃyutaṃ vā||
6.26.58 |  sarvaṃ tridoṣaprabhave tu vāyoḥ sthānānupūrvyā prasamīkṣya kāryam|
tribhyo 'dhike prāgvamanaṃ kaphe syāt pitte virekaḥ pavane tu bastiḥ||
iti mūtrakṛcchracikitsā|
6.26.59 |  kriyā hitā sā 'śmariśarkarābhyāṃ kṛcchre yathaiveha kaphānilābhyām|
kāryā 'śmarībhedanapātanāya viśeṣayuktaṃ śṛṇu karma siddham||
6.26.60 |  pāṣāṇabhedaṃ vṛṣakaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāpāṭhābhayāvyoṣaśaṭīnikumbhāḥ|
*hiṃsrākharāśvāśitivārakāṇāmervārukāṇāṃ trapuṣasya bījam||
6.26.61 |  utkuñcikā hiṅgu savetasāmlaṃ syāddve bṛhatyau hapuṣā vacā ca|
cūrṇaṃ pibedaśmaribhedapakvaṃ sarpiśca gomūtracaturguṇaṃ taiḥ||
6.26.62 |  mūlaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrakṣurakorubūkāt kṣīreṇa piṣṭaṃ bṛhatīdvayācca|
āloḍya dadhnā madhureṇa peyaṃ dināni saptāśmaribhedanāya||
6.26.63 |  punarnavāyorajanīśvadaṃṣṭrāphalgupravālāśca sadarbhapuṣpāḥ|
kṣīrāmbumadyekṣurasaiḥ supiṣṭaṃ peyaṃ bhavedaśmariśarkarāsu||
6.26.64 |  triṭiṃ *surāhvaṃ lavaṇāni pañca yavāgrajaṃ kundurukāśmabhedau|
kampillakaṃ gokṣurakasya bījamervārubījaṃ trapuṣasya bījam||
6.26.65 |  cūrṇīkṛtaṃ citrakahiṅgumāṃsīyavānitulyaṃ triphalādvibhāgam|
amlairaśuktai rasamadyayūṣaiḥ peyaṃ hi gulmāśmaribhedanārtham||
6.26.66 |  bilvapramāṇo ghṛtatailabhṛṣṭo yūṣaḥ kṛtaḥ śigrukamūlakalkāt|
śīto 'śmabhit syāddadhimaṇḍayuktaḥ peyaḥ prakāmaṃ lavaṇena yuktaḥ||
6.26.67 |  jalena śobhāñjanamūlakalkaḥ śīto hitaścāśmariśarkarāsu|
sitopalā vā samayāvaśūkā kṛcchreṣu sarveṣvapi bheṣajaṃ syāt||
6.26.68 |  pītvā 'tha madyaṃ nigadaṃ rathena hayena vā śīghrajavena yāyāt|
taiḥ śarkarā pracyavate 'śmarī tu śāmyenna cecchalyaviduddharettām||
6.26.69 |  retobhighātaprabhave tu kṛcchre samīkṣya doṣaṃ pratikarma kuryāt|
kārpāsamūlaṃ vṛṣakāśmabhedau balā sthirādīni gavedhukā ca||
6.26.70 |  vṛścīra aindrī ca punarnavā ca śatāvarī madhvasanākhyaparṇyau|
tatkvāthasiddhaḥ pavane rasaḥ syāt pitte 'dhike kṣīramathāpi sarpiḥ||
6.26.71 |  kaphe ca yūṣādikamannapānaṃ saṃsargaje sarvahitaḥ kramaḥ syāt|
evaṃ na cecchāmyati tasya yuñjyāt surāṃ purāṇāṃ madhukāsavaṃ vā||
6.26.72 |  vihaṅgamāṃsāni ca bṛṃhaṇāya bastīṃśca śukrāśayaśodhanārtham|
śuddhasya tṛptasya ca vṛṣyayogaiḥ priyānukūlāḥ pramadā vidheyāḥ||
6.26.73 |  raktodbhave tūtpalanālatālakāsekṣubālekṣukaśerukāṇi|
pibet sitākṣaudrayutāni khādedikṣuṃ vidārīṃ tripuṣāṇi caiva||
6.26.74 |  ghṛtaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāsvarasena siddhaṃ kṣīreṇa caivāṣṭaguṇena peyam|
sthirādikānāṃ kanakādikānāmekaikaśo vā vidhinaiva tena||
6.26.75 |  kṣīreṇa bastirmadhurauṣadhaiḥ syāttailena vā svākuphalotthitena||
yanmūtrakṛcchre vihitaṃ tu paitte kāryaṃ tu tacchoṇitamūtrakṛcchre||
6.26.76 |  vyāyāmasaṃdhāraṇaśuṣkarūkṣapiṣṭānnavātārkakaravyavāyān|
kharjūraśālūkakapitthajambūbisaṃ kaṣāyaṃ na rasaṃ bhajeta||
ityaśmarīcikitsā|
6.26.77 |  vyāyāmatīkṣṇātivirekabasticintābhayatrāsagadāticārāḥ|
chardyāmasaṃdhāraṇakarśanāni hṛdrogakartṛṛṇi tathā 'bhighātaḥ||
6.26.78 |  vaivarṇyamūrcchājvarakāsahikkāśvāsāsyavairasyatṛṣāpramohāḥ|
chardiḥ kaphotkleśarujo 'ruciśca hṛdrogajāḥ syurvividhāstathā 'nye||
6.26.79 |  hṛcchūnyabhāvadravaśoṣabhedastambhāḥ samohāḥ pavanādviśeṣaḥ|
pittāttamodūyanadāhamohāḥ saṃtrāsatāpajvarapītabhāvāḥ||
6.26.80 |  stabdhaṃ guru syāt stimitaṃ ca marma kaphāt prasekajvarakāsatandrāḥ|
vidyāttridoṣaṃ tvapi sarvaliṅgaṃ tīvrārtitodaṃ kṛmijaṃ sakaṇḍūm||
6.26.81 |  tailaṃ sasauvīrakamastutakraṃ vāte prapeyaṃ lavaṇaṃ sukhoṣṇam|
mūtrāmbusiddhaṃ lavaṇaiśca tailamānāhagulmārtihṛdāmayaghnam||
6.26.82 |  punarnavāṃ dāru sapañcamūlaṃ rāsnāṃ yavān bilvakulatthakolam|
paktvā jale tena vipācya taialmabhyaṅgapāne 'nilahṛdgadaghnam||
6.26.83 |  harītakīnāgarapuṣkarāhvairvayaḥkayasthālavaṇaiśca kalkaiḥ|
sahiṅgubhiḥ sādhitamagryasarpirgulme sahṛtpārśvagade 'nilotthe||
6.26.84 |  sapuṣkarāhvaṃ phalapūramūlaṃ mahauṣadhaṃ śaṭyabhayā ca kalkāḥ|
kṣārāmbusarpirlavaṇairvimiśrāḥ syurvātahṛdrogavikartikāghnāḥ||
6.26.85 |  kvāthaḥ kṛtaḥ pauṣkaramātuluṅgapalāśabhūtīkaśaṭīsurāhvaiḥ|
sanāgarājājivacāyavānīkṣāraḥ sukhoṣṇo lavaṇaśca peyaḥ||
6.26.86 |  pathyāśaṭīpauṣkarapañcakolāt samātuluṅgādyamakena kalkaḥ|
guḍaprasannālavaṇaiśca bhṛṣṭo hṛtpārśvapṛṣṭhodarayoniśūle||
6.26.87 |  syāttryūṣaṇaṃ dve triphale sapāṭhe nidigdhikāgokṣurakau bale dve|
ṛddhistruṭistāmalakī svaguptā mede madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ sthirā ca||
6.26.88 |  śatāvarī jīvakapṛśniparṇyau dravyairimairakṣasamaiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ|
prasthaṃ ghṛtasyeha pacedvidhijñaḥ prasthena dadhnā tvatha māhiṣeṇa||
6.26.89 |  mātrāṃ palaṃ cārdhapalaṃ picuṃ vā prayojayenmākṣikasaṃprayuktām|
śvāse sakāse tvatha pāṇḍuroge halīmake hṛdgrahaṇīpradoṣe||
6.26.90 |  śītāḥ pradehāḥ pariṣecanāni tathā vireko hṛdi pittaduṣṭe|
drākṣāsitākṣaudraparūṣakaiḥ syācchuddhe tu pittāpahamannapānam||
6.26.91 |  *yaṣṭyāhvikātiktakarohiṇībhyāṃ kalkaṃ pibeccāpi sitājalena|
kṣate ca sarpīṃṣi hitāni sarpirguḍāśca ye tān prasamīkṣya samyak||
6.26.92 |  dadyādbhiṣagdhanvarasāṃśca gavyakṣīrāśināṃ pittahṛdāmayeṣu|
taireva sarve praśamaṃ prayānti pittāmayāḥ śoṇitasaṃśraya ye||
6.26.93 |  drākṣābalāśreyasiśarkarābhiḥ kharjūravīrarṣabhakotpalaiśca|
kākolimedāyugajīvakaiśca kṣīreṇa siddhaṃ mahiṣīghṛtaṃ syāt||
6.26.94 |  kaśerukāśaivalaśṛṅgaveraprapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ bisasya|
granthiśca sarpiḥ payasā pacettaiḥ kṣaudrānvitaṃ pittahṛdāmayaghnam||
6.26.95 |  sthirādikalkaiḥ payasā ca siddhaṃ drākṣārasenekṣurasena vā 'pi|
sarpirhitaṃ svāduphalekṣujāśca rasāḥ suśītā hṛdi pittaduṣṭe||
6.26.96 |  svinnasya vāntasya vilaṅghitasya kriyā kaphaghnī kaphamarmaroge|
kaulatthadhānyaiśca rasairyavānnaṃ pānāni tīkṣṇāni *ca śaṅkarāṇi||
6.26.97 |  mūtre śṛtāḥ kaṭphalaśṛṅgaverapītadrupathyātiviṣāḥ pradeyāḥ|
*kṛṣṇāśaṭīpuṣkaramūlarāsnāvacābhayānāgaracūrṇakaṃ ca||
6.26.98 |  udumbarāśvatthavaṭārjunākhye pālāśarauhītakakhāvire ca|
kvāthe trivṛttryūṣaṇacūrṇasiddho lehaḥ kaphaghno 'śiśirāmbuyuktaḥ||
6.26.99 |  śilāhvayaṃ vā bhiṣagapramattaḥ prayojayet kalpavidhānadiṣṭam|
prāśaṃ *tathā++āgastyamathāpi lehaṃ rasāyanaṃ brāhmamathāmalakyāḥ||
6.26.100 |  tridoṣaje laṅghanamāditaḥ syādannaṃ ca sarveṣu hitaṃ vidheyam|
hīnātimadhyatvamavekṣya caiva kāryaṃ trayāṇāmapi karma śastam||
6.26.101 |  bhuktea+dhikaṃ jīryati śūlamalpaṃ jīrṇe sthitaṃ cet suradārukuṣṭham|
satilvakaṃ dve lavaṇe viḍaṅgamuṣṇāmbunā sātiviṣaṃ pibet saḥ||
6.26.102 |  jīrṇe 'dhike snehavirecanaṃ syāt phalairvirecyo yadi jīryati syāt|
triṣveva kāleṣvadhike tu śūle tīkṣṇaṃ hitaṃ mūlavirecanaṃ syāt||
6.26.103 |  prāyo 'nilo ruddhagatiḥ prakupyatyāmāśaye śodhanameva tasmāt|
kāryaṃ tathā laṅghanapācanaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṛmighnaṃ kṛmihṛdgade ca||
iti hṛdrogacikitsā|
6.26.104 |  saṃdhāraṇājīrṇarajotibhāṣyakrodhartuvaiṣamyaśirobhitāpaiḥ|
prajāgarātisvapanāmbuśītairavaśyayā maithunabāṣpadhūmaiḥ||
6.26.105 |  saṃstyānadoṣe śirasi pravṛddho vāyuḥ pratiśyāyamudīrayettu|
ghrāṇārtitodau kṣavathurjalābhaḥ srāvo 'nilāt sasvaramūrdharogaḥ||
6.26.106 |  nāsāgrapākajvaravaktraśoṣatṛṣṇoṣṇapītasravaṇāni pittāt|
kāsārucisrāvaghanaprasekāḥ kaphādguruḥ srotasi cāpi kaṇḍūḥ||
6.26.107 |  sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātāt syuḥ pīnase *tīvraruje 'tiduḥkhe|
sarvo 'tivṛddho 'hitabhojanāttu duṣṭapratiśyāya upekṣitaḥ syāt||
6.26.108 |  tatastu rogāḥ kṣavathuśca nāsāśoṣaḥ pratīnāhaparisravau ca|
ghrāṇasya pūtitvamapīnasaśca sapākaśothārbudapūyaraktāḥ||
6.26.109 |  arūṃsi śīrṣaśravaṇākṣirogakhālityaharyarjunalomabhāvāḥ|
tṛṭśvāsakāsajvararaktapittavaisvaryaśoṣāśca tato bhavanti||
6.26.110 |  rodhābhighātasravaśoṣapākairghrāṇaṃ yutaṃ yaśca na vetti gandham|
durgandhi cāsyaṃ bahuśaḥprakopi duṣṭapratiśyāyamudāharettam||
6.26.111 |  saṃspṛśya marmāṇyanilastu mūrdhni viṣvakpathasthaḥ kṣavathuṃ karoti|
kruddhaḥ sa saṃśoṣya kaphaṃ tu nāsāśṛṅgāṭakaghrāṇaviśoṣaṇaṃ ca||
6.26.112 |  ucchvāsamārgaṃ tu kaphaḥ savāto rundhyāt pratīnāhamudāharettam|
yo mastuluṅgādghanapītapakvaḥ kaphaḥ *sravedeṣa parisravastu||
6.26.113 |  vaivarṇyadaurgandhyamupekṣyā tu syāt pūtinasyaṃ śvayathurbhramaśca|
ānahyate yasya viśuṣyate ca praklidyate dhūpyati cāpi nāsā||
6.26.114 |  na vetti yo gandharasāṃśca janturjuṣṭaṃ vyavasyettamapīnasena|
taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavaṃ vikāraṃ brūyāt pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgam||
6.26.115 |  sadāharāgaḥ śvayathuḥ sapākaḥ syād ghrāṇapāko 'pi ca raktapittāt|
ghrāṇaśritāsṛkprabhṛtīna pradūṣya kurvanti nāsāśvayathuṃ malāśca||
6.26.116 |  ghrāṇe tathocchvāsagatiṃ nirudhya māṃsāsradoṣādapi cārbudāni|
ghrāṇāt sravedvā śravaṇānmukhādvā pittāktamasraṃ tvapi pūyaraktam||
6.26.117 |  kuryāt sapittaḥ pavanastvagādīn saṃdūṣya cārūṃṣi sapākavanti|
nāsā pradīpteva narasya yasya dīptaṃ tu taṃ rogamudāharanti||
iti nāsāroganidānam|
6.26.118 |  bhṛśārtiśūlaṃ sphuratīha vātāt pittāt sadāhārti kaphādguru syāt|
sarvaistridoṣaṃ krimibhistu kaṇḍūrdaurgandhyatodārtiyutaṃ śiraḥ syāt||
iti śiroroganidānam|
6.26.119 |  mukhāmaye mārutaje tu śoṣakārkaśyaraukṣyāṇi calā rujaśca|
kṛṣṇāruṇaṃ niṣpatanaṃ saśītaṃ prasraṃsanaspandanatodabhedāḥ||
6.26.120 |  *tṛṣṇājvarasphoṭakatāludāhā dhūmāyanaṃ cāpyavadīrṇatā ca|
pittāt samūrcchā vividhā rujaśca varṇāśca śuklāruṇavarṇavarjyāḥ||
6.26.121 |  kaṇḍūrgurutvaṃ sitavijjalatvaṃ sneho 'rucirjāḍyakaphaprasekau|
utkleśamandānalatā ca tandrā rujaśca mandāḥ kaphavaktraroge||
6.26.122 |  sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu vaktraroge bhavanti yasmin sa tu sarvajaḥ syāt|
saṃsthānadūṣyākṛtināmabhedāccaite catuḥṣaṣṭividhā bhavanti||
6.26.123 |  śālākyatantre 'bhihitāni teṣāṃ nimittarūpākṛtibheṣajāni|
yathāpradeśaṃ tu caturvidhasya kriyāṃ pravakṣyāmi mukhāmayasya||
iti mukharoganidānam|
6.26.124 |  vātādibhiḥ śokabhayātilobhakrodhairmanoghnāśanagandharūpaiḥ|
arocakāḥ syuḥ parihṛṣṭadantaḥ kaṣāyavaktraśca mato 'nilena||
6.26.125 |  kaṭvamlamuṣṇaṃ virasaṃ ca pūti pittena vidyāllavaṇaṃ ca vaktram|
mādhuryapaicchilyagurutvaśaitya*vibaddhasaṃbaddhayutaṃ kaphena||
6.26.126 |  arocake śokabhayānilobha*krodhādyahṛdyāśanagandhaje syāt|
svābhāvikaṃ vaktramathāruciśca tridoṣaje naikarasaṃ bhavettu||
ityarocakanidānam|
6.26.127 |  nādo 'tirukkarṇamalasya śoṣaḥ srāvastanuścāśravaṇaṃ ca vātāt|
śophaḥ sarāgo daraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ sapītapūtiśravaṇaṃ ca pittāt||
6.26.128 |  vaiśrutyakaṇḍūsthiraśophaśuklasnigdhaśrutiḥ śleṣmabhave 'lparuk ca|
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātāt srāvaśca tatrādhikadoṣavarṇaḥ||
iti karṇaroganidānam|
6.26.129 |  *alpastu rāgo 'nupadehavāṃśca satodabhedo 'nilajākṣiroge|
pittāt sadāho 'tirujaḥ sarāgaḥ pītopadehaḥ subhṛśoṣṇavāhī||
6.26.130 |  śuklopadehaṃ bahupicchilāśru netraṃ kaphāt syādgurutā sakaṇḍuḥ|
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātānnetrāmayāḥ ṣaṇṇavatistu bhedāt||
6.26.131 |  teṣāmabhivyaktirabhipradiṣṭā śālākyatantreṣu cikitsitaṃ ca|
parādhikāre tu na vistaroktiḥ śasteti tenātra na naḥ prayāsaḥ||
iti netraroganidānam|
6.26.132 |  tejo 'nilādyaiḥ saha keśabhūmiṃ dagdhvā++āśu kuryāt khalatiṃ narasya|
kiṃcittu dagdhvā palitāni kuryāddhariprabhatvaṃ ca śiroruhāṇām||
6.26.133 |  ityūrdhvajatrūtthagadaikadeśas*tantre nibaddho 'yamaśūnyatārtham|
ataḥ paraṃ bheṣajasaṃgrahaṃ tu nibodha saṃkṣepata ucyamānam||
iti khālityaroganidānam|
6.26.134 |  vātāt sakāsavaisvarye sakṣāraṃ pīnase vṛtam|
pibedrasaṃ payaścoṣṇaṃ snaihikaṃ dhūmameva vā||
6.26.135 |  śatāhvā tvagbalā mūlaṃ syonākairaṇḍabilvajam|
sāragvadhaṃ pibedvartiṃ madhūcchiṣṭavasāghṛtaiḥ||
6.26.136 |  athavā saghṛtān saktūn kṛtvā mallakasaṃpuṭe|
navapratiśyāyavatāṃ dhūmaṃ vaidyaḥ prayojayet||
6.26.137 |  śaṅkhamūrdhalalāṭārtau pāṇisvedopanāhanam|
svabhyakte kṣavathusrāvarodhādau saṃkarādayaḥ||
6.26.138 |  ghreyāśca rohiṣājājīvacātarkāricorakāḥ|
tvakpatramaricailānāṃ cūrṇā vā sopakuñcikāḥ||
6.26.139 |  srotaḥśṛṅgāṭanāsākṣiśoṣe tailaṃ ca nāvanam|
prabhāvyāje tilān kṣīre tena piṣṭāṃstaduṣmaṇā||
6.26.140 |  mandasvinnān sayaṣṭyāhvacūrṇāṃstenaiva pīḍayet|
daśamūlasya niṣkvāthe rāsnāmadhukakalkavat||
6.26.141 |  siddhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ tailaṃ daśakṛtvo 'ṇu tat smṛtam|
snigdhasyāsthāpanairdoṣaṃ nirharedvātapīnase||
6.26.142 |  snigdhāmloṣṇaiśca laghvannaṃ grāmyādīnāṃ rasairhitam|
uṣṇāmbunā snānapāne nivātoṣṇapratiśrayaḥ||
6.26.143 |  cintāvyāyāmavākceṣṭāvyavāyavirato bhavet|
vātaje pīnase dhīmānicchannevātmano hitam||
6.26.144 |  paitte sarpiḥ pibet *siddhaṃ śṛṅgaveraśṛtaṃ payaḥ|
pācanārthaṃ pibet pakve kāryaṃ mūrdhavirecanam||
6.26.145 |  pāṭhādvirajanīmūrvāpippalījātipallavaiḥ|
dantyā ca sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ syāt pakvapīnase||
6.26.146 |  pūyāsre raktapittaghnāḥ kaṣāyā nāvanāni ca|
*pākadāhaḍhyarūkṣeṣu śītā *lepāḥ sasecanāḥ||
6.26.147 |  *ghreyanasyopacārāśca kaṣāyāḥ svāduśītalāḥ|
mandapitte pratiśyāye snigdhaiḥ kuryādvirecanam||
6.26.148 |  ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ yavāḥ śālirgodhūmā jāṅgalā rasāḥ|
śītāmlāstiktaśākāni yūṣā mudgādibhirhitāḥ||
6.26.149 |  gauravārocakeṣvādau laṅghanaṃ kaphapīnase|
svedāḥ sekāśca pākārthaṃ lipte śirasi sarpiṣā||
6.26.150 |  laśunaṃ mudgacūrṇena vyoṣakṣāraghṛtairyutam|
deyaṃ kaphaghnavamanamutkliṣṭaśleṣmaṇe hitam||
6.26.151 |  apīnase pūtinasye ghrāṇasrāve sakaṇḍuke|
dhūmaḥ śasto 'vapīḍaśca kaṭubhiḥ kaphapīnase||
6.26.152 |  namaḥśilā vacā vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ hiṅgu gugguluḥ|
cūrṇo ghreyaḥ pradhamanaṃ kaṭubhiśca phalaistathā||
6.26.153 |  bhārgīmadanatarkārīsurasādivipācite|
mūtre lākṣā vacā lambā viḍaṅgaṃ kuṣṭhapippalī||
6.26.154 |  kṛtvā kalkaṃ karañjaṃ ca tailaṃ taiḥ sārṣapaṃ pacet|
pākānmukte ghane nasyametanmedonibhe kaphe||
6.26.155 |  snigdhasya vyāhate vege cchardanaṃ kaphapīnase|
vamanīyaśṛtakṣīratilamāṣayavāgunā||
6.26.156 |  vārtākakulakavyoṣakulatthāḍhakimudgajāḥ|
yūṣāḥ kaphaghnamannaṃ ca śastamuṣṇāmbuseca(va)nam||
6.26.157 |  sarvajit pīnase duṣṭe kāryaṃ śophe ca śophajit|
ksāro 'rbudādhimāṃseṣu kriyā śeṣeṣvavekṣya ca||
iti pīnasanāsārogacikitsā|
6.26.158 |  vātike śiraso roge snehān svedān sanāvanān|
pānānnamupanāhāṃśca kuryādvātāmayāpahān||
6.26.159 |  tailabhṛṣṭairagurvādyaiḥ sukhoṣṇairupanāhanam|
jīvanīyaiḥ sumanasā matsyairmāṃsaiśca śasyate||
6.26.160 |  rāsnāsthirādibhiḥ siddhaṃ sakṣīraṃ nasyamartinut|
tailaṃ rāsnādvikākolīśarkarābhirathāpi vā||
6.26.161 |  balāmadhūkayaṣṭyāhvavidārīcandanotpalaiḥ|
jīvakarṣabhakadrākṣāśarkarābhiśca sādhitaḥ||
6.26.162 |  prasthastailasya sakṣīro jāṅgalārdhatulārase|
nasyaṃ sarvordhvajatrūtthavātapittāmayāpaham||
6.26.163 |  daśamūlabalārāsnātriphalāmadhukaiḥ saha|
mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntraśakṛttuṇḍāṅgrivarjitam||
6.26.164 |  jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet|
madhuraiḥ kārṣikaiḥ kalkaiḥ śirorogārditāpaham||
6.26.165 |  karṇākṣināsikājihvātālvāsyagalaroganut|
māyūramitivikhyātamūrdhvajatrugadāpaham||
iti māyūraghṛtam|
6.26.166 |  etenaiva kaṣāyeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
caturguṇena payasā kalkairebhiśca kārṣikaiḥ||
6.26.167 |  jīvantītriphalāmedāmṛdvīkardhiparūṣakaiḥ|
samaṅgācavikābhārgīkāśmarīsuradārubhiḥ||
6.26.168 |  ātmaguptāmahāmedātālakharjūramastakaiḥ|
*mṛṇālabisaśālūkaśṛṅgījīvakapadmakaiḥ||
6.26.169 |  śatāvarīvidārīkṣubṛhatīsārivāyugaiḥ|
mūrvāśvadaṃṣṭrarṣabhakaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ||
6.26.170 |  rāsnāsthirātāmalakīrsūkṣmailāśaṭipauṣkaraiḥ|
punarnavātugākṣīrīkākolīdhanvayāsakaiḥ||
6.26.171 |  *kharjūrākṣoṭavātāmamuñjātābhiṣukairapi|
dravyaurebhiryathālābhaṃ pūrvakalpena sādhitam||
6.26.172 |  nasye pāne tathā 'bhyaṅge bastau caiva prayojayet|
śirorogeṣu sarveṣu kāse śvāse ca dāruṇe||
6.26.173 |  namyāpṛṣṭhagrahe śoṣe svarabhede tathā 'rdite|
yonyasṛkśukradoṣeṣu śastaṃ vandhyāsutapradam||
6.26.174 |  ṛtusnātā tathā nārī pītvā putraṃ prasūyate|
mahāmāyūramityetadghṛtamātreyapūjitam||
iti mahāmāyūraghṛtam|
6.26.175 |  ākhubhiḥ kukkuṭairhaṃsaiḥ śaśaiścāpi hi buddhimān|
kalpenānena vipacet sarpirūrdhvagadāpaham||
6.26.176 |  paitte ghṛtaṃ payaḥ sekāḥ śītā lepāḥ sanāvanāḥ|
jīvanīyāni sarpīṃṣi pānānnaṃ cāpi pittanut||
6.26.177 |  candanośīrayaṣṭyāhvabalāvyāghranakhotpalaiḥ|
kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ pradehaḥ syācchṛtairvā pariṣecanam||
6.26.178 |  tvakpatraśarkarākalkaḥ supiṣṭastaṇḍulāmbunā|
kāryo 'vapīḍaḥ sarpiśca nasyaṃ tasyānu paittike||
6.26.179 |  yaṣṭyāhvacandanānantākṣīrasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam|
nāvanaṃ śarkarādrākṣāmadhūkairvā 'pi pittaje||
6.26.180 |  kaphaje sveditaṃ dhūmanasyapradhamanādibhiḥ|
śuddhaṃ pralepapānānnaiḥ kaphaghnaiḥ samupācaret||
6.26.181 |  purāṇasarpiṣaḥ pānaistīkṣṇairbastibhireva ca|
kaphānilotthite dāhaḥ śeṣayo raktamokṣaṇam||
6.26.182 |  eraṇḍanaladakṣaumaguggulvagurucandanaiḥ|
dhūmavartīṃ pibedgandhairakuṣṭhatagaraistathā||
6.26.183 |  sannipātabhave kāryā sannipātahitā kriyā|
krimije caiva kartavyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ mūrdhavirecanam||
6.26.184 |  tvagdantīvyāghrakarajaviḍaṅganavamālikāḥ|
apāmārgaphalaṃ bījaṃ naktamālaśirīṣayoḥ|
kṣavako 'śmantako bilvaṃ haridrā hiṅgu yūthikā||
6.26.185 |  phaṇijjhakaśca taistailamavimūtre caturguṇe|
siddhaṃ syānnāvanaṃ cūrṇaṃ caiṣāṃ pradhamanaṃ hitam||
6.26.186 |  phalaṃ śigrukarañjābhyāṃ savyoṣaṃ cāvapīḍakaḥ|
kaṣāyaḥ svarasaḥ kṣāraścūrṇaṃ kalko 'vapīḍakaḥ||
6.26.187 |  śuktatiktakaṭukṣaudrakaṣāyaiḥ kavalagrahaḥ|
iti śirorogacikitsā|
dhūmaḥ pradhamanaṃ śuddhiradhaśchardanalaṅghanam||
6.26.188 |  bhojyaṃ ca mukharogeṣu yathāsvaṃ doṣanuddhitam|
pippalyagurudārvītvagyavakṣārarasāñjanam||
6.26.189 |  pāṭhāṃ tejovatīṃ pathyāṃ samabhāgaṃ vicūrṇayet|
mukharogeṣu sarveṣu sakṣaudraṃ tadvidhārayet||
6.26.190 |  sīdhumādhavamādhvīkaiḥ śreṣṭho 'yaṃ kavalagrahaḥ|
tejohvāmabhayāmelāṃ samaṅgāṃ kaṭukāṃ ghanam||
6.26.191 |  pāṭhāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ lodhraṃ dārvīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca cūrṇayet|
dantānāṃ gharṣaṇaṃ raktasrāvakaṇḍūrujāpaham||
6.26.192 |  pañcakolakatālīsapatrailāmaricatvacaḥ|
palāśamuṣkakakṣārayavakṣārāśca cūrṇitāḥ||
6.26.193 |  guḍe purāṇe dviguṇe kvathite guṭikāḥ kṛtāḥ|
karkandhumātrāḥ saptāhaṃ sthitā muṣkakabhasmani||
6.26.194 |  kaṇṭharogeṣu sarveṣu *dhāryāḥ syuramṛtopamāḥ|
gṛhadhūmo yavakṣāraḥ pāṭhā vyoṣaṃ rasāñjanam||
6.26.195 |  tejohvā triphalā lodhraṃ citrakaśceti cūrṇitam|
sakṣaudraṃ dhārayedetadgalarogavināśanam||
6.26.196 |  kālakaṃ nāma tacūrṇaṃ dantāsyagalaroganut|
iti kālakacūrṇam|
manaḥśilā yavakṣāro haritālaṃ sasaindhavam||
6.26.197 |  dārvītvak ceti taccūrṇaṃ mākṣikeṇa samāyutam|
mūrcchitaṃ ghṛtamaṇḍena kaṇṭharogeṣu dhārayet||
6.26.198 |  mukharogeṣu ca śreṣṭhaṃ pītakaṃ nāma kīrtitam|
iti pītakacūrṇam|
mṛdvīkā kaṭukā vyoṣaṃ dārvītvak triphalā ghanam||
6.26.199 |  mūrcchitaṃ ghṛtamaṇḍena kaṇṭharogeṣu dhārayet|
pāṭhā rasāñjanaṃ mūrvā tejohveti ca cūrṇitam||
6.26.200 |  kṣaudrayuktaṃ vidhātavyaṃ galaroge bhiṣagjitam|
yogāstvete trayaḥ proktā vātapittakaphāpahāḥ||
6.26.201 |  kaṭukātiviṣāpāṭhādārvīmustakaliṅgakāḥ|
gomūtrakvathitāḥ peyāḥ kaṇṭharogavināśanāḥ||
6.26.202 |  svarasaḥ kvathito dārvyā ghanībhūto rasakriyā|
sakṣaudrā mukharogāsṛgdoṣanāḍīvraṇāpahā||
6.26.203 |  tāluśoṣe *tvatṛṣṇasya sarpirauttarabhaktikam|
nāvanaṃ madhurāḥ snigdhāḥ śītāścaiva rasā hitāḥ||
6.26.204 |  mukhapāke sirākarma śiraḥkāyavirecanam|
mūtratailaghṛtakṣaudrakṣīraiśca kavalagrahāḥ||
6.26.205 |  sakṣaudrāstriphalāpāṭhāmṛdvīkājātipallavāḥ|
kaṣāyatiktakāḥ śītāḥ kvāthāśca mukhadhāvanāḥ||
6.26.206 |  tulāṃ khadirasārasya dviguṇāmarimedasaḥ|
prakṣālya jarjarīkṛtya caturdroṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacet||
6.26.207 |  droṇaśeṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtvā bhūyaḥ pacecchanaiḥ|
tatastasmin ghanībhūte cūrṇīkṛtyākṣabhāgikam||
6.26.208 |  candanaṃ padmakośīraṃ mañjiṣṭhā dhātakī ghanam|
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭyāhvatvagelāpadmakeśaram||
6.26.209 |  lākṣāṃ rasāñjanaṃ māṃsītriphalālodhravālakam|
rajanyau phalinīmelāṃ samaṅgāṃ kaṭphlaṃ vacām||
6.26.210 |  yavāsāgurupattaṅgagairikāñjanamāvapet|
lavaṅganakhakakkolajātikośān palonmitān||
6.26.211 |  karpūrakuḍavaṃ cāpi kṣipecchīte 'vatārite|
tatastu guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ śuṣkāścāsyena dhārayet||
6.26.212 |  tailaṃ cānena kalkena kaṣāyeṇa ca sādhayet|
dantānāṃ calanabhraṃśaśauśiryakrimiroganut||
6.26.213 |  mukhapākāsyadaurgandhyajāḍyārocakanāśanam|
srāvopalepapaicchilyavaisvaryagalaśoṣanut||
6.26.214 |  dantāsyagalarogeṣu sarveṣvetat parāyaṇam|
khadirādiguṭīkeyaṃ tailaṃ ca khadirādikam||
iti khadirādiguṭikā tailaṃ ca|
6.26.215 |  arucau kavalagrāhā dhūmāḥ samukhadhāvanāḥ|
manojñamannapānaṃ ca harṣaṇāśvāsanāni ca||
6.26.216 |  kuṣṭhasauvarcalājājīśarkarāmaricaṃ biḍam|
dhātryelāpadmakośīrapippalyutpalacandanam||
6.26.217 |  lodhraṃ tejovatī pathyā tryūṣaṇaṃ sayavāgrajam|
ārdradāḍimaniryāsaścājājīśarkarāyutaḥ||
6.26.218 |  satailamākṣikāstvete catvāraḥ kavalagrahāḥ|
caturo 'rocakān hanyurvātādyekajasarvajān||
6.26.219 |  kāravīmaricājājīdrākṣāvṛkṣāmladāḍimam|
sauvarcalaṃ guḍaḥ kṣaudraṃ sarvārocakanāśanam||
6.26.220 |  bastiṃ samīraṇe, pitte virekaṃ, vamanaṃ kaphe|
kuryāddhṛdyānukūlāni harṣaṇaṃ ca manoghnaje||
ityarocakacikitsā|
6.26.221 |  karṇaśūle tu vātaghnī hitā pīnasavat kriyā|
pradehāḥ pūraṇaṃ nasyaṃ pākasrāve vraṇakriyāḥ||
6.26.222 |  bhojyāni ca yathādoṣaṃ kuryāt snehāṃśca pūraṇān|
hiṅgutumbaruśuṇṭhībhistailaṃ tu sārṣapaṃ pacet||
6.26.223 |  etaddhi pūraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ karṇaśūlanivāraṇam|
devadāruvacāśuṇṭhīśatāhvākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ||
6.26.224 |  tailaṃ siddhaṃ bastamūtre karṇaśūlanivāraṇam|
varāṭakān samāhṛtya dahenmṛdbhājane nave||
6.26.225 |  tadbhasma *ścyotayettena gandhatailaṃ vipācayet|
rasāñjanasya śuṇṭhyāśca kalkābhyāṃ karṇaśūlanut||
6.26.226 |  *śuṣkamūlakaśuṇṭhānāṃ kṣāro hiṅgu mahauṣadham|
śatapuṣpā vacā kuṣṭhaṃ dāru śigru rasāñjanam||
6.26.227 |  sauvarcalayavakṣārasvārjikodbhidasaindhavam|
bhūrjagranthirbiḍaṃ mustaṃ madhuśuktaṃ caturguṇam||
6.26.228 |  mātuluṅgarasaścaiva kadalyā rasa eva ca|
*sarvairetairyathoddiṣṭaiḥ kṣāratailaṃ vipācayet||
6.26.229 |  bādhiryaṃ karṇanādaśca pūyasrāvaśca dāruṇaḥ|
krimayaḥ karṇaśūlaṃ ca pūraṇādasya *naśyati||
6.26.230 |  mukhakarṇākṣirogeṣu yathoktaṃ pīnase vidhim|
kuryādbhiṣak samīkṣyādau doṣakālabalābalam||
iti karṇarogacikitsā|
6.26.231 |  utpannamātre taruṇe netraroge biḍālakaḥ|
kāryo dāhopadehāśruśopharāganivāraṇaḥ||
6.26.232 |  nāgaraṃ saindhavaṃ sarpirmaṇḍena ca rasakriyā|
nighṛṣṭaṃ vātike tadvanmadhusaindhavagairikam||
6.26.233 |  tathā śāvarakaṃ lodhraṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ biḍālakaḥ|
tadvat kāryo harītakyā ghṛtabhṛṣṭo rujāpahaḥ||
6.26.234 |  paittike candanānantāmañjiṣṭhābhirbiḍālakaḥ|
kāryaḥ padmakayaṣṭyāhvamāṃsīkālīyakaistathā||
6.26.235 |  gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ mustaṃ rocanā *ca rasakriyā|
kaphe kāryā tathā kṣaudraṃ priyaṅguḥ samanaḥśilā||
6.26.236 |  sannipāte tu sarvaiḥ syādbahirakṣṇoḥ pralepanam|
*pakṣmāṇyaspṛśyatā kāryaṃ saṃpakve tvañjanaṃ tryahāt||
6.26.237 |  āścyotanaṃ mārutaje kvātho bilvādibhirhitaḥ|
koṣṇaḥ sairaṇḍatarkārībṛhatīmadhuśigrubhiḥ||
6.26.238 |  pṛthvīkādārvimañjiṣṭhālākṣādvimadhukotpalaiḥ|
kvāthaḥ saśarkaraḥ śītaḥ pūraṇaṃ raktapittanut||
6.26.239 |  *nāgaratriphalāmustanimbavāsārasaḥ kaphe|
koṣṇamāścyotanaṃ miśrairoṣadhaiḥ sānnipātake||
6.26.240 |  bṛhatyeraṇḍamūlatvak śigroḥ puṣpaṃ sasaindhavam|
ajākṣīreṇa piṣṭaṃ syādvartirvātākṣiroganut||
6.26.241 |  sumanaḥkorakāḥ śaṅkhastriphalā madhukaṃ balā|
pittaraktāpahā vartiḥ piṣṭā divyena vāriṇā||
6.26.242 |  saindhavaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ śaṅkhanābhiḥ samudrajaḥ|
phenaḥ śaileyakaṃ sarjo vartiḥ śleṣmākṣiroganut||
6.26.243 |  amṛtāhvā bisaṃ bilvaṃ paṭolaṃ chāgalaṃ śakṛt|
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ dārvī kālānusārivā||
6.26.244 |  eṣāmaṣṭapalān bhāgān sudhautāñjarjarīkṛtān|
toye paktvā rase pūte bhūyaḥ pakve rase ghane||
6.26.245 |  karṣaṃ ca śvetamaricājjātīpuṣpānnavāt palam|
cūrṇaṃ kṣiptvā kṛtā vartiḥ *sarvaghnī dṛkprasādanī||
6.26.246 |  śaṅkhapravālavaidūryalauhatāmraplavāsthibhiḥ|
srotojaśvetamaricairvartiḥ sarvākṣiroganut||
6.26.247 |  śāṇārdhaṃ maricāddvau ca pippalyarṇavaphenayoḥ|
śāṇārdhaṃ saindhavācchāṇā nava sauvīrakāñjanāt||
6.26.248 |  piṣṭaṃ susūkṣmaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇāñjanamidaṃ śubham|
kaṇḍūkācakaphārtānāṃ malānāṃ ca viśodhanam||
6.26.249 |  bastamūtre tryahaṃ *sthāpyamelācūrṇaṃ subhāvitam|
cūrṇāñjanaṃ hi taimiryakrimipillamalāpaham||
6.26.250 |  sauvīramañjanaṃ tutthaṃ tāpyo dhāturmanaḥśilā|
cakṣuṣyā madhukaṃ lohā maṇayaḥ pauṣpamañjanam||
6.26.251 |  saindhavaṃ śaukarī daṃṣṭrā katakaṃ cāñjanaṃ śubham|
timirādiṣu cūrṇaṃ vā vartirveyamanuttamā||
6.26.252 |  katakasya phalaṃ śaṅkhaḥ saindhavaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ sitā|
pheno rasāñjanaṃ kṣaudraṃ viḍaṅgāni manaḥśilā||
6.26.253 |  kukkuṭāṇḍakapālāni varireṣā vyapohati|
timiraṃ paṭalaṃ kācaṃ malaṃ cāśu sukhāvatī||
iti sukhāvatī vartiḥ|
6.26.254 |  triphalākukkuṭāṇḍatvakkāsīsamayaso rajaḥ|
nīlotpalaṃ viḍaṅgāni phenaṃ ca saritāṃ pateḥ||
6.26.255 |  ājena payasā piṣṭvā bhāvayettāmrabhājane|
saptarātraṃ sthitaṃ bhūyaḥ piṣṭvā kṣīreṇa vartayet||
6.26.256 |  eṣā dṛṣṭipradā vartirandhasyābhinnacakṣuṣaḥ|
iti dṛṣṭipradā vartiḥ|
vadane kṛṣṇasarpasya nihitaṃ māsamañjanam||
6.26.257 |  tatastasmāt samṛddhṛtya suśuṣkaṃ cūrṇayedbudhaḥ|
sumanaḥkorakaiḥ śuṣkairardhāṃśaiḥ saindhavena ca||
6.26.258 |  etannetrāñjanaṃ kāryaṃ timiraghnamanuttamam|
pippalyaḥ kiṃśukaraso vasā sarpasya saindhavam||
6.26.259 |  jīrṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ ca sarvākṣirogaghnī syādrasakriyā|
kṛṣṇasarpavasā kṣaudraṃ raso dhātryā rasakriyā||
6.26.260 |  śastā sarvākṣirogeṣu kācārbudamaleṣu ca|
dhātrīrasāñjanakṣaudrasarpirbhistu rasakriyā||
6.26.261 |  pittaraktākṣirogaghnī taimiryapaṭalāpahā|
dhātrīsaindhavapippalyaḥ syuralpamaricāḥ samāḥ||
6.26.262 |  kṣaudrayuktā nihantyāndhyaṃ paṭalaṃ ca rasakriyā|
iti netrarogacikitsā|
6.26.263 |  khālitye palite valyāṃ harilomni ca śodhitam|
nasyaistailaiḥ śirovaktrapralepaiścāpyupācaret|
siddhaṃ vidārīgandhādyairjīvanīyairathāpi ca||
6.26.264 |  nasyaṃ syādaṇutailaṃ vā khālityapalitāpaham|
kṣīrāt sahacarādbhṛṅgarājācca saurasādrasāt||
6.26.265 |  prasthaistu kuḍavastailādyaṣṭyāhvapalakalkitaḥ|
siddhaḥ śilāsame bhāṇḍe meṣaśṛṅgādiṣu sthitaḥ||
6.26.266 |  nasyaṃ syādbhiṣajā samyagyojitaṃ palitāpaham|
bhiṣajā kṣīrapiṣṭau vā dugdhikākaravīrakau||
6.26.267 |  utpāṭya palite deyau tāvubhau palitāpahau|
mārkavasvarasāt kṣīrāddbiprasthaṃ madhukāt palam||
6.26.268 |  taiḥ pacet kuḍavaṃ tailāttannasyaṃ palitāpaham|
ādityavallyā mūlāni kṛṣṇaśaireyakasya ca||
6.26.269 |  surasasya ca patrāṇi *patraṃ kṛṣṇaśaṇasya ca|
mārkavaḥ kākamācī ca madhukaṃ devadāru ca||
6.26.270 |  pṛthagdaśapalāṃśāni pippalyastriphalā 'ñjanam|
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ mañjiṣṭhā lodhraṃ kṛṣṇāgurūtpalam||
6.26.271 |  āmrāsthi kardamaḥ kṛṣṇo mṛṇālaṃ raktacandanam|
nīlī bhallātakāsthīni kāsīsaṃ madayantikā||
6.26.272 |  somarājyasanaḥ śastraṃ kṛṣṇau piṇḍītacitrakau|
puṣkarārjunakāśmaryāṇyāmrajambūphalāni ca||
6.26.273 |  pṛthak pañcapalāṃśāni taiḥ piṣṭairāḍhakaṃ pacet|
baibhītakasya tailasya dhātrīrasacaturguṇam||
6.26.274 |  kuryādādityapākaṃ vā yāvacchuṣko bhavedrasaḥ|
lohapātre tataḥ pūtaṃ saṃśuddhamupayojayet||
6.26.275 |  pāne nasyakriyāyāṃ ca śirobhyaṅge tathaiva ca|
etaccakṣuṣyamāyuṣyaṃ śirasaḥ sarvaroganut||
6.26.276 |  mahānīlamiti khyātaṃ palitaghnamanuttamam|
iti mahānīlatailam|
prapauṇḍarīkamadhukapippalīcandanotpalaiḥ||
6.26.277 |  kārṣikaistailakuḍavo dviguṇāmalakīrasaḥ|
siddhaḥ sa pratimarśaḥ syāt sarvamūrdhagadāpahaḥ||
6.26.278 |  (*palitaghno viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇātreyeṇa bhāṣitaḥ|)
kṣīraṃ priyālayaṣṭyāhve jīvakādyo gaṇastilāḥ||
6.26.279 |  kṛṣṇā vaktre pralepaḥ syāddharilomanivāraṇaḥ|
*tilāḥ sāmalakāścaiva kiñjalko madhukaṃ madhu||
6.26.280 |  bṛṃhayedrañjayecaitat keśānmūrdhapralepanāt|
pacetsaindhavaśuktāmlairayaścūrṇaṃ sataṇḍulam||
6.26.281 |  tenāliptaṃ śiraḥ śuddhamasnigdhamuṣitaṃ niśi|
tat prātastriphalādhautaṃ syāt kṛṣṇamṛdumūrdhajam||
6.26.282 |  ayaścūrṇo 'mlapiṣṭaśca rāgaḥ satriphalo varaḥ|
kuryāccheṣeṣu rogeṣu kriyāṃ svāṃ svāccikitsitāt|
śeṣeṣvādau ca nirdiṣṭā siddhau cānyā pravakṣyate||
iti khālityādicikitsā|
6.26.283 |  sarpīṃṣyuparibhaktāni svarabhede 'nilātmake|
tailaiścatuṣprayogaiśca balārāsnāmṛtāhvayaiḥ||
6.26.284 |  barhitittiridakṣāṇāṃ pañcamūlaśṛtān rasān|
māyūraṃ kṣīrasarpirvā pibetryūṣaṇameva vā||
6.26.285 |  paittike tu virekaḥ syāt payaśca madhuraiḥ śṛtam|
sarpirguḍā ghṛtaṃ tiktaṃ jīvanīyaṃ vṛṣasya vā||
6.26.286 |  kaphaje svarabhede tu tīkṣṇaṃ mūrdhavirecanam|
vireko vamanaṃ dhūmo yavānnakaṭusevanam||
6.26.287 |  cavyabhārgyabhayāvyoṣakṣāramākṣikacitrakān|
lihyādvā pippalīpathye tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ pibecca saḥ||
6.26.288 |  raktaje svarabhede tu *saghṛtā jāṅgalā rasāḥ|
drākṣāvidārīkṣurasāḥ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkarāḥ||
6.26.289 |  yaccoktaṃ kṣayakāsaghnaṃ tacca sarvaṃ cikitsitam|
pittajasvarabhedaghnaṃ sirāvedhaśca raktaje||
6.26.290 |  sannipāte hitāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā na tu sirāvyadhaḥ|
ityuktaṃ svarabhedasya samāsena cikitsitam||
iti svarabhedacikitsā|
6.26.291 |  bhavanti cātra---
vātapittakaphā nṛṛṇāṃ bastihṛnmūrdhasaṃśrayāḥ|
tasmāttatsthānasāmīpyāddhartavyā vamanādibhiḥ||
6.26.292 |  adhyātmaloko vātādyairloko vātaravīndubhiḥ|
pīḍyate dhāryate caiva vikṛtāvikṛtaistathā||
6.26.293 |  viruddhairapi na tvete guṇairghnanti parasparam|
doṣāḥ sahajasātmyatvādviṣaṃ ghoramahīniva||
6.26.294 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
trimarmajānāṃ rogāṇāṃ nidānākṛtibheṣajam|
vistareṇa pṛthagdiṣṭaṃ trimarmīye cikitsite||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne trimarmīyacikitsitaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||26 | |

saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.27.1 |  athāta ūrustambhacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.27.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.27.3 |  śriyā paramayā brāhmyā parayā ca tapaḥśriyā|
*ahīnaṃ candrasūryābhyāṃ sumerumiva parvatam||
6.27.4 |  dhīdhṛtismṛtivijñānajñānakīrtikṣamālayam|
*agniveśo guruṃ kāle saṃśayaṃ paripṛṣṭvān||
6.27.5 |  bhagavan pañca karmāṇi samastāni pṛthak tathā|
nirdiṣṭānyāmayānāṃ hi sarveṣāmeva bheṣajam||
6.27.6 |  doṣajoa 'styāmayaḥ kaścidyasya tāni bhiṣagvara!|
na syuḥ śaktāni śamane sādhyasya kriyayā sataḥ||
6.27.7 |  astyūrustambha ityukte guruṇā tasya kāraṇam|
saliṅgabheṣajaṃ bhūyaḥ pṛṣṭastenābravīdguruḥ||
6.27.8 |  *snigdhoṣṇalaghuśītāni jīrṇājīrṇe samaśnataḥ|
dravaśuṣkadadhikṣīragrāmyānūpaudakāmiṣaiḥ||
6.27.9 |  piṣṭavyāpannamadyātidivāsvapnaprajāgaraiḥ|
laṅghanādhyaśamāyāsabhayavegavidhāraṇaiḥ||
6.27.10 |  snehāccāmaṃ citaṃ koṣṭhe vātādīnmedasā saha|
ruddhvā++āśu gauravādūrū yātyadhogaiḥ sirādibhiḥ||
6.27.11 |  pūrayan sakthijaṅghoru doṣo medobalotkaṭaḥ|
avidheyaparispandaṃ janayatyalpavikramam||
6.27.12 |  mahāsarasi gambhīre pūrṇe 'mbu stimitaṃ yathā|
tiṣṭhati sthiramakṣobhyaṃ tadvadūrugataḥ kaphaḥ||
6.27.13 |  *gauravāyāsasaṅkocadāharuksuptikampanaiḥ|
bhedasphuraṇatodaiśca yukto dehaṃ nihantyasūn||
6.27.14 |  ūrū śleṣmā samedasko vātapitte 'bhibhūya tu|
stambhayetsthairyaśaityābhyāmūrustambhastatastu saḥ||
6.27.15 |  prāgrūpaṃ dhyānanidrātistaimityārocakajvarāḥ|
lomaharṣaśca chardiśca jaṅghorvoḥ sadanaṃ tathā||
6.27.16 |  vātaśaṅkibhirajñānāttasya syāt snehanāt punaḥ|
pādayoḥ sadanaṃ suptiḥ kṛcchrāduddharaṇaṃ tathā||
6.27.17 |  jaṅghoruglāniratyarthaṃ śaśvaccādāhavedanā|
padaṃ ca vyathate nyastaṃ śītasparśaṃ na vetti ca||
6.27.18 |  saṃsthāne pīḍane gatyāṃ cālane cāpyanīśvaraḥ|
anyaneyau hi saṃbhagnāvūrū pādau ca manyate||
6.27.19 |  yadā dāhārtitodārto vepanaḥ puruṣo bhavet|
ūrustambhastadā hanyāt sādhayedanyathā navam||
6.27.20 |  tasya na snehanaṃ kāryaṃ na bastirna virecanam|
na caiva vamanaṃ yasmāttannibodhata kāraṇam||
6.27.21 |  vṛddhaye śleṣmaṇo nityaṃ snehanaṃ bastikarma ca|
tatsthasyoddharaṇe caiva na samarthaṃ virecanam||
6.27.22 |  kaphaṃ kaphasthānagataṃ pittaṃ ca vamanāt sukham|
hartumāmāśayasthau ca sraṃsanāttāvubhāvapi||
6.27.23 |  pakvāśayasthāḥ sarve 'pi bastibhirmūlanirjayāt|
śakyā na tvāmamedobhyāṃ stabdhā jaṅghorusaṃsthitāḥ||
6.27.24 |  vātasthāne hi *tacchaityāddvayoḥ stambhācca tadgatāḥ|
na śakyāḥ sukhamuddhartuṃ jalaṃ nimnādiva sthalāt||
6.27.25 |  tasya saṃśamanaṃ nityaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tathā|
*yuktyapekṣī bhiṣak kuryādadhikatvātkaphāmayoḥ||
6.27.26 |  sadā rūkṣopacārāya yavaśyāmākakodravān|
