śākairalavaṇairdadyājjalatailopasādhitaiḥ||
6.27.27 |  suniṣaṇṇakanimbārkavetrāragvadhapallavaiḥ|
vāyasīvāstukairanyaistikaiśca kulakādibhiḥ||
6.27.28 |  kṣārāriṣṭaprayogāśca harītakyāstathaiva ca|
madhūdakasya pippalyā ūrustambhavināśanāḥ||
6.27.29 |  samaṅgāṃ śālmalīṃ bilvaṃ madhunā saha nā pibet|
tathā śrīveṣṭakodīcyadevadārunatānyapi||
6.27.30 |  candanaṃ dhātakīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tālīsaṃ naladaṃ tathā|
mustaṃ harītakīṃ lodhraṃ padmakaṃ tiktarohiṇīm||
6.27.31 |  devadāru haridre dve vacāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm|
pippalīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ saralaṃ devadāru ca||
6.27.32 |  cavyaṃ citrakamūlāni devadāru harītakīm|
bhallātakaṃ samūlāṃ ca pippalīṃ pañca tān pibet||
6.27.33 |  sakṣaudrānardhaślokoktān kalkānūrugrahāpahān|
śārṅgeṣṭāṃ madanaṃ dantīṃ vatsakasya phalaṃ *vacām||
6.27.34 |  mūrvāmāragvadhaṃ pāṭhāṃ karañjaṃ kulakaṃ tathā|
pibenmadhuyutaṃ tulyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā vāriṇā++āplutam||
6.27.35 |  sakṣaudraṃ dadhimaṇḍairvā 'pyūrustambhavināśanam|
mūrvāmativiṣāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ citrakaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||
6.27.36 |  *pūrvavadgugguluṃ mūtre rātristhitamathāpi vā|
svarṇakṣīrīmativiṣāṃ mustaṃ tejovatīṃ vacām||
6.27.37 |  surāhvaṃ *citrakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ pāṭhāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm|
lehayenmadhunā cūrṇaṃ sakṣaudraṃ vā jalāplutam||
6.27.38 |  phalīṃ vyāghranakhaṃ hema pibedvā madhusaṃyutam|
triphalāṃ pippalīṃ mustaṃ cavyaṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm||
6.27.39 |  lihyādvā madhunā cūrṇamūrustambhārdito naraḥ|
apatarpaṇajaścet syāddoṣaḥ saṃtarpayeddhi tam||
6.27.40 |  yuktyā jāṅgalajairmāṃsaiḥ purāṇaiścaiva śālibhiḥ|
rūkṣaṇādvātakopaścennidrānāśārtipūrvakaḥ||
6.27.41 |  snehasvedakramastatra kāryo vātāmayāpahaḥ|
pīluparṇī payasyā ca rāsnā gokṣurako vacā||
6.27.42 |  saralāgurupāṭhāśca tailamebhirvipācayet|
sakṣaudraṃ prasṛtaṃ tasmādañjaliṃ vā 'pi nā pibet||
6.27.43 |  kuṣṭhaśrīveṣṭakodīcyasaralaṃ dāru keśaram|
ajagandhā 'śvagandhā ca tailaṃ taiḥ sārṣapaṃ pacet||
6.27.44 |  sakṣaudraṃ mātrayā taccāpyūrustambhārditaḥ pibet|
(*raukṣyānmukta ūrustambhāttataśca sa vimucyate||)
6.27.45 |  dve pale saindhavāt pañca śuṇṭhyā granthikacitrakāt|
dve dve bhallātakāsthīni viṃśatirdve tathā++āḍhake||
6.27.46 |  āranālāt pacet prasthaṃ tailasyaitairapatyadam|
gṛdhrasyūrugrahārśortisarvavātavikāranut||
6.27.47 |  palābhyāṃ pippalīmūlanāgarādaṣṭakaṭvaraḥ|
tailaprasthaḥ samo dadhnā gṛdhrasyūrugrahāpahaḥ||
ityaṣṭakaṭvaratailam|
6.27.48 |  ityābhyantaramuddiṣṭamūrustambhasya bheṣajam|
śleṣmaṇaḥ kṣapaṇaṃ tvanyadvāhyaṃ śṛṇu cikitsitam||
6.27.49 |  valmīkamṛttikā mūlaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ tvacam|
iṣṭakānāṃ tataścūrṇaiḥ kuryādutsādanaṃ bhṛśam||
6.27.50 |  mūlairvā 'pyaśvagandhāyā mūlairarkasya vā bhiṣak|
picumardasya vā mūlairathavā devadāruṇaḥ||
6.27.51 |  kṣaudrasarṣapavalmīkamṛttikāsaṃyutairbhiṣak|
gāḍhamutsādanaṃ kuryādūrustambhe pralepanam||
6.27.52 |  dantīdravantīsurasāsarṣapaiścāpi buddhimān|
tarkārīśigrusurasāviśvavatsakanimbajaiḥ||
6.27.53 |  patramūlaphalaistoyaṃ śṛtamuṣṇaṃ ca secanam|
piṣṭaṃ tu sarṣapaṃ mūtre 'dhyuṣitaṃ syāt pralepanam||
6.27.54 |  vatsakaḥ surasaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ gandhāstumburuśigrukau|
*hiṃsrārkamūlavalmīkamṛttikāḥ sakuṭherakāḥ||
6.27.55 |  dadhisaindhavasaṃyuktaṃ kāryametaiḥ pralepanam|
(*ūrustambhāvināśāya bhiṣajā jānatā kramam||)
6.27.56 |  śyonākaṃ khadiraṃ bilvaṃ bṛhatyau saralāsanau|
śobhāñjanakatarkārīśvadaṃṣṭrāsurasārjakān||
6.27.57 |  agnimanthakarañjau ca jalenotkvāthya secayet|
pralepo mūtrapiṣṭairvā 'pyūrustambhanivāraṇaḥ||
6.27.58 |  kaphakṣayārthaṃ *śakyeṣu vyāyāmeṣvanuyojayet|
sthalānyākrāmayet kalyaṃ śarkarāḥ sikatāstathā||
6.27.59 |  pratārayet pratisroto nadīṃ śītajalāṃ śivām|
saraśca vimalaṃ śītaṃ sthiratoyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ||
6.27.60 |  tathā viśuṣke 'sya kaphe śāntimūrugraho vrajet|
śleṣmaṇaḥ kṣapaṇaṃ yat syānna ca *mārutamāvahet||
6.27.61 |  tat sarvaṃ sarvadā kāryamūrustambhasya bheṣajam|
śarīraṃ balamagniṃ ca kāryaiṣā rakṣatā kriyā||
6.27.62 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
hetuḥ prāgrūpaliṅgāni karmāyogyatvakāraṇam|
dvividhaṃ bheṣajaṃ coktamūrustambhacikitsite||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne ūrustambhacikitsitaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||27 | |

aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.28.1 |  athāto vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.28.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.28.3 |  vāyurāyurbalaṃ vāyurvāyurdhātā śarīriṇām|
vāyurviśvamidaṃ sarvaṃ prabhurvāyuśca kīrtitaḥ||
6.28.4 |  avyāhatagatiryasya sthānasthaḥ prakṛtau sthitaḥ|
vāyuḥ syātso 'dhikaṃ jīvedvītarogaḥ samāḥ śatam||
6.28.5 |  prāṇodānasamānākhyavyānāpānaiḥ sa pañcadhā|
dehaṃ tantrayate samyak sthāneṣvavyāhataścaran||
6.28.6 |  sthānaṃ prāṇasya *mūrdhoraḥkaṇṭhajihvāsyanāsikāḥ|
ṣṭhīvanakṣavathūdgāraśvāsāhārādi karma ca||
6.28.7 |  udānasya punaḥ sthānaṃ nābhyuraḥ kaṇṭha eva ca|
vākpravṛttiḥ prayatnaurjobalavarṇādi karma ca||
6.28.8 |  svedadoṣāmbuvāhīni srotāṃsi samadhiṣṭhitaḥ|
antaragneśca pārśvathaḥ samāno 'gnibalapradaḥ||
6.28.9 |  dehaṃ vyāpnoti sarvaṃ tu vyānaḥ śīghragatirnṛṇām|
gatiprasāraṇākṣepanimeṣādikriyaḥ sadā||
6.28.10 |  vṛṣaṇau bastimeḍhraṃ ca nābhyūrū vaṃkṣaṇau gudam|
apānasthānamantrasthaḥ *śukramūtraśakṛnti ca||
6.28.11 |  sṛjatyārtavagarbhau ca yuktāḥ sthānasthitāśca te|
svakarma kurvate deho dhāryate tairanāmayaḥ||
6.28.12 |  vimārgasthā hyayuktā vā rogaiḥ svasthānakarmajaiḥ|
śarīraṃ pīḍayantyete prāṇānāśu haranti ca||
6.28.13 |  saṅkhyāmapyativṛttānāṃ tajjānāṃ hi pradhānataḥ|
aśītirnakhabhedādyā rogāḥ sūtre nidarśitāḥ||
6.28.14 |  tānuvyamānān paryāyaiḥ sahetūpakramāñchṛṇu|
kevalaṃ vāyumuddiśya sthānabhedāttathā++āvṛtam||
6.28.15 |  rūkṣaśītālpalaghvannavyavāyātiprajāgaraiḥ|
viṣamādupacārācca doṣāsṛksravaṇādati||
6.28.16 |  laṅghanaplavanātyadhvavyāyāmātiviceṣṭitaiḥ|
dhātūnāṃ saṃkṣayāccintāśokarogātikarṣaṇāt||
6.28.17 |  duḥkhaśayyāsanāt krodhāddivāsvapnādbhayādapi|
vegasaṃdhāraṇādāmādabhighātādabhojanāt||
6.28.18 |  marmāghātādgajoṣṭrāśvaśīghrayānāpataṃsanāt|
dehe srotāṃsi riktāni pūrayitvā 'nilo balī||
6.28.19 |  karoti vividhān vyādhīn sarvāṅgaikāṅgasaṃśritān|
avyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ pūrvarūpamiti smṛtam||
6.28.20 |  ātmarūpaṃ tu tadvyaktamapāyo laghutā punaḥ|
saṅkocaḥ parvaṇāṃ stambho bhedo 'sthnāṃ parvaṇāmapi||
6.28.21 |  lomaharṣaḥ pralāpaśca pāṇipṛṣṭhaśirograhaḥ|
khāñjyapāṅgulyakubjatvaṃ śoṣo 'ṅgānāmanidratā||
6.28.22 |  garbhaśukrarajonāśaḥ spandanaṃ gātrasuptatā|
śironāsākṣijatrūṇāṃ grīvāyāścāpi huṇḍanam||
6.28.23 |  bhedastodārtirākṣepo mohaścāyāsa eva ca|
evaṃvidhāni rūpāṇi karoti kupito 'nilaḥ||
6.28.24 |  hetusthānaviśeṣācca bhavedrogaviśeṣakṛt|
tatra koṣṭhāśrite duṣṭe nigraho mūtravarcaso||
6.28.25 |  bradhnahṛdrogagulmārśaḥpārśvaśūlaṃ ca mārute|
sarvāṅgakupite vāte gātrasphuraṇabhañjane||
6.28.26 |  vedanābhiḥ parītaśca sphuṭantīvāsya sandhayaḥ|
graho viṇmūtravātānāṃ śūlādhmānāśmaśarkarāḥ||
6.28.27 |  jaṅgorutrikapātpṛṣṭha-*rogaśoṣau gudasthite|
hṛnnābhipārśvodararuktṛṣṇodgāravisūcikāḥ||
6.28.28 |  kāsaḥ kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaśca śvāsaścāmāśayasthite|
pakvāśayastho 'ntrakūjaṃ śūlāṭopau karoti ca||
6.28.29 |  kṛcchramūtrapurīṣatvamānāhaṃ trikavedanām|
śrotrādiṣvindriyavadhaṃ kuryādduṣṭasamīraṇaḥ||
6.28.30 |  tvagrūkṣā sphuṭitā suptā kṛśā kṛṣṇā ca tudyate|
ātanyate sarāgā ca parvaruk tvaksthite 'nile||
6.28.31 |  rujastīvrāḥ sasaṃtāpā vaivarṇyaṃ kṛśatā 'ruciḥ|
gātre cārūṃṣi bhuktasya stambhaścāsṛggate 'nile||
6.28.32 |  gurvaṅgaṃ tudyate 'tyarthaṃ daṇḍamuṣṭihataṃ tathā|
saruk *śramitamatyarthaṃ māṃsamedogate 'nile||
6.28.33 |  bhedo 'sthiparvaṇāṃ sandhiśūlaṃ māṃsabalakṣayaḥ|
asvapnaḥ saṃtatā ruk ca majjāsthikupite 'nile||
6.28.34 |  kṣipraṃ muñcati badhnāti śukraṃ garbhamathāpi vā|
vikṛtiṃ janayeccāpi śukrasthaḥ kupite 'nilaḥ||
6.28.35 |  bāhyābhyantaramāyāmaṃ khalliṃ kubjatvameva ca|
sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogāṃśca kuryāt snāyugato 'nilaḥ||
6.28.36 |  śarīraṃ mandarukśophaṃ śuṣyati spandate tathā|
suptāstanvyo mahatyo vā sirā vāte sirāgate||
6.28.37 |  vātapūrṇadṛtisparśaḥ śothaḥ sandhigate 'nile|
prasāraṇākuñcanayoḥ *pravṛttiśca savedanā||
6.28.38 |  (*ityuktaṃ sthānabhedena vāyorlakṣaṇameva ca|)
ativṛddhaḥ śarīrārdhamekaṃ vāyuḥ prapadyate|
yadā tadopaśoṣyāsṛgbāhuṃ pādaṃ ca jānu ca||
6.28.39 |  tasmin saṅkocayatyardhe mukhaṃ jihmaṃ karoti ca|
vakrīkaroti nāsābhrūlalāṭākṣihanūstathā||
6.28.40 |  tato vakraṃ vrajatyāsye bhojanaṃ *vakranāsikam|
stabdhaṃ netraṃ kathayataḥ kṣavathuśca nigṛhyate||
6.28.41 |  dinā jihmā samutkṣiptā *kalā sajjati cāsya vāk|
dantāścalanti bādhyete śravaṇau bhidyate svaraḥ||
6.28.42 |  *pādahastākṣijaṅghoruśaṅkhaśravaṇagaṇḍaruk|
ardhe tasminmukhārdhe vā kevale syāttadarditam||
6.28.43 |  manye saṃśritya vāto 'ntaryadā nāḍīḥ prapadyate|
manyāstambhaṃ tadā kuryādantarāyāmasaṃjñitam||
6.28.44 |  antarāyamyate grīvā manyā ca stabhyate bhṛśam|
dantānāṃ daṃśanaṃ lālā *pṛṣṭhāyāmaḥ śirograhaḥ||
6.28.45 |  jṛmbhā vadanasaṅgaścāpyantarāyāmalakṣaṇam|
(*ityuktastvantarāyāmo bahirāyāma ucyate||)
6.28.46 |  pṛṣṭhamanyāśritā bāhyāḥ śoṣayitvā sirā balī|
vāyuḥ kuryāddhanustambhaṃ bahirāyāmasaṃjñakam||
6.28.47 |  cāpavannāmyamānasya pṛṣṭhato nīyate śiraḥ|
ura utkṣipyate manyā stabdhā grīvā 'vamṛdyate||
6.28.48 |  dantānāṃ daśanaṃ jṛmbhā lālāsrāvaśca vāggrahaḥ|
jātavego nihantyeṣa vaikalyaṃ vā prayacchati||
6.28.49 |  hanumūle sthito bandhāt saṃsrayatyanilo hanū|
vivṛtāsyatvamathavā *kuryāt stabdhamavedanam||
6.28.50 |  hanugrahaṃ ca saṃstabhya hanuṃ(nū)saṃvṛtavakratām|
muhurākṣipati kruddho gātrāṇyākṣepako 'nilaḥ||
6.28.51 |  pāṇipādaṃ ca saṃśoṣya sirāḥ sasnāyukaṇḍarāḥ|
pāṇipādaśiraḥpṛṣṭhaśroṇīḥ stabhnāti mārutaḥ||
6.28.52 |  daṇḍavatstabdhagātrasya daṇḍakaḥ so 'nupakramaḥ|
svasthaḥ syādarditādīnāṃ *muhurvege gate 'gate||
6.28.53 |  pīḍyate pīḍanaistaistairbhiṣagetān vivarjayet|
hatvaikaṃ mārutaḥ pakṣaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vāmameva vā||
6.28.54 |  kuryācceṣṭānivṛttiṃ hi rujaṃ *vākstambhameva ca|
gṛhītvā 'rdhaṃ śarīrasya sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣya ca||
6.28.55 |  pādaṃ saṃkocayatyekaṃ hastaṃ vā todaśūlakṛt|
ekāṅgarogaṃ taṃ vidyāt *sarvāṅgaṃ sarvadehajam||
6.28.56 |  sphikpūrvā kaṭipṛṣṭhorujānujaṅghāpadaṃ kramāt|
gṛdhrasī stambharuktodairgṛhṇāti spandate muhuḥ||
6.28.57 |  vātādvātakaphāttandrāgauravārocakānvitā|
khallī tu pādajaṅgorukaramūlāvamoṭanī||
6.28.58 |  sthānānāmanurūpaiśca liṅgaiḥ śeṣān vinirdiśet|
sarveṣveteṣu saṃsargaṃ pittādyairupalakṣayet||
6.28.59 |  vāyordhātukṣayāt kopo mārgasyāvaraṇena ca (vā)|
vātapittakaphā dehe sarvasroto 'nusāriṇaḥ||
6.28.60 |  vāyureva hi *sūkṣmatvāddbayostatrāpyudīraṇaḥ|
kupitastau samuddhūya tatra tatra kṣipan gadān||
6.28.61 |  karotyāvṛtamārgatvādrasādīṃścopaśoṣayet|
liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte dāhastṛṣṇā śūlaṃ *bhramastamaḥ||
6.28.62 |  kaṭvamlalavaṇoṣṇaiśca vidāhaḥ śītakāmitā|
śaityagauravaśūlāni kaṭvādyupaśayo 'dhikam||
6.28.63 |  laṅghanāyāsarūkṣoṣṇakāmitā ca kaphāvṛte|
raktāvṛte sadāhārtistvaḍmāṃsāntarajo bhṛśam||
6.28.64 |  bhavet sarāgaḥ śvayathurjāyante maṇḍalāni ca|
kaṭhināśca vivarṇāśca piḍakāḥ śvayathustathā||
6.28.65 |  harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca saṃcāra iva māṃsage|
calaḥ snigdho mṛduḥ śītaḥ śopho 'ṅgeṣvarucistathā||
6.28.66 |  āḍhyavāta iti jñeyaḥ sa kṛcchro medasā++āvṛtaḥ|
sparśamasthnā++āvṛte tūṣṇaṃ pīḍanaṃ cābhinandati||
6.28.67 |  saṃbhajyate sīdati ca sūcībhiriva tudyate|
majjāvṛte *vināmaḥ syājjṛmbhaṇaṃ pariveṣṭanam||
6.28.68 |  śūlaṃ tu pīḍyamāne ca pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham|
śukrāvego 'tivego vā niṣphalatvaṃ ca śukrage||
6.28.69 |  bhukte kukṣau ca rugjīrṇe śāmyatyannāvṛte 'nile|
mūtrāpravṛttirādhmānaṃ bastau mūtrāvṛte 'nile||
6.28.70 |  varcaso 'tivibandho 'dhaḥ sve sthāne parikṛntati|
vrajatyāśu jarāṃ sneho bhukte cānahyate naraḥ||
6.28.71 |  cirāt pīḍitamannena duḥkhaṃ śuṣkaṃ śakṛt sṛjet|
śroṇīvaṃkṣaṇapṛṣṭheṣu rugvilomaśca mārutaḥ||
6.28.72 |  asvasthaṃ hṛdayaṃ caiva varcasā tvāvṛte 'nile|
*sandhicyutirhanustambhaḥ kuñcanaṃ kubjatā 'rditaḥ||
6.28.73 |  *ekṣāghāto 'ṅgasaṃśoṣaḥ paṅgutvaṃ khuḍavātatā|
stambhanaṃ cāḍhyavātaśca rogā majjāsthigāśca ye||
6.28.74 |  ete sthānasya gāmbhīryādyatnāt sidhyanti vā ca vā|
navān balavatastvetān sādhayennirupadravān||
6.28.75 |  kriyāmataḥ paraṃ siddhāṃ vātarogāpahāṃ śṛṇu|
kevalaṃ nirupastambhamādau snehairupācaret||
6.28.76 |  vāyuṃ sarpirvasātailamajjapānairnaraṃ tataḥ|
snehaklāntaṃ samāśvāsya payobhiḥ snehayet punaḥ||
6.28.77 |  yūṣairgrāmyāmbujānūparasairvā snehasaṃyutaiḥ|
pāyasaiḥ kṛśaraiḥ sāmlalavaṇairanuvāsanaiḥ||
6.28.78 |  *nāvanaistarpaṇaiścānnaiḥ susnigdhaṃ svedayettataḥ|
svabhyaktaṃ snehasaṃyuktairnāḍīprastarasaṅkaraiḥ||
6.28.79 |  tathā 'nyairvividhaiḥ svedairyathāyogamupācaret|
*snehāktaṃ svinnamaṅgaṃ tu vakraṃ stabdhamathāpi vā||
6.28.80 |  śanairnāmayituṃ śakyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ śuṣkadāruvat|
harṣatodarugāyāmaśothastambhagrahādayaḥ||
6.28.81 |  svinnasyāśu praśāmyanti mārdavaṃ copajāyate|
snehaśca dhātūnsaṃśuṣkān puṣṇātyāśu prayojitaḥ||
6.28.82 |  balamagnibalaṃ puṣṭiṃ prāṇāṃścāpyabhivardhayet|
asakṛttaṃ punaḥ snehaiḥ svedaiścāpyupapādayet||
6.28.83 |  tathā snehamṛdau koṣṭhe na tiṣṭhantyanilāmayāḥ|
yadyanena sadoṣatvāt karmaṇā na praśāmyati||
6.28.84 |  mṛdubhiḥ snehasaṃyuktairauṣadhaistaṃ viśodhayet|
ghṛtaṃ tilvakasiddhaṃ vā sātalāsiddhameva vā||
6.28.85 |  payasairaṇḍatailaṃ vā pibeddoṣaharaṃ śivam|
snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇādyairāhārairhi malaścitaḥ||
6.28.86 |  sroto baddhvā 'nilaṃ *rundhyāttasmāttamanulomayet|
durbalo yo 'virecyaḥ syāttaṃ nirūhairupācaret||
6.28.87 |  pācanairdīpanīyairvā bhojanaistadyutairnaram|
saṃśuddhasyotthite cāgnau snehasvedau punarhitau||
6.28.88 |  svādvamlalavaṇasnigdhairāhāraiḥ satataṃ punaḥ|
nāvanairdhūmapānaiśca sarvānevopapādayet||
6.28.89 |  iti sāmānyataḥ proktaṃ vātarogacikitsitam|
viśeṣatastu koṣṭhasthe vāte *kṣāraṃ pibennaraḥ||
6.28.90 |  *pācanairdīpanairyuktairamlairvā pācayenmalān|
gudapakvāśayasthe tu karmodāvartanuddhitam||
6.28.91 |  āmāśayasthe śuddhasya yathādoṣaharīḥ kriyāḥ|
sarvāṅgakupite 'bhyaṅgo bastayaḥ sānuvāsanāḥ||
6.28.92 |  svedābhyaṅgāvagāhāśca dṛdyaṃ cānnaṃ tvagāśrite|
śītāḥ pradehā raktasthe vireko raktamokṣaṇam||
6.28.93 |  vireko māṃsamedaḥsthe nirūhāḥ śamanāni ca|
bāhyābhyantarataḥ snehairasthimajjagataṃ jayet||
6.28.94 |  harṣo 'nnapānaṃ śukrasthe balaśukrakaraṃ hitam|
vibaddhamārgaṃ dṛṣṭvā vā śukraṃ dadyādvirecanam||
6.28.95 |  viriktapratibhuktasya pūrvoktāṃ kārayet kriyām|
garbhe śuṣke tu vātena bālānāṃ cāpi śuṣyatām||
6.28.96 |  sitākāśmaryamadhukairhitamutthāpane payaḥ|
hṛdi prakupite siddhamaṃśumatyā payo hitam||
6.28.97 |  matsyānnābhipradeśasthe siddhān bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ|
vāyunā veṣṭyamāne tu gātre syādupanāhanam||
6.28.98 |  tailaṃ saṃkucite 'bhyaṅgo māṣasaindhavasādhitam|
bāhuśīrṣagate nasyaṃ pānaṃ caittarabhaktikam||
6.28.99 |  bastikarma tvadho nābheḥ śasyate cāvapīḍakaḥ|
ardite nāvanaṃ mūrdhni tailaṃ tarpaṇameva ca||
6.28.100 |  nāḍīsvedopanāhāścāpyānūpapiśitairhitāḥ|
svedanaṃ snehasaṃyuktaṃ pakṣāghāte virecanam||
6.28.101 |  *antarākaṇḍarāgulphaṃ sirā bastyagnikarma ca|
gṛdhrasīṣu prayuñjīta khallyāṃ tūṣṇopanāhanam||
6.28.102 |  pāyasaiḥ kṛśarairmāṃsaiḥ śastaṃ tailaghṛtānvitaiḥ|
*vyāttānane hanuṃ svinnāmaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ prapīḍya ca||
6.28.103 |  pradeśinībhyāṃ connāmya cibukonnāmanaṃ hitam|
srastaṃ svaṃ gamayetsthānaṃ stabdhaṃ svinnaṃ vināmayet||
6.28.104 |  pratyekaṃ sthānadūṣyādi-*kriyāvaiśeṣyamācaret|
*sarpistailavasāmajjasekābhyañjanabastayaḥ||
6.28.105 |  snigdhāḥ svedā nivātaṃ ca sthānaṃ prāvaraṇāni ca|
rasāḥ payāṃsi bhojyāni svādvamlalavaṇāni ca||
6.28.106 |  bṛṃhaṇaṃ yacca tat sarvaṃ praśastaṃ vātarogiṇām|
balāyāḥ pañcamūlasya daśamūlasya vā rase||
6.28.107 |  ajaśīrṣambujānūpamāṃsādapiśitaiḥ pṛthak|
sādhayitvā rasān snigdhāndadhyamlavyoṣasaṃskṛtān||
6.28.108 |  bhojayedvātarogārtaṃ tairvyaktalavaṇairnaram|
etairevopanāhāṃśca piśitaiḥ saṃprakalpayet||
6.28.109 |  ghṛtatailayutaiḥ sāmlaiḥ kṣuṇṇasvinnairanasthibhiḥ|
patrotkvāthapayastailadroṇyaḥ syuravagāhane||
6.28.110 |  svabhyaktānāṃ praśasyante sekāścānilarogiṇām|
ānūpaudakamāṃsāni daśamūlaṃ śatāvarīm||
6.28.111 |  kulatthān badarānmāṣāṃstilāvrāsnāṃ yavān balām|
vasādadhyāranālāmlaiḥ saha kumbhyāṃ vipācayet||
6.28.112 |  nāḍīsvedaṃ prayuñjīta piṣṭaiścāpyupanāhanam|
taiśca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailamabhyaṅgaṃ pānāmeva ca||
6.28.113 |  mustaṃ kiṇvaṃ tilāḥ kuṣṭhaṃ surāhvaṃ lavaṇaṃ natam|
dadhikṣīracatuḥsnehaiḥ siddhaṃ syādupanāhanam||
6.28.114 |  utkārikāvesavārakṣīramāṣatilaudanaiḥ|
eraṇḍabījagodhūmayavakolasthirādibhiḥ||
6.28.115 |  sasnehaiḥ sarujaṃ gātramālipya bahalaṃ bhiṣak|
eraṇḍapatrairbadhnīyādrātrau kalyaṃ vimokṣayet||
6.28.116 |  kṣīrāsbunā tataḥ siktaṃ punaścaivopanāhitam|
muñcedrātrau divābaddhaṃ carmabhiśca salomabhiḥ||
6.28.117 |  phalānāṃ tailayonīnāmamlapiṣṭān suśītalān|
pradehānupanāhāṃśca gandhairvātaharairapi||
6.28.118 |  pāyasaiḥ kṛśaraiścaiva kārayet snehasaṃyutaiḥ|
rūkṣaśuddhānilārtānāmataḥ snehān pracakṣmahe||
6.28.119 |  vividhān vividhavyādhipraśamāyāmṛtopamān|
droṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacedbhāgān daśamūlāccatuṣpalān||
6.28.120 |  yavavkolakulatthānāṃ bhāgaiḥ prasthonmitaiḥ saha|
pādaśeṣe rase piṣṭairjīvanīyaiḥ saśarkaraiḥ||
6.28.121 |  tathā svarjūrakāśmaryadrākṣābadaraphalgubhiḥ|
sakṣīraiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaḥ siddhaḥ kevalavātanut||
6.28.122 |  niratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ pānābhyañjanabastiṣu|
citrakaṃ nāgaraṃ rāsnāṃ pauṣkaraṃ pippalīṃ śaṭīm||
6.28.123 |  piṣṭvā vipācayet sarpirvātarogaharaṃ param|
balābilvaśṛte kṣīre ghṛtamaṇḍaṃ vipācayet||
6.28.124 |  tasya śuktiḥ prakuñco vā nasyaṃ mūrdhagate 'nile|
grāmyānūpaudakānāṃ tu bhittvā 'sthīni pacejjale||
6.28.125 |  taṃ snehaṃ daśamūlasya kaṣāyeṇa punaḥ pacet|
jīvakarṣabhakāsphotāvidārīkapikacchubhiḥ||
6.28.126 |  vātaghnairjīvanīyaiśca kalkairdvikṣīrabhāgikam|
tatsiddhaṃ nāvanābhyaṅgāttathā pānānuvāsanāt||
6.28.127 |  sirāparvāsthikoṣṭhasthaṃ praṇudatyāśu mārutam|
ya syuḥ prakṣīṇamajjānaḥ kṣīṇaśukraujasaśca ye||
6.28.128 |  balapuṣṭikaraṃ teṣāmetat syādamṛtopamam|
tadvatsiddhā vasā nakramatsyakūrmaculūkajā||
6.28.129 |  pratyagrā vidhinā 'nena nasyapāneṣu śasyate|
prasthaḥ syāttriphalāyāstu kulatthakuḍavadvayam||
6.28.130 |  kṛṣṇagandhātvagāḍhakyoḥ pṛthak pañcapalaṃ bhavet|
rāsnācitrakayordve dve daśamūlaṃ palonmitam||
6.28.131 |  jaladroṇe pacet pādaśeṣe prasthonmitaṃ pṛthak|
surāranāladadhyamlasaubīrakatuṣodakam||
6.28.132 |  koladāḍimavṛkṣāmlarasaṃ tailaṃ vasāṃ ghṛtam|
majjānaṃ ca payaścaiva jīvanīyapalāni ṣaṭ||
6.28.133 |  kalkaṃ dattvā mahāsnehaṃ samyagenaṃ vipācayet|
sirāmajjāsthige vāte sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogiṣu||
6.28.134 |  vepanākṣepaśūleṣu tadabhyaṅge prayojayet|
nirguṇḍyā mūlapatrābhyāṃ gṛhītvā svarasaṃ tataḥ||
6.28.135 |  tena siddhaṃ samaṃ tailaṃ nāḍīkuṣṭhānilārtiṣu|
hitaṃ pāmāpacīnāṃ ca pānābhyañjanapūraṇam||
6.28.136 |  kārpāsāsthikulatthānāṃ rase siddhaṃ ca vātanut|
mūlakasvarase kṣīrasame sthāpyaṃ tryahaṃ dadhi||
6.28.137 |  tasyāmlasya tribhiḥ prasthaistailaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
yaṣṭyāhvaśarkarārāsnālavaṇārdrakanāgaraiḥ||
6.28.138 |  supiṣṭaiḥ palikaiḥ pānāttadabhyaṅgācca vātanut|
pañcamūlakaṣāyeṇa piṇyākaṃ bahuvārṣikam||
6.28.139 |  paktvā tasya rasaṃ *pūtvā tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
payasā 'ṣṭagunaitat sarvavātavikāranut||
6.28.140 |  saṃsṛṣṭe śleṣmaṇā caitadvāte śastaṃ viśeṣataḥ|
yavakolakulatthānāṃ śreyasyāḥ śuṣkamūlakāt||
6.28.141 |  bilvāccāñjalimekaikaṃ dravairamlairvipācayet|
tena tailaṃ kaṣāyeṇa phalāmlaiḥ kaṭubhistathā||
6.28.142 |  piṣṭaiḥ siddhaṃ mahāvātairārtaḥ śīte prayojayet|
sarvavātavikārāṇāṃ tailanyanyānyataḥ śṛṇu||
6.28.143 |  catuṣprayogāṇyāyuṣyabalavarṇakarāṇi ca|
rajaḥśukrapradoṣaghnānyapatyajananāni ca||
6.28.144 |  niratyayāni siddhāni sarvadoṣaharāṇi ca|
sahācaratulāyāśca rase tailāḍhakaṃ pacet||
6.28.145 |  mūlakalkāddaśapalaṃ payo dattvā caturguṇam|
siddhe 'smiñcharkarācūrṇādaṣṭādaśapalaṃ bhiṣak||
6.28.146 |  vinīya dāruṇeṣvetadvātavyādhiṣu yojayet|
śvadaṃṣṭrāsvarasaprasthau dvau samau payasā saha||
6.28.147 |  ṣaṭpalaṃ śṛṅgaverasya guḍasyāṣṭapalaṃ tathā|
tailaprasthaṃ vipakvaṃ tairdadyāt sarvānilārtiṣu||
6.28.148 |  jīrṇe taile ca dugdhena peyākalpaḥ praśasyate|
balāśataṃ guḍūcyāśca pādaṃ rāsnāṣṭabhāgikam||
6.28.149 |  jalāḍhakaśate paktvā daśabhāgasthite rase|
dadhimastvikṣuniryāsaśuktaistailāḍhakaṃ samaiḥ||
6.28.150 |  pacet sājapayo 'rdhāṃśaiḥ kalkairebhiḥ palonmitaiḥ|
śaṭīsaraladārvelāmañjiṣṭhāgurucandanaiḥ||
6.28.151 |  padmakātiviṣāmustasūrpaparṇīhareṇubhiḥ|
yaṣṭyāhvasurasavyāghranakharṣabhakajīvakaiḥ||
6.28.152 |  palāśarasakastūrīnalikājātikoṣakaiḥ|
spṛkkākuṅkumaśaileyajātīkaṭuphalāmbubhiḥ||
6.28.153 |  *tvacākundurukarpūratutuṣkaśrīnivāsakaiḥ|
lavaṅganakhakakkolakuṣṭhamāṃsīpriyaṅgubhiḥ||
6.28.154 |  sthauṇeyatagaradhyāmavacāmadanapallavaiḥ|
sanāgakeśaraiḥ siddhe kṣipeccātrāvatārite||
6.28.155 |  patrakalkaṃ tataḥ pūtaṃ vidhinā tat prayojayet|
śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ jvaraṃ *hikkāṃ chardiṃ gulmān kṣataṃ kṣayam||
6.28.156 |  plīhaśoṣāvapasmāramalakṣmīṃ ca praṇāśayet|
balātailamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vātavyādhivināśanam||
6.28.157 |  (agniveśāya guruṇā kṛṣṇātreyeṇa bhāṣitam|)
iti balātailam|
amṛtāyāstulāḥ pañca droṇeṣvaṣṭasvapāṃ pacet||
6.28.158 |  pādaśeṣe samakṣīraṃ tailasya dvyāḍhakaṃ pacet|
elāmāṃsīnatośīrasārivākuṣṭhacandanaiḥ||
6.28.159 |  *balātāmalakīmedāśatapuṣpardhijīvakaiḥ|
kākolīkṣīrakākolīśrāvaṇyatibalānakhaiḥ||
6.28.160 |  mahāśrāvaṇijīvantīvidārīkapikacchubhiḥ|
śatāvarīmahāmedākarkaṭākhyāhareṇubhiḥ||
6.28.161 |  vacāgokṣurakairaṇḍarāsnākālāsahācaraiḥ|
vīrāśallakimustatvakpatrarṣabhakabālakaiḥ||
6.28.162 |  sahailākuṅkumaspṛkkātridaśāhvaiśca kārṣikaiḥ|
mañjiṣṭhāyāstrikarṣeṇa madhukāṣṭapalena ca||
6.28.163 |  kalkaistat kṣīṇavīryāgnibalasaṃmūḍhacetasaḥ|
unmādāratyapasmārairārtāṃśca prakṛtiṃ nayet||
6.28.164 |  vātavyādhiharaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tailāgryamamṛtāhvayam|
(*kṛṣṇātreyeṇa guruṇā bhāṣitaṃ vaidyapūjitam||)
ityamṛtādyaṃ tailam|
6.28.165 |  rāsnāsahasraniryūhe tailadroṇaṃ vipācayet|
gandhairhaimavataiḥ piṣṭairelādyaiścānilārtinut||
6.28.166 |  kalpo 'yamaśvagandhāyāṃ prasāraṇyāṃ balādvaye|
kvāthakalkapayobhirvā balādīnāṃ pacet pṛthak||
iti rāsnātailam|
6.28.167 |  mūlakasvarasaṃ kṣīraṃ tailaṃ dadhyamlakāñjikam|
tulyaṃ vipācayet kalkairbalācitrakasaindhavaiḥ||
6.28.168 |  pippalyativiṣārāsnācavikāguruśigrukaiḥ|
bhallātakavacākuṣṭhaśvadaṃṣṭrāviśvabheṣajaiḥ||
6.28.169 |  puṣkarāhvaśaṭībilvaśatāhvānatadārubhiḥ|
tatsiddhaṃ pītamatyugrān hanti vātātmakān gadān||
iti mūlakādyaṃ tailam|
6.28.170 |  vṛṣamūlaguḍūcyośca dviśatasya śatasya ca|
citrakāt sāśvagandhācca kvāthe tailāḍhakaṃ pacet||
6.28.171 |  sakṣīraṃ vāyunā bhagne dadyājjarjarite tathā|
prāktailāvāpasiddhaṃ ca bhavedetadguṇottaram||
iti vṛṣamūlāditailam|
6.28.172 |  rāsnāśirīṣayaṣṭyāhvaśuṇṭhīsahacarāmṛtāḥ||
6.28.173 |  syonākadāruśampākahayagandhātrikaṇṭakāḥ|
eṣāṃ daśapalān bhāgān kaṣāyamupakalpayet||
6.28.174 |  tatastena kaṣāyeṇa sarvagandhaiśca kārṣikaiḥ|
dadhyāranāla-*māṣāmbumūlakekṣurasaiḥ śubhaiḥ||
6.28.175 |  pṛthak prasthonmitaiḥ sārdhaṃ tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet|
*plīhamūtragrahaśvāsakāsamārutaroganut||
6.28.176 |  *etanmūlakatailākhyaṃ varṇāyurbalavardhanam|
iti mūlakatailam|
yavakolakulatthānāṃ matsyānāṃ śigrubilvayoḥ|
rasena mūlakānāṃ ca tailaṃ dadhipayonvitam||
6.28.177 |  sādhayitvā bhiṣagdadyāt sarvavātāmayāpaham|
laśunasvarase siddhaṃ tailamebhiśca vātanut||
6.28.178 |  tailānyetānyṛtusnātāmaṅganāṃ pāyayeta ca|
pītvā 'nyatamameṣāṃ hi vandhyā 'pi janayet sutam||
6.28.179 |  yacca śītajvare tailamagurvādyamudāhṛtam|
anekaśataśastacca siddhaṃ syādvātaroganut||
6.28.180 |  vakṣyante yāni tailāni vātaśoṇitake 'pi ca|
tāni cānilaśāntyarthaṃ siddhikāmaḥ prayojayet||
6.28.181 |  nāsti tailāt paraṃ kiṃcidauṣadhaṃ mārutāpaham|
vyavāyyuṣṇagurusnehāt saṃskārādbalavattaram||
6.28.182 |  gaṇairvātaharaistasmācchataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ|
siddhaṃ kṣiprataraṃ hanti sūkṣmamārgasthitān gadān||
6.28.183 |  kriyā sādhāraṇī sarvā saṃsṛṣṭe cāpi śasyate|
vāte pittādibhiḥ srotaḥsvāvṛteṣu viśeṣataḥ||
6.28.184 |  pittāvṛte viśeṣeṇa śītāmuṣṇāṃ tathā kriyām|
vyatyāsāt kārayet sarpirjīvanīyaṃ ca śasyate||
6.28.185 |  dhanvamāṃsaṃ yavāḥ śāliryāpanāḥ kṣīrabastayaḥ|
virekaḥ kṣīrapānaṃ ca pañcamūlībalāśṛtam||
6.28.186 |  madhuyaṣṭibalātailaghṛtakṣīraiśca secanam|
pañcamūlakaṣāyeṇa kuryādvā śītabāriṇā||
6.28.187 |  kaphāvṛte yavānnāni jāṅgalā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ|
svedāstīkṣṇā nirūhāśca vamanaṃ savirecanam||
6.28.188 |  jīrṇaṃ sarpistathā tailaṃ tilasarṣapajaṃ hitam|
saṃsṛṣṭe kaphapittābhyāṃ pittamādau vinirjayet||
6.28.189 |  āmāśayagataṃ *matvā kaphaṃ vamanamācaret||
6.28.190 |  pakvāśaye virekaṃ tu pitte sarvatrage tathā|
svedairviṣyanditaḥ śleṣmā yadā pakvāśaye sthitaḥ||
6.28.191 |  pittaṃ vā darśayelliṅgaṃ bastibhistau vinirharet|
śleṣmaṇā 'nugataṃ vātamuṣṇairgomūtrasaṃyutaiḥ||
6.28.192 |  nirūhaiḥ pittasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ nirharet kṣīrasaṃyutaiḥ|
madhurauṣadhasiddhaiśca tailaistamanuvāsayet||
6.28.193 |  śirogate tu sakaphe dhūmanasyādi kārayet|
hṛte pitte kaphe yaḥ syāduraḥsroto 'nugo 'nilaḥ||
6.28.194 |  *saśeṣaḥ syāt kriyā tatra kāryā kevalavātikī|
śoṇitenāvṛte kuryādvātaśoṇitakīṃ kriyām||
6.28.195 |  pramehavātamedoghnī-*māmavāte prayojayet|
svedābhyaṅgarasakṣīrasnehā māṃsāvṛte hitāḥ||
6.28.196 |  mahāsneho 'sthimajjasthe pūrvavadretasā++āvṛte|
annāvṛte *tadullekhaḥ pācanaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu||
6.28.197 |  mūtralāni tu mūtreṇa svedāḥ sottarabastayaḥ|
śakṛtā tailamairaṇḍaṃ *snigdhodāvartavatkriyā||
6.28.198 |  svasthānastho balī doṣaḥ prāk taṃ svairauṣadhairjayet|
vamanairvā virekairvā bastibhiḥ śamanena vā||
6.28.199 |  (*ityuktamāvṛte vāte pittādibhiryathāyatham|)
mārutānāṃ hi pañcānāmanyonyāvaraṇe śṛṇu||
6.28.200 |  liṅgaṃ vyāsasamāsābhyāmucyamānaṃ mayā 'nagha!|
prāṇe vṛṇotyudānādīn prāṇaṃ vṛṇvanti te 'pi ca||
6.28.201 |  udānādyāstathā 'nyonyaṃ sarva eva yathākramam|
*viṃśatirvaraṇānyetānyūlbaṇānāṃ parasparam||
6.28.202 |  mārutānāṃ hi pañcānāṃ tāni samyak pratarkayet|
sarvendriyāṇāṃ śūnyatvaṃ jñātvā smṛtibalakṣayam||
6.28.203 |  vyāne prāṇāvṛte liṅgaṃ karma tatrordhvajatrukam|
svedo 'tyarthaṃ lomaharṣastvagdoṣaḥ suptagātratā||
6.28.204 |  prāṇe vyānāvṛte tatra snehayuktaṃ virecanam|
prāṇāvṛte samāne syurjaḍagadgadamūkatāḥ||
6.28.205 |  catuṣprayogāḥ śasyante snehāstatra sayāpanāḥ|
*samānenāvṛte 'pāne grahaṇīpārśvahṛdgadāḥ||
6.28.206 |  śūlaṃ cāmāśaye tatra dīpanaṃ sarpiriṣyate|
śirograhaḥ pratiśyāyo niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃgrahaḥ||
6.28.207 |  hṛdrogo mukhaśoṣaścāpyudāne prāṇasaṃvṛte|
tatrordhvabhāgikaṃ karma kāryamāśvāsanaṃ tathā||
6.28.208 |  karmaujobalavarṇānāṃ nāśo mṛtyurathāpi vā|
udānenāvṛte prāṇe taṃ śanaiḥ śītavāriṇā||
6.28.209 |  siñcedāśvāsayeccainaṃ sukhaṃ caivopapādayet|
ūrdhvagenāvṛte 'pāne chardiśvāsādayo gadāḥ||
6.28.210 |  syurvāte tatra bastyādi bhojyaṃ caivānulomanam|
moho 'lpo 'gniratīsāra ūrdhvage 'pānasaṃvṛte||
6.28.211 |  vāte syādvamanaṃ tatra dīpanaṃ grāhi cāśanam|
vamyādhmānamudāvartagulmārtiparikartikāḥ||
6.28.212 |  liṅgaṃ vyānāvṛte 'pāne taṃ snigdhairanulomayet|
apānenāvṛte vyāne bhavedviṇmūtraretasām||
6.28.213 |  atipravṛttistatrāpi sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ matam|
mūrcchā tandrā pralāpo 'ṅgasādo 'gnyojobalakṣayaḥ||
6.28.214 |  samānenāvṛte vyāne vyāyāmo laghubhojanam|
stabdhatā 'lpāgnitā 'svedaśceṣṭāhānirnimīlanam||
6.28.215 |  udānenāvṛte vyāne tatra pathyaṃ mitaṃ laghu|
pañcānyonyāvṛtānevaṃ vātān budhyeta lakṣaṇaiḥ||
6.28.216 |  eṣāṃ svakarmaṇāṃ hānirvṛddhirvā++āvaraṇe matā|
yathāsthūlaṃ samuddiṣṭametadāvaraṇe 'ṣṭakam||
6.28.217 |  saliṅgabheṣajaṃ samyagbudhānāṃ buddhivṛddhaye|
sthānānyavekṣya vātānāṃ vṛddhiṃ hāniṃ ca karmaṇām||
6.28.218 |  dvādaśāvaraṇānyanyānyabhilakṣya bhiṣagjitam|
kuryādabhyañjana-*snehapānabastyādi sarvaśaḥ||
6.28.219 |  kramamuṣṇamanuṣṇaṃ vā vyatyāsādavacārayet|
udānaṃ yojayedūrdhvamapānaṃ cānulomayet||
6.28.220 |  samānaṃ śamayeccaiva tridhā vyānaṃ tu yojayet|
prāṇo rakṣyaścaturbhyo 'pi sthāne hyasya sthitirdhruvā||
6.28.221 |  svaṃ sthānaṃ gamayedevaṃ vṛtānetān vimārgagān|
mūrcchā dāho bhramaḥ śūlaṃ vidāhaḥ śītakāmitā||
6.28.222 |  chardanaṃ ca vidagdhasya prāṇe pittasamāvṛte|
ṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣavathūdgāraniḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃgrahaḥ||
6.28.223 |  prāṇe kaphāvṛte rūpāṇyaruciśchardireva ca|
mūrcchādyāni ca rūpāṇi dāho nābhyurasaḥ klamaḥ||
6.28.224 |  aujobhraṃśaśca sādaścāpyudāne pittasaṃvṛte|
āvṛte śleṣmaṇodāne vaivarṇyaṃ vāksvaragrahaḥ||
6.28.225 |  daurbalyaṃ gurugātratvamaruciścopajāyate|
atisvedastṛṣā dāho mūrcchā *cārucireva ca||
6.28.226 |  pittāvṛte samāne syādupaghātastathoṣmaṇāḥ|
asvedo vahnimāndyaṃ ca lomaharṣastathaiva ca||
6.28.227 |  kaphāvṛte samāne syādgātrāṇāṃ cātiśītatā|
vyāne pittāvṛte tu syāddāhaḥ sarvāṅgagaḥ klamaḥ||
6.28.228 |  gātravikṣepasaṅgaśca sasaṃtāpaḥ savedanaḥ|
gurutā sarvagātrāṇāṃ sarvasandhyasthijā rujaḥ||
6.28.229 |  vyāne kaphāvṛte liṅgaṃ gatisaṅgastathā+*adhikaḥ|
hāridramūtravarcastvaṃ tāpaśca gudameḍhrayoḥ||
6.28.230 |  liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte 'pāne rajasaścātivartanam|
bhinnāmaśleṣmasaṃsṛṣṭaguruvarcaḥpravartanam||
6.28.231 |  śleṣmaṇā saṃvṛte 'pāne kaphamehasya cāgamaḥ|
lakṣaṇānāṃ tu miśratvaṃ pittasya ca kaphasya ca||
6.28.232 |  upalakṣya bhiṣagvidvān miśramāvaraṇaṃ vadet|
yadyasya vāyornirdiṣṭaṃ sthānaṃ tatretarau sthitau||
6.28.233 |  doṣau bahuvidhān vyādhīn darśayetāṃ yathānijān|
āvṛtaṃ śleṣmapittābhyāṃ prāṇaṃ codānameva ca||
6.28.234 |  garīyastvena paśyanti bhiṣajaḥ śāstravakṣuṣaḥ|
viśeṣājjīvitaṃ prāṇe udāne saṃśritaṃ balam||
6.28.235 |  syāttayoḥ pīḍanāddhānirāyuṣaśca balasya ca|
sarve 'pyete 'parijñātāḥ parisaṃvatsarāstathā||
6.28.236 |  upekṣaṇādasādhyāḥ syurathavā *durupakramāḥ|
hṛdrogo vidradhiḥ plīhā gulmo 'tīsāra eva ca||
6.28.237 |  bhavantyupadravāsteṣāmāvṛtānāmupekṣaṇāt|
tasmādāvaraṇaṃ vaidyaḥ pavanasyopalakṣayet||
6.28.238 |  pañcātmakasya vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā 'pi vā|
bhiṣagjitamataḥ samyagupalakṣya samācaret||
6.28.239 |  anabhiṣyandibhiḥ snigdhaiḥ srotasāṃ śuddhikārakaiḥ|
kaphapittāviruddhaṃ yadyacca vātānulomanam||
6.28.240 |  sarvasthānāvṛte 'pyāśu tat kāryaṃ mārute hitam|
yāpanā bastayaḥ prāyo madhurāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ||
6.28.241 |  prasamīkṣya balādhikyaṃ mṛdu vā sraṃsanaṃ hitam|
rasāyanānāṃ sarveṣāmupayogaḥ praśasyate||
6.28.242 |  śailasya jatuno 'tyarthaṃ payasā guggulostathā|
lehaṃ vā bhārgavaproktamabhyaset kṣīrabhuṅnaraḥ||
6.28.243 |  *abhayāmalakīyoktamekādaśasitāśatam|
apānenāvṛte sarvaṃ dīpanaṃ grāhi bheṣajam||
6.28.244 |  vātānulomanaṃ yacca pakvāśayaviśodhanam|
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktamāvṛtānāṃ cikitsitam||
6.28.245 |  prāṇādīnāṃ bhiṣak kuryādvitarkya svayameva tat|
pittāvṛte tu pittaghnairmārutasyāvirodhibhiḥ|
kaphāvṛte kaphaghnaistu mārutasyānulomanaiḥ||
6.28.246 |  loke vāyvarkasomānāṃ durvijñeyā yathā gatiḥ|
tathā śarīre vātasya pittasya ca kaphasya ca||
6.28.247 |  kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ samatvaṃ ca tathaivāvaraṇaṃ bhiṣak|
vijñāya pavanādīnāṃ na pramadyati karmasu||
6.28.248 |  tatra ślokau---
pañcātmanaḥ sthānavaśāccharīre sthānāni karmāṇi ca dehadhātoḥ|
prakopahetuḥ kupitaśca rogān sthāneṣu cānyeṣu vṛto 'vṛtaśca||
6.28.249 |  prāṇeśvaraḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ karoti kriyā ca teṣāmakhilā niruktā|
tāṃ deśasātmyartubalānyavekṣya prayojayecchāstramatānusārī||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||28 | |

ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.29.1 |  athāto vātaśoṇitacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.29.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.29.3 |  hutāgnihotramāsīnamṛṣimadhye punarvasum|
pṛṣṭhavān gurumekāgramagniveśo 'gnivarcasam||
6.29.4 |  agnimārutatulyasya saṃsargasyānilāsṛjoḥ|
hetulakṣaṇabhaiṣajyānyathāsmai gururabravīt||
6.29.5 |  lavaṇāmlakaṭukṣārasnigdhoṣṇājīrṇabhojanaiḥ|
klinnaśuṣkāmbujānūpamāṃsapiṇyākamūlakaiḥ||
6.29.6 |  kulatthamāṣaniṣpāvaśākādipalalekṣubhiḥ|
dadhyāranālasauvīraśuktatakrasurāsavaiḥ||
6.29.7 |  viruddhādhyaśanakrodhadivāsvapnaprajāgaraiḥ|
prāyaśaḥ sukumārāṇāṃ *miṣṭānnasukhabhojinām||
6.29.8 |  avaṅkramaṇaśīlānāṃ kupyate vātaśoṇitam|
abhighātādaśuddyā ca praduṣṭe śoṇite nṛṇām||
6.29.9 |  kaṣāyakaṭutiktālparūkṣāhārādabhojanāt|
*hayoṣṭrayānayānāmbukrīḍāplavanalaṅghanaiḥ||
6.29.10 |  uṣṇe *cātyadhvavaiṣamyādvyavāyādveganigrahāt|
vāyurvivṛddho vṛddhena raktenāvāritaḥ pathi||
6.29.11 |  kṛtsnaṃ saṃdūṣayedraktaṃ tajjñeyaṃ vātaśoṇitam|
khuḍaṃ vātabalāsākhyamāḍhyavātaṃ ca nāmabhiḥ||
6.29.12 |  tasya sthānaṃ karau pādāvaṅgulyaḥ sarvasandhayaḥ|
kṛtvā++ādau hastapāde tu mūlaṃ dehe vidhāvati||
6.29.13 |  saukṣmyāt sarvasaratvācca pavanasyāsṛjastathā|
taddravatvāt saratvācca dehaṃ gacchan sirāyanaiḥ||
6.29.14 |  parvasvabhihataṃ kṣubdhaṃ vakratvādavatiṣṭhate|
sthitaṃ pittādisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ tāstāḥ sṛjati vedanāḥ||
6.29.15 |  karoti duḥkhaṃ teṣveva tasmāt prāyeṇa sandhiṣu|
bhavanti vedanāstāstā atyarthaṃ duḥsahā nṛṇām||
6.29.16 |  svedo 'tyarthaṃ na vā kārṣṇyaṃ sparśājñatvaṃ kṣate 'tiruk|
sandhiśaithilyamālasyaṃ sadanaṃ piḍakodgamaḥ||
6.29.17 |  jānuaṅghorukaṭyaṃ sahastapādāṅgasandhiṣu|
nistodaḥ sphuraṇaṃ bhedo gurutvaṃ suptireva ca||
6.29.18 |  kaṇḍūḥ saṃdhiṣu rugbhūtvā bhūtvā naśyati cāsakṛt|
vaivarṇyaṃ maṇḍalotpattirvātāsṛkpūrvalakṣaṇam||
6.29.19 |  uttānamatha gambhīraṃ dvividhaṃ tat pracakṣate|
tvaṅmāṃsāśrayamuttānaṃ gambhīraṃ tvantarāśrayam||
6.29.20 |  kaṇḍūdāharugāyāmatodasphuraṇakuñcanaiḥ|
anvitā śyāvaraktā tvagbāhye tāmrā tatheṣyate||
6.29.21 |  gambhīre śvayathuḥ stabdhaḥ kaṭhino 'ntarbhṛśārtimān|
śyāvastāmro 'thavā dāhatodasphuraṇapākavān||
6.29.22 |  rugvidāhānvito 'bhīkṣṇaṃ vāyuḥ sandhyasthimajjasu|
chindanniva caratyantarbakrīkurvaṃśca vegavān||
6.29.23 |  karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīre sarvataścaran|
sarvairliṅgaiśca vijñeyaṃ vātāsṛgubhayāśrayam||
6.29.24 |  tatra vāte 'dhike vā syādrakte pitte kaphe 'pi vā|
saṃsṛṣṭeṣu samasteṣu yacca tacchṛṇu lakṣaṇam||
6.29.25 |  viśeṣataḥ *sirāyāmaśūlasphuraṇatodanam|
śothasya kārṣṇyaṃ raukṣyaṃ ca śyāvatāvṛddhihānayaḥ||
6.29.26 |  dhamanyaṅgulisandhīnāṃ saṅkoco 'ṅgagraho 'tiruk|
kuñcanastambhane śītapradveṣaścānile 'dhike||
6.29.27 |  *śvayathurbhṛśaruk todastāmraścimicimāyate|
snigdharūkṣaiḥ śamaṃ naiti kaṇḍūkledānvito 'sṛji||
6.29.28 |  vidāho vedanā mūrcchā svedastṛṣṇā mado bhramaḥ|
rāgaḥ pākaśca bhedaśca śoṣaścoktāni paittike||
6.29.29 |  staimityaṃ gauravaṃ snehaḥ suptirmandā ca ruk kaphe|
hetulakṣaṇasaṃsargādvidyāddvandvatridoṣajam||
6.29.30 |  ekadoṣānugaṃ sādhyaṃ navaṃ, yāpyaṃ dvidoṣajam|
tridoṣajamasādhyaṃ stādyasya ca syurupadravāḥ||
6.29.31 |  asvapnārocakaśvāsamāṃsakothaśirograhāḥ|
mūrcchāyamadaruktṛṣṇājvaramohapravepakāḥ||
6.29.32 |  hikkāpāṅgulyavīsarpapākatodabhramaklamāḥ|
aṅgulīvakratā sphoṭā dāhamarmagrahārbudāḥ||
6.29.33 |  etairupadravairvarjyaṃ mohenaikena vā 'pi yat|
saṃprasrāvi vivarṇaṃ ca stabdhamarbudakṛcca yat||
6.29.34 |  varjayeccaiva saṃkocakaramindriyatāpanam|
akṛtsnopadravaṃ yāpyaṃ sādhyaṃ syānnirupadravam||
6.29.35 |  raktamārgaṃ *nihantyāśu śākhāsandhiṣu mārutaḥ|
*niviśyānyonyamāvārya vedanābhirharedasūn||
6.29.36 |  tatra muñcedasṛk śṛṅgajalaukaḥsūcyalābudhiḥ|
pracchanairvā sirābhirvā yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam||
6.29.37 |  *rugdāhaśūlatodārtādasṛk srāvyaṃ jalaukasā|
śṛṅgaistumbairharet suptikaṇḍūcimicimāyanāt||
6.29.38 |  deśāddeśaṃ vrajat srāvyaṃ sirābhiḥ pracchanena vā|
aṅgaglānau na tu srāvyaṃ *rūkṣe vātottare ca yat||
6.29.39 |  gambhīraṃ śvayathuṃ stambhaṃ kampaṃ snāyusirāmayān|
glāniṃ cāpi sasaṅkocāṃ kuryādvāyurasṛkkṣayāt||
6.29.40 |  khāñjyādīn vātarogāṃśca mṛtyuṃ cātyavasecanāt|
kuryāttasmāt pramāṇena snigdhādraktaṃ vinirharet||
6.29.41 |  virecyaḥ snehayitvā++ādau snehayuktairvirecanaiḥ|
rūkṣairvā mṛdubhiḥ śastamasakṛdbastikarma ca||
6.29.42 |  sekābhyaṅgapradehānnasnehāḥ prāyo 'vidāhinaḥ|
vātarakte praśasyante viśeṣaṃ tu nibodha me||
6.29.43 |  bāhyamālepanābhyaṅgapariṣekopanāhanaiḥ|
virekāsthāpanasnehapānairgambhīramācaret||
6.29.44 |  sarpistailavasāmajjāpānābhyañjanabastibhiḥ|
sukhoṣṇairupanāhaiśca vātottaramupācaret||
6.29.45 |  virecanairghṛtakṣīrapānaiḥ sekaiḥ sabastibhiḥ|
śītairnirvāpaṇaiścāpi raktapittottaraṃ jayet||
6.29.46 |  vamanaṃ mṛdu nātyarthaṃ snehasekau vilaṅghanam|
koṣṇā lepāśca śasyante vātarakte kaphottare||
6.29.47 |  kaphavātottare śītaiḥ pralipte vātaśoṇite|
dāhaśotharujākaṇḍūvivṛddhiḥ stambhanādbhavet||
6.29.48 |  raktapittottare coṣṇairdāhaḥ kledo 'vadāraṇam|
bhavettasmādbhiṣagdoṣabalaṃ buddhvā++ācaretkriyām||
6.29.49 |  divāsvapnaṃ sasaṃtāpaṃ vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ tathā|
kaṭūṣṇaṃ gurvabhiṣyandi lavaṇāmlaṃ ca varjayet||
6.29.50 |  purāṇā yavagodhūmanīvārāḥ śāliṣaṣṭikāḥ|
bhojanārthaṃ rasārthaṃ vā viṣkirapratudā hitāḥ||
6.29.51 |  āḍhakyaścaṇakā mudgā masūrāḥ samakuṣṭhakāḥ|
yūṣārthaṃ bahusarpiṣkāḥ praśastā vātaśoṇite||
6.29.52 |  suniṣaṇṇakavetrāgrakākamācīśatāvarī|
vāstukopodikāśākaṃ śākaṃ sauvarcalaṃ tathā||
6.29.53 |  ghṛtamāṃsarasairbhṛṣṭaṃ śākasātmyāya dāpayet|
vyañjanārthaṃ, tathā gavyaṃ māhiṣājaṃ payo hitam||
6.29.54 |  iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ vātaraktacikitsitam|
etadeva punaḥ sarvaṃ vyāsataḥ saṃpravakṣyate||
6.29.55 |  śrāvaṇīkṣīrakākolījīvakarṣabhakaiḥ samaiḥ|
siddhaṃ samadhukaiḥ sarpiḥ sakṣīraṃ vātaraktanut||
6.29.56 |  balāmatibalāṃ medāmātmaguptāṃ śatāvarīm|
kākolīṃ kṣīrakākolīṃ rāsnāmṛddhiṃ ca peṣayet||
6.29.57 |  ghṛtaṃ caturguṇakṣīraṃ taiḥ siddhaṃ vātaraktanut|
hṛtpāṇḍurogavīsarpakāmalājvaranāśanam||
6.29.58 |  trāyantikātāmalakīdvikākolīśatāvarī|
kaśerukākaṣāyeṇa kalkairebhiḥ pacedghṛtam||
6.29.59 |  dattvā parūṣakādrākṣākāśmaryekṣurasān samān|
pṛthagvidāryāḥ svarasaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ caturguṇam||
6.29.60 |  etat prāyogikaṃ sarpiḥ pārūṣakamiti smṛtam|
vātarakte kṣate kṣīṇe vīsarpe paittike jvare||
iti pārūṣakaṃ ghṛtam|
6.29.61 |  dve pañcamūle varṣābhūmeraṇḍaṃ sapunarnavam|
mudgaparṇīṃ mahāmedāṃ māṣaparṇīṃ śatāvarīm||
6.29.62 |  śaṅkhapuṣpīmavākpuṣpīṃ rāsnāmatibalāṃ balām|
pṛthagdvipalikaṃ kṛttvā jaladroṇe vipācayet||
6.29.63 |  pādaśeṣe samān kṣīradhātrīkṣucchāgalān rasān|
ghṛtāḍhakena saṃyojya śanairmṛdvagninā pacet||
6.29.64 |  kalkānāvāpya mede dve kāśmaryaphalamutpalam|
tvakkṣīrīṃ pippalīṃ drākṣāṃ padmabījaṃ punarnavām||
6.29.65 |  nāgaraṃ kṣīrakākolīṃ padmakaṃ bṛhatīdvayam|
vīrāṃ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ bhavyamurumāṇaṃ nikocakam||
6.29.66 |  kharjūrākṣoṭavātāmamuñjātābhiṣukāṃstathā|
etairghṛtāḍhake siddhe kṣaudraṃ śīte pradāpayet||
6.29.67 |  samyak siddhaṃ ca vijñāya suguptaṃ saṃnidhāpayet|
kṛtarakṣāvidhiṃ caukṣe prāśayedakṣasaṃmitam||
6.29.68 |  pāṇḍurogaṃ jvaraṃ hikkāṃ svarabhedaṃ bhagandaram|
pārśvaśūlaṃ kṣayaṃ kāsaṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam||
6.29.69 |  kṣataśoṣamapasmāramaśmarīṃ śarkarāṃ tathā|
sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogāṃśca mūtrasaṅgaṃ ca nāśayet||
6.29.70 |  balavarṇakaraṃ dhanyaṃ valīpalitanāśanam|
jīvanīyamidaṃ sarpirvṛṣyaṃ vandhyāsutapradam||
6.29.71 |  drākṣāmadhu(dhū)katoyābhyāṃ siddhaṃ vā sasitopalam|
pibedghṛtaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ guḍūcīsvarase śṛtam||
6.29.72 |  jīvakarṣabhakau medāmṛṣyaproktāṃ śatāvarīm|
madhukaṃ madhuparṇīṃ ca kākolīdvayameva ca||
6.29.73 |  mudgamāṣākhyaparṇinyau daśamūlaṃ punarnavām|
balāmṛtāvidārīśca sāśvagandhāśmabhedakāḥ||
6.29.74 |  eṣāṃ kaṣāyakalkābhyāṃ sarpistailaṃ ca sādhayet|
lābhataśca vasāmajjadhānvaprātudavaiṣkiram||
6.29.75 |  caturguṇena payasā tat siddhaṃ vātaśoṇitam|
sarvadehāśritaṃ hanti vyādhīn ghorāṃśca vātajān||
6.29.76 |  sthirā śvadaṃṣṭrā bṛhatī sārivā saśatāvarī|
kāśmaryāṇyātmaguptā ca vṛścīro dve bale tathā||
6.29.77 |  eṣāṃ kvāthe catuḥkṣīraṃ pṛthak tailaṃ pṛthagvṛtam|
medāśatāvarīyaṣṭijīvantījīvakarṣabhaiḥ||
6.29.78 |  paktvā mātrā tataḥ kṣīratriguṇā 'dhyardhaśarkarā|
khajena mathitā peyā vātarakte tridoṣaje||
6.29.79 |  tailaṃ payaḥ śarkarāṃ ca pāyayedvā sumūrcchitam|
sarpistailasitākṣaudrairmiśraṃ vā 'pi pibet payaḥ||
6.29.80 |  aṃśumatyā śṛtaḥ prasthaḥ payaso dvisitopalaḥ|
pāne praśasyate tadvat pippalīnāgaraiḥ śṛtaḥ||
6.29.81 |  balāśatāvalīrāsnādaśamūlaiḥ sapīlubhiḥ|
śyāmairaṇḍasthirābhiśca vātārtighnaṃ śṛtaṃ payaḥ||
6.29.82 |  dhāroṣṇaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ vā kṣīraṃ doṣānulomanam|
pibedvā satrivṛccūrṇaṃ pittaraktāvṛtānilaḥ||
6.29.83 |  kṣīreṇairaṇḍatailaṃ vā prayogeṇa pibennaraḥ|
bahudoṣo virekārthaṃ jīrṇe kṣīraudanāśanaḥ||
6.29.84 |  *kaṣāyamabhayānāṃ vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ pibennaraḥ|
kṣīrānupānaṃ trivṛtācūrṇaṃ drākṣārasena vā||
6.29.85 |  kāśmaryaṃ trivṛtāṃ drākṣāṃ triphalāṃ saparūṣakām|
śṛtaṃ pibedvirekāya lavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam||
6.29.86 |  triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyaṃ vā pibet kṣaudreṇa saṃyutam|
dhātrīharidrāmustānāṃ kaṣāyaṃ vā kaphādhikaḥ||
6.29.87 |  yogaiśca kalpavihitairasakṛttaṃ virecayet|
mṛdubhiḥ snehasaṃyuktairjñātvā vātaṃ malāvṛtam||
6.29.88 |  nirharedvā malaṃ tasya saghṛtaiḥ kṣīrabastibhiḥ|
na hi bastisamaṃ kiṃcidvātaraktacikitsitam||
6.29.89 |  bastivaṃkṣaṇapārśvoruparvāsthijaṭharārtiṣu|
udāvarte ca śasyante nirūhāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ||
6.29.90 |  dadyāttailāni cemāni bastikarmaṇi buddhimān|
nasyābhyañjanasekeṣu dāhaśūlopaśāntaye||
6.29.91 |  *madhuyaṣṭyāstulāyāstu kaṣāye pādaśeṣite|
tailāḍhakaṃ samakṣīraṃ pacet kalkaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||
6.29.92 |  śatapuṣpāvarīmūrvāpayasyāgurucandanaiḥ|
sthirāhaṃsapadīmāṃsīdvimedāmadhuparṇibhiḥ||
6.29.93 |  kākolīkṣīrakākolītāmalakyṛddhipadmakaiḥ|
jīvakarṣabhajīvantītvakpatranakhavālakaiḥ||
6.29.94 |  prapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhāsārivaindrīvitunnakaiḥ|
catuṣprayogāttaddhanti tailaṃ mārutaśoṇitam||
6.29.95 |  sopadravaṃ sāṅgaśūlaṃ sarvagātrānugaṃ tathā|
vātāsṛkpittadāhārtijvaraghnaṃ balavarṇakṛt||
iti madhuparṇyāditailam|
6.29.96 |  madhukasya śataṃ drākṣā kharjūrāṇi parūṣakam|
madhūkaudanapākyau ca prasthaṃ muñjātakasya ca||
6.29.97 |  kāśmaryāḍhakamityetaccaturdroṇe pacedapām|
śeṣe 'ṣṭabhāge pūte ca tasmiṃstailāḍhakaṃ pacet||
6.29.98 |  tathā++āmalakakāśmaryavidārīkṣurasaiḥ samaiḥ|
caturdroṇena payasā kalkaṃ dattvā palonmitam||
6.29.99 |  kadambāmalakākṣoṭapadmabījakaśerukam|
śṛṅgāṭakaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ lavaṇaṃ pippalīṃ sitām||
6.29.100 |  jīvanīyaiśca saṃsiddhaṃ kṣaudraprasthena saṃsṛjet|
nasyābhyañjanapāneṣu bastau cāpi niyojayet||
6.29.101 |  vātavyādhiṣu sarveṣu manyāstambhe hanugrahe|
sarvāṅgaikāṅgavāte ca kṣatakṣīṇe kṣatajvare||
6.29.102 |  sukumārakamityetadvātāsrāmayanāśanam|
svaravarṇakaraṃ tailamārogyabalapuṣṭidam||
iti sukumārakatailam|
6.29.103 |  guḍūcīṃ madhukaṃ hrasvaṃ pañcamūlaṃ punarnavām|
rāsnāmeraṇḍamūlaṃ ca jīvanīyāni lābhataḥ||
6.29.104 |  palānāṃ śatakairbhāgairbalāpañcaśataṃ tathā|
kolabilvayavānmāṣānkulatthāṃśrāḍhakonmitān||
6.29.105 |  kāśmaryāṇāṃ suśuṣkāṇāṃ droṇaṃ droṇaśate 'mbhasi|
sādhayejjarjaraṃ dhautaṃ caturdroṇaṃ ca śeṣayet||
6.29.106 |  tailadroṇaṃ pacettena dattvā pañcaguṇaṃ payaḥ|
piṣṭvā tripalikaṃ caiva candanośīrakeśaram||
6.29.107 |  patrailāgurukuṣṭhāni tagaraṃ madhuyaṣṭikām|
mañjiṣṭhāṣṭapalaṃ caiva tat siddhaṃ sārvayogikam||
6.29.108 |  vātarakte kṣatakṣīṇe bhārārte kṣīṇaretasi|
vepanākṣepabhagnānāṃ sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogiṇām||
6.29.109 |  yonidoṣamapasmāramunmādaṃ khañjapaṅgutām|
hanyāt *prasavanaṃ caitattailāgryamamṛtāhvayam||
ityamṛtādyaṃ tailam|
6.29.110 |  padmavetasayaṣṭyāhvaphenilāpadmakotpalaiḥ|
pṛthakpañcapalairdarbhabalācandanakiṃśukaiḥ||
6.29.111 |  jale śṛtaiḥ pacettailaprasthaṃ sauvīrasaṃmitam|
lodhrakālīyakośīrajīvakarabhakeśaraiḥ||
6.29.112 |  madayantīlatāpatrapadmakeśarapadmakaiḥ|
prapauṇḍarīkakāśmaryamāṃsīmedāpriyaṅgubhiḥ||
6.29.113 |  kuṅkumasya palārdhena mañjiṣṭhāyāḥ palena ca|
mahāpadmamidaṃ tailaṃ vātāsṛgjvaranāśanam||
iti mahāpadmaṃ tailam|
6.29.114 |  padmakośīrayaṣṭyāhvarajanīkvāthasādhitam|
syāt piṣṭaiḥ sarjamañjiṣṭhāvīrākākolicandanaiḥ||
6.29.115 |  khuḍḍūkapadmakamidaṃ tailaṃ vātāsradāhanut|
iti khuḍḍūkapadmakaṃ tailam|
śatena yaṣṭimadhukāt sādhyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ payaḥ||
6.29.116 |  tasmiṃstaile caturdroṇe madhukasya palena tu|
siddhaṃ madhukakāśmaryarasairvā vātaraktanut||
6.29.117 |  madhuparṇyāḥ palaṃ piṣṭvā tailaprasthaṃ caturguṇe|
kṣīre sādhyaṃ śataṃ kṛtvā tadevaṃ madhukācchate||
6.29.118 |  siddhaṃ deyaṃ *tridoṣe syādvātāsre śvāsakāsanut|
hṛtpāṇḍurogavīsarpakāmalādāhanāśanam||
iti śatapākaṃ madhukatailam|
6.29.119 |  balākaṣāyakalkābhyāṃ tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ pacet|
*sahasraṃ śatavāraṃ vā vātāsṛgvātaroganut||
6.29.120 |  rasāyanamidaṃ śreṣṭhamindriyāṇāṃ prasādanam|
jīvanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ svaryaṃ śukrāsṛgdoṣanāśanam||
iti sahasrapākaṃ śatapākaṃ vā balātailam|
6.29.121 |  guḍūcīrasadugdhābhyāṃ tailaṃ drākṣārasena vā|
siddhaṃ madhukakāśmaryarasairvā vātaraktanut||
6.29.122 |  āranālāḍhake tailaṃ pādasarjarasaṃ śṛtam|
prabhūte khajitaṃ toye jvaradāhārtinut param||
6.29.123 |  samadhūcchiṣṭamāñjiṣṭhaṃ sasarjarasasārivam|
piṇḍatailaṃ tadabhyaṅgādvātaraktarujāpaham||
iti piṇḍatailam|
6.29.124 |  daśamūlaśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ sadyaḥ śūlanivāraṇam|
paribeko 'nilaprāye tadvat koṣṇena sarpiṣā||
6.29.125 |  snehairmadhurasiddhairvā caturbhiḥ pariṣecayet|
stambhākṣepakaśūlārtaṃ koṣṇairdāhe tu śītalaiḥ||
6.29.126 |  tadvadgavyāvikacchāgaiḥ kṣīraistailavimiśritaiḥ|
kvāthairvā jīvanīyānāṃ pañcamūlasya vā bhiṣak||
6.29.127 |  drākṣekṣurasamadyāni dadhimastvamlakāñjikam|
sekārthe taṇḍulakṣaudraśarkarāmbu ca śasyate||
6.29.128 |  kumudotpalapadmādyairmaṇihāraiḥ sacandanaiḥ|
śītatoyānigairdāhe prokṣaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ hitam||
6.29.129 |  candrapādāmbusaṃsikte kṣaumapadmadalacchade|
śayane pulinasparśaśītamārutavījite||
6.29.130 |  candanārdrastanakarāḥ priyā nāryaḥ priyaṃvadāḥ|
sparśaśītāḥ sukhasparśā ghnanti dāhaṃ rujaṃ klamam||
6.29.131 |  sarāge saruje dāhe raktaṃ visrāvya lepayet|
madhukāśvatthatvaṅmāṃsīvīrodumbaraśādvalaiḥ||
6.29.132 |  jalajairyavacūrṇairvā sayaṣṭyāhvapayoghṛtaiḥ|
sarpiṣā jīvanīyairvā piṣṭairlepo 'rtidāhanut||
6.29.133 |  *tilāḥ priyālo madhukaṃ bisaṃ mūlaṃ ca vetasāt|
ājena payasā piṣṭaḥ pralepo dāharāganut||
6.29.134 |  prapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhādārvīmadhukacandanaiḥ|
sitopalairakāsaktumasūrośīrapadmakaiḥ||
6.29.135 |  lepo rugdāhavīsarparāgaśophanivāraṇaḥ|
pittaraktottare tvete, lepān vātottare śṛṇu||
6.29.136 |  vātaghnaiḥ sādhitaḥ snigdhaḥ *sakṣīramudgapāyasaḥ|
tilasarṣapapiṇḍairvā 'pyupanāho rujāpahaḥ||
6.29.137 |  audakaprasahānūpaveśavārāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ|
jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ snehayuktāḥ syurupanāhane||
6.29.138 |  stambhatodarugāyāmaśothāṅgagrahanāśanāḥ|
jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ siddhā sapayaskā vasā 'pi vā||
6.29.139 |  ghṛtaṃ sahacarānmūlaṃ jīvantī cchāgalaṃ payaḥ|
lepaḥ piṣṭāstilāstadvadbhṛṣṭāḥ payasi nirvṛtāḥ||
6.29.140 |  kṣīrapiṣṭamumālepameraṇḍasya phalāni ca|
kuryācchūlanivṛttyarthaṃ śatāhvāmānale 'dhike||
6.29.141 |  samūlāgracchadairaṇḍakvāthe dviprāsthikaṃ pṛthak|
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vasā majjā cānūpamṛgapakṣiṇām||
6.29.142 |  kalkārthe jīvanīyāni gavyaṃ kṣīramathājakam|
haridrotpalakuṣṭhailāśatāhvāś-*vahanacchadān||
6.29.143 |  bilvamātrān pṛthak puṣpaṃ kākubhaṃ cāpi sādhayet|
madhūcchiṣṭapalānyaṣṭau dadyācchīte 'vatārite||
6.29.144 |  śūlenaiṣo 'rditāṅgānāṃ lepaḥ sandhigate 'nile|
vātarakte cyute bhagne khañje kubje ca śasyate||
6.29.145 |  śophagauravakaṇḍvādyairyukte tvasmin kaphottare|
mūtrakṣārasurāpakvaṃ vṛtamabhyañjane hitam||
6.29.146 |  padmakaṃ tvak samadhukaṃ sārivā ceti tairghṛtam|
siddhaṃ samadhuśuktaṃ syāt sekābhyaṅge kaphottare||
6.29.147 |  *kṣārastailaṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ *jalaṃ ca kaṭukaiḥ śṛtam|
pariṣeke praśaṃsanti vātarakte kaphottare||
6.29.148 |  lepaḥ sarṣapanimbārkahiṃsrākṣīratilairhitaḥ|
śreṣṭhaḥ *siddhaḥ kapitthatvagghṛtakṣīraiḥ sasaktubhiḥ||
6.29.149 |  gṛhadhūmo vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā rajanīdvayam|
pralepaḥ śūlanudvātarakte vātakaphottare||
6.29.150 |  tagaraṃ tvak śatāhvailā kuṣṭhaṃ mustaṃ hareṇukā|
dāru vyāghranakhaṃ cāmlapiṣṭaṃ vātakaphāsranut||
6.29.151 |  madhuśigrorhitaṃ tadvadbījaṃ dhānyāmlasaṃyutam|
muhūrtaṃ liptamamlaiśca siñcedvātakaphottaram||
6.29.152 |  triphalāvyoṣapatrailātvakkṣīrīcitrakaṃ vacām|
viḍaṅgaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ romaśaṃ vṛṣakatvacam||
6.29.153 |  ṛddhiṃ tāmalakīṃ cavyaṃ samabhāgāni peṣayet|
kalyaṃ *liptamayaspātre madhyāhne bhakṣayettataḥ||
6.29.154 |  varjayeddadhiśuktāni kṣīraṃ vairodhikāni ca|
vātāsre sarvadoṣe 'pi hitaṃ śūlārdite param||
6.29.155 |  buddhvā sthānaviśeṣāṃśca doṣāṇāṃ ca balābalam|
cikitsitamidaṃ kuryādūhāpohavikalpavit||
6.29.156 |  kupite mārgasaṃrodhānmedaso vā kaphasya vā|
*ativṛddhyā 'nile nādau śastaṃ snehanabṛṃhaṇam||
6.29.157 |  vyāyāmaśodhanāriṣṭamūtrapānairvirecanaiḥ|
takrābhayāprayogaiśca kṣapayet kaphamedasī||
6.29.158 |  bodhivṛkṣakaṣāyaṃ tu prapibenmadhunā saha|
vātaraktaṃ jayatyāśu tridoṣamapi dāruṇam||
6.29.159 |  purāṇayavagodhūmasīdhvariṣṭasurāsavaiḥ|
śilājatuprayogaiśca guggulormākṣikasya ca||
6.29.160 |  gambhīre raktamākrāntaṃ syāccettadvātavajjayet|
paścādvāte kriyāṃ kuryādvātaraktaprasādanīm||
6.29.161 |  raktapittātivṛddhyā tu pākamāśu niyacchati|
bhinnaṃ sravati vā raktaṃ vidagdhaṃ pūyameva vā||
6.29.162 |  tayoḥ kriyā vidhātavyā *bhedaśodhanaropaṇaiḥ|
kuryādupadravāṇāṃ ca kriyāṃ svāṃ svāccikitsitāt||
6.29.163 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
hetuḥ sthānāni mūlaṃ ca yasmāt prāyeṇa sandhiṣu|
kupyati prāk ca yadrūpaṃ dvividhasya ca lakṣaṇam||
6.29.164 |  pṛthagbhinnasya liṅgaṃ ca doṣādhikyamupadravāḥ|
sādhyaṃ yāpyamasādhyaṃ ca kriyā sādhyasya cākhilā||
6.29.165 |  vātaraktasya nirdiṣṭā samāsavyāsatastathā|
maharṣiṇā 'gniveśāya tathaivāvasthikī kriyā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsitasthāne vātaśoṇitacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||29 | |

triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
6.30.1 |  athāto yonivyāpaccikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
6.30.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
6.30.3 |  divyatīrhtauṣadhimataścitradhātuśilāvataḥ|
puṇye himavataḥ pārśve surasiddharṣisevite||
6.30.4 |  viharantaṃ tapoyogāttattvajñānārhtadarśinam|
*punarvasuṃ jitātmānamagniveśo 'nu pṛṣṭavān||
6.30.5 |  bhagavan! yadapatyānāṃ mūlaṃ nāryaḥ paraṃ nṛṇām|
taddhighāto gadaiścāsāṃ kriyate yonimāśritaiḥ||
6.30.6 |  tasmātteṣāṃ samutpattimutpannānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam|
sauṣadhaṃ śrotumicchāmi prajānugrahakāmyayā||
6.30.7 |  iti śiṣyeṇa pṛṣṭastu provācarṣivaro 'trijaḥ|
viṃśatirvyāpado yonernirdiṣṭā rogasaṃgrahe||
6.30.8 |  mithyācāreṇa tāḥ strīṇāṃ praduṣṭenārtavena ca|
jāyante bījadoṣācca daivācca śṛṇu tāḥ pṛthak||
6.30.9 |  vātalāhāraceṣṭāyā vātalāyāḥ samīraṇaḥ|
vivṛddho yonimāśritya yonestodaṃ savedanam||
6.30.10 |  stambhaṃ pipīlikāsṛptimiva karkaśatāṃ tathā|
karoti suptimāyāsaṃ vātajāṃścāparān gadān||
6.30.11 |  sā syāt saśabdarukphenatanurūkṣārtavā 'nilāt|
vyāpatkaṭvamlalavaṇakṣārādyaiḥ pittajā bhavet||
6.30.12 |  dāhapākajvaroṣṇārtā nīlapītāsitārtavā|
bhṛśoṣṇakuṇapasrāvā yoniḥ syātpittadūṣitā||
6.30.13 |  kapho 'bhiṣyandibhirvṛddho yoniṃ ceddūṣayet striyāḥ|
sa kuryāt picchilāṃ śītāṃ kaṇḍugrastālpavedanām||
6.30.14 |  pāṇḍuvarṇāṃ tathā pāṇḍupicchilārtavavāhinīm|
samaśnantyā rasān sarvāndūṣayitvā trayo malāḥ||
6.30.15 |  yonigarbhāśayasthāḥ svairyoniṃ yuñjanti lakṣaṇaiḥ|
sā bhaveddāhaśūlārtā śvetapicchilavāhinī||
6.30.16 |  raktapittakarairnāryā raktaṃ pittena dūṣitam|
atipravartate yonyāṃ labdhe garbhe 'pi *sāsṛjā||
6.30.17 |  yonigarbhāśayasthaṃ cet pittaṃ saṃdūṣayedasṛk|
sā 'rajaskā matā kārśyavaivarṇyajananī bhṛśam||
6.30.18 |  yonyāmadhāvanāt kaṇḍūṃ jātāḥ kurvanti jantavaḥ|
sā syādacaraṇā kaṇḍvā tayā 'tinarakāṅkṣiṇī||
6.30.19 |  pavano 'tivyavāyena śophasuptirujaḥ striyāḥ|
karoti kupito yonau sā cāticaraṇā matā||
6.30.20 |  maithunādatibālāyāḥ pṛṣṭhakaṭyūruvaṃkṣaṇam|
rujan dūṣayate yoniṃ vāyuḥ prākcaraṇā hi sā||
6.30.21 |  garbhiṇyāḥ śleṣmalābhyāsācchardiniḥśvāsanigrahāt|
vāyuḥ *kruddhaḥ kaphaṃ yonimupanīya pradūṣayet||
6.30.22 |  pāṇḍuṃ satodamāsrāvaṃ śvetaṃ sravati vā kapham|
kaphavātāmayavyāptā sā syādyonirupaplutā||
6.30.23 |  pittalāyā nṛsaṃvāse kṣavathūdgāradhāraṇāt|
pittasaṃmūrcchito vāyuryoniṃ dūṣayati striyāḥ||
6.30.24 |  śūnā sparśākṣamā sārtirnīlapītamasṛk sravet|
śroṇivaṃkṣaṇapṛṣṭhārtijvarārtāyāḥ pariplutā||
6.30.25 |  vegodāvartanādyonimudāvartayate 'nilaḥ|
sā rugārtā rajaḥ *kṛcchreṇodāvṛttaṃ vimuñcati||
6.30.26 |  ārtave sā vimukte tu tatkṣaṇaṃ labhate sukham|
rajaso gamanādūrdhvaṃ jñeyodāvartinī budhaiḥ||
6.30.27 |  akāle vāhamānāyā garbheṇa pihito 'nilaḥ|
karṇikāṃ janayedyonau śleṣmaraktena mūrcchitaḥ||
6.30.28 |  raktamārgāvarodhinyā *sā tayā karṇinī matā|
raukṣyādvāyuryadā garbhaṃ jātaṃ jātaṃ vināśayet||
6.30.29 |  duṣṭaśoṇitajaṃ nāryāḥ putraghnī nāma sā matā|
vyavāyamatitṛptāyā bhajantyāstvannapīḍitaḥ||
6.30.30 |  vāyurmithyāsthitāṅgāyā yonisrotasi saṃsthitaḥ|
vakrayatyānanaṃ *yonyāḥ sā 'sthimāṃsānilārtibhiḥ||
6.30.31 |  bhṛśārtirmaithunāśaktā yonirantarmukhī matā|
garbhasthāyāḥ striyā raukṣyādvāyuryoniṃ pradūṣayan||
6.30.32 |  mātṛdoṣādaṇudvārāṃ kuryāt sūcīmukhī tu sā|
vyavāyakāle rundhantyā vegān prakupito 'nilaḥ||
6.30.33 |  kuryādviṇmūtrasaṅgārtiṃ śoṣaṃ yonimukhasya ca|
ṣaḍahāt saptarātrādvā śukraṃ garbhāśayaṃ gatam||
6.30.34 |  sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ vā 'pi yā sravet sā tu vāminī|
bījadoṣāttu garbhasthamārutopahatāśayā||
6.30.35 |  nṛdveṣiṇyastanī caiva ṣaṇḍhī syādanupakramā|
viṣamaṃ duḥkhaśayyāyāṃ maithunāt kupito 'nilaḥ||
6.30.36 |  garbhāśayasya yonyāśca mukhaṃ viṣṭambhayet striyāḥ|
asaṃvṛtamukhī *sārtī rūkṣaphenāsravāhinī||
6.30.37 |  māṃsotsannā mahāyoniḥ parvavaṃkṣaṇaśūlinī|
ityetairlakṣaṇaiḥ proktā viṃśatiryonijā gadāḥ||
6.30.38 |  na śukraṃ dhārayatyebhirdoṣairyonirupadrutā|
tasmādgarbhaṃ na gṛhṇāti strī gacchatyāmayān bahūn||
6.30.39 |  gulmārśaḥpradarādīṃśca vātādyaiścātipīḍanam|
āsāṃ ṣoḍaśa yāstvantyā ādye dve pittadoṣaje||
6.30.40 |  pariplutā vāminī ca vātapittātmike mate|
karṇinyupaplute vātakaphāccheṣāstu vātajāḥ||
6.30.41 |  dehaṃ vātādayastāsāṃ svairliṅgaiḥ pīḍayanti hi|
snehanasvedabastyādi vātajāsvanilāpaham||
6.30.42 |  kārayedraktapitaghnaṃ śītaṃ pittakṛtāsu ca|
śleṣmajāsu ca rūkṣoṣṇaṃ karma kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ||
6.30.43 |  sannipāte vimiśraṃ tu saṃsṛṣṭāsu ca kārayet|
snigdhasvinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ duḥsthitāṃ sthāpayetpunaḥ||
6.30.44 |  pāṇinā nāmayejjihmāṃ saṃvṛtāṃ vardhayet punaḥ|
praveśayenniḥsṛtāṃ ca vivṛtāṃ parivartayet||
6.30.45 |  yoniḥ sthānāpavṛttā hi śalyabhūtā matā striyāḥ|
sarvāṃ vyāpannayoniṃ tu karmabhirvamanādibhiḥ||
6.30.46 |  mṛdubhiḥ pañcabhirnārīṃ snigdhasvinnāmupācaret|
sarvataḥ suviśuddhāyāḥ śeṣaṃ karma vidhīyate||
6.30.47 |  vātavyādhiharaṃ karma vātārtānāṃ sadā hitam|
audakānūpajairmāṃsaiḥ kṣīraiḥ satilataṇḍulaiḥ||
6.30.48 |  savātaghnauṣadhairnāḍīkumbhīsvedairupācaret|
aktāṃ lavaṇatailena sāśmaprastarasaṅkaraiḥ||
6.30.49 |  svinnāṃ koṣṇāmbusiktāṅgīṃ vātaghnairbhojayedrasaiḥ|
balādroṇadvayakvāthe *ghṛtatailāḍakaṃ pacet||
6.30.50 |  sthirāpayasyājīvantīvīrarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ|
śrāvaṇīpippalīmudgapīlumāṣākhyaparṇibhiḥ||
6.30.51 |  śarkarākṣīrakākolīkākanāsābhireva ca|
piṣṭaiścaturguṇakṣīre siddhaṃ peyaṃ yathābalam||
6.30.52 |  vātapittakṛtān rogān hatvā garbhaṃ dadhāti tat|
kāśmaryatriphalādrākṣākāsamardaparūṣakaiḥ||
6.30.53 |  punarnavādvirajanīkākanāsāsahācaraiḥ|
śatāvaryā guḍūcyāśca prasthamakṣasamairghṛtāt||
6.30.54 |  *sādhitaṃ yonivātaghnaṃ garbhadaṃ paramaṃ pibet|
*pippalīkuñcikājājīvṛṣakaṃ saindhavaṃ vacām||
6.30.55 |  yavakṣārājamode ca śarkarāṃ citrakaṃ tathā|
piṣṭvā *sarpiṣi bhṛṣṭāni pāyayeta prasannayā||
6.30.56 |  yonipārśvārtihṛdrogagulmārśovinivṛttaye|
vṛṣakaṃ mātuluṅgasya mūlāni madayantikām||
6.30.57 |  pibet salavaṇairmadyaiḥ pippalīkuñcike tathā|
rāsnāśvadaṃṣṭrāvṛṣakaiḥ pibecchūle śṛtaṃ payaḥ||
6.30.58 |  guḍūcītriphalādantīkvāthaiśca pariṣecayet|
saindhavaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bṛhatī devadāru ca||
6.30.59 |  samāṃśaiḥ sādhitaṃ kalkaistailaṃ dhāryaṃ rujāpaham|
guḍūcīmālatīrāsnābalāmadhukacitrakaiḥ||
6.30.60 |  nidigdhikādevadāruyūthikābhiśca kārṣikaiḥ|
tailaprasthaṃ gavāṃ mūtre kṣīre ca dviguṇe pacet||
6.30.61 |  vātārtāyāḥ picuṃ dadyādyonau ca praṇayettataḥ|
vātārtānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ sekābhyaṅgapicukriyāḥ||
6.30.62 |  (*uṣṇāḥ sigdhāḥ prakartavyāstailāni snehanāni ca|)
hiṃsrākalkaṃ tu vātārtā koṣṇamabhyajya dhārayet|
pañcavalkasya pittārtā śyāmādīnāṃ kaphāturā||
6.30.63 |  pittalānāṃ tu yonīnāṃ sekābhyaṅgapicukriyāḥ|
śītāḥ pittaharāḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca||
6.30.64 |  (*pittaghnauṣadhasiddhāni kāryāṇi bhiṣajā tathā|)
śatāvarīmūlatulāścatasraḥ saṃprapīḍayet||
6.30.65 |  rasena kṣīratulyena pacettena ghṛtāḍhakam|
jīvanīyaiḥ śatāvaryā mṛdvīkābhiḥ parūṣakaiḥ||
6.30.66 |  piṣṭaiḥ priyālaiścākṣāṃśairdviyaṣṭimadhukairbhiṣak|
siddhe śīte ca madhunaḥ pippalyāśca palāṣṭakam||
6.30.67 |  sitādaśapalonmiśrāllihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ|
yonyasṛkśukradoṣaghnaṃ vṛṣyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ ca tat||
6.30.68 |  kṣataṃ kṣataṃ raktapittaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ halīmakam|
kāmalāṃ vātaraktaṃ ca vīsarpaṃ hṛcchirograham||
6.30.69 |  unmādāratyapasmārān vātapittātmakāñjayet|
iti bṛhacchatāvarīghṛtam|
evameva kṣīrasarpirjīvanīyopasādhitam||
6.30.70 |  garbhadaṃ pittalānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ syādbhiṣagjitam|
yonyāṃ śleṣmapraduṣṭāyāṃ vārtiḥ saṃśodhanī hitā||
6.30.71 |  vārāhe bahuśaḥ pitte bhāvitairlaktakaiḥ kṛtā|
bhāvitaṃ payasā 'rkasya yavacūrṇaṃ sasaindhavam||
6.30.72 |  vartiḥ kṛtā muhurdhāryā tataḥ secyā sukhāmbunā|
pippalyā maricairmāṣaiḥ śatāhvākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ||
6.30.73 |  vartistulyā pradeśinyā dhāryā yoniviśodhanī|
udumbaraśalāṭūnāṃ droṇamabdroṇasaṃyutam||
6.30.74 |  *sapañcavaklakulakamālatīnimbapallavam|
niśāṃ sthāpya jale tasmiṃstailaprasthaṃ vipācayet||
6.30.75 |  lākṣādhavapalāśatvaṅniryāsaiḥ śālmalena ca|
piṣṭaiḥ siddhasya tailasya picuṃ yonau nidhāpayet||
6.30.76 |  saśarkaraiḥ kaṣāyaiśca śītaiḥ kurvīta secanam|
picchilā vivṛtā kāladuṣṭā yoniśca dāruṇā||
6.30.77 |  *saptāhācchudhyati kṣipramapatyaṃ cāpi vindati|
udumbarasya dugdhena ṣaṭkṛtvo bhāvitāttilāt||
6.30.78 |  tailaṃ kvāthena tasyaiva siddhaṃ dhāryaṃ ca pūrvavat|
dhātakyāmalakīpatrasrotojamadhukotpalaiḥ||
6.30.79 |  jambvāmramadhyakāsīsalodhrakaṭphalatindukaiḥ|
saurāṣṭrikādāḍimatvagudumbaraśalāḍubhiḥ||
6.30.80 |  akṣamātrairajāmūtre kṣīre ca dviguṇe pacet|
tailaprasthaṃ picuṃ dadyādyonau ca praṇayettataḥ||
6.30.81 |  kaṭīpṛṣṭhatrikābhyaṅgaṃ snehabastiṃ ca dāpayet|
picchilā *srāviṇī yonirviplutopaplutā tathā||
6.30.82 |  uttānā connatā śūnā sidhyet sasphoṭaśūlinī|
karīradhavanimbarkaveṇukośāmrajāmbavaiḥ||
6.30.83 |  jiṅginīvṛṣamūlānāṃ kvāthairmārdvīkasīdhubhiḥ|
saśuktairdhāvanaṃ mithairyonyāsrāvavināśanam||
6.30.84 |  kuryāt satakragomūtraśuktairvā triphalārasaiḥ|
pippalyayorajaḥ pathyāprayogā madhunā hitāḥ||
6.30.85 |  śleṣmalāyāṃ kaṭuprāyāḥ samūtrā bastayo hitāḥ|
pitte samadhurakṣīrā vāte tailāmlasaṃyutāḥ||
6.30.86 |  sannipātasamutthāyāḥ karma sādhāraṇaṃ hitam|
raktayonyāmasṛgvarṇairanubandhaṃ samīkṣya ca||
6.30.87 |  tataḥ kuryādyathādoṣaṃ raktasthāpanamauṣadham|
tilacūrṇaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ phāṇitaṃ śaukarī vasā||
6.30.88 |  kṣaudreṇa saṃyutaṃ peyaṃ vātasṛgdaranāśanam|
varāhasya raso medyaḥ sakaulattho 'nilādhike||
6.30.89 |  śarkarākṣaudrayaṣṭyāhvanāgarairvā yutaṃ dadhi|
payasyotpalaśālūkabisakālīyakāmbudam||
6.30.90 |  sapayaḥśarkarākṣaudraṃ *paittike 'sṛgdare pibet|
pāṭhā jambvāmrayormadhyaṃ śilodbhedaṃ rasāñjanam||
6.30.91 |  ambaṣṭhā śālmalīśleṣaṃ samaṅgāṃ vatsakatvacam|
bāhlīkātiviṣe bilvaṃ mustaṃ lodhraṃ sagairikam||
6.30.92 |  kaṭvaṅgaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ mṛdvīkāṃ raktacandanam|
kaṭphalaṃ vatsakānantādhātakīmadhukārjunam||
6.30.93 |  puṣyeṇoddhṛtya tulyāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet|
tāni kṣaudreṇa saṃyojya pibettaṇḍulavāriṇā||
6.30.94 |  arśaḥsu cātisāreṣu raktaṃ yaccopaveśyate|
doṣāgantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃśca nāśayet||
6.30.95 |  yonidoṣaṃ rajodoṣaṃ śvetaṃ nīlaṃ sapītakam|
strīṇāṃ śyāvāruṇaṃ yacca prasahya vinivartayet||
6.30.96 |  cūrṇaṃ puṣyānugaṃ nāma hitamātreyapūjitam|
iti puṣyānugacūrṇam|
taṇḍulīyakamūlaṃ tu sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunā||
6.30.97 |  rasāñjanaṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca chāgena payasā pibet|
patrakalkau ghṛte bhṛṣṭau rājādanakapitthayoḥ||
6.30.98 |  pittānilaharau, paitte sarvathaivāsrapittajit|
madhukaṃ triphalāṃ lodhraṃ mustaṃ saurāṣṭrikāṃ madhu||
6.30.99 |  madyairnimbaguḍūcyau vā kaphaje 'sṛgdare pibet|
virecanaṃ mahātiktaṃ paittike 'sṛgdare pibet||
6.30.100 |  hitaṃ garbhaparisrāve yaccokataṃ tacc kārayet|
kāśmaryakuṭajākvāthasiddhamuttarabastinā||
6.30.101 |  raktayonyarajaskānāṃ putraghnyāśca hitaṃ ghṛtam|
*mṛgājāvivarāhāsṛgdadhyamlaphalasarpiṣā||
6.30.102 |  arajaskā pibet siddhaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ payo 'pi vā|
karṇinyacaraṇāśuṣkayoniprākcaraṇāsu ca||
6.30.103 |  kaphavāte ca dātavyaṃ tailamuttarabastinā|
gopitte matsyapitte vā kṣaumaṃ triḥsaptabhāvitam||
6.30.104 |  madhunā kiṇvacūrṇaṃ vā dadyādacaraṇāpaham|
srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ kaṇḍūkledaśophaharaṃ ca tat||
6.30.105 |  vātaghnaiḥ śatapākaiśca tailaiḥ prāgaticāriṇī|
āsthāpyā cānuvāsyā ca svedyā cānilasūdanaiḥ||
6.30.106 |  snehadravyaistathā++āhārairupanāhaiśca yuktitaḥ|
śatāhvāyavagodhūmakiṇvakuṣṭhapriyaṅgubhiḥ||
6.30.107 |  balākhuparṇikāśryāhvaiḥ saṃyāvo dhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ|
vāminyupaplutānāṃ ca snehasvedādikaḥ kramaḥ||
6.30.108 |  kāryastataḥ snehapicustataḥ saṃtarpaṇaṃ bhavet|
śallakījiṅginījambūdhavatvakpañcavalkalaiḥ||
6.30.109 |  kaṣāyaiḥ sādhitaḥ snehapicuḥ syādviplutāpahaḥ|
karṇinyāṃ vartikā kuṣṭhapippalyarkāgrasaindhavaiḥ||
6.30.110 |  bastamūtrakṛtā dhāryā sarvaṃ ca śleṣmanuddhitam|
traivṛtaṃ snehanaṃ svedo grāmyānūpaudakā rasāḥ||
6.30.111 |  daśamūlapayobastiścodāvartānilārtiṣu|
traivṛtenānuvāsyā ca bastiścottarasaṃjñitaḥ||
6.30.112 |  etadeva mahāyonyāṃ srastāyāṃ ca vidhīyate|
*vasā rkṣavarāhāṇāṃ ghṛtaṃ ca mdhuraiḥ śṛtam||
6.30.113 |  *pūrayitvā mahāyoniṃ badhnīyāt kṣaumalaktakaiḥ|
prasrastāṃ sarpiṣā 'bhyajya kṣīrasvinnāṃ praveśya ca||
6.30.114 |  badhnīyādveśavārasya piṇḍenāmūtrakālataḥ|
yacca vātavikārāṇāṃ karmoktaṃ tacca kārayet||
6.30.115 |  sarvavyāpatsu matimānmahāyonyāṃ viśeṣataḥ|
nahi vātādṛte yonirnārīṇāṃ saṃpraduṣyati||
6.30.116 |  śamayitvā tamanyasya kuryāddoṣasya meṣajam|
rohītakānmūlakalkaṃ pāṇḍure 'sṛgdare pibet||
6.30.117 |  jalenāmalakībījaṃ kalkaṃ vā sasitāmadhum|
madhunā++āmalakāccūrṇaṃ rasaṃ vā *lehayecca tām||
6.30.118 |  nyagrodhatvakkaṣāyeṇa lodhrakalkaṃ tatahā pibet|
āsrāve kṣaumapaṭṭaṃ vā bhāvitaṃ tena dhārayet||
6.30.119 |  plakṣatvakcūrṇapiṇḍaṃ vā dhārayenmadhunā kṛtam|
yonyā snehāktayā lodhrapriyaṅgumadhukasya vā||
6.30.120 |  dhāryā madhuyutā vartiḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ|
srāvacchedārthamabhyaktāṃ dhūpayedvā ghṛtāplutaiḥ||
6.30.121 |  saralāgugguluyavaiḥ satailakaṭumatsyakaiḥ|
kāsīsaṃ triphalā kāṃkṣī samaṅgā++āmrāsthi dhātakī||
6.30.122 |  paicchilye kṣaudrasaṃyuktaścūrṇo vaiśadyakārakaḥ|
palāśasarjajambūtvaksamaṅgāmocadhātakīḥ||
6.30.123 |  sapicchilāpariklinnāstambhanaḥ kalka iṣyate|
stabdhānāṃ karkaśānāṃ ca kāryaṃ mārdavakārakam||
6.30.124 |  dhārayedveśavāraṃ vā pāyasaṃ kṛśarāṃ tathā|
durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāttauvaraḥ kalka eva vā||
6.30.125 |  cūrṇaṃ vā sarvagandhānāṃ pūtigandhāpakarṣaṇam|
evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ||
6.30.126 |  aduṣṭe prākṛte bīje jīvopakramaṇe sati|
pañcakarmaviśuddhasya puruṣasyāpi cendriyam||
6.30.127 |  parīkṣya varṇairdoṣāṇāṃ duṣṭaṃ tadghnairupācaret|
bhavanti cātra---
saliṅgā vyāpado yoneḥ sanidānacikitsitāḥ||
6.30.128 |  uktā vistarataḥ samyaṅguninā tattvadarśinā|
punarevāgniveśastu papraccha bhiṣajāṃ varam||
6.30.129 |  ātreyamupasaṅgamya śukradoṣāstvayā 'nagha!|
rogādhyāye samuddiṣṭā hyaṣṭau puṃsāmaśeṣataḥ||
6.30.130 |  teṣāṃ hetuṃ bhiṣakśreṣṭha! duṣṭāduṣṭasya cākṛtim|
cikitsitaṃ ca kārtsnyona klaibyaṃ yacca caturvidham||
6.30.131 |  upadraveṣu yonīnāṃ pradaro yaśca kīrtitaḥ|
teṣāṃ nidānaṃ liṅgaṃ ca cikitsāṃ caiva tattvataḥ||
6.30.132 |  samāsavyāsamedena *prabrūhi bhiṣajāṃvara!|
tasmai śuśrūṣamāṇāya provāca munipuṅgavaḥ||
6.30.133 |  bījaṃ *yasmādvyavāye tu harṣayonisamutthitam|
śukraṃ pauruṣamityuktaṃ tasmādvakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu||
6.30.134 |  yathā bījamakālāmbukṛmikīṭāgnidūṣitam|
na virohati saṃduṣṭaṃ tathā śukraṃ śarīriṇām||
6.30.135 |  ativyavāyadvyāyāmādasātmyānāṃ ca sevanāt|
akāle vā 'pyayonau vā maithunaṃ na ca gacchataḥ||
6.30.136 |  rūkṣatiktakaṣāyātilavaṇāmloṣṇasevanāt|
*nārīṇāmarasajñānāṃ gamanājjarayā tathā||
6.30.137 |  cintāśokādavisrambhācchastrakṣāragnivibhramāt|
*bhayātkrodhādabhīcārādvyādhibhiḥ karśitasya ca||
6.30.138 |  vegāghātāt kṣatāccāpi dhātūnāṃ saṃpradūṣaṇāt|
doṣāḥ pṛthak samastā vā prāpya retovahāḥ sirāḥ||
6.30.139 |  śukraṃ sṃdūṣayantyāśu tadvakṣyāmi vibhāgaśaḥ|
phenilaṃ tanu rūkṣaṃ ca vivarṇaṃ pūti picchilam||
6.30.140 |  anyadhātūpasaṃsṛṣṭamavasādi tathā 'ṣṭamam|
phenilaṃ tanu rūkṣaṃ ca kṛcchreṇālpaṃ ca mārutāt||
6.30.141 |  bhavatyupahataṃ śukraṃ na tadgarbhāya kalpate|
sanīlamathavā pītamatyuṣṇaṃ pūtigandhi ca||
6.30.142 |  dahalliṅgaṃ viniryāti śukraṃ pittena dūṣitam|
śleṣmaṇā baddhamārgaṃ tu bhavatyatyarthapicchilam||
6.30.143 |  strīṇāmatyarthagamanādabhighātāt kṣatādapi|
śukraṃ pravartate jantoḥ prāyeṇa rudhirānvayam||
6.30.144 |  vegasaṃdhāraṇācchukraṃ vāyunā vihataṃ pathi|
kṛcchreṇa yāti grathitamavasādi tathā++āṣṭamam||
6.30.145 |  iti doṣāḥ samākhyātāḥ śukrasyāṣṭau salakṣaṇāḥ|
snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ picchilaṃ ca madhuraṃ cāvidāhi ca||
6.30.146 |  retaḥ śuddhaṃ *vijānīyācchvetaṃ sphaṭikasannibham|
vājīkaraṇayogaistairupayogasukhairhitaiḥ||
6.30.147 |  raktapittaharairyogairyonivyāpadikaistathā|
duṣṭaṃ yadā bhavecchukraṃ tadā tat samupācaret||
6.30.148 |  ghṛtaṃ ca jīvanīyaṃ yaccyavanaprāśa eva ca|
girijasya prayogaśca retodoṣānapohati||
6.30.149 |  vātānvite hitāḥ śukre nirūhāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ|
abhayāmalakīyaṃ ca paitte śastaṃ rasāyanam||
6.30.150 |  māgadhyamṛtalohānāṃ triphalāyā rasāyanam|
kaphotthitaṃ śukradoṣaṃ hanyādbhallātakasya ca||
6.30.151 |  yadanyadhātusaṃsṛṣṭAṃ śukraṃ tadvīkṣya yuktitaḥ|
yathādoṣAṃ prayuñjīta doṣadhātubhiṣagjitam||
6.30.152 |  sarpiḥ payo rasāḥ śāliryavagodhūmaṣaṣṭikāḥ|
praśastāḥ śukradoṣeṣu bastikarma viśeṣataḥ||
6.30.153 |  ityaṣṭaśukradoṣāṇāṃ muninoktaṃ cikitsitam|
retodoṣodbhavaṃ klaibyaṃ yasmācchuddhyaiva sidhyati||
6.30.154 |  tato vakṣyāmi te samyagagniveśa! yathātatham|
bījadhvajopaghātābhyāṃ jarayā śukrasaṃkṣayāt||
6.30.155 |  klaibyaṃ saṃpadyate tasya śṛṇu sāmānyalakṣaṇam|
saṅkalpapravaṇo nityaṃ priyāṃ vaśyāmapi striyam||
6.30.156 |  na yāti liṅgaśaitthilyāt kadācidyāti vā yadi|
śvāsārtaḥ svinnagātraśca moghasaṅkalpaceṣṭitaḥ||
6.30.157 |  mlānaśiśnaśca *nirbījaḥ syādetat klaibyalakṣaṇam|
sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ hyetadvistareṇa pravakṣyate||
6.30.158 |  śītarūkṣālpasaṃkliṣṭa-*viruddhājīrṇabhojanāt|
śokacintābhayatrāsāt strīṇāṃ cātyarthasevanāt||
6.30.159 |  abhicārādavisrambhādrasādīnāṃ ca saṃkṣayāt|
vātādīnāṃ ca vaiṣamyāttathaivānaśanācchramāt||
6.30.160 |  nārīṇāmarasajñatvāt pañcakarmāpacārataḥ|
bījopaghātādbhavati pāṇḍuvarṇaḥ sudurbalaḥ||
6.30.161 |  alpaprāṇo 'lpaharṣaśca pramadāsu bhavennaraḥ|
hṛtpāṇḍurogatamakakāmalāśramapīḍitaḥ||
6.30.162 |  chardyatīsāraśūlārtaḥ kāsajvaranipīḍitaḥ|
vījopaghātajaṃ klaibyaṃ dhvajabhaṅgakṛtaṃ śṛṇu||
6.30.163 |  atyamlalavaṇakṣāraviruddhāsātmyabhojanāt|
atyambupānādviṣamāt piṣṭānnagurubhojanāt||
6.30.164 |  dadhikṣīrānūpamāṃsasevanādhyādhikarṣaṇāt|
kanyānāṃ caiva gamanādayonigamanādapi||
6.30.165 |  *dīrgharogāṃ cirotsṛṣṭāṃ tathaiva ca rajasvalām|
durgandhāṃ duṣṭayoniṃ ca tathaiva ca *parisrutām||
6.30.166 |  īdṛśīṃ pramadāṃ mohādyo gacchet kāmaharṣitaḥ|
catuṣpadābhigamanācchephasaścābhighātataḥ||
6.30.167 |  adhāvanādvā meḍhrasya śastradantamakhakṣatāt|
kāṣṭhaprahāraniṣpeṣācchūkānāṃ cātisevanāt||
6.30.168 |  retasaśca pratīghātāddhvajabhaṅgaḥ pravartate|
(*bhavanti yāni rūpāṇi tasya vakṣyāmyataḥ param|)
śvayathurvedanā meḍhre rāgaścaivopalakṣyate||
6.30.169 |  sphoṭāśca tīvrā jāyante liṅgapāko bhavatyapi|
māṃsavṛddhirbhaveccāsya vraṇāḥ kṣipraṃ bhavantyapi||
6.30.170 |  pulākodakasaṅkāśaḥ srāvaḥ śyāvāruṇaprabhaḥ|
*valayīkurute cāpi kaṭhinaśca parigrahaḥ||
6.30.171 |  jvarastṛṣṇā bhramo mūrcchā cchardiścāsyopajāyate|
raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sraveccāpi nīlamāvilalohitam||
6.30.172 |  agnineva ca dagdhasya tīvro dāhaḥ savedanaḥ|
bastau vṛṣaṇayorvā 'pi sīvanyāṃ vaṅkṣaṇeṣu ca||
6.30.173 |  kadācitpicchilo vā 'pi pāṇḍuḥ srāvaśca jāyate|
śvayathurjāyate mandaḥ stimito 'lpaparisravaḥ||
6.30.174 |  cirācca pākaṃ vrajati śūghraṃ vā 'tha pramucyate|
jāyante krimayaścāpi klidyate pūtigandhi ca||
6.30.175 |  ciśīryate maṇiścāsya meḍhraṃ muṣkāvathāpi ca|
dhvajabhaṅgakṛtaṃ klaibyamityetat samudāhṛtam||
6.30.176 |  *etaṃ pañcavidhaṃ deciddhvajabhaṅgaṃ pracakṣate|
klaibyaṃ jarāsaṃbhavaṃ hi pravakṣyāmyatha tacchṛṇu||
6.30.177 |  jaghanyamadhyapravaraṃ vayastrividhamucyate|
atipravayasāṃ śukraṃ prāyaśaḥ kṣīyate nṛṇām||
6.30.178 |  rasādīnāṃ saṃkṣayācca tathaivāvṛṣyasevanāt|
balavīryendiryāṇāṃ ca krameṇaiva parikṣayāt||
6.30.179 |  parikṣayādāyuṣaścāpyanāhārācchramāt klamāt|
jarāsaṃbhavajaṃ klaibyamityetairhetubhirnṛṇām||
6.30.180 |  jāyate tena so 'tyarhtaṃ kṣīṇadhātuḥ sudurbalaḥ|
vivarṇo durbalo dīnaḥ kṣipraṃ vyādhimathāśnute||
6.30.181 |  etajjarāsaṃbhavaṃ hi caturthaṃ kṣayajaṃ śṛṇu|
atīva cintanāccaiva śokātkrodhādbhayāttathā||
6.30.182 |  *īrṣyotkaṇṭhāmadodvegān sadā viśati yo naraḥ|
kṛśo vā sevate rūkṣamannapānaṃ tathauṣadham||
6.30.183 |  durbalaprakṛtiścaiva nirāhāro bhavedyadi|
*asātmyabhojanāccāpi hṛdaye yo vyavasthitaḥ||
6.30.184 |  rasaḥ pradhānadhāturhi kṣīyetāśu tato mṛṇām|
raktādayaśca kṣīyante dhātavastasya dehinaḥ||
6.30.185 |  śukrāvasānāstebhyo 'pi śukraṃ dhāma paraṃ matam|
cetaso vā 'tiharṣeṇa vyavāyaṃ sevate 'ti yaḥ||
6.30.186 |  tasyāśu kṣīyate śukraṃ tataḥ prāpnoti saṃkṣayam|
ghoraṃ vyādhimavāpnoti maraṇaṃ vā sa gacchati||
6.30.187 |  śukraṃ tasmādviśeṣeṇa rakṣyamārogyamicchatā|
evaṃ nidānaliṅgābhyāmuktaṃ klaibyaṃ caturvidham||
6.30.188 |  kecit klaibye tvasādhye dve dhvajabhaṅgakṣayodbhave|
vadanti śephasaśchedādvṛṣaṇotpāṭanena ca||
6.30.189 |  mātāpitrorbījadoṣādaśubhaiścākṛtātmanaḥ|
garbhasthasya yadā doṣāḥ prāpya retovahāḥ sirāḥ||
6.30.190 |  śoṣayantyāśu tannāśādretaścāpyupahanyate|
tatra saṃpūrṇasarvāṅgaḥ sa bhavatyapumān pumān||
6.30.191 |  ete tvasādhyā vyākhyātāḥ sannipātasamucchrayāt|
cikitsitamatastūrdhvaṃ samāsavyāsataḥ śṛṇu||
6.30.192 |  śukradoṣeṣu nirdiṣṭaṃ bheṣajaṃ yanmayā 'nagha!|
klaibyopaśāntaye kuryāt kṣīṇakṣatahitaṃ ca yat||
6.30.193 |  bastayaḥ kṣīrasarpīṃṣi vṛṣyayogāśca ye matāḥ|
rasāyanaprayogāśca sarvānetān prayojayet||
6.30.194 |  samīkṣya dehadoṣāgnibalaṃ bheṣajakālavit|
vyavāyahetuje klaibye tathā *dhātuviparyayāt||
6.30.195 |  daivavyapāśrayaṃ caiva bheṣajaṃ *cābhicāraje|
samāsenaitaduddiṣṭaṃ bheṣajaṃ klaibyaśāntaye||
6.30.196 |  vistareṇa pravakṣyāmi klaibyānāṃ bheṣajaṃ punaḥ|
susvinnasnigdhagātrasya snehayuktaṃ virecanam||
6.30.197 |  annāśanaṃ tataḥ kuryādathavā++āsthāpanaṃ punaḥ|
pradadyānmatimān vaidyastatastamanuvāsayet||
6.30.198 |  palāśairaṇḍamustādyaiḥ paścādāsthāpayettataḥ|
vājīkaraṇayogāśca pūrvaṃ ye samudāhṛtāḥ||
6.30.199 |  bhiṣajā te prayojyāḥ syuḥ klaibye bījopaghātaje|
dhvajabhaṅgakṛtaṃ klaibyaṃ jñātvā tasyācaret kriyām||
6.30.200 |  pradehān pariṣekāṃśca kuryādvā raktamokṣaṇam|
snehapānaṃ ca kurvīta sasnehaṃ ca virecanam||
6.30.201 |  *anuvāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādathavā++āsthāpanaṃ punaḥ|
vraṇavacca kriyāḥ sarvāstatra kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ||
6.30.202 |  jarāsaṃbhavaje klaibye kṣayaje caiva kārayet|
snehasvedopapannasya sasnehaṃ śodhanaṃ hitam||
6.30.203 |  kṣīrasarpirvṛṣyayogā bastayaścaiva yāpanāḥ|
rasāyanaprayogāśca tayorbheṣajamucyate||
6.30.204 |  vistareṇaitaduddiṣṭaṃ klaibyānāṃ bheṣajaṃ mayā|
yaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ pradaraḥ śṛṇu hetvādibhistu tam||
6.30.205 |  yā 'tyarthaṃ sevate nārī lavaṇāmlagurūṇi ca|
kaṭūnyatha vidāhīni snigdhāni piśitāni ca||
6.30.206 |  grāmyaudakāni medyāni kṛśarāṃ pāyasaṃ *dadhi|
śukramastusurādīni bhajantyāḥ kupito 'nilaḥ||
6.30.207 |  *raktaṃ pramāṇamutkramya garbhāśayagatāḥ sirāḥ|
rajovahāḥ samāśritya raktamādāya tadrajaḥ||
6.30.208 |  yasmādvivardhayatyāśu *rasabhāvādvimānatā|
tasmādasṛgdaraṃ prāhuretattantraviśāradāḥ||
6.30.209 |  rajaḥ pradīryate yasmāt pradarastena sa smṛtaḥ|
sāmānyataḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ liṅgameva ca||
6.30.210 |  caturvidhaṃ vyāsatastu vātādyaiḥ sannipātataḥ|
ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi hetvākṛtibhiṣagjitam||
6.30.211 |  rūkṣādibhirmārutastu raktamādāya pūrvavat|
kupitaḥ pradaraṃ kuryāllakṣaṇaṃ tasya me śṛṇu||
6.30.212 |  phenilaṃ tanu rūkṣaṃ ca śyāvaṃ cāruṇameva ca|
kiṃśukodakasaṅkāśaṃ sarujaṃ vā 'tha nīrujam||
6.30.213 |  kaṭivaṅkṣaṇahṛtpārśvapṛṣṭhaśroṇiṣu mārutaḥ|
kurute vedanāṃ tīvrāmetadvātātmakaṃ viduḥ||
6.30.214 |  amloṣṇalavaṇakṣāraiḥ pittaṃ prakupitaṃ yadā|
pūrvavat pradaraṃ kuryāt paittikaṃ liṅgataḥ śṛṇu||
6.30.215 |  sanīlamathavā pītamatyuṣṇamasitaṃ tathā|
nitāntaraktaṃ sravati muhurmuhurathārtimat||
6.30.216 |  dāharāgatṛṣāmohajvarabhramasamāyutam|
asṛgdaraṃ paittikaṃ syācchlaibmikaṃ tu pravakṣyate||
6.30.217 |  gurvādibhirhetubhiśca pūrvavat kupitaḥ kaphaḥ|
pradaraṃ kurute tasya lakṣaṇaṃ tattvataḥ śṛṇu||
6.30.218 |  picchilaṃ pāṇḍuvarṇaṃ caguru snigdhaṃ ca śītalam|
sravatyasṛk śleṣmalaṃ ca ghanaṃ mandarujākaram||
6.30.219 |  chardyarocakahṛllāsaśvāsakāsasamanvitam|
(*vakṣyate kṣīradoṣāṇāṃ sāmānyamiha kāraṇam||
6.30.220 |  yattadeva tridoṣasya kāraṇaṃ pradarasya tu|)
triliṅgasaṃyutaṃ vidyānnaikāvasthamasṛgdaram||
6.30.221 |  nārī tvatiparikliṣṭā yadā prakṣīṇaśoṇitā|
sarvahetusamācārādativṛddhastadā 'nilaḥ||
6.30.222 |  raktamārgeṇa sṛjati *pratyanīkabalaṃ kapham|
durgandhaṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ vidagdhaṃ pittatejasā||
6.30.223 |  vasāṃ medaśca yāvaddhi samupādāya vegavān|
sṛjatyapatyamārgeṇa sarpirmajjavasopamam||
6.30.224 |  śaśvat sravatyathāsrāvaṃ tṛṣṇādāhajvarānvitām|
kṣīṇaraktāṃ durbalāṃ sa tāmasādhyāṃ vivarjayet||
6.30.225 |  māsānniṣpicchadāhārti pañcarātrānubandhi ca|
naivātibahu nātyalpamārtavaṃ śuddhamādiśet||
6.30.226 |  guñjāphalasavarṇaṃ ca *padmālaktakasannibham|
indragopakasaṅkāśamārtavaṃ śuddhamādiśet||
6.30.227 |  yonīnāṃ vātalādyānāṃ yaduktamiha bheṣajam|
caturṇāṃ pradarāṇāṃ ca tat sarvaṃ kārayedbhiṣak||
6.30.228 |  raktatisāriṇāṃ yacca tathā śoṇitapittinām|
raktārśasāṃ ca yat proktaṃ bheṣajaṃ tacca kārayet||
6.30.229 |  dhātrīstanastanyasaṃpaduktā vistarataḥ purā|
stanyasaṃjananaṃ caiva stanyasya ca viśodhanam||
6.30.230 |  vātādiduṣṭe liṅgaṃ ca kṣīṇasya ca cikitsitam|
tatsarvamuktaṃ ye tvaṣṭau kṣīradoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||
6.30.231 |  vātādiṣveva tān vidyācchāstracakṣurbhiṣaktamaḥ|
trividhāstu yataḥ śiṣyāstato vakṣyāmi vistaram||
6.30.232 |  ajīrṇāsātmyaviṣamaviruddhātyarthabhojanāt|
lavaṇāmlakaṭukṣārapraklinnānāṃ ca sevanāt||
6.30.233 |  manaḥśarīrasaṃtāpādasvapnānniśi cintanāt|
prāptavegapratīghātādaprāptodīraṇena ca||
6.30.234 |  paramānnaṃ guḍakṛtaṃ kṛśarāṃ dadhi *mandakam|
abhiṣyandīni māṃsāni grāmyānūpaudakāni ca||
6.30.235 |  bhuktvā bhuktvā divāsvapnānmadyasyātiniṣevaṇāt|
*anāyāsādabhīghātāt krodhāccātaṅkakarśanaiḥ||
6.30.236 |  doṣāḥ kṣīravahāḥ prāpya sirāḥ stanyaṃ pradūṣya ca|
kuryuraṣṭavidhaṃ bhūyo doṣatastannibodha me||
6.30.237 |  vairasyaṃ phenasaṅghāto raukṣyaṃ cetyanilātmake|
pittādvaivarṇyadaurgandhye snehapaicchilyagauravam||
6.30.238 |  kaphādbhavati rūkṣādyairanilaḥ svaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ|
kruddhaḥ kṣīrāśayaṃ prāpya rasaṃ *stanyasya dūṣayet||
6.30.239 |  virasaṃ vātasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṛśībhavati tat piban|
na *cāsya svadate kṣīraṃ kṛcchreṇa ca vivardhate||
6.30.240 |  tathaiva vāyuḥ kupitaḥ stanyamantarviloḍayan|
karoti phenasaṅghātaṃ *tattu kṛcchrāt pravartate||
6.30.241 |  tena kṣāmasvaro bālo baddhaviṇmūtramārutaḥ|
vātikaṃ śīrṣarogaṃ vā pīnasaṃ vā 'dhigacchati||
6.30.242 |  pūrvavat kupitaḥ stanye snehaṃ śoṣayate 'nilaḥ|
rūkṣaṃ tat pibato raukṣyādbalahrāsaḥ prajāyate||
6.30.243 |  pittamuṣṇādibhiḥ kruddhaṃ stanyāśayamabhiplutam|
karoti stanyavaivarṇyaṃ nīlapītāsitādikam||
6.30.244 |  vivarṇagātraḥ svinnaḥ syāttṛṣṇālurbhinnaviṭ śiśuḥ|
nityamuṣṇaśarīraśca nābhinandati taṃ stanam||
6.30.245 |  pūrvavat kupite pitte daurgandhyaṃ kṣīramṛcchati|
pāṇḍvāmayastatpibataḥ kāmalā ca bhavecchiśoḥ||
6.30.246 |  kruddho gurvādibhiḥ śleṣmā kṣīrāśayagataḥ striyāḥ|
snehānvitatvāttatkṣīramatisnigdhaṃ karoti tu||
6.30.247 |  chardanaḥ kunthanastena lālālurjāyate śiśuḥ|
nityopadigdhaiḥ *srotobhirnidrāklamasamanvitaḥ||
6.30.248 |  śvāsakāsaparītastu prasekatamakānvitaḥ|
abhibhūya kaphaḥ stanyaṃ picchilaṃ kurute yadā||
6.30.249 |  lālāluḥ śūnavaktrākṣirjaḍaḥ syāttat pibañchiśuḥ|
kaphaḥ kṣīrāśayagato gurutvāt kṣīragauravam||
6.30.250 |  *karoti guru tat pītvā bālo hṛdrogamṛcchati|
anyāṃśca vividhānrogānkuryātkṣīrasamāśritān||
6.30.251 |  kṣīre vātādibhirduṣṭe saṃbhavanti tadātmakāḥ|
tatrādau stanyaśuddhyarthaṃ dhātrīṃ snehopapāditām||
6.30.252 |  saṃsvedya vidhivadvaidyo vamanenopapādayet|
vacāpriyaṅguyaṣṭyāhvaphalavatsakasarṣapaiḥ||
6.30.253 |  kalkairnimbapaṭolānāṃ kvāthaiḥ salavaṇairvamet|
samyagvāntāṃ yathānyāyaṃ kṛtasaṃsarjanāṃ tataḥ||
6.30.254 |  doṣakālabalāpekṣī snehayitvā virecayet|
trivṛtāmabhayāṃ vā 'pi triphalārasasaṃyutām||
6.30.255 |  pāyayenmadhusaṃyuktāmabhayāṃ vā 'pi kevalām|
(*pāyayenmūtrasaṃyuktāṃ virekārthaṃ ca śāstravit||)
6.30.256 |  samyagviriktāṃ matimān kṛtasaṃsarjanāṃ punaḥ|
tato *doṣāvaśeṣaghnairannapānairupācaret||
6.30.257 |  śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikā vā syuḥ śyāmākā bhojane hitāḥ|
priyaṅgavaḥ koradūṣā yavā veṇuyavāstathā||
6.30.258 |  vaṃśavetrakalāyāśca *śākārthe snehasaṃskṛtāḥ|
mudgān masūrān yūṣārthe kulatthāṃśca prakalpayet||
6.30.259 |  nimbavetrāgrakulakavārtākāmalakaiḥ śṛtān|
savyoṣasaindhavān yūṣāndāpayetstanyaśodhanān||
6.30.260 |  śaśān kapiñjilāneṇān saṃskṛtāṃśca pradāpayet|
śārṅgeṣṭāsaptaparṇatvagaśvagandhāśṛtaṃ jalam||
6.30.261 |  pāyayetāthavā stanyaśuddhaye rohiṇīśṛtam|
amṛtāsaptaparṇatvakkvāthaṃ caiva sanāgaram||
6.30.262 |  kirātatiktakakvāthaṃ ślokapāderitān pibet|
trīnetānstanyaśuddhyarthamiti sāmānyabheṣajam||
6.30.263 |  kīrtitaṃ stanyadoṣāṇāṃ pṛthaganyaṃ nibodhata|
pāyayedvirasakṣīrāṃ drākṣāmadhukasārivāḥ||
6.30.264 |  ślakṣṇapiṣṭāṃ payasyāṃ ca samāloḍya sukhāmbunā|
pañcakolakulatthaiśca piṣṭairālepayet stanau||
6.30.265 |  śuṣkau prakṣālya nirduhyāttathā stanyaṃ viśudhyati|
phenasaṅghātavatkṣīraṃ yasyāstāṃ pāyayet striyam||
6.30.266 |  *pāṭhānāgaraśārṅgeṣṭāmūrvāḥ piṣṭvā sukhāmbunā|
añjanaṃ *nāgaraṃ dāru bilvamūlaṃ priyaṅgavaḥ||
6.30.267 |  stanayoḥ pūrvavat kāryaṃ lepanaṃ kṣīraśodhanam|
kirātatiktakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ sāmṛtāṃ kvāthayedbhiṣak||
6.30.268 |  taṃ kvāthaṃ pāyayeddhātrīṃ stanyadoṣanibarhaṇam|
stanau cālepayet piṣṭairyavagodhūmasarṣapaiḥ||
6.30.269 |  ṣaḍvirekāśritīyoktairauṣadhaiḥ stanyaśodhanaiḥ|
*rūkṣakṣīrā pibet kṣīraṃ tairvā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet||
6.30.270 |  pūrvavajjīvakādyaṃ ca pañcamūlaṃ pralepanam|
stanayoḥ saṃvidhātavyaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ stanyaśodhanam||
6.30.271 |  yaṣṭīmadhukamṛdvīkāpayasyāsindhuvārikāḥ|
śītāmbunā pibetkalkaṃ kṣīravaivarṇyanāśanam||
6.30.272 |  drākṣāmadhukakalkena stanau cāsyāḥ pralepayet|
prakṣālya vāriṇā caiva *nirduhyāttau punaḥ punaḥ||
6.30.273 |  viṣāṇikājaśṛṅgyau ca triphalāṃ rajanīṃ vacām|
pibecchītāmbunā piṣṭvā kṣīradaurgandhyanāśinīm||
6.30.274 |  lihyādvā 'pyabhayācūrṇaṃ savyoṣaṃ mākṣikaplutam|
kṣīradaurgandhyanāśārthaṃ dhātrī pathyāśinī tathā||
6.30.275 |  sārivośīramañjiṣṭhāśleṣmātakakucandanaiḥ|
*patrāmbucandanośīraiḥ stanau cāsyāḥ pralepayet||
6.30.276 |  *snigdhakṣīrā dārumustapāṭhāḥ piṣṭvā sukhāmbunā|
pītvā sasaindhavāḥ kṣipraṃ kṣīraśuddhimavāpnuyāt||
6.30.277 |  pāyayet picchilakṣīrāṃ śārṅgeṣṭāmabhayāṃ vacām|
mustanāgarapāṭhāśca pītāḥ stanyaviśodhanāḥ||
6.30.278 |  takrāriṣṭaṃ pibeccāpi yaduktaṃ gudajāpaham|
vidārībilvamadhukaiḥ stanau cāsyāḥ pralepayet||
6.30.279 |  trāyamāṇāmṛtānimbapaṭolatriphalāśṛtam|
gurukṣīrā pibedāśu stanyadoṣaviśuddhaye||
6.30.280 |  pibedvā pippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaram|
balānāgaraśārṅgeṣṭāmūrvābhirlepayet stanau||
6.30.281 |  pṛśniparṇī payasyābhyāṃ stanau cāsyāḥ pralepayet|
aṣṭāvete kṣīradoṣā hetulakṣaṇabheṣajaiḥ||
6.30.282 |  nirdiṣṭāḥ kṣīradoṣotthāstathoktāḥ kecidāmayāḥ|
doṣadūṣyamalāścaiva mahatāṃ vyādhayaśca ye||
6.30.283 |  ta eva *sarve bālānāṃ mātrā tvalpatarā matā|
nivṛttirvamanādīnāṃ mṛdutvaṃ paratantratām||
6.30.284 |  vākceṣṭayorasāmarthyaṃ vīkṣya bāleṣu śāstravit|
bheṣajaṃ svalpamātraṃ tu yathāvyādhi prayojayet||
6.30.285 |  madhurāṇi kaṣāyāṇi kṣīravanti mṛdūni ca|
prayojayedbhiṣagbāle matimānapramādataḥ||
6.30.286 |  atyarhtasnigdharūkṣoṣṇamamlaṃ kaṭuvipāki ca|
guru cauṣadhapānānnametadbāleṣu garhitam||
6.30.287 |  samāsāt sarvarogāṇāmetadbāleṣu bheṣajam|
nirdiṣṭaṃ śāstravidvaidyaḥ *pravivicya prayojayet||
6.30.288 |  bhavanti cātra---
iti sarvavikārāṇāmuktametaccikitsitam|
sthānametaddhi tantrasya rahasyaṃ *paramuttamam||
6.30.289 |  asmin saptadaśādhyāyāḥ kalpāḥ siddhaya eva ca|
nāsādyante 'gniveśasya tantre carakasaṃskṛte||
6.30.290 |  tānetān kāpilabaliḥ śeṣān dṛḍhabalo 'karot|
tantrasyāsya mahārthasya pūraṇārthaṃ yathātatham||
6.30.291 |  rogā ye 'pyatra noddiṣṭā bahutvānnāmarūpataḥ|
teṣāmapyetadeva syāddoṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam||
6.30.292 |  doṣadūṣyanidānānāṃ viparītaṃ hitaṃ dhruvam|
uktānuktān gadān sarvān samyagyuktaṃ niyacchati||
6.30.293 |  deśakālapramāṇānāṃ sātmyāsātmyasya caiva hi|
samyagyogo 'nyathā hyeṣāṃ pathyamapyanyathā bhavet||
6.30.294 |  āsyādāmāśayasthān hi rogān nastaḥśirogatān|
gudāt pakvāśayasthāṃśca *hantyāśu dattamauṣadham||
6.30.295 |  śarīrāvayavottheṣu visarpapiḍakādiṣu|
*yathādeśaṃ pradehādi śamanaṃ syādviśeṣataḥ||
6.30.296 |  *dināturauṣadhavyādhijīrṇaliṅgartvavekṣaṇam|
kālaṃ vidyāddināvekṣaḥ pūrvāhṇe vanamaṃ yathā||
6.30.297 |  rogyavekṣo yathā prātarviranno balavān pibet|
bheṣajaṃ laghupathyānnairyuktamadyāttu durbalaḥ||
6.30.298 |  bhaiṣajyakālo bhuktādau madhye paścānmuhurmuhuḥ|
sāmudgaṃ bhaktasaṃyuktaṃ grāsagrāsāntare daśa||
6.30.299 |  apāne viguṇe pūrvaṃ, samāne madhyambhojanam|
*vyāne tu prātaraśitamudāne bhojanottaram||
6.30.300 |  vāyau prāṇe praduṣṭe tu grāsagrāsāntariṣyate|
śvāsakāsapipāsāsu tvavacāryaṃ muhurmuhuḥ||
6.30.301 |  sāmudgaṃ hikkine deyaṃ laghunā 'nnena saṃyutam|
saṃbhojyaṃ tvauṣadhaṃ bhojyairvicitrairarucau hitam||
6.30.302 |  jvare peyāḥ kaṣāyāśca kṣīraṃ sarpirvirecanam|
ṣaḍahe ṣAḍahe deyaṃ kālaṃ vīkṣyāmayasya ca||
6.30.303 |  kṣudvegamokṣau laghutā viśuddhirjīrṇalakṣaṇam|
tadā bheṣajamādeyaṃ syāddhi doṣavadanyathā||
6.30.304 |  cayādayaśca doṣāṇāṃ varjyaṃ sevyaṃ ca yatra yat|
rtāvavekṣyaṃ yat karma pūrvaṃ sarvamudāhṛtam||
(*6.30.305 |  upakramāṇāṃ karaṇaṃ pratiṣedhe ca kāraṇam|
vyākhyātamabalānāṃ savikalpānāmavekṣaṇe||
6.30.306 |  muhurmuhuśca rogāṇāmavasthāmāturasya ca|
avekṣamāṇastu bhiṣak cikitsāyāṃ na muhyati||)
6.30.307 |  ityevaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ kālamanavekṣya bhiṣagjitam|
prayuktamahitāya syāt sasyasyākālavarṣavat||
6.30.308 |  vyādhīnāmṛtvahorātravayasāṃ bhojanasya ca|
viśeṣo bhidyate yastu kālāvekṣaḥ sa ucyate||
6.30.309 |  vasante śleṣmajā rogāḥ śaratkāle tu pittajāḥ|
varṣāsu vātikāścaiva prāyaḥ prādurbhavanti hi||
