6.30.310 |  niśānte divasānte ca varṣānte vātajā gadāḥ|
prātaḥ kṣapādau kaphajāstayormadhye tu pittajāḥ||
6.30.311 |  vayontamadhyaprathame vātapittakaphāmayāḥ|
balavanto bhavantyeva svabhāvādvayaso nṛṇām||
6.30.312 |  jīrṇānte vātajā rogā jīryamāṇe tu pittajāḥ|
śleṣmajā bhuktamātre tu labhante prāyaśo balam||
6.30.313 |  nālpaṃ hantyauṣadhaṃ vyādhiṃ yathā++āpo 'lpā mahānalam|
doṣavaccātimātraṃ syātsasyasyātyudakaṃ yathā||
6.30.314 |  saṃpradhārya balaṃ tasmādāmayasyauṣadhasya ca|
naivātibahu nātyalpaṃ bhaiṣajyamavacārayet||
6.30.315 |  aucityādyasya yat sātmyaṃ deśasya puruṣasya ca|
apathyamapi naikāntāttattyajaṃllabhate sukham||
6.30.316 |  vāhlīkāḥ pahlavāścīnāḥ śūlīkā yavanāḥ śakāḥ|
māṃsagodhūmamādhvīkaśastravaiśvānarocitāḥ||
6.30.317 |  *matsyasātmyāstathā prācyāḥ kṣīrasātmyāśca saindhavāḥ|
*aśmakāvantikānāṃ tu tailāmlaṃ sātmyamucyate||
6.30.318 |  *kandamūlaphalaṃ sātmyaṃ vidyānmalayavāsinām|
sātmyaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ peyā *manthaścottarapaścime||
6.30.319 |  madhyadeśe bhavet sātmyaṃ yavagodhūmagorasāḥ|
teṣāṃ tatsātmyayuktāni bhaiṣajānyavacārayet||
6.30.320 |  sātmyaṃ hyāśu balaṃ dhatte nātidoṣaṃ ca bahvapi|
yogaireva cikitsan hi deśādyajño 'parādhyati||
6.30.321 |  vayobalaśarīrādibhedā hi bahavo *matāḥ|
tathā 'ntaḥsandhimārgāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ gūḍhacāriṇām||
6.30.322 |  bhavet kadācit kāryā 'pi viruddhābhimatā kriyā|
pittamantargataṃ *gūḍhaṃ svedasekopanāhanaiḥ||
6.30.323 |  nīyate bahiruṣṇairhi tathoṣṇaṃ śamayanti te|
bāhyaiśca śītaiḥ sekādyairūṣmā 'ntaryāti pīḍitaḥ||
6.30.324 |  so 'ntargūḍhaṃ kaphaṃ hanti śītaṃ śītaistathā jayet|
ślakṣṇapiṣṭo ghano lepaścandanasyāpi dāhakṛt||
6.30.325 |  tvaggatasyoṣmaṇo rodhācchītakṛccānyathā 'guroḥ|
chardighnī makṣikāviṣṭhā makṣikaiva tu vāmayet||
6.30.326 |  dravyeṣu svinnajagdheṣu caiva teṣveva vikriyā|
tasmāddoṣauṣadhādīni parīkṣya daśa tattvataḥ||
6.30.327 |  kuryāccikitsitaṃ prājño na yogaireva kevalam|
nivṛtto 'pi punarvyādhiḥ svalpenāyāti hetunā||
6.30.328 |  kṣīṇe mārgīkṛte dehe śeṣaḥ sūkṣma ivānalaḥ|
tasmāttamanubadhnīyāt prayogeṇānapāyinā||
6.30.329 |  siddhyarthaṃ prākprayuktasya siddhasyāpyauṣadhasya tu|
kāṭhinyādūnabhāvādvā doṣo 'ntaḥ kupito mahān||
6.30.330 |  pathyairmṛdvalpatāṃ nīto mṛdudoṣakaro bhavet|
pathyamapyaśnatastasmādyo vyādhirupajāyate||
6.30.331 |  jñātvaivaṃ vṛddhimabhyāsamathavā tasya kārayet|
sātatyātsvādvabhāvādvā pathyaṃ dveṣyatvamāgatam||
6.30.332 |  kalpanāvidhibhistaistaiḥ priyatvaṃ gamayet punaḥ|
manaso 'rthānukūlyāddhi tuṣṭirūrjā rucirbalam||
6.30.333 |  sukhopabhogatā ca syādvyādheścāto balakṣayaḥ|
laulyāddoṣakṣayādvyādhervaidharmyāccāpi yā ruciḥ||
6.30.334 |  tāsu pathyopacāraḥ syādyogenādyaṃ vikalpayet|
tatra ślokāḥ---
viṃśatirvyāpado yonernidānaṃ liṅgameva ca||
6.30.335 |  cikitsā cāpi nirdiṣṭā śiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā|
śukradoṣāstathā cāṣṭau nidānākṛtibheṣajaiḥ||
6.30.336 |  klaibyānyuktāni catvāri catvāraḥ pradarāstathā|
teṣāṃ nidānaṃ liṅgaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ caiva kīrtitam||
6.30.337 |  kṣīradoṣāstathā cāṣṭau hetuliṅgabhiṣagjitaiḥ|
retaso rajasaścaiva kīrtitaṃ śuddhilakṣaṇam||
6.30.338 |  uktānuktacikitsā ca samyagyogastathaiva ca|
*deśādiguṇaśaṃsā ca kālaḥ ṣaḍvidha eva ca||
6.30.339 |  deśe deśe ca yat sātmyaṃ yathā vaidyo 'parādhyati|
cikitsā cāpi nirdiṣṭā doṣāṇāṃ gūḍhacāriṇām||
6.30.340 |  yo hi samyaṅna jānāti śāstraṃ śāstrārthameva ca|
na kuryāt sa kriyāṃ citramacakṣuriva citrakṛt||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite cikitsāsthāne yonivyāpaccikitsitaṃ nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||30 | |

6.30.341 |  agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte|
cikitsitamidaṃ sthānaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ parisamāpitam||


Kalpasthānam|

prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.1.1 |  athāto madanakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.1.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.1.3 |  atha khalu *vamanavirecanārhtaṃ vamanavirecanadravyāṇāṃ sukhopabhogatamaiḥ sahānyairdravyairvividhaiḥ kalpanārthaṃ - bhedārthaṃ vibhāgārthaṃ *cetyarthaḥ, tadyogānāṃ ca kriyāvidheḥ sukhopāyasya samyagupakalpanārthaṃ kalpasthānamupadekṣyāmo 'gniveśa!||
7.1.4 |  tatra doṣaharaṇamūrdhvabhāgaṃ vamanasaṃjñakam, adhobhāgaṃ virecanasaṃjñakam; ubhayaṃ vā śarīramalavirecanādvirecanasaṃjñāṃ labhate||
7.1.5 |  tatroṣṇa-tīkṣṇa-sūkṣma-vyavāyi-vikāśīnyauṣadhāni svavīryeṇa hṛdayamupetya dhamanīranusṛtya sthūlāṇusrotobhyaḥ kevalaṃ śarīragataṃ doṣasaṃghātamāgneyatvād viṣyandayanti, taikṣṇyād vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaḥ *pariplavan snehabhāvite kāye snehāktabhājanasthamiva kṣaudramasajjannaṇupravaṇabhāvādāmāśayamāgamyodānapraṇunno 'gnivāyvātmakatvādūrdhvabhāgaprabhāvādauṣadhasyordhvamutkṣipyate, salilapṛthivyātmakatvādadhobhāgaprabhāvāccauṣadhasyādhaḥ pravartate, ubhayataścobhayaguṇatvāt|
iti lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ||
7.1.6 |  tatra phala-jīmūtakekṣvāku-dhāmārgava-kuṭaja-kṛtavedhanānāṃ, śyāmā-trivṛccaturaṅgula-tilvaka-mahāvṛkṣa-saptalā-śāṅkhinī-dantī-dravantīnāṃ ca, nānāvidhadeśakālasaṃbhavāsvāda-rasa-vīrya-vipāka-*prabhāvagrahaṇād deha-doṣa-prakṛti-vayo-balāgni-bhakti-sātmya-rogāvasthādīnāṃ *nānāprabhāvavattvācca, vicitragandha-varṇa-rasa-*sparśānāmupayogasukhārthamasaṃkhyeyasaṃyogānāmapi ca satāṃ dravyāṇāṃ vikalpamārgopadarśanārthaṃ ṣaḍvirecanayogaśatāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.1.7 |  tāni tu dravyāṇi deśa-kāla-guṇa-bhājana-saṃpadvīryabalādhānāt kriyāsamarthatamāni bhavanti||
7.1.8 |  trividhaḥ khalu deśaḥ-jāṅgalaḥ, ānūpaḥ, sādhāraṇaśceti|
tatra jāṅgalaḥ paryākāśabhūyiṣṭhaḥ, tarubhirapica kadara-khadirāsanāśvakarṇa-dhava-tiniśa-śallakīsāla-somavalka-badarī-tindukāśvattha-vaṭāmalakīva-nagahanaḥ, anekaśamī-kakubha-śiṃśapāprāyaḥ, sthiraśuṣkapavanabalavidhūyamānapravṛtyattaruṇaviṭapaḥ, pratatamṛgatṛṣṇikopagūḍhatanukharaparuṣasikatāśarkarābahulaḥ, lāvatittiricakorānucaritabhūmibhāgaḥ, vātapittabahulaḥ, sthirakaṭhinamanuṣyaprāyo jñeyaḥ; athānūpo hintālatamālanārikelakadalīvanagahanaḥ, saritsamudraparyantaprāyaḥ, śiśirapavanabahulaḥ, vañjulavānīropaṇobhitatīrābhiḥ saridbhirupagatabhūmibhāgaḥ, kṣitidharanikuñjopaśobhitaḥ, mandapavanānuvījitakṣitiruhagahanaḥ, anekavanarājīpuṣpitavanagahanabhūmibhāgaḥ, snigdhatarupratānopagūḍhaḥ, haṃsa-cakravāka-balākā-nandīmukha-puṇḍarīka-kādamba-*madgu-bhṛṅgarāja-śatapatra-mattakokilānunāditataruviṭapaḥ, sukumārapuruṣaḥ, pavanakaphaprāyo jñeyaḥ; anayoreva dvayordeśayorvīrudvanaspativānaspatyaśakunimṛgagaṇayutaḥ sthirasukumārabalavarṇasaṃhananopapannasādhāraṇaguṇayuktapuruṣaḥ sādhāraṇo jñeyaḥ||
7.1.9 |  tatra deśe sādhāraṇe jāṅgale vā yathākālaṃ śiśirātapapavanasalilasevite same śucau pradakṣiṇodake śmaśāna-caitya-devayajanāgāra-sabhā-śvabhrārāma-valmīkoṣaravirahite kuśarohiṣāstīrṇe snigdhakṛṣṇamadhuramṛttike suvarṇavarṇamadhuramṛttike vā mṛdāvaphālakṛṣṭe 'nupahate 'nyairbalavattarairdrumairauṣadhāni jātāni praśasyante||
7.1.10 |  tatra yāni *kālajātānyupāgatasaṃpūrṇapramāṇa-rasavīrya-gandhāni kālātapāgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varṇa-rasa-sparśa-prabhāvāṇi pratyagrāṇyudīcyāṃ diśi sthitāni; teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśamaciraprarūḍhaṃ varṣāvasantayorgrāhyaṃ, grīṣme mūlāni śiśire vā śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānāṃ, śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi, hemante sārāṇi, yathartu puṣpaphalamiti; maṅgalācāraḥ kalyāṇavṛttaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ saṃpūjya devatā aśvinau gobrāhmaṇāṃśca kṛtopavāsaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā gṛhṇīyāt||
7.1.11 |  gṛhītvā *cānurūpaguṇavadbhājanasthānyāgāreṣu prāgudagdvāreṣu nivātapravātaikadeśeṣu nityapuṣpopahārabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhūma-rajo-mūṣaka-catuṣpadāmanabhigamanīyāni svavacchannāni śikyeṣvāsajya sthāpayet||
7.1.12 |  tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjīta surā-sauvīraka-tuṣodaka-maireya-medaka-*dhānyāmla-phalāmla-dadhyamlādibhirvāte, *mṛdvīkāmalaka-madhu-madhuka-parūṣaka-phāṇita-kṣīrādibhiḥ pitte, śleṣmaṇi tu madhu-mūtra-kaṣāyādibhirbhāvitānyāloḍitāni ca; ityuddeśaḥ|
taṃ vistareṇa dravya-deha-doṣa-*sātmyādīni pravibhajya vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.1.13 |  vamanadravyāṇāṃ madanaphalāni śreṣṭhatamānyācakṣate, anapāyitvāt|
tāni *vasantagrīṣmayorantare puṣyāśvayugbhyāṃ mṛgaśirasā vā gṛhṇīyānmaitre muhūrte|
yāni pakvānyakāṇānyaharitāni pāṇḍūnyakrimīṇyapūtīnyajantujagdhānyahrasvāni; tāni *pramṛjya, kuśapuṭe baddhvā, gomayenālipya, yavatu(bu)ṣamāṣaśālikulattha-*mudgapalānāmanyatame nidadhyādaṣṭarātram|
ata ūrdhvaṃ mṛdūbhūtāni madhviṣṭagandhānyuddhṛtya śoṣayet|
suśuṣkāṇāṃ *phalapippalīruddharet|
tāsāṃ ghṛtadadhimadhupalalavimṛditānāṃ punaḥ śuṣkāṇāṃ navaṃ kalaśaṃ supramṛṣṭavālukamarajaskamākaṇṭhaṃ pūrayitvā svavacchannaṃ svanuguptaṃ *śikyeṣvāsajya samyak sthāpayet||
7.1.14 |  atha cchardanīyamāturaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannaṃ śvaśchardayitavyamiti grāmyānūpaudakamāṃsarasakṣīra-dadhi-māṣa-tila-śākādibhiḥ samutkleśitaśleṣmāṇaṃ vyuṣitaṃ jīrṇāhāraṃ pūrvāhṇe kṛtabalihomamaṅgalaprāyaścittaṃ nirannamanatisnigdhaṃ yavāgvā ghṛtamātrāṃ pītavantaṃ, tāsāṃ phalapippalīnāmantarnakhamuṣṭiṃ yāvadvā sādhu manyeta jarjarīkṛtya yaṣṭimadhukaṣāyeṇa kovidāra-karbudāra-nīpa-vidula-bimbī-śaṇapuṣpī-sadāpuṣpī-pratyakpuṣpī-kaṣāyāṇāmanyatamena vā rātrimuṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtaṃ madhusaindhavayuktaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ mantreṇānenābhimantrayet---
`auṃ brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkānilānalāḥ|
ṛṣayaḥ sauṣadhigrāmā bhūtasaṅghāśca pāntu te||
rasāyanamivarṣīṇāṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ yathā|
sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamastu te||'
ityevamabhimantryodaṅmukhaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ vā++āturaṃ pāyayecchleṣmajvaragulmapratiśyāyārtaṃ viśeṣeṇa punaḥ punarāpittāgamanāt, tena sādhu vamati; hīnavegaṃ tu pippalyāmalaka-sarṣapa-vacākalkalavaṇoṣṇodakaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravartayedāpittadarśanāt|
ityeṣa sarvaśchardanayogavidhiḥ||
7.1.15 |  sarveṣu tu madhusaindhavaṃ kaphavilayanacchedārthaṃ vamaneṣu vidadhyāt|
na coṣṇavirodho madhunaśchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyāgamanāddoṣanirharaṇācca||
7.1.16 |  phalapippalīnāṃ dvau dvau bhāgau kocidārādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ srāvayet, tena rasena tṛtīyaṃ bhāgaṃ piṣṭvā mātrāṃ harītakībhirbibhītakairāmalairvā tulyāṃ vartayet, tāsāmekāṃ dve vā pūrvoktānāṃ kaṣāyāṇāmanyatamasyāñjalimātreṇa vimṛdya balavacchleṣmaprasekagranthijvarodarāruciṣu pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.17 |  phalapippalīkṣīraṃ, tena vā kṣīrayavāgūmadhobhāge raktapitte hṛddāhe ca; tajjasya vā dadhna uttarakaṃ kaphaccharditamaka-*prasekeṣu; tasya vā payasaḥ śītasya santānikāñjaliṃ pitte prakupite uraḥkaṇṭhahṛdaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.18 |  phalapippalīśṛtakṣīrānnavanītamutpannaṃ phalādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ kaphābhibhūtāgniṃ *viśuṣyaddehaṃ ca mātrayā pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.19 |  phalapippalīnāṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ suparibhāvitena puṣparajaḥprakāśena cūrṇena sarasi *saṃjātaṃ bṛhatsaroruhaṃ sāyāhne 'vacūrṇayet, tadrātrivyuṣitaṃ prabhāte punaravacūrṇitamuddhṛtya haridrākṛsarakṣīrayavāgūnāmanyatamaṃ saindhavaguḍaphāṇitayuktamākaṇṭhaṃ pītavantamāghrāpayet sukumāramutkliṣṭapittakaphamauṣadhadveṣiṇamiti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.20 |  phalapippalīnāṃ *bhallātakavidhiparisrutaṃ svarasaṃ paktvā phāṇitībhūtamātantulībhāvāllehayet; ātapaśuṣkaṃ vā cūrṇīkṛtaṃ jīmūtakādikaṣāyeṇa pitte kaphasthānagate pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.21 |  phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat *phalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmanyatamakaṣāyasrutāni vartikriyāḥ *phalādikaṣāyopasarjanāḥ peyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.22 |  *phalapippalīnāmāragvadha-vṛkṣaka-svādukaṇṭaka-pāṭhā-pāṭalā-śārṅgeṣṭā-mūrvā-saptaparṇa-naktamāla-picumarda-paṭola-suṣavī-guḍūcī-somavalka-dvīpikānāṃ pippalī-pippalīmūla-hastipippalī-citraka-śṛṅgaverāṇāṃ cānyatamakaṣāyeṇa siddho leha iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.23 |  phalapippalīṣvelā-hareṇukā-śatapuṣpā-kustumburu-tagara-kuṣṭha-tvak-coraka-marubakāguru-guggulvelavāluka-śrīveṣṭaka-paripelava-māṃsī-śaileyaka-sthauṇeyaka-sarala-pārāvatapadyaśokarohiṇīnāṃ viṃśateranyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa sādhitotkārikā utkārikākalpena, modakā vā modakakalpena, yathādoṣarogabhakti prayojyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.24 |  phalapippalīsvarasakaṣāyaparibhāvitāni tilaśālitaṇḍulapiṣṭāni tatkṣāyopasarjanāni śaṣkulīkalpena vā śāṣkulyaḥ, pūpakalpena vā pūpāḥ, iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||
7.1.25 |  etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuṭheraka-kāṇḍīra-kālamālaka-parṇāsaka-kṣavaka-phaṇijjhaka-gṛñjana-kāsamarda-bhṛṅgarājānāṃ poṭekṣuvālikā-kālaṅkataka-daṇḍairakāṇāṃ cānyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa kārayet||
7.1.26 |  tathā badaraṣāḍava-rāga-leha-modakotkārikā-tarpaṇa-pānaka-māṃsarasa-yūṣa-*madyānāṃ madanaphalānyanyatamenopasṛjya yathādoṣarogabhakti dadyāt; taiḥ sādhuvamatīti||
7.1.27 |  madanaḥ karahāṭaśca rāṭhaḥ piṇḍītakaḥ phalam|
śvasanaśceti paryāyairucyate tasya kalpanā||
7.1.28 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
nava yogāḥ kaṣāyeṣu, *mātrāsvaṣṭau, payoghṛte|
pañca, phāṇitacūrṇe dvau ghreye, vartikriyāsu ṣaṭ||
7.1.29 |  viṃśatirviṃśatirlehamodakotkārikāsu ca|
śaṣkulīpūpayoścoktā yogāḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa||
7.1.30 |  daśānye ṣāḍavādyeṣu trayastriṃśadidaṃ śatam|
yogānāṃ vidhivaddiṣṭaṃ phalakalpe maharṣiṇā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1 | |

dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.2.1 |  athāto jīmūtakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.2.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.2.3 |  kalpaṃ jīmūtakasyemaṃ phalapuṣpāśrayaṃ śṛṇu|
garāgarī ca veṇī ca tathā syāddevatāḍakaḥ||
7.2.4 |  jīmūtakaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ yathāsvauṣadhakalpitam|
prayoktavyaṃ jvaraśvāsahikkādyeṣvāmayeṣu ca||
7.2.5 |  yathoktaguṇayuktānāṃ deśajānāṃ yathāvidhi|
*payaḥ puṣpe 'sya, nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā||
7.2.6 |  lomaśe kṣīrasaṃtānaṃ, dadhyuttaramalomaśe|
śṛte payasi dadhyamlaṃ *jātaṃ haritapāṇḍuke||
7.2.7 |  jīrṇānāṃ ca suśuṣkāṇāṃ nyastānāṃ bhājane śucau|
cūrṇasya payasā śuktiṃ vātapittārditaḥ pibet||
7.2.8 |  āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe mṛditvā prasrutaṃ pibet|
kaphaje 'rocake kāse pāṇḍuroge sayakṣmaṇi||
7.2.9 |  dve cāpothyāthavā trīṇi *guḍūcyā madhukasya vā|
kovidārādikānāṃ vā nimbasya kuṭajasya vā||
7.2.10 |  kaṣāyeṣvāsutaṃ pūtvā tenaiva vidhinā pibet|
athavā++āragvadhādīnāṃ saptānāṃ pūrvavat pibet||
7.2.11 |  *ekaikasya kaṣāyeṇa pittaśleṣmajvarārditaḥ|
mātrāḥ *syuḥ phalavaccāṣṭAu kolamātrāstu tā matāḥ||
7.2.12 |  jīvakarṣabhakekṣūṇāṃ śatāvaryā rasena vā|
pittaśleṣmajvare dadyādvātapittajvare 'thavā||
7.2.13 |  tathā jīmūtakakṣīrāt samutpannaṃ pacedghṛtam|
phalādīnāṃ kaṣāyeṇa śreṣṭhaṃ tadvamanaṃ matam||
7.2.14 |  tatra ślokau---
ṣaṭ kṣīre *madirāmaṇḍe eko dvādaśa cāpare|
sapta cāragvadhādīnāṃ kaṣāye 'ṣṭau ca vartiṣu||
7.2.15 |  jīvakādiṣu catvāro ghṛtaṃ caikaṃ prakīrtitam|
kalpe jīmūtakānāṃ *ca yogāstriṃśannavādhikāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||2 | |

tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.3.1 |  athāta ikṣvākukalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.3.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.3.3 |  siddhaṃ vakṣyāmyathekṣvākukalpaṃ yeṣāṃ praśasyate|
*lambā 'tha kaṭukālābūstumbī piṇḍaphalā tathā||
7.3.4 |  ikṣvākuḥ phalinī caiva procyate tasya kalpanā|
kāsaśvāsaviṣacchardijvarārte kaphakarṣite||
7.3.5 |  pratāmyati nare caiva vamanārthaṃ tadiṣyate|
apuṣpasya pravālānāṃ muṣṭiṃ prādeśasaṃmitam||
7.3.6 |  kṣīraprasthe śṛtaṃ dadyāt pittodrikte kaphajvare|
puṣpādiṣu ca catvāraḥ kṣīre jīmūtake yathā||
7.3.7 |  yogā haritapāṇḍūnāṃ surāmaṇḍena pañcamaḥ|
phalasvarasabhāgaṃ ca triguṇakṣīrasādhitam||
7.3.8 |  uraḥsthite kaphe dadyāt svarabhede ca pīnase|
jīrṇe madhyoddhṛte *kṣīraṃ prakṣipettadyadā dadhi||
7.3.9 |  jātaṃ syāt sakaphe kāse śvāse vamyāṃ ca tat pibet|
ajākṣīreṇa bījāni *bhāvayet pāyayeta ca||
7.3.10 |  viṣagulmodaragranthigaṇḍeṣu ślīpadeṣu ca|
mastunā vā phalānmadhyaṃ pāṇḍukuṣṭhaviṣārditaḥ||
7.3.11 |  tena takraṃ vipakvaṃ vā sakṣaudralavaṇaṃ pibet|
tumbyā phalarasaiḥ śuṣkaiḥ sapuṣpairavacūrṇitam||
7.3.12 |  chardayenmālyamāghrāya gandhasaṃpatsukhocitaḥ|
bhakṣayet phalamadhyaṃ vā guḍena palalena ca||
7.3.13 |  ikṣvākuphalatailaṃ vā siddhaṃ vā pūrvavadghṛtam|
pañcāśaddaśavṛddhāni phalādīnāṃ yathottaram||
7.3.14 |  pibedvimṛdya bījāni kaṣāyeṣvāśataṃ pṛthak|
yaṣṭyāhvakovidārādyairmuṣṭimantarnakhaṃ pibet||
7.3.15 |  kaṣāyaiḥ *kovidārādyairmātrāśca phalavat smṛtāḥ|
bilvamūlakaṣāyeṇa tumbībījāñjaliṃ pacet||
7.3.16 |  pūtasyāsya trayo *bhāgāścaturthaḥ phāṇitasya tu|
saghṛto bījabhāgaśca *piṣṭānardhāṃśikāṃstathā||
7.3.17 |  mahājālinijīmūtakṛtavedhanavatsakān|
taṃ lehaṃ sādhayeddarvyā ghaṭṭayanmṛdunā 'gninā||
7.3.18 |  yāvat syāttantumattoye patitaṃ tu na śīryate|
taṃ lihanmātrayā *lehaṃ pramathyāṃ ca pibedanu||
7.3.19 |  kalpa eṣo 'gnimanthādau catuṣke pṛthagucyate|
śaktubhirvā pibenmanthaṃ tumbīsvarasabhāvitaiḥ||
7.3.20 |  kaphaje 'tha jvare kāse kaṇṭharogeṣvarocake|
gulme *mehe praseke ca kalkaṃ māṃsarasaiḥ pibet|
naraḥ sādhu vamatyevaṃ na ca daurbalyamaśnute||
7.3.21 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
payasyaṣṭau surāmaṇḍa-mastu-takreṣu ca trayaḥ|
ghreyaṃ sapalalaṃ tailaṃ vardhamānāḥ phaleṣu ṣaṭ||
7.3.22 |  ghṛtamekaṃ kaṣāyeṣu navānye madhukādiṣu|
aṣṭau vartikriyā lehāḥ pañca *mantho rasastathā||
7.3.23 |  yogā *ikṣvākukalpe te catvāriṃśacca pañca ca|
uktā maharṣiṇā samyak prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||3 | |

caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.4.1 |  athāto dhāmārgavakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.4.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.4.3 |  karkoṭakī *koṭhaphalā mahājālinireva ca|
dhāmārgavasya paryāyā rājakośātakī tathā||
7.4.4 |  gare gulmodare kāse vāte śleṣmāśayasthite|
kaphe ca kaṇṭhavaktrasthe kaphasaṃcayajeṣu ca||
7.4.5 |  *rogeṣveṣu prayojyaṃ syāt sthirāśca guravaśca ye|
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca vidhinā tasya saṃharet||
7.4.6 |  pravālasvarasaṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛtvā *ca gulikāḥ pṛthak|
kovidārādibhiḥ peyāḥ kaṣāyairmadhukasya ca||
7.4.7 |  puṣpādiṣu *payoyogāścatvāraḥ pañcamī surā|
pūrvavat jīrṇaśuṣkāṇāmataḥ kalpaḥ pravakṣyate||
7.4.8 |  madhukasya kaṣāyeṇa bījalaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalam|
saguḍaṃ vyuṣitaṃ rātriṃ kovidārādibhistathā||
7.4.9 |  dadyādgulmodarārtebhyo ye cāpyanye kaphāmayāḥ|
dadyādannena saṃyuktaṃ chardihṛdrogaśāntaye||
7.4.10 |  cūrṇairvā 'pyutpalādīni bhāvitāni prabhūtaśaḥ|
rasakṣīrayavāgvāditṛpto ghrātvā vamet sukham||
7.4.11 |  cūrṇīkṛtasya vartiṃ vā kṛtvā badarasaṃmitām|
vinīyāñjalimātre tu pibedgo+*aśvaśakṛdrase||
7.4.12 |  pṛṣatarṣyakuraṅgāhvagajoṣṭrāśvatarāvike|
śvadaṃṣṭrakharakhaḍgānāṃ caivaṃ peyā *śakṛdrase||
7.4.13 |  jīvakarṣabhakau vīrāmātmaguptāṃ śatāvarīm|
kākolīṃ śrāvaṇīṃ medāṃ mahāmedāṃ madhūlikām||
7.4.14 |  ekaikaśo 'bhisaṃcūrṇya saha dhāmārgaveṇa te|
śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktā lehā hṛddāhakāsinām||
7.4.15 |  sukhodakānupānāḥ syuḥ pittoṣmasahite kaphe|
dhānyatumburuyūṣeṇa kalkaḥ sarvaviṣāpahaḥ||
7.4.16 |  jātyāḥ saumanasāyinyā rajanyāścorakasya ca|
vṛścīrasya mahākṣudrasahāhaimavatasya ca||
7.4.17 |  bimbyāḥ punarnavāyā vā kāsamardasya vā *pṛthak|
ekaṃ dhāmārgavaṃ dve vā kṣāye parimṛdya tu||
7.4.18 |  pūtaṃ manovikāreṣu pibedvamanamuttamam|
tacchṛtakṣīrajaṃ sarpiḥ sādhitaṃ vā phalādibhiḥ||
7.4.19 |  tatra ślokau---
pallave nava catvāraḥ kṣīra ekaḥ surāsave|
kaṣāye viṃśatiḥ kalke daśa dvau ca śakṛdrase||
7.4.20 |  anna ekastathā ghreye daśa lehāstathā ghṛtam|
kalpe dhāmārgavasyoktāḥ ṣaṣṭiryogā maharṣiṇā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4 | |

pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.5.1 |  athāto vatsakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.5.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.5.3 |  atha vatsakanāmāni bhedaṃ strīpuṃsayostathā|
kalpaṃ cāsya *pravakṣyāmi vistareṇa yathātatham||
7.5.4 |  vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ śakro vṛkṣako girimallikā|
bījānīndrayavāstasya tathocyante kaliṅgakāḥ||
7.5.5 |  bṛhatphalaḥ *śvetapuṣpaḥ snigdhapatraḥ pumān bhavet|
śyāmā cāruṇapuṣpā strī *phalavṛntaistathā 'ṇubhiḥ||
7.5.6 |  raktapittakaphaghnastu sukumāreṣvanatyayaḥ|
hṛdrogajvaravātāsṛgvīsarpādiṣu śasyate||
7.5.7 |  kāle phalāni saṃgṛhya tayoḥ śuṣkāṇi *nikṣipet|
teṣāmantarnakhaṃ muṣṭiṃ jarjarīkṛtya *bhāvayet||
7.5.8 |  madhukasya kaṣāyeṇa kovidārādibhistathā|
niśi sthitaṃ vimṛdyaitallavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam||
7.5.9 |  pibettadvamanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pittaśleṣmanibarhaṇam|
aṣṭāhaṃ payasā++ārkeṇa teṣāṃ cūrṇāni bhāvayet||
7.5.10 |  *jīvakasya kaṣāyeṇa tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet|
phalajīmūtakekṣvākujīvantīnāṃ pṛthak tathā||
7.5.11 |  sarṣapāṇāṃ madhūkānāṃ lavaṇasyāthavā 'mbunā|
kṛśareṇāthavā yuktaṃ vidadhyādvamanaṃ bhiṣak||
7.5.12 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
kaṣāyairnava cūrṇaiśca pañcoktāḥ salilaistrayaḥ|
ekaśca kṛśarāyāṃ syādyogāste 'ṣṭādaśa *smṛtāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5 | |

ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.6.1 |  athātaḥ kṛtavedhanakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.6.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.6.3 |  kṛtavedhananāmāni kalpaṃ cāsya nibodhata|
kṣveḍaḥ kośātakī *coktaṃ mṛdaṅgaphalameva ca||
7.6.4 |  atyarthakaṭukīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ gāḍheṣviṣṭaṃ gadeṣu ca||
kuṣṭhapāṇḍvāmayaplīhaśophagulmagarādiṣu||
7.6.5 |  kṣīrādi *kusumādīnāṃ surā caiteṣu pūrvavat|
suśuṣkāṇāṃ tu *jīrṇānāmekaṃ dve vā yathābalam||
7.6.6 |  kaṣāyairmadhukādīnāṃ navabhiḥ phalavat pibet|
kvāthayitvā *phalaṃ tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet||
7.6.7 |  kṛtavedhanakalkāṃśaṃ *phalādyardhāṃśasaṃyutam|
pṛthak cāragvadhādīnāṃ trayodaśabhirāsutam||
7.6.8 |  *śālmalīmūlacūrṇānāṃ picchābhirdaśanbhistathā|
*vartikriyāḥ ṣaṭ phalavat, phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā||
7.6.9 |  kośātakāni pañcāśat kovidārarase pacet|
taṃ kaṣāyaṃ phalādīnāṃ kalkairlehaṃ punaḥ pacet||
7.6.10 |  kṣveḍasya tatra bhāgaḥ syāccheṣāṇyardhāṃśikāni tu|
kaṣāyaiḥ *kovidārādyairevaṃ tat kalpayet pṛthak||
7.6.11 |  kaṣāyeṣu phalādīnāmānūpaṃ piśitaṃ pṛthak|
kośātakyā samaṃ paktvā rasaṃ salavaṇaṃ pibet||
7.6.12 |  phalādipippalītulyaṃ tadvat kṣveḍarasaṃ pibet|
kṣveḍaṃ *kāsī pibet siddhaṃ miśramikṣurasena ca||
7.6.13 |  tatra ślokau---
kṣīre dvau dvau surā caikā kvāthā dvāviṃśatistathā|
daśa picchā ghṛtaṃ caikaṃ ṣaṭ ca vartikriyāḥ śubhāḥ||
7.6.14 |  lehe 'ṣṭau sapta māṃse ca yoga ikṣurase 'paraḥ|
kṛtavedhanakalpe 'smin ṣaṣṭiryogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6 | |

saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.7.1 |  athātaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.7.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.7.3 |  virecane trivṛnmūlaṃ *śreṣṭhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ||
tasyāḥ saṃjñā guṇāḥ karma bhedaḥ kalpaśca vakṣyate||
7.7.4 |  tribhaṇḍī trivṛtā *caiva śyāmā kūṭaraṇā tathā|
sarvānubhūtiḥ *suvahā śabdaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ||
7.7.5 |  kaṣāyā madhurā rūkṣā vipāke kaṭukā ca sā|
kaphapittapraśamanī raukṣyāccānilakopanī||
7.7.6 |  sedānīmauṣadhairyuktā vātapittakaphāpahaiḥ|
*kalpavaiśeṣyamāsādya sarvarogaharā bhavet||
7.7.7 |  mūlaṃ tu dvividhaṃ tasyāḥ śyāmaṃ cāruṇameva ca|
*tayormukhyataraṃ viddhi mūlaṃ yadaruṇaprabham||
7.7.8 |  sukumāre śiśau vṛddhe mṛdukoṣṭhe ca *tacchubham|
mohayedāśukāritvācchyāmā kṣiṇvīta *mūrcchayet||
7.7.9 |  taikṣṇyāt karṣati hṛtkaṇṭhamāśu doṣaṃ haratyapi|
śasyate bahudoṣāṇāṃ krūrakoṣṭhāśca ye narāḥ||
7.7.10 |  guṇavatyāṃ tayorbhūmau jātaṃ mūlaṃ samuddharet|
upoṣya prayataḥ śukle śuklavāsāḥ samāhitaḥ||
7.7.11 |  gambhīrānugataṃ ślakṣṇamatiryagvisṛtaṃ ca yat|
*tadvipāṭyoddharedgarbhaṃ tvacaṃ śuṣkāṃ nidhāpayet||
7.7.12 |  snigdhasvinno virecyastu *peyāmātroṣitaḥ sukham|
akṣamātraṃ tayoḥ piṇḍaṃ vinīyāmlena nā pibet||
7.7.13 |  go 'vyajāmahiṣīmūtrasauvīrakatuṣodakaiḥ|
prasannayā triphalayā śṛtayā ca pṛthak pibet||
7.7.14 |  ekaikaṃ saindhavādīnāṃ dvādaśānāṃ sanāgaram|
*trivṛddviguṇasaṃyuktaṃ cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pibet||
7.7.15 |  pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ maricaṃ gajapippalī|
saralaḥ kilimaṃ hiṅgu bhārgī tejovatī tathā||
7.7.16 |  mustaṃ haimavatī pathyā citrako rajanī vacā|
svarṇakṣīryajamodā ca śṛṅgaveraṃ ca taiḥ pṛthak||
7.7.17 |  ekaikārdhāṃśasaṃyuktaṃ pibedgomūtrasaṃyutam|
madhukārdhāṃśasaṃyuktaṃ śarkarāmbuyutaṃ pibet||
7.7.18 |  jīvakarṣabhakau medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ karkaṭāhvayām|
mudgamāṣākhyaparṇyau ca mahatīṃ śrāvaṇīṃ tathā||
7.7.19 |  kākolīṃ *kṣīrakākolīmindrāṃ chinnaruhāṃ tathā|
kṣīraśuklāṃ payasyāṃ ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā pibet||
7.7.20 |  vātapittahitānyetānyanyāni tu kaphānile|
kṣīramāṃsekṣukāśmaryadrākṣāpīlurasaiḥ pṛthak||
7.7.21 |  sarpiṣā vā tayoścūrṇamabhayārdhāṃśikaṃ pibet|
lihyādvā madhusarpirbhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ sasitopalam||
7.7.22 |  ajagandhā tugākṣīrī vidārī śarkarā trivṛt|
cūrṇitaṃ kṣaudrasarpirbhyāṃ līḍhvā sādhu viricyate||
7.7.23 |  sannipātajvarastambhadāhatṛṣṇārdito naraḥ|
śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca saśarkaram||
7.7.24 |  sādhayedvidhivallehaṃ lihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ|
sakṣaudrāṃ śarkarāṃ paktvā kuryānmṛdbhājane nave||
7.7.25 |  *kṣipecchīte trivṛccūrṇaṃ tvakpatramaricaiḥ saha|
*mātrayā lehayedetadīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam||
7.7.26 |  *kuḍavāṃśān rasānikṣudrākṣāpīluparūṣakāt|
sitopalāpalaṃ kṣaudrāt kuḍavārdhaṃ ca sādhayet||
7.7.27 |  taṃ lehaṃ yojayecchītaṃ trivṛccūrṇena śāstravit|
*etadutsannapittānāmīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam||
7.7.28 |  śarkarāmodakān vartīrgulikāmāṃsapūpakān|
anena vidhinā kuryāt paittikānāṃ virecanam||
7.7.29 |  pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ kṣāraṃ śyāmāṃ trivṛtayā saha|
lehayenmadhunā sārdhaṃ *śleṣmalānāṃ virecanam||
7.7.30 |  mātuluṅgābhayādhātrīśrīparṇīkoladāḍimāt|
subhṛṣṭān svarasāṃstaile sādhayettatra cāvapet||
7.7.31 |  sahakārāt kapitthācca madhyamamlaṃ ca yat phalam|
pūrvavadbahalībhūte trivṛccūrṇaṃ samāvapet||
7.7.32 |  tvakpatrakeśarailānāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhu ca mātrayā|
leho 'yaṃ kaphapūrṇānāmīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam||
7.7.33 |  pānakāni rasān yūṣānmodakān rāgaṣāḍavān|
anena vidhinā kuryādvirekārthaṃ kaphādhike||
7.7.34 |  bhṛṅgailābhyāṃ samā nīlī taistrivṛttaiśca śarkarā|
cūrṇaṃ phalarasakṣaudraśaktubhistarpaṇaṃ pibet||
7.7.35 |  vātapittakaphottheṣu rogeṣvalpānaleṣu ca|
nareṣu sukumāreṣu nirapāyaṃ virecanam||
7.7.36 |  śarkarātriphalāśyāmātrivṛtpippalīmākṣikaiḥ|
modakaḥ sannipātordhvaraktapittajvarāpahaḥ||
7.7.37 |  trivṛcchāṇā matāstisrastisraśca triphalātvacaḥ|
viḍaṅgapippalīkṣāraśāṇāstisraśca cūrṇitāḥ||
7.7.38 |  lihyāt sarpirmadhubhyāṃ ca modakaṃ vā guḍena tu|
*bhakṣayenniṣparīhārametacchodhanamuttamam||
7.7.39 |  gulmaṃ plīhodaraṃ *śvāsaṃ halīmakamarocakam|
kaphavātakṛtāṃścānyān vyādhīnetadvyapohati||
7.7.40 |  viḍaṅgapippalīmūlatriphalādhānyacitrakān|
maricendrayavājājīpippalīhastipippalīḥ||
7.7.41 |  lavaṇānyajamodāṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ kārṣikaṃ pṛthak|
tilatailatrivṛccūrṇabhāgau cāṣṭapalonmitau||
7.7.42 |  dhātrīphalarasaprasthāṃstrīn guḍārdhatulāṃ tathā|
paktvā mṛdvagninā khādedbadarodumbaropamān||
7.7.43 |  guḍān kṛtvā na cātra syādvihārāhārayantraṇā|
mandāgnitvaṃ jvaraṃ mūrcchāṃ mūtrakṛcchramarocakam||
7.7.44 |  asvapnaṃ gātraśūlaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ bhramaṃ kṣayam|
kuṣṭhārśaḥkāmalāmehagulmodarabhagandarān||
7.7.45 |  grahaṇīpāṇḍurogāṃśca hanyuḥ puṃsavanāśca te|
kalyāṇakā iti khyātāḥ sarveṣvṛtuṣu yaugikāḥ||
iti kalyāṇakaguḍaḥ|
7.7.46 |  *vyoṣatvakpatramustailāviḍaṅgāmalakābhayāḥ|
samabhāgā bhiṣagdadyāddviguṇaṃ ca mukūlakam||
7.7.47 |  trivṛto 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhāgaṃ śarkarāyāśca ṣaḍguṇam|
cūrṇitaṃ guḍikāḥ kṛtvā kṣaudreṇa palasaṃmitāḥ||
7.7.48 |  bhakṣayet kalyamutthāya śītaṃ cānu pibejjalam|
mūtrakṛcchre jvare vamyāṃ kāse śvāse bhrame kṣaye||
7.7.49 |  tāpe pāṇḍvāmaye 'lpe 'gnau śastā niryantraṇāśinaḥ|
yogaḥ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ ca mataḥ *śreṣṭho virecane||
7.7.50 |  mūtrajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ vidhijñenāvacāritaḥ|
pathyādhātryurubūkāṇāṃ prasṛtau dvau trivṛtpalam||
7.7.51 |  daśa tānmodakān kuryādīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam|
trivṛddhaimavatī śyāmā nīlinī hastipippalī||
7.7.52 |  samūlā pippalī mustamajamodā durālabhā|
kārṣikaṃ nāgarapalaṃ guḍasya palaviṃśatim||
7.7.53 |  cūrṇitaṃ modakān kuryādudumbaraphalopamān|
hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣayavānībiḍajīrakaiḥ||
7.7.54 |  vacājagandhātriphalācavyacitrakadhānyakaiḥ|
modakān veṣṭayeccūrṇaistān satumburudāḍimaiḥ||
7.7.55 |  trikavaṅkṣaṇahṛdbastikoṣṭhārśaḥplīhaśūlinām|
hikkākāsāruciśvāsakaphodāvartināṃ *śubhāḥ||
7.7.56 |  trivṛtāṃ kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ pippalīṃ viśvabheṣajam|
*kṣaudradrākṣārasopetaṃ varṣāsvetadvirecanam||
7.7.57 |  trivṛddurālabhāmustaśarkarodīcyacandanam|
drākṣāmbunā sayaṣṭyāhvasātalaṃ jaladātyaye||
7.7.58 |  trivṛtāṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhāmajājīṃ saralaṃ vacām|
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante piṣṭvā tūṣṇāmbunā pibet||
7.7.59 |  śarkarā trivṛtā tulyā grīṣmakāle virecanam|
trivṛttrāyantihapuṣāḥ sātalāṃ *kaṭurohiṇīm||
7.7.60 |  svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca saṃcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayettryaham|
eṣa sarvartuko yogaḥ snigdhānāṃ maladoṣahṛt||
7.7.61 |  trivṛcchyāmā durālambhā vatsakaṃ hastipippalī|
nīlinī triphalā mustaṃ kaṭukā ca sucūrṇitam||
7.7.62 |  sarpirmāṃsarasoṣṇāmbuyuktaṃ pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ|
pibet *sukhatamaṃ hyetadrūkṣāṇāmapi śasyate||
7.7.63 |  tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalā hiṅgu kārṣikaṃ trivṛtāpalam|
sauvarcalārdhakarṣAṃ ca pālārdhaṃ cāmlavetasāt||
7.7.64 |  taccūrṇaṃ śarkarātulyaṃ madyenāmlena vā pibet|
gulmapārṇvārtinutsiddhaṃ jīrṇe cādyādrasaudanam||
7.7.65 |  trivṛtāṃ triphalāṃ dantīṃ saptalāṃ vyoṣasaindhavam|
kṛtvā cūrṇaṃ tu saptāhaṃ bhāvyamāmalakīrase||
7.7.66 |  tadyojyaṃ tarpaṇe yūṣe piśite rāgayuktiṣu|
tulyāmlaṃ trighṛtākalkasiddhaṃ gulmaharaṃ ghṛtam||
7.7.67 |  śyāmātrivṛtayormūlaṃ pacedāmalakaiḥ saha|
jale tena *kaṣāyeṇa paktvā sarpiḥ pibennaraḥ||
7.7.68 |  śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇa siddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibettathā|
sādhitaṃ vā payastābhyāṃ sukhaṃ tena viricyate||
7.7.69 |  trivṛnmuṣṭīṃstu sanakhānaṣṭau droṇe 'mbhasaḥ *pacet|
pādaśeṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtaṃ guḍatulāyutam||
7.7.70 |  snigdhe sthāpyaṃ ghaṭe kṣaudrapippalīphalacitrakaiḥ|
pralipte *madhunā māsaṃ jātaṃ tanmātrayā pibet||
7.7.71 |  grahaṇīpāṇḍurogaghnaṃ gulmaśvayathunāśanam|
surāṃ vā *trivṛtāyogakiṇvāṃ tatkvāthasaṃyutām||
7.7.72 |  yavaiḥ śyāmātrivṛtkvāthasvinnaiḥ kulmāṣamambhasā|
āsutaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ palle jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ pibet||
7.7.73 |  bhṛṣṭān vā *satuṣāñchuddhān yavāṃstaccūrṇasaṃyutān|
āsutānambhasā tadvat pibejjātaṃ tuṣodakam||
7.7.74 |  tathā madanakalpoktān ṣāḍavādīn pṛthagdaśa|
trivṛccūrṇena saṃyujya virekārthaṃ prayojayet||
7.7.75 |  bhavataścātra---
tvakkeśarāmrātakadāḍimailāsitopalāmākṣikamātuluṅgaiḥ|
madyaistathā 'mlaiśca manonukūlairyuktāni deyāni virecanāni||
7.7.76 |  śītāmbunā pītavataśca tasya siñcenmukhaṃ chardivighātahetoḥ|
hṛdyāṃśca mṛtpuṣpaphalapravālānamlaṃ ca dadyādupajighraṇārtham||
7.7.77 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
eko 'mlādibhiraṣṭau ca daśa dvau saindhavādibhiḥ|
mūtre 'ṣṭādaśa *yaṣṭyāṃ dvau jīvakādau caturdaśa||
7.7.78 |  kṣīrādau sapta lehe 'ṣṭau catvāraḥ sitayā 'pi ca|
pānakādiṣu pañcaiva ṣaḍṛtau pañca modakāḥ||
7.7.79 |  catvāraśca ghṛte kṣīre dvau cūrṇe tarpaṇe tathā|
dvau madye kāñjike dvau ca daśānye ṣāḍavādiṣu||
7.7.80 |  śyāmāyāstrivṛtāyāśca kalpe 'smin samudāhṛtam|
śataṃ daśottaraṃ siddhaṃ yogānāṃ paramarṣiṇā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7 | |

aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.8.1 |  athātaścaturaṅgulakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.8.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.8.3 |  āragvadho rājavṛkṣaḥ śampākaścaturaṅgulaḥ|
pragrahaḥ kṛtamālaśca karṇikāro 'vaghātakaḥ||
7.8.4 |  jvarahṛdrogavātāsṛgudāvartādirogiṣu|
rājavṛkṣo 'dhikaṃ pathyo mṛdurmadhuraśītalaḥ||
7.8.5 |  bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave|
*yojyo mṛdvanapāyitvādviṇeṣāccaturaṅgulaḥ||
7.8.6 |  *phlakāle phalaṃ tasya grāhyaṃ pariṇataṃ ca yat|
teṣāṃ guṇavatāṃ *bhāraṃ sikatāsu nidhāpayet||
7.8.7 |  saptarātrāt samuddhṛtya śoṣayedātape bhiṣak|
tato majjānamuddhṛtya śucau bhāṇḍe nidhāpayet||
7.8.8 |  drākṣārasayutaṃ dadyāddāhodāvartapīḍite|
caturvarṣamukhe bāle yāvaddvādaśavārṣike||
7.8.9 |  caturaṅgulamajjñastu prasṛtaṃ vā 'thavā 'ñjalim|
surāmaṇḍena saṃyuktamathavā kolasīdhunā||
7.8.10 |  dadhimaṇḍena vā *yuktaṃ rasenāmalakasya vā|
kṛtvā śītakaṣāyaṃ *taṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā||
7.8.11 |  *trivṛto vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibet|
tathā bilvakaṣāyeṇa lavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam||
7.8.12 |  kaṣāyeṇāthavā tasya trivṛccūrṇaṃ guḍānvitam|
sādhayitvā śanairlehaṃ lehayenmātrayā naram||
7.8.13 |  caturaṅgulasiddhādvā kṣīrādyadudiyādghṛtam|
majjñaḥ kalkena dhātrīṇāṃ rase tatsādhitaṃ pibet||
7.8.14 |  tadeva daśamūlasya kulatthānāṃ yavasya ca|
kaṣāye sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kalkaiḥ śyāmādibhiḥ pibet||
7.8.15 |  dantīkvāthe 'ñjaliṃ majjñaḥ śampākasya guḍasya ca|
dattvā māsārdhamāsasthamariṣṭaṃ *pāpayeta ca||
7.8.16 |  yasya yat *pānamannaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ svādvatha vā kaṭu|
lavaṇaṃ vā bhavettena yuktaṃ dadyādvirecanam||
7.8.17 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
drākṣārase surāsīdhvordadhni cāmalakīrase|
sauvīrake kaṣāye ca trivṛto *bilvakasya ca||
7.8.18 |  lehe 'riṣṭe ghṛte dve ca yogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ|
caturaṅgulakalpe 'smin sukumārāḥ sukhodayāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne caturaṅgulakalpo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8 | |

navamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.9.1 |  athātastilvakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.9.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.9.3 |  tilvakastu mato lodhro bṛhatpatrastirīṭakaḥ|
tasya mūlatvacaṃ śuṣkāmantarvalkalavarjitām||
7.9.4 |  cūrṇayettu tridhā kṛtvā dvau bhāgau ścotayettataḥ|
lodhrasyaiva kaṣāyeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tena bhāvayet||
7.9.5 |  bhāgaṃ taṃ daśamūlasya *punaḥ kvāthena bhāvayet|
śuṣkaṃ cūrṇa punaḥ kṛtvā *tata ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet||
7.9.6 |  *dadhitakrasurāmaṇḍamūtrairbadarasīdhunā|
rasenāmalakānāṃ vā tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet||
7.9.7 |  meṣaśṛṅgyabhayākṛṣṇācitrakaiḥ salile śṛte|
marujān sunuyāttacca jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ yadā||
7.9.8 |  bhavedajjalinā tasya loghrakalkaṃ pibet sadā|
surāṃ lodhrakaṣāyeṇa jātāṃ pakṣasthitāṃ pibet||
7.9.9 |  dantīcitrakayordroṇe salilasyāḍhakaṃ pṛthak|
samutkvāthya guḍasyaikāṃ tulāṃ lodhrasya cāñjalim||
7.9.10 |  āvapettat paraṃ *pakṣānmadyapānāṃ virecanam|
*kampillakakaṣāyeṇa daśakṛtvaḥ subhāvitām||
7.9.11 |  mātrāṃ kampillakasyaiva kaṣāyeṇa punaḥ pibet|
caturaṅgulakalpena leho 'nyaḥ kārya eva ca||
7.9.12 |  triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa sasarpirmadhuphāṇitaḥ|
lodhracūrṇayutaḥ siddho lehaḥ *śreṣṭho virecane||
7.9.13 |  tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca saśarkaraḥ|
saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca *śreṣṭho virecane||
7.9.14 |  aṣṭāṣṭau trivṛtādīnāṃ muṣṭīṃstu sanakhān pṛthak|
droṇe 'pāṃ sādhayet pādaśeṣe prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet||
7.9.15 |  piṣṭaistaireva bilvāṃśaiḥ samūtralavaṇairatha|
tato mātrāṃ pibet kāle śreṣṭhametadvirecanam||
7.9.16 |  lodhrakalkena mūtrāmlalavaṇaiśca pacedghṛtam|
caturaṅgulakalpena sarpiṣī dve ca sādhayet||
7.9.17 |  tatra ślokau---
pañca dadhyādibhistvekā surā sauvīrakeṇa ca|
eko 'riṣṭastathā yoga ekaḥ kampillakena ca||
7.9.18 |  lehāstrayo ghṛtenāpi catvāraḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ|
yogāste lodhramūlānāṃ kalpe ṣoḍaśa darśitāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ||9 | |

daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.10.1 |  athātaḥ sudhākalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|
7.10.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.10.3 |  virecanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sudhā tīkṣṇatamā matā|
saṅghātaṃ hi bhinattyāśu doṣāṇāṃ kaṣṭavibhramā||
7.10.4 |  tasmānnaiṣā mṛdau koṣṭhe prayoktavyā kadācana|
na doṣanicaye cālpe sati *mārgaparikrame||
7.10.5 |  pāṇḍurogodare gulme kuṣṭhe dūṣīviṣārdite|
śvayathau madhumehe ca doṣavibhrāntacetasi||
7.10.6 |  rogairevaṃvidhairgrastaṃ jñātvā saprāṇamāturam|
prayojayenmahāvṛkṣaṃ samyak sa hyavacāritaḥ||
7.10.7 |  sadyo *harati doṣāṇāṃ mahāntamapi saṃcayam|
dvividhaḥ sa mato 'lpaiśca bahubhiścaiva kaṇṭakaiḥ||
7.10.8 |  sutīkṣṇaiḥ kaṇṭakairalpaiḥ pravaro bahukaṇṭakaḥ|
sa nāmnā snugguḍā nandā sudhā nistriṃśapatrakaḥ||
7.10.9 |  *tau vipāṭyāharet kṣīraṃ śastreṇa matimān bhiṣak|
dvivarṣaṃ vā trivarṣaṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ||
7.10.10 |  bilvādīnāṃ bṛhatyā vā kaṇṭakāryāstathaikaśaḥ|
kaṣāyeṇa samāṃśaṃ taṃ kṛtvā 'ṅgāreṣu śoṣayet||
7.10.11 |  *tataḥ kolasamāṃ mātrāṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā|
tuṣodakena kolānāṃ rasenāmalakasya vā||
7.10.12 |  surayā dadhimaṇḍena mātuluṅgarasena vā|
sātalāṃ kāñcanakṣīrīṃ śyāmādīni *kaṭutrikam||
7.10.13 |  yathopapatti saptāhaṃ sudhākṣīreṇa bhāvayet|
kolamātrāṃ ghṛtenātaḥ pibenmāṃsarasena vā||
7.10.14 |  tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalāṃ dantīṃ citrakaṃ trivṛtāṃ tathā|
snukkṣīrabhāvitaṃ samyagvidadhyādguḍapānakam||
7.10.15 |  trivṛtāragvadhaṃ dantīṃ śaṅkhinīṃ saptalāṃ samam|
gomūtre rajanīṃ *kṛtvā śoṣayedātape tataḥ||
7.10.16 |  saptāhaṃ bhāvayitvaivaṃ snukkṣīreṇāparaṃ punaḥ|
saptāhaṃ bhāvayecchuṣkaṃ tatastenāpi bhāvitam||
7.10.17 |  gandhamālyaṃ *tadāghrāya prāvṛtya paṭameva ca|
sukhamāśu viricyante mṛdukoṣṭhā narādhipāḥ||
7.10.18 |  śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇa snukkṣīraghṛtaphāṇitaiḥ|
lehaṃ *paktvā virekārthaṃ lehayenmātrayā naram||
7.10.19 |  pāyayettu sudhākṣīraṃ yūṣairmāṃsarasairghṛtaiḥ|
bhāvitāñchuṣkamatsyān vā māṃsaṃ vā bhakṣayennaraḥ||
7.10.20 |  kṣīreṇāmalakaiḥ sarpiścaturaṅgulavat pacet|
surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat pacet||
7.10.21 |  tatra ślokau---
sauvīrakādibhiḥ sapta sarpiṣā ca rasena ca|
pānakaṃ ghreyalehau ca yogā yūṣādibhistrayaḥ||
7.10.22 |  dvau śuṣkamatsyamāṃsābhyāṃ suraikā dve ca sarpiṣī|
mahāvṛkṣasya yogāste viṃśatiḥ samudāhṛtāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||10 | |

ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.11.1 |  athātaḥ saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.11.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.11.3 |  saptalā carmasāhvā ca bahuphenarasā ca sā|
śaṅkhinī tiktalā *caiva yavatiktā 'kṣi(kṣa)pīḍakaḥ||
7.11.4 |  te gulmarahṛdrogakuṣṭhaśophodarādiṣu|
vikāsitīkṣṇarūkṣatvādyojye śleṣmādhikeṣu tu||
7.11.5 |  nātiśuṣkaṃ phalaṃ grāhyaṃ śaṅkhinyā nistuṣīkṛtam|
saptalāyāśca mūlāni gṛhītvā bhājane kṣipet||
7.11.6 |  akṣamātraṃ tayoḥ piṇḍaṃ prasannālavaṇāyutam|
hṛdroge *kaphavātotthe gulme caiva prayojayet||
7.11.7 |  priyālapīlukarkandhukolāmrātakadāḍimaiḥ|
drākṣāpanasakharjūrabadarāmlaparūṣakaiḥ||
7.11.8 |  maireye dadhimaṇḍe 'mle sauvīrakatuṣodake|
sīdhau cāpyeṣa kalpaḥ syāt sukhaṃ śīghravirecanaḥ||
7.11.9 |  tailaṃ vidārigandhādyaiḥ payasi kvathite pacet|
saptalāśaṅkhinīkalke trivṛcchyāmārdhamāgike||
7.11.10 |  dadhimaṇḍena sannīya siddhaṃ tat pāyayeta ca|
śaṅkhinīcūrṇabhāgau dvau *tilacūrṇasya cāparaḥ||
7.11.11 |  harītakīkaṣāyeṇa tailaṃ tatpīḍitaṃ pibet|
atasīsarṣapairaṇḍakarañjeṣveṣa saṃvidhiḥ||
7.11.12 |  śaṅkhinīsaptalāsiddhāt kṣīrādyadudiyādghṛtam|
kalkabhāge tayoreva trivṛcchyāmārdhasaṃyute||
7.11.13 |  kṣīreṇāloḍya *saṃpakvaṃ pibettacca virecanam|
dantīdravantyoḥ kalpo 'yamajaśṛṅgyajagandhayoḥ||
7.11.14 |  kṣīriṇyā *nīlikāyāśca tathaiva ca karañjayoḥ|
masūravidalāyāśca pratyakparṇyāstathaiva ca||
7.11.15 |  dvivargārdhāṃśakalkena tadvat sādhyaṃ ghṛtaṃ punaḥ|
śaṅkhinīsaptalādhātrīkaṣāye *sādhayedghṛtam||
7.11.16 |  trivṛtkalpena sarpiśca trayo lehāśca *lodhravat|
surākampillayoryogaḥ kāryo lodhravadeva ca||
7.11.17 |  dantīdravantyoḥ kalpena sauvīrakatuṣodake|
ajagandhājaśṛṅgyośca *tadvat syātāṃ virecane||
7.11.18 |  tatra ślokau---
kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ taile 'ṣṭau ca sarpiṣi|
pañca madye trayo lehā yogaḥ kampillake tathā||
7.11.19(?)| saptalāśaṅkhinībhyāṃ te triṃśaduktā navādhikāḥ|
yogāḥ siddhāḥ samastābhyāmekaśo 'pi ca te hitāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne saptalāśāṅkhinīkalpo nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||11 | |

dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
7.12.1 |  athāto dantīdravantīkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
7.12.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
7.12.3 |  dantyudumbaraparṇī syānnikumbho 'tha mukūlakaḥ|
dravantī nāmataścitrā nyagrodhī mūṣikāhvayā||
(tathā mūṣikaparṇī cāpyupacitrā ca śambarī|
pratyakśreṇī sutaśreṇī dantī ra(ca)ṇḍā ca *kīrtitā||)
7.12.4 |  tayormūlāni saṃgṛhya sthirāṇi bahalāni ca|
hastidantaprakārāṇi śyāvatāmrāṇi buddhimān||
7.12.5 |  pippalīmadhuliptāni svedayenmṛtkuśāntare|
*śoṣAyedātape 'gnyarkau hato hyeṣāṃ vikāśitām||
7.12.6 |  tīkṣṇoṣṇānyāśukārīṇi vikāśīni gurūṇi ca|
vilāyayanti doṣau dvau mārutaṃ kopayanti ca||
7.12.7 |  dadhitakrasurāmaṇḍaiḥ piṇḍamakṣasamaṃ tayoḥ|
priyālakolabadarapīluśīdhubhireva ca||
7.12.8 |  pibedgulmodarī *doṣairabhikhinnaśca yo naraḥ|
gomṛgājarasaiḥ pāṇḍuḥ kṛmikoṣṭhī bhagandarī||
7.12.9 |  tayoḥ kalke kaṣāye ca daśamūlarasāyute|
*kakṣyālajīvisarpeṣu dāhe ca vipacedghṛtam||
7.12.10 |  tailaṃ mehe ca gulme ca sodāvarte kaphānile|
catuḥsnehaṃ śakṛcchukravātasaṅgānilārtiṣu||
7.12.11 |  rase dantyajaśṛṅgayośca guḍakṣaudraghṛtānvitaḥ|
lehaḥ siddho virekārthe *dāhasaṃtāpamehanut||
7.12.12 |  vātatarṣe jvare paitte syāt sa evājagandhayā|
dantīdravantyormūlāni pacedāmalakīrase||
7.12.13 |  trīṃstu tasya kaṣāyasya bhāgau dvau phāṇitasya ca|
tapte sarpiṣi taile vā bharjayettatra cāvapet||
7.12.14 |  kalkaṃ dantīdravantyośca śyāmādīnāṃ ca bhāgaśaḥ|
tatsiddhaṃ prāśayellehaṃ sukhaṃ tena viricyate||
7.12.15 |  rase ca daśamūlasya tathā baibhītake rase|
harītakīrase caiva lehānevaṃ pacet *pṛthak||
7.12.16 |  tayorbilvasamaṃ cūrṇaṃ tadraseneva bhāvitam|
asṛṣṭe viśi vātotthe gulme cāmlayutaṃ śubham||
7.12.17 |  pāṭayitvekṣukāṇḍaṃ vā kalkenālipya cāntarā|
svedayitvā *tataḥ khādet sukhaṃ tena viricyate||
7.12.18 |  mūlaṃ dantīdravantośca saha mudgairvipācayet|
*lāvavartīrakādyaiśca te rasāḥ syurvirecane||
7.12.19 |  tayorvā 'pi kaṣāyeṇa yavāgūṃ jāṅgalaṃ rasam|
*māṣayūṣaṃ ca saṃskṛtya dadyāttaiśca viricyate||
7.12.20 |  tatkaṣāyāttrayo bhāgā dvau sitāyāstathaiva ca|
eko godhūmacūrṇānāṃ *kāryā cotkārikā śubhā||
7.12.21 |  modako vā 'sya *kalpena kāryastacca virecanam|
tayoścāpi kaṣāyeṇa madyānyasyopakalpayet||
7.12.22 |  dantīkvāthena *cāloḍya dantītailena sādhitān|
guḍalāvaṇikān bhakṣyān vividhān bhakṣayennaraḥ||
7.12.23 |  dantīṃ dravantīṃ maricaṃ yavānīmupakuñcikām|
nāgaraṃ hemadugdhāṃ ca citrakaṃ ceti cūrṇitam||
7.12.24 |  saptāhaṃ bhāvayenmūtre gavāṃ pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ|
pibedghṛtena *jīeṇe tu viriktaścāpi tarpaṇam||
7.12.25 |  sarvarogaharaṃ mukhyaṃ sarveṣvṛtuṣu yaugikam|
cūrṇaṃ tadanapāyitvādbālavṛddheṣu pūjitam||
7.12.26 |  durbhaktājīrṇapārśvārtigulmaplīhodareṣu ca|
gaṇḍamālāsu *vāte ca pāṇḍuroge ca śasyate||
7.12.27 |  palaṃ citrakadantyośca harītakyāśca viṃśatiḥ|
trivṛtpippalikarṣau dvau guḍasyāṣṭapalena tat||
7.12.28 |  vinīya modakān kuryāddaśaikaṃ bhakṣayettataḥ|
uṣṇāmbu ca *pibeccānu daśame daśame 'hni ca||
7.12.29 |  ete niṣparihārāḥ syuḥ sarvaroganibarhaṇāḥ|
grahaṇīpāṇḍurogārśaḥkaṇḍūkoṭhānilāpahāḥ||
7.12.30 |  dantīdvipalaniryūho *drākṣārdhaprasthasādhitaḥ|
virecanaṃ pittakāse pāṇḍuroge ca śasyate||
7.12.31 |  dantīkalkaṃ samaguḍaṃ śītavāriyutaṃ pibet|
virecanaṃ *mukhyatamaṃ kāmalāharamuttamam||
7.12.32 |  śyāmādantīrase gauḍaḥ pippalīphalacitrakaiḥ|
lipte 'riṣṭo 'nilaśleṣmaplīhapāṇḍūdarāpahaḥ||
7.12.33 |  tathā dantīdravantyośca kaṣāye sājagandhayoḥ|
gauḍaḥ kāryo++ājaśṛṅgyā vā *sa vai sukhavirecanaḥ||
7.12.34 |  taccūrṇakvāthamāṣāmbukiṇvatoyasamudbhavā|
madirā kaphagulmālpavahnipārśvakaṭigrahe||
7.12.35 |  ajagandhākaṣāyeṇa sauvīrakatuṣodake|
surākampillake yogau lodhravacca tayoḥ smṛtau||
7.12.36 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
*(dadhyādiṣu trayaḥ pañca priyālādyaistrayo rase|
sneheṣu vai trayo lehyāḥ ṣaṭ cūrṇe tveka eva ca||
7.12.37 |  ikṣāvekastathā mudgamāṃsānāṃ ca rasāstrayaḥ|
yavāgvādau trayaścaiva ukta utkārikāvidhau||
7.12.38 |  ekaśca modake madye caikastatkvāthatailake|
cūrṇamekaṃ punaścaiko modakaḥ pañca cāsave||
7.12.39 |  ekaḥ sauvīrake 'thaiko yogaḥ syāttu tuṣodake|
ekā suraikaḥ kampille tathā pañca ghṛte smṛtāḥ||)
7.12.40 |  dantīdravantīkalpe 'smin proktāḥ ṣoḍaśakāstrayaḥ|
nānāvidhānāṃ yogānāṃ bhaktidoṣāmayānprati||
7.12.41 |  triśataṃ pañcapañcāśadyogānāṃ vamane smṛtam|
dve śate navakāḥ pañca yogānāṃ tu virecane||
7.12.42 |  ūrdhvānulomabhāgānāmityuktāni śatāni ṣaṭ|
prādhānyataḥ samāśritya dravyāṇi daśa pañca ca||
7.12.43 |  bhavanti cātra---
yaddhi yena pradhānena dravyaṃ samupasṛjyate|
tatsaṃjñakaḥ sa yogo vai bhavatīti *viniścayaḥ||
7.12.44 |  phalādīnāṃ pradhānānāṃ guṇabhūtāḥ surādayaḥ|
te hi tānyanuvartante manujendramivetare||
7.12.45 |  viruddhavīryamapyeṣāṃ pradhānānāmabādhakam|
adhikaṃ tulyavīrye hi *kriyāsāmarthyamiṣyate||
7.12.46 |  iṣṭavarṇarasasparśagandhārthaṃ prati cāmayam|
ato viruddhavīryāṇāṃ prayoga iti niścitam||
7.12.47 |  bhūyaścaiṣāṃ balādhānaṃ kāryaṃ svarasabhāvanaiḥ|
subhāvitaṃ hyalpamapi dravyaṃ syādbahukarmakṛt||
7.12.48 |  svarasaistulyavīryairvā tasmāddravyāṇi bhāvayet|
alpasyāpi mahārthatvaṃ prabhūtasyālpakarmatām||
7.12.49 |  kuryāt saṃyogaviśleṣkālasaṃskārayuktibhiḥ|
pradeśamātrametāvaddraṣṭavyamiha ṣaṭśatam||
7.12.50 |  svabuddhyaivaṃ sahasrāṇi koṭīrvā 'pi prakalpayet|
*bahudravyavikalpatvādyogasaṃkhyā na vidyate||
7.12.51 |  tīkṣṇamadhyamṛdūnāṃ tu teṣāṃ śṛṇuta lakṣaṇam|
sukhaṃ kṣipraṃ mahāvegamasaktaṃ yat pravartate||
7.12.52 |  nātiglānikaraṃ pāyau hṛdaye na ca rukkaram|
antarāśayamakṣiṇvan kṛtsnaṃ doṣaṃ nirasyati||
7.12.53 |  virecanaṃ nirūho vā tattīkṣṇamiti nirdiśet|
jalāgnikīṭairaspṛṣṭaṃ deśakālaguṇānvitam||
7.12.54 |  īṣanmātrādhikairyuktaṃ tulyavīryaiḥ subhāvitam|
snehasvedopapannasya tīkṣṇatvaṃ yāti bheṣajam||
7.12.55 |  kiṃcidebhirguṇairhīnaṃ pūrvoktairmātrayā tathā|
snigdhasvinnasya vā samyaṅmadhyaṃ bhavati bheṣajam||
7.12.56 |  mandavīryaṃ virūkṣasya hīnamātraṃ tu bheṣajam|
atulyabīryaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ mṛdu syānmandavegavat||
7.12.57 |  akṛtsnadoṣaharaṇādaśuddhī te balīyasām|
madhyāvarabalānāṃ tu prayojye siddhimicchatā||
7.12.58 |  tīkṣṇo madhyo mṛdurvyādhiḥ sarvamadhyālpalakṣaṇaḥ|
tīkṣṇādīni *balāvekṣī bheṣajānyeṣu yojayet||
7.12.59 |  deyaṃ tvanirhṛte pūrvaṃ pīte paścāt punaḥ punaḥ|
bheṣajaṃ vamanārthīyaṃ prāya āpittadarśanāt||
7.12.60 |  *balatraividhyamālakṣya doṣāṇāmāturasya ca|
punaḥ pradadyādbhaiṣajyaṃ sarvaśo vā vivarjayet||
7.12.61 |  nirhṛte vā 'pi jīrṇe vā doṣanirharaṇe budhaḥ|
bheṣaje 'nyatprayuñjīta prārthayansiddhimuttamām||
7.12.62 |  apakvaṃ vamanaṃ *doṣaṃ pacyamānaṃ virecanam|
nirharedvamanasyātaḥ pākaṃ na pratipālayet||
7.12.63 |  pīte *prasraṃsane doṣānna nirhatya jarāṃ gate|
vamite cauṣadhe dhīraḥ pāyayedauṣadhaṃ punaḥ||
7.12.64 |  dīptāgniṃ bahudoṣaṃ tu dṛḍhasnehaguṇaṃ naram|
duḥśuddhaṃ tadaharbhuktaṃ śvobhūte pāyayet punaḥ||
7.12.65 |  durbalo bahudoṣaśca doṣapākena yo naraḥ|
viricyate *śanairbhojyairbhūyastamanusārayet||
7.12.66 |  vamanaiśca virekaiśca *viśuddhasyāpramāṇataḥ|
bhojanāntarapānābhyāṃ doṣaśeṣaṃ śamaṃ nayet||
7.12.67 |  durbalaṃ śodhitaṃ *pūrvamalpadoṣaṃ ca mānavam|
aparijñātakoṣṭhaṃ ca pāyayetauṣadhaṃ mṛdu||
7.12.68 |  śreyo mṛdvasakṛtpītamalpabādhaṃ niratyayam|
na cātitīkṣṇaṃ yat kṣipraṃ janayetprāṇasaṃśayam||
7.12.69 |  durbalo 'pi mahādoṣo virecyo bahuśo 'lpaśaḥ|
mṛdubhirbheṣajairdoṣā hanyurhyenamanirhṛtāḥ||
7.12.70 |  yasyordhvaṃ kaphasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ pītaṃ yātyānulomikam|
vamitaṃ kavalaiḥ śuddhaṃ laṅghitaṃ pāyayettu tam||
7.12.71 |  *vibaddhe 'lpe cirāddoṣe sravatyuṣṇaṃ pibejjalam|
tenādhmānaṃ tṛṣā cchardirvibandhaścaiva śāmyati||
7.12.72 |  bheṣajaṃ doṣaruddhaṃ cennordhvaṃ nādhaḥ pravartate|
sodgāraṃ *sāṅgaśūlaṃ ca svedaṃ tatrāvacārayet||
7.12.73 |  *suvirikte tu sodgāramāśvevauṣadhamullikhet|
*atipravartanaṃ jīrṇe suśītaiḥ stambhayedbhiṣak||
7.12.74 |  kadācicchleṣmaṇā ruddhaṃ tiṣṭhatyurasi bheṣajam|
kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi sāyāhne rātrau vā tatpravartate||
7.12.75 |  *rūkṣānāhārayorjīrṇe viṣṭabhyordhvaṃ gate 'pi vā|
vāyunā bheṣaje tvanyat sasnehalavaṇaṃ pibet||
7.12.76 |  tṛṇmohabhramamūrcchāyāḥ *syuścejjīryati bheṣaje|
pittaghnaṃ svādu śītaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ tatra śasyate||
7.12.77 |  *lālāhṛllāsaviṣṭambhalomaharṣāḥ kaphāvṛte|
bheṣajaṃ tatra tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ kaṭvādi kaphanuddhitam||
7.12.78 |  susnigdhaṃ krūrakoṣṭhaṃ ca laṅghayedavirecitam|
tenāsya snehajaḥ śleṣmā saṅgaścaivopaśāmyati||
7.12.79 |  rūkṣa-bahvanila-krūrakoṣṭha-*vyāyāmaśālinām|
dīptāgnīnāṃ ca bhaiṣajyamaviricyaiva jīryati||
7.12.80 |  tebhyo bastiṃ purā dattvā pañcāddadyādvirecanam|
*bastipravartitaṃ doṣaṃ harecchīghraṃ virecanam||
7.12.81 |  rūkṣāśanāḥ karmanityā ye narā dīptapāvakāḥ|
teṣāṃ doṣāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti *karmavātātapāgnibhiḥ||
7.12.82 |  viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇadoṣānapi sahanti te|
snehyāste mārutādrakṣyā nāvyādhau tān *viśodhayet||
7.12.83 |  nātisnigdhaśarīrāya dadyāt snehavirecanam|
snehotkliṣṭaśarīrāya rūkṣaṃ dadyādvirecanam||
7.12.84 |  evaṃ jñātvā vidhiṃ dhīro deśakālapramāṇavit|
virecanaṃ virecyebhyaḥ prayacchannāparādhyati||
7.12.85 |  vibhraṃśo viṣavadyasya prayacchānnāparādhyati|
kāleṣvavaśyaṃ peyaṃ ca tasmādyatnāt prayojayet||
7.12.86 |  dravyapramāṇaṃ tu yaduktamasminmadhyeṣu tat koṣṭhavayobaleṣu|
*tanmūlamālambya bhavedvikalpyaṃ teṣāṃ vikalpyo 'bhyadhikonabhāvaḥ||
7.12.87 |  ṣaḍ dhvaṃśyastu marīciḥ syāt ṣaṇmarīcyastu sarṣapaḥ|
aṣṭau te sarṣapā raktāstaṇḍulaścāpi taddvayam||
7.12.88 |  dhīnyamāṣo bhavedeko dhānyamāṣadvayaṃ yavaḥ|
aṇḍikā te tu catvārastāścatasrastu māṣakaḥ||
7.12.89 |  hemaśca dhānyakaścokto bhavecchāṇastu te trayaḥ|
śāṇau dvau draṅkṣaṇaṃ vidyāt kolaṃ badarameva ca||
7.12.90 |  vidyāddvau drakṣaṇau karṣaṃ suvarṇaṃ cākṣameva ca|
biḍālapadakaṃ caiva picuṃ pāṇitalaṃ tathā||
7.12.91 |  tindukaṃ ca vijānīyāt kavalagrahameva ca|
dve suvarṇe palārdhaṃ syācchuktiraṣṭamikā tathā||
7.12.92 |  dve palārdhe palaṃ muṣṭiḥ prakuñco 'tha caturthikā|
bilvaṃ ṣoḍaśikā cāmraṃ dve pale prasṛtaṃ vidhuḥ||
7.12.93 |  aṣṭamānaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ kuḍavau dvau tu mānikā|
palaṃ caturguṇaṃ vidyādañjaliṃ kuḍavaṃ tathā||
7.12.94 |  catvāraḥ kuḍavāḥ prasthaścatuḥprasthamathāḍhakam|
pātraṃ tadeva vijñeyaṃ kaṃsaḥ prasthāṣṭakaṃ tathā||
7.12.95 |  kaṃsaścaturguṇo droṇaścārmaṇaṃ nalvaṇaṃ ca tat|
sa eva kalaśaḥ khyāto ghaṭamunmānameva ca||
7.12.96 |  droṇastu dviguṇaḥ śūrpo vijñeyaḥ kumbha eva ca|
goṇīṃ śūrpadvayaṃ vidyāt khārīṃ bhāraṃ tathaiva ca||
7.12.97 |  dvātriṃśataṃ vijānīyādvāhaṃ śūrpāṇi buddhimān|
tulāṃ śatapalaṃ vidyāt parimāṇaviśāradaḥ||
7.12.98 |  śuṣkadravyeṣvidaṃ mānamevamādi prakīrtitam|
dviguṇaṃ taddraveṣviṣṭaṃ tathā sadyoddhṛteṣu ca||
7.12.99 |  *yaddhi mānaṃ tulā proktā palaṃ vā tat prayojayet|
anukte parimāṇe tu tulyaṃ mānaṃ prakīrtitam||
7.12.100 |  dravakārye 'pi cānukte sarvatra salilaṃ smṛtam|
yataśca pādanirdeśaścāturbhāgastataśca saḥ||
7.12.101 |  jalasnehauṣadhānāṃ tu pramāṇaṃ yatra *neritam|
tatra syādauṣadhāt snehaḥ snehāttoyaṃ caturguṇam||
7.12.102 |  snehapākastridhā jñeyo mṛdurmadhyaḥ kharastathā|
tulye kalkena niryāse bheṣajānāṃ mṛduḥ smṛtaḥ||
7.12.103 |  saṃyāva iva niryāse madhyo darvīṃ vimuñcati|
śīryamāṇe tu niryāse *vartamāne kharastathā||
7.12.104 |  kharo 'bhyaṅge smṛtaḥ kāko, mṛdurnastaḥkriyāsu ca|
madhyapākaṃ tu pānārthe bastau ca viniyojayet||
7.12.105 |  mānaṃ ca dvividhaṃ prāhuḥ kāliṅgaṃ māgadhaṃ tathā|
kāliṅgānmāgadhaṃ śreṣṭhamevaṃ mānavido viduḥ||
7.12.106 |  tatra ślokau---
kalpārthaḥ śodhanaṃ saṃjñā pṛthagghetuḥ pravartane|
deśādīnāṃ phalādīnāṃ guṇā yogaśatāni ṣaṭ||
7.12.107 |  vikalpaheturnāmāni tīkṣṇamadhyālpalakṣaṇam|
vidhiścāvasthiko mānaṃ snehapākaśca darśitaḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite kalpasthāne dantīdravantīkalpo nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||12 | |

saptamaṃ kalpasthānaṃ samāptam|

siddhisthānam|

prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.1.1 |  athātaḥ kalpanāsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.1.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.1.3 |  kā kalpanā pañcasu karmasūktā, kramaśca kaḥ, kiṃ ca kṛtākṛteṣu|
liṅgaṃ tathaivātikṛteṣu, saṃkyā kā, kiṃguṇaḥ, keṣu ca kaśca bastiḥ||
8.1.4 |  kiṃ varjanīyaṃ pratikarmakāle, kṛte kiyān vā parihārakālaḥ|
praṇīyamānaśca na yāti kena, kenaiti śīghraṃ, sucirācca bastiḥ||
8.1.5 |  *sādhyā gadāḥ svaiḥ śamanaiśca kecit kasmāt prayuktairna śamaṃ vrajanti|
*pracoditaḥ śiṣyavareṇa samyagityagniveśena bhiṣagvariṣṭhaḥ||
8.1.6 |  punarvasustantravidāha tasmai sarvaprajānāṃ hitakāmyayedam|
tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya *uktaḥ||
8.1.7 |  nātaḥ paraṃ snehanamādiśanti sātmyībhavet saptadināt paraṃ tu|
sneho 'nilaṃ hanti mṛdūkaroti dehaṃ malānāṃ vinihanti saṅgam||
8.1.8 |  snigdhasya sūkṣmeṣvayaneṣu līnaṃ svedastu doṣaṃ nayati dravatvam|
grāmyaudakānūparasaiḥ *samāṃsairutkleśanīyaḥ payasā ca vamyaḥ||
8.1.9 |  rasaistathā jāṅgalajaiḥ sayūṣaiḥ *snigdhaiḥ kaphāvṛddhikarairvirecyaḥ|
śleṣmottaraśchardayati *hyaduḥkhaṃ viricyate mandakaphastu samyak||
8.1.10 |  adhaḥ kaphe 'lpe vamanaṃ *virecayedvirecanaṃ vṛddhakaphe tathordhvam|
*snigdhāya deyaṃ vamanaṃ yathoktaṃ vāntasya peyādiranukramaśca||
8.1.11 |  snigdhasya susvinnatanoryathāvadvirecanaṃ yogyatamaṃ *prayojyam|
peyāṃ vilepīmakṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trirdvirathaikaśaśca||
8.1.12 |  krameṇa seveta viśuddhakāyaḥ pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ|
yathā 'ṇuragnistṛṇagomayādyaiḥ saṃdhukṣyamāṇo bhavati krameṇa||
8.1.13 |  mahān sthiraḥ *sarvapacastathaiva śuddhasya peyādibhirantaragniḥ|
jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau||
8.1.14 |  daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthastathā dvitricaturguṇaśca|
pittāntamiṣṭaṃ vamanaṃ virekādardhaṃ kaphāntaṃ ca virekamāhuḥ||
8.1.15 |  dvitrān saviṭkānapanīya vegānmeyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītam|
kramāt kaphaḥ pittamathānilaśca yasyaiti samyagvamitaḥ sa iṣṭaḥ||
8.1.16 |  hṛtpārśvamūrdhendriyamārgaśuddhau tathā laghutve 'pi ca lakṣyamāṇe|
duśchardite sphoṭakakoṭhakaṇḍūhṛtkhāviśuddhirgurugātratā ca||
8.1.17 |  tṛṇmohamūrchānilakopanidrā-*balādihānirvamane 'ti ca syāt|
srotoviśuddhīndriyasaṃprasādau laghutvamūrjo 'gniranāmayatvam||
8.1.18 |  prāptiśca viṭpittakaphānilānāṃ samyagviriktasya bhavet krameṇa|
syācchleṣmapittānilasaṃprakopaḥ sādastathā+*agnergurutā pratiśyā||
8.1.19 |  tandrā tathā cchardirarocakaśca vātānulomyaṃ na ca durvirikte|
kaphāsrapittakṣayajānilotthāḥ suptyaṅgamardaklamavepanādyāḥ||
8.1.20 |  nidrābalābhāvatamaḥpraveśāḥ sonmādahikkāśca virecite 'ti|
saṃsṛṣṭabhaktaṃ navame 'hni sarpistaṃ pāyayetāpyanuvāsayedvā||
8.1.21 |  tailāktagātrāya tato nirūhaṃ dadyāttryahānnātibubhukṣitāya|
pratyāgate dhanvarasena bhojyaḥ samīkṣya vā doṣabalaṃ *yathārham||
8.1.22 |  narastato viśyanuvāsanārho nātyāśitaḥ *syādanuvāsanīyaḥ|
śīte vasante ca divā 'nuvāsyo rātrau śaradgrīṣmaghanāgameṣu||
8.1.23 |  tāneva doṣān parirakṣatā ye snehasya pāne parikīrtitāḥ prāk|
pratyāgate cāpyanuvāsanīye divā pradeyaṃ vyuṣitāya bhojyam||
8.1.24 |  sāyaṃ ca bhojyaṃ parato dvyahe vā tryahe 'nuvāsyo 'hani pañcame *vā|
tryahe tryahe vā+*apyatha pañcame vā dadyānnirūhādanuvāsanaṃ ca||
8.1.25 |  ekaṃ tathā trīn kaphaje vikāre pittātmake pañca tu sapta vā 'pi|
vāte navaikādaśa vā punarvā bastīnayugmān kuśalo vidadhyāt||
8.1.26 |  naro viriktastu nirūhadānaṃ vivarjayet saptadinānyavaśyam|
śuddho nirūheṇa virecanaṃ ca taddhyasya śūnyaṃ vikaseccharīram||
8.1.27 |  bastirvayaḥsthāpayitā sukhāyurbalāgnimedhāsvaravarṇakṛcca|
sarvārthakārī śiśuvṛddhayūnāṃ niratyayaḥ sarvagadāpahaśca||
8.1.28 |  *viṭśleṣmapittānilamūtrakarṣī dārḍhyāvahaḥ śukrabalapradaśca|
viśvaksthitaṃ doṣacayaṃ nirasya sarvān vikārān śamayennirūhaḥ||
8.1.29 |  dehe nirūheṇa viśuddhamārge saṃsnehanaṃ varṇabalapradaṃ ca|
na tailadānāt paramasti kiñciddravyaṃ viśeṣeṇa *samīraṇārte||
8.1.30 |  snehena raukṣyaṃ laghutāṃ gurutvādauṣṇyācca śaityaṃ pavanasya hatvā|
tailaṃ dadātyāśu manaḥprasādaṃ *vīryaṃ balaṃ *varṇamathāgnipuṣṭim||
8.1.31 |  mūle niṣikto hi yathā drumaḥ syānnīlacchadaḥ komalapallavāgryaḥ|
kāle mahān puṣpaphalapradaśca tathā naraḥ syādanuvāsanena||
8.1.32 |  stabdhāśca ye saṅkucitāśca ye 'pi ye paṅgavo ye 'pi ca bhagnarugṇāḥ|
yeṣāṃ ca śākhāsu caranti vātāḥ śasto viśeṣeṇa hi teṣu bastiḥ||
8.1.33 |  *ādhmāpane vigrathite purīṣe śūle ca bhaktānabhinandane ca|
evaṃprakārāśca bhavanti kukṣau ye cāmayāsteṣu ca bstiriṣṭaḥ||
8.1.34 |  yāśca striyo *vātakṛtopasargā garbhaṃ na nṛhṇanti nṛbhiḥ sametāḥ|
kṣīṇendriyā ye ca narāḥ kṛśāśca *bastiḥ praśastaḥ paraṃ ca teṣu||
8.1.35 |  uṣṇābhibhūteṣu vadanti śītāñchītābhibhūteṣu tathā sukhoṣṇān|
tatpratyanīkauṣadhasaṃprayuktān sarvatra bastīn pravibhajya *yuñjyāt||
8.1.36 |  na bṛṃhaṇīyān vidadhīta bastīn viśodhanīyeṣu gadeṣu vaidyaḥ|
kuṣṭhapramehādiṣu medureṣu nareṣu ye cāpi viśodhanīyāḥ||
8.1.37 |  kṣīṇakṣatānāṃ na viśodhanīyānna śoṣiṇāṃ no bhṛśadurbalānām|
na mūrcchitānāṃ na viśodhitānāṃ yeṣāṃ ca doṣeṣu nibaddhamāyuḥ||
8.1.38 |  śākhāgatāḥ koṣṭhagatāśca rogā marmordhvasarvāvayavāṅgajāśca|
ye santi teṣāṃ na hi kaścidanyo vāyoḥ paraṃ janmani heturasti||
8.1.39 |  *viṇmūtrapittādimalāśayānāṃ vikṣepasṃghātakaraḥ sa yasmāt|
tasyātivṛddhasya śamāya nānyadbastiṃ vinā bheṣajamasti kiñcit||
8.1.40 |  tasmāccikitsārdhamiti bruvanti sarvāṃ cikitsāmapi bastimeke|
nābhipradeśaṃ kaṭipārśvakukṣiṃ gatvā śakṛddoṣacayaṃ *viloḍya||
8.1.41 |  saṃsnehya kāyaṃ sapurīṣadoṣaḥ samyak sukhenaiti ca yaḥ sa *bastiḥ|
prasṛṣṭaviṇmūtrasamīraṇatvaṃ rucyagnivṛddhyāśayalāghavāni||
8.1.42 |  rogopaśāntiḥ prakṛtisthatā ca balaṃ ca tat syāt sunirūḍhaliṅgam|
*syādrukchirohṛdgudabastiliṅge śophaḥ pratiśyāyavikartike ca||
8.1.43 |  hṛllāsikā mārutamūtrasaṅgaḥ śvāso na samyak ca *nirūhite syuḥ|
liṅgaṃ yadevātivirecitasya bhavettadevātinirūhitasya||
8.1.44 |  pratyetyasaktaṃ saśakṛcca tailaṃ *raktādibuddhīndriyasaṃprasādaḥ|
svapnānuvṛttirlaghutā balaṃ ca sṛṣṭāśca vegāḥ svanuvāsite syuḥ||
8.1.45 |  adhaḥśarīrodarabāhupṛṣṭhapārśveṣu rugrūkṣakharaṃ ca *gātram|
grahaśca *viṇmūtrasamīraṇānāmasamyagetānyanuvāsitasya||
8.1.46 |  hṛllāsamohaklamasādamūrcchā vikartikā cātyanuvāsitasya|
yasyeha yāmānanuvartate trīn sneho naraḥ syāt sa viśuddhadehaḥ||
8.1.47 |  āśvāgate 'nyastu punarvidheyaḥ sneho na saṃsnehayati hyatiṣṭhan|
triṃśanmatāḥ *karma nu bastayo hi kālastato 'rdhena tataśca yogaḥ||
8.1.48 |  sānvāsanā dvādaśa vai nirūhāḥ prāk sneha ekaḥ parataśca pañca|
*kāle trayo 'nte puratastathaikaḥ snehā nirūhāntaritāśca ṣaṭ syuḥ||
8.1.49 |  *yoge nirūhāstraya eva deyāḥ snehāśca pañcaiva parādimadhyāḥ|
trīn pañca vā++āhuścaturo 'tha ṣaṭvā *vātādikānāmanuvāsanīyān||
8.1.50 |  snehān pradāyāśu bhiṣagvidadhyāt srotoviśuddhyarthamato nirūhān|
*niśuddhadehasya tataḥ krameṇa snigdhaṃ talasveditamuttamāṅgam||
8.1.51 |  virecayettrirdvirathaikaśo vā balaṃ samīkṣya trividhaṃ malānām|
*uraḥśirolāghavamindriyācchyaṃ srotoviśuddhiśca bhavedviśuddhe||
8.1.52 |  galopalepaḥ śiraso gurutvaṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ cāpyatha durvirikte|
śirokṣiśaṅkhaśravaṇārtitodāvatyarthaśuddhe timiraṃ ca paśyet||
8.1.53 |  syāttarpaṇaṃ tatra mṛdu dravaṃ ca snigdhasya tīkṣṇaṃ tu punarna yoge|
ityāturasvasthasukhaḥ *prayogo balāyuṣorvṛddhikṛdāmayaghnaḥ||
8.1.54 |  kālastu bastyādiṣu yāti yāvāṃstāvān bhaveddviḥ parihārakālaḥ|
atyāsanasthānavacāṃsi yānaṃ svapnaṃ divā maithunavegarodhān||
8.1.55 |  śītopacārātapaśokaroṣāṃstyajedakālāhitabhojanaṃ ca|
baddhe praṇīte *viṣamaṃ ca netre mārge *tathā 'rśaḥkaphaviḍvibaddhe||
8.1.56 |  na yāti bastirna sukhaṃ nireti doṣāvṛto 'lpo yadi vā 'lpavīryaḥ|
prāpte tu varconilamūtravege vāte+*ativṛddhe 'lpabale gude vā||
8.1.57 |  atyuṣṇatīkṣṇaśca mṛdau ca koṣṭhe praṇītamātraḥ punareti bastiḥ|
medaḥkaphābhyāmanilo niruddhaḥ *śūlāṅgasuptiśvayathūn karoti||
8.1.58 |  snehaṃ tu yuñjannabudhastu tasmai saṃvardhayatyeva hi tān vikārān|
rogāstathā 'nye 'pyavitarkyamāṇāḥ paraspareṇāvagṛhītamārgāḥ||
8.1.59 |  saṃdūṣitā dhātubhireva cānyaiḥ svairbheṣajairnopaśamaṃ vrajanti|
sarvaṃ ca rogapraśamāya karma hīnātimātraṃ viparītakālam||
8.1.60 |  mithyopacārācca na taṃ vikāraṃ śāntiṃ nayet pathyamapi prayuktam|
tatra ślokaḥ---
praśnānimān dvādaśa pañcakarmāṇyuddiśya siddhāviha kalpanāyām||
8.1.61?| prajāhitārhtaṃ bhagavān mahārthān samyagjagādarṣivaro 'triputraḥ|

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne kalpanāsiddhirnāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1 | |

dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.2.1 |  athātaḥ *pañcakarmīyāṃ siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.2.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.2.3 |  yeṣāṃ yasmāt pañcakarmāṇyagniveśa na kārayet|
yeṣāṃ ca kārayettāni tat sarvaṃ saṃpravakṣyate||
8.2.4 |  caṇḍaḥ sāhasiko bhīruḥ kṛtaghno vyagra eva ca|
*sadrājabhiṣajāṃ dveṣṭā taddviṣṭaḥ śokapīḍitaḥ||
8.2.5 |  yādṛcchiko mumūrṣuśca vihīnaḥ karaṇaiśca yaḥ|
vairī vaidyavidagdhaśca śradvāhīnaḥ suśaṅkitaḥ||
8.2.6 |  bhiṣajāmavidheyaśca nopakramyā bhiṣagvidā|
etānupacaran vaidyo bahūn doṣānavāpnuyāt||
8.2.7 |  ebhyo 'nye samupakramyā narāḥ sarvairupakramaiḥ|
avasthāṃ pravibhajyaiṣāṃ varjyaṃ kāryaṃ ca vakṣyate||
8.2.8 |  avamyāstāvat-kṣatakṣīṇātisthūlātikṛśabālavṛddhadurbalaśrāntapipāsitakṣudhitakarmabhārādhvahatopavāsamaithunādhyayanavyāyāmacintāprasaktakṣāmagarbhiṇīsukumārasaṃvṛtakoṣṭhaduśchardanordhvaraktapittaprasaktacchardirūrdhvavātāsthāpitānuvāsitahṛdrogodāvartamūtrāghātaplīhagulmodarāṣṭhīlāsvaropaghātatimiraśiraḥśaṅkhakarṇākṣiśūlārtāḥ||
8.2.9 |  tatra kṣatasya bhūyaḥ kṣaṇanādraktātipravṛttiḥ syāt, kṣīṇātisthūlakṛśabālavṛddhadurbalānāmauṣadhabalāsahatvāt prāṇoparodhaḥ, śrāntapipāsitakṣudhitānāṃ ca tadvat, karmabhārādhvahatopavāsamaithunādhyayanavyātadvat, karmabhārādhvahatopavāsamaithunādhyayanavyātadvat, karmabhārādhvahatopavāsamaithunādhyayanavyāyāmacintāprasaktakṣāmāṇāṃ raukṣyādvātaraktacchedakṣatabhayaṃ syāt, garbhiṇyā garbhavyāpadāmagarbhabhraṃśācca dāruṇā rogaprāptiḥ, sukumārasya *hṛdayāpakarṣaṇādūrdhvamadho vā rukhirātipravṛttiḥ, saṃvṛtakoṣṭhakuśchardanayoratimātrapravāhaṇāddoṣāḥ samutkliṣṭā *antaḥkoṣṭhe janayantyantarvisarpaṃ stambhaṃ jāḍyaṃ vaicittyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā, ūrdhvagaraktapittina udānasmutkṣipya prāṇān haredraktaṃ cātipravartayet, prasaktacchardestadvat, ūrdhvavātāsthāpitānuvāsitānāmūrdhvaṃ vātātipravṛttiḥ, hṛdrogiṇo hṛdayoparodhaḥ, udāvartino ghoratara udāvartaḥ syācchīghratarahantā, mūtrāghātādibhirārtānāṃ tīvrataraśūlaprādurbhāvaḥ, timirārtānāṃ timirātivṛddhiḥ, śiraḥśūlādiṣu śūlātivṛddhiḥ; tasmādete na vamyāḥ|
sarveṣvapi tu khalveteṣu viṣagaraviruddhājīrṇābhyavahārāmakṛteṣvapratiṣiddhaṃ *śīghratarakāritvādeṣāmiti||
8.2.10 |  śoṣāstu vamyāḥ; *viśeṣatastu pīnasakuṣṭhanavajvararājayakṣmakāsaśvāsagalagrahagalagaṇḍaślīpadamehamandāgniviruddhājīrṇānnavisūcikālasakaviṣagarapītadaṣṭadigdhāviddhādhaḥśoṇitapittapraseka(*durnāma)hṛllāsārocakāvipākāpacyapasmāronmādātisāraśophapāṇḍurogamukhapākaduṣṭastanyādayaḥ śleṣmavyādhayo viśeṣeṇa mahārogādhyāyoktāśca; eteṣu hi vamanaṃ pradhānatamamityuktaṃ kedārasetubhede śālyādyaśoṣadoṣavināśavat||
8.2.11 |  avirecyāstu subhagakṣatagudamuktanālādhobhāgaraktapittivilaṅghitadurbalendriyālpāgninirūḍhakāmādivyagrājīrṇinavajvarimadātyayitādhmātaśalyārditābhihatātisnigdharūkṣadāruṇakoṣṭhāḥ kṣatādayaśca garbhiṇyantāḥ||
8.2.12 |  tatra subhagasya sukumārokto doṣaḥ syāt, kṣatagudasya kṣate gude prāṇoparodhakarīṃ rujāṃ janayet, muktanālamatipravṛttyā hanyāt, adhobhāgaraktapittinaṃ tadvat, vilaṅghitadurbalendriyālpāgninirūḍhā auṣadhavegaṃ na saheran, kāmādivyagramanaso na pravartate kṛcchreṇa vā pravartamānamayogadoṣān kuryāt, ajīrṇina āmadoṣaḥ syāt, navajrariṇo 'vipakvān doṣān na virhared vātameva ca kopayet, madātyayitasya madyakṣīṇe dehe vāyuḥ prāṇoparodhaṃ kuryāt, ādhmātasyādhamato vā *purīṣakoṣṭhe nicito vāyurvisarpan sahasā++ānāhaṃ tīvrataraṃ maraṇaṃ vā janayet, śalyārditābhihatayoḥ kṣate vāyurāśrito jīvitaṃ hiṃsyāt, atisnigdhasyātiyogabhayaṃ bhavet, rūkṣasya vāyuraṅgapragrahaṃ kuryāt, dāruṇakoṣṭhasya virecanoddhatā doṣā hṛcchūlaparvabhedānāhāṅgamardacchardimūrcchāklamāñjanayitvā prāṇān hanyuḥ, kṣatādīnāṃ garbhiṇyantānāṃ chardanokto doṣaḥ syāt; tasmādete na virecyāḥ||
8.2.13 |  śeṣāstu virecyāḥ; viśeṣatastu kuṣṭhajvaramehordhvaraktapittabhagandarodarārśobradhnaplīhagulmārbudagalagaṇḍagranthivisūcikālasakamūtrāghātakrimikoṣṭhavisarpapāṇḍurogaśiraḥpārśvaśūlodāvartanetrāsyadāhahṛdrogavyaṅganīlikā*netranāsikāsyasravaṇahalīmakaśvāsakāsakāmalāpacyapasmāronmādavātaraktayoniretodoṣataimiryārocakāvipākacchardiśvayathūdaravisphoṭakādayaḥ pittavyādhayo viśeṣeṇa mahārogādhyāyoktāśca; eteṣu hi virecanaṃ pradhānatamamityuktamagnyupaśame 'gnigṛhavat||
8.2.14 |  anāsthāpyāstu-ajīrṇyatisnigdhapītasnehotkliṣṭadoṣālpāgniyānaklāntātidurbalakṣuttṛṣṇāśramārtātikṛśabhuktabhaktapītodakavamitaviriktakṛtanastaḥkarmakuddhabhītamattamūrcchitaprasaktacchardiniṣṭhīvikāśvāsakāsahikkābaddhacchidrodakodarādhmānālasakavisūcikāmaprajātāmātisāramadhumehakuṣṭhārtāḥ||
8.2.15 |  tatrājīrṇyatisnigdhapītasnehānāṃ dūṣyodaraṃ mūrcchā śvayathurvā syāt, utkliṣṭadoṣamandāgnyorarocakastīvraḥ, yānaklāntasya kṣobhavyāpanno bastirāśu dehaṃ śoṣayet, atidurbalakṣuttṛṣṇāśramārtānāṃ pūrvokto doṣaḥ syāt, atikṛśasya kārśyaṃ punarjanayet, bhuktabhaktapītodakayorutkliśyordhvamadho *vā vāyurbastimutkṣipya kṣipraṃ ghorān vikārāñjanayet, vamitaviriktayostu rūkṣaṃ śarīraṃ nirūhaḥ kṣataṃ kṣār iva dahet, kṛtanastaḥkarmaṇo vibhraṃśaṃ *bhṛśasaṃruddhasrotasaḥ kuryāt, kuddhabhītayorbastirūrdhvamupaplavet, mattamūrcchitayorbhṛśaṃ vicalitāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ cittopaghātād vyāpat syāt, prasaktacchardirniṣṭhīvikāśvāsakāsahikkārtānāmūrdhvībhūto vāyurūrdhvaṃ bastiṃ nayet, baddhacchidrodakodarādhmānārtānāṃ bhṛśataramādhyāpya bastiḥ prāṇān hiṃsyāt, alasakavisūcikāmaprajātāmātisāriṇāmāmakṛto doṣaḥ syāt, madhumehakuṣṭhinorvyādheḥ punarvṛddhiḥ; tasmādete nāsthāpyāḥ||
8.2.16 |  śeṣāstvāsthāpyāḥ; viśeṣatastu sarvāṅgaikāṅgakukṣirogavātavarcomūtraśukrasaṅgabalavarṇamāṃsaretaḥkṣayadoṣādhmānāṅgasuptikrimikoṣṭhodāvartaśuddhātisāraparvabhedābhitāpaplīhagulmaśūlahṛdrogabhagandaronmādajvarabradhnaśiraḥkarṇaśūlahṛdayapārśvapṛṣṭhakaṭīgrahavepanākṣepakagauravātilāghavarajaḥkṣayārtaviṣamāgnisphigjānujaṅghorugulphapārṣṇiprapadayoni*bāhvaṅgulistanāntadantasnakhaparvāsthiśūlaśoṣastambhāntrakūjaparikartikālpālpasaśabdogragandhotthānādayo vātavyādhayoviśeṣeṇa mahārogādhyāyoktāśca; eteṣvāsthāpanaṃ pradhānatamamityuktaṃ vanaspatimūlacchedavat||
8.2.17 |  ya evānāsthāpyāsta evānanuvāsyāḥ syuḥ; viśeṣatastvabhuktabhaktanavajvarapāṇḍurogakāmalāpramehārśaḥpratiśyāyārocakamandāgnidurbalaplīhakaphodarorustambhavarcobhedaviṣagara*pītapittakaphābhiṣyandagurukoṣṭhaślīpadagalagaṇḍāpacikrimikoṣṭhinaḥ||
8.2.18 |  tatrābhuktabhaktasyānāvṛtamārgatvādūrdhvamativartate snehaḥ, navajvarapāṇḍurogakāmalāpramehiṇāṃ doṣānutkliśyodaraṃ janayet, arśasasyārśāṃsyabhiṣyandyādhmānaṃ kuryāt, arocakārtasyānnagṛddhiṃ punarhanyāt, mandāgnidurbalayormandataramagniṃ kuryāt, pratiśyāyaplīhādimatāṃ bhṛśamutkliṣṭadoṣāṇāṃ bhūya eva doṣaṃ vardhayet; tasmādete nānuvāsyāḥ||
8.2.19 |  ya evāsthāpyāsta evānuvāsyāḥ; viśeṣatastu rūkṣatīkṣṇāgnayaḥ kevalavātarogārtāśca; eteṣu hyanuvāsanaṃ pradhānatamamityuktaṃ mūle drumaprasekavat||
8.2.20 |  aśirovirecanārhāstu ajīrṇibhuktabhaktapītasnehamadyatoyapātukāmāḥ snātaśirāḥ snātukāmaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇāśramārtamattamūrcchitaśastradaṇḍahatavyavāyavyāyāmapānaklāntanavajvaraśokābhitaptaviriktānuvāsitagarbhiṇīnavapratiśyāyārtāḥ, anṛtau durdine ceti||
8.2.21 |  tatrājīrṇibhuktabhaktayordoṣa ūrdhvavahāni srotāṃsyāvṛtya kāsaśvāsacchardipratiśyāyāñjanayet, pītasnehamadyatoyapātukāmānāṃ kṛte ca pibatāṃ mukhanāsāsrāvākṣyupadehatimiraśirorogāñjanayet, snātaśirasaḥ kṛte ca *snānācchirasaḥ pratiśyāyaṃ, kṣudhārtasya vātaprakopaṃ, tṛṣṇārtasya punastṛṣṇābhivṛddhi mukhaśoṣaṃ ca, śramārtamattamūrcchitānāmāsthāpanoktaṃ doṣaṃ janayet, śastradaṇḍahatayostīvratarāṃ rujaṃ janayet, vyavāyavyāyāmapānaklāntānāṃ śiraḥskandhanetroraḥpīḍanaṃ, navajvaraśokābhitaptayorūṣmā netranāḍīranusṛtya timiraṃ jvaravṛddhiṃ ca kuryāt, viriktasya vāyurindriyopaghātaṃ kuryāt, viriktasya vāyurindriyopaghātaṃ kuryāt, anuvāsitasya kaphaḥ śirogurutvakaṇḍūkrimidoṣāñjanayet, garbhiṇyā garbhaṃ stambhayet sa kāṇaḥ kuṇiḥ pakṣahataḥ pīṭhasarpī vā jāyate, navapratiśyāyārtasya srotāṃsi vyāpādayet, anṛtau durdine ca śītadoṣān pūtinasyaṃ śirorogaṃ ca janayet; tasmādete na śirovirecanārhāḥ||
8.2.22 |  śeṣāstvarhāḥ, viśeṣatastu śirodantamanyāstambhagalahanugrahapīnasagalaśuṇḍikāśālūkaśukratimiravartmarogavyaṅgopajihvikārdhāvabhedakagrīvāskandhāṃsāsyanāsikākarṇākṣimūrdhakapālaśirorogārditāpatantrakāpatānakagalagaṇḍadantaśūlaharṣa cālākṣirājyarbudasvarabhedavāggrahagadgadakrathanādaya ūrdhvajatrugatāśca vātādivikārāḥ paripakvāśca; eteṣu śirovirecanaṃ pradhānatamamityuktaṃ, taddhyutāmāṅgamanupraviśya muñjādīṣikāmivāsaktāṃ kevalaṃ vikārakaraṃ doṣamapakarṣati||
8.2.23 |  prāvṛṭśaradvasantetareṣvātyayikeṣu rogeṣu nāvanaṃ kuryāt kṛtrimaguṇopadhānāt; grīṣme pūrvāhṇe, śīte madhyāhne, varṣāsvadurdine ceti||
8.2.24 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
iti pañcavidhaṃ karma vistareṇa nidarśitam|
yebhyo yanna hitaṃ yasmāt karma yebhyaśca yaddhitam||
8.2.25 |  *na vaikāntena nirdiṣṭe 'pyarthe 'bhiniviśedbudhaḥ|
svayamapyatra *vaidyena tarkyaṃ buddhimatā bhavet||
8.2.26 |  utpadyeta hi sā 'vasthā deśakālabalaṃ prati|
yasyāṃ kāryamakāryaṃ *syāt karma kāryaṃ ca varjitam||
8.2.27 |  chardirhṛdrogagulmānāṃ vamanaṃ sve cikitsite|
avasthāṃ prāpya nirdiṣṭaṃ *kuṣṭhināṃ bastikarma ca||
8.2.28 |  tasmāt satyapi nirdeśe kuryādūhya svayaṃ dhiyā|
vinā tarkeṇa yā siddhiryadṛcchāsiddhireva sā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne pañcakarmīyasiddhirnāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||2 | |

tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.3.1 |  athāto *bastisūtrīyāṃ siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.3.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.3.3 |  kṛtakṣaṇaṃ śailavarasya ramye sthitaṃ dhaneśāyatanasya pārśve|
maharṣisaṅghairvṛtamagniveśaḥ punarvasuṃ prāñjaliranvapṛcchat||
8.3.4 |  bastirnarebhyaḥ kimapekṣya dattaḥ syāt siddhimān kimmayamasya netram|
kīdṛkpramāṇākṛti kiṅguṇaṃ ca kebhyaśca kiṃyoniguṇaśca bastiḥ||
8.3.5 |  nirūhakalpaḥ praṇidhānamātrā snehasya kā vā śayane vidhiḥ kaḥ|
ke bastayaḥ keṣu hitā itīdaṃ śrutvottaraṃ prāha vaco maharṣiḥ||
8.3.6 |  *samīkṣya doṣauṣadhadeśakālasātmyāgnisattvādivayobalāni|
bastiḥ prayukto niyataṃ guṇāya syāt sarvakarmāṇi ca siddhimanti||
8.3.7 |  *suvarṇarūpyatraputāmrarītikāṃsyāsthiśastradrumaveṇudantaiḥ|
nalairviṣāṇairmaṇibhiśca taistairnetrāṇi kāryāṇi *su(tri)karṇikāni||
8.3.8 |  ṣaḍdvādaśāṣṭāṅgulasaṃmitāni ṣaḍviṃśatidvādaśavarṣajānām|
syurmudgakarkandhusatīnavāhicchidrāṇi vartyā 'pihitāni caiva||
8.3.9 |  yathāvayo 'ṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ mūlāgrayoḥ syuḥ pariṇāhavanti|
ṛjūni gopucchasamākṛtīni ślakṣṇāni ca syurguḍikāmukhāni||
8.3.10 |  syāt karṇikaikā 'gracaturthabhāge mūlāśrite bastinibandhane dve|
jāradgavo māhiṣahāriṇau vā syācchaukaro bastirajasya vā 'pi||
8.3.11 |  hṛḍhastanurnaṣṭasiro vigandhaḥ kaṣāyaraktaḥ sumṛduḥ *suśuddhaḥ|
nṛṇāṃ vayo vīkṣya yathānurūpaṃ retreṣu yojyastu subaddhamūtraḥ||
8.3.12 |  bsteralābhe plavajo galo vā syādaṅkapādaḥ sughanaḥ paṭo vā|
āsthāpanārhaṃ puruṣaṃ vidhijñaḥ samīkṣya puṇye 'hani śuklapakṣe||
8.3.13 |  praśastanakṣatramuhūrtayoge *jīrṇānnamekāgramupakrameta|
balāṃ guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ sarāsnāṃ dve pañcamūle ca palonmitāni||
8.3.14 |  aṣṭau phalānyardhatulāṃ ca māṃsācchāgāt pacedapsu caturthaśeṣam|
pūtaṃ yavānīphalabilvakuṣṭhavacāśatāhvāghanapippalīnām||
8.3.15 |  kalkairguḍakṣaudraghṛtaiḥ satailairyutaṃ sukhoṣṇaistu picupramāṇaiḥ|
guḍāt palaṃ dviprasṛtāṃ tu mātrāṃ snehasya yuktyā madhu *saindhavaṃ ca||
8.3.16 |  prakṣipya bastau mathitaṃ khajena *subaddhamucchvāsya ca nirvalīkam|
aṅguṣṭhamadhyena mukhaṃ pidhāya netrāgrasaṃsthāmapanīya vartim||
8.3.17 |  tailāktagātraṃ kṛtamūtraviṭkaṃ nātikṣudhārtaṃ śayane manuṣyam|
*same 'thaveṣannataśīrṣake vā nātyucchrite svāstaraṇopapanne||
8.3.18 |  savyena pārśvena sukhaṃ śayānaṃ kṛtvarjudehaṃ svabhujopadhānam|
*saṅkocya savyetaradasya sakthi vāmaṃ prasārya praṇayettatastam||
8.3.19 |  snigdhe gude netracaturthabhāgaṃ snigdhaṃ *śanairṛjvanu pṛṣṭhavaṃśam|
akampanāvepanalāghavādīn pāṇyorguṇāṃścāpi *vidarśayaṃstam||
8.3.20 |  prapīḍya caikagrahaṇena dattaṃ netraṃ śanaireva tato 'pakarṣet|
tiryak praṇīte tu na yāti dhārā gude vraṇaḥ syāccalite tu netre||
8.3.21 |  dattaḥ śanairnāśayameti bastiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ pradhāvatyatipīḍitaśca|
śītastvatistambhakaro vidāhaṃ mūrcchāṃ ca kuryādatimātramuṣṇaḥ||
8.3.22 |  snigdho 'tijāḍyaṃ pavanaṃ tu rūkṣastanvalpamātrālavaṇastvayogam|
karoti mātrābhyadhiko 'tiyogaṃ kṣāmaṃ tu sāndraḥ sucireṇa caiti||
8.3.23 |  dāhātisārau lavaṇo 'ti kuryāttasmāt suyuktaṃ samameva dadyāt|
pūrvaṃ hi dadyānmadhu saindhavaṃ tu snehaṃ vinirmathya tato 'nu kalkam||
8.3.24 |  vimathya saṃyojya punardravaistaṃ bastau *nidadhyānmathitaṃ khajena|
*vāmāśraye hi grahaṇīgude ca tat pārśvasaṃsthasya sukhopalabdhiḥ||
8.3.25 |  līyanta evaṃ valayaśca tasmāt savyaṃ śayāno 'rhati bastidānam|
viḍvātavego yadi cārdhadatte niṣkṛṣya mukte *praṇayedaśeṣam||
8.3.26 |  uttānadehaśca kṛtopadhānaḥ syādvīryamāpnoti tathā 'sya *deham|
eko 'pakarṣatyanilaṃ svamārgāt pittaṃ dvitīyastu kaphaṃ tṛtīyaḥ||
8.3.27 |  pratyāgate koṣṇajalāvasiktaḥ śālyannamadyāttanunā rasena|
jīrṇe tu sāyaṃ laghu cālpamātraṃ bhukto 'nuvāsyaḥ parivṛṃhaṇārtham||
8.3.28 |  nirūhapādāṃśasamena tailenāmlānilaghnauṣadhasādhitena|
dattvā sphicau pāṇitalena hanyāt snehasya śīghrāgamarakṣaṇārtham||
8.3.29 |  *īṣacca pādāṅguliyugmamāñcheduttānadehasya talau pramṛjyāt|
snehena pārṣṇyaṅgulipiṇḍikāśca ye cāsya gātrāvayavā rugārtāḥ||
8.3.30 |  tāṃścāvamṛdgīta sukhaṃ tataśca nidrāmupāsīta kṛtopadhānaḥ|
bhāgāḥ kaṣāyasya tu pañca, pitte snehasya ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakṛtau sthite ca||
8.3.31 |  vāte vivṛddhe tu caturthabhāgo, mātrā nirūheṣu kaphe 'ṣṭabhāgaḥ|
nirūhamātrā prasṛtārdhamādye varṣe tato 'rdhaprasṛtābhivṛddhiḥ||
8.3.32 |  ādvādaśāt syāt prasṛtābhivṛddhirāṣṭādaśād dvādaśataḥ paraṃ syuḥ|
*āsaptatestadvihitaṃ pramāṇamataḥ paraṃ ṣoḍaśavadvidheyam||
8.3.33 |  nirūhamātrā prasṛtapramāṇā bāle ca vṛddhe ca mṛdurviśeṣaḥ|
nātyucchritaṃ nāpyatinīcapādaṃ sapādapīṭhaṃ śayanaṃ praśastam||
8.3.34 |  pradhānamṛdvāstaraṇopapannaṃ prākśīrṣakaṃ śuklapaṭottarīyam|
bhojyaṃ punarvyādhimavekṣya *tadvat prakalpayedyūṣapayorasādyaiḥ||
8.3.35 |  sarveṣu vidyādvidhimetamādyaṃ vakṣyāmi bastīnata uttarīyān|
dvipañcamūlasya raso 'mlayuktaḥ sacchāgamāṃsasya sapūrvapeṣyaḥ||
8.3.36 |  trisnehayuktaḥ pravaro nirūhaḥ sarvānilavyādhiharaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ|
sthirādivargasya balāpaṭolatrāyantikairaṇḍayavairyutasya||
8.3.37 |  prastho rasācchāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamastu yāvat|
priyaṅgukṛṣṇāghanakalkayuktaḥ atailasarpirmadhusaindhavaśca||
8.3.38 |  syāddīpano māṃsabalapradaśca cakṣurbalaṃ cāpi dadāti *bastiḥ|
eraṇḍamūlaṃ tripalaṃ *palāśā hrasvāni mūlāni ca yāni pañca||
8.3.39 |  rāsnāśvagandhātibalāguḍūcīpunarnavāragvadhadevadāru|
bhāgāḥ palāṃśā *madanāṣṭayuktā jaladvikaṃse kvathite 'ṣṭaśeṣe||
8.3.40 |  peṣyāḥ śatāhvā hapuṣā priyaṅguḥ sapippalīkaṃ madhukaṃ *balā ca|
rasāñjanaṃ vatsakabījamustaṃ *bhāgākṣamātraṃ lavaṇāṃśayuktam||
8.3.41 |  samākṣikastailayutaḥ samūtro bastirnṛṇāṃ dīpanalekhanīyaḥ|
jaṅghorupādatrikapṛṣṭaśūlaṃ kaphāvṛtiṃ mārutanigrahaṃ ca||
8.3.42 |  viṇmūtravātagrahaṇaṃ saśūlamādhmānatāmaśmariśarkare ca|
ānāhamarśograhaṇīpradoṣāneraṇḍabastiḥ śamayet prayuktaḥ||
8.3.43 |  catuṣpale tailaghṛtasya bhṛṣṭācchāgācchatārdho dadhidāḍimāmlaḥ|
rasaḥ sapeṣyo balamāṃsavarṇaretognidaścāndhya*śirortiśastaḥ||
8.3.44 |  jaladvikaṃse 'ṣṭapalaṃ palāśāt paktvā raso 'rdhāḍhakamātraśeṣaḥ|
*kalkairvacāmāgadhikāpalābhyāṃ yuktaḥ śatāhvādvipalena cāpi||
8.3.45 |  sasaindhavaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ satailo deyo nirūho balavarṇakārī|
ānāhapārśvāmayayonidoṣān gulmānudāvartarujaṃ ca hanyāt||
8.3.46 |  *yaṣṭyāhvayasyāṣṭapalena siddhaṃ payaḥ śatāhvāphalapippalībhiḥ|
yuktaṃ sasarpirmadhu vātaraktavaisvaryavīsarpahito nirūhaḥ||
8.3.47 |  yaṣṭyāhvalodhrābhayacandanaiśca śṛtaṃ payo 'gryaṃ kamalotpalaiśca|
saśarkaraṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītaṃ pittāmayān hanti sajīvanīyam||
8.3.48 |  dvikārṣikāścandanapadmakardhiyaṣṭyāhvarāsnāvṛṣasārivāśca|
*salodhramañjiṣṭhamathāpyanantābalāsthirāditṛṇapañcamūlam||
8.3.49 |  toye samutkvāthya rasena tena śṛtaṃ payo 'rdhāḍhakamambuhīnam|
jīvantimedardhiśatāvarībhirvīrādvikākolikaśerukābhiḥ||
8.3.50 |  sitopalājīvakapadmareṇuprapauṇḍarīkaiḥ kamalotpalaiśca|
lodhrātmaguptāmadhukairvidārīmuñjātakaiḥ keśaracandanaiśca||
8.3.51 |  piṣṭairghṛtakṣaudrayutairnirūhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ śītalameva dadyāt|
pratyāgate dhanvarasena śālīn kṣīreṇa vā 'dyāt pariṣiktagātraḥ||
8.3.52 |  dāhātisārapradarāsrapittahṛtpāṇḍurogān viṣamajvaraṃ ca|
sagulmamūtragrahakāmalādīn sarvāmayān pittakṛtānnihanti||
8.3.53 |  drākṣādikāśmaryamadhūkasevyaiḥ sasārivācandanaśītapākyaiḥ|
payaḥ śṛtaṃ śrāvaṇimudgaparṇītugātmaguptāmadhuyaṣṭikalkaiḥ||
8.3.54 |  godhūmacūrṇaiśca tathā 'kṣamātraiḥ sakṣaudrasarpirmadhuyaṣṭitailaiḥ|
*pathyāvidārīkṣurasairguḍena bastiṃ yutaṃ pittaharaṃ vidadhyāt||
8.3.55 |  *hṛnnābhipārśvottamadehadāhe dāhe 'ntarasthe ca sakṛcchramūtre|
kṣīṇe kṣAte retasi cāpi naṣṭe paitte 'tisāre ca nṛṇāṃ praśastaḥ||
8.3.56 |  koṣātakāragvadha*devadāruśārṅgeṣṭamūrvākuṭajārkapāṭhāḥ|
paktvā kṛlatthān bṛhatīṃ ca toye rasasya tasya prasṛtā daśa syuḥ||
8.3.57 |  tān sarṣapailāmadanaiḥ sakuṣṭhairakṣapramāṇaiḥ prasṛtaiśca yuktān|
phalāhvatailasya *samākṣikasya kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya||
8.3.58 |  dadyānnirūhaṃ kapharogiṇe jño mandāgraye cāpyaśanadviṣe ca|
paṭolapathyāmaradārubhirvā sapippalīkaiḥ kvathitairjale 'gnau||
8.3.59 |  dvipañcamūle triphalāṃ sabilvāṃ phālāni gomūtrayuta kaṣāyaḥ|
kaliṅgapāṭhāphalamustakalkaḥ sasaindhavaḥ kṣārayutaḥ satailaḥ||
8.3.60 |  nirūhamukhyaḥ kaphajān vikārān sapāṇḍurogālasakāmadoṣān|
hanyāttathā mārutamūtrasaṅgaṃ bastestathā++*āṭopamadhāpi ghoram||
8.3.61 |  rāsnāmṛtairaṇḍaviḍaṅgadārvīsaptacchadośīrasurāhvanimbaiḥ|
śampākabhūnimbapaṭolapāṭhātiktākhuparṇīdaśamūlamustaiḥ||
8.3.62 |  trāyantikāśigruphalatrikaiśca kvāthaḥ sapiṇḍītakatoyamūtraḥ|
yaṣṭyāhvakṛṣṇāphalinīśatāhvārasāñjanaśvetavacāviḍaṅgaiḥ||
8.3.63 |  kaliṅgapāṭhāmbudasaindhavaiśca kalkaiḥ sasarpirmadhutailamiśraḥ|
ayaṃ nirūhaḥ krimikuṣṭhamehabradhnodarājīrṇakaphāturebhyaḥ||
8.3.64 |  rūkṣauṣadhairapyapatarpitebhya eteṣu rogeṣvapi satsu dattaḥ|
nihatya vātaṃ jvalanaṃ pradīpya vijitya rogāṃśca balaṃ karoti||
8.3.65 |  *punarnavairaṇḍavṛṣāśmabhedavṛścīrabhūtīkabalāpalāśāḥ|
dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palāṃśikāni kṣuṇṇāni dhautāni *phalāni cāṣṭau||
8.3.66 |  bilvaṃ yavān kolakulatthadhānyaphalāni caiva prasṛtonmitāni|
*payojaladvyāḍhakavacchṛtaṃ tat kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ sitavastrapūtam||
8.3.67 |  *vacāśatāhvāmaradārukuṣṭhayaṣṭyāhvasiddhārthakapippalīnām|
kalkairyavānyā madanaiśca yuktaṃ nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ guḍasaindhavāktam||
8.3.68 |  kṣaudrasya tailasya ca sarpiṣaśca tathaiva yuktaṃ *prasṛtaistribhiśca|
dadyānnirūhaṃ vidhinā vivijñaḥ sa sarvasaṃsargakṛtāmayaghnaḥ||
8.3.69 |  snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane samāṃso dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte|
trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ||
8.3.70 |  rasena vāte pratibhojanaṃ syāt kṣīreṇa pitte tu kaphe ca yūṣaiḥ|
tathā 'nuvāsyeṣu ca bilvatailaṃ syājjīvanīyaṃ phalasādhitaṃ ca||
8.3.71 |  itīdamuktaṃ nikhilaṃ yathāvadvastipradānasya vidhānamagryam|
yo 'dhītya vidvāniha bastikarma karoti loke labhate sa siddhim||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasṃpūrite siddhisthāne bastisūtrīyasiddhirnāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||3 | |

caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.4.1 |  athātaḥ *snehavyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.4.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.4.3 |  snehabastīnnibodhemān vātapittakaphāpahān|
mithyāpraṇihitānāṃ ca vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ||
8.4.4 |  daśamūlaṃ balāṃ rāsnāmaśvagandhāṃ punarnavām|
guḍūcyeraṇḍabhūtīkabhārgīvṛṣakarohiṣam||
8.4.5 |  śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ *palāṃśikam|
yavamāṣātasīkolakulatthān prasṛtonmitān||
8.4.6 |  caturdroṇe 'mbhasaḥ paktvā droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca|
tailāḍhakaṃ *samakṣīraṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||
8.4.7 |  anuvāsanametaddhi sarvavātavikāranut|
ānūpānāṃ vasā tadvajjīvanīyopasādhitā||
8.4.8 |  śatāhvāyavabilvāmlaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ samīraṇe|
saindhavenāgnitaptena taptaṃ cānilanudghṛtam||
8.4.9 |  jībantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām|
śatāhvarṣabhakau kṛṣṇāṃ kākanāsāṃ śatāvarīm||
8.4.10 |  svaguptāṃ kṣīrakākolīṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ śaṭīṃ vacām|
piṣṭvā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīre sādhayettaccaturguṇe||
8.4.11 |  bṛhaṇaṃ vātapittaghnaṃ balaśukrāgnivardhanam|
*mūtraretorajodoṣān harettadanuvāsanam||
8.4.12 |  lābhataścandanādyaiśca piṣṭaiḥ kṣīracaturguṇam|
*tailapādaṃ ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ pittaghnamanuvāsanam||
8.4.13 |  saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvāṃ niculaṃ *vacām|
hrīveraṃ madhukaṃ bhārgīṃ devadāru sakaṭphalam||
8.4.14 |  nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medāṃ cavikāṃ citrakaṃ śaṭīm|
viḍaṅgātiviṣe śyāmāṃ hareṇuṃ nīlinīṃ sthirām||
8.4.15 |  bilvājamode kṛṣṇāṃ ca dantīṃ rāsnāṃ ca peṣayet|
sādhyameraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ tailaṃ vā kapharoganut||
8.4.16 |  bradhnodāvartagulmārśaḥplīhamehāḍhyamārutān|
ānāhamaśmarīṃ caiva hanyāttadanuvāsanāt||
8.4.17 |  madanairvā 'mlasaṃyuktairbilvādyena gaṇena vā|
tailaṃ kaphaharairvā 'pi kaphaghnaṃ kalpayedbhiṣak||
8.4.18 |  viḍaṅgairaṇḍarajanīpaṭolatriphalāmṛtāḥ|
jātīpravālanirguṇḍīdaśamūlākhuparṇikāḥ||
8.4.19 |  nimbapāṭhāsahacaraśampākakaravīrakāḥ|
eṣāṃ kvāthena vipacettailamebhiśca kalkitaiḥ||
8.4.20 |  phalabilvatrivṛtkṛṣṇārāsnābhūnimbadārubhiḥ|
saptaparṇavacośīradārvīkuṣṭhakaliṅgakaiḥ||
8.4.21 |  *latāgaurīśatāhvāgniśaṭīcorakapauṣkaraiḥ|
tat kuṣṭhāni krimīn mehānarśāṃsi grahaṇīgadam||
8.4.22 |  klībatāṃ viṣamāgnitvaṃ malaṃ doṣatrayaṃ tathā|
prayuktaṃ praṇudatyāśu pānābhyaṅgānuvāsanaiḥ||
8.4.23 |  vyādhivyāyāmakarmādhvakṣīṇābalanirojasām|
kṣīṇaśukrasya cātīva snehabastirbalapradaḥ||
8.4.24 |  pādajaṅghorupṛṣṭhāṃsakaṭīnāṃ sthiratāṃ parām|
janayedaprajānāṃ ca prajāṃ strīṇāṃ tathā nṛṇām||
8.4.25 |  vātapittakaphātyannapurīṣairāvṛtasya ca|
abhukte ca praṇītasya snehabasteḥ ṣaḍāpadaḥ||
8.4.26 |  śīto 'lpo vā 'dhike vate pitte 'tyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ|
atibhukte gururvarcaḥsaṃcaye 'lpabalastathā||
8.4.27 |  dattastairāvṛtaḥ sneho na *yātyabhibhavādapi|
abhukte 'nāvṛtatvācca yātyūrdhvaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam||
8.4.28 |  *aṅgamardajvarādhmānaśītastambhorupīḍanaiḥ|
pārśvarugveṣṭanairvidyāt snehaṃ vātāvṛtaṃ bhiṣak||
8.4.29 |  snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇaistaṃ *rāsnāpītadrutailikaiḥ|
sauvīrakasurākolakulatthayavasādhitaiḥ||
8.4.30 |  nirūhairnirharet samyak samūtraiḥ pāñcamūlikaiḥ|
tābhyāmeva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte 'nuvāsayet||
8.4.31 |  dāharāgatṛṣāmohatamakajvaradūṣaṇaiḥ|
vidyāt pittāvṛtaṃ svādutiktaistaṃ bastibhirharet||
8.4.32 |  tandrāśītajvarālasyaprasekarucigauravaiḥ|
saṃmūrcchāglānibhirvidyācchleṣmaṇā snehamāvṛtam||
8.4.33 |  *kaṣāyakaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ surāmūtropasādhitaiḥ|
phalatailayutaiḥ sāmlairbastibhistaṃ vinirharet||
8.4.34 |  *chardimūrcchāruciglāniśūlanidrāṅgamardanaiḥ|
āmaliṅgaiḥ sadāhaistaṃ vidyādatyaśanāvṛtam||
8.4.35 |  kaṭūnāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca kvāthaiścūrṇaiśca pācanam|
vireko mṛduratrāmavihitā ca kriyā hitā||
8.4.36 |  viṇmūtrānilasaṅgārtigurutvādhmānahṛdgrahaiḥ|
snehaṃ viḍāvṛtaṃ jñātvā snehasvedaiḥ savartibhiḥ||
8.4.37 |  śyāmābilvādisiddhaiśca nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ|
nirharedvidhinā samyagudāvartahareṇa ca||
8.4.38 |  abhukte śūnyapāyau vā vegāt sneho 'tipīḍitaḥ|
dhāvatyūrdhvaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhādūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya etyapi||
