8.4.39 |  mūtraśyāmātrivṛtsiddho yavakolakulatthavān|
tatsiddhataila iṣṭo 'tra nirūhaḥ sānuvāsanaḥ||
8.4.40 |  kaṇṭhādāgacchataḥ stambhakaṇṭhagrahavirecanaiḥ|
chardighnībhiḥ kriyābhiśca tasya kāryaṃ nivartanam||
8.4.41 |  yasya nopadravaṃ kuryāt snehabastiraniḥsṛtaḥ|
sarvo 'lpo vā++āvṛto raukṣyādupekṣyaḥ sa vijānatā||
8.4.42 |  yuktasnehaṃ dravoṣṇaṃ ca laghupathyopasevanam|
bhuktavān mātrayā bhojyamanuvāsyastryahātryahāt||
8.4.43 |  dhānyanāgarasiddhaṃ hi toyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ|
vyuṣitāya niśāṃ kalyamuṣṇaṃ vā kevalaṃ jalam||
8.4.44 |  snehājīrṇaṃ jarayati śleṣmāṇaṃ tadbhinatti ca|
mārutasyānulomyaṃ ca kuryāduṣṇodakaṃ nṛṇām||
8.4.45 |  vamane ca vireke ca nirūhe sānuvāsane|
tasmāduṣṇodakaṃ deyaṃ vātaśleṣmopaśāntaye||
8.4.46 |  rūkṣanisyastu *dīptāgnirvyāyāmī mārutāmayī|
vaṅkṣaṇaśroṇyudāvṛttavātāścārhā dine dine||
8.4.47 |  eṣāṃ cāśu jarāṃ sneho yātyambu sikatāsviva|
ato 'nyeṣāṃ tryahāt prāyaḥ snehaṃ pacati pāvakaḥ||
8.4.48 |  na tvāmaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ sa hyabhiṣyandayedgudam|
sāvaśeṣaṃ ca kurvīta vāyuḥ śeṣe hi tiṣṭhati||
8.4.49 |  na caiva gudakaṇṭhābhyāṃ dadyāt snehamanantaram|
*ubhayasmāt samaṃ gacchan vātamagniṃ ca dūṣayet||
8.4.50 |  snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ vā naikamevātiśīlayet|
utkleśāgnivadhau snehāgnirūhāt pavanādbhayam||
8.4.51 |  tasmānnirūḍhaḥ *saṃsnehyo nirūhyaścānuvāsitaḥ|
snehaśodhanayuktyaivaṃ bastikarma tridoṣanut||
8.4.52 |  karmavyāyāmabhārādhvayā(pā)nastrīkarṣiteṣu ca|
durbale *vātabhahne ca mātrābastiḥ sadā mataḥ||
8.4.53 |  yatheṣṭāhāraceṣṭasya sarvakālaṃ niratyayaḥ|
hrasvāyāḥ snehamātrāyā mātrābastiḥ samo bhavet||
8.4.54 |  balyaṃ sukhopacaryaṃ ca sukhaṃ sṛṣṭapurīṣakṛt|
snehamātrāvidhānaṃ hi bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātaroganut||
8.4.55 |  tatra ślokau---
vātādīnāṃ śamāyoktāḥ pravarāḥ snehabastayaḥ|
teṣāṃ cājñaprayuktānāṃ vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ||
8.4.56 |  prāgbhojyaṃ snehabasteryad dhruvaṃ ye 'rhāstryāhācca ye|
snehabastividhiścokto mātrābastividhistathā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne snehavyāpatsiddhirnāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4 | |

pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.5.1 |  athāto *netrabastivyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.5.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.5.3 |  atha netrāṇi bastīṃśca śṛṇu varjyāni karmasu|
netrasyājñapraṇītasya *vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ||
8.5.4 |  hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ tanu sthūlaṃ jīrṇaṃ śithilabandhanam|
*pārśvacchidraṃ tathā vakramaṣṭau netrāṇi varjayet||
8.5.5 |  aprāptyatigatikṣobhakarṣaṇakṣaṇanasravāḥ|
gudapīḍā gatirjihmā teṣāṃ doṣā yathākramam||
8.5.6 |  viṣamamāṃsalacchinnasthūlajālikavātalāḥ|
snigdhaḥ klinnaśca tānaṣṭau bastīn karmasu varjayet||
8.5.7 |  gativaiṣamyavisratvasrāvadaurgrāhyanisravāḥ|
phenilacyutyadhāryatvaṃ basteḥ syurbastidoṣataḥ||
8.5.8 |  savātatidrutotkṣiptatiryagulluptakampitāḥ|
atibāhyagamandātivegadoṣāḥ praṇetṛtaḥ||
8.5.9 |  anucchvāsya ca baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā|
praviśya *kupito vāyuḥ śūlatodakaro bhavet||
8.5.10 |  tatrābhyaṅgo gude svedo vātaghnānyaśanāni ca|
drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā||
8.5.11 |  syāt *kaṭīgudajaṅghārtibastistambhoruvedanāḥ|
bhojanaṃ tatra vātaghnaṃ snehāḥ svedāḥ sabastayaḥ||
8.5.12 |  tiryagvalyāvṛtadvāre baddhe vā 'pi na gacchati|
netre tadṛju niṣkṛṣya saṃśodhya ca praveśayet||
8.5.13 |  pīḍyamāne 'ntarā mukte gude pratihato 'nilaḥ|
1uraḥśirortimūrvośca sadanaṃ janayedbalī||
8.5.14 |  bastiḥ syāttatra bilvādiphalaśyāmādimūtravān|
syāddāho davathuḥ śophaḥ kampanābhihate gude||
8.5.15 |  kaṣāyamadhurāḥ śītāḥ sekāstatra sabastayaḥ|
atimātrapraṇītena netreṇa kṣaṇanādvaleḥ||
8.5.16 |  syāt 1sārti dāhanistodagudavarcaḥpravartanam|
tatra sarpiḥ picuḥ kṣīraṃ picchābastiśca śasyate||
8.5.17 |  1na bhāvayati mandastu bāhyastvāśu nivartate|
snehastatra punaḥ samyak praṇeyaḥ siddhimicchatā||
8.5.18 |  atiprapīḍitaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhatyāyāti vā galam|
tatra bastirvirekaśca galapīḍādi karma ca||
8.5.19 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
netrabastipraṇetṛṛṇāṃ doṣānetān sabheṣajān|
vetti yastena matimān bastikarmāṇi kārayet||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne netrabastivyāpatsiddhirnāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5 | |

ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.6.1 |  athā 'to vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|
8.6.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.6.3 |  atha śodhanayoḥ samyagvidhimūrdhvānulomayoḥ|
asamyakkṛtayoścaiva doṣān vakṣyāmi sauṣadhān||
8.6.4 |  atyuṣṇavarṣaśītā hi grīṣmavarṣāhimāgamāḥ|
!tadantare prāvṛḍādyāsteṣāṃ sādhāraṇāstrayaḥ||
8.6.5 |  prāvṛṭ śucinabhau jñeyau śaradūrjasahau punaḥ|
tapasyaśca madhuścaiva vasantaḥ śodhanaṃ prati||
8.6.6 |  !etānṛtūn vikalpyaivaṃ dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ bhiṣak|
svasthavṛttamabhipretya vyādhau vyādhivaśena tu||
8.6.7 |  karmaṇāṃ !vamanādīnāmantareṣvantareṣu ca|
snehasvedau prayuñjīta snehaṃ cānte prayojayet||
8.6.8 |  !visarpapiḍakāśophakāmalāpāṇḍurogiṇaḥ|
abhighātaviṣārtāṃśca nātisnigdhāt virecayet||
8.6.9 |  nātisnighdaśarīrāya dadyāt snehavirecanam|
snehotkliṣṭaśarīrāya !rūkṣaṃ dadyāvirecanam||
8.6.10 |  snehasvedopapannena jīrṇe mātrāvadauṣadham|
ekāgramanasā pītaṃ samyagyogāya kalpate||
8.6.11 |  snigdhāt pātrādyathā toyamayatnena praṇudyate|
kaphādayaḥ praṇudyante snigdhāddehāttathauṣadhaiḥ||
8.6.12 |  ārdraṃ kāṣṭhaṃ yathā vahnirviṣyandayati sarvataḥ|
tathā snigdhasya vai doṣān svedo viṣyandayet sthirān||
8.6.13 |  kliṣṭaṃ vāso yathotkleśya malaḥ saṃśodhyate 'mbhasā|
snehasvedaistathotkleśya śodhyate !śodhanairmalaḥ||
8.6.14 |  ajīrṇe vardhate glānirvibandhaścāpi jāyate|
pītaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ caiva viparītaṃ pravartate||
8.6.15 |  alpamātraṃ mahāvegaṃ bahudoṣaharaṃ sukham|
laghupākaṃ sukhāsvādaṃ prīṇanaṃ vyādhināśanam||
8.6.16 |  avikāri ca vyāpattau nātiglānikaraṃ ca yat|
gandhavarṇarasopetaṃ nidyānmātrāvadauṣadham||
8.6.17 |  vidhūya mānasān doṣān 1kāmādīnaśubhodayān|
ekāgramanasā pītaṃ samyagyogāya kalpate||
8.6.18 |  naraḥ śvo vamanaṃ pātā bhuñjīta kaphavardhanam|
sujaraṃ dravabhūyiṣṭhaṃ, laghvaśītaṃ virecanam||
8.6.19 |  utkliṣṭālpakaphatvena kṣipraṃ doṣāḥ sravanti hi|
pītauṣadhasya tu bhiṣak śuddhiliṅgāni lakṣayet||
8.6.20 |  ūrdhvaṃ kaphānuge pitte viṭpitte 'nukaphe tvadhaḥ|
hṛtadoṣaṃ vadet kārśyadaurbalye cet salāghave||
8.6.21 |  vāmayettu tataḥ śeṣamauṣadhaṃ na tvalāghave|
staimitye 'nilasaṅge ca nirudgāre 'pi vāmayet||
8.6.22 |  ālāghavāttanutvācca kaphasyāpat paraṃ bhavet|
vamite vardhate vahniḥ śamaṃ doṣā vrajanti hi||
8.6.23 |  vamitaṃ laṅghayet samyagjīrṇaliṅgānyalakṣayan|
tāni dṛṣṭvā tu peyādikramaṃ kuryānna laṅghanam||
8.6.24 |  saṃśodhanābhyāṃ śuddhasya 1hṛtadoṣasya dehinaḥ|
1yātyagnirmandatāṃ tasmāt kramaṃ peyādimācaret||
8.6.25 |  kaphapitte viśuddhe 'lpaṃ madyape vātapaitteke|
tarpaṇādikramaṃ kuryāt peyā 'bhiṣyandayeddhi tān||
8.6.26 |  anulomo 'nilaḥ svāsthyaṃ kṣuttṛṣṇorjo manasvitā|
laghutvamindriyodgāraśuddhirjīrṇauṣadhākṛtiḥ||
8.6.27 |  klamo dāho 'ṅgasadanaṃ bhramo 1mūrcchā śirorujā|
aratirbalahāniśca sāvaśeṣauṣadhākṛtiḥ||
8.6.28 |  akāle 'lpātimātraṃ ca purāṇaṃ na ca bhāvitam|
asamyaksaṃskṛtaṃ caiva vyāpadyetauṣadhaṃ drutam||
8.6.29 |  ādhmānaṃ parikartiśca srāvo hṛdgātrayorgrahaḥ|
jīvādānaṃ savibhraṃśaḥ stambhaḥ sopadravaḥ klamaḥ||
8.6.30 |  ayogādatiyogācca daśaitā vyāpado matāḥ|
preṣyabhaiṣajyavaidyānāṃ vaiguṇyādāturasya ca||
8.6.31 |  yogaḥ samyakpravṛttiḥ syādatiyogo 'tivartanam|
ayogaḥ prātilomyena na cālpaṃ vā pravartanam||
8.6.32 |  śleṣmotkliṣṭena durgandhamahṛdyamati vā bahu|
virecanamajīrṇe ca pītamūrdhvaṃ pravartate||
8.6.33 |  kṣudhārtamṛdukoṣṭhābhyāṃ svalpotkliṣṭakaphena vā|
tīkṣṇaṃ pītaṃ sthitaṃ kṣubdhaṃ vamanaṃ syādvirecanam||
8.6.34 |  prātilomyena doṣāṇāṃ haraṇātte hyakṛtsnaśaḥ|
ayogasaṃjñe, kṛcchreṇa 1yāti doṣo navā 'lpaśaḥ||
8.6.35 |  pītauṣadho na śuddhaścejjīrṇe tasmin punaḥ pibet|
auṣadhaṃ na tvajīrṇe 'nyadbhayaṃ syādatiyogataḥ||
8.6.36 |  koṣṭhasya gurutāṃ jñātvā laghutvaṃ balameva ca|
ayoge mṛdu vā dadyādauṣadhaṃ tīkṣṇameva vā||
8.6.37 |  vamanaṃ na tu duśchardaṃ 1duṣkoṣṭhaṃ na virecanam|
pāyayetauṣadhaṃ bhūyo hanyāt pītaṃ punarhi tau||
8.6.38 |  asnīgdhāsvinnadehasya rūkṣasyānavamauṣadham|
doṣānutkliśya nirhartumaśaktaṃ janayedgadān||
8.6.39 |  vibhraṃśaṃ śvayathuṃ hikkāṃ tamaso darśanaṃ 1bhṛśam|
piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ kaṇḍūmūrvoḥ sādaṃ vivarṇatām||
8.6.40 |  snigdhasvinnasya cātyalpaṃ dīptāgnerjīrṇamauṣadham|
śītairvā stabdhamāme vā doṣānutkliśya nāharet||
8.6.41 |  tāneva janayedrogānayogaḥ sarva eva saḥ|
vijñāya matimāṃstatra yathoktāṃ kārayet kriyām||
8.6.42 |  taṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ prastarasaṅkaraiḥ|
pāyayeta punarjīrṇe samūtrairvā nirūhayet||
8.6.43 |  nirūḍhaṃ ca rasairdhānvairbhojayitvā 'nuvāsayet|
phalamāgadhikādārusiddhatailena mātrayā||
8.6.44 |  snigdhaṃ vātaharaiḥ snehaiḥ punastīkṣṇena śodhayet|
na cātitīkṣṇena tato hyatiyogastu jāyate||
8.6.45 |  atitīkṣṇaṃ kṣudhārtasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya bheṣajam|
hṛtvā++āśu viṭpittakaphān dhātūnvisrāvayeddravān||
8.6.46 |  balasvarakṣayaṃ dāhaṃ kaṇṭhaśoṣaṃ 1bhramaṃ tṛṣām|
kuryācca madhuraistatra śeṣamauṣadhamullikhet||
8.6.47 |  vamane tu virekaḥ syādvireke vamanaṃ 1punaḥ|
pariṣekāvagāhādyaiḥ suśītaiḥ stambhayecca tat||
8.6.48 |  kaṣāyamadhuraiḥ śītairannapānauṣadhaistathā|
raktapittātisāraghnairdāhajvaraharairapi||
8.6.49 |  añjanaṃ candanośīramajjāsṛkśarkarodakam|
lājacūrṇaiḥ pibenmanthamatiyogaharaṃ param||
8.6.50 |  śuṅgābhirvā vaṭādīnāṃ siddhāṃ peyāṃ samākṣikām|
varcaḥsāṃgrāhikaiḥ siddhaṃ kṣīraṃ bhojyaṃ ca dāpayet||
8.6.51 |  jāṅgalairvā rasairbhojyaṃ picchābastiśca śasyate|
maghurairanuvāsyaśca siddhena kṣīrasarpiṣā||
8.6.52 |  vamanasyātiyoge tu śītāmbupariṣecitaḥ|
pibet 1kaphaharairmanthaṃ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram||
8.6.53 |  sodgārāyāṃ bhṛśaṃ vamyāṃ mūrcchāyāṃ dhānyamustayoḥ|
samadhūkāñcanaṃ cūrṇaṃ lehayenmadhusaṃyutam||
8.6.54 |  vamato 'ntaḥpraviṣṭāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ kavalagrahāḥ|
snigdhāmlalavaṇairhṛdyairyūṣakṣīrarasairhitāḥ||
8.6.55 |  phalānyamlāni khādeyustasya cānye 'grato narāḥ|
niḥsṛtāṃ tu tiladrākṣākalkaliptāṃ praveśayet||
8.6.56 |  1vāgrahānilarogeṣu ghṛtamāṃsopasādhitām|
yavāgūṃ tanukāṃ 1dadyāt snehasvedau ca buddhimān||
8.6.57 |  vamitaśca viriktaśca mandāgniśca vilaṅghitaḥ|
agniprāṇavivṛddhyarthaṃ kramaṃ peyādikaṃ 1bhajet||
8.6.58 |  bahudoṣasya rūkṣasya hīnāgneralpamauṣadham|
sodāvartasya cotkliśya doṣānmārgānnirudhya ca||
8.6.59 |  bhṛśamādhmāpayennābhiṃ pṛṣṭhapārśvaśirorujam|
śvāsaviṇmūtravātānāṃ saṅgaṃ kuryācca dāruṇam||
8.6.60 |  abhyaṅgasvedavartyādi sanirūhānuvāsanam|
udāvartaharaṃ sarvaṃ karmādhmātasya śasyate||
8.6.61 |  snigdhena gurukoṣṭhena sāme balavadauṣadham|
kṣāmeṇa mṛdukoṣṭhena śrāntenālpabalena vā||
8.6.62 |  pītaṃ gatvā gudaṃ sāmamāśu doṣaṃ nirasya ca|
tīvraśūlāṃ sapicchāsrāṃ karoti parikartikām||
8.6.63 |  laṅghanaṃ 1pācanaṃ sāme rūkṣoṣṇaṃ laghubhojanam|
bṛṃhaṇīyo vidhiḥ sarvaḥ kṣāmāsya madhurastatahā||
8.6.64 |  āme jīrṇe 'nubandhaścet kṣārāmlaṃ laghu śasyate|
puṣpakāsīsamiśraṃ vā kṣāreṇa lavaṇena vā||
8.6.65 |  sadāḍimarasaṃ sarpiḥ pibedvāte 'dhike sati|
dadhyamlaṃ 1bhojane pāne saṃyuktaṃ dāḍimatvacā||
8.6.66 |  devadārutilānāṃ vā kalkamuṣṇāmbunā pibet|
aśvatthodumbaraplakṣakadambairvā śṛtaṃ payaḥ||
8.6.67 |  kaṣāyamadhuraṃ 1śītaṃ picchābastimathāpi vā|
yaṣṭīmadhukasiddhaṃ vā snehāstiṃ pradāpayet||
8.6.68 |  alpaṃ tu bahudoṣasya doṣamutkliśya bheṣajam|
alpālpaṃ srāvayet kaṇḍūṃ śophaṃ kuṣṭhāni gauravam||
8.6.69 |  kuryāccāgnibalotkleśastaimityārucipāṇḍutāḥ|
parisrāvaḥ sa, taṃ doṣaṃ śamayedvāmayedapi||
8.6.70 |  snehitaṃ vā punastīkṣaṇaṃ pāyayeta virecanam|
śuddhe cūrṇāsavāriṣṭān saṃskṛtāṃśca pradāpayet||
8.6.71 |  pītauṣadhasya vegānāṃ nigrahānmārutādayaḥ|
kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā ghoraṃ kurvanti hṛdgraham||
8.6.72 |  1sa hikkākāsapārśvārtidainyalālākṣivibhramaiḥ|
jihvāṃ khādati niḥsaṃjño dantān kiṭikiṭāpayan||
8.6.73 |  na gacchedvibhramaṃ tatra vāmayedāśu taṃ bhiṣak|
madhuraiḥ pittamūrcchārtaṃ kaṭubhiḥ kaphamūrcchitam||
8.6.74 |  pācanīyaistataścāsya doṣaśeṣaṃ vipācayet|
kāyāgniṃ ca balaṃ cāsya 1krameṇotthāpayettataḥ||
8.6.75 |  pavanenātivamato hṛdayaṃ yasya pīḍyate|
tasmai snigdhāmlalavaṇaṃ dadyāt pittakaphe 'nyathā||
8.6.76 |  pītauṣadhasya vegānāṃ nigraheṇa kaphena vā|
1ruddho 'ti vā viśuddhasya gṛhṇātyaṅgāni mārutaḥ||
8.6.77 |  stambhavepathunistodasādodveṣṭanamanthanaiḥ|
tatra vātaharaṃ sarvaṃ snehasvedādi 1kārayet||
8.6.78 |  atitīkṣṇaṃ mṛdau koṣṭhe laghudoṣasya bheṣajam|
doṣān hṛtvā vinirmathya jīvaṃ harati śoṇitam||
8.6.79 |  tenānnaṃ miśritaṃ dadyādvāyasāya śune 'pi vā|
bhuṅkte taccedvadejjīvaṃ na bhuṅkte pittamādiśet||
8.6.80 |  śuklaṃ vā bhāvitaṃ vastramāvānaṃ koṣṇavāriṇā|
prakṣālitaṃ vivarṇaṃ syāt 1pitte śuddhaṃ tu śoṇite||
8.6.81 |  tṛṣṇāmūrcchāmadārtasya kuryādāmaraṇāt kriyām|
tasya pittaharīṃ sarvāmatiyoge ca yā 1hitā||
8.6.82 |  mṛgagomahiṣājānāṃ sadyaskaṃ jīvatāmasṛk|
pibejjīvābhisandhānaṃ jīvaṃ taddhyāśu 1gacchati||
8.6.83 |  tadeva darbhamṛditaṃ raktaṃ bastiṃ pradāpayet|
śyāmākāśmaryabadarīdūrvośīraiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ||
8.6.84 |  ghṛtamaṇḍāñjanayutaṃ śītaṃ bastiṃ pradāpayet|
picchābastiṃ suśītaṃ vā ghṛtamaṇḍānuvāsanam||
8.6.85 |  gudaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ kaṣāyaiśca stambhayitvā praveśayet|
sāma gāndharvaśabdāṃśca saṃjñānāśe 'sya kārayet||
8.6.86 |  yadā virecanaṃ pītaṃ viḍantamavatiṣṭhate|
vamanaṃ bheṣajāntaṃ vā doṣānutkliśya nāvahet||
8.6.87 |  tadā kurvanti kaṇḍvādīn doṣāḥ prakupitā gadān|
sa vibhraṃśo matastatra syādyathāvyādhi bheṣajam||
8.6.88 |  pītaṃ snigdhena sasnehaṃ taddoṣairmārdavādvṛtam|
na vāhayati doṣāṃstu svasthānāt stambhayeccyutān||
8.6.89 |  vātasaṅgagudastambhaśūlaiḥ kṣarati cālpaśaḥ|
tīkṣṇaṃ bastiṃ virekaṃ vā so 'rho laṅghitapācitaḥ||
8.6.90 |  rūkṣaṃ virecanaṃ pītaṃ rūkṣeṇālpabalena vā|
mārutaṃ kopayitvā++āśu kuryādghorānupadravān||
8.6.91 |  stambhaśūlāni ghorāṇi sarvagātreṣu muhyataḥ|
snehasvedādikastatra kāryo vātaharo vidhiḥ||
8.6.92 |  snigdhasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya mṛdūtkliśyauṣadhaṃ kapham|
pittaṃ vātaṃ ca saṃrudhya satandrāgauravaṃ klamam||
8.6.93 |  daurbalyaṃ cāṅgasādaṃ ca kuryādāśu tadullikhet|
laṅghanaṃ pācanaṃ 1cātra snigdhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca śodhanam||
8.6.94 |  tatra ślokau---
ityetā vyāpadaḥ proktāḥ sarūpāḥ sacikitsitāḥ|
vamanasya virekasya kṛtasyākuśalairnṛṇām1 | |
8.6.95 |  1etā vijñāya matimānavasthāścaiva tattvataḥ|
1dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ samyagārogyārthī1 nṛṇāṃ sadā||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhirnāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6 | |

saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.7.1 |  athāto bastivyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.7.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.7.3 |  dhīdhairyaudāryagāmbhīryakṣamādamataponidhim|
punarvasuṃ śiṣyagaṇaḥ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ||
8.7.4 |  kāḥ kati vyāpado basteḥ kiṃsamutthānalakṣaṇāḥ|
kā cikitsā iti praśnāñchrutvā tānabravīdguruḥ||
8.7.5 |  nātiyogau klamādhmāne hikkā hṛtprāptirūrdhvatā|
pravāhikā śiroṅgārtiḥ 1parikartaḥ parisravaḥ||
8.7.6 |  dvādaśa vyāpado basterasamyagyogasaṃbhavāḥ|
āsāmekaikaśo rūpaṃ cikitsāṃ ca nibodhata||
8.7.7 |  gurukoṣṭhe 'nilaprāye rūkṣe vātolbaṇe 'pi vā|
śīto+1alpalavaṇasnehadravamātro ghano 'pi vā||
8.7.8 |  bastiḥ saṃkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ durbalatvādanirharan|
karoti gurukoṣṭhatvaṃ vātamūtraśakṛdgraham||
8.7.9 |  nābhibastirujaṃ dāhaṃ hṛllepaṃ śvayathuṃ gude|
kaṇḍūgaṇḍāni vaivarṇyamaruciṃ vahnimārdavam||
8.7.10 |  tatroṣṇāyāḥ pramathyāyāḥ pānaṃ svedāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ|
phalavartyo 'thavā kālaṃ jñātvā śastaṃ virecanam||
8.7.11 |  bilvamūlatrivṛddāruyavakolakulatthavān|
1surādimūtravān bastiḥ saprākpeṣyastamānayet||
8.7.12 |  snigdhasvinne 'titīkṣṇoṣṇo mṛdukoṣṭhe 'tiyujyate|
tasya liṅgaṃ cikitsā ca śodhanābhyāṃ samā bhavet||
8.7.13 |  pṛśniparṇīṃ sthirāṃ padmaṃ kāśmaryaṃ 1madhukaṃ balām|
piṣṭvā drākṣāṃ madhūkaṃ ca kṣīre taṇḍuladhāvane||
8.7.14 |  drākṣāyāḥ pakvaloṣṭasya prasāde madhukasya ca|
vinīya saghṛtaṃ bastiṃ dadyāddāhe1 'tiyogaje||
8.7.15 |  1āmaśeṣe nirūheṇa mṛdunā doṣa īritaḥ|
1mārgaṃ ruṇaddhi vātasya hantyagniṃ mūrcchayatyapi||
8.7.16 |  klamaṃ 1vidāhaṃ hṛcchūlaṃ mohaveṣṭanagauravam|
kuryāt svedairvirūkṣaistaṃ pācanaiścāpyupācaret||
8.7.17 |  pippalīkattṛṇośīradārumūrvāśṛtaṃ jalam|
pibet sauvarcalonmiśraṃ dīpanaṃ hṛdviśodhanam||
8.7.18 |  vacānāgaraśaṭyelā dadhimaṇḍena mūrcchitāḥ|
peyāḥ prasannayā vā syurariṣṭenāsavena vā||
8.7.19 |  dāru 1trikaṭukaṃ pathyāṃ palāśaṃ citrakaṃ śaṭīm|
piṣṭvā kuṣṭhaṃ ca mūtreṇa pibet kṣārāṃśca dīpanān||
8.7.20 |  bastimasya vidadhyācca samūtraṃ dāśamūlikam|
samūtramathavā vyaktalavaṇaṃ mādhutailikam||
8.7.21 |  alpavīryo mahādoṣe rūkṣe krūrāśaye kṛtaḥ|
bastirdoṣāvṛto ruddhamārgo rundhyāt1 samīraṇam||
8.7.22 |  sa vimārgo 'nilaḥ kuryādādhmānaṃ marmapīḍanam|
vidāhaṃ gurukoṣṭhasya muṣkavaṅkṣaṇavedanām||
8.7.23 |  ruṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlairitaścetaśca dhāvati|
śyāmāphalādibhiḥ kuṣṭhakṛṣṇālavaṇasarṣapaiḥ||
8.7.24 |  dhūmamāṣavacākiṇvakṣāracūrṇaguḍaiḥ kṛtām|
karāṅguṣṭhanibhāṃ vartiṃ yavamadhyāṃ 1nidhāpayet||
8.7.25 |  abhyaktasvinnagātrasya tailāktāṃ snehite gude|
athavā lavaṇāgāradhūmasiddhārthakaiḥ kṛtām||
8.7.26 |  bilvādinā nirūhaḥ syāt pīlusarṣapamūtravān|
saralāmaradārubhyāṃ siddhaṃ caivānuvāsanam||
8.7.27 |  mṛdukoṣṭhe 'bale bastiratitīkṣṇo 'tinirharan|
kuryāddhikkāṃ, hitaṃ tasmai hikkāghnaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca yat||
8.7.28 |  balāsthirādikāśmaryatriphalāguḍasaindhavaiḥ|
saprasannāranālāmlaistailaṃ paktavā 'nuvāsayet||
8.7.29 |  kṛṣṇālavaṇayorakṣaṃ pibeduṣṇāmbunā 1yutam|
dhūmaleharasakṣīrasvedāścānnaṃ ca vātanut||
8.7.30 |  atitīkṣṇaḥ savāto vā na vā samyak prapīḍitaḥ|
ghaṭṭayeddhṛdayaṃ bastistatra kāśakuśetkaṭaiḥ||
8.7.31 |  syāt sāmlalavaṇaskandhakarīrabadarīphalaiḥ|
śṛtairbastirhitaḥ siddhaṃ vātaghnaiścānuvāsanam||
8.7.32 |  vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ datte vegānnigṛhṇataḥ|
ati vā pīḍito bastirmukhenāyāti vegavān||
8.7.33 |  mūrcchāvikāraṃ tasyādau dṛṣṭvā śītāmbunā mukham|
siñcet pārśvodaraṃ cādhaḥ pramṛjyādvījayecca tam||
8.7.34 |  keśeṣvālambya 1cākāśe dhunuyāttrāsayecca tam|
gokharāśvagajaiḥ siṃhai rājapreṣyaistathoragaiḥ||
8.7.35 |  ulkābhirevamanyaiśca 1bhītasyādhaḥ pravartate|
vastrapāṇigrahaiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rundhyānna mriyate yathā||
8.7.36 |  prāṇodānanirodhāddhi prasiddhataramārgavān1 | 
apānaḥ pavano bastiṃ tamāśvevāpakarṣati||
8.7.37 |  tataḥ kramukakalkākṣaṃ pāyayetāmlasaṃyutam|
auṣṇyāttaikṣyāt saratvācca bastiṃ so 'syānulomayet||
8.7.38 |  pakvāśayasthite svinne nirūho dāśamūlikaḥ|
yavakolakulatthaiśca vidheyo mūtrasādhitaḥ||
8.7.39 |  bilvādipañcamūlena siddho bastiruraḥsthite|
śiraḥsthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ||
8.7.40 |  snigdhasvinne mahādoṣe bastirmṛdvalpabheṣajaḥ|
utkliśyālpaṃ hareddoṣaṃ janayecca pravāhikām||
8.7.41 |  sa bastipāyuśophena jaṅghorusadanena vā|
niruddhamāruto janturabhīkṣṇaṃ saṃpravāhate||
8.7.42 |  svedābhyāṅgānnirūhāṃśca śodhanīyānulomikān|
vidadhyāllaṅghayitvā tu vṛttiṃ kuryādviriktavat||
8.7.43 |  durbale krūrakoṣṭhe ca tīvradoṣe tanurmṛduḥ|
śīto 'lpaścāvṛto doṣairbastistadvihato 'nilaḥ||
8.7.44 |  1mārgairgātrāṇi sandhāvannūrdhvaṃ mūrdhni1 vihanyate|
grīvāṃ manye ca 1gṛhṇāni śiraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ bhinatti ca||
8.7.45 |  bādhiryaṃ karṇanādaṃ ca pīnasaṃ netravibhramam|
kuryādabhyañjanaṃ 1tailalavaṇena yathāvidhi||
8.7.46 |  yuñjyāt pradhamanairnasyairdhūmairasya1 virecayet|
tīkṣṇānulomikenātha snigdhaṃ bhukte 'nuvāsayet1 | |
8.7.47 |  1snehasvedairanāpādya gurustīkṣṇo 'timātrayā|
yasya bastiḥ prayujyeta so 'timātraṃ pravartayet||
8.7.48 |  sruteṣu tasya doṣeṣu nirūḍhasyātimātraśaḥ|
stabdhodāvṛtakoṣṭhasya vāyuḥ saṃpratihanyate||
8.7.49 |  vilomanasamudbhūto rujatyaṅgāni dehinaḥ|
1gātraveṣṭananistodabhedasphuraṇajṛmbhaṇaiḥ||
8.7.50 |  taṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktaṃ secayeduṣṇavāriṇā|
eraṇḍapatraviṣkvāthaiḥ prastaraiścopapādayet||
8.7.51 |  1yavān kulatthān kolāni pañcamūle tathobhaye|
jalāḍhakadvaye paktvā pādaśeṣeṇa tena ca||
8.7.52 |  kuryāt sabilvatailoṣṇalavaṇena nirūhaṇam|
taṃ nirūḍhaṃ samāśvastaṃ droṇyāṃ samavagāhayet||
8.7.53 |  tato bhuktavatastasya kārayedanuvāsanam|
yaṣṭīmadhukatailena bilvatailena vā 1bhiṣak||
8.7.54 |  mṛdukoṣṭhālpadoṣasya rūkṣastīkṣṇo 'timātravān|
1bastirdoṣānnirasyāśu janayet parikartikām||
8.7.55 |  trikavaṅkṣaṇabastīnāṃ todaṃ nābheradho rujam|
vibandho+1alpālpamutthānaṃ bastinirlekhanādbhavet||
8.7.56 |  svāduśītauṣadhaistatra paya ikṣvādibhiḥ śṛtam|
yaṣṭyāhvatilakalkābhyāṃ bastiḥ syāt kṣīrabhojinaḥ||
8.7.57 |  sasarjarasayaṣṭyāhvajiṅginīkardamāñjanam|
vinīya dugdhe bastiḥ syāt vyaktāmlamṛdubhojinaḥ||
8.7.58 |  1pittaroge 'mla uṣṇo vā tīkṣṇo vā lavaṇo 'thavā|
bastirlikhati pāyuṃ tu kṣiṇoti vidahatyapi||
8.7.59 |  sa vidagdhaḥ sravatyasraṃ pittaṃ cānekavarṇavat|
sāryate 1bahuvegena mohaṃ gacchati cāsakṛt||
8.7.60 |  ārdraśālmalivṛntaistu kṣuṇṇairājaṃ payaḥ śṛtam|
sarpiṣā yojitaṃ śītaṃ bastimasyai pradāpayet||
8.7.61 |  vaṭādipallaveṣveṣa kalpo yavatileṣu ca|
suvarcalopodikayoḥ karbudāre ca śasyate||
8.7.62 |  gude sekāḥ pradehāśca śītāḥ syurmadhurāśca ye|
raktapittātisāraghnī kriyā cātra praśasyate||
8.7.63 |  tīkṣṇatvaṃ mūtrapīlvagnilavaṇakṣārasarṣapaiḥ|
prāptakālaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kṣīrādyairmārdavaṃ tathā||
8.7.64 |  āpādatalamūrdhasthān doṣān pakvāśaye sthitaḥ|
vīryeṇa bastirādatte khastho 'rko bhūrasāniva||
8.7.65 |  yadvat kusumbhasaṃmiśrāttoyādrāgaṃ haret paṭaḥ|
tadvaddravīkṛtāddehānnirūko nirharenmalān||
8.7.66 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
ityetā vyāpadaḥ proktā basteḥ sākṛtibheṣajāḥ|
buddhvā kārtsnyena tān bastīnniyuñjannāparādhyati||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite 1siddhisthāne bastivyāpatsiddhirnāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7 | |

aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
8.8.1 |  athātaḥ 1prāsṛtayogīyāṃ siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.8.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.8.3 |  athemān sukumārāṇāṃ nirūhān 1snehanān mṛdūn|
karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak||
8.8.4 |  kṣīrāddvau prasṛtau kāryau madhutailaghṛtāttrayaḥ|
khajena mathito bastirvātaghno balavarṇakṛt||
8.8.5 |  ekaikaḥ prasṛtastailaprasannākṣaudrasarpiṣām|
bilvādimūlakvāthāddvau kaulatthāddvau sa vātanut||
8.8.6 |  pañcamūlarasāt pañca dvau tailāt kṣaudrasarpiṣoḥ|
ekaikaḥ prasṛto bastiḥ snehanīyo 'nilāpahaḥ||
8.8.7 |  saindhavārdhākṣa ekaikaḥ kṣaudratailapayoghṛtāt|
1prasṛto hapuṣākarṣo nirūhaḥ śukrakṛt param||
8.8.8 |  paṭolanimbabhūnimbarāsnāsaptacchadāmbhasaḥ|
catvāraḥ prasṛtā eko ghṛtāt sarṣapakalkitaḥ||
8.8.9 |  nirūhaḥ pañcatikto 'yaṃ 1mehābhiṣyandakuṣṭhanut|
viḍaṅgatriphalāśigruphalamustākhuparṇijāt||
8.8.10 |  1kaṣāyāt prasṛtāḥ pañca tailādeko vimathya tān|
viḍaṅgapippalīkalko nirūhaḥ krimināśanaḥ||
8.8.11 |  payasyekṣusthirārāsnāvidārīkṣaudrasarpiṣām|
ekaikaḥ prasṛto bastiḥ kṛṣṇākalko vṛṣatvakṛt||
8.8.12 |  catvārastailagomūtradadhimaṇḍāmlakāñjikāt|
prasṛtāḥ sarṣapaiḥ 1kalkairviṭsaṅgānāhamedanaḥ||
8.8.13 |  śvadaṃṣṭrāśmabhideraṇḍarasāttailāt surāsavāt|
prasṛtāḥ pañca yaṣṭyāhvakauntīmāgadhikāsitāḥ||
8.8.14 |  1kalkaḥ syānmūtrakṛcchre tu sānāhe bastiruttamaḥ|
ete salavaṇāḥ koṣṇā nirūhāḥ prasṛtairnava||
8.8.15 |  mṛdubastijaḍībhūte tīkṣṇo 'nyo bastiriṣyate|
tīkṣṇairvikarṣite svādu pratyāsthāpanamiṣyate1 | |
8.8.16 |  vātopasṛṣṭasyoṣṇaiḥ 1syurgudadāhādayo yadi|
drākṣāmbunā trivṛtkalkaṃ dadyāddoṣānulomanam||
8.8.17 |  taddhi pittaśakṛdvātān hṛtvā dāhādikāñjayet|
śuddhaścāpi pibecchītāṃ yavāgūṃ śarkarāyutām||
8.8.18 |  athavā 'tiviriktaḥ syāt kṣīṇaviṭkaḥ sa bhakṣayet|
māṣayūṣeṇa kulmāṣān pibenmadhvathavā1 surām||
8.8.19 |  1sāmaṃ cet kuṇapaṃ śūlairupaviśedarocakī|
sa ghanātiviṣākuṣṭhanatadāruvacāḥ pibet||
8.8.20 |  śakṛdvātamasṛk pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā yo 'tisāryate|
1pakvaṃ, tatra svavargīyairbastiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ bhiṣagjitam||
8.8.21 |  ṣaṇṇāmeṣāṃ dvisaṃsargāt triṃśadbhedā bhavanti tu|
kevalaiḥ saha ṣaṭtriṃśadvidyāt sopadravānapi||
8.8.22 |  śūlapravāhikādhmānaparikartyarucijvarān|
tṛṣṇoṣṇadāhamūrcchādīṃścaiṣāṃ vidyādupadravān||
8.8.23 |  1tatrāme 'ntarapānaṃ syāt vyoṣāmlalavaṇairyutam|
pācanaṃ śasyate bastirāme hi pratiṣidhyate||
8.8.24 |  vātaghnairgrāhivargīyairbastiḥ śakṛti śasyate|
svādvamlalavaṇaiḥ śastaḥ snehabastiḥ samīraṇe||
8.8.25 |  rakte raktena, pitte tu kaṣāyasvādutiktakaiḥ|
sāryamāṇe kaphe bastiḥ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaiḥ||
8.8.26 |  śakṛtā vāyunā vā++āme tena varcasyathānile|
saṃsṛṣṭe 'ntarapānaṃ syād vyoṣāmlalavaṇairyutam||
8.8.27 |  pittenāme 'sṛjā vā 'pi tayorāmena vā punaḥ|
saṃsṛṣṭayorbhavet pānaṃ savyoṣasvādutiktakam||
8.8.28 |  tathā++āme kaphasaṃsṛṣṭe kaṣāyavyoṣatiktakam|
āmena tu kaphe vyoṣakaṣāyalavaṇairyutam||
8.8.29 |  vātena viśi pitte vā viṭpittābhyāṃ1 tathā 'nile|
madhurāmlakaṣāyaḥ syāt saṃsṛṣṭe bastiruttamaḥ||
8.8.30 |  śakṛcchoṇitayoḥ pittaśakṛto raktapittayoḥ|
bastiranyonyasaṃsarge kaṣāyasvādutiktakaḥ||
8.8.31 |  kaphena viśi pitte vā kaphe viṭpittaśoṇitaiḥ|
vyoṣatiktakaṣāyaḥ syāt saṃsṛṣṭe bastiruttamaḥ||
8.8.32 |  syādbastirvyoṣatiktāmlaḥ saṃsṛṣṭe vāyunā kaphe|
madhuravyoṣatiktastu rakte kaphavimūrcchite||
8.8.33 |  mārute kaphasaṃsṛṣṭe vyoṣāmlalavaṇo bhavet|
bastirvātena 1pitte tu kāryaḥ svādvamlatiktakaḥ||
8.8.34 |  tricatuḥpañcasaṃsargānevameva vikalpayet|
yuktiścaiṣātisāroktā sarvarogeṣvapi smṛtā||
8.8.35 |  yugapat ṣaḍrasaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saṃsarge pācanaṃ bhavet1 | 
nirāmāṇāṃtu pañcānāṃ bastiḥ ṣāḍrasiko mataḥ||
8.8.36 |  udumbaraśalāṭūni jambvāmrodumbaratvacaḥ|
śaṅkhaṃ sarjarasaṃ lākṣāṃ kardamaṃ ca palāṃśikam||
8.8.37 |  piṣṭvā taiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ kṣīradviguṇitaṃ pacet|
atīsāreṣu sarveṣu peyametadyathābalam||
8.8.38 |  kacchurādhātakībilvasamaṅgāraktaśālibhiḥ|
masūrāśvatthaśuṅgaiśca yavāgūḥ syājjale śṛtaiḥ||
8.8.39 |  1bālodumbarakaṭvaṅgasamaṅgāplakṣapallavaiḥ|
masūradhātakīpuṣpabalābhiśca tathā bhavet||
8.8.40 |  sthirādīnāṃ 1balādīnāmikṣvādīnāmathāpi vā|
kvātheṣu samasūrāṇāṃ yavāgvaḥ syuḥ pṛthak pṛthak||
8.8.41 |  kacchurāmūlaśālyāditaṇḍulairupasādhitāḥ|
dadhitakrāranālāmlakṣīreṣvikṣurase 'pi vā||
8.8.42 |  śītāḥ saśarkarākṣaudrāḥ sarvātīsāranāśanāḥ|
sasarpirmaricājājyo madhurā lavaṇāḥ śivāḥ||
8.8.43 |  bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ---
snigdhāmlalavaṇamadhuraṃ pānaṃ bastiśca mārute koṣṇaḥ|
śītaṃ tiktakaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ pitte ca rakte ca||
8.8.44 |  tiktoṣṇakaṣāyakaṭuśleṣmaṇi saṃgrāhi vātanucchakṛti pācanamāme pānaṃ picchāsṛgbastayo rakte||
8.8.45 |  atisāraṃ pratyuktaṃ miśraṃ 1dvandvādiyogajeṣvapi ca|
tatrodrekaviśeṣāddoṣeṣūpakramaḥ kāryaḥ||
8.8.46 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
prāsṛtikāḥ savyāpatkriyā nirūhāstathā 'tisārahitāḥ|
1rasakalpaghṛtayavāgvaścoktā guruṇā prasṛtasiddhau||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne 1prāsṛtayogīyasiddhirnāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8 | |

navamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.9.1 |  athātastrimarmīyāṃ siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.9.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.9.3 |  saptottaraṃ marmaśatamasmiñcharīre skandhaśākhāsamāśritamagniveśa!|
teṣāmanyatamapīḍāyāṃ samadhikā pīḍā bhavati, cetanānibandhavaiśeṣyāt|
tatra śākhāśritebhyo marmabhyaḥ skandhāśritāni garīyāṃsi, śākhānāṃ tadāśritatvāt; skandhāśritebhyo 'pi hṛdbastiśirāṃsi, tanmūlatvāccharīrasya||
8.9.4 |  tatra hṛdaye1 daśa dhamanyaḥ prāṇāpānau1 namo buddhiścetanā mahābhūtāni ca nābhyāmarā iva pratiṣṭhitāni, śirasi indriyāṇi indriyaprāṇavahāni ca srotāṃsi sūryamiva gabhastayaḥ saṃśritāni, bastistu sthūlagudamuṣkasevanīśukramūtravāhinīnāṃ1 nāḍī(lī)nāṃ madhye mūtradhāro 'mbuvahānāṃ sarvasrotasāmudadhirivāpagānāṃ 1pratiṣṭhā, bahubhiśca tanmūlairmarmasaṃjñakaiḥ srotobhirgaganamiva dinakarakarairvyāptamidaṃ śarīram||

8.9.7 |  kiṃtvetāni viśeṣato 'nilādrakṣyāṇi, anilo hi pittakaphasamūdīraṇe hetuḥ prāṇamūlaṃ ca, sa bastikarmasādhyatamaḥ, tasmānna bastisamaṃ kiñcit karma marmaparipālanamasti|
tatra ṣaḍāsthāpanaskandhān vimāne dvau cānuvāsanaskandhāviha ca vihitān bastīn buddhyā vicārya mahāmarmaparipālanārthaṃ prayojayedvātavyādhicikitsāṃ ca||
8.9.8 |  1bhūyaśca hṛdyupasṛṣṭe hiṅgucūrṇaṃ lavaṇānāmanyatamacūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ 1mātuluṅgasya rasenānyena vā 'mlena hṛdyena vā pāyayet, sthirādipañcamūlīrasaḥ saśarkaraḥ pānārthaṃ, bilvādipañcamūlarasasiddhā ca yavāgūḥ, hṛdrogavihitaṃ ca karma; mūrdhni tu vātopasṛṣṭe 'bhyaṅgasvedanopanāhasnehapānanastaḥ karmāvapīḍanadhūmādīni; bastau tu kumbhīsvedaḥ, vartayaḥ, śyāmādibhirgomūtrasiddho nirūhaḥ, bilvādibhiśca surāsiddhaḥ, śarakāśekṣudarbhagokṣurakamūlaśṛtakṣīraiśca1 trapusairvārukharāśvābījayavarṣabhakavṛddhikalkito nirūhaḥ, pītadārusiddhatailenānuvāsanaṃ, tailvakaṃ ca sarpirvirekārthaṃ, śatāvarīgokṣurakabṛhatīkaṇṭakārikāguḍūcīpunarnavośīramadhukadvisārivālodhraśreyasīkuśakāśamūlakaṣāyakṣīracaturguṇaṃ balāvṛṣarṣabhakakharāśvopakuñcikāvatsakatrapusairvārubījaśitivārakamadhukavacāśatapuṣpāśmabhedakavarṣābhūmadanaphalakalkasiddhaṃ tailamuttarabastirnirūho vā śuddhasnigdhasvinnasya bastiśūlamūtravikārahara iti||

kṛte ca svedayedbhūya ākarṣecca punaḥ punaḥ||
8.9.104 |  taṃ snehaṃ śleṣmaṇā 1sākaṃ tathā sneho na tiṣṭhati|
svedenotkleśitaḥ śleṣmā nastaḥkarmaṇyupasthitaḥ1 | |
8.9.105 |  bhūyaḥ snehasya śaityena śirasi styāyate1 tataḥ|
śrotramanyāgalādyeṣu vikārāya sa kalpate||
8.9.106 |  tato nastaḥkṛte dhūmaṃ pibet kaphavināśanam1 | 
hitānnabhuṅnivātoṣṇasevī syānniyatendriyaḥ||
8.9.107 |  vidhireṣo 'vapīḍasya kāryaḥ pradhmāpanasya tu|
tat 1ṣaḍaṅgulayā nāḍyā dhameccūrṇaṃ mukhena tu||
8.9.108 |  viriktaśirasaṃ 1tūṣṇaṃ pāyayitvā 'mbu bhojayet|
laghu triṣvaviruddhaṃ ca nivātasthamatandritaḥ||
8.9.109 |  virekaśuddho doṣasya kopanaṃ yasya sevate|
sa doṣo vicaraṃstatra karoti svān gadān bahūn||
8.9.110 |  yathāsvaṃ vihitāṃ teṣu kriyāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ|
akālakṛtajātānāṃ rogāṇāmanurūpataḥ||
8.9.111 |  1ajīrṇe bhojane bhukte toye pīte 'tha durdine|
pratiśyāye nave 1snāte snehapāne 'nuvāsane||
8.9.112 |  nāvanaṃ snehanaṃ rogān karoti ślaiṣmikān bahūn|
tatra śleṣmaharaḥ sarvastīkṣṇoṣṇādirvidhirhitaḥ||
8.9.113 |  kṣāme virecite garbhe vyāyāmābhihate tṛṣi|
vāto rūkṣeṇa nasyena kruddhaḥ svāñjanayednādgadān||
8.9.114 |  tatra vātaharaḥ sarvo vidhiḥ snehanabṛṃhaṇaḥ|
svedādiḥ, syādghṛtaṃ 1kṣīraṃ garbhiṇyāstu viśeṣataḥ||
8.9.115 |  jvaraśokātitaptānāṃ timiraṃ madyapasya tu|
rūkṣśaiḥ śītāñjanairlepaiḥ puṭapākaiśca 1sādhayet||
8.9.116 |  snehanaṃ śodhanaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ 1nāvanaṃ matam|
pratimarśastu nasyārthaṃ karoti na ca doṣavān||
8.9.117 |  nastaḥ snehāṅguliṃ dadyāt prātarniśi ca sarvadā|
na cocchiṅghedarogāṇāṃ pratimarśaḥ sa dārḍyakṛt||
8.9.118 |  tatra ślokau---
trīṇi yasmāt pradhānāni marmāṇyabhihateṣu ca|
teṣu liṅgaṃ cikitsāṃ ca rogabhedāśca sauṣadhāḥ||
8.9.119 |  vidhiruttarabasteśca nastaḥkarmavidhistathā|
savyāpadbheṣajaṃ siddhau marmākhyāyāṃ prakīrtitam||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne trimarmīyasiddhirnāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ||9 | |

daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.10.1 |  athāto bastisiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.10.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.10.3 |  siddhānāṃ bastīnāṃ śastānāṃ teṣu teṣu rogeṣu|
śṛṇvagniveśa! gadataḥ siddhiṃ siddhipradāṃ bhiṣajām||
8.10.4 |  baladoṣakālarogaprakṛtīḥ pravibhajya yojitāḥ samyak|
svaiḥ svairauṣadhavargaiḥ svān 1svān rogānniyacchanti||
8.10.5 |  karmānyadbastisamaṃ na vidyate śīghrasukhaviśodhitvāt|
āśvapatarpaṇatarpaṇayogācca niratyayatvācca||
8.10.6 |  satyapi doṣaharatve kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇādi bheṣajādānāt|
duḥkhodgārotkleśāhṛdyatvakoṣṭharujā vireke syuḥ||
8.10.7 |  avirecyau śiśuvṛddhau tāvaprāptaprahīnadhātubalau|

8.10.8 |  balavarṇaharṣamārdavagātrasnehānnṛṇāṃ dadātyāśu|

8.10.9 |  śākhāvātārtānāṃ 1sakuñcitastabdhabhagnarugṇānām|

8.10.10 |  uṣṇārtānāṃ śītāñchītārtānāṃ tathā sukhoṣṇāṃśca|

8.10.11 |  bastīnna bṛṃhaṇīyān 1dadyād vyādhiṣu viśodhanīyeṣu|

8.10.12 |  na kṣīṇakṣatadurbalamūrcchitakṛśaśuṣkadehānām|

8.10.13 |  vājīkaraṇe 'sṛkpittayośca madhughṛtapayoyuktāḥ|

8.10.14 |  yuñjāddravyāṇi bastiṣvamlaṃ mūtraṃ payaḥ surāṃ kvāthān|

8.10.15 |  suradāruśatāhvailākuṣṭhamadhukapippalīmadhusnehāḥ|
ūrdhvānulomabhāgāḥ sasarṣapāḥ śarkarā lavaṇam||
8.10.16 |  1āvāpā bastīnāmataḥ prayojyāni yeṣu yāni syuḥ|
yuktāni saha kaṣāyaistānyuttarataḥ pravakṣyāmi||
8.10.17 |  cirajātakaṭhinabaleṣu vyādhiṣu tīkṣṇā viparyaye mṛdavaḥ|
saprativāpakaṣāyā yojyāstvanuvāsananirūhāḥ||
8.10.18 |  ardhaślokairataḥ siddhān nānāvyādhiṣu 1sarvaśaḥ|
bastīn vīryasamairbhāgairyathārhāloḍanāñchṛṇu||
8.10.19 |  bilvo 'gnimanthaḥ śyonākaḥ kāśmaryaḥ pāṭalistathā|
śālaparṇī pṛśniparṇī bṛhatyau vardhamānakaḥ||
8.10.20 |  yavāḥ kulatthāḥ kolāni sthirā ceti trayo 'nile|
śasyante sacatuḥsnehāḥ piśitasya rasānvitāḥ||
8.10.21 |  nalavañjulavānīraśatapatrāṇi śaivalam|
mañjiṣṭhā sārivā 'nantā payasyā madhuyaṣṭikā||
8.10.22 |  candanaṃ padmakośīraṃ tuṅgaṃ te paittike trayaḥ|
saśarkarākṣaudraghṛtāḥ sakṣīrā bastayo hitāḥ||
8.10.23 |  arkastathaiva cālarka ekāṣṭhīlā punarnavā|
haridrā triphalā mustaṃ pītadāru kuṭannaṭam||
8.10.24 |  pippalyaścitrakaśceti trayaste śleṣmarogiṣu1 | 
sakṣārakṣaudragomūtrā nātisnehānvitā hitāḥ||
8.10.25 |  phalajīmūtakekṣvākudhāmārgavakavatsakāḥ1 | 
śyāmā ca 1triphalā caiva sthirā dantī dravantyapi||
8.10.26 |  prakīryā codakīryā ca nīlinī kṣīriṇī tathā|
saptalā śaṅkhinī lodhraṃ phalaṃ kampillakasya ca||
8.10.27 |  catvāro mūtrasiddhāste pakvāśayaviśodhanāḥ|
(vyastairapi samastaiśca caturyogā udāhṛtāḥ1 | |)
8.10.28 |  kākolī kṣīrakākolī 1mudgaparṇī śatāvarī|

8.10.29 |  ātmaguptāphalaṃ māṣāḥ sagodhūmā yavāstathā|
1jalajānūpajaṃ māṃsamityete śukramāṃsalāḥ1 | |
8.10.30 |  jīvantī cāgnimanthaśca dhātakīpuṣpavatsakau|
pragrahaḥ khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ śamī piṇḍītako yavāḥ||
8.10.31 |  priyaṅgū raktamūlī ca taruṇī svarṇayūthikā|
vaṭādyāḥ kiṃśukaṃ lodhramiti sāṃgrāhikā matāḥ||
8.10.32 |  1parisrāve śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ savṛścīrapunarnavam|
ākhupariṇikayā vā 'pi taṇḍulīyakayuktayā||
8.10.33 |  kālaṅkatakakāṇḍekṣudarbhapoṭagalekṣubhiḥ1 | 
dāhaghraḥ saghṛtakṣīro dvitīyaścotpalādibhiḥ||
8.10.34 |  karbudārāḍhakīnīpavidulaiḥ kṣīrasādhitaiḥ|
bastiḥ pradeyo bhiṣajā śītaḥ samadhuśarkaraḥ||
8.10.35 |  parikarte tathā vṛntaiḥ śrīparṇīkovidārajaiḥ|
(deyo bastiḥ suvaidyaistu yathāvadviditakriyaiḥ1 | |)
8.10.36 |  1bastiḥ śālmalivṛntānāṃ kṣīrasiddho ghṛtānvitaḥ|

8.10.37 |  aśvāvarohikākākanāsārājakaśerukaiḥ|
siddhāḥ kṣīre 'tiyoge syuḥ kṣaudrāñjanaghṛtairyutāḥ||
8.10.38 |  nyagrodhādyaiścaturbhiśca tenaiva vidhinā paraḥ|

8.10.39 |  kāśmaryabadarīdūrvāstathośīrapriyaṅgavaḥ|

8.10.40 |  bastī pradeyau bhiṣajā śītau samadhuśarkarau|

8.10.41 |  śaśaiṇadakṣamārjāramahiṣāvyajaśoṇitaiḥ|

8.10.42 |  madhūkamadhukadrākṣādūrvākāśmaryacandanaiḥ|

8.10.43 |  mañjiṣṭhāsārivānantāpayasyāmadhukaistathā|

8.10.44 |  gulmātisārodāvartastambhasaṅkucitādiṣu|
sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogeṣu rogeṣvevaṃvidheṣu ca||
8.10.45 |  yathāsvairauṣadhaiḥ siddhān bastīn dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ|
pūrvoktena vidhānena kurvan yogān pṛthagvidhān||
8.10.46 |  tatra ślokāḥ---
trikāstrayo 'nilādīnāṃ catuṣkāścāpare trayaḥ|
pakvāśayaviśuddhyarthaṃ vṛṣyāḥ sāṃgrāhikāstathā||
8.10.47 |  parisrāve tathā dāhe parikarte pravāhaṇe|
sātiyoge matau dvau dvau jīvādāne tathā trayaḥ||
8.10.48 |  dvau raktapitte mehe ca ekatriṃśacca sapta te|
sulabhālpauṣadhakleśā bastayo guṇavattamāḥ||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne bastisiddhirnāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||10 | |

ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.11.1 |  athātaḥ phalamātrāsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.11.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.11.3 |  bhagavantamudārasattvadhīśrutivijñānasamṛddhamatrijam|
phalabastivaratvaniścaye savivādā munayo 'bhyupāgaman||
8.11.4 |  bhṛgukauśikakāpyaśaunakāḥ sapulastyāsitagautamādayaḥ|
katamat pravaraṃ phalādiṣu smṛtamāsthāpanayojanāsviti||
8.11.5 |  kaphapittaharaṃ varaṃ phaleṣvatha jīmūtakamāha śaunakaḥ|
mṛduvīryatayā 'bhinatti tacchakṛdityāha nṛpo 'tha vāmakaḥ||
8.11.6 |  kaṭutumbamamanyatottamaṃ vamane doṣasamīraṇaṃ ca tat|
1tadavṛṣyamaśaityatīkṣṇatākaṭuraukṣyāditi gautamo 'bravīt||
8.11.7 |  kaphapittanirbahaṇaṃ paraṃ sa ca 1dhāmārgavamityamanyata|
tadamanyata vātalaṃ punarbaḍiśo glānikaraṃ balāpaham||
8.11.8 |  kuṭajaṃ praśaśaṃsa cottamaṃ na balaghnaṃ kaphapittahāri ca|
ativijjalamaurdhvabhāgikaṃ pavanakṣobhi ca kāpya āha tat||
8.11.9 |  kṛtavedhanamāha vātalaṃ kaphapittaṃ prabalaṃ harediti|
tadasādhviti bhadraśaunakaḥ kaṭukaṃ cātibalaghnamityapi||
8.11.10 |  iti tadvacanāni hetubhiḥ suvicitrāṇi niśamya buddhimān1 | 
praśaśaṃsa phaleṣu niścayaṃ paramaṃ cātrisuto 'bravīdidam||
8.11.11 |  phaladoṣaguṇān sarasvatī pratisarvairapi samyagīritā|
na tu kiṃcidadoṣanirguṇaṃ guṇabhūyastvamato vicintyate1 | |
8.11.12 |  iha kuṣṭhahitā garāgarī hitamikṣvāku tu mehine matam|
kuṭajasya phalaṃ hṛdāmaye pravaraṃ koṭhaphalaṃ ca pāṇḍuṣu||
8.11.13 |  udare kṛtavedhanaṃ hitaṃ, madanaṃ sarvagadāvirodhi tu|
madhuraṃ sakaṣāyatiktakaṃ tadarūkṣaṃ sakaṭūṣṇavijjalam||
8.11.14 |  kaphapittahṛdāśukāri cāpyanapāyaṃ pavanānulomi ca|
phalanāma viśeṣatastvato labhate 'nyeṣu phaleṣu satsvapi||
8.11.15 |  guruṇeti vacasyudāhṛte munisaṅghena ca pūjite 1tataḥ|
praṇipatya mudā samanvitaḥ sahitaḥ śiṣyagaṇo 'nupṛṣṭavān||
8.11.16 |  sarvakarmaguṇakṛdguruṇokto bastirūrdhvamatha naiti nābhitaḥ|
nābhyadho gudamataḥ sa śarīrāt sarvataḥ kathamapohati doṣān1 | |
8.11.17 |  tadgururabravīdidaṃ śarīraṃ tantrayate 'nilaḥ saṅgavighātāt1 | 
kevala eva doṣasahito vā svāśayagaḥ prakopamupayāti||
8.11.18 |  taṃ pavanaṃ sapittakaphaviṭkaṃ śuddhikaro 'nulomayati bastiḥ|
sarvaśarīragaśca gadasaṃghastatpraśamāt praśāntimupayāti||
8.11.19 |  1athādhigamyārthamakhaṇḍitaṃ dhiyā 1gajoṣṭragośvāvyajakarma roganut|
apṛcchadenaṃ sa ca bastimabravīdvidhiṃ ca tasyāha punaḥ pracoditaḥ||
8.11.20 |  ājoraṇau saumya gajoṣṭrayoḥ kṛte gavāśvayorbastimuśanti māhiṣam|
ajāvikānāṃ tu jaradgavodbhavaṃ vadanti bastiṃ tadupāyacintakāḥ||
8.11.21 |  aratnimaṣṭādaśaṣoḍaśāṅgulaṃ tathaiva netraṃ hi 1daśāṅgulaṃ kramāt|
gajoṣṭragośvāvyajabastisaṃdhau caturthabhāgopanayaṃ hitaṃ vadet1 | |
8.11.22 |  1prasthastvajāvyorhi nirūhamātrā gavādiṣu dvitriguṇaṃ yathābalam|
nirūhamuṣṭrasya tathā++āḍhakadvayaṃ gajasya vṛddhistvanuvāsane 'ṣṭamaḥ||
8.11.23 |  kaliṅgakuṣṭhe madhukaṃ ca pippalī vacā śatāhvā madanaṃ rasāñjanam|
hitāni sarveṣu guḍaḥ sasaindhavo dvipañcamūlaṃ ca vikalpanā tviyam||
8.11.24 |  gaje 'dhikā 'śvatthavaṭāśvakarṇakāḥ sakhādirapragrahaśālatālajāḥ|
tathā ca parṇyau dhavaśigrupāṭalīmadhūkasārāḥ sanikumbhacitrakāḥ||
8.11.25 |  palāśabhūtīkasurāhvarohiṇīkaṣāya uktastvadhiko gavāṃ hitaḥ|
palāśadantīsuradārukattṛṇadravantya uktāsturagasya cādhikāḥ||
8.11.26 |  kharoṣṭrayoḥ pīlukarīrakhādirāḥ 1śamyākabilvādigaṇasya ca cchadāḥ|ajāvikānāṃ triphalāparūṣakaṃ kapitthakarkandhu sabilvakolajam||
8.11.27 |  athāgniveśaḥ satatāturān narān hitaṃ 1ca papraccha gurustadāha ca|
sadā++āturāḥ śrotriyarājasevakāstathaiva veśyā saha paṇyajīvibhiḥ||
8.11.28 |  dvijohi 1vedādhyayanavratāhnikakriyādibhirdehahitaṃ na 1ceṣṭate|

8.11.29 |  nṛcittavartinyupacāratatparā mṛjābhi(vi)bhūṣāniratā paṇāṅganā|

8.11.30 |  sadaiva te hyāgataveganigrahaṃ 1samācarante na ca kālabhojanam|
akālanirhāravihārasevino bhavanti ye 'nye 'pi sadā++āturāśca te||
8.11.31 |  samīraṇaṃ vegavidhāraṇoddhataṃ vibandhasarvāṅgarujākaraṃ bhiṣak|
samīkṣya teṣāṃ phalavartimāditaḥ sukalpitāṃ snehavatīṃ prayojayet||
8.11.32 |  punarnavairaṇḍanikumbhacitrakān sadevadārutrivṛtānidigdhikān|
mahānti mūlāni ca pañca yāni vipācya mūtre dadhimastusaṃyute||
8.11.33 |  satailasarpirlavaṇaiśca pañcabhirvimūrcchitaṃ bastimatha prayojayet|
nirūhitaṃ dhanvarasena bhojitaṃ nikumbhatailena tato 'nuvāsayet||
8.11.34 |  balāṃ sarāsnāṃ phalabilvacitrakān dvipañcamūlaṃ 1kṛtamālakāt phalam|
yavān kulatthāṃśca pacejjalāḍhake rasaḥ sa peṣyaistu kaliṅgakādibhiḥ||
8.11.35 |  1satilasarpirguḍasaindhavo hitaḥ sadāturāṇāṃ balavarṇavardhanaḥ|
tathā 'nuvāsye madhukena sādhitaṃ phalena bilvena śatāhvayā 'pi vā||
8.11.36 |  sajīvanīyastu raso 'nuvāsane nirūhaṇe cālavaṇaḥ śiśorhitaḥ|
na cānyadāśvaṅgabalābhivardhanaṃ nirūhabasteḥ śiśuvṛddhayoḥ param||
8.11.37 |  tatra ślokaḥ---
phalakarma bastivaratā netraṃ yadbastayo gavādīnām|
satatāturāśca diṣṭāḥ phalamātrāyāṃ hitaṃ caiṣām||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne phalamātrāsiddhirnāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||11 | |

dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|
8.12.1 |  athāta uttarabastisiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||
8.12.2 |  iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||
8.12.3 |  atha khalvāturaṃ vaidyaḥ saṃśuddhaṃ vamanādibhiḥ|
durbalaṃ kṛśamalpāgniṃ muktasaṃdhānabandhanam||
8.12.4 |  nirhṛtānilaviṇmūtrakaphapittaṃ kṛśāśayam|
śūnyadehaṃ pratīkārāsahiṣṇuṃ paripālayet||
8.12.5 |  yathā 'ṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ tailapātraṃ 1yathaiva ca|
gopāla iva daṇḍī gāḥ sarvasmādapacārataḥ||
8.12.6 |  agnisaṃdhukṣaṇārthaṃ tu pūrvaṃ peyādinā bhiṣak|
rasottareṇopacaret krameṇa kramakovidaḥ||
8.12.7 |  snigdhāmlasvāduhṛdyāni tato 'mlalavaṇau rasau|
svādutiktau tato bhūyaḥ kaṣāyakaṭukau tataḥ||
8.12.8 |  anyo 'nyapratyanīkānāṃ rasānāṃ snigdharūkṣayoḥ|
vyatyāsādupayogena prakṛtiṃ gamayedbhiṣak||
8.12.9 |  1sarvakṣamo hyasaṃsargo ratiyuktaḥ sthirendriyaḥ|

karmaṇāṃ vamanādīnāmasamyakkaraṇāpadām||
8.12.34 |  yatroktaṃ sādhanaṃ sthāne siddhisthānaṃ taducyate|
ityadhyāyaśataṃ viṃśamātreyamunivāṅgyam||
8.12.35 |  hitārthaṃ prāṇināṃ proktamagniveśena dhīmatā|
dīrghamāyuryaśaḥ 1svāsthyaṃ trivargaṃ cāpi puṣkalam||
8.12.36 |  siddhiṃ cānuttamāṃ loke prāpnoti vidhinā paṭhan|
vistārayati leśoktaṃ saṃkṣipatyativistaram||
8.12.37 |  saṃskartā kurute tantraṃ purāṇaṃ ca punarnavam|
atastantrottamamidaṃ carakeṇātibuddhinā||
8.12.38 |  saṃskṛtaṃ tattvasaṃpūrṇaṃ tribhāgenopalakṣyate|
tacchaṅkaraṃ bhūtapatiṃ saṃprasādya samāpayat||
8.12.39 |  akhaṇḍārthaṃ dṛḍhabalo jātaḥ pañcanade pure|
kṛtvā bahubhyastantrebhyo viśeṣoñchaśiloccayam||
8.12.40 |  saptadaśauṣadhādhyāyasiddhikalpairapūrayat|
idamanyūnaśabdārthaṃ tantradoṣavivarjitam||
8.12.41 |  ṣaḍviṃśatā vicitrābhirbhūṣitaṃ tantrayuktibhiḥ|
tatrādhikaraṇaṃ yogo hetvartho 'rthaḥ padasya ca||
8.12.42 |  pradeśoddeśanirdeśavākyaśeṣāḥ prayojanam|
upadeśāpadeśātideśārthāpattinirṇayāḥ||
8.12.43 |  prasaṅgaikāntanaikāntāḥ sāpavargo viparyayaḥ|
pūrvapakṣavidhānānumatavyākhyānasaṃśayāḥ||
8.12.44 |  atītānāgatāvekṣāsvasaṃjñohyasamuccayāḥ|
nidarśanaṃ nirvacanaṃ saṃniyogo vikalpanam||
8.12.45 |  pratyutsārastathoddhāraḥ saṃbhavastantrayuktayaḥ|
tantre samāsavyāsokte bhavantyetā hi kṛtsnaśaḥ||
8.12.46 |  ekadeśena dṛśyante samāsābhihite tathā|
yathā 'mbujavanasyārkaḥ pradīpo veśmano yathā||
8.12.47 |  prabodhanaprakāśārthastathā tantrasya yuktayaḥ|
ekasminnapi yasyeha śāstre labdhāspadā matiḥ||
8.12.48 |  sa śāstramanyadapyāśu yuktijñatvāt prabudhyate|
adhīyāno 'pi śāstrāṇi tantrayuktyā1 vinā bhiṣak|
nādhigacchati śāstrārthānarthān bhāgyakṣaye yathā||
8.12.49 |  durgṛhītaṃ kṣiṇotyeva śāstraṃ śastramivābudham|
sugṛhītaṃ tadeva jñaṃ śāstraṃ śastraṃ ca rakṣati||
8.12.50 |  (tasmādetāḥ pravakṣyante vistareṇottare punaḥ|
tattvajñānārthamasyaiva tantrasya guṇadoṣataḥ)||
8.12.51 |  idamakhilamadhītya samyagarthān vimṛśati yo 'vimanāḥ prayoganityaḥ|
sa manujasukhajīvitapradātā bhavati dhṛtismṛtibuddhidharmavṛddhaḥ||
(8.12.52 |  yasya dvādaśasāhasrī hṛdi tiṣṭhati saṃhitā|
so 'rthajñaḥ sa vicārajñaścikitsākuśalaśca saḥ||
8.12.53 |  rogāṃsteṣāṃ cikitsāṃ ca sa kimarthaṃ na budhyate|
cikitsā vahniveśasya susthāturahitaṃ prati||
8.12.54 |  yadihāsti tadanyatra yannehāsti na tatkvacit|
agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte||
8.12.55 |  siddhisthāne 'ṣṭame prāpte tasmin dṛḍhabalena tu|
siddhisthānaṃ svasiddhyarthaṃ samāsena samāpitam||)

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne uttarabastisiddhirnāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||12 | |

samāptamidaṃ carakatantram|
